p0426, སངས་རྒྱས་ཀྱི་ལམ་རྣལ་མ = 'đạo chân thật của Phật'. No entry. Kept distinct from དམ་པ = 'chân chính' (glossary, in བཤེས་གཉེན་དམ་པ) so the two adjectives stay separable.

terms.vi: Trình bày rằng do tu học riêng lẻ từng bên phương tiện và trí tuệ thì không thành tựu quả Phật
terms.note: Outline heading, sectionPath 6.2.3.1.10.2. No entry for the heading nor for ཐབས་ཤེས as a compound; the ཐབས entry's note cites ཐབས་ཤེས་ཡ་བྲལ = 'phương tiện và trí tuệ tách rời nhau', with which 'phương tiện và trí tuệ' here is consistent. རེ་རེ་བ་ལ་བསླབས་པ rendered 'tu học riêng lẻ từng bên'. Register the heading and, if useful, ཐབས་ཤེས = 'phương tiện và trí tuệ' as the compound's standing form.

terms.vi: sự tu tập (as used at p0425 l.1, three times)
terms.note: No bare སྒྲུབ་པ entry; the སྒྲུབ་པ་པོ entry's note already records that glossary.json renders སྒྲུབ་པ as 'tu tập' inside སྒྲུབ་པའི་ཆོས and flags the open question. Within this chunk སྒྲུབ་པ ('sự tu tập', p0425) and བསྒོམ་པ ('tu tập' / 'tu', pp0426-427) collapse onto one Vietnamese word, so two distinct Tibetan verbs are no longer distinguishable in the Vietnamese. A ruling is needed, e.g. སྒྲུབ་པ = 'tu hành' / 'thực hành' vs བསྒོམ་པ = 'tu tập'. Wording left unchanged pending that ruling — see 'remaining'.

terms.vi: Kinh Vô Cấu Xưng Sở Thuyết
terms.note: p0429. Rendered from the Tibetan components (དྲི་མ་མེད་པར་གྲགས་པ = Vô Cấu Xưng, བསྟན་པ = sở thuyết), matching 說無垢稱經. Already used in this exact form by c136 line 30; not yet in glossary.json.

terms.vi: Cát Tường Tối Thắng Đệ Nhất
terms.note: p0429. From the components: དཔལ = Cát Tường (śrī), མཆོག = tối thắng (parama), དང་པོ = đệ nhất (ādya). No established Vietnamese title found; not verified against an existing edition.
p0430. གཙུག་ན་རིན་པོ་ཆེ = jewel on the crown = Ratnacūḍa; established Sino-Vietnamese 寶髻 = Bảo Kế. Distinct from the glossary's གཙུག་གི་ནོར་བུ = 'bảo châu trên đỉnh đầu' (a term, not a title).

p0431 (×2), p0432 as རྗེ་བཙུན་མ་ཕམ་པ = 'đức Chí Tôn Vô Năng Thắng'. Epithet of Maitreya; the Sarvavaidalyasaṃgraha passage alternates བྱམས་པ (Di-lặc) and མ་ཕམ་པ within the same dialogue, so the two must stay distinct in Vietnamese. Follows c004 l.29 and c009 l.50.
p0429, ×6 in the Vimalakīrti passage, contrasted throughout with ཐར་པ = giải thoát (glossary, fixed). No entry.

terms.vi: tánh không đầy đủ tối thắng của tất cả hành tướng
terms.note: p0429–p0430, ×4 (incl. the contracted verse form རྣམ་པ་ཀུན་གྱི་མཆོག་ལྡན་པ, rendered 'tánh không đầy đủ tối thắng của mọi hành tướng'). Controlling term of this chunk. Uses the glossary's སྟོང་པ་ཉིད = tánh không (fixed).

p0429, ཡ་བྲལ་གྱིས་མི་འགྲུབ. Matches the wording already recorded in the glossary's ཐབས entry note ('ཐབས་ཤེས་ཡ་བྲལ = phương tiện và trí tuệ tách rời nhau') but has no entry of its own; it is also the operative word of this section's headword ཐབས་ཤེས་རེ་རེ་བ.

p0432 (×2). Follows the glossary's ཡེ་ཤེས = trí; kept apart from the glossary's མི་རྟོག་པའི་ཏིང་ངེ་འཛིན = 'định vô phân biệt'. Bare རྣམ་པར་མི་རྟོག་པ later in the same sentence rendered 'cái vô phân biệt'.
p0430, Ratnacūḍa quotation. Uses the glossary's བྱམས་པ = từ (the quality sense, not Di-lặc).
p0430, ×4 in the Ratnagotravibhāga king's-portrait simile; the verb འདྲི་བ in the same passage rendered 'vẽ'.
p0431, ཀ་ཤིའི་རྒྱལ་པོ = 'vua xứ Ca-thi'. Established Sino-Vietnamese transcription 迦尸.

terms.vi: đức Chí Tôn Vô Năng Thắng
terms.note: p0432, c133 l.112, in the list of commentators alongside ཀླུ་སྒྲུབ (Long Thọ) and ཐོགས་མེད (Vô Trước). Composed from the registered རྗེ་བཙུན = Chí Tôn plus མ་ཕམ་པ = Vô Năng Thắng above. Register together with the bare form.

terms.vi: Cách thức sửa chữa lại khi đã suy tổn
terms.note: Outline s162, path 6.2.3.1.9.3.3, level 6 → '#' (following c128/c130, which render their own chunk section at '#'). ཉམས་པ = 'suy tổn' per the glossary's གཏོང་བ / ཉམས་པ = 'xả bỏ / suy tổn'; ཕྱིར་བཅོས་པ = 'sửa chữa lại', built on the glossary's ལྟུང་བ་ཕྱིར་བཅོས = 'phục hồi đọa tội' but kept distinct because the object here is the vow/mind, not a downfall.

p0419–p0421, 4×. No glossary entry. The measure/limit of a session, in the debate over whether the aspiring mind is lost only when a ཐུན་ཚོད passes. Rendered 'thời hạn', glossed '[của một thời khóa]' at first occurrence only, since the glossary already fixes ཐུན = 'thời khóa' (ཐུན་མཚམས = 'khoảng giữa các thời khóa').
p0421. ཉེ་བར་འཁོར = Upāli, already rendered 'Ưu-ba-ly' in earlier translated chunks; ཞུས་པ = 'Thỉnh Vấn' per སེང་གེས་ཞུས་པ.

terms.vi: Kinh Văn-thù Sát Độ Trang Nghiêm
terms.note: p0419. Built from the glossary's འཇམ་དཔལ = 'Văn-thù' and བཀོད་པ = 'Trang Nghiêm' (cf. དམ་ཚིག་གསུམ་བཀོད་པ = 'Ba Tam-muội-da Trang Nghiêm'); ཞིང = 'sát độ' (buddha-field). No established Vietnamese title located, so rendered from the Tibetan components.

p0421, Tsongkhapa's own work, referred to in the first person (བདག་གིས་...གཏན་ལ་ཕབ་ཟིན་པས). ཚུལ་ཁྲིམས་ལེའུ = 'Phẩm Giới'; རྣམ་བཤད 'Giải Thuyết' deliberately kept distinct from འགྲེལ་པ = 'chú giải' (glossary: ལམ་སྒྲོན་འགྲེལ་པ = 'Chú Giải Đạo Đăng'). No glossary entry for རྣམ་བཤད at all — a general ruling would help.
p0421, first in the list of masters with differing systems taken from the ལམ་སྒྲོན་འགྲེལ་པ. Sanskrit name kept in transliteration, as with Śāntarakṣita/Candragomin elsewhere in the glossary.

terms.bo: དཔའ་བོ (the ācārya, in the master-list ཨིནྡྲ་བྷཱུ་ཏི…ཞི་བ་འཚོ)
terms.note: SCOPE REQUEST. p0421. Glossary has three དཔའ་བོ entries — འཕགས་པ་དཔའ་བོ = 'bậc Thánh Dũng' (the author), bare དཔའ་བོ = 'đấng Dũng Mãnh' (Buddha epithet, p0188), and 'dũng sĩ' (ordinary sense). None covers bare དཔའ་བོ naming the ācārya in a list of masters. Rendered with the registered author-name 'Thánh Dũng' even though འཕགས་པ is absent from the Tibetan here, on the proper-noun principle.
SCOPE NOTE. Glossary registers ཞི་བ་འཚོ = 'đức Cát Tường Śāntarakṣita', but 'Cát Tường' there renders a དཔལ་ལྡན that is absent on p0421, so the honorific was dropped.
SCOPE NOTE. Glossary registers སློབ་དཔོན་ཆེན་པོ་ཙནྡྲ་གཽ་མི = 'đại A-xà-lê Candragomin'; p0421 has the bare name, so the title was dropped.

terms.vi: một chi phần bị hoại thì cả tập hợp tan hoại
terms.note: p0421, the analogy for why abandoning one being destroys bodhicitta for all. No glossary entry for ཡ་གྱལ (one member of a set/pair); rendered 'chi phần'. ཚོགས་པ here is the aggregation/collection, not the glossary's ཕུན་སུམ་ཚོགས་པ = 'viên mãn'.
p0421, contrasted with སྤྱོད་པ་ལ་ཞུགས་པ ('sự bước vào hành trì'). Built on the glossary's provisional སེམས་བསྐྱེད = 'phát tâm'.
p0419–p0420. Refers back to the six-times-a-day taking of the aspiring mind treated in c126; the Tibetan here says only 'six times', so 'trong ngày' was NOT supplied.

SCOPE SPLIT REQUEST, p0421 l.5, in the master-list `ཞི་བ་ལྷ་དང་ཙནྡྲ་གཽ་མི་དང་ཞི་བ་འཚོ`. glossary.json has ཞི་བ་འཚོ → "đức Cát Tường Śāntarakṣita" (provisional), whose own note says the "Cát Tường" renders དཔལ་ལྡན from the occurrence that fixed it (c007). There is no དཔལ་ or དཔལ་ལྡན here, so the recorded string would import a word the Tibetan does not have. Wording kept. Requested: split into དཔལ་ལྡན་ཞི་བ་འཚོ → "đức Cát Tường Śāntarakṣita" and bare ཞི་བ་འཚོ → "ngài Śāntarakṣita" (matching the bare-name honorific used for ཙནྡྲ་གཽ་མི 'ngài Candragomin' in the same list).

terms.bo: དཔའ་བོ (Āryaśūra, in a list of masters)
terms.note: p0421 l.5, `ཐོགས་མེད་དང་དཔའ་བོ་དང་ཞི་བ་ལྷ`, the Bodhipathapradīpa-pañjikā list. Neither recorded entry covers this: bare དཔའ་བོ → "đấng Dũng Mãnh" is explicitly scoped to the vocative Buddha-epithet at p0188, and འཕགས་པ་དཔའ་བོ → "bậc Thánh Dũng" has an འཕགས་པ absent here. Aligned to the person entry's Vietnamese "bậc Thánh Dũng" because it is the same author (Āryaśūra of the Jātakamālā, cross-linked to སྐྱེས་རབས). Ruling needed on whether bare དཔའ་བོ as this person may keep "Thánh" (the established Sino-Vietnamese name 聖勇) even where འཕགས་པ is unwritten; alternative would be "bậc Dũng", which would split the person across chunks.

p0419 l.5, p0420 l.1 (ll.47, 59, 74; also bare `ནག་ཆོས་རྣམས` → "các hắc pháp" at l.75 and `ནག་ཆོས་གཉིས་པ` → "hắc pháp thứ hai" at l.13). Only the counterpart དཀར་པོའི་ཆོས → "bạch pháp" is recorded. "hắc pháp" is already the corpus form across c127/c128/c130, so this is a missing entry, not drift. Record ནག་པོའི་ཆོས / ནག་ཆོས → "hắc pháp" as the explicit counterpart of "bạch pháp"; note the existing tension flagged at ནག་པོའི་ལས ("nghiệp đen", plain Vietnamese) — a Phase 5 ruling should decide the whole colour-pair family at once.

VERB-SCOPE SPLIT, p0419 l.1, Ratnamegha citation: `དགེ་བ་ཅི་བྱེད་ཀྱི་སྔོན་དུ་བྱང་ཆུབ་ཀྱི་སེམས་གཏོང་བ་བྱས་ན`. Everywhere else in this chunk གཏོང་བ is 'xả bỏ' (abandon): སྨོན་སེམས་གཏོང, སེམས་བསྐྱེད་གཏོང་བའི་རྒྱུ, སྡོམ་པ་གཏོང་བར་འགྱུར, སྨོན་སེམས་བཏང་བ. Here the opposite sense is required by the syntax, not merely by doctrine: the protasis is positive (`སྤྱོད་ལམ་ཐམས་ཅད་དུ་བྱང་ཆུབ་ཀྱི་སེམས་སྦྱོང་བ་དང...བྱས་ན`) and its consequent is positive (`སྐྱེ་བ་གཞན་དུའང་སེམས་རིན་པོ་ཆེ་དང་མི་འབྲལ་བ` — 'in other lives too one is not separated from the precious mind'). 'Abandoning' bodhicitta before every virtue cannot yield non-separation from it. Reading confirmed at repair; wording kept. Requested ruling: གཏོང་བ with an object of aspiration/prayer (parallel to སྨོན་ལམ་གཏོང་བ) = 'phát khởi / phát', vs. གཏོང་བ with a vow or generated mind as object = 'xả bỏ'.
p0437-p0438, འཁོར་གསུམ་དུ་འཛིན་པ / འཁོར་གསུམ་དུ་རྟོག་པ. No glossary entry. Established Sino-Vietnamese 三輪 (giver / gift / recipient). Rendered 'chấp thủ theo tam luân' / 'phân biệt theo tam luân'.

p0438, 3×. Deliberately kept distinct from the glossary's ངེས་པ = 'sự xác quyết', because both terms occur in the same passage (ངེས་པ ×5, ངེས་ཤེས ×3) and collapsing them would lose the contrast. 'trí' renders ཤེས. Needs an owner ruling; 'định giải' (定解) was considered and rejected as opaque and unattested in the corpus.

p0438, དམིགས་གཏད་རྡུལ་ཙམ་ཡང་མ་ལུས་པ. No entry. Kept distinct from དམིགས་པ = 'sở duyên' (glossary) and from དམིགས་རྟེན = 'đối tượng sở duyên' (glossary), both of which occur elsewhere in this same chunk.
p0437. Built on the glossary's སྒོམ་རིམ་བར་པ = '*Tu Tập Thứ Đệ* quyển giữa'; ཐ་མ = last.

p0439. Occurs exactly once in the whole book. Rendered from the Tibetan components (མདོ = kinh, ཀུན་ལས་བཏུས་པ = tập) following the glossary's ཀུན་ལས་བཏུས = 'A-tỳ-đạt-ma Tập Luận' and བསླབ་བཏུས = 'Tập Học Luận'. Not verified against an existing Vietnamese edition; owner confirmation wanted.
p0439, inside the Sūtrasamuccaya quotation, paired with འདུས་བྱས. Mirrors the glossary's འདུས་བྱས = 'pháp hữu vi'.
p0440, inside the Tathāgatācintyaguhya quotation. No entry existed; 'thiện căn' is already used 33× across the translated corpus.

p0440. Rendered literally rather than 'Tiểu thừa', which the glossary already fixes for ཐེག་པ་དམན་པ; the sentence here asserts that ཉི་ཚེ་བའི་ཐེག་པ and ཐེག་པ་ཆུང་ངུ are synonyms, so the two must stay separable from ཐེག་པ་དམན་པ.
p0437. Built on the glossary's མཚན་མ་དང་བཅས་པའི་རྣལ་འབྱོར = 'du-già hữu tướng'.
p0439, བསྟན་པ་ནུབ་པའི་ཡང་རྐྱེན. A secondary/contributing condition, kept distinct from རྐྱེན alone.
p0438. Built on the glossary's སྤྲོས་པ = 'hý luận'.
p0438, འཁོར་འདས་ཀྱི་ཆོས་ཐམས་ཅད. Contraction of འཁོར་བ + མྱ་ངན་ལས་འདས་པ, both already fixed in the glossary.

terms.vi: cái bị hại và cái làm hại
terms.note: p0438, of the two valid cognitions. Tibetan order (bị hại trước) preserved.

terms.vi: một hòn đá ném mà đuổi trăm con chim
terms.note: p0440. A Tibetan saying quoted with སྐད་ཟེར་ནས. Rendered literally; see the flag — its rhetorical force (the opponent's boast that one practice does everything, vs. an image of futility) is not settled by the Tibetan.

p0452 l.1, credited with setting out Ārya Asaṅga's position on the definite enumeration of the six perfections. No glossary entry under any spelling. Seng ge bzang po is the standard Tibetan for Haribhadra, whose established Vietnamese/Sino-Vietnamese name is Sư Tử Hiền (師子賢); rendered by translation rather than transcription following the corpus pattern for names with settled Vietnamese forms (ཐོགས་མེད = Vô Trước, ཟླ་བ་གྲགས་པ = Nguyệt Xứng, འཕགས་པ་ལྷ = Thánh Thiên), while Kamalaśīla-type names stay transcribed. སློབ་དཔོན = A-xà-lê per the registered provisional. The name recurs once more in the corpus at source/clean/p0597.txt (beside ཀ་མ་ལ་ཤཱི་ལ), so one ruling settles both occurrences.

terms.vi: trình tự sinh khởi / trình tự thấp kém và thù thắng / trình tự thô và tế
terms.note: The three inline divisions of this section (p0452), each also named in the Sūtrālaṃkāra verse that closes it. Not printed sa-bcad headings, so kept in prose. རིམ་པ rendered 'trình tự' here and 'thứ lớp' in the verse line དེ་དག་རིམ་པར་བསྟན་པ་ཡིན — flagged below; if one word is wanted for both, 'thứ tự' would collide with གོ་རིམ above.

p0452. Composed from the two registered provisionals ལས་སུ་རུང་བ = 'kham nhậm' (kept distinct from khinh an / śin sbyangs) and ཏིང་ངེ་འཛིན = 'định'. Recorded only so the compound does not later drift to 'định có tính kham nhậm' or absorb 'khinh an'.

p0452 l.1, སློབ་དཔོན་སེང་གེ་བཟང་པོས་བཀོད་པ, rendered 'A-xà-lê Sư Tử Hiền' (translation/c140.md L18). No entry exists: the current སེང་གེ entries cover the lion sleeping posture (སེང་གེ་ལྟར་ཉལ་བ), སེང་གེས་ཞུས་པ = Kinh Sư Tử Thỉnh Vấn, and སྨྲ་བའི་སེང་གེ. Wording KEPT — it follows the glossary's སློབ་དཔོན = A-xà-lê (provisional) and the corpus habit of translating rather than transliterating སེང་གེ (as recorded under སེང་གེས་ཞུས་པ: 'སེང་གེ = Siṃha, translated (Sư Tử) rather than transliterated, as the Tibetan itself translates'). Downstream reach: he is named again as the author of བརྒྱད་སྟོང་འགྲེལ་ཆེན (p0254 entry).

p0452 l.3 and l.5, in the sa-bcad heading ཞར་ལ་གོ་རིམ་ངེས་པ་བསྟན་པ། and its restatement. glossary.json has only ཞར་ལ་འགྲུབ་པ = 'thành tựu một cách phụ đới' (p0354), a different sense (one's own aim accomplished incidentally). Bare ཞར་ལ = incidentally / in passing is rendered 'nhân tiện'; wording KEPT, ruling owed so the sibling sections do not drift between 'nhân tiện' and 'phụ đới'.

terms.vi: Nhân tiện, trình bày sự xác định về thứ tự
terms.note: Section heading of c140, sectionPath 6.2.3.1.10.3.1.3.2.2, p0452. decisions.md requires cited/section headings to be fixed at one Vietnamese form. Built from the registered གོ་རིམ་ངེས་པ = 'sự xác định về thứ tự' plus ཞར་ལ = 'nhân tiện' (see the bare ཞར་ལ gap above) and བསྟན་པ = 'trình bày'. Wording KEPT; registration needed so the heading and its in-text restatement (L22, L24) stay identical.

p0449-p0450, twice: བསམ་གཏན་གྱིས་ཉོན་མོངས་པ་དང་ཤེས་རབ་ཀྱིས་ཤེས་སྒྲིབ་རྣམ་པར་སྦྱོང་བ and དེའི་ས་བོན་དང་ཤེས་སྒྲིབ་འཇོམས་པ. No entry exists for ཤེས་སྒྲིབ or ཤེས་བྱའི་སྒྲིབ་པ; glossary has only ཤེས་བྱ = sở tri and several unrelated སྒྲིབ་པ compounds. Paired with the fixed ཉོན་མོངས = phiền não.
p0451, ནང་རིག་པའི་སྡེ་སྣོད་ཀྱི་དོན = 'ý nghĩa của tạng nội minh'. No entry; c005.md already uses 'nội minh' for it inside the list of the four/five minh xứ, so this only registers the existing usage.

p0451, འཇུག་ལྡོག་གི་གནས་རགས་པ = 'những chỗ thô hiển của việc thâm nhập và quay lui'. Follows c138.md, which renders the same pair as 'đối tượng nào phải thâm nhập và đối tượng nào phải quay lui'. Kept distinct from སྤང་བླང = thủ xả, which occurs separately.
p0451, སེམས་ཅན་གྱི་ལོག་སྒྲུབ་ཀྱིས་སྡུག་བསྔལ་བ — the wrong/hostile conduct of sentient beings that causes the bodhisattva suffering. No entry.
p0451, བར་དུ་མ་ལོག་ཀྱང་ཆུད་ཟ་བའི་རྒྱུ — virtue already produced coming to nothing. No entry.
p0451, དཀའ་སྤྱད་ཐན་ཐུན་ལ་བཟོད་བསྲན་ཆུང་བ. No entry. Deliberately not 'nhẫn', which is reserved for the fixed བཟོད་པ = nhẫn occurring in the same sentence.
p0450, ཉོན་མོངས་མགོ་གནོན་པ་ལ་བསམ་གཏན — suppressing the manifest afflictions, contrasted in the next clause with འཇོམས་པ ('phá hủy') applied to their seeds. The two verbs must stay distinguishable.

p0451, in the heading-like label སངས་རྒྱས་ཀྱི་ཆོས་ཐམས་ཅད་འགྲུབ་པའི་གཞིའི་གནས་ཀྱི་གྲངས་ངེས, which opens the next chunk's material. Provisional; the chunk that carries the full explanation (c140) should confirm the reading.

terms.vi: việc nên làm và nên tránh
terms.note: p0451 l.7, `འཇུག་ལྡོག་གི་གནས་རགས་པ`. Glossary registers only the compound `འཁོར་བའི་འཇུག་ལྡོག` = 'sự lưu chuyển và hoàn diệt của luân hồi' (provisional, p0347), which is the forward/reverse order of dependent origination — a different sense that does not govern here. Here the pair is adoption/rejection in conduct (blang dor). Text changed away from the previous 'thâm nhập và quay lui'; note the corpus has 'thâm nhập' for bare `འཇུག` at c140 l.35-36, so a ruling should say whether the bare compound takes 'nên làm và nên tránh' (or 'thủ xả' / 'hành và chỉ') in practice contexts.

p0449 last line (`སྤྲོ་བ་དྲག་ལ་རིང་བའི་བརྩོན་པ`, restored by this repair) and p0451 l.4 (`བལྟ་བའི་སྤྲོ་བ་རྣམས`). No entry for bare `སྤྲོ་བ`. IMPORTANT COLLISION the check did not see: glossary.json DOES have `སྤྲོ་ཤུགས` = 'lòng hăng hái' (provisional, p0394), whereas c139 renders `སྤྲོ་ཤུགས` 'sức hoan hỷ' (p0451 l.6) and `སྤྲོ་བ` 'lòng hoan hỷ'. A single ruling should settle the whole family (`སྤྲོ་བ` / `སྤྲོ་ཤུགས` / `སྤྲོ་བ་བསྐྱེད`) and, if 'hăng hái' wins, sweep c139's two occurrences together. Kept as-is here because the repair brief lists only the listed defects as changeable and the term is provisional, not fixed.

p0451 l.2, `དགེ་ཕྱོགས་ལ་ཡུན་རིང་པོར་སྦྱོར་བས་ཡོངས་སུ་སྐྱོ་བ`. glossary.json fixes `སྐྱོ་བ` = 'nhàm chán' (provisional, companion to `སྐྱོ་ཤས` = lòng yểm ly) — disenchantment with saṃsāra. Here it is discouragement/weariness produced by long application to virtue, i.e. a cause of turning back, the opposite valence. Precedent for splitting exists: `སྐྱོ་བ་སྤངས་པ` = 'dứt bỏ chán mệt' (p0062) is already registered for exactly this non-saṃsāra sense. Text kept; a second sense is owed.
p0451 l.6. No entry; glossary has `རིག་པ` = minh and `རིག་པའི་གནས་ལྔ` = năm minh xứ, which entail but do not fix this member. `སྡེ་སྣོད` rendered 'tạng'.

p0451 last line, the sa-bcad announced at the end of this chunk. The identical problem is already registered from c126: `སངས་རྒྱས་ཆོས / སངས་རྒྱས་ཀྱི་ཆོས` = 'Phật pháp' (provisional), whose note asks for a ruling because the sense is the *qualities of a buddha to be accomplished*, not the Buddha's teaching. This occurrence (`...ཐམས་ཅད་འགྲུབ་པའི་གཞིའི་གནས`) makes the accomplishment sense explicit and should be decided in the same ruling; it governs the heading of the next chunk too, so c140 must follow whatever is settled.

p0451 l.5, `དཀའ་སྤྱད་ཐན་ཐུན་ལ་བཟོད་བསྲན་ཆུང་བ`. No entry; idiomatic 'a little bit / a trifling amount'. Pairs with the registered `དཀའ་སྤྱད` = 'hạnh khó hành' (provisional, p0364), which this chunk follows.
p0451 l.3, `སྡུག་བསྔལ་དང་གནོད་པ་ལ་ཇི་མི་སྙམ་པ`. No entry; idiomatic 'thinking nothing of it / being unfazed'. Rendered by sense.

p0481 l.3 and p0482 l.5. NOT the same Tibetan as the glossary's དཔུང་བཟང་གིས་ཞུས་པ = 'Kinh Diệu Tý Thỉnh Vấn' (Subāhu). A scan of source/clean shows the two titles are in complementary distribution: དཔུང་བཟང on p0064/p0252/p0281/p0323/p0339/p0343, ལག་བཟང on p0464/p0481–p0483/p0522/p0549/p0551/p0565. ལག = tay (thủ), བཟང = thiện. c143 (p0464), the first real occurrence, already renders it 'Kinh Thiện Thủ Thỉnh Vấn'; that rendering is followed here so the two texts stay separable.

p0481 l.1, the merchant simile. No entry of its own; the glossary's ཚོང་དཔོན = 'thương chủ' entry already records ཚོང་པ = 'thương nhân' in its note, and c105 uses that word. Registered so it is a rule rather than an inference.

p0481 l.1, closing line of the Catuḥśataka verse (ཚོང་སྤོགས་བཞིན་དུ་སྨད་པར་འགྱུར). སྤོགས = lãi/lợi in trade. Kept descriptive rather than Sino-Vietnamese, since the verse's point is the vulgarity of the comparison.
p0482 l.3, ས་མཐོན་པོའི་སྦྱིན་པ་ལ་སློབ་ཚུལ — the giving practised on the higher bodhisattva grounds, held up as an object of aspiration rather than of present practice. ས = địa per the glossary.

terms.vi: của cải / người có của cải
terms.note: p0481 l.3. Bare འབྱོར་པ in the sense of wealth has no entry; the glossary only rules it inside དལ་འབྱོར / རང་འབྱོར, where it means 'thuận duyên'. Rendered 'của cải' here and kept distinct from ལོངས་སྤྱོད = 'thọ dụng', which the same sentence uses two clauses later.

terms.vi: sự bố thí chỉ bằng ý lạc
terms.note: p0481 l.3, the second member of a pair whose first is actual material giving. Built on the glossary's བསམ་པ = 'ý lạc'.

terms.vi: địa thắng ý lạc hoàn toàn thanh tịnh
terms.note: p0481 l.3, glossed by the source itself as ས་དང་པོ = Sơ địa. Uses the glossary's ལྷག་བསམ = 'thắng ý lạc'; the Bodhisattvabhūmi quotation four lines later writes the full ལྷག་པའི་བསམ་པ, rendered 'tăng thượng ý lạc' per the other glossary entry — see flag.

The glossary itself is split at headword level and c148 followed both entries faithfully: ལྷག་བསམ = 'thắng ý lạc' (provisional, derived from the title ལྷག་བསམ་བསྐུལ་བ = Kinh Khuyến Phát Thắng Ý Lạc) vs ལྷག་པའི་བསམ་པ = 'tăng thượng ý lạc' (provisional). p0481 uses the short form and p0482 the long form for the SAME referent six lines apart inside one Bodhisattvabhūmi citation, so the two rulings collide visibly. Unified to 'tăng thượng ý lạc' in this chunk. ONE ruling is needed for both headwords, plus a retro-sweep: 'thắng ý lạc' currently in c113, c118; 'tăng thượng ý lạc' in c062, c128. If the ruling goes the other way, the fixed title 'Kinh Khuyến Phát Thắng Ý Lạc' must be reconciled with it.

GAP, wording KEPT. ཆོས is status fixed-set with viVariants [pháp, Pháp, giáo pháp] and 'Nothing else', but the closed set has no ruling for ཆོས meaning the various articles to be given away; 'pháp đáng đem bố thí' would be positively wrong here (the passage is about mentally emanating goods to give). Needs the sense licensed on the entry — the same treatment already given to བསམ་པ and གཏོང་བ — rather than the text being changed.

GAP, wording KEPT — it follows the glossary's provisional བློ = 'cái trí', whose own note already flags this exact collision and asks for the ruling. The collision is live inside c148: ཤེས་རབ = 'bậc có trí tuệ' three lines away (L35, L41) and གཏོང་བའི་སེམས = 'tâm thí xả' (L11), so 'trí thí xả' reads as a wisdom-term where the Tibetan has a disposition to give. A neutral 'tâm' or 'ý' for བློ would resolve it; high-frequency term, so the ruling needs a corpus sweep.

GAP — only the compounds རང་དབང་མེད་པའི་ཉེས་པ and ཉེས་པ་ལས་ལྡོག་པ are registered; bare ཉེས་པ has no ruling. c148 had 'lỗi' (L12) and 'tội lỗi' (L58) two pages apart; normalised to 'lỗi'/'lỗi lầm', which matches c147 and the 'lỗi lầm' inside ཉེས་པ་ལས་ལྡོག་པ. 'tội lỗi' should be ruled out for bare ཉེས་པ — it says sin/transgression where the Tibetan says fault/defect.

terms.vi: đối tượng của sự mong nguyện
terms.note: GAP — new rendering introduced by this repair. The previous 'đối tượng của tâm nguyện' imported the registered rendering of སྨོན་པའི་སེམས = praṇidhicitta (aspiring bodhicitta) into a non-technical phrase: here the sa mtho po'i sbyin pa training-modes are simply made the object of aspiration. A ruling should cover bare སྨོན་པ outside vow contexts, alongside the existing entry 'སྨོན་པ (in སྨོན་པའི་ཆོ་ག ...)' = '[tâm] nguyện (supply bracketed)', which explicitly requests this decision.

p0455, cited as ཟླ་བ་སྒྲོན་མ་ལས as the source of the eight-line verse on the rotting body and Death's mount. Rendered from the Tibetan components (ཟླ་བ = Nguyệt, སྒྲོན་མ = Đăng). The source names no མདོ, so no 'Kinh' prefix was supplied, following the precedent recorded for སྡོང་པོ་བཀོད་པ and མྱ་ངན་ལས་འདས་པ. NOT identified with the Samādhirāja / ཏིང་ངེ་འཛིན་རྒྱལ་པོ = 'Kinh Tam-muội Vương' (glossary, fixed), even though the two are commonly taken as one work: the Tibetan here writes only ཟླ་བ་སྒྲོན་མ. A ruling is owed on whether the two titles should be merged.

terms.vi: Tổng Trì Thành Tựu Vô Biên Môn
terms.note: p0455. Built from the Tibetan components: སྒོ = môn, མཐའ་ཡས་པ = vô biên, སྒྲུབ་པ = thành tựu, གཟུངས = tổng trì (glossary: translated, not transliterated). Ordered Sino-Vietnamese. No 'Kinh' prefix — the source writes only གཟུངས, following the འཆི་མེད་རྔ་སྒྲའི་གཟུངས precedent. Note this contradicts the glossary's other line of titles (Đà-la-ni Ratnolkā, Đà-la-ni Khuyến Phát); the unresolved 'gzungs in cited titles' entry already asks for that ruling.

p0454, in the Bodhicaryāvatāra verse སྐྱོབ་པ་ཇི་ལྟར་ཕ་རོལ་ཕྱིན — the buddhas of the past. No glossary entry for སྐྱོབ་པ anywhere. 'Đấng Cứu Hộ' (救護) chosen rather than 'Đấng Cứu Độ', which would import a 度 (crossing-over) the Tibetan does not have and would clash with ཕ་རོལ་ཕྱིན in the same line.

p0456, Pāramitāsamāsa line 22 (འཇུངས་པ་འཕགས་པའི་ལམ་མིན). Deliberately NOT 'xan lận', which the glossary assigns to སེར་སྣ — སེར་སྣ occurs four times in this same chunk's prose and the two must stay separable.
p0456, མི་ཡི་ནོར་རྣམས་སྐར་མདའི་རང་བཞིན་ལྟར. No entry.

terms.vi: dòng nước trên sườn núi dốc
terms.note: p0455, Tsongkhapa's gloss on སྲོག་ཀྱང་གཡོ་བ — life is as unsteady as water on a steep mountainside. Rendered literally (རི་གཟར = sườn núi dốc, ཆུ = nước); not expanded to 'thác nước'.
p0455, མི་མཁས་འཆི་བདག་བཞོན་པས་སོང. Built on the glossary's འཆི་བདག = Tử thần; བཞོན་པ = vật cưỡi (mount). See flag: the instrumental བཞོན་པས admits a second reading.
p0455, Jātaka verse སྡུག་བསྔལ་དྲིན་མེད་རྟག་ཏུ་མི་གཙང་བའི — an epithet of the body. No entry.
p0453, the second of the two divisions of སྤྱོད་པ་ལ་སློབ་པའི་རིམ་པ. ཕར་ཕྱིན = ba-la-mật (glossary, fixed); ཐ་མ = sau cùng. The text does not name which two, and they are not named here.
p0453, third of the four subdivisions of the generosity section (སྦྱིན་པའི་རབ་ཏུ་དབྱེ་བ). No entry.

p0454, སེར་སྣའི་ཀུན་ཏུ་འཛིན་པ. Kept deliberately distinct from the glossary's ཡོངས་སུ་འཛིན = 'sự nắm giữ trọn vẹn' (parigraha), which appears in the very next paragraph and again in the Pāramitāsamāsa verse; the two must not converge.

p0454; the variant སྙིང་ཐག་པ་ནས occurs on the same page and is given the same Vietnamese. Distinct from bare བསམ་པ = 'ý lạc' (glossary), which is also used in this chunk for བསམ་པ་སྙིང་ཐག་པ་ནས་བསྐྱེད.
p0455, closing line of the Śikṣāsamuccaya verse (དེ་ནི་རིན་མེད་རྙེད་མིན་ནམ). See flag — 'rin med' is ambiguous.
p0453. Spelled-out form of the glossary's བསྡུ་བཞི = 'bốn nhiếp pháp'; same Vietnamese, registered so the sweep sees one form.

p0454, BCA 5.9 pāda 4, c141 l.55. KEPT (no ruling covers it). glossary.json fixes ཕ་རོལ་ཕྱིན་པ and ཕ་རོལ་ཏུ་ཕྱིན་པ = "ba-la-mật" — both NOMINAL forms ending in པ. Here the word is finite-verbal: སྐྱོབ་པ་ཇི་ལྟར་ཕ་རོལ་ཕྱིན, 'how did the Protector reach the far shore / perfect [it]?', with no པ and no expressed object. Forcing "ba-la-mật" here yields no Vietnamese sentence, and supplying an object ([bố thí]) or a verb ([viên mãn]) to make the fixed noun fit would insert words the pāda does not have. The two nominal occurrences in the SAME stanza (l.53, l.58, both སྦྱིན་པའི་ཕ་རོལ་ཕྱིན) are correctly "bố thí ba-la-mật", so the entry as written is already being obeyed everywhere it applies. Requested ruling: extend the fixed entry with an explicit verbal carve-out — ཕ་རོལ་ཕྱིན as predicate = literal 'đến bờ kia' (or a chosen alternative), ཕ་རོལ་(ཏུ་)ཕྱིན་པ as noun = 'ba-la-mật' — so a Phase 5 sweep does not read this as drift.

p0456, བདག་བླུན་པའོ་སྙམ་དུ་བསམས་ནས, c141 l.115 ('ta thật là kẻ ngu'). No ruling for བླུན་པ. HEAD-ON COLLISION with the registered བྱིས་པ = "kẻ ngu" (provisional), which THIS SAME CHUNK uses twice: l.78 (བྱིས་པ་འདི་དག, inside the ཟླ་བ་སྒྲོན་མ quotation) and l.145 (སྐྱེ་བོ་བྱིས་པ → "Hạng người ngu", inside the ཕར་ཕྱིན་བསྡུས་པ quotation). Two distinct Tibetan words are currently indistinguishable in Vietnamese inside one chunk. Wording KEPT because neither word is ruled against the other. Requested: one ruling covering the pair, ideally taken together with the already-flagged བྱིས་པ/བརྟན་པ pair — e.g. reserve 'kẻ ngu' for བླུན་པ (literally foolish/stupid) and give བྱིས་པ a form marking its 'childish/immature' sense, or vice versa; note the existing བྱིས་པ entry itself records that 'kẻ ngu' was chosen after the Chinese 愚夫 rather than a literal 'kẻ ấu trĩ'.

p0456, BCA 3.11 pādas 1-2: ཐམས་ཅད་བཏང་བས་མྱ་ངན་འདའ། །བདག་བློ་མྱ་ངན་འདས་པ་སྒྲུབ། — c141 l.121 'vượt khỏi sầu khổ', l.122 'niết-bàn'. glossary.json registers only the nominal མྱ་ངན་ལས་འདས་པ = "niết-bàn" (provisional); the verbal མྱ་ངན་འདའ is unruled. Both renderings are literally correct and the Tibetan itself alternates verb/noun across two adjacent pādas, so the wording is KEPT — but a mechanical Phase 5 sweep will read consecutive lines of one stanza as drift unless the verbal form is registered alongside the nominal one.

terms.vi: ý lạc / tự đáy lòng / ý tưởng
terms.note: KNOWN RECURRING SCOPING GAP, no rewrite requested. c141 renders བསམ་པ three ways, each defensible in its context: 'tự đáy lòng' for the idiom བསམ་པ་ཐག་པ་ནས (l.46, p0454; cf. བསམ་པ་སྙིང་ཐག་པ་ནས at l.69); 'cái ý lạc' for bare བསམ་པ at l.69 (p0454, བདོག་པ་ཐམས་ཅད་གཞན་ལ་གཏོང་བའི་བསམ་པ — this is the registered āśaya sense); and 'bằng ý tưởng' for བསམ་པས་བཏང་བས spanning p0455-p0456 (l.114, mentally giving away the body). The registered བསམ་པ = "ý lạc" is scoped by its own note to the āśaya sense, and glossary.json already carries two recorded 'scoping gap - entry needs sense-splitting' notes for བསམ་པ; this is a third instance. The entry needs its senses split centrally — the chunk should not be rewritten.

terms.vi: buông xả / bố thí / đem cho
terms.note: HIGH PRIORITY — settle before the remaining parts of the bố thí section are translated. གཏོང་བ is the pivot verb of the entire dāna chapter and has NO ruling for the giving sense. The only registered entry is གཏོང་བ / ཉམས་པ = "xả bỏ / suy tổn", explicitly scoped to abandoning the refuge vow, plus the recorded VERB-SCOPE SPLIT note on བྱང་ཆུབ་ཀྱི་སེམས་གཏོང་བ. c141 splits it three ways, all defensible in context and all KEPT: 'buông xả' where the object is one's own grasping or possessions in the abstract (ll. 36, 45, 57, 121, 144, 148 — e.g. གཏོང་བའི་སེམས་པ, བཏང་སེམས, ཡོངས་སུ་གཏོང་བ); 'bố thí' where the sense is the pāramitā act itself (ll. 46, 114, 116); 'đem cho' where a concrete recipient is named (ll. 132, 141, 147, 150 — བྱིན་པ / སེམས་ཅན་རྣམས་ལ་བཏང་བ). Note the source itself alternates གཏོང་བ / བཏང་བ / བྱིན་པ across the ཕར་ཕྱིན་བསྡུས་པ quotation, so some Vietnamese variation tracks the Tibetan rather than departing from it — the ruling should say which Tibetan stem maps to which Vietnamese, not merely pick one word. Without it the split will spread across the seven remaining parts of this section.
p0479, Pāramitāsamāsa verse: ཅི་ནས་ཡི་ཆད་དམའ་བར་མི་འགྱུར་བར. No entry. Discouragement/loss of heart; kept distinct from སྐྱོ་བ.

p0479. Built on the glossary's ཉེ་བར་ལེན་པ = thủ. Deliberately NOT 'kiến thủ', which glossary.json already fixes for the different compound ལྟ་བ་ཉེ་བར་ལེན་པ (upādāna OF views, one of the four upādāna).
p0478, the poorer of the two simultaneous petitioners (སློང་བ་པོ་བཀྲེན་པ་དང་འབྱོར་པ་ཅན་གཉིས). Kept distinct from དབུལ་པོ/ཕོངས་པ.
p0478, paired with བཀྲེན་པ in the two-petitioner case.
p0480, ཕོངས་པའི་སྡུག་བསྔལ = 'nỗi khổ thiếu thốn' — the deprivation accepted by one who gives away his last means.
p0477: བདག་གིས་འདི་བྱིན་པས་ཚེ་འདི་ལ་ལྐུགས་པར་གྱུར་ཀྱང་བླ. Literally 'câm/mute'; here the figurative sense (left uneducated by giving away one's own text). See flag.
p0477 and again p0478, paired with རྒྱ (lưới) in the list of implements that harm sentient beings. Rendered as a hunting device. NOT confirmed — see flag.
p0480: སྔོ་རྔད་ཅི་ཡང་རུང་བ་ཙམ་གྱིས་འཚོའོ. སྔོ = greens; རྔད uncertain. See flag.
p0480, twice (གཏོང་བའི་སེམས་མི་སྐྱེ་བ). Follows c148, which already renders the same phrase 'tâm thí xả' two pages later.

NEW ENTRY NEEDED. p0479 དགེ་རྩ་མ་སྨིན = "thiện căn chưa thành thục". Must be kept distinct from གོམས་པ, which the glossary fixes as "thuần thục": in c147 both fell together as "chưa thuần thục" within four paragraphs. Ripening (སྨིན) vs habituation (གོམས) are different acts and need different Vietnamese. See also the note on གོམས་པ below.

NO ENTRY. p0479, in the compound ཉེ་བར་ལེན་པའི་ལྟ་བ (upādāna-dṛṣṭi) → "kiến chấp thủ" (ལྟ་བ kept as the ruled "kiến"). "cận thủ" is the more literal calque and is the established rendering in ཉེ་བར་ལེན་པའི་ཕུང་པོ = cận thủ uẩn; a ruling is needed on which of the two the project uses, and whether it differs inside compounds.
NO ENTRY. Very frequent through the dāna section (p0477–p0480), also as bare སློང་བ. Needs pinning centrally.
NO ENTRY. p0477, the book one may be miserly about and must give to a knowledge-seeking asker.
NO ENTRY. p0477, among the things not to be given when sought in order to harm the populace.
NO ENTRY. p0478, དམིགས་བསལ་མེད་པ་རྣམས — the points with nothing special about them, explained per the Bodhisattvabhūmi's intent.

p0496 l.末. GAP - glossary.json has no entry for the name in either the bo or vi field, although his works are registered twice (དབུ་མའི་སྙིང་པོ / དབུ་མ་སྙིང་པོ = Trung Quán Tâm Luận, cited at p0065 and p0125). Established Sino-Vietnamese 清辯. Uses the corpus pattern སློབ་དཔོན = 'A-xà-lê' (provisional, registered).

p0495, ཚེ་དང་ལྡན་པ་ཉེ་བར་འཁོར inside the Sarvāstivāda passage quoted by the Śikṣāsamuccaya. No entry. Established Sino-Vietnamese 具壽; deliberately not 'tôn giả', which would render བཙུན་པ - and བཙུན་པ occurs eight lines earlier in the same quotation, so the two must stay separable.

p0495, ×4 as vocative. glossary.json registers only the compound ཉེ་བར་འཁོར་གྱིས་ཞུས་པ = 'Kinh Ưu-ba-ly Thỉnh Vấn' (p0421), whose own note states that ཉེ་བར་འཁོར = Upāli is 'already rendered Ưu-ba-ly in earlier translated chunks'. Recording the bare name so the sweep does not read it as unruled.

terms.vi: phái Nhất Thiết Hữu / phái Thánh Nhất Thiết Hữu
terms.note: Sentence begins at the foot of p0494 (c151) and its verb lands on p0495 l.1, so it is fixed across the chunk boundary; c151 renders it 'phái Thánh Nhất Thiết Hữu'. Established Sino-Vietnamese 說一切有部. No glossary entry.
p0495. Built on the glossary's མཆོད་རྟེན = 'bảo tháp' (provisional). Rendered literally; the Tibetan does not say whose hair and nails, so no 'của đức Phật' was supplied.
p0495. Uses the glossary's འཁོར་ལོས་བསྒྱུར་བ = 'Chuyển Luân Vương' (p0285, provisional); རྒྱལ་སྲིད = 'vương vị'. Bare རྒྱལ་སྲིད has no entry.
p0495, the layer reached at 84,000 do-tuần below the ground. Rendered literally rather than with a cosmological gloss ('kim luân', 'địa luân bằng vàng'), which the Tibetan does not write. See flag.

terms.vi: Đảnh / Nhẫn của Gia Hành đạo
terms.note: p0496, སྦྱོར་ལམ་རྩེ་མོ་དང་བཟོད་པ་ཐོབ་པའི་ཚེ. Two of the four nirvedhabhāgīya. Uses the glossary's སྦྱོར་ལམ = 'Gia Hành đạo' (provisional). NOTE the collision: glossary.json fixes བཟོད་པ = 'nhẫn' as the pāramitā, which is the very topic of this section - here it is the path-stage, capitalised as 'Nhẫn' to keep the two apart. རྩེ་མོ has no entry (only དཔལ་རྡོ་རྗེ་རྩེ་མོ, a proper name).
p0497, གཏོང་བ་དང་སྤོང་སེམས་ལ་གོམས་པ - the intention to abstain, i.e. what morality consists of, paired with གཏོང་བ ('xả thí') as what giving consists of. No entry.

p0497. Rendered literally. Contrasted in the same sentence with the external results ལུས་དང་ལོངས་སྤྱོད - see flag; I am not certain 'inner morality' is the intended sense rather than 'morality [as an] internal [cause]'.
p0497, སངས་རྒྱས་ཉག་གཅིག་གི་ལུང. ཉག་གཅིག = 'sole, one alone'; rendered literally to preserve Tsongkhapa's point that only a buddha's scripture can settle the question.
p0495, closing the Upāli passage. See flag - the source's spelling is འགལ་བ ('contradiction'), read as མགལ་བ ('firebrand'), which is what the a fortiori requires.
p0498, Bodhicaryāvatāra VI.5d (སྡང་ལྡན་པའི་རྗེ་དཔོན་དེ). No entry. The master/employer whom his own retainers turn on.
p0498, Jātakamālā verse (མལ་སྟན་བཟང་པོ). No entry.
p0498, Jātakamālā verse (མི་རིགས་གཡང་སར་ལྟུང་བ). No entry.
p0498, Jātakamålā simile. མར་ངོ = the waning fortnight, as against ཡར་ངོ. No entry.

p0496 l.3, `སློབ་དཔོན་ལེགས་ལྡན་འབྱེད`. No entry of any kind for Bhāvaviveka. Established Sino-Vietnamese 清辯; used with the registered `སློབ་དཔོན` -> "A-xà-lê", so the phrase reads "A-xà-lê Thanh Biện". Wording KEPT.

p0498 l.1, `མཐོང་ཆོས་ཀྱི་ཉེས་དམིགས` as the section-level contrast with `མ་མཐོང་བའི་ཉེས་དམིགས` at the end of p0497. Only the compounds `མཐོང་ཆོས་ལ་མྱོང་བ` and `མཐོང་ཆོས་བདེ་བ` are registered; the bare head-term is unruled. Wording KEPT, consistent with 10 corpus uses.

p0497 l.1, twice (`གོམས་པའི་བྱེད་པ་རྒྱུ་མཐུན་གྱིས` and `བྱེད་པ་རྒྱུ་མཐུན་རིགས་འདྲ་རྒྱུན་ཆགས`). The registered entry is only `རྒྱུ་མཐུན་གྱི་འབྲས་བུ` -> "quả đẳng lưu", whose note already proposes "quả đẳng lưu tạo tác" for this sub-form; the short form `བྱེད་པ་རྒྱུ་མཐུན` (without `གྱི་འབྲས་བུ`) has no entry of its own, and the whole passage turns on the puruṣakāra/niṣyanda distinction. Wording KEPT.

p0496 l.1, `སྦྱོར་ལམ་རྩེ་མོ་དང་བཟོད་པ` — the second of the four nirvedhabhāgīya. Only `དཔལ་རྡོ་རྗེ་རྩེ་མོ` (a proper name) is registered. `དྲོད` is registered as "hơi ấm", so the set is half-ruled: `དྲོད` / `རྩེ་མོ` / `བཟོད་པ` / `ཆོས་མཆོག` should be pinned together, and a ruling on `དྲོད` as a stage-name (vs the literal "hơi ấm") is what would settle whether `རྩེ་མོ` stays "Đảnh" or becomes "đỉnh". Wording KEPT.

p0497 l.1, twice (`བསྐལ་པ་གཅིག་གིས་རྫོགས་པར་བགྲོད` and `བསྐལ་པ་གཅིག་གི་ཡུན་གྱིས`). Only compounds are registered (`བསྐལ་པ་གྲངས་མེད་པ་གསུམ`, `བར་གྱི་བསྐལ་པ`, `བསྐལ་པ་བཟང་པོ`); the bare term has no ruling. Wording KEPT.

p0498 l.1, Bodhicaryāvatāra `དེ་དག་ཀྱང་ནི་སྡང་ལྡན་པའི། །རྗེ་དཔོན་དེ་ལ་གསོད་པར་རྒོལ`. No entry for the abbreviated `སྡང་`. "sân" bare is consistent with the note on `ཁོང་ཁྲོ` ('sân' reserved for `ཞེ་སྡང`), and in this chunk `ཞེ་སྡང` / `ཁྲོ་བ` / `ཁོང་ཁྲོ` are all rendered per their provisional entries (sân hận / sân giận / phẫn nộ). Wording KEPT.

p0445. Epithet of the author of the Mahāyānasūtrālaṃkāra commentary tradition (i.e. Maitreya) but the Tibetan prints only 'holy Regent'; the name Di-lặc is deliberately NOT supplied. རྒྱལ་ཚབ has no glossary entry at all.

p0447: སེམས་དམིགས་པ་ལ་གནས་པ་བསམ་གཏན་གྱི་ལག་རྗེས / འཁོར་བ་ལས་གྲོལ་བ་ཤེས་རབ་ཀྱི་ལག་རྗེས. Literally 'hand-trace' — the result attributable to X's own doing. 'công dụng' chosen as the least interpretive; 'dấu tay' is literal but unreadable, 'thành quả' overstates.
p0447, སེམས་འཛིན་ཟབ་པར་འདོད་པ་རྣམས. Named as something practitioners seek that turns out to be only a fraction of བསམ་གཏན.
p0448, ཞི་གནས་ཀྱི་རྣལ་འབྱོར་མི་རྟོག་པ and the verse རྣལ་འབྱོར་རྣམ་པར་མི་རྟོག་པ. No glossary entry for the bare word; transliteration kept rather than 'sự tương ưng'.
p0448, qualifying རྣལ་འབྱོར. 'vô phân biệt' was the alternative; the plain form is used so the verse's རྣམ་པར་མི་རྟོག་པ ('hoàn toàn không phân biệt') can show the རྣམ་པར intensifier.

terms.vi: chỗ cần lấy và cần bỏ
terms.note: p0445, བླང་དོར་གྱི་གནས་རྣམས. No entry.
p0447, བསམ་གཏན་གྱིས་སེམས་མཉམ་པར་བཞག་སྟེ. No entry.
p0447 verse (གཏོང་དང་མི་གནོད་བཟོད་པས་བྱེད) and p0448 prose (ཟང་ཟིང་བཏང་བས). Deliberately NOT rendered 'bố thí', which is reserved for the fixed སྦྱིན་པ — the verse uses གཏོང, not སྦྱིན་པ.
p0445 simile: reed and plantain destroyed by their own fruiting, and the she-mule (དྲེའུ་མོ → 'con la cái') by pregnancy. ཆུ་ཤིང → 'cây chuối'.

p0445 l.5, བཅོམ་ལྡན་འདས་ཀྱིས་ཕྱིན་དྲུག་གི་སྡོམ་ཙམ་མཛད་པ་ལ། རྒྱལ་ཚབ་དམ་པས་... Confirmed absent from glossary.json (0 hits over all 2486 terms). The referent is Maitreya as the Buddha's regent, author of the མདོ་སྡེའི་རྒྱན་ quoted three lines later; the same word recurs at p0581 (རྒྱལ་ཚབ་ཀྱི་བསྟན་བཅོས) and p0976, so a central ruling is needed before those chunks. Wording kept as written: རྒྱལ་ཚབ = 'regent/vicegerent' (nhiếp chính) and དམ་པ = 'holy, excellent' (tôn quý) are both literal, and nothing is invented. A ruling should also settle whether the honorific དམ་པ stays a separate adjective or is folded into a fixed epithet, and whether the bare རྒྱལ་ཚབ (p0581) takes the same head noun.

p0446 l.1. Confirmed absent from glossary.json. Must be registered SEPARATELY from ལས་ཀྱི་མཐའ (karmānta) = 'nghiệp sự', which is the prose gloss on p0445 l.5 (ལས་ཀྱི་མཐའ་གང་བརྩམས་པ་རྣམས་འགྲུབ་པ) and which was wrongly imported into the verse. Keeping the two distinct in Vietnamese is what lets a reader see that the root verse says only 'undertaking' while Tsongkhapa's gloss supplies 'karmānta'. Note the verbal རྩོམ་/བརྩམས་ ('khởi làm', 'dấn thân làm') also appears in the prose gloss itself and at p0447 l.1 (བརྩོན་འགྲུས་རྩོམ་དགོས་ = 'cần khởi sự tinh tấn'), so a ruling should cover the noun in the verse and the verb in prose together. An existing entry for གནས (in the Gayā quotation) already glosses the paired རྩོམ་པ as 'sự khởi đầu' — a ruling should reconcile the two.

p0457. Spelling VARIANT of the registered རིན་ཆེན་ཕྲེང་བ = Bảo Man Luận. Same Nāgārjuna text; the source here writes རིན་པོ་ཆེའི་ instead of རིན་ཆེན་. Same Vietnamese title used. Register the variant so the Phase 5 sweep does not read it as an unmatched title.

p0457, Ratnāvalī verse (སེམས་ཅན་ཁམས་ནི་ཚད་མེད་ལ). No entry for the compound; ཁམས alone is registered only as the place-name 'Kham'. Rendered 'cõi' rather than 'giới' so it does not read as ཁམས་གསུམ = tam giới.

p0457, same verse. No entry. Kept distinct from the fixed འཇིག་རྟེན = thế gian, which also occurs in this section (c141, p0456: འཇིག་རྟེན་ཕ་རོལ = 'thế gian đời sau'). A ruling should confirm the split thế gian / thế giới.
p0460, twice, inside the Śikṣāsamuccaya servant simile. No entry. Paired with the registered བྲན = 'kẻ tôi tớ', which occurs in the same sentences.

p0459, Pāramitāsamāsa verse (རྨད་བྱུང་རྣམ་རྟོག). No entry. Kept apart from ངོ་མཚར (p0460, ངོ་མཚར་ཆེན་པོ་ཅན), which I rendered 'kỳ diệu' precisely so the two do not collapse onto one Vietnamese word inside the same chunk.
p0460, ངོ་མཚར་ཆེན་པོ་ཅན inside the Śikṣāsamuccaya quotation. No entry. See the རྨད་བྱུང note — the two need one joint ruling.
p0459-p0460, ×3. The monetary threshold at which theft becomes a pārājika. No entry. Rendered literally (རིན་ཐང 'value' + ཚང 'complete'); no amount was supplied, since the Tibetan names none.

Not new, but unregistered and load-bearing for this whole section (~12× in this chunk). Rendered following c141, the immediately preceding chunk of the same section. NOTE the batch-5 draft of this same chunk used 'xả thí' throughout — one ruling is needed before the remaining six parts of སྦྱིན་པ་ལ་བསླབ་ཚུལ are done, or the section will split down the middle.
p0457, p0459. No entry. Follows c141, which already renders བདོག་པ་ཐམས་ཅད as 'hết thảy vật mình có'.
p0457, Ratnāvalī verse (གལ་ཏེ་དེ་ནི་གཟུགས་ཅན་གྱུར). No entry. Kept consistent with the recorded གཟུགས = 'sắc tướng' note, which proposes སྐར/གཟུགས = 'sắc'.

Standing partner of `མཐར་ཐུག`. The PAIR is already registered (`གནས་སྐབས་དང་མཐར་ཐུག` = "nhất thời và rốt ráo", provisional, p0121) and c142 l.12-13 follows it exactly, but bare `གནས་སྐབས` has no entry of its own. The pair entry's own note flags that c036 renders it "giai đoạn trước mắt" / "cứu cánh" and that Phase 5 must unify; ruling the two members individually would settle it.

ll.26, 31, 34, 61 of c142, plus `གཏོང་བའི་སེམས` at l.128 rendered identically. Needs pinning together with `གཏོང་བ` above and kept distinct from `གཏོང་བའི་བློ` (l.58), now "cái trí buông xả" per the registered `བློ` = cái trí. If the owner overrides `བློ` = "cái trí", this pair needs a joint retro-sweep.

c142 l.50, inside the Pāramitāsamāsa quotation `སེམས་ལ་རྟོག་པའི་དམ་པ་འདི་དག་རྟོགས`. No entry for `དམ་པ`. Wording kept per the gap rule, but flagging that "chân chánh" is also this chunk's rendering of `ཡང་དག` (l.35, `ཡང་དག་བྱང་ཆུབ་ལམ`), so two distinct Tibetan words collapse; and `དམ་པ` is holy/excellent (cf. `སྐྱེས་བུ་དམ་པ`, `དམ་པའི་ཆོས`) rather than "correct", so "thù thắng" or "tối thắng" may be the better ruling. `ཡང་དག` also has no entry and should be ruled at the same time.

c142 l.78, inside the Pāramitāsamāsa quotation `དེ་འདྲ་རྨད་བྱུང་རྣམ་རྟོག་ཡང་དང་ཡང`. No entry. Identical to the registered `རྟོག་པ` = "phân biệt" (provisional), which the same chunk uses at l.50, so the two become indistinguishable. Note the sense here is positive (a marvellous རྣམ་རྟོག the bodhisattva cultivates), unlike the Hashang-context `རྟོག་པ` the existing entry was decided in.

c142 l.113, `བདག་པོ་དང་བཅས་པའི་ལོངས་སྤྱོད` / `བདག་པོ་དང་བཅས་པའི་ལུས` = "các thọ dụng vốn có chủ" / "cái thân vốn có chủ". No entry, and it sits three lines from `རྗེ་བོ` in the same quotation, so the two need one joint ruling.
p0475, འཕགས་པའི་རིགས་ལ་གནས་པའི་བྱང་སེམས. No entry existed.

p0476, vocative inside the Bodhisattvaprātimokṣa quotation. Distinct from the existing entry ཤཱ་ར་དྭ་ཏིའི་བུ = Śāradvatīputra, which was kept in transcription precisely because the Tibetan there was NOT ཤཱ་རིའི་བུ. Here it is, so the established Vietnamese name is used.

p0475, twice, in the vinaya simile (a monk 'assigning' robes to his preceptor before keeping them) and then applied to the bodhisattva's goods. No entry; the Vietnamese is descriptive rather than importing the Chinese vinaya term 說淨/tác tịnh, which the Tibetan does not spell out.
p0476, inside the Bodhisattvaprātimokṣa quotation.
p0473 l.1, completing the sentence carried over from p0472 (མུ་སྟེགས་ཅན་ཀླན་ཀ་ཚོལ་བ).

terms.vi: ngụy tạo giả dạng Chánh pháp
terms.note: p0473, in the Viniścayasaṃgrahaṇī quotation. Built on the existing provisional དམ་པའི་ཆོས = Chánh pháp.

terms.vi: kẻ có trí tuệ trẻ con
terms.note: p0473, in the quotation. Adjectival use of བྱིས་པ; kept literal rather than reusing the standalone gloss 'kẻ ngu', since the Tibetan qualifies ཤེས་རབ, not the person.
p0475, སངས་རྒྱས་བྱང་སེམས་ཀྱིས་བཅོལ་བ་དང་འདྲ་བར་འཆང་ངོ.
p0476, in the list of what may not be given away by way of the thing given.

p0474, the third of the five headings for outer things not fit to give; here རྟེན is the giver himself. Deliberately NOT the glossary's 'thân y', which is registered for དལ་བའི་རྟེན (the human body-basis) and would read as the physical support. Flagged.

terms.vi: tuyên xướng [điều ấy] một cách thỏa đáng
terms.note: p0473, inside the Bodhisattvabhūmi-viniścaya quotation, `བདག་ཉིད་ཀྱིས་ཀྱང་སྙིང་པོ་མེད་པ་ཁོ་ནར་ཡོངས་སུ་ཤེས་པར་བྱ་ཞིང་གཞན་དག་ལའང་ལེགས་པ་ཁོ་ནར་བསྒྲག་པར་བྱའོ`. `ལེགས་པ་ཁོ་ནར` is genuinely ambiguous: adverbial ('proclaim it well/properly') or object ('proclaim only good things'). The object reading makes a doctrinal claim — say only nice things about a tīrthika book — that sits oddly with the erase-and-replace instruction it follows. Rendered adverbially with the object bracketed as supplied; a ruling is needed, and the parallel `ཁོ་ནར` clause immediately before is the main evidence.

p0473, `ནོར་གྱི་འདུ་ཤེས་ཅན་གྱིས`. No entry exists. 'tài vật' is however the registered (provisional) Vietnamese for `ཟང་ཟིང` (āmiṣa), so two distinct Tibetan words currently collapse onto one Vietnamese word. Wording kept per the repair rule; an entry is needed, and 'của cải' is the obvious candidate to keep `ནོར` separable from `ཟང་ཟིང`.

p0473–p0476 use three related forms: `སློང་བ` (p0473, p0474, p0476), `སློང་བ་པོ` (p0475, p0476) and `སློང་མོ་བ` / `སློངས་མོ་པ` (p0473, p0476). c146 renders them as 'kẻ đến xin' / 'người đến xin' / 'người đi xin' interchangeably. No entry for any of them. A ruling is needed on whether the three Tibetan forms are to be kept distinct in Vietnamese or deliberately merged.
p0475, `ཆོ་ག་བཞིན་དུ`. No entry.

p0474 (repeatedly, in the 'three purposes' argument) and the p0476 headword `དགོས་པའི་སྒོ་ནས་སྦྱིན་དུ་མི་རུང་བ`. No entry. It is one of the four doors of the analysis, so it should be ruled together with `ཞིང / རྟེན / དངོས་པོ`.

p0474 ×4, in the graded series `གཞུང་ཤིན་ཏུ་ངན་པ` / `གཞུང་འབྲིང` / `གཞུང་ཁྱད་པར་དུ་འཕགས་པ` — the text a petitioner wants to copy. No entry; 'bản văn' keeps it distinct from `གླེགས་བམ` (the physical book).
p0465. Built from the glossary's ལས་ཀྱི་སྒྲིབ་པ = nghiệp chướng (registered only inside ཆོས་སྤོང་བའི་ལས་ཀྱི་སྒྲིབ་པ) plus རྣམ་པར་དག་པ = thanh tịnh. No entry existed for the sūtra title.

terms.vi: ý lạc chấp ác kiến làm tối thắng
terms.note: p0465, first of the intentions to be abandoned in the dāna section. Built on the glossary's ལྟ་ངན = ác kiến. Deliberately NOT 'kiến thủ', which would import an abhidharma technical label the Tibetan does not use here.
p0466, in the same list. Rendered literally; the text's own gloss (not giving in hope of fame) supplies the sense, so no interpretive expansion was added.
p0466. No glossary entry for ཞུམ་པ at all. 'thối chí' chosen over 'khiếp nhược'; the same root recurs in the gloss as ཡིད་ཞུམ་པར་མི་བྱེད་པ = 'không nản lòng'.
p0466. Literal rendering; its gloss is impartiality toward friend/enemy/neutral.

terms.vi: ý lạc trông mong đền đáp
terms.note: p0466. Paired with རྣམ་སྨིན་ལ་བལྟ་བའི་བསམ་པ; the two share the ལ་བལྟ་བ construction and are rendered on the same pattern.

terms.vi: ý lạc trông mong quả dị thục
terms.note: p0466. Uses the glossary's རྣམ་སྨིན = quả dị thục.
p0466, ལོག་འཚོའི་བསམ་པ = 'ý lạc tà mạng'. No glossary entry (the glossary has ལོག་པར་ལྟ་བ, ལོག་པར་སྒྲུབ་པ but not this). Established Sino-Vietnamese 邪命.
p0466. No entry. Kept plain 'tiếng tăm' and distinct from གྲགས་པ / བསྔགས་པ = tán thán.
p0465 and p0466, both times in a boast/reputation context ('ta là kẻ dám xả thí'). No entry. 'hào phóng' was rejected as colloquial and as losing the ཕོད = 'dare' element.

p0466, in the triad དགྲ་གཉེན་ཐ་མལ་པ. The glossary registers only ཐ་མལ་པའི་འདུ་ཤེས = 'tưởng phàm thường'; 'bình thường' keeps the same root without asserting the pejorative 'phàm phu', which is already fixed to སོ་སོའི་སྐྱེ་བོ.

terms.vi: có điều đáng chê trách · không có điều đáng chê trách
terms.note: p0467. Follows the glossary's ཁ་ན་མ་ཐོ་བ = 'điều đáng chê trách' so the pair reads as one term negated.
p0468. Literal; the argument is that hoarding means the eventual/final act of giving never comes off.
p0468, among the qualities of the manner of giving. No entry. Kept distinct from the glossary's སྙན་པར་སྨྲ་བ / ཚིག་སྙན་པ = ái ngữ.

p0468, Satyakaparivarta: ལག་བདར་ཏེ་བསྩལ་བས་ནི་རིམ་གྲོ་བ་ཐོབ་པར་འགྱུར. Agent noun of the glossary's རིམ་གྲོ = tôn kính; the abstract 'tôn kính' cannot be 'obtained', so the agent sense is required. See flag — the derivational link to tôn kính is lost in Vietnamese.
p0468, quoted from the Satyakaparivarta and then glossed from the Câu-xá Thích (not cut off by others, not destroyed by fire etc.). Uses the glossary's ལོངས་སྤྱོད = thọ dụng.
p0467 l.3 (L81), ཟུར་གྱིས་སྨོད་པའི་བསྟིང་བ. No entry. Part of the abuse triad འཕྱ་བ / བསྟིང་བ / སྤ་བཀོང་བ, each of which needs its own Vietnamese word to stay separable.
p0467 l.3 (L81), ངག་རྩུབ་པོས་སྤ་བཀོང་བར་བྱས་ནས. No entry. Third member of the འཕྱ་བ / བསྟིང་བ / སྤ་བཀོང་བ triad.

p0468 l.3 (L99), དཀའ་སྤྱད་ཀྱི་སྡུག་བསྔལ་བསྲན་ནས. No entry. Requested explicitly so it stays split from the fixed བཟོད་པ = 'nhẫn': this repair moved བཟོད་པ at L111 to 'nhẫn chịu' and left 'kham nhẫn' to བསྲན alone, but the split only holds if བསྲན is registered.

p0468 l.1 (L93–94), བསྲུང་བ་ལ་སོགས་པའི་ཚོགས་ཀྱིས — the set of activities such as guarding, not saṃbhāra. The registered ཚོགས = 'tư lương' would misread it, and that entry's own note asks for the assembly/gathering sense to be distinguished if it occurs. Text kept; the second, scoped sense needs registering. (Distinct from ཡོན་ཏན་གྱི་ཚོགས at L40, which this repair did move to the registered 'tư lương công đức'.)

p0467 l.3 (L82), སངས་རྒྱས་ཀྱིས་བཅས་པའི་བསླབ་པ — a precept laid down by the Buddha, not one of the three trainings. The existing entry བསླབ་པ = 'môn học' is scoped to the three trainings and does not license this; the near-neighbour བསླབ་པའི་གཞི = 'học xứ' is a different Tibetan form. Text kept; the second sense needs scoping onto the existing entry.

RE-SCOPING REQUEST, not a translator dissent — the text now follows the registered rendering at L104–105 and L115. But the registered entry was decided on རང་གིས་ལག་བདར་ནས་བྱེད་པ (p0195/p0197), where the contrast is with གཞན་བྱེད་དུ་འཇུག་པ. Here the two occurrences sit inside the Satyakaparivarta verse and the Kośa gloss, where the Sanskrit sense is plausibly svahastena = 'with one's own hand' — and this chunk separately renders རང་གི་ལག་གིས (p0468 l.3, L98–99) as 'bằng chính tay mình'. If ལག་བདར is svahastena, the two Tibetan phrases are near-synonyms getting two Vietnamese words, and the entry may need a second scoped sense rather than one blanket rendering. Cannot be decided inside one chunk.

KNOWN COLLISION reproduced, glossary's own. glossary.json registers 'khinh miệt' for both བརྙས་པ and ཁྱད་གསོད, and this chunk has both inside one passage: སློང་བ་པོ་ལ་བརྙས་པ (p0465 l.5, L25) and བདག་ལ་ཁྱད་དུ་གསོད་པར་མི་བྱེད་པར (p0466 l.1, L48). Text follows the glossary and was left alone; the བརྙས་པ entry's note already asks for the split, and this is a fresh instance showing the two words really do co-occur. Note also that the p0466 form is ཁྱད་དུ་གསོད་པ, whose relation to the registered ཁྱད་གསོད should be recorded when the pair is split.

p0488–p0490, ~10×. First of the three-fold division of ཚུལ་ཁྲིམས. Composed from the glossary's fixed ཚུལ་ཁྲིམས = giới and provisional སྡོམ་པ = luật nghi, rather than the compact Sino-Vietnamese 'luật nghi giới', so the three names stay parallel in form.
p0488. Second of the three. The source uses the full form in the division sentence and the contracted དགེ་བ་ཆོས་སྡུད when defining it; both rendered identically.

terms.vi: giới làm lợi ích chúng sinh
terms.note: p0488. Third of the three. Rendered componentially (སེམས་ཅན = chúng sinh, fixed) rather than as 'nhiêu ích hữu tình giới', which would import 'hữu tình' where the glossary fixes 'chúng sinh'. Full and contracted forms rendered identically.

terms.vi: bảy loại biệt giải thoát · biệt giải thoát
terms.note: p0488. རིས = 'loại' (class), rendered plainly rather than 'bảy chúng', which the Tibetan does not say. སོ་ཐར is the source's own contraction of སོ་སོར་ཐར་པ and is given the same Vietnamese; note the glossary's existing entries split the text-title (Biệt Giải Thoát) from the vow (luật nghi biệt giải thoát).

terms.vi: hành và tránh (các điều nên hành và nên tránh)
terms.note: p0489 ×2, p0490. Aligned to c149's rendering of འཇུག་ལྡོག་གི་གནས་རྣམས at p0485 as 'các điều nên hành và nên tránh'. Deliberately NOT the glossary's འཁོར་བའི་འཇུག་ལྡོག = 'lưu chuyển và hoàn diệt', which is the saṃsāra sense of the same pair.

p0489, the Viniścayasaṃgrahaṇī quotation pairs བསྡམས་ཤིང་བསྲུངས four times, and p0490 has སྒོ་གསུམ་ཡང་དག་པར་སྡོམ and the verse ངག་ལུས་ཡིད་རྣམས་ཡང་དག་བསྡམ་བྱ་བ. Two Vietnamese words are needed or the quotation collapses into a tautology. བསྲུང་བ = 'phòng hộ' follows the existing provisional entry; བསྡམ་པ = 'thu thúc' is new and is kept distinct from སྡོམ་པ = 'luật nghi' and from སྡོམ་སེམས = 'tâm ngăn giữ' (both already registered).

p0490. No headword. Rendering taken VERBATIM from c143 (p0461, the parallel passage in the dāna chapter), which enumerates the six as 'sở y tối thắng / sự vật tối thắng / mục đích tối thắng / phương tiện thiện xảo tối thắng / hồi hướng tối thắng / thanh tịnh tối thắng'. Recorded so the two occurrences do not diverge.
p0488 ×2. Contracted form of the registered སྤོང་བའི་སྡོམ་པ = 'luật nghi đoạn trừ' (p0241); same Vietnamese so a sweep does not read them as two terms.

p0489 ×3. The proscriptions laid down by the Buddha. Built on the glossary's བཅས་པའི་མཚམས = 'giới hạn chế định' and on རང་བཞིན་དང་བཅས་པའི་ཁ་ན་མ་ཐོ་བ, whose note already renders བཅས་པ as 'do chế định'. No entry for the bare noun.
p0487 verse (བསླབ་པའི་གནས་རྣམས་ཚང་བར་ཡོངས་རྫོགས་པས). Spelling variant of the glossary's བསླབ་པའི་གཞི = 'học xứ'; same Vietnamese. Kept distinct from བསླབ་བྱ = 'các điều cần học'.

p0487, of the dust from the disciplined person's footprints being carried away མཆོད་པའི་ཞིང་དུ. Uses the glossary's provisional ཞིང = 'ruộng'. Kept distinct from the registered བཀུར་བའི་ཞིང and ཚོགས་གསོག་པའི་ཞིང. See flags — the construction is not fully clear.

p0487 verse: བརྗོད་དུ་མ་འོས་རིགས་སུ་འབྱུང་བ and ཚུལ་ཁྲིམས་དང་ལྡན་རིགས་མཆོག་ཡིན. The existing རིགས = 'chủng tánh' entry is the gotra sense and does not apply. 'dòng dõi' is what every recorded compound uses (རིགས་ཕུན་སུམ་ཚོགས་པ = 'dòng dõi viên mãn'; རིགས་སྐྱེས་པའི་མི = 'người sinh trong dòng dõi') and what c149 uses for Tsongkhapa's prose gloss of this very verse (རང་གི་གཉེན་ལ་སོགས་པའི་རིགས = 'dòng dõi thân quyến'). A ruling is owed on the bare word; 'dòng họ' (c068) should be swept to it if the ruling lands here.
p0488, second of the three. The source uses the full form in the division list and the contracted དགེ་བ་ཆོས་སྡུད when the paragraph takes it up; both rendered identically.

terms.vi: giới làm lợi ích chúng sinh
terms.note: p0488, third of the three. Full form in the division list, contracted སེམས་ཅན་དོན་བྱེད in the paragraph heading; both rendered identically. སེམས་ཅན = 'chúng sinh' (fixed).

p0487 verse, ཚེགས་མེད་མ་བསྒྲུབས་དབང་ཕྱུག་འཐོབ་པར་འགྱུར. The glossary's དབང་ཕྱུག = 'Tự Tại Thiên' is Īśvara the deity (its own note already marks the bare word as having separate uses) and must not be applied here. Consistent with the recorded དབང་ཕྱུག་ཕུན་སུམ་ཚོགས་པ = 'tự tại viên mãn'. This is a fourth distinct use of the bare word after Īśvara, རྣལ་འབྱོར་དབང་ཕྱུག and འཇིག་རྟེན་དབང་ཕྱུག.

p0484, source of the śīla etymology and of the seven/ten abandonings. No glossary entry for the short form འཇུག་འགྲེལ. Aligned VERBATIM to translation/c151 (p0494, same short form, same batch), which renders it 'Chú Giải Nhập Trung Luận' beside འཇུག་པ = '*Nhập Trung Luận*'. Registering it so the two chunks cannot drift apart.

p0484, inside the Madhyamakāvatārabhāṣya quotation — the śīla/śītala ('cool') etymology: the fire of it in the mind being quenched, [śīla] is cool. Hapax in this sense; the only other གཅགས in the whole corpus is དྲིན་དུ་གཅགས་པ (gratitude), which pulls toward 'attachment' rather than 'remorse'. Read as remorse because the sentence's whole point is that śīla COOLS this fire. See flag.

p0485, named as the author of the ཕར་ཕྱིན་བསྡུས་པ verses quoted here. glossary.json has འཕགས་པ་དཔའ་བོ = 'bậc Thánh Dũng' (same author), bare དཔའ་བོ = 'đấng Dũng Mãnh' (Buddha epithet, p0188) and 'dũng sĩ' (ordinary sense). None covers the epithet དཔལ་ལྡན. 'Cát Tường' renders དཔལ་ལྡན per the registered དཔལ་ལྡན་མ་ཁོལ = 'đức Cát Tường Mātṛceṭa' and དཔལ་ལྡན་ཟླ་བ་གྲགས་པ = 'Đấng Cát Tường Nguyệt Xứng'; 'Thánh' was NOT imported, since འཕགས་པ is absent from the Tibetan here. A ruling is needed on whether this person may be unified as 'Thánh Dũng' regardless of the printed epithet — see flag.

terms.vi: những chỗ nên làm và nên tránh
terms.note: p0485. No entry. Kept distinct from གནང་བཀག = 'điều khai điều giá' (translation/c148, p0482), because that pair is about what the vow permits/forbids while this is about entering and turning back. Rendered descriptively rather than with a Sino-Vietnamese compound.

p0486, a hapax — one occurrence in the entire 978-page corpus, and ཁ་གསག (the standard wrong-livelihood 'flattery') occurs zero times. Read as a wrong-livelihood speech-act on the strength of the -གསག element and of the verse that glosses this prose two lines later on p0487 (ཚིག་ཏུ་མ་བརྗོད་ཚེགས་སུ་མ་གྱུར་ཀྱང). Possibly a printing variant of ཁ་གསག. See flag.

p0486, ཚ་གདུང་སེལ་བའི་ཙནྡན་ལ་སོགས་པའི་ལྡེ་གུའི་བྱུག་པ. ལྡེ་གུ = a paste/dough consistency; བྱུག་པ = the ointment/unguent that the passage contrasts with the 'ointment' of śīla two clauses later. ཙནྡན = 'chiên-đàn' per the registered entry (there 'cây chiên-đàn'; here the substance, so the classifier 'cây' was dropped).

p0486, closing the ornament/perfume/ointment series: those with only the outward marks of ordination are alike, but the one who has this is superior. ནོར has no glossary entry; 'tài sản' chosen over 'của báu' because the Tibetan has no རིན་ཆེན.

terms.vi: Cách thức tu học giới ba-la-mật
terms.note: Outline section 6.2.3.1.11.1.1.2. Matched to its sibling 6.2.3.1.11.1.1.3 as rendered in translation/c151 ('Cách thức tu học nhẫn ba-la-mật') and to the six-fold announcement in translation/c141 line 23 ('cách thức tu học bố thí, giới, nhẫn, tinh tấn, tĩnh lự và trí tuệ').

NO entry. c149 splits it deliberately inside one chunk and both readings are defensible: (a) "trang nghiêm" in `ཚུལ་ཁྲིམས་ཀྱི་རྒྱན` where it is the abstract adornment of a Buddha's morality — p0484 l.3 prose and the Pāramitāsamāsa verse at p0485 l.1 (c149 ll.60, 68); (b) "trang sức" throughout the ornament simile, where the word must denote a physical piece of jewellery for the comparison to work at all — `རྒྱན་གཞན` (other ornaments look ridiculous on the very young or very old), `རྒྱན་གྱི་མཆོག`, `རྒྱན་དུ་འགྱུར་བའི་མཆོག` (p0485 l.3 – p0486 l.1; c149 ll.108, 111, 122). Wording kept. Proposed ruling: register the two-way split explicitly with the simile scope named, so it is recorded rather than read as drift.

SCOPE REQUEST, not a violation. Glossary has `བསླབ་པ` = "môn học" (provisional), with the three-trainings compounds fixed as giới học / định học / tuệ học. At `བསླབ་པ་མཚུངས་པར་འགྱུར་བ` (p0486 l.1, c149 l.107) the sense is verbal — one becomes equal in training to the great beings whose nature is compassion — where "môn học" (a subject of study) does not fit. "đồng đẳng về sự tu học" kept. A ruling should say whether the verbal sense takes "sự tu học" or must be forced to "môn học".

UNRESOLVED COLLISION, already flagged in the `འགྲོ་བ` entry's own note and now visible inside a single chunk: `སེམས་ཅན་ཐམས་ཅད` (p0484 l.3, prose, c149 l.60) and `འགྲོ་བ་ཐམས་ཅད` (p0485 l.1, Pāramitāsamāsa verse, c149 l.69) both come out as "hết thảy chúng sinh" nine lines apart, so two different Tibetan words are invisible to the reader at close range. Text kept — it follows the glossary exactly as written (`སེམས་ཅན` = chúng sinh is FIXED; `འགྲོ་བ` = chúng sinh is provisional). Only a central ruling can break this: either accept the merge explicitly, or give `འགྲོ་བ` a distinct rendering (e.g. "loài hữu tình" / "chúng hữu tình") and sweep the corpus.
p0472, paired with གནོད་སྦྱིན = dạ-xoa (registered). No entry for སྲིན་པོ; 'la-sát' already used once elsewhere in the corpus.

p0471, quoted inside the Śikṣāsamuccaya passage. The glossary's existing entry འཕགས་པ་ནམ་མཁའི་མཛོད = 'Thánh Hư Không Tạng' notes the Tibetan there carries no མདོ. HERE the Tibetan DOES write ...ཀྱི་མདོ་ལས, so the 'Kinh' prefix is licensed by the source, not supplied. That answers the open question in that entry's note: the two forms are deliberate, tracking the presence or absence of མདོ.

terms.vi: nghề công xảo và các ngành nghề
terms.note: p0469. Built on c005's 'công xảo minh' for བཟོ་རིག; ལས་ཀྱི་གནས rendered 'các ngành nghề'. No entry.
p0469, qualifying the khenpo/lopön/students/companions who cannot give. Kept distinct from སེར་སྣ = xan lận (registered) and from ཆགས་པ alone.
p0470, the opposite pole of ཚོར་བ་བདེ་བ in the brief presentation of what may/may not be given. No entry.

p0470, the controlling pair of the whole མདོར་བསྟན་པ paragraph (4 occurrences each). Both forms already used in the corpus (trước mắt ×8, rốt ráo ×29) but neither is registered as the partner of the other.

terms.vi: người tinh cần trì luật nghi
terms.note: p0472. Built on the glossary's སྡོམ་པ = luật nghi (provisional). No entry.
p0471, printed in source/clean as སྨོན་པ — see flags. Paired with སེམས་འཁྲུགས་པ = 'kẻ tâm trí rối loạn'. Both are on the Bodhisattvabhūmi list of petitioners one must not give to.
p0471–p0472, བླ་བརྡོལ་ཙམ་དུ་ཟད་པ, contrasted with བསམ་པ་ཐག་པ་ནས་སློང་བ. No entry.

p0472. The second of the two ways of giving the body: གནས་སྐབས་དབང་བྱར་སྦྱིན་པ = giving oneself temporarily as something the recipient may direct (e.g. going as a བྲན = kẻ tôi tớ). Rendered 'cho một cách tạm thời để [người ấy] sai sử'; the bracketed agent is a supply, see flags.
p0472, ཡན་ལག་ལ་སོགས་པ་གསེས་ནས་གཏན་དུ་སྦྱིན་པ. Reading གསེས་པ as 'sever/detach'. No entry.

terms.bo: སྐྱོ་བ (sense: discouragement/disheartenment at a task or at beings — སྐྱོ་བར་འགྱུར་བ, སྐྱོ་བར་གྱུར་པ)
terms.note: p0470 (གང་གིས་སྐྱོ་བར་འགྱུར་བའི་བརྩོན་འགྲུས, Śikṣāsamuccaya quote) and p0471 (སེམས་ཅན་དེ་དག་ལ་བྱང་ཆུབ་སེམས་དཔའ་སྐྱོ་བར་གྱུར་པས). The registered སྐྱོ་བ = 'nhàm chán' (provisional) is the saṃsāra-weariness / disenchantment sense, companion to སྐྱོ་ཤས = 'lòng yểm ly'. Here the sense is a bodhisattva becoming discouraged by an over-hard practice and toward the beings who ask, which is why the seed of bodhicitta is said to be destroyed — 'nhàm chán' would positively invert the doctrine (disenchantment is a virtue there, a defect here). Precedent for splitting already exists in the glossary: the སྐྱོ་བ་སྤངས་པ entry's own note says 'chán nản alone would mislead' in ITS context, i.e. the two senses are already treated as distinct. Requesting an explicit sense-split entry so this stops being silent divergence. Wording kept.

terms.bo: དཀའ་སྤྱད (sense: the hardship/ordeal of being asked for one's own flesh, not an ascetic discipline)
terms.note: p0470, ལུས་ཀྱི་ཤ་ལ་སོགས་པ་སློང་བའི་དཀའ་སྤྱད་ཀྱིས་ཡིད་འབྱུང་བར་མི་འགྱུར་བ. The registered དཀའ་སྤྱད = 'hạnh khó hành' (provisional) is scoped to འཁོར་བའི་དཀའ་སྤྱད, where དཀའ་སྤྱད is a practice one undertakes; here it is the hardship attaching to being asked. Note also that the genitive སློང་བའི་དཀའ་སྤྱད is ambiguous as to whose ordeal it is (the asking, or the giving occasioned by it); 'hạnh khó hành' would resolve it toward the bodhisattva's own practice, which the Tibetan does not state. Wording kept and the neutral bracketed supply '[kẻ khác]' retained; requesting a sense-split rather than a forced substitution.

p0471 ཡན་ལག་ལ་སོགས་པ་སློང (twice) and p0472 ཡན་ལག་ལ་སོགས་པ་གསེས་ནས — limbs cut from the body and given away. The registered ཡན་ལག = 'chi' (provisional) is explicitly scoped to the seven-limb practice ('kept as bare chi so the seven are countable'), and bare 'chi' here would collide with it. 'chi phần' is already used in the registered ཡན་ལག་གི་ལྟུང་བ = 'đọa tội chi phần'. Requesting the anatomical sense be recorded.

p0470, ཕུགས་སུ་ཕན་པ་སྡིག་སྤོང་བའམ་དགེ་བ་ལ་འགོད་པ. The registered དགེ་བ = 'thiện' (provisional) says in its own note that a ruling between 'thiện' / 'điều thiện' / 'thiện pháp' is still outstanding; in this verbal frame ('establish [someone] in ___') Vietnamese needs the nominal 'điều thiện'. Wording kept; requesting the outstanding ruling be closed, covering the ལ་འགོད་པ frame.

p0472, གཞན་གྱི་ཆོས་ལྡན་གྱི་དགོས་པ་སྒྲུབ་པའི་ཕྱིར་བྲན་དུ་འགྲོ་བ. No ruling existed. The chunk's earlier 'hợp pháp' has been changed because it reads as 'lawful/legal' in Vietnamese; 'đúng pháp' keeps the bare 'pháp' the ཆོས fixed-set licenses and adds no qualifier. 'hợp với Chánh pháp' was deliberately avoided: the ཆོས fixed-set note states 'chánh pháp is NOT licensed'.

Not a defect in this chunk — the usage follows the registered དམ་པའི་ཆོས = 'Chánh pháp' (provisional). Recorded only to keep the standing tension visible: that entry sits against the ཆོས fixed-set note ('chánh pháp is NOT licensed') and against the fixed དམ་ཆོས = 'Diệu pháp'. Nothing changed at L75; the three entries need one joint ruling.
p0472, རབ་བྱུང་དང་བསྙེན་གནས་ཅན་ལ་ཕྱི་དྲོའི་ཁ་ཟས. Only compounds (རབ་བྱུང་མ), the multi-term row 'hàng xuất gia', and རབ་ཏུ་བྱུང་བ = 'xuất gia' exist; no ruling for the bare noun.
p0469, རང་གི་མཁན་སློབ. Contraction of མཁན་པོ + སློབ་དཔོན; built from the two separate registered entries. Recording the contracted form so it is not re-decided.
p0500, in the triad ཡུལ་དང་ཡུལ་ཅན་དང་རྟེན་ལ་བརྟགས་ན — the three angles from which anger is shown to be unreasonable. No glossary entry.
p0500, second member of the same triad. Standard Sino-Vietnamese 有境; kept distinct from ཡུལ = cảnh. No glossary entry.

p0501-p0502, twice (Catuḥśataka: སྨན་པ་འཁྲུག་པ་མིན; Candrakīrti: སེམས་ཅན་དག་ལ་འཁྲུག་མི་བྱེད). Deliberately given a third word so it stays separable from ཁྲོ་བ = sân giận and ཞེ་སྡང = sân hận, both of which occur in the same chunk, and from ཁོང་ཁྲོ = phẫn nộ used in c151.
p0499, རྐང་པ་དང་པོའི་རྒྱུ་མཚན = 'lý do của câu kệ thứ nhất', pointing back to the first line of the just-quoted Bodhicaryāvatāra verse. Matches c028's 'câu kệ'.
p0500, སྡུག་བསྔལ་དང་དུ་ལེན་པ, second of the three kinds of nhẫn. Follows c151's 'kham nhận việc khổ'.

terms.vi: tâm xác quyết đối với pháp
terms.note: p0500, third of the three kinds of nhẫn. Built on the registered ངེས་པ = sự xác quyết; c151 rendered the parallel phrase 'tư duy xác quyết về pháp'. The two forms are close but not identical — worth pinning.
p0502 Bodhicaryāvatāra verse སྤྲུལ་ལྟ་བུའི་དངོས་པོ. Rendered literally as 'vật biến hóa' rather than 'huyễn' — the Tibetan is nirmita (emanation), not māyā.

p0500-p0502, ~10 occurrences — the pivot of this whole argument (རང་དབང་ཡོད་མེད་བརྟགས་ན). No glossary entry; 'tự chủ' is already the dominant corpus form (c116, c121, c141, c150) against 'tự tại', which the corpus uses for དབང་འབྱོར/དབང་ཐོབ senses.
p0499-p0500. Follows the corpus majority (c033, c072, c073, c079, c085); 'không đáng ưa' also occurs and the two should be split or merged by ruling.

terms.vi: Cách thức tu học nơi nhẫn ba-la-mật
terms.note: Outline s180, path 6.2.3.1.11.1.1.3. Built to match the sibling heading already rendered in c149 for ཚུལ་ཁྲིམས་ཀྱི་ཕར་ཕྱིན་ལ་བསླབ་ཚུལ = 'Cách thức tu học nơi giới ba-la-mật', so the six pāramitā headings read as one series. Uses the fixed བཟོད་པ = nhẫn and ཕར་ཕྱིན = ba-la-mật.

terms.vi: sự tư duy xác quyết về pháp
terms.note: p0491 l5, in ཆོས་ལ་ངེས་པར་སེམས་པ་ལ་མོས་པ་ཤིན་ཏུ་གནས་པ — the third of the three patiences. NO entry. Built on the registered ངེས་པ = 'sự xác quyết' and the fixed-set ཆོས = pháp; མོས་པ rendered 'lòng tin ưa' per the existing provisional entry.

p0491, the vipakṣa of the second patience (ཞེ་སྡང་དང་ཞུམ་ནས་སྲོ་ཤི་བ). NO entry for either ཞུམ་པ or སྲོ་ཤི་བ. Rendered as a two-verb phrase mirroring the Tibetan (ཞུམ = daunted, སྲོ་ཤི = losing vitality/heart). See flag — I am not fully certain of སྲོ་ཤི་བ.

p0491–p0493, 3× (སེམས་ཅན་ཐམས་ཅད་མི་བསྲུན་པ་དང་བྲལ་བ; the Bodhicaryāvatāra verse སེམས་ཅན་མི་བསྲུན་ནམ་མཁའ་བཞིན; མི་བསྲུན་སྐྱེ་བོ / མི་བསྲུན་པ་རྣམས in the Pāramitāsamāsa verse and its gloss). NO entry. Kept distinct from the anger family (ཞེ་སྡང / ཁྲོ་བ / ཁོང་ཁྲོ) because it describes beings, not a mental factor.

p0491 l1 (ཤིན་ཏུ་ལྕི་བའི་ཉེས་ལྟུང་གིས་རྒྱུན་དུ་གོས་པར་འགྱུར). NO entry. c105 already renders it 'lỗi và đọa tội'; kept identical. Mirrors the registered སྡིག་ལྟུང = 'tội và đọa tội' and builds on ལྟུང་བ = 'đọa tội'.

p0492, inside the Bodhisattvabhūmi quotation, paired with བདེ་བ (registered provisionally as 'lạc'). NO entry. Rendered descriptively rather than with 'ý lạc', which is already the registered Vietnamese for བསམ་པ (āśaya), or with 'hỷ', which would pre-empt a དགའ་བ / སྤྲོ་བ ruling.

p0493, Pāramitāsamāsa verse (གཟུགས་སྒྲུབ་བཟོ་ཡི་གནས་ཀྱང་བཟོད་པ་ཡིན). NO entry for the bare term; c005 renders བཟོའི་གནས inside the list of the four vidyāsthānas as 'công xảo minh'. Here 'minh' is dropped because the verse means the craft itself, not the branch of learning. Glossed in the following prose as བཟོ་བོ་མཁས་པ = 'người thợ khéo'.

p0494. A third sense of རྟེན beyond the two already recorded ('thân y' = the physical basis for practice; 'sở y' in c028 = a physical representation). Here it is the person in whom the anger arises — the topic being whether the angry party must himself be a bodhisattva. Rendered 'sở y' following c028's word rather than 'thân y', which would import the body sense.

p0494, cited for the destruction of a hundred kalpas' virtue. NO entry. Built from the glossary's འཇམ་དཔལ = 'Văn-thù' plus རྣམ་པར་རོལ་པ = vikrīḍita, the established Sino-Vietnamese 遊戲 = 'Du Hý'. 'Kinh' is warranted here because the Tibetan writes མདོ. NOT verified against an existing Vietnamese edition.

p0494, 2× (འཇུག་པར་ཡང་; འཇུག་པ་ལས). The bare short form of the glossary's དབུ་མ་ལ་འཇུག་པ = 'Nhập Trung Luận'; the identification is secured by the quoted verse གང་ཕྱིར་རྒྱལ་སྲས་རྣམས་ལ་ཁྲོས་པ་ཡིས (MAv III.6). Same Vietnamese title used, on the precedent of སྤྱོད་འཇུག / སྤྱོད་པ་ལ་འཇུག་པ. Recorded so the sweep does not read it as a second work.

terms.vi: phái Thánh Nhất Thiết Hữu Bộ
terms.note: p0494 closing line, inside a Śikṣāsamuccaya citation that runs on into c152. NO entry. Established Sino-Vietnamese 聖說一切有部. Deliberately distinct from the registered བྱེ་བྲག་ཏུ་སྨྲ་བ = 'phái Tỳ-bà-sa', whose note records that 'Hữu bộ' was reserved for exactly this term. The chunk is cut mid-title, so c152 must confirm what work of the school is being quoted.

terms.bo: འབྱེ་བ (in the Bodhisattvabhūmi list of patience's benefits)
terms.note: p0492, འབྱེ་བ་མང་བར་མི་འགྱུར་བ, second in the list. NO entry. Read as the noun of འབྱེད་པ 'to split/divide' — being estranged from others — parallel to the preceding དགྲ་མང་བར་མི་འགྱུར་བ. Rendered plainly; see flag.

terms.kind: sense-split needed — wording kept, ruling owed across c151/c153/c154
terms.note: p0494 L (ཁོང་ཁྲོ་སྐྱེ་བའི་རྟེན་ནི།). The registered entry རྟེན = "thân y" is scoped by its own note to the physical basis/support for practice (རྟེན་བཟང་པོ, སྡོམ་པའི་རྟེན, ལམ་བསྒྲུབ་པའི་རྟེན, p0114–p0116), and it records c028 using "sở y" for yet a third sense (a physical representation). Here རྟེན is neither: it is the person in whom anger arises — the sentence that follows glosses it entirely in terms of who is angry (བྱང་སེམས་ཀྱིས་ཁྲོས་ནའང… བྱང་སེམས་མ་ཡིན་པས་བྱང་སེམས་ལ་ཁྲོས་ན). "thân y" would import a bodily-support reading the Tibetan does not carry. The adjacent chunks c153 L62 and c154 L119 render the same རྟེན in the same anger-analysis as "sở y" ("xét về … sở y"), so an edit confined to c151 would split one continuous section. Kept, and referred up: the entry itself asks for the central ruling. Recommended shape: keep "thân y" for the practice-support sense, add "sở y" for āśraya as the person/locus in which a mental event arises, and apply it to c151/c153/c154 together.

terms.kind: gap — second sense needed, wording kept
terms.note: p0492, inside the བྱང་ས quotation: ལུས་ཞིག་ནས་ཀྱང་བདེ་འགྲོ་མཐོ་རིས་ཀྱི་འཇིག་རྟེན་དུ་ལྷ་རྣམས་ཀྱི་ནང་དུ་སྐྱེ་བར་འགྱུར. The registered bare ལྷ = "bổn tôn" is itself marked "gap — ruling needed, wording kept under protest" and is scoped to p0154 ལྷ་དང་བླ་མ, a Kadampa iṣṭadevatā context; its note's "'chư thiên' is wrong here" applies to that context. Here ལྷ་རྣམས is governed by བདེ་འགྲོ་མཐོ་རིས་ཀྱི་འཇིག་རྟེན and is unambiguously the devas of the higher realms, where "bổn tôn" would be plainly wrong. Needs a second entry: ལྷ in the deva-realm sense = "chư thiên".

terms.vi: "một ý phẫn nộ" (L117) / "từ tận đáy lòng" (L11)
terms.kind: gap — entry scoped to āśaya, no ruling for these two uses
terms.note: The registered བསམ་པ = "ý lạc" is explicitly the term paired with སྦྱོར་བ (āśaya). p0494 ཁོང་ཁྲོའི་བསམ་པ་སྐད་ཅིག་ཙམ་ཞིག་སྐྱེས་པས is a single momentary thought of anger — "một ý lạc phẫn nộ" would be incoherent. p0491 བསམ་པ་ཐག་པས is the fixed adverbial idiom ("wholeheartedly / from the depth of intent") and is not a nominal term at all. Two rulings needed: བསམ་པ as a passing/occurrent thought, and the idiom བསམ་པ་ཐག་པས.

p0493. Matches the provisional entry འགྲོ་བ = "chúng sinh", but that entry's own note flags the collision with the fixed སེམས་ཅན = "chúng sinh", and both terms occur in this one chunk (སེམས་ཅན་མི་བསྲུན at L29 verse, སེམས་ཅན་ཐམས་ཅད at L37, སེམས་ཅན་གྱི་ལོག་སྒྲུབ at L88). Not a translator error; the unresolved collision resurfacing. A distinguishing rendering for འགྲོ་བ is owed.

terms.kind: gap — abbreviation needs its own entry
terms.note: p0494 L116 (འཇུག་པར་ཡང་) and L122 (འཇུག་པ་ལས). Only the full form དབུ་མ་ལ་འཇུག་པ = "Nhập Trung Luận" is registered. The abbreviation needs registering in its own right, the way སྤྱོད་འཇུག and བྱང་ས were.
p0494 L137, in འཕགས་པ་ཐམས་ཅད་ཡོད་པར་སྨྲ་བའི (the sentence runs into the next chunk).

terms.kind: gap — folds into the ཞེ་སྡང / ཁྲོ་བ / ཁོང་ཁྲོ ruling already requested
terms.note: p0494 L120–136 (ཡུལ་ཇི་འདྲ་ཞིག་ལ་ཁྲོས་པ, རྒྱལ་སྲས་རྣམས་ལ་ཁྲོས་པ་ཡིས, བྱང་སེམས་ཀྱིས་ཁྲོས་ནའང, བྱང་སེམས་ལ་ཁྲོས་པ). Only the nominal ཁྲོ་བ = "sân giận" is registered. "nổi sân" reduces to bare "sân", which the ཁོང་ཁྲོ entry reserves for ཞེ་སྡང — and ཞེ་སྡང = "sân hận" occurs twice at L33 of this same chunk. This chunk uses all four members (ཞེ་སྡང L33, ཁྲོ་བ L36/43/89, ཁོང་ཁྲོ L112/117, ཁྲོས་པ L120–136), so it is a good test case for the joint ruling the ཁྲོ་བ entry already asks for.

p0493: གཟུགས་སྒྲུབ་བཟོ་ཡི་གནས་ཀྱང་བཟོད་པ་ཡིན (verse, L86) and the prose gloss …སྒྲུབ་པའི་བཟོ་བོ་མཁས་པ (L93). The verse term and its prose gloss are deliberately rendered differently; a ruling should confirm or unify.

p0461, the Mahāyānasaṃgraha's six 'supremacies' of a pāramitā. Members rendered: རྟེན་དམ་པ = 'sở y tối thắng', དངོས་པོ་དམ་པ = 'vật tối thắng', ཆེད་དུ་བྱ་བ་དམ་པ = 'mục đích tối thắng', ཐབས་མཁས་པ་དམ་པ = 'phương tiện thiện xảo tối thắng', བསྔོ་བ་དམ་པ = 'hồi hướng tối thắng', རྣམ་པར་དག་པ་དམ་པ = 'thanh tịnh tối thắng'. དམ་པ rendered 'tối thắng' on the precedent of ཞིང་དམ་པ = 'ruộng tối thắng' (c062/p0408), NOT 'chân chính' (བཤེས་གཉེན་དམ་པ) or 'chân nhân' (སྐྱེས་བུ་དམ་པ). Needs one central ruling, since three different Vietnamese words for དམ་པ are now live.

terms.bo: རྟེན (sense: the practitioner's status as basis of giving)
terms.note: p0461, three times in the sa-bcad (རྟེན་ཐམས་ཅད་ཀྱིས་ཇི་ལྟར་བྱ་བ / རྟེན་སོ་སོ་ལ་ལྟོས་པའི་རབ་དབྱེ / རྟེན་དམ་པ). Not the glossary's རྟེན = 'thân y' (scoped by its own note to the physical basis for practice) — here the second division turns out to mean householder vs. ordained, so it is the practitioner's status. Follows the 'sở y' precedent already recorded for the affliction-basis and c028/c063.
p0461, cited for the six དམ་པ. Full form of the contracted ཐེག་བསྡུས already registered as 'Nhiếp Đại Thừa' (that entry's own note points at this chunk). Same Vietnamese for both forms.
p0462, the Śāriputra passage on householder vs. ordained giving. Matches c021 line 44, which already uses '*Bồ-tát Biệt Giải Thoát*'; recorded so the title is fixed rather than re-derived.

p0464, དགའ་བའི་བསམ་པ = 'ý lạc hỷ', third member of the sequence བྱམས་པ / སྙིང་རྗེ / དགའ་བ / བཏང་སྙོམས applied to different recipients of giving. Uses the glossary's བྱམས་པ = từ, སྙིང་རྗེ = bi, བཏང་སྙོམས = xả so the four stay visibly parallel. Bare དགའ་བ has no entry (only ཀུན་དགའ་བོ / དགའ་བོ as names and རང་དགའ་བ = 'thuần túy').

terms.bo: སྣོད (sense: a worthy recipient of a gift)
terms.note: p0464, twice inside cited verse: སྣོད་དམ་སྣོད་མིན (Candrakīrti) and སྣོད་གཞན་ཡོན་ཏན་དག་དང་ལྡན (Guṇāparyantastotra). The glossary's སྣོད = 'bình chứa' is scoped to the three-faults-of-the-vessel simile; here it is the fit recipient of alms. Kept 'bình chứa' rather than 'pháp khí', which would import ཆོས the Tibetan does not have. A scope note is needed or Phase 5 will read this as a false hit.

p0461 ×2 (contracted རྫོགས་བྱང) and p0464 (full རྫོགས་པའི་བྱང་ཆུབ, in the Pāramitāsamāsa verse). Both rendered identically, following the corpus majority ('bồ-đề viên mãn' ×8 vs 'viên mãn bồ-đề' ×3). Unregistered; recorded so the contraction and the full form stay collapsed.

p0461, ཐེག་དམན་དང་མ་འདྲེས་པའི་སེམས་རྩེ་གཅིག་པས — the dhyāna member of the six pāramitās within giving. The glossary's རྩེ་གཅིག་པ = 'sự nhất tâm' is a nominal and cannot take the head noun སེམས ('tâm nhất tâm' is not Vietnamese), so the live corpus variant 'chuyên nhất' (c014/c033) was used. That entry's own note already asks for a ruling between 'nhất tâm' and 'chuyên nhất'; this is a third case for it.

p0462, ཐོས་པ་ལ་སོགས་པའི་བར་གཅོད་དུ་འགྱུར་བ. Follows the registered བར་གཅོད = 'sự gây chướng ngại' (p0204) and is kept distinct from གེགས = 'chướng ngại', which occurs in this same chunk's sa-bcad (སྦྱིན་པའི་གེགས་ཀྱི་གཉེན་པོ).
