p0583, cited inside the Bhāvanākrama II quotation. Built on the registered མྱ་ངན་ལས་འདས་པ་ཆེན་པོ = '*Đại Bát Niết Bàn*' (p0139), with འཕགས་པ = Thánh and མདོ = Kinh, both present in the Tibetan here and absent at p0139.

p0583, cited inside the Bhāvanākrama II quotation as the source of the two-line verse ཞི་གནས་སྟོབས་ཀྱིས་གཡོ་བ་མེད་པར་འགྱུར. Built on the registered ཟླ་བ་སྒྲོན་མ = 'Nguyệt Đăng' (p0455); མདོ is present in the Tibetan here, so 'Kinh' is added.
p0583, in the Mahāparinirvāṇa quotation. Composed from the registered དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ = 'Như Lai' and རིགས = 'chủng tánh'.
p0584, ཕས་ཀྱི་རྒོལ་བས་བསྒུལ་མི་ནུས་པའི་རི་དང་འདྲ་བ. No entry for རྒོལ་བ at all. The debate opponent. 'kẻ đối luận' chosen over 'địch luận' as plainer.
p0583 (ལྟ་བ་ངན་པའི་དྲ་བ = 'lưới ác kiến', inside the Bhāvanākrama quotation) and p0584 (བདག་ཏུ་ལྟ་བ་ལ་སོགས་པའི་ལྟ་བ་ངན་པ་རྣམས). Neither is registered. Both use the glossary's ལྟ་བ = 'kiến'.

p0584, ཞི་གནས་ཀྱི་མཉམ་གཞག་དང་ལྡན་པའི་ཤེས་རབ. The contracted form; glossary carries only the finite མཉམ་པར་བཞག་པ = 'nhập đẳng dẫn' (p0447), so the noun is rendered 'đẳng dẫn' and the verbal form in the Dharmasaṃgīti quote here stays 'nhập đẳng dẫn'.

terms.vi: bức tranh trên vách / tôn tượng được vẽ
terms.note: p0582, the lamp simile. ལོགས་རིས = a mural. བྲིས་སྐུ uses the honorific སྐུ, so 'tôn tượng' rather than plain 'hình'; the next clause switches to plain གཟུགས་རྣམས = 'các hình sắc' and is kept plain. See flags.
p0584, གར་བཞག་ཏུ་ལྷན་ལྷན་སྡོད་པ. Onomatopoeic-adverbial: settling and staying put wherever placed. Rendered non-technically; no Sino-Vietnamese equivalent claimed.

p0584, the second lamp simile (the wick and preceding flame produce the illuminating aspect; the wind-screen produces the stable aspect). Everyday nouns, recorded only so the simile stays consistent with the first lamp simile on p0582.

terms.vi: an lạc, sáng tỏ, không phân biệt
terms.note: p0582 l.1 (×3), in `བདེ་གསལ་མི་རྟོག་པའི་ཏིང་ངེ་འཛིན` and twice standalone. No entry for the compound. A named technical triad (bliss / clarity / non-conceptuality) that the whole passage is built around and that recurs across the śamatha–vipaśyanā division; deserves a fixed ruling now, including whether it is rendered as a three-term list or as a fixed compound. Related, also unregistered: `དགའ་བདེ` (prīti-sukha) → 'hỷ lạc' and `གསལ་ཆ` → 'phần sáng tỏ', both p0582 l.1. Note `བདེ་བ` → 'an lạc' rather than the bare headword 'lạc' matches existing corpus entries (e.g. `མཐོང་ཆོས་བདེ་བ` → 'an lạc hiện pháp'). Wording kept.

p0583 l.1 (`ལྟ་བ་ངན་པའི་དྲ་བ` → 'lưới ác kiến', inside the Bhāvanākrama quote) and p0584 l.3 (`བདག་ཏུ་ལྟ་བ་ལ་སོགས་པའི་ལྟ་བ་ངན་པ་རྣམས`). Only bare `ལྟ་བ` → 'kiến' (provisional) is registered; the negative compound has no entry. Wording kept.

p0582 l.1, `དགའ་བདེ་སྐྱེ་བ་ཆོས་ཉིད་ཡིན་པས`. Not a violation — recorded only so a later sweep does not 'correct' it to the headword 'pháp tánh'. The glossary already carries `ཆོས་ཉིད་ཀྱིས` → 'theo lẽ tự nhiên' (idiom, non-doctrinal sense); this is the predicative form of the same idiom and is not itself listed. Wording kept.

p0560. No glossary entry. The Tibetan translates the questioner's name (srid med kyi bu = Nārāyaṇa). Follows the pattern already fixed for དྲག་ཤུལ་ཅན་གྱིས་ཞུས་པ = 'Kinh Ugra Thỉnh Vấn' (Sanskrit name kept in transcription, ཞུས་པ = thỉnh vấn). The established Sino-Vietnamese 'Na-la-diên' was the alternative; rejected only to stay consistent with the Ugra ruling, so this is worth a project-owner check.

p0560, ལམ་གྱི་སྲོག་དམ་པ་ཆོས་རབ་ཏུ་རྣམ་འབྱེད་ཀྱི་ཤེས་རབ. No entry. Rendered 'trạch pháp' (擇法, as in trạch pháp giác chi) and deliberately kept distinct from the glossary's སོ་སོར་རྟོག་པ = 'giản trạch', because both terms occur within four lines of each other on this page.

p0562. glossary.json carries ལུང་གི་བསྟན་པ / རྟོགས་པའི་བསྟན་པ = 'giáo pháp thuộc phần giáo / thuộc phần chứng'. Here the second member is སྒྲུབ་པ, not རྟོགས་པ, and the whole passage turns on སྒྲུབ་པ = tu hành/thực hành, so it is rendered 'phần hành' rather than silently collapsed into the registered 'phần chứng'.
p0562, བསྟན་འཛིན་གྱི་མཆོག. No entry. Built on the glossary's བསྟན་པ = giáo pháp; 持教 is the established Sino-Vietnamese.

p0563, སྒོམ་ཆེན་རབ / སྒོམ་ཆེན་འབྲིང. No entry. Kept short so the རབ / འབྲིང grading reads as an attribute; deliberately NOT 'bậc thượng/trung', which the glossary reserves for སྐྱེས་བུ་ཆེན་པོ / འབྲིང.

terms.vi: quả Phật Nhất Thiết Chủng Trí
terms.note: p0560, inside Naljorpa Chenpo's saying. Established Sino-Vietnamese 一切種智.
p0563, ཉམས་ལེན་གྱི་ཕྱོགས་རེ་ཙམ་ལ་བྲོད་པ་རྙེད་པ. No entry. Delight/enthusiasm at a partial practice, contrasted in the same sentence with ངེས་པ = sự xác quyết.
p0560, དེའི་རང་འགྲེལ (the Śikṣāsamuccaya's own commentary). No entry.

p0563 l.1. No ruling for bare ལྷ. Text KEPT — corpus precedent is uniform (c048 renders the same pair ལྷ་དང་བླ་མ identically; c005/c107/c108 also use 'bổn tôn'). Flagging that 'bổn tôn' (iṣṭadevatā) is narrower than ལྷ (deity in general) and that the glossary's other ལྷ compounds go to 'chư thiên' / 'thiên chủ' (e.g. ལྷ་དབང་བརྒྱ་བྱིན, བདུད་ཀྱི་རིས་ཀྱི་ལྷ). A ruling should state that bare ལྷ beside བླ་མ in a practice context takes 'bổn tôn' while ལྷ as a class of beings does not.

p0563 l.1, `ཚོགས་བསག་པ་དང་སྒྲིབ་པ་སྦྱང་བ`. The only bare སྒྲིབ་པ entry is 'triền cái' (nīvaraṇa, the five hindrances at p0085), a sense impossible here; the other registered forms carry ལས་ explicitly (ཆོས་སྤོང་བའི་ལས་ཀྱི་སྒྲིབ་པ = 'nghiệp chướng của việc bỏ pháp'). The chunk's 'nghiệp chướng' imported a ལས་ the Tibetan does not write, so it was changed to 'tịnh trừ các chướng'. A ruling is needed for the general obscuration sense — it recurs constantly in the ཚོགས་བསག་སྒྲིབ་སྦྱང་ formula.

The registered person entries are mutually inconsistent: ཕུ་ཆུང་བ = 'Puchungwa' and དགོན་པ་བ = 'Gönpawa' are bare, while པོ་ཏོ་བ = 'ngài Potowa', ཤ་ར་བ = 'ngài Sharawa', ཀ་མ་བ = 'ngài Kamapa' carry the honorific. All four of the first group appear in c169 within fifteen lines of each other, so following the entries as recorded now produces bare 'Puchungwa' and 'Chengawa' beside 'ngài Potowa', 'ngài Sharawa', 'ngài Kamapa' in adjacent paragraphs. I followed the recorded entries rather than the chunk's internal consistency. This is the same defect already raised from c107; one policy — 'ngài' on every master, or on none with the honorific carried by 'dạy' — plus a sweep would settle both.

terms.vi: Cách thức tu học bát-nhã ba-la-mật
terms.note: Outline path 6.2.3.1.11.1.1.6, the last of the six pāramitā headings. Built on the sibling series already translated: c149 'Cách thức tu học giới ba-la-mật', c159 'Cách thức tu học tinh tấn ba-la-mật', c166 'Cách thức tu học tĩnh lự ba-la-mật'. NOTE c151 alone reads 'Cách thức tu học NƠI nhẫn ba-la-mật' — the series is already split two ways and needs one ruling. 'bát-nhã' (not 'trí tuệ') per decisions.md's standing rule that ཤེས་རབ = bát-nhã inside ཤེས་རབ་ཀྱི་ཕར་ཕྱིན; bare ཤེས་རབ throughout the body of this chunk is 'trí tuệ'.

p0552, twice — in Tsongkhapa's own definition of prajñā and inside the Bodhisattvabhūmi quotation. No entry. 'giản trạch' is already the corpus-wide rendering of the ...རྣམ་པར་འབྱེད་པ / སོ་སོར་རྟོག་པ family (c011, c032, c033, c076, c083 etc.), so this is continuity, not a new choice; only the full compound is unrecorded. Deliberately NOT the compact Sino-Vietnamese 'trạch pháp', which would lose the intensifiers རབ་ཏུ / རྣམ་པར and collide with the bodhyaṅga name.

terms.vi: nội minh · nhân minh · y phương minh · thanh minh · minh về công xảo cùng nghiệp xứ
terms.note: p0552, Bodhisattvabhūmi quotation. glossary.json registers only the set རིག་པའི་གནས་ལྔ = 'năm minh xứ'; the five members are unrecorded. Four match c005's 'thanh minh, nhân minh, công xảo minh và y phương minh' for the four-fold list. The fifth, བཟོ་དང་ལས་ཀྱི་གནས་ཀྱི་རིག་པ, is rendered in full ('minh về công xảo cùng nghiệp xứ') rather than c005's compact 'công xảo minh', because this Tibetan spells out ལས་ཀྱི་གནས as well. A ruling should say whether the two are unified.

terms.bo: རིག་པ (in the Nāgārjuna verse ཆོས་དོན་འདོད་དང་ཐར་པ་ཡི། འབྱུང་གནས་ཆེན་པོ་རིག་པ་ཡིན།)
terms.note: p0552–p0553. Not the same word as ཤེས་རབ, which the surrounding verse lines already use as 'trí tuệ', so it must stay visibly distinct. Bare 'minh' is opaque in Vietnamese outside the compound 'minh xứ'; 'minh trí' keeps the link to the registered རིག་པའི་གནས = 'minh xứ'. Uncertain — see flag.

terms.vi: pháp, tài, dục và giải thoát
terms.note: p0553, Nāgārjuna verse. The four human aims. དོན rendered 'tài' (artha, wealth/aim) and འདོད 'dục'; ཐར་པ = 'giải thoát' is fixed in glossary.json. No entry for the list.

p0553, Nāgārjuna verse. glossary.json has རྒྱལ་བའི་ཡུམ = 'Phật mẫu của chư Đấng Chiến Thắng' and bare ཡུམ = 'Mẹ' (p0358), but nothing for ཡུམ་ཆེན. 'Phật mẫu' was NOT used: the Tibetan says only 'great mother', with no སངས་རྒྱས.

p0553, in the gold-ornament simile. Sanskrit kept in transliteration, following the glossary's རྒྱལ་པོ་ཨིནྡྲ་བྷཱུ་ཏི = 'vua Indrabhūti'. The established Sino-Vietnamese 'đế thanh bảo' (帝青寶) was deliberately not used, because 'Đế' would collide with the two entries already rendering 'Đế Thích' (བརྒྱ་བྱིན and bare དབང་པོ) in a chunk that also uses དབང་པོ = 'căn' six times.

p0553, the inlay-gems of the ornament simile, used twice: once literally (of indranīla) and once figuratively (of prajñā). Rendered the same way in both so the simile's two halves stay visibly matched. No entry.

p0554, སྲིད་ཞིའི་རྒུད་པ་མཐོང་བའི་ཤེས་རབ. No entry for the compound. Built from the registered སྲིད་པ = 'hữu' (provisional, deliberately kept off 'sinh tử'/'luân hồi') and ཞི་བ = 'tịch tĩnh' (provisional) — shortened to 'tịch tịnh' inside the compound. Uncertain — see flag.

terms.vi: đoạn đường đi được của đạo là lớn
terms.note: p0554. ཆོད here is the stretch of path actually covered, not 'quyết đoán'. Rendered descriptively; no entry, and no other occurrence in the translated corpus.

p0555, སེམས་དམིགས་པ་ལས་གཡེང་བའི་ཡ་ཡ་པོ — the flightiness that would accompany immeasurable joy. No entry. Kept distinct from the registered རྒོད་པ family and from གཡེང་བ = 'tán loạn', which stands in the same clause.

terms.vi: vị đại thần là trí tuệ
terms.note: p0555, the cakravartin figure: the bodhisattva-king is not overpowered by the kāmaguṇas because he 'has prajñā as his minister'. Rendered appositively so the metaphor stays visible.

p0555, closing Pāramitāsamāsa verse. No entry. 'hạ liệt' matches c032's already-used 'tà chấp hạ liệt'; kept distinct from the three-capacities term སྐྱེས་བུ་ཆུང་ངུ = 'bậc hạ' (decisions.md §3), which this is NOT.
p0555, final (incomplete) verse: དབང་པོའི་ཡུལ་རྣམས་ལྷ་རྫས་འདྲ. No entry.

p0552 l.5, second member of the `རིག་པའི་གནས་ལྔ` list inside the Bodhisattvabhūmi quotation. No entry for the compound. Wording KEPT: 因明 is the established Vietnamese name of this member of the five vidyās, and it is what makes the list parallel with the registered `རིག་པའི་གནས་ལྔ` = năm minh xứ (nội minh / y phương minh / thanh minh). But the bare headword `གཏན་ཚིགས` is registered = chánh lý and its note explicitly rejects "nhân" for that term. The ruling must either register the five-vidyā member as a scoped exception or force "chánh lý minh" here — not resolvable by the translator.

p0553 l.1. The registered `རིག་པ` = minh was fixed at p0314 as the positive counterpart of `མ་རིག་པ` = vô minh; this verse uses vidyā as "knowledge/learning", the source of the four human aims, a third sense beside that one and the `རིག་པའི་གནས་ལྔ` sense. Text set to bare "minh" for consistency; register the verse sense so the sweep does not read it as an error.

p0553 l.1, `ཤེས་རབ་ཡུམ་ཆེན་གཟུང་བར་བྱ`, at l.34. No entry. The glossary has only `ཡུམ` = Mẹ (p0358, where "Phật mẫu" was deliberately avoided because that passage turns on the literal mother/sons figure) and `རྒྱལ་བའི་ཡུམ` = Phật mẫu của chư Đấng Chiến Thắng. Here ཡུམ་ཆེན is an epithet of prajñā in a verse, with no mother/sons figure, so "Đại Mẫu" (大母) is proposed. The draft's classifier "bậc" has been removed as an unsupported honorific inside a quotation.

p0555 l.3, at l.103, listed beside `བྱམས་པ`, `སྙིང་རྗེ` and `དགའ་བ་ཚད་མེད་པ` — i.e. upekṣā as the fourth immeasurable, the exact second sense the registered `བཏང་སྙོམས (in ཚོར་བ་བཏང་སྙོམས)` entry predicted and said needed a ruling "now". "đại xả" keeps the registered word xả plus ཆེན་པོ = đại, and is consistent with `ཚད་མེད་བཏང་སྙོམས` = xả vô lượng already in the glossary. The ruling is now due.

terms.vi: hữu và tịch tịnh / hữu / tịch tịnh
terms.note: p0554 l.1, `སྲིད་ཞིའི་རྒུད་པ་མཐོང་བའི་ཤེས་རབ` at l.71; also `སྲིད་པའི་བརྩོན་ར` = "ngục tù nơi hữu" (l.81) and `སྲིད་པའི་དོན་དུ` = "vì mục đích của hữu" (l.83). No entry for any of the three. Wording kept; it needs pinning because the saṃsāra/quiescence pair recurs constantly through the remaining pāramitā and vipaśyanā chapters, and `སྲིད་པ` must also be held apart from the registered twelve-links `སྲིད་པ` = hữu.

terms.vi: lực chuyên cần đảm nhận đối với tinh tấn
terms.note: p0543. The fifth item after the four powers (མོས་པ / བརྟན་པ / དགའ་བ / དོར་བ, all already registered). c160 already renders the corresponding outline item བརྩོན་འགྲུས་རྩོམ་པ་ལྷུར་བླང་བ as 'chuyên cần đảm nhận việc khởi sự tinh tấn'; kept identical so the topic sentence and the outline entry match. No entry for ལྷུར་བླང་བ / ལྷུར་ལེན anywhere in glossary.json.

p0543, Mātṛceṭa verse ཁྱོད་ལ་ཐང་ལྷོད་འགའ་མ་བྱུང. Literally the slackness of a rope. Kept distinct from the prose ལྷོད་པ in the same paragraph (ཧ་ཅང་ལྷོད་པ), which is rendered 'buông lơi', so the verse word and the prose word stay separable.
p0543, ཆུ་བོའི་རྒྱུན་བཞིན་དུ་ན་རེ་བ་ཞིག་དགོས. Printed as ན་རེ་བ; read as ནར་རེ་བ (sustained, drawn out) — see flag. Describes the middle way between over-exertion and slackness.
p0543, three times in Potowa's saying. Colloquial; kept distinct from ངལ་བསོ = 'nghỉ ngơi' in the preceding paragraph (p0542).
p0543, Potowa's louse-and-flea simile.
p0543, Potowa's louse-and-flea simile; contrasted with ཤིག.
p0543, verse form འཐབ་རྙིང (Bodhicaryāvatāra) and prose gloss འཐབ་མོ་བ་རྙིང་པ. Same Vietnamese for both so the gloss visibly explains the verse word.
p0544, ×3 (ཟོན་བྱེད་ཅིང་བཟུར་བ, ཉོན་མོངས་གཞན་ལ་ཟོན་མ་བྱས་པ, རྨོངས་པའི་དགྲ་ལ་ཟོན་བྱེད་པ). No entry. Kept distinct from ཤེས་བཞིན = tỉnh giác, which occurs separately on p0545.
p0544, སྡོམ་པ་རྣམས་ཀྱི་བཅས་པའི་འཇུག་ལྡོག — the Vinaya sense of what has been laid down as a rule. No entry.
p0544, ཤེས་པ་ཙམ་ལ་སྙིང་པོར་བཟུང་ནས་རྩད་བཅད་པ་ན. No entry.
p0543, Potowa's saying, contrasted with བྱང་པ = 'người phương Bắc'. Tibetan place name left in transcription, as with ngài Potowa and ngài Kamapa. See flag: the whole simile is uncertain.

p0543 l.1, twice, inside Potowa's saying: `སེ་མོ་གྲུ་པའི་ར་མདའ་ལྟ་བུས་མི་འོང་། བྱང་པའི་ར་མདའ་དང་པོ་སོས་བདལ་ནས་ཇག་པ་མ་སླེབ་བར་དུ་འདེད།`. No glossary entry, and this is the compound's only occurrence in the book (the p0456 hit is `སྐར་མདའ`, unrelated). Rendered 'cách lùa dê' / 'Cách lùa dê'; wording KEPT. The reading is inferred from `ར` (goat) + the explicit `འདེད` (drive livestock) and the `སོས་བདལ` / `ཇག་པ` (bandits) context, but it is an unverified resolution: `ར་མདའ` could equally be a place name or the proper name of a herding practice, and `སེ་མོ་གྲུ་པ` / `བྱང་པ` are read as ethnonyms ('người xứ Semodru' / 'người phương Bắc') on the same inference. Needs a ruling and should carry a chunk flag; see 'remaining'.

terms.vi: chánh niệm và tỉnh giác (proposed) — currently 'niệm và tỉnh giác'
terms.kind: contracted form of a registered compound
terms.note: p0545 l.1, `སེམས་དམིགས་པ་ལ་འདོགས་པ་གཅིག་པུ་ལ་དྲན་ཤེས་བསྟེན་པ་ཙམ་གྱིས` -> 'chỉ nương vào niệm và tỉnh giác' (l.73). Only the full `དྲན་པ་དང་ཤེས་བཞིན` is registered ('chánh niệm và tỉnh giác', provisional), and it occurs one clause earlier in the same sentence, so as printed the two forms read as two different terms. Wording KEPT per the no-ruling rule. This is the only bare 'niệm và tỉnh giác' in the corpus (10 other occurrences are all 'chánh niệm và tỉnh giác'). The ruling should decide whether the contraction takes the same Vietnamese as the full form, and it interacts with the open bare-`དྲན་པ` question already recorded on the `དྲན་པ` entry ('niệm' vs 'chánh niệm').

terms.vi: tu thiền / tu (both used; ruling needed)
terms.note: No entry at all. Two renderings in c164: p0544 l.1 `བསྒོམ་པ་གཙོ་བོར་བྱས` -> 'lấy việc tu thiền làm chính' (l.55), and p0545 l.1 `ལམ་བསྒོམ་པ་པོས་ཀྱང` -> 'người tu đạo lộ' (l.75), where 'tu' alone carries it. Wording KEPT per the no-ruling rule. The glossary's `སྒྲུབ་པ` entry already records that `སྒྲུབ་པ` and `བསྒོམ་པ` collapse onto one Vietnamese word elsewhere; a `བསྒོམ་པ` ruling should be made together with that one, and should cover the agentive `བསྒོམ་པ་པོ` (cf. the existing `སྒྲུབ་པ་པོ` entry) so 'người tu đạo lộ' either stands or becomes e.g. 'người tu tập đạo lộ'.

p0557, བདེན་གཉིས་ཀྱི་རྣམ་གཞག → 'sự an lập hai đế'. glossary.json registers only the two members separately (ཀུན་རྫོབ་བདེན་པ = thế tục đế, དོན་དམ་པའི་བདེན་པ = thắng nghĩa đế); the dual compound has no headword. 'hai đế' follows translation/c135.md line 23, which already renders it so; 'nhị đế' deliberately not used, to stay with the form already in the corpus.

p0557 verse, གཙུག་ལག་མིག་འདྲ་ཇི་སྙེད་ཡོད་པ → 'bao nhiêu luận điển tựa như con mắt'. glossary.json has only གཙུག་ལག་ཁང = 'tinh xá'. 'luận điển' is already the corpus form for treatises (c008, c011, c073) but is unregistered as a Tibetan headword.

p0558 prose list of the causes of delusion and p0559 verse (contracted as ལེ་ལོ་སྙོམས). No entry. Must stay distinct from the registered ལེ་ལོ = 'sự biếng nhác', since the two stand side by side in one list. 'trễ nải' follows c061 and c160, which already pair the two words this way. 'giải đãi' deliberately avoided (it is the standard Sino-Vietnamese for kausīdya = ལེ་ལོ, which the glossary has already ruled against).

p0557 verse, རྣམ་གྲངས་རྣམ་མང་རྣམ་ཐར་སྒོ་དག. No entry. The existing རྣམ་པར་ཐར་པ / རྣམ་ཐར entry is scoped to 'giải thoát (soteriological) / hành trạng (biographical)'; this compound is the technical doors-of-liberation term and needs its own headword.

p0557, twice, in the Ratnaguṇasaṃcaya (*Bảo Đức Tạng*) verse: དམུས་ལོང་དམིགས་བུ་མེད་པ… and དམིགས་བུ་མེད་པས་བྱང་ཆུབ་རེག་པར་ནུས་མ་ཡིན. UNCERTAIN — see flag. Rendered 'người dẫn đường' (guide), which fits ལམ་ཡང་མི་ཤེས in the next line; the competing reading is 'con ngươi (mắt)', which would fit the parallel with མིག་མེད. Recorded so the choice is visible and revisable, not because it is settled.

terms.vi: sở tri chướng · phiền não chướng
terms.note: p0559, the Maitreya verse that defines the pair. Neither compound has a headword, though 'sở tri chướng' is already used in c139 and c143 and 'phiền não chướng' in c143. Compositional from the registered ཤེས་བྱ = 'sở tri', ཉོན་མོངས = 'phiền não' and the āvaraṇa sense of སྒྲིབ་པ = 'chướng' (p0360 entry). Registered so the pair is fixed as a pair.

terms.vi: tánh khí chẳng chịu suy xét
terms.note: p0559 verse, listed as a cause of delusion, glossed in the prose above it by སོ་སོར་རྟོག་ཅིང་དཔྱོད་པ་ལ་མི་དགའ་བ. Rendered non-technically ON PURPOSE: the registered མི་རྟོག་པ = 'không phân biệt' is the technical nirvikalpa sense and is the opposite of what this line means (here མི་རྟོག is a fault). Recorded so the Phase 5 sweep does not read this as drift.

p0559 verse; the prose gloss above it reads གྲོགས་ངན་པ་བསྟེན་པ = 'nương theo bạn xấu' (registered). The verse's compressed form does not say 'friend', only 'a bad thing relied on', so it is rendered without importing 'bạn' from the prose.

p0556 l1, འདོད་ཆགས་འགོ་བ་ཡོངས་སུ་སྤངས་པ -> 'sự lây nhiễm của tham ái đã được đoạn trừ trọn vẹn'. Only the compound ནད་འགོ་བ = 'bệnh lây nhiễm' is registered; bare འགོ་བ used metaphorically of a kleśa is unruled. Wording KEPT — it preserves the contagion metaphor that ནད་འགོ་བ was already rendered with.

p0558 l1, ×2 (ཤེས་རབ་སྣང་བས་མུན་པ་མ་བསལ་ན; གཏི་མུག་རྨོངས་པའི་མུན་པ), plus མུན་ནག -> 'bóng tối đen' in the sun verse. No entry, though the term is frequent. Wording KEPT. A ruling should also cover མུན་ནག so the ནག element is not lost.

p0557 l1, འཇིག་རྟེན་དག་ན་སྒྱུ་རྩལ་གཏེར་མཆོག -> 'Trong các thế gian, kho tàng tối thượng của kỹ nghệ'. No entry. Wording KEPT. Worth deciding against 'công xảo' / 'kỹ xảo' (the 工巧明 register) since this is worldly arts-and-crafts, not the vidyāsthāna.

p0559 l1, དམའ་སེམས་བདག་ལ་ཞེན་པས་བྱུང་བའི་རྒྱུས, listed as a cause of si mê. No entry. Wording KEPT. Note it must NOT be confused with the virtue of humility: here it is the self-deprecating discouragement glossed in the preceding prose as བདག་འདྲ་བས་མི་ནུས་སྙམ་དུ་ཞུམ་པ. Note also the distinct དམའ་ at p0556 l1 (ལེ་ལོས་མི་དམའ་ -> 'chẳng bị hạ thấp').

p0558 l1, ཉོན་མོངས་རྙོག་བཅས་འགྱུར and སེམས་བརྙོགས་ན, two lines apart in the same Śiṣyalekha-style passage. No entry for either form. Wording KEPT, and deliberately kept identical across the two forms since the Tibetan uses one root; a ruling should say whether the verbal བརྙོགས and the adjectival རྙོག་བཅས stay merged in Vietnamese.

p0559 l1, ×2 (བསྒོམས་བྱུང་གི་ཤེས་རབ་ཡངས་པ་འབྱུང་བ; ཤེས་རབ་ཡངས་པ་འབྱུང in the Cát Tường Dũng verse). No entry. Wording KEPT. Note the collision risk with རྒྱ་ཆེན་པོ, rendered 'rộng lớn' at L120 in this same chunk — if they must stay apart, ཡངས་པ could take 'rộng mở' / 'quảng đại'.

terms.vi: ngã mạn nơi việc làm / ngã mạn nơi khả năng / ngã mạn đối với phiền não
terms.note: p0538-p0540, the ང་རྒྱལ་གསུམ of Bodhicaryāvatāra ch. VII, the pivot of this whole chunk. Built on the registered ང་རྒྱལ = 'ngã mạn' (provisional). Recorded as one set so the three stay parallel. The text itself twice says the name is only imputed (ང་རྒྱལ་དང་འདྲ་བ་ཡོད་པས་དེར་བཏགས་པའོ; ང་རྒྱལ་དུ་བཏགས་སོ), so the Vietnamese must keep 'ngã mạn' rather than soften it.

terms.bo: ལས (work / task sense, in ལས་ཀྱི་ང་རྒྱལ, དམན་པའི་ལས, རྩེད་མོའི་ལས)
terms.note: SCOPE REQUEST, not a violation. glossary.json fixes ལས = 'nghiệp' with skt 'karma'. Here ལས is the ordinary 'work / undertaking' sense throughout: ལས་ཀྱི་ང་རྒྱལ (contrasted with ཉོན་མོངས and ནུས་པ), དམན་པའི་ལས = menial work, རྩེད་མོའི་ལས = the work of play, ལས་དེ་ལ་ནི་ཞེན་བྱ. 'nghiệp thấp kém' / 'nghiệp chơi đùa' would misrepresent the passage. Same kind of split already recorded for ལས་ཚོགས = 'các loại hành sự' and ལས་ཀྱི་མཐའ = 'nghiệp sự'.
p0538, གང་བྱ་བར་ཡི་དམ་བཅས་པ་དེ་ཡང་མགོ་མི་ཐོན. Idiom, lit. 'the head does not emerge'.

p0539, twice (གཞན་ཁྱད་དུ་བསད་ནས; ཉོན་མོངས་པ་...ཁྱད་དུ་བསད་ནས). Spelling variant of the registered ཁྱད་གསོད / ཁྱད་དུ་གསོད་པ = 'khinh miệt'; same Vietnamese, and ཁྱད་གསོད itself also occurs on p0540 in the same argument.
p0540, རང་གིས་ནུས་སོ་སྙམ་དུ་གདེང་འཆའ. Kept distinct from དད་པ and from the registered མོས་པ = 'lòng tin ưa'; this is self-confidence, not faith.
p0539, contrasted with དམན་པའི་ལས in the same sentence.
p0541, ལས་དེའི་འཕྲོ་གཅོད་པར་མི་འདོད་པ, in the definition of དགའ་བའི་སྟོབས. འཕྲོ = the unfinished remainder of a task.
p0541, 6× — the operative word of the whole དགའ་བའི་སྟོབས 段. One Vietnamese phrase used for every occurrence, prose and verse alike.
p0539, མི་མཐུན་པའི་ཕྱོགས་འཇོམས་པ་ལ་བློའི་དཔའ་བསྐྱེད་ནས. Kept distinct from the glossary's སྙིང་སྟོབས = 'dũng khí' and from the several དཔའ་བོ entries.
p0541 verse, སྤུ་གྲིའི་སོར་ཆགས་སྦྲང་རྩི (the verse runs on into p0542, where the prose gloss elaborates the simile).
p0540, རྣམ་བཤད་མཛད་པ་རྣམས་དེ་དང་མི་འདྲ་བར་འཆད་མོད — Tsongkhapa dissenting from the Bodhicaryāvatāra commentators. Kept distinct from the glossary's འགྲེལ་པ renderings.

p0538. Uses the glossary's སྦྱོར་བ = 'gia hành' rather than paraphrasing to 'việc sắp làm', since the verse is a quotation and the surrounding prose already supplies the sense. Flagged: the reading is defensible but the Vietnamese is stiff.

No entry. c163 L114, BCA 7.62 `རྩེད་མོའི་བདེ་འབྲས་འདོད་པ་ལྟར`. Contracted form of `བདེ་བའི་འབྲས་བུ`; rendered 'quả lạc' to match the registered `བདེ་བ` = 'lạc'. Register the contraction so it is not read as drift.

No entry for bare `སྡིག`; only `སྡིག་པ` (provisional = 'tội lỗi') and `སྡིག་གྲོགས` exist. c163 uses bare `སྡིག` twice: L11 prose `ཚེ་དེར་སྡིག་འཕེལ་བ` and L20 verse `སྡིག་དང་སྡུག་བསྔལ་འཕེལ་འགྱུར` (BCA 7.48), both 'tội ác'. KEPT. Register the bare form and decide whether it takes the `སྡིག་པ` wording; note the chunk keeps `ལྟུང་བ` = 'đọa tội' properly distinct at L82, L95, L101, which is the distinction that carries weight here.

p0547 l.last, བག་ཡོད་ལེའུ་ནས་བཤད་པ་ལྟར — the Bodhicaryāvatāra's chapter 4, cited by name. No entry. Built from the glossary's བག་ཡོད = 'bất phóng dật' plus the ལེའུ = 'phẩm' precedents (འོད་སྲུངས་ཀྱི་ལེའུ = 'phẩm Ca-diếp', བདེན་པ་པོའི་ལེའུ = 'phẩm Đế Giả').

p0547. Names the fourth of the four sub-items of བརྩོན་འགྲུས་བསྐྱེད་ཐབས (listed at p0527, translated in c160 l.19): དེ་ལས་ལུས་སེམས་ལས་སུ་རུང་བར་བྱ་ཚུལ = 'lực của sự làm chủ'. Must NOT be confused with the fourth of the four ཚོགས-forces, དོར་བའི་སྟོབས = 'lực của sự buông bỏ' (c162 l.57). Coordinated with the verse's དབང་བསྒྱུར་བ = 'làm chủ' (BCA cotton simile, quoted twice on p0548).

p0546, འདི་ཀཱ་ཏྱཱ་ཡ་ནའི་བྱུང་བའི་མཐའ — the source of the mustard-oil-vessel story. Only occurrence in the corpus. Kept in Sanskrit transcription, as the glossary does for other Indian proper names that the Tibetan transliterates rather than translates.

p0546. NOT in the glossary, though c065 (p0209, two occurrences: སྔོན་གྱི་བྱུང་བའི་མཐའ་བརྗོད་པ and གླང་པོ་སྐྱོང་གི་བྱུང་བའི་མཐའ) already renders it 'đầu đuôi những sự việc đã xảy ra / đầu đuôi các câu chuyện'. Kept consistent with c065; recorded so the rendering is fixed rather than re-invented.

p0548, ལུས་སེམས་དགེ་བ་ལ་བཀོལ་དུ་མི་རུང་བའི་མཚེར་སྣང་ཐམས་ཅད་བཟློག་ནས. No entry. Only three occurrences of the མཚེར root in the whole corpus: this one, p0658 (མཚེར་སྣང་གིས་འཇུག་པར་དཀའ་བའི་ལུས་སེམས་ལས་སུ་མི་རུང་བ — same collocation), and p0143 (འཆི་ཁར་མི་མཚེར་བ, which c045 renders 'không hối tiếc'). 'hối tiếc' does not fit here, so a separate rendering was needed. Deliberately kept distinct from ཞུམ་པ = 'thối chí', ལེ་ལོ = 'sự biếng nhác', སྙོམ་ལས = 'trễ nải', སྒྱིད་ལུག = 'biếng trễ'. See flags — this is a guess at the register.
p0546, the simile for a small misdeed: དུག་མདས་ལུས་ལ་རྨ་ཅུང་ཟད་ཅིག་བཏོད་ན. Rendered literally.

p0546, རྒྱུན་འཐུད་དུ་མི་འཇུག་པར. No entry. Kept distinct from the registered རྒྱུན་ཆགས = 'một cách nối liền không dứt', which is used positively of mindfulness in this same chunk (p0547) — here the sense is a misdeed being allowed to run on.
p0547, བརྩོན་ས་མ་འཕྱུགས་པ་གལ་ཆེའོ — 'it is important not to mistake the ground of one's striving'. No entry.

terms.vi: nền móng chân chính của đạo lộ
terms.note: p0546. རྐང་ read as 'footing/foundation' (cf. the glossary's རྐང་མི་ཟིན་པ = 'không nắm được chỗ đặt chân'). དམ་པ rendered 'chân chính' on the བཤེས་གཉེན་དམ་པ precedent — see flags, three renderings of དམ་པ are live.

terms.vi: hăng hái / lòng hăng hái (kept) vs. lòng hoan hỷ
terms.note: COLLISION, not a translator error — needs ONE ruling over the whole family. glossary.json carries three competing provisional entries: `སྤྲོ་བ` = "lòng hoan hỷ", `སྤྲོ་བ / མངོན་པར་སྤྲོ་བ` = "sự hăng hái / hăng hái", and `སྤྲོ་ཤུགས` = "lòng hăng hái" (the last's own note, from p0394, already asks for this). c165 has three occurrences and is internally consistent with the "hăng hái" pair: p0548 `དགེ་བ་ལ་སྤྲོ་བའི་སྤྲོ་ཤུགས` -> "lòng hăng hái — tức sự hăng hái đối với điều thiện" (L69), p0548 verse `དེ་བཞིན་སྤྲོ་བས་དབང་བསྒྱུར` -> "sự hăng hái làm chủ" (L73), p0549 `...ལ་སྤྲོ་བའི་གོ་ཆའི་བརྩོན་འགྲུས` -> "tinh tấn áo giáp hăng hái" (L91). Text KEPT. Whichever way the ruling goes, it must be applied as a corpus-wide sweep, not by rewriting this chunk alone. Note also the `སྤྲོ་ཤུགས` entry's warning to keep this family apart from `སྤྲོས་པ` = "hí luận".

p0549 `ཚེ་རབས་གཞན་དུའང` -> "trong những đời khác" (L93). NO headword for `ཚེ་རབས`. In the same sentence `སྐྱེ་བ་གཞན་དུ` -> "trong đời khác", which IS glossary-backed (the registered heading `སྐྱེ་བ་གཞན་དུའང་དེ་དང་མི་འབྲལ་བའི་རྒྱུ་ལ་བསླབ་པ` = "...ngay cả trong đời khác", from c125). So two distinct Tibetan words land on one Vietnamese phrase within one sentence. Wording KEPT per the no-ruling rule. Requested ruling: (a) a headword for `ཚེ་རབས` that keeps it separable from `སྐྱེ་བ`; (b) an explicit carve-out on the FIXED `སྐྱེ་བ` = "sinh" licensing `སྐྱེ་བ་གཞན་དུ` = "đời khác" ("sinh khác" is not Vietnamese), so the Phase 5 sweep does not read this as drift from a fixed entry.

p0546 l.1. Only the compound `གདམས་པའི་མཐིལ` = "cốt tủy" is registered; bare `མཐིལ` in the idiom `...ལ་མཐིལ་དུ་བྱས་ནས` ("having made X the core/base") has no headword. Text changed to "cốt tủy" at repair on that entry's own gloss. A ruling should register the bare word and the idiom, and keep it apart from the literal `ལག་མཐིལ` = palm, which the glossary already uses twice.

terms.vi: bậc thiện tri thức chân chính
terms.note: NOT a gap and NOT an addition — flagging only to close the question. `བཤེས་གཉེན་དམ་པ / དམ་པའི་བཤེས` = "bậc thiện tri thức chân chính" IS registered (provisional, glossary.json ~l.2569), and the separate `བཤེས་གཉེན` entry records that the source itself confirms bare `བཤེས་གཉེན` is the abbreviation of the fixed `དགེ་བའི་བཤེས་གཉེན` = "thiện tri thức" (p0059 writes the full form for the same referent the heading abbreviates). A second glossary note (p0364, `འདིར་དམ་པ་བསྟེན་ཅིང`) states outright that `དམ་པའི་བཤེས` -> "bậc thiện tri thức chân chính" matches its registered entry exactly. Text KEPT. If the entry is to be re-ruled to a plainer word, that is a corpus-wide decision, not a c165 edit.
p0546, inside the Bodhicaryāvatāra verse `ཉུངས་མར་བཀང་བའི་སྣོད་བསྐུར་ལ`. No entry. Concrete object inside a quotation, rendered literally with no expansion. Wording kept.

p0549 `ས་མཐོན་པོའི་བརྩོན་འགྲུས་རྩོམ་ལུགས་རྣམས་སྨོན་པའི་ཡུལ་དུ་བྱས་ཏེ` -> L89 "làm đối tượng của tâm nguyện". Same open question the glossary already records twice for bare `སྨོན་པ` (p0129 `སྨོན་པའི་ཆོ་ག` note; p0411/p0413 `སྨོན་སེམས` note): the registered lemma is `སྨོན་པའི་སེམས` = "tâm nguyện", and bare `སྨོན་པ` has no ruling. Here the noun is supplied UNbracketed. One ruling should cover all three sites.

terms.vi: điều cần chứng đắc / điều cần đoạn trừ
terms.note: p0549, `ཐུན་མོང་མ་ཡིན་པའི་བརྩོན་འགྲུས་ཀྱི་སྤང་བྱ་ཞུམ་པ` (L89) and `ཐོབ་བྱ་བྱང་ཆུབ` (L91). No entries. Rendered as a deliberate matched pair with the bare verbal noun and NO supplied doctrinal noun on either side — this is what the L91 fabrication fix restored. A ruling should register both together so the pair cannot be broken by adding "quả" to one half.

terms.vi: Cách thức tu học tịnh chỉ, tức thể tánh của tĩnh lự
terms.note: Outline s197, path 6.2.3.1.11.2.6.1, the chunk's root heading. Built from the glossary's བསམ་གཏན = tĩnh lự, ངོ་བོ = thể tánh, ཞི་གནས = tịnh chỉ (fixed-set headword, used because this is a section heading), and the registered pattern ...ལ་བསླབ་ཚུལ = 'Cách thức tu học...' (cf. ཚུལ་ཁྲིམས་ཀྱི་ཕར་ཕྱིན་ལ་བསླབ་ཚུལ).

terms.vi: Cách thức tu học riêng từng phần
terms.note: Outline s196 (heading itself sits on p0591, i.e. in c179; only its division sentence falls in this chunk). སོ་སོ = 'riêng từng phần' follows the glossary's སོ་སོའི་བསླབ་བྱ = 'các điều cần học riêng'; བསླབ་ཚུལ = 'cách thức tu học' as in the sibling headings.

terms.vi: Nương vào tư lương của tịnh chỉ
terms.note: Outline s198. ཚོགས = tư lương (glossary); བསྟེན་པ = 'nương vào'. Recurs as the body's own topic sentence and again at the close of the section (ཚོགས་ནི་སྔར་བཤད་པ་དྲུག...).

terms.vi: Cách thức nương vào đó mà tu tịnh chỉ
terms.note: Outline s199.

terms.vi: Tu tập với oai nghi của thân như thế nào
terms.note: Outline s202. སྤྱོད་ལམ = oai nghi (glossary, provisional).

terms.vi: mức lượng của tịnh chỉ đã thành tựu do tu tập
terms.note: Outline s-sibling named only in the three-fold division sentence on p0592 (its own section falls in a later chunk). ཚད rendered 'mức lượng' — the measure by which one judges attainment, not 'lượng' (pramāṇa).

p0595, རྗེ་བཙུན་རྣམ་པར་སྣང་མཛད་ཀྱི་སྐྱིལ་མོ་ཀྲུང = 'thế ngồi kiết già của đức Chí Tôn Tỳ-lô-giá-na'. glossary.json registers only the compound title རྣམ་སྣང་མངོན་བྱང = 'Tỳ-lô-giá-na Hiện Chứng Bồ-đề' (c132), never the bare name. རྗེ་བཙུན = 'Chí Tôn' per the glossary's རྗེ་བཙུན་མ་ཕམ་པ / c005's 'đức Chí Tôn Di-lặc'.

terms.vi: tám pháp nơi cách hành xử của thân
terms.note: p0595. ཀུན་སྤྱོད deliberately rendered 'cách hành xử' rather than 'oai nghi', because སྤྱོད་ལམ = 'oai nghi' (glossary) occurs in the same sentence-neighbourhood and in this section's own heading; collapsing them would erase the distinction.

p0594, སྔར་བཤད་པའི་སྦྱོར་བའི་ཆོས་དྲུག. Follows translation/c028 l.15 ('các pháp chuẩn bị có sáu') and the glossary's སྦྱོར་བ / དངོས་གཞི = 'chuẩn bị / chính hành', NOT the other registered སྦྱོར་བ = 'gia hành' (which is the བསམ་པ་དང་སྦྱོར་བ pair). The two senses of སྦྱོར་བ collide in this chunk and a general ruling would help.

terms.vi: trú nơi xứ sở thuận hợp
terms.note: p0592, first of the six prerequisites; recurs at p0593 in the list of the three principal ones.

terms.vi: đoạn trừ trọn vẹn các việc bận rộn
terms.note: p0592–p0593, fourth prerequisite. བྱ་བ་མང་པོ rendered 'các việc bận rộn' (the many activities) rather than literally 'nhiều việc', since the list that glosses it is trade, over-familiarity with laity and monastics, medicine, astrology.

p0593, sixth prerequisite (འདོད་པ་ལ་སོགས་པའི་རྣམ་རྟོག་ཡོངས་སུ་སྤངས་པ). Uses the glossary's provisional རྣམ་རྟོག = 'sự phân biệt'. Note the sense here is the discursive thought to be abandoned, the opposite of the positive རྣམ་རྟོག the existing entry was decided in (c142, Pāramitāsamāsa).

terms.vi: dễ tìm được [vật dụng] · chỗ ở tốt lành · đất tốt lành · bạn tốt lành · khéo đầy đủ
terms.note: p0592, the five qualities of a suitable place, each keyed to a foot of the Sūtrālaṃkāra verse quoted immediately after (ལེགས་པར་རྙེད / གནས་བཟང / ས་བཟང / གྲོགས་བཟང / རྣལ་འབྱོར་བདེ་བའི་ཡོ་བྱད་ལྡན). Rendered as a parallel five-member set so the prose and the verse line up as the source intends.

terms.vi: tòa / tòa nhỏ / chỗ trải cỏ
terms.note: p0595, the supports the Buddha permitted for sitting cross-legged, from the Śrāvakabhūmi. ཁྲི/ཁྲིའུ follow the glossary's registered ཁྲི / ཁྲིའུ / སྟེགས་བུ = 'tòa / tòa nhỏ / bệ đài'. See flag: translation/c028 renders this same Śrāvakabhūmi citation 'trên giường hoặc trên ghế', so the corpus is inconsistent and needs a sweep.

p0594, ཞི་གནས་ཀྱི་ཡན་ལག་གམ་ཚོགས and the Bodhipathapradīpa verse ཞི་གནས་ཡན་ལག་རྣམ་ཉམས་པས. Follows the registered ཡན་ལག = 'chi phần'; here the sense is a constituent/prerequisite of śamatha, not a bodily limb.

terms.vi: nhân của [ba-la-mật] cao hơn kế tiếp
terms.note: p0594, inside the Bhāvanākrama I quotation, of dāna etc. being the cause of each successively higher pāramitā. 'ba-la-mật' is bracketed because the Tibetan supplies no noun.

p0593 l.1 (རྒྱས་པར་ནི་ཉན་ཐོས་ཀྱི་ས་ལས་ཤེས་པར་བྱའོ།). glossary.json registers only the contraction ཉན་ས = "Thanh Văn Địa". The full form is rendered identically here (c180.md l.42), which is correct; add the long form as a variant of the same entry so the Phase 5 sweep does not read it as an unruled title.

p0594 l.1, inside the སྒོམ་རིམ་དང་པོ quotation; rendered "Thánh Giải Thâm Mật" at c180.md l.48. glossary.json registers only the contraction འཕགས་པ་དགོངས་འགྲེལ. Same situation as ཉན་ཐོས་ཀྱི་ས: rendered identically to the registered short form, correct as it stands, long form needs adding as a variant.

terms.vi: định của chỉ quán / tư lương của tịnh chỉ
terms.note: c180.md l.57 renders p0594 l.1 ཞི་ལྷག་གི་ཏིང་ངེ་འཛིན ... ཞི་གནས་ཀྱི་ཡན་ལག་གམ་ཚོགས as "định của chỉ quán" and "các chi phần hay tư lương của tịnh chỉ" in the same sentence. Kept, and the borderline resolves permissive: decisions.md §1's "never tịnh chỉ beside bare quán" bars mixing the two registers for ONE term, whereas these are two different Tibetan terms, and the registered ཞི་ལྷག entry explicitly licenses the "chỉ quán" register for the contraction. Recommend the ཞི་ལྷག entry's note state that the contraction keeps its own register even when ཞི་གནས stands nearby, so the Phase 5 sweep does not flag the collocation.

p0592 l.5; rendered "mức lượng của tịnh chỉ đã thành tựu do tu tập" at c180.md l.17. No general ruling for ཚད in a heading. The registered heading སྐྱེས་བུ་ཆུང་ངུའི་བསམ་པ་སྐྱེས་པའི་ཚད། = "Mức độ phát sinh ý lạc của bậc hạ" uses "mức độ", while ཚེའི་ཚད = "thọ lượng" uses "lượng" — both live in the glossary, so neither wording departs from a ruling. Kept per the repair rule. Recommendation: settle on "mức độ" for the bare heading-final ཚད, since this same heading recurs verbatim for ལྷག་མཐོང later (བསྒོམས་པས་ལྷག་མཐོང་གྲུབ་པའི་ཚད) and the two must match.

terms.vi: Phải làm thế nào vào lúc hướng tâm vào sở duyên
terms.note: Outline path 6.2.3.1.11.2.6.1.2.2.2.1.2, p0600. Middle member of a triad whose siblings are …གཏོད་པའི་སྔོན་དུ… ('trước lúc') and …གཏད་པའི་འོག་ཏུ… ('sau lúc'), so the three must be worded in parallel when c181/c183 render them. གཏོད་པ = 'hướng … vào' (no glossary entry); དམིགས་པ = 'sở duyên' per glossary.

p0600, first of the Buddha's four ālambana. Rendered literally from ཁྱབ་པ = 'pervade'. The established Sino-Vietnamese is 'biến mãn sở duyên' (遍滿所緣), deliberately NOT used because 滿/'mãn' has no counterpart in the Tibetan. A ruling is wanted: this term and its three siblings recur through the whole śamatha section.

terms.vi: sở duyên tịnh hóa hành vi
terms.note: p0600/p0602. སྤྱད་པ here = the predominant conduct/disposition (the text glosses it འདོད་ཆགས་སོགས་ལ་ཤས་ཆེར་སྤྱད་པ). 'hành vi' chosen over bare 'hành' so it cannot be read as saṃskāra. Glossary has ལེགས་པར་སྤྱད་པ = 'diệu hạnh', a different scope.

p0600/p0603. མཁས་པ = 'thiện xảo' here (skill in the aggregates etc.), following the glossary's ཐབས་མཁས་པ = 'phương tiện thiện xảo'; the registered མཁས་པ = 'bậc học giả' / 'bậc trí' is a person and does not fit.

terms.vi: sở duyên tịnh hóa phiền não
terms.note: p0600. ཉོན་མོངས = phiền não (glossary, fixed); རྣམ་པར་སྦྱོང་བ = 'tịnh hóa', matching the སྤྱད་པ… sibling.
p0601, དམིགས་བྱེད་ཀྱི་སྒོ་ནས་བཞག་པ. The apprehending side, paired in the same passage with དམིགས་བྱ་ཡུལ = 'cảnh sở duyên'. Built on the glossary's དམིགས་པ = 'sở duyên'.
p0601, the object side of the pair with དམིགས་བྱེད. ཡུལ = 'cảnh' per the glossary's ཡུལ་ཅན = 'hữu cảnh' note.
p0601, དམིགས་པ་རང་མཚན་པ་དེ — the actual self-charactered object, as against the ảnh tượng that appears in its place. No glossary entry.
p0602, closing the definition of དགོས་པ་ཡོངས་སུ་གྲུབ་པ. Established Sino-Vietnamese 轉依, and component-for-component literal (གནས = y/sở y, གྱུར = chuyển). No corpus occurrence yet.
p0602, qualifying the བསམ་པ that constitutes བྱམས་པ as a meditation object. Built on the glossary's མཉམ་པར་བཞག་པ = 'nhập đẳng dẫn'; ས = 'địa' (bhūmi).
p0602/p0603, fifth of the carita-viśodhana objects. Rendered plainly; the glossary registers དབུགས only inside དབུགས་འབྱིན་པ = 'ban cho sự an ủi', an unrelated idiom.

p0602, fourth of the carita-viśodhana objects; the six giới are named in the next clause (đất, nước, lửa, gió, hư không, thức). ཁམས = 'giới' — note glossary.json's ཁམས = 'Kham' is the place name and must not be applied here.
p0602, the example of ཕྱི་རོལ་གྱི་མི་སྡུག་པ. The Tibetan says only 'the discoloured/blue one'; 'thây' is bracketed because the Tibetan supplies no noun. See flag.

p0603, fifth of the kauśalya objects, defined in the same passage (virtue → agreeable ripening = གནས; non-virtue → agreeable ripening = གནས་མིན). Established Sino-Vietnamese 處非處. See flag: this collides with སྐྱེ་མཆེད = 'xứ', which is listed three items earlier in the same sentence.
p0603. Established Sino-Vietnamese 增上緣; the Tibetan བདག་པོ ('master') is Kanjur usage for adhipati, so the Vietnamese is not literal but is the settled term of the four-pratyaya scheme.
p0603. Consistent with the glossary's དམིགས་པ = 'sở duyên'; 所緣緣.
p0603, of འགགས་མ་ཐག་པའི་ཡིད ('ý vừa mới diệt'). Established Sino-Vietnamese 等無間緣.

p0603, in the definition of ཁམས་ལ་མཁས་པ. 因緣, the first of the four pratyayas. See flag: 'nhân duyên' is already the corpus rendering of the ordinary compound རྒྱུ་རྐྱེན ('causes and conditions', c095/c111/c132/c136/c153/c168), so the two are no longer distinguishable in Vietnamese.
p0603, བདག་དང་བདག་གི་བ་མེད་པར་ཤེས་པ. Established Sino-Vietnamese 我所. No glossary entry.
p0601, paired with དེ་བཞིན་ཉིད = 'chân như' (glossary) in the definition of ཇི་ལྟ་བ. Kept as a separate word so the pair stays visibly distinct.

p0601 l.3 བདེན་བཞིར་ཤེས་བྱའི་དངོས་པོ་ཐམས་ཅད་འདུས. The existing བདེན་པ entry is status 'ruling-needed' and licenses only the compounds ཀུན་རྫོབ = thế tục đế and དོན་དམ་པ = thắng nghĩa đế; bare བདེན་པ has no ruling. The chunk's original 'bốn chân đế' was changed to 'bốn đế' because (a) 'chân' adds a qualifier not in བདེན་བཞི and (b) 'chân đế' (真諦) is in standing use for paramārtha-satya and therefore collides with the licensed 'thắng nghĩa đế'. A ruling should settle bare བདེན་པ = 'đế' and pick one of 'bốn đế' / 'tứ đế' / 'bốn thánh đế' for བདེན་བཞི — note the Tibetan here has no འཕགས་པ, so 'thánh' would itself be an addition.

NO ENTRY AT ALL in glossary.json for either form. p0602 ll.3, 9 and p0603 ll.5, 13 → 'duyên khởi' (L33, L39, L45, L53), standard and consistent. High-frequency across the whole book; registering it costs nothing and prevents a large false-positive class in the Phase 5 sweep.

NO RULING. p0602 l.1 གནས་ངན་ལེན་དང་བྲལ་ནས་གནས་གྱུར་པའོ → 'lìa khỏi thô trọng ... rồi chuyển y' (L31). 'chuyển y' is the standard Sino-Vietnamese; kept. Note the neighbouring གནས་ངན་ལེན (dauṣṭhulya) → 'thô trọng' also has no entry and could be registered at the same time.

p0608 (and p0606, where it is introduced as ནམ་གྲུས་ཞུས་པ་ཉན་སར་དྲངས་པ = 'the Nam-gru Thỉnh Vấn as cited in the Śrāvakabhūmi'). No glossary entry. The Tibetan name ནམ་གྲུ is the nakṣatra Revatī, so the sūtra is most likely the Revatīparipṛcchā, but I could not confirm this from anything in the repo, so I transliterated the TIBETAN rather than assert a Sanskrit title. If the identification is confirmed, the title should probably become *Revatī Thỉnh Vấn*. Referred to on p0609 as མདོ་དེ་ཉིད = 'chính kinh ấy'.
The interlocutor addressed in the vocative inside the quotation (ནམ་གྲུ། = 'Này Nam-gru!'). Same identification caveat as the title above.

terms.vi: người hành xử với các phần ngang bằng
terms.note: Second of the three practitioner types classified by disposition (p0608 ×2, p0610 ×1; also p0607). No entry. Rendered literally (ཆ = phần, མཉམ་པ = ngang bằng, སྤྱོད་པ = hành xử) rather than coining a Sino-Vietnamese compound. Both spellings སྤྱོད་པ and སྤྱད་པ occur for the same term in these pages; I rendered them identically. c182/c183 (parts 1–2 of the same section) are not yet translated, so this sets the precedent and should be checked against them at merge.

terms.vi: người nặng phần về năm thứ tham v.v.
terms.note: First of the three types. ཤས་ཆེ་བ rendered 'nặng phần' throughout, incl. རྣམ་རྟོག་ཤས་ཆེ་བ = 'người nặng phần về sự phân biệt' (p0610) and འདོད་ཆགས་ཤས་ཆེ་བ = 'người nặng phần về tham' (p0610).
Third of the three types (p0608 ×2, p0610). No entry.

terms.vi: sở duyên tịnh hóa hành vi
terms.note: p0610 ×2 (also p0607). One of the four classes of ālambana this whole section enumerates. Follows the glossary's དམིགས་པ = sở duyên and སྤྱོད་པ = hành vi.

p0608. glossary.json's bare ཁམས is the PLACE NAME 'Kham'; the realm-sense entry covers འདོད་ཁམས. Here ཁམས is the dhātu of the uẩn/giới/xứ triad — rendered 'giới', consistent with the realm-sense entry but needing its own registration.
p0610, last member of the Śrāvakabhūmi list of synonyms for གཟུགས་བརྙན. Kept distinct from the glossary's གཟུགས་བརྙན = 'ảnh tượng', since the quotation lists the two as separate names.

terms.vi: cảnh thuộc hành cảnh của định
terms.note: p0610, in the same synonym list. Literal double genitive kept; see flag.

terms.vi: thân của sự phân biệt bên trong
terms.note: p0610, same synonym list. Rendered literally; the sense is opaque in the Tibetan too.

p0611, in Bodhibhadra's list of inner objects. No bare entry; glossary has only རྩ་རླུང་ཐིག་ལེ = 'mạch, khí, minh điểm', whose third member is the same word — so this is that entry's stem, registered on its own.
p0611, same list. Rendered literally; follows the glossary's ཡན་ལག = chi / chi phần.
p0611, ཀེང་རུས་ལ་སོགས་པ་མི་སྡུག་པར་དམིགས་པ — the skeleton as an object of the aśubha meditation.
p0611. Left in Sanskrit transliteration (the Tibetan is itself a transliteration); the ritual staff, given as an example of མཚན་མ་ཁྱད་པར་ཅན.

p0611. No entry. Follows the glossary's སློབ་དཔོན = A-xà-lê. Left in Sanskrit rather than translated as 'Bồ-đề Hiền'; if the project prefers Sino-Vietnamese for Indian masters (cf. སེང་གེ་བཟང་པོ = Sư Tử Hiền, ཟླ་བ་གྲགས་པ = Nguyệt Xứng), this should become 'A-xà-lê Bồ-đề Hiền' — a ruling is owed.

terms.vi: nhìn vào bên trong / nhìn ra bên ngoài
terms.note: p0611, the top-level division of śamatha objects in the Bodhibhadra quotation.

terms.vi: định tùy thuận với tịnh chỉ
terms.note: p0610 — the samādhi 'concordant with' but short of actual śamatha. རྗེས་མཐུན has no entry.
p0610, ཞི་གནས་མ་མཐའ་ཞིག་ངེས་པར་བསྒྲུབ་ན. མ་མཐའ = 'at the very least'. No entry.
p0611. Spelling variant (མངོན་སུམ་དུ་བཞུགས་པ) of the glossary's ད་ལྟར་གྱི་སངས་རྒྱས་མངོན་སུམ་པའི་ཏིང་ངེ་འཛིན; registered so the variant is not read as a different sūtra.
p0608. བུལ་བ = slow/tardy. No entry.
p0608, inside the Nam-gru Thỉnh Vấn list བདག་དང་སེམས་ཅན་དང་སྲོག་དང་སྐྱེ་བ་པོ་དང་གསོ་བ་དང་གང་ཟག — the standard string of synonyms for a self. སྲོག rendered 'mạng'. None of the three has an entry.

terms.kind: person - no entry; second Tibetan form of a registered master
terms.note: p0611, `སློབ་དཔོན་བྱང་ཆུབ་བཟང་པོས་ཀྱང༌།` (c184 L47). glossary.json registers only the transliterated Tibetan `བྷ་དྲ་བོ་དྷི` -> "Bhadrabodhi", whose own note already says the usual form of this master's name is Bodhibhadra. `བྱང་ཆུབ་བཟང་པོ` is the translated Tibetan of the same name, and the exact parallel `སེང་གེ་བཟང་པོ` (Haribhadra) is registered translated as "Sư Tử Hiền", so the house pattern would give "Bồ-đề Hiền". Wording KEPT. One entry should cover both Tibetan forms and decide translation vs. transcription once; whichever wins, `བྷ་དྲ་བོ་དྷི` needs correcting to match.

terms.kind: term - sense not registered; live collision with དབུགས
terms.note: p0610 `ངེས་པར་རླུང་བསྒོམ་པར་བྱ་དགོས་སོ།` (c184 L45) vs p0611 `དབུགས་ལ་དམིགས་པ` (L49), both rendered "hơi thở". glossary.json gives `རླུང` only as "khí" - in the humoral triad `བད་ཀན / རླུང / མཁྲིས་པ` -> "đàm / khí / mật" and in `རྩ་རླུང་ཐིག་ལེ` -> "mạch, khí, minh điểm" - and the entry `རླུང་མཉམ་འཇུག (and bare མཉམ་འཇུག)` already asks for a ruling on `རླུང` in the yogic/prāṇa sense as distinct from the humoral one. This chunk is that case, plus a new one: `རླུང` and `དབུགས` are now indistinguishable in the Vietnamese, in the same chunk, and both depart from the registered "khí". Wording KEPT. The ruling should cover the breath-meditation sense of `རླུང` and give `དབུགས` its own word.

terms.vi: sự thiện xảo (về uẩn / giới / xứ / duyên khởi); sở duyên thiện xảo
terms.note: p0608-p0609 (c184 L25, L27). glossary.json registers `མཁས་པ` only in the person sense - "bậc học giả" (paṇḍita), "bậc trí" (verse/contrastive), "khéo léo" (adjectival) - plus the compound `ཐབས་ལ་མཁས་པ` -> "sự thiện xảo về phương tiện". The chunk's "sở duyên thiện xảo" / "sự thiện xảo về uẩn, giới, xứ, duyên khởi" follows that compound's pattern and is internally consistent. Wording KEPT. Registration is owed because this names one of the four ālambana classes the whole śamatha division is divided by, and it will recur throughout the śamatha chapter. Note the existing `ཐབས་ལ་མཁས་པ` entry already requests one ruling plus a corpus sweep over 'phương tiện thiện xảo' / 'thiện xảo phương tiện' / 'thiện xảo về phương tiện' - this abstract-noun sense should be settled in the same ruling.

terms.kind: term - unrecorded split of a provisional entry
terms.note: p0608, inside the quotation (c184 L27), in the standard six-synonym list `བདག་དང་སེམས་ཅན་དང་སྲོག་དང་སྐྱེ་བ་པོ་དང་གསོ་བ་དང་གང་ཟག` -> ngã, chúng sinh, mạng, kẻ sinh, kẻ nuôi dưỡng, bổ-đặc-già-la. The chunk uses the registered "hạng người" at L25, L31, L45 and switches to the transliteration only here. Wording KEPT: the registered entry's own note restricts "hạng người" to enumerative, non-technical use, and glossary.json already carries four technical-context transliterations (`གང་ཟག་གི་བདག་ཏུ་འཛིན་པ`, `གང་ཟག་གི་བདག་མེད་པ`, `གང་ཟག་གི་བདག`), each with a note asking for a ruling on the split. This is a fifth instance and a distinct trigger - not the pudgala-nairātmya idiom but the ātman-synonym list - so it should be named explicitly when the split is finally recorded.

terms.kind: term - no entry; introduced by this repair
terms.note: p0608-p0609, 6 occurrences in the ནམ་གྲུས་ཞུས་པ quotation (c184 L27, L33, two of them bracketed elisions). No entry for `ཉེ་བར་གཏོད་པ` or bare `གཏོད་པ` anywhere in glossary.json. The rejected draft read "khiến tâm an trú nơi", which is the abiding sense and collides with `གནས་པ` (cf. the registered `བདེ་བ་ལ་རེག་པར་གནས་པ` -> "an trú nơi sự tiếp xúc với an lạc" and this chunk's own "sự an trụ của tâm" for `སེམས་གནས་པ`, L23). Changed to "khiến tâm hướng đến". Three neighbours are all taken and must stay separable in any ruling: `སེམས་གཏོད་པ` -> "đặt tâm vào" (L31), `སེམས་བཟུང་བ` -> "tâm được buộc vào" (L39), `སེམས་འཛིན་པ` -> "buộc tâm vào" (L53). Flagging one residue honestly: the preverb `ཉེ་བར` (upa-, 'closely') is not separately marked in "hướng đến" - I could find no Vietnamese that marks it without either colliding with the above or overstating the act. A ruling should decide whether it needs marking at all.

terms.vi: Cách thức xác định thứ tự
terms.note: Outline s195, path 6.2.3.1.11.2.5, depth 6 → '##' (following c174, which set '#' for the depth-5 parent 6.2.3.1.11.2 and '##' for its depth-6 children, and c175). Built from the registered གོ་རིམ་ངེས་པ = 'sự xác định về thứ tự' (p0337) and ཞར་ལ་གོ་རིམ་ངེས་པ་བསྟན་པ = 'Nhân tiện, trình bày sự xác định về thứ tự' (c140), plus ཚུལ = 'cách thức' per c174's ...ལ་བསླབ་ཚུལ = 'Cách thức tu học...'. The nominal phrase was turned into 'Cách thức xác định thứ tự' rather than 'Cách thức của sự xác định về thứ tự' for readability; the in-text restatement one line below uses the identical wording.

p0588, ཞི་གནས་ཀྱི་དམིགས་པ་ལ་ཆོས་ཅན་དང་ཆོས་ཉིད་གཉིས་ཡོད་པས. No entry, and the word does not occur anywhere else in translation/ (the three corpus hits for 'pháp hữu' are all ཆོས་འདུས་བྱས = 'pháp hữu vi', a different word). Rendered with the established Sino-Vietnamese 有法 so it pairs visibly with the registered ཆོས་ཉིད = 'pháp tánh' (法性), which stands beside it in the same clause. The term recurs in the vipaśyanā division (e.g. outline s250, གཞི་ཆོས་ཅན་མ་གྲུབ་པ), so it should be fixed centrally.

p0590, listed with ཤཱནྟི་པ (glossary: Śāntipa) among the authorities who teach that śamatha is sought first. No entry, and the name occurs nowhere else in translation/. Rendered by translation, not transcription, following the corpus pattern for གྲགས་པ names: ཆོས་ཀྱི་གྲགས་པ = 'Pháp Xứng' and ཟླ་བ་གྲགས་པ = 'Nguyệt Xứng' (both in glossary.json). ཡེ་ཤེས = 'trí' (the glossary's ཡེ་ཤེས family). The Sanskrit given here is derived from the components (jñāna + kīrti); the text says nothing more about him, and no work of his is named.

terms.vi: Thánh Kinh Tu Tập Lòng Tin Nơi Đại Thừa
terms.note: p0588. glossary.json already carries the title without the འཕགས་པ prefix as 'Kinh Tu Tập Lòng Tin Nơi Đại Thừa' (registered from p0269 / c083). The prefix is in the Tibetan here, so it is kept, following the corpus pattern for འཕགས་པ = 'Thánh' before a title (c083 *Thánh Giải Thâm Mật*, c175 *Thánh Bảo Vân*, c177 *Thánh Đại Bát Niết-bàn*, c178 *Thánh Bảo Tích* / *Thánh Tam-muội Vương*). This is the first corpus case where the prefixed title also contains 'Kinh' — see flag.

terms.vi: kinh nghiệm làm chuyển đổi tâm ý
terms.note: p0588–p0589, 2×; the pivot of the argument that śamatha need not precede either the view or the felt conviction in it. No entry for མྱོང་བ in this sense (the registered མྱོང་བ entries are all མྱོང་བར་ངེས་པའི་ལས = experiencing a karmic result). Rendered literally: ཡིད་འགྱུར་བ = 'tâm ý chuyển đổi', not smoothed to 'kinh nghiệm chứng nghiệm' or 'thể nghiệm', which would import a level of attainment the Tibetan does not state.

terms.vi: sẽ thành ra cái thái quá rằng…
terms.note: p0589. First occurrence of the prasaṅga/over-extension idiom anywhere in the translated corpus (grep of source/clean p0001–p0589 finds ཐལ་བར་འགྱུར only here; every other ཐལ is ཐལ་མོ = 'chắp tay' or ཐལ་བ = 'tro'). 'thái quá' is the established Sino-Vietnamese for the fallacy of over-extension; note c164 already uses 'thái quá' non-technically ('dụng công thái quá'), so a ruling may want a distinct term. The construction recurs constantly in the vipaśyanā division, so it should be fixed before it.

terms.vi: tăng thượng định học / tăng thượng tuệ học
terms.note: p0590. Composed from the registered བསླབ་པ, whose note rules ཏིང་ངེ་འཛིན་/ཤེས་རབ་ཀྱི་བསླབ་པ = 'định học / tuệ học', plus ལྷག་པ = 'tăng thượng' per the registered ལྷག་པའི་ཚུལ་ཁྲིམས = 'tăng thượng giới' and ལྷག་པའི་བསམ་པ = 'tăng thượng ý lạc'. Recorded so the ལྷག་པ- prefix is not dropped (the plain 'định học / tuệ học' would lose it) and so the trio with 'tăng thượng giới' is complete.

terms.vi: tăng thượng tuệ / tăng thượng tâm
terms.note: p0591, inside the *Bổn Địa Phần* citation, where the two stand without བསླབ་པ. Kept as the bare pair so the quotation is not padded with a word ('học') the Tibetan does not have there, while staying visibly the same family as ལྷག་པ་ཏིང་ངེ་འཛིན་གྱི་བསླབ་པ above.

terms.vi: tác ý tùy thuận với thắng quán
terms.note: p0589, the Saṃdhinirmocana criterion: analytical meditation is only 'concordant with' vipaśyanā until pliancy arises. Built from the glossary's ཡིད་ལ་བྱེད་པ = 'tác ý' and the corpus's རྗེས་སུ་མཐུན་པ = 'tùy thuận' (registered ཆོས་ཀྱི་རྗེས་སུ་མཐུན་པའི་ཆོས = 'pháp tùy thuận với pháp'). The parallel form ཞི་གནས་དང་རྗེས་སུ་མཐུན་པའི་ཡིད་བྱེད occurs later in the śamatha section, so the pair should be fixed together.

terms.vi: để cho danh ngôn được dùng cho nhẹ nhàng
terms.note: p0591. UNCERTAIN — see flag. ཟོར་ཡང་བ is not a lexical item; ཟོར elsewhere in source/clean occurs only as ཟོར་བ = 'sickle' (p0360) and inside རང་བཟོར (p0696). Read as this edition's spelling of ཟུར་ཡང་བ, i.e. loose/facile use of a designation, which is the only reading that fits the sentence (the nine abidings are 'called' śamatha and the four discernments 'called' vipaśyanā only by loose usage, whereas the real pair is posited from pliancy). ཐ་སྙད = 'danh ngôn' per the registered entry, ཡང་བ = 'nhẹ'. Recorded so a later chunk does not silently repair it.

terms.vi: chứng ngộ bốn đế một cách hiện tiền
terms.note: p0591. Bare བདེན་པ་བཞི, without འཕགས་པ — so 'bốn đế', not the registered འཕགས་པའི་བདེན་པ་བཞི = 'bốn thánh đế'. མངོན་སུམ་དུ་རྟོགས་པ rendered 'chứng ngộ một cách hiện tiền', built on the glossary's མངོན་སུམ་དུ་མཆོད་པ = 'cúng dường hiện tiền'; the corpus's 'hiện chứng' (c109, c133, c158, c160) was not used because there it renders མངོན་པར་རྫོགས་པར་སངས་རྒྱས་པ / མངོན་དུ་བྱ་བ, and merging the two would hide the difference.

p0589 l.3 (×3), p0590 (×2), and L53. No entry under either spelling despite 23 corpus occurrences; the two spellings are free variants of one term in this passage and should be registered together. Wording KEPT — internally consistent and the standard Sino-Vietnamese rendering.

terms.vi: hỷ lạc của khinh an nơi thân và tâm
terms.note: p0589 l.3. The compound form in which ཤིན་ཏུ་སྦྱངས་པ first appears in this chunk; register alongside the bare term so ལུས་སེམས་ is not dropped or re-ordered elsewhere. Wording KEPT.

p0589 l.3, p0591 l.3 (L37, L51, L53). Saṃdhinirmocana term of art, deliberately kept distinct from the registered སོ་སོར་རྟོག་པ = "giản trạch", which co-occurs with it in the same sentence. Wording KEPT; the split needs recording so the two are never collapsed.
p0589 l.3 (L37). The intensified partner of རྣམ་པར་འབྱེད་པ in the Saṃdhinirmocana pair; རབ་ཏུ rendered "tột cùng". Register as a pair with the entry above. Wording KEPT.

p0591 l.3 (L49), the uncontracted spelling. glossary.json has བདེན་བཞི = "bốn chân đế" and འཕགས་པའི་བདེན་པ་བཞི = "bốn thánh đế" but nothing for the plain uncontracted form. The text has been CHANGED to follow the contracted form's ruling; register the spelling so it resolves to the same Vietnamese and does not attract the འཕགས་པ-qualified rendering.

terms.vi: chính hành của tĩnh lự thứ nhất
terms.note: p0591 l.3 (L49). དངོས་གཞི = "chính hành" is registered only in the session-structure and karmapatha frames (སྦྱོར་བ / དངོས་གཞི / མཇུག); here it is the actual basis of a dhyāna, opposed to the registered ཉེར་བསྡོགས = "cận phần" in the same sentence — a third frame with no entry. Wording KEPT (it matches the registered word); the frame needs recording.

p0596, p0597 (×2), p0599. First occurrence in the corpus - grep for 'Trung Biên' over translation/ returns nothing and glossary.json has no entry. The Tibetan cites only the ABBREVIATED title དབུས་མཐའ (not དབུས་དང་མཐའ་རྣམ་པར་འབྱེད་པ), so the short Vietnamese form was chosen on the exact precedent of the registered མདོ་སྡེའི་རྒྱན = 'Kinh Trang Nghiêm Luận' (short Tibetan -> short Vietnamese, genre word added, no 'Đại Thừa' prefixed). The established full Sino-Vietnamese title is *Biện Trung Biên Luận*; if the project prefers full titles, this must be swept together with the four occurrences here. Cited on p0599 for the verse གནས་དང་དེ་ལ་གནས་པ་དང༌། །རྒྱུ་དང་འབྲས་བུ་ཉིད་དུ་འོ།

p0596 (དབུ་མ་སྒོམ་རིམ་གསུམ list) and p0597 (འཕགས་པ་ཐོགས་མེད་ཀྱིས་ས་སྡེ་ལྔར་རྒྱས་པར་གཏན་ལ་ཕབ་པ). No entry. Distinct from the bare ས་ = *Du-già Sư Địa* used in c067/c088/c091/c096; ས་སྡེ་ལྔ names the five-part collection, so 'năm bộ Địa' keeps the plural structure the Tibetan states rather than collapsing it onto the single title.

p0596, མཁས་པ་ཡོན་ཏན་གྲགས = 'bậc học giả Yönten Drak'. No entry. Transliterated rather than translated because p0597 says he explains this in རང་གི་ལམ་རིམ ('his own Lamrim'), which makes him a Tibetan lamrim author, not an Indian ācārya; spelling follows the registered སྒོམ་པ་ཡོན་ཏན་འབར = 'Gompa Yönten Bar'. Sanskrit would be Guṇakīrti if he were Indian - NOT asserted here. See flag.

Not new to the corpus (c166, c172, c175, c176 all use 'khinh an'), but genuinely absent from glossary.json - both the full ཤིན་ཏུ་སྦྱངས་པ and the contraction ཤིན་སྦྱངས (p0599) miss. Occurs 6× in this chunk and is the head term of the whole passage (it is the 'quả của sự nỗ lực' in the Trung Biên verse). Recording so the ruling is explicit. Kept distinct from the registered ལས་སུ་རུང་བ = 'kham nhậm'.

terms.vi: chín phương tiện an trụ tâm
terms.note: p0596, p0597. No entry (glossary has nothing under སེམས་གནས). Rendered descriptively, matching the Tibetan's own wording. The same nine are referred to in shorthand as སེམས་དགུ on p0596, rendered 'chín tâm' - a ruling should cover both forms and their relation to the section title དེ་ལ་བརྟེན་ནས་སེམས་གནས་སྐྱེ་བའི་རིམ་པ (p0598), rendered 'thứ đệ phát sinh sự an trụ của tâm'.

p0597, ལྷ་སྐུ་དང་ཐིག་ལེ་དང་ཡི་གེ་སོགས་ལ་དམིགས་པ - the meditation object. No entry; follows the registered ལྷ་བསྒོམ་པ = 'tu bổn tôn'. ཐིག་ལེ in the same list rendered 'minh điểm', per the registered compound རྩ་རླུང་ཐིག་ལེ; ཡི་གེ rendered 'chủng tự'.

terms.vi: ba bộ *Tu Tập Thứ Đệ* thuộc Trung Quán
terms.note: p0596. The three registered volumes (སྒོམ་རིམ་དང་པོ / བར་པ / ཐ་མ = *Tu Tập Thứ Đệ* quyển đầu/giữa/cuối) cited collectively with the དབུ་མ qualifier. Rendered with the registered title plus the registered དབུ་མ = 'Trung Quán'; the Tibetan does not name Kamalaśīla here, so no author was supplied.

terms.vi: làm cho hơi thở lắng dịu
terms.note: p0596, closing the posture instructions. Read as the breath, because it points back to the དབུགས (breath) item among the eight bodily postures on p0595; the glossary's རླུང = 'khí' entries are all medical (བད་ཀན/རླུང/མཁྲིས་པ) or tantric (རྩ་རླུང་ཐིག་ལེ) and do not cover this. See flag.
p0597. No entry. The general frame/body of samādhi practice, contrasted with the differing དམིགས་པ. Rendered non-technically.

GAP, wording KEPT (4x in c181: p0596 l.5, p0597 l.3, p0599 in the verse citation གནས་དང་དེ་ལ་གནས་པ་དང). No entry exists for དབུས་མཐའ in glossary.json and no other translated chunk contains 'Trung Biên Luận' or 'Biện Trung Biên' — p0596 is the book's first occurrence. decisions.md requires one fixed Vietnamese title per cited text, so this must be registered NOW: it recurs at p0625, p0631, p0632, p0640, p0643, p0645, p0655, p0683, p0788, p0964, i.e. repeatedly inside the śamatha chapters that follow immediately. Register the short form དབུས་མཐའ and the full དབུས་དང་མཐའ་རྣམ་པར་འབྱེད་པ to one title so they do not read as two works, on the same pattern as the existing གཏན་ལ་དབབ་པ་བསྡུ་བ / བསྡུ་བ short-form problem.

GAP arising from fabrication 4. Same p0597 list. glossary.json has only the compound ཡི་གེ་བརྒྱ་པ (hundred-syllable mantra), nothing for the bare word. Rendered plainly as 'chữ'; 'chủng tự' (bīja) must NOT be used for bare ཡི་གེ, since the Tibetan states no seed-syllable. A ruling would fix 'chữ' (or 'tự') for the bare word and keep 'chủng tự' available only where the Tibetan actually writes ས་བོན / ས་བོན་ཡི་གེ.

Confirmation rather than a gap, recorded so the choice is not relitigated. c181 p0597 l.3 now reads 'quyết trạch một cách rộng rãi' for ས་སྡེ་ལྔར་རྒྱས་པར་གཏན་ལ་ཕབ་པས, matching the registered གཏན་ལ་དབབ་པ -> 'quyết trạch' and the title གཏན་ལ་དབབ་པ་བསྡུ་བ -> *Nhiếp Quyết Trạch* that appears two clauses later. Note the standing tension the glossary itself records: ལས་དང་འབྲས་བུ་གཏན་ལ་དབབ་པ deliberately uses 'xác định' to avoid colliding with the title, while the outline heading ཐར་པར་བགྲོད་པའི་ལམ་གྱི་རང་བཞིན་གཏན་ལ་དབབ་པ uses 'quyết trạch'. One ruling on headings vs finite verb is still owed; c181 follows the finite-verb precedent of c034/c035/c137/c150.

terms.vi: sở duyên tịnh hóa phiền não
terms.note: p0604, p0605. Parallel in construction to སྤྱད་པ་རྣམ་པར་སྦྱོང་བའི་དམིགས་པ above; ཉོན་མོངས = 'phiền não' (fixed).

p0604, the upper limit of the levels whose grossness/peacefulness is the object. No entry. Established Sino-Vietnamese name of the third formless absorption; སྐྱེ་མཆེད = 'xứ' per the glossary's སྐྱེ་མཆེད་དྲུག = 'sáu xứ'.

p0605 (ཆོས་ཐམས་ཅད་ཁམས་དང་སྐྱེ་མཆེད་དུ་འདུ་ཚུལ) and p0607 (ཁམས་ཀྱི་རབ་ཏུ་དབྱེ་བ = 'sự phân tách các giới', the antidote object for pride). The glossary's bare ཁམས = 'Kham' is a place name and must NOT apply; this follows the registered 'ཁམས (realm sense) => giới'.

p0607 (×3, incl. inside the Śrāvakabhūmi quotation). ཆ་མཉམ་པ = 'equal parts'; 'đẳng phần' is the established Sino-Vietnamese (等分). Paired with ཉོན་མོངས་པ་ཆུང་བ = 'kẻ có phiền não nhỏ nhẹ' (rendered literally, no entry).

p0607, 5× inside the Revata quotation. No entry. 'hệ tâm' (繫心) chosen as the established Vietnamese register; note it does not visibly preserve the ཉེ་བར་ prefix, and the plain གཏོད་པ of the section headword (སེམས་དམིགས་པ་ལ་གཏོད་པ) is rendered 'hướng [tâm] đến', so the two are no longer visibly one family. A ruling would settle this.

terms.vi: duyên khởi thuộc chính duyên này
terms.note: p0607, the antidote object for delusion in the Revata quotation. Rendered literally on the glossary's རྟེན་ཅིང་འབྲེལ་པར་འབྱུང་བ = 'duyên khởi'; the established Chinese 此緣性緣起 was not used because it would read as a technical coinage the Tibetan does not signal. See flag.

terms.vi: hướng về / đổ về / quy về
terms.note: p0604, the triad describing how the twelve branches of scripture relate to suchness, inside a quoted phrase from the middle Bhāvanākrama. No entry. Rendered as three distinct verbs to keep the Tibetan's three distinct; the exact nuance separating them is not certain - see flag.

terms.vi: Nơi một sở duyên nào đó, bất kỳ,
terms.note: p0606, the single pāda quoted from ལམ་སྒྲོན = *Đạo Đăng* (Bodhipathapradīpa). Recorded so the same line is rendered identically if it recurs.
p0605. No entry. Built to sit beside the glossary's དམིགས་གཏད = 'đối tượng nhắm tới' and དམིགས་རྟེན = 'đối tượng sở duyên'.

p0604, contrasted in the same sentence with སྡུད་པ ('việc thâu gọn') and named as what produces སོ་སོར་རྟོག་པའི་ཤེས་རབ = 'trí tuệ giản trạch' (glossary). Kept verbally distinct from སོ་སོར་རྟོག་པ = 'giản trạch' so the two Tibetan verbs stay separable.

REAL DRIFT, no entry exists. c183 L33 (p0607 l1, the Revata quotation, antidote for ང་རྒྱལ) has "sự phân tách các giới"; c182 L33/L41 has "sự phân biệt các giới" for the identical Śrāvakabhūmi list item. Wording kept. Constraint the ruling must respect: in c183 "phân biệt" is already carrying རྣམ་པར་རྟོག་པ ("kẻ có hạnh phân biệt", L31/L37/L41 — and རྣམ་པར་རྟོག་པ་སྤྱད་པ is the very next item in the same quoted list), so adopting c182's "phân biệt" here would put two different Tibetan terms under one Vietnamese word inside one sentence. Recommend fixing རབ་ཏུ་དབྱེ་བ = "phân tách" and reserving "phân biệt" for རྣམ་པར་རྟོག་པ, then sweeping c182.

terms.kind: gap — partial coverage, nothing to change
terms.note: c183 L15 (ཆོས་ཐམས་ཅད་ཁམས་དང་སྐྱེ་མཆེད་དུ་འདུ་ཚུལ, p0604 l3 -> "giới và xứ") and L33 (ཁམས་ཀྱི་རབ་ཏུ་དབྱེ་བ -> "các giới", the six dhātus earth/water/fire/wind/space/consciousness per c182 L41). glossary.json has ཁམས = "Kham" (place, and must NOT apply here) and "ཁམས (realm sense) = giới", plus compounds ཁམས་གོང་མ་གཉིས / ཁམས་གསུམ / སེམས་ཅན་ཁམས / འཇིག་རྟེན་ཁམས, but no entry for ཁམས as element/dhātu. The Vietnamese is "giới" either way, so no text change was made — record the sense so the Phase 5 sweep does not read it as unruled.
p0621–p0622, ×4. The 'stability aspect' of samādhi, the counterpart of གསལ་ཆ. Built on the corpus's གནས་པ = an trú.

terms.vi: phần trầm một / phần trạo cử
terms.note: p0621–p0622. ཤས = share/portion; kept as 'phần' to match the ཆ pair above (རྒོད་ཤས་ཆེ་བས = 'vì phần trạo cử lớn').

p0621–p0622. The glossary only rules རིག་པ = 'minh' in རིག་པའི་གནས་ལྔ (vidyā-sthāna), which is a different word-sense; here it is the meditator's awareness whose 'pitch' is raised or lowered. Needs an owner ruling.

p0622, author of the commentary on Candragomin's verse. Rendered by the standard Sanskrit reconstruction of the Tibetan name (སངས་རྒྱས = buddha, ཞི་བ = śānti), following the corpus practice of Sanskrit for Indian masters with no established Sino-Vietnamese name. The reconstruction is an inference from the Tibetan, not something the source states.

terms.vi: việc an trú [tâm] / việc an trú [tâm] một cách chân chánh
terms.note: p0623, inside an Asaṅga quotation — the first two of the nine mental abidings. Rendered literally; the conventional Sino-Vietnamese set-names 'nội trụ / đẳng trụ' were NOT imported, because the quotation does not use set-names and importing them would add doctrinal information the Tibetan does not carry. If the owner prefers the set-names, this is the place to rule.

terms.vi: tác ý gắng siết mà thâm nhập
terms.note: p0623, Asaṅga quotation. Literal rendering of the Tibetan; the Sanskrit/Chinese technical name (力励运转作意) was not imported into the quotation.

terms.vi: sự gắng siết chặt / sự buông lỏng
terms.note: p0620–p0623, the pivot pair of the whole chunk (×12). Also གྲིམས་དྲགས་པ / ལྷོད་དྲགས་པ = 'quá căng / quá chùng' and དམ་ལྷོད་རན་པ = 'mức căng chùng vừa phải'.

terms.vi: sự thối lui (tâm co rút vào trong)
terms.note: p0622–p0623, ×5. DIVERGES from the glossary's ཞུམ་པ = 'thối chí' (recorded from p0534–p0536, where it means discouragement of motivation). Here it is a technical meditation state: the source itself glosses it as སེམས་ནང་དུ་སྡོད་པའི་ཞུམ་པ and Buddhaśānti equates it with བྱིང་བ arising (སེམས་ནང་དུ་ཞུམ་ཞིང་བྱིང་བ་སྐྱེ). 'thối chí' would name a motivational state the passage is not talking about. Needs an owner ruling on splitting the two senses.

terms.vi: sự thành tựu mức trung dung
terms.note: p0622–p0623, in the Deśanāstava verse and its gloss. དབུ་མ here is the middle between the two extremes of laxity and excitement, NOT the Madhyamaka school; rendered 'mức trung dung' to keep it from reading as 'Trung Quán'.

terms.vi: nhập đẳng chí một cách đúng mực
terms.note: p0622, Candragomin verse and gloss. Built on the glossary's མཉམ་འཇུག = 'đẳng chí'.

p0621, in སེམས་ཉོག་ཉོག་པོར་སོང་བའི་འཐིབས་པ = 'sự mờ đục khiến tâm trở nên vẩn đục'. Kept distinct from རྨུགས་པ = 'hôn trầm' and བྱིང་བ = 'trầm một', which the same passage is arguing must not be confused.
p0620. ཧད་དེ = blankly, vacantly. Rendered plainly; see flag — the idiom is read from context, not from a lexical ruling.

The bare verb behind the registered compound `སྐྱོང་ཚུལ` = 'cách thức gìn giữ' has no entry of its own. p0620 `ཏིང་ངེ་འཛིན་སྐྱོང་བ་ན`, p0621 `རྣམ་པར་མི་རྟོག་པའི་སེམས་སྐྱོང་བས`, p0622 `དེ་ཧ་ཅང་གློད་ནས་བསྐྱངས་པ་ན`. Conformed to 'gìn giữ' in this repair to match the compound; needs pinning centrally so the verb and the compound stay together.
GAP — no entry. p0623 `འཛིན་སྟངས་ཀྱི་གྲིམས་ཆ་དགོས་པ`. Same `X་ཆ` set; must not collapse into `བསྒྲིམས་པ` = 'gắng siết chặt', which is a different word doing different work in the same paragraph.

GAP — no entry. p0620 `ངེས་ཤེས་ཀྱི་ངར་ཐོན་པའི་གསལ་ཆ`, p0622 `ངར་ཐོན་པའི་གསལ་བ`. The criterion that separates a faultless samādhi from mere clarity, so it is load-bearing for the whole section and recurs beyond c187.

GAP — no entry. p0620–p0623 throughout, incl. `བསྒྲིམས་དྲགས་པ` ('gắng siết chặt quá mức') and the Asaṅga quote `བསྒྲིམས་ཏེ་འཇུག་པའི་ཡིད་ལ་བྱེད་པ`. One pole of the tension/looseness axis this whole passage argues about.

GAP — no entry. p0622 `གློད་དྲགས`, `དེ་གློད་ན`, p0623 `གློད་པ་རབ`. The opposite pole to `བསྒྲིམས་པ`; also the quoted slogan `གློད་པ་རབ` rendered 'buông lỏng bậc nhất'. Kept distinct from `ལྷོད་དྲགས་པ` ('quá chùng') and `རྩོལ་བ་བཏང་བ` ('buông rơi nỗ lực').
GAP — bare `ལུགས` has no entry. p0621 section head `སྐྱོན་དང་བཅས་པའི་ལུགས་བསལ་བ་ལ`. Because it is a sa-bcad heading it must be fixed before the parallel sub-sections are translated.

terms.vi: phần sáng tỏ / sức mạnh của phần sáng tỏ
terms.note: p0616 l.2, p0617 ×3. No entry. Follows c176, which already renders གསལ་ཆའི་ངར as 'sức mạnh của phần sáng tỏ' in the same division. One of the two defining qualities of the samadhi to be achieved here, so it must be fixed before c187/c188.

p0617 l.2, the fourth quality some add to the list. No entry. Follows c176, which renders དྭངས་ཆ 'phần trong trẻo'. Kept distinct from གསལ་བ = 'sáng tỏ', which the same sentence says already absorbs it.

p0618 (རྣམ་པར་མི་གཡེང་བའི་ལས་ཅན, inside the Abhidharmasamuccaya definition of དྲན་པ) and p0619 (བྱེད་ལས་ཀྱི་ཁྱད་པར). No entry. c093 l.27 already renders ལས་ཅན 'nghiệp dụng' inside the exactly parallel Abhidharmasamuccaya definition of སེམས་པ, so this follows established corpus usage.

p0618, twice: the Sūtrālaṃkāra commentary's དྲན་པ་དང་ཤེས་བཞིན་ནི་ཉེ་བར་གཏོད་པར་བྱེད་པ, and Tsongkhapa's own དྲན་པ་དེས་སེམས་དམིགས་པ་ལ་ཉེ་བར་གཏོད་ཚུལ. No entry. Deliberately kept distinguishable from the bare གཏོད་པ of the section heading (སེམས་དམིགས་པ་ལ་གཏོད་པ = 'hướng tâm vào sở duyên'), which c182 will have fixed; ཉེ་བར adds the upa- of closeness. See flag.

terms.bo: ཁ་དོག (visualised deity body, not the physical-excellence sense)
terms.note: p0616, ཁ་དོག་མ་ངེས་པ — the colour of a visualised deity coming up wrong (yellow intended, red arises). The glossary's ཁ་དོག = 'màu da' is scoped by its own note to ཁ་དོག་ཕུན་སུམ་ཚོགས་པ (p0243) and is wrong here; that note already asks for a general ruling. Recorded as the second, distinct sense.

terms.vi: sự không nhất định về màu sắc / về hình dáng / về số lượng / về lớn nhỏ
terms.note: p0616, the four instabilities of the visualised object, given as one set. Registered together so they stay parallel; དབྱིབས has no entry at all.
p0617. དབང་ here is mastery/vaśitā, NOT the glossary's དབང་ = 'quán đảnh' (initiation, c005); applying that entry would produce a false claim. Built on the corpus's དབང་ཕྱུག = 'tự tại'. See flag.
p0616, third of the three sub-topics announced here; it will be the heading of a later part of this section. Uses the glossary's ཐུན = 'thời khóa'.

terms.vi: xác lập cách thức không lỗi / loại bỏ cách thức có lỗi
terms.note: p0616, the first two of the three sub-topics announced here. Recorded now because c187 and c188 fall inside them and must repeat the same wording.
p0617. Uses the glossary's སྐྱོང་བ = 'duy trì' (recorded for section 6.1.2.1), not the competing 'hộ trì' variant, because the object here is the samadhi itself.

p0617, of བྱིང་བ against གསལ་ཆ and རྒོད་པ against མི་རྟོག་པ. No entry. Deliberately NOT 'chướng ngại', which the glossary fixes for གེགས — the two words stand two clauses apart in the same sentence and must stay separable.
p0619, the elephant-tamer of the simile. No entry. Follows the corpus pattern for X-རྫི (ཕྱུགས་རྫི = 'người chăn', གནག་རྫི = 'người chăn bò') rather than the more idiomatic Vietnamese 'quản tượng'.

terms.vi: dây thừng / sợi dây của niệm
terms.note: p0619, the rope of the elephant simile and its application. No entry for either. Uses the glossary's bare དྲན་པ = 'niệm'.

terms.vi: hỷ lạc mang hành tướng của cảm thọ thấm nhuần
terms.note: p0617. No entry for སིམ་པ. 'thấm nhuần' is the corpus rendering already used at c033 and c105/c115 for the saturating/refreshing sense. Uses the registered ཚོར་བ = 'cảm thọ', དགའ་བ = 'hỷ', བདེ་བ = 'lạc'.

terms.vi: làm cho tâm được nâng cao lên
terms.note: p0618. The glossary's སེམས་འཕངས་མཐོ་བ = 'tâm chí cao vời' is scoped by its own note to p0516, where it is a lofty resolve; here it is a meditation instruction about the pitch/tautness of the mind's apprehension, immediately after ཚིར་གྱིས་བཟུང་བའི་འཛིན་སྟངས་ཤུགས་ཅན. Rendered neutrally rather than by the p0516 idiom. See flag.
p0618, qualifying འཛིན་སྟངས་ཤུགས་ཅན. No entry; ཚིར་ is rare. Rendered by sense (tight grip). See flag.
p0619. No entry. Adverbial intensifier of དྲན་པ; rendered by sense (fixedly, without letting go).

p0619. Applies the existing glossary entry མི་བསྲུན་པ = 'hung bạo' unchanged. Recorded only because that entry's note scopes it to beings (p0491–p0493) and this is its first use of an animal; no change of Vietnamese was made.

p0617 l1, བྱང་སེམས་དབང་ཐོབ་པ་འགའ་ཞིག -> 'một số bồ-tát đã đắc tự tại' (c186 L27). The only ruling touching དབང is དབང -> 'quán đảnh' (provisional, skt abhiṣeka, recorded from the empowerment context of c005); it does not apply here. Two things are needed: scope the existing དབང = quán đảnh entry explicitly to the abhiṣeka sense, and register དབང་ཐོབ་པ separately. Note the glossary already keeps several unrelated senses of དབང apart (དབང་ཕྱུག at p0177, མི་དབང, ཐུབ་དབང), so this is the same pattern.

p0614, ཏིང་ངེ་འཛིན་བསྒྲུབ་པའི་གཞུང་ཚད་ལྡན་ས་སྡེ་དང་སྒོམ་རིམ་གསུམ. No entry. Rendered from the components (ས = địa, སྡེ = bộ). Deliberately NOT 'Du-già Sư Địa', which glossary.json already fixes for རྣལ་འབྱོར་སྤྱོད་པའི་ས, and NOT 'Bổn Địa Phần' (སའི་དངོས་གཞི) — ས་སྡེ names the whole collection of Bhūmi works, not one of them. RULING NEEDED, and it is urgent: the same word recurs at p0596 as འཕགས་པ་ཐོགས་མེད་ཀྱི་ས་སྡེ་དང་དབུ་མ་སྒོམ་རིམ་གསུམ inside c181, which is still pending, so whatever is decided must be applied there too. 'Ngũ Bộ Địa Luận' was rejected because the Tibetan has no 'ngũ' here.

p0612 and p0615 (the latter as གསང་སྔགས་ཀྱི་ལྷའི་རྣལ་འབྱོར, running into c186). No entry. ལྷ rendered 'bổn tôn' following the corpus (c005, c006, c008, c048, c107, c108 all use 'bổn tôn' for the tantric deity); རྣལ་འབྱོར = du-già per the glossary's རྣལ་འབྱོར་པ = 'hành giả du-già'. Not 'thiên du-già'.

terms.vi: tu theo lối *har* [nhìn chăm chăm — thuật ngữ không rõ]
terms.note: p0613, ཁ་ཅིག་སྐུ་གཟུགས་མདུན་དུ་བཞག་པ་ལ་མིག་གིས་བལྟས་ནས་ཧར་སྒོམ་བྱེད་པ. ཧར་ left transliterated with a bracketed gloss and an explicit 'nghĩa không rõ', on the pattern already used in the corpus for opaque Tibetan idiom (c028 '[*g.yam* — thành ngữ, nghĩa không rõ]', c107 '*ske cu cu* [nghĩa không rõ]'). See flag.

p0614, inside the Bhāvanākrama I quotation, ཕུང་པོ་དང་ཁམས་ལ་སོགས་པའི་བྱེ་བྲག. COLLISION: glossary.json's only ཁམས entry is the place name 'Kham'. Rendered 'giới' (界), the standard Sino-Vietnamese for the eighteen dhātus, paired with the glossary's ཕུང་པོ = uẩn. The place-name entry needs a scope note or Phase 5 will read this as drift.

p0615, སེམས་གནས་ཆའི་ཏིང་ངེ་འཛིན — the stability-factor of samādhi, contrasted in the same sentence with གསལ་ཆ = 'phần sáng rõ'. No entry for either. The pair is the controlling contrast of this passage's practical instruction (settle for half-clear and get stability first), so the two must stay visibly paired.

p0613, twice, of the images one looks at to fix the meditation object. Both rendered plainly; built alongside the glossary's སྐུ་གཟུགས = 'hình tượng', which is the general word used in the same sentences.
p0614, of the word གཅིག in the *Bodhipathapradīpa* line — the restrictive expression Tsongkhapa reads as proof that only one object is meant. Kept distinct from ངེས་པ = 'xác quyết' in the corpus.
p0615. Built on the glossary's མུ་བཞི = 'bốn trường hợp' (whose note explicitly declines 'tứ cú' for the non-Madhyamaka combinatorial sense — which is what this is); ཚན = 'bộ'/set.

p0613, the pair on which the refutation of staring-meditation turns. No entries. 'ý thức' is the settled Sino-Vietnamese; 'thức của căn' kept descriptive rather than 'căn thức' so the two do not look like a fixed compound pair the Tibetan does not write.
p0614, ཡིད་ལ་བྱེད་པ་ཁུགས་པར་བྱེད་པ inside the Bhāvanākrama I quotation — attention brought under control. Built on the glossary's ཡིད་ལ་བྱེད་པ = 'tác ý'.

terms.bo: རྣམ་པ (in the ālambana / ākāra / karman triad)
terms.note: p0628, the Abhidharmasamuccaya analysis of auddhatya into དམིགས་པ / རྣམ་པ / བྱེད་ལས. The view has འཛིན་སྟངས -> 'cách nắm giữ [ākāra]' and c187 rendered ཡུལ་གྱི་རྣམ་པ as 'hình tướng của đối tượng', but neither fits this Abhidharma slot, where 行相 'hành tướng' is the established Sino-Vietnamese. Registering so the three slots read as the standard triad: sở duyên / hành tướng / tác dụng (the last already registered as བྱེད་ལས -> tác dụng).

p0629 ×2, inside the Bhāvanākrama II and Saṃdhinirmocana quotations. The view registers རྨུགས་པ -> hôn trầm but nothing for གཉིད; 'thùy miên' is the established pair-word (睡眠). Bare གཉིད elsewhere is ordinary sleep.

p0630, རྨུགས་པ་ནི་མི་དགེ་བ་དང་བསྒྲིབས་ལ་ལུང་མ་བསྟན་གང་རུང. Builds on the registered ལུང་མ་བསྟན -> vô ký; 有覆無記 is the standard compound. A literal 'vô ký bị che lấp' would break the Abhidharma pairing with 無覆無記.

terms.vi: sự thối lui theo nghĩa chán nản
terms.note: p0629, བྱིང་བ ... ཡི་ཤི་བའི་ཞུམ་པ་དང་ནི་མི་གཅིག་གོ. ཡི་ཤི་བ has no entry and I could not confirm the form; it looks like a variant/typo neighbourhood of ཡི་ཆད་པ / ཡི་ཞུམ (dejection, loss of heart). Rendered as the dejection sense because the whole clause exists to separate laya's ཞུམ་པ from an emotional one. See flags.

p0627, ཆུ་ཚོད་གཅིག་ལ་སོགས་པའི་ཡུན་ཚད. Back-reference to the Bhāvanākrama III quotation on p0626, which is in c188 (untranslated) — whichever wording c188 uses for ཆུ་ཚོད / མེལ་ཚེ / ཐུན་ཕྱེད must govern, and this occurrence should be swept to match.

terms.vi: chướng ngại nơi các giới [của thân]
