terms.note: p0627. Uses the registered བར་ཆད -> chướng ngại and ཁམས (dhātu sense) -> giới, but the sense here is a disturbance of the bodily elements/humours, not the eighteen dhātus. 'giới' alone is opaque, so '[của thân]' is bracketed as supplied. A ruling would help; see flags.

terms.bo: གྲོགས་བྱེད་པ (verbal, of styāna assisting the kleśas)
terms.note: p0630, ཉོན་མོངས་པ་དང་ཉེ་བའི་ཉོན་མོངས་པ་ཐམས་ཅད་ཀྱི་གྲོགས་བྱེད་པའི་ལས་ཅན. The registered bare གྲོགས -> 'bạn hữu' is scoped to the noun 'friend' and would read absurdly here; the verbal compound needs its own scope note.
p0630, one of the remedies for laya. No entry for སྣང་བ in this luminosity sense. 'quang minh' is the alternative; 'ánh sáng' was chosen to stay non-technical since the Tibetan here is bare.
p0629, གངས་རིའི་ཁྲོད་ཀྱི་བསམ་གཏན་པ་ཕལ་མོ་ཆེ — Tsongkhapa's standard designation for the Tibetan meditators he is criticising. Kept descriptive rather than turned into a place name.

CONFLICT between two live prov entries for what is one lemma. The view holds `བར་གཅོད -> sự gây chướng ngại` (scoped to p0204 མི་དང་མི་མ་ཡིན་གྱི་བར་གཅོད and p0462 ཐོས་པ་ལ་སོགས་པའི་བར་གཅོད — both NOMINAL, an obstacle that befalls one) and `བར་དུ་གཅོད་པ -> làm trở ngại` (p0617, VERBAL, one factor obstructing another), whose note forbids 'chướng ngại' because the glossary fixes that for གེགས. p0628 l.7 writes the contracted བར་གཅོད but uses it verbally (བར་གཅོད་བྱེད་པ) and it directly glosses the quoted བར་དུ་གཅོད་པ of the Abhidharmasamuccaya definition two lines earlier, so it was brought onto 'làm trở ngại'. Requested ruling: བར་གཅོད and བར་དུ་གཅོད་པ are ONE lemma, split by syntax not by spelling — nominal use 'sự gây chướng ngại' / verbal use 'làm trở ngại' — or else the nominal entry is retitled too, since 'sự gây chướng ngại' also collides with the prov `བར་ཆད -> chướng ngại` and the fixed གེགས -> chướng ngại. Three distinct Tibetan words currently touch one Vietnamese word.

DEPARTURE FROM PROV, DECLARED HERE; wording KEPT. The view's `དྲན་པ -> niệm` is itself scoped to p0350 (Suhṛllekha verse) and its own note says the glossary rules only the compound དྲན་པ་དང་ཤེས་བཞིན => 'chánh niệm và tỉnh giác' and that a ruling on the bare term is owed. c189 has bare དྲན་པ four times on p0627 l.1 (དྲན་པ་མ་བརྗེད, དྲན་པ་སྟོབས་ལྡན་སྐྱེ་བ, དྲན་པ་ཉམས་པ, དྲན་པ་སྐྱོང་ཚུལ) and renders all four 'chánh niệm'. Specific reason for the departure: here དྲན་པ is not free vocabulary but the first member of the technical śamatha pair, standing in explicit parallel with ཤེས་བཞིན in the very same sentence (སྔ་མས་ནི་དྲན་པ་སྟོབས་ལྡན་སྐྱེ་བ་ལ... ཕྱི་མས་ནི་ཤེས་བཞིན་སྟོབས་ལྡན་སྐྱེ་བ་ལ...), which the chunk renders 'tỉnh giác' per the fixed compound. Reading it 'niệm' beside 'tỉnh giác' would break the registered pair at the exact place the text is arguing about it. The chunk is internally consistent and renders བརྗེད་ངས as 'thất niệm' per its own prov entry. ONE ruling needed covering both environments: suggested split — bare དྲན་པ in verse / non-technical prose = 'niệm' (and in the registered titles དྲན་པའི་ཚོམས, དྲན་པ་ཉེ་བར་བཞག་པ), bare དྲན་པ inside the śamatha faculty-pair = 'chánh niệm'. It recurs several hundred times from here to the end of the śamatha division, so it should be settled before the next batch.

NO TEXT CHANGE MADE. The view carries two competing prov entries for the same lemma: `གཞུང་ཆེ་བ -> các bản văn lớn` (p0383) and `གཞུང་ཆེ་བ་རྣམས -> các bộ luận lớn` (p0565), the latter's own note already recording the corpus split ('các bộ luận lớn' at c011 vs 'các đại luận' at c010/c011/c032/c033/c034/c181) and asking for one ruling. c189 has both forms on p0630 — གཞུང་ཆེ་བ་གཞན (L64) and གཞུང་ཆེ་བ་རྣམས (L66) — and applies 'các bộ luận lớn' to both, i.e. it picked one of the two entries in the view and stayed consistent within the chunk. The referent in both places is unambiguously the great Indian treatises (the second occurrence introduces the Bhāvanākrama-type instruction on clearing བྱིང་བ), so 'bộ luận' is substantively right; the open question is only the corpus-wide form. Held until the central ruling lands, since it is a sweep across at least eight chunks, not a c189 edit. Note also the neighbouring registered གཞུང་ཆེན་མོ -> 'đại luận' and prov `གཞུང -> bản văn`, which the ruling has to be consistent with.

SECOND SCOPED SENSE requested; wording KEPT. The view's `གཟེངས་བསྟོད -> nâng cao ý chí` is scoped by its own note to p0535 (བློ་གཟེངས་བསྟོད་ན, the Jātakamālā passage on raising one's resolve against ཞུམ་པ = discouragement). p0630's སེམས་གཟེངས་བསྟོད་དགོས་པ is the śamatha antidote to བྱིང་བ: the sentence continues བློའི་འཛིན་སྟངས་འཕངས་དམའ་རུ་སོང་བ ('the mind's mode of apprehension has dropped to a low pitch'), so what is raised is the pitch/tautness of the apprehension, not the practitioner's morale. 'nâng cao ý chí' would import resolve-against-discouragement, which is what the neighbouring ཞུམ་པ passages are about and must stay separable from laya. The chunk's wording matches the established śamatha usage in the corpus (c187 'nâng cao khéo léo cái thế của tâm thức', c191 'nâng cao cách nắm giữ') and uses 'thế' consistently with the prov `འཛིན་སྟངས -> cách nắm giữ` rendering. Requested: register a second scoped sense — གཟེངས་བསྟོད (śamatha, against བྱིང་བ) = 'nâng cao thế của tâm' — and ideally settle the wording of འཕངས (pitch/height) at the same time, since it is the same metaphor and occurs in the same sentence.

terms.vi: đạo có hành tướng tịnh và thô
terms.note: GAP - first occurrence in the corpus (p0675 tail, p0676 l.1, l.5; recurs on p0679+). The mundane path that views the lower level as coarse (རགས་པ) and the higher as peaceful (ཞི་བ). Note the collision: གློssary already has ཞི་བ -> 'tịch tĩnh' (from the ten qualities) and ཞི་གནས -> tịnh chỉ/chỉ/thiền chỉ; here ཞི་ is rendered 'tịnh' as one half of the contrastive pair 'tịnh và thô', which reads naturally but is a third Vietnamese for the same syllable. A ruling is needed on whether to keep 'tịnh và thô' or use 'tịch tĩnh và thô'; the term names one of the two divisions of this whole section so it will recur constantly.

terms.vi: [tác ý] liễu tri riêng từng tướng
terms.note: GAP - the first of the six ཡིད་བྱེད (manaskāra) of the first sāmantaka. Occurs 1× p0676, 2× p0677, 1× p0678, and again on p0679-p0680, so it governs the rest of this section. Built on the glossary's provisional མཚན་ཉིད -> tướng (characteristic sense, not 'định nghĩa' here - it is the individual characteristics of the lower and higher levels that are being discerned) and ཡིད་ལ་བྱེད་པ -> tác ý. 'liễu tri' renders སོ་སོར་རིག་པ (pratisaṃvedana); the established Sino-Vietnamese for this manaskāra is 了相作意, which would give 'tác ý liễu tướng' - shorter and arguably preferable. Ruling requested.

p0677 l.3, p0678 l.1. The six manaskāras of the sāmantaka. Uses the glossary's provisional ཡིད་ལ་བྱེད་པ -> tác ý; recorded only so the set-phrase is fixed, since the individual members are named one by one from p0679 on.

p0677 l.1, a division of the Śrāvakabhūmi (ཉན་ས = Thanh Văn Địa, already provisional in the glossary). 瑜伽處 'du-già xứ' is the established Sino-Vietnamese for yogasthāna. No entry exists; wording chosen, ruling requested. Kept distinct from the glossary's རྣལ་འབྱོར -> du-già and རྣལ་འབྱོར་པ -> hành giả du-già.

p0677 l.1 ×2, contrasted with འཇིག་རྟེན་པ = 'thế gian' (from the fixed འཇིག་རྟེན -> thế gian). 'xuất thế gian' already occurs 16× in the corpus but has no glossary entry; recorded so the pair thế gian / xuất thế gian is registered together with the section heading འཇིག་རྟེན་པའི་ལམ = 'đạo thế gian'.
p0676 l.5, p0678 l.1 ×2. No glossary entry, but 'khinh an' is already used consistently in c166, c172, c175, c176, c179, c180, c181 - this only records the settled usage.

p0676 l.5 ×2 (verse དངོས་གཞིའི་གནས་པ and the prose gloss དངོས་གཞི་བསྒྲུབ་པ). Follows c179 L49 ('chính hành của tĩnh lự thứ nhất') and c180. Pairs with the glossary's provisional ཉེར་བསྡོགས -> cận phần. Recorded because the alternative Sino-Vietnamese 'căn bản định' is equally standard and the two must not both appear.
The section heading itself (p0676 l.3). From the fixed འཇིག་རྟེན -> thế gian.

p0676 l.1, རྒྱལ་བའི་བསྟན་པ་སྤྱིའི་ཕྱག་རྒྱས་བཏབ་པ = 'đã được đóng dấu ấn chung của giáo pháp Đấng Chiến Thắng'. The glossary's provisional ཕྱག་རྒྱ -> 'thủ ấn' is scoped to p0356, where it is a tantric mudrā paired with གསང་སྔགས; here it is the seal-of-authority metaphor, so 'thủ ấn' would be wrong. Scoped entry requested.

p0677 l.1. Uses the glossary's provisional ཆོས་མངོན་པ / མངོན་པ -> A-tỳ-đạt-ma. The referents (Asaṅga's Abhidharmasamuccaya as 'upper' and Vasubandhu's Abhidharmakośa as 'lower') are NOT supplied in the translation, since the Tibetan does not name them.

terms.vi: sự nhất tâm thuộc Dục [giới] / tâm chuyên nhất thuộc Dục [giới]
terms.note: p0678 l.1 ×2. Combines the glossary's provisional རྩེ་གཅིག་པ -> 'sự nhất tâm' and སེམས་རྩེ་གཅིག་པ -> 'tâm chuyên nhất' with འདོད་པ་ཁམས -> Dục giới. The two Vietnamese forms fall out of two different Tibetan forms in the same paragraph, which is faithful but may read as drift in the Phase 5 sweep - flagging so it is recorded rather than swept.

p0676 l.1, in the Sūtrālaṃkāra verse དངོས་གཞིའི་གནས་པ → 'sự an trú của chính hành', and in the gloss དངོས་གཞི་བསྒྲུབ་པ → 'thành tựu chính hành'. The view holds only སའི་དངོས་གཞི → Bổn Địa Phần, which is a TITLE (Maulī Bhūmi) and was correctly not applied here. The bare term is the actual/main absorption as opposed to ཉེར་བསྡོགས (cận phần, ruled). One ruling needed for the bare term, scoped away from the title.

7 occurrences across pp.676-678 (p0676 l.1 ×2, p0677 l.1, l.3 ×2, p0678 l.1 ×2). The view rules only bare མཚན་ཉིད → tướng (prov). This is a fixed technical term — the first of the six ཡིད་བྱེད — and it names the object of the chunk's entire argument. Rendered identically at all 7 hits; kept. Will recur throughout the dhyāna chapter.

Abbreviated form, p0676 l.1 ×3, p0677 l.1, l.3, p0678 l.1; also ཡིད་བྱེད་དྲུག → 'sáu tác ý' (p0677 l.3, p0678 l.1). The view rules the full ཡིད་ལ་བྱེད་པ → tác ý; the contraction is unruled but rendered identically, which is correct. Record the abbreviation as an alias so a Phase 5 sweep does not read it as unruled.

p0676 l.1 བདག་མེད་པའི་དེ་ཁོ་ན་ཉིད་ཀྱི་རྣམ་པ་ཅན; p0676 l.5 ×2 ཞི་རགས་ཀྱི་རྣམ་པ་ཅན (plus two further hits in the sa-bcad headings). No entry for རྣམ་པ or རྣམ་པ་ཅན in the view (only the compound རྣམ་པ་ཐམས་ཅད་མཁྱེན་པ). Consistent throughout; kept.

p0676 l.5 ×2 and in both sa-bcad headings — ཞི་རགས་ཀྱི་རྣམ་པ་ཅན་གྱི་ལམ, the name of the entire mundane path expounded in this section. Unruled in the view. Should be decided together with རྣམ་པ་ཅན above, since the two only ever occur as one phrase here.

p0678 l.3. The view has ཤེས་བྱ → sở tri (prov) and two scoped སྒྲིབ་པ entries (triền cái for nīvaraṇa at p0085; chướng for the general āvaraṇa sense), but no entry for the jñeyāvaraṇa compound. 'sở tri chướng' is the established Sino-Vietnamese rendering; kept. A scoped compound entry is what is missing.

p0677 l.1, རྣལ་འབྱོར་གྱི་གནས་བཞི་པའི་འགོར → 'ở đoạn đầu của Du-già Xứ thứ tư'. No ruling for the citation unit (the internal division of the Śrāvakabhūmi). The view's རྣལ་འབྱོར → du-già and ཉན་ས → Thanh Văn Địa are both honoured; only the unit name is unruled.
p0678 l.3, ཞི་གནས་གསལ་བ་དང་མི་རྟོག་པ་ལ་སོགས་པའི་ཁྱད་པར. Its partner མི་རྟོག་པ → không phân biệt IS ruled in the view and is honoured; གསལ་བ as a quality of śamatha has no entry. Kept.

p0624 (×2), p0625, p0626. GAP — no entry for བྱ་ར in glossary.json. The recurring verb of this passage: the periodic 'keeping watch' over whether the mind still holds the object. Rendered 'canh xét' (and 'xem xét canh chừng' where it heads the compound བྱ་ར་བྱེད་པའི་ལྟ་རྟོག at p0626). Kept verbally distinct from ཤེས་བཞིན = tỉnh giác and from དཔྱད་པ/བརྟག་པ = khảo sát/xét, all of which occur in the same paragraphs.

p0624 l.1. Built from the glossary's བསྟེན་པ = 'nương tựa' (compound sense) plus the ལུགས of the already-registered སྐྱོང་ལུགས = 'cách thức duy trì'. Kept distinct from སྐྱོང་ཚུལ / སྐྱོང་ལུགས = 'cách thức gìn giữ', which occurs three lines later in the same chunk (དྲན་པའི་སྐྱོང་ཚུལ, p0625).

terms.vi: bản thích luận của *Trung Biên Luận*
terms.note: p0625. Uses the registered provisional དབུས་མཐའ = 'Trung Biên Luận'. འགྲེལ་བཤད rendered 'thích luận' on the precedent of ཕར་ཕྱིན་གྱི་འགྲེལ་བཤད་ཚིག་གསལ་བ = 'Minh Cú (bộ thích luận về Ba-la-mật)', deliberately NOT 'bản Thích', which glossary.json fixes on འགྲེལ་པ (c021) and which c187 uses several times in these very pages for a different commentary. If the project prefers one word for both, this needs a sweep, not a c188 edit.

p0625, twice inside the Śrāvakabhūmi quotation (སེམས་རྩེ་གཅིག་པ་ཉིད, དགེ་བའི་སེམས་རྩེ་གཅིག་པ་ཉིད). Follows the registered སེམས་རྩེ་གཅིག་པ = 'tâm chuyên nhất'; the ཉིད makes it the abstract quality being defined, hence 'tính chuyên nhất của tâm' rather than 'tâm chuyên nhất'.

terms.vi: rời [thời thiền] khi [nó] còn đang tốt
terms.note: p0626. GAP, no entry, and the compound is rare. Read as བཟང་ (good) + གྱེས་ (to part) — parting from the session while it is still going well, which is what the following clause requires (རྟིང་མ་རེས་ཀྱང་བསྒོམ་པ་ལ་བྲོད = one is glad of meditation in later sessions too). See flags.

p0626, inside the *Bhāvanākrama* III quotation ཆུ་ཚོད་གཅིག་གམ་མེལ་ཚེ་ཐུན་ཕྱེད་དམ་ཐུན་གཅིག. མེལ་ཚེ = a night-watch; ཐུན་ཕྱེད = half a period. Rendered 'nửa thời canh', with ཐུན་གཅིག following it as 'một thời khóa' per the glossary's ཐུན = thời khóa. See flags — the three time-units in this quotation are not certain.

p0624. No bare entry; follows the registered ངར་ཐོན་པ = 'mang sức mạnh trỗi lên' (p0620/p0622) and གསལ་ཆའི་ངར = 'sức mạnh của phần sáng tỏ', so the same element reads the same way three pages apart. ཤུགས rendered 'cái thế', as in c187.

l.43, དྲན་པ་དང་ཤེས་བཞིན་གྱི་སྐྱོང་ལུགས. Text KEPT as 'cách thức gìn giữ chánh niệm và tỉnh giác'. The view carries two provisional entries that split one verb: སྐྱོང་ཚུལ -> 'cách thức gìn giữ' (p0058) and སྐྱོང་ལུགས -> 'cách thức duy trì [định]' (p0617). ལུགས and ཚུལ are interchangeable here (both = 'the way/manner of'), so the split assigns two Vietnamese verbs to the same སྐྱོང. This chunk uses 'gìn giữ' uniformly — l.11 བསྐྱངས་པ, l.21 སྐྱོང་བ and སྐྱོང་ཚུལ, l.43 སྐྱོང་ལུགས — and reads as one term throughout. Recommend merging the two entries onto སྐྱོང -> 'gìn giữ' (with 'cách thức gìn giữ' for both ཚུལ and ལུགས), rather than editing this text; a sweep of c187/p0617 would then be needed.

p0625, twice: གདམས་ངག་ཡིད་ཀྱིས་བརྗོད (Madhyāntavibhāga-ṭīkā, in quotation) and ཡིད་ཀྱིས་དམིགས་པ་བརྗོད་པ (Tsongkhapa's gloss). No ruling in the view. Rendered 'nói ra' — deliberately plain, since ཡིད་ཀྱིས makes the utterance mental; avoid 'tuyên đọc'/'tuyên thuyết' (public proclamation) and 'trì tụng' (recitation), neither of which the verb carries. A ruling is needed because the verb recurs across the śamatha section.

terms.vi: rời [thời thiền] khi còn đang tốt
terms.note: p0626, ཐུན་ཆུང་ངེ་བའི་སྒོམ་དང་བཟང་གྱེས་བྱས་ན. No entry. Rendered as a gloss-phrase because there is no Vietnamese single term for breaking off a session while it is still going well; no compact rendering was invented.

p0626, in the Bhāvanākrama III quotation: ཆུ་ཚོད་གཅིག་གམ་མེལ་ཚེ་ཐུན་ཕྱེད — 'một giờ, hoặc nửa thời canh'. No entry. A night-watch unit of time, kept distinct from ཐུན = 'thời khóa' (fixed) which stands beside it in the same list.
p0625, དབུས་མཐའི་འགྲེལ་བཤད. No entry. Kept distinct from འགྲེལ་པ (bhāṣya/vṛtti) — this is the sub-commentary on the Madhyāntavibhāga.

p0624 final line, བློ་སྔ་མའི་ཤུགས་དང་ངར་མ་ཟད་ཙམ་ནས ... བློ་དེའི་ངར་སྐྱེས་ནས་ངར་ལྡན་ལ་གནས་པའི་ཡུན. No entry. Paired with ཤུགས ('thế') in the same phrase and needing to stay distinct from it; 'sức mạnh trỗi lên' renders the sense of forcefulness/intensity of the mind rather than 'ngã mạn', which ངར is NOT here.
p0679, the Śrāvakabhūmi list that structures c203-c204. ཡིད་ལ་བྱེད་པ = tác ý follows the registered provisional; the seven member names are listed separately below.

terms.vi: tác ý phát sinh từ lòng tin ưa
terms.note: Second of the seven, p0679 and p0680-p0681 (མཐའ་གཅིག་ཏུ་ཞི་རགས་ཀྱི་དོན་དེ་ལ་མོས་པར་བྱེད་པ). Follows the registered provisional མོས་པ = 'lòng tin ưa', whose own note says it was rendered non-technically. Here it is a technical adhimokṣa in a fixed seven-member list, where 'thắng giải' is the established Sino-Vietnamese; see flag.

terms.vi: tác ý hết sức viễn ly
terms.note: Third of the seven, p0679 and p0681 (defined as the point where the antidote to the great afflictions of the desire realm has arisen). རབ་ཏུ rendered 'hết sức'.

terms.vi: tác ý thâu nhiếp niềm hỷ
terms.note: Fourth of the seven, p0679 and p0681 (able to abandon the middling afflictions). Uses the registered provisional དགའ་བ = hỷ, whose note scopes it to the four immeasurables; a scope extension is needed, or a separate rendering.

Fifth of the seven, p0679. Uses the registered provisional དཔྱོད་པ = thẩm sát; note the corpus split flagged in that entry (c083 'quán sát' vs c125/c134 'thẩm sát') — this chunk has དཔྱོད་པ/དཔྱད་པ five more times in prose and is uniformly 'thẩm sát'.

terms.vi: tác ý gia hành cứu cánh
terms.note: Sixth of the seven, p0679, p0681. Built from the registered provisionals སྦྱོར་བ = gia hành and མཐར་ཐུག = cứu cánh.

terms.vi: tác ý quả của gia hành cứu cánh
terms.note: Seventh of the seven, p0679; identified in the prose as the manaskāra at the time of entering the ཆགས་བྲལ dngos gzhi and therefore the སྒྲུབ་བྱ.

p0681, of the first and second manaskāras — a member of the technical four-antidote list, not the free verb. Follows the registered provisional སུན་འབྱིན་པ = 'bài xích' and c104 ('ba môn học là để bài xích phiền não, để trấn áp [phiền não] hiện hành, và để đoạn trừ hạt giống tận gốc'), which is the same list. The three renderings now on record for this root (phá trừ / bài xích / đả phá) still need one ruling.

p0681, ×3 (མི་རྒྱུ་བར་མཐོང་བ་ན, མི་རྒྱུ་བ་ཡིན་ནམ, མི་རྒྱུ་བ་ཡིན). The afflictions not moving/circulating in the mind either in equipoise or on rising from it. No entry. Kept distinct from མངོན་གྱུར = hiện hành, which occurs in the same chunk.

terms.vi: thứ pha lẫn văn và tư
terms.note: p0680. Uses the registered provisional ཐོས་པ = văn; བསམ་བྱུང rendered '[trí tuệ] do tư sinh ra' following c032.
p0679, the Buddhist insider contrasted with ཕྱི་རོལ་པ. Deliberately literal rather than 'nội đạo', which the Tibetan does not say.
p0679. Absent from the c203 view; corpus precedent c005, c007.
p0680, འདི་ནི་ཉོན་མོངས་སྤོང་བ་ཐམས་ཅད་ཀྱི་རྣམ་པར་བཞག་པའོ. Corpus precedent c016/c039/c041.
p0680, ཇི་འདྲ་བ་ཞིག་གཏན་ལ་ཕབ་ནས. Corpus precedent c015; kept distinct from ངེས་པ = sự xác quyết, which stands eight lines later in the same paragraph.

terms.vi: tu xen kẽ / tu luân phiên
terms.note: p0681, of śamatha and vipaśyanā. Two different Tibetan expressions in adjacent sentences, given two different Vietnamese so they stay separable.

terms.bo: རྟེན (sense: the persons who are the basis of this path)
terms.note: p0679, འདི་ལ་རྟེན་ནི། … ཕྱི་རོལ་པ་དང༌ ཆོས་འདི་པ … གཉིས་ཀས་བསྒོམ་པ་ཡོད་དོ. Deliberately NOT 'thân y', which the registered entry scopes to the physical body-basis for practice; this is the practitioner as basis, the sense already given 'sở y' at p0461 and c153/c154.

terms.vi: phiền não lớn / phiền não bậc trung
terms.note: p0681, the graded strengths of affliction abandoned by the third and fourth manaskāras. 'bậc trung' matches the glossary's སྐྱེས་བུ་འབྲིང = bậc trung without asserting the person-sense.

Bare ལམ has no headword in the c203 view. Occurs at p0679 ལམ་ཕྱི་མ -> "đạo lộ sau" and p0680 ལམ་འདིས -> "đạo lộ này". Corpus precedent is heavy and consistent (c004, c009, c011, c018, c032, ...). Wording kept; a ruling on the bare noun is owed.

p0679 བདེན་པའི་རྣམ་པ་ཅན / ཞི་རགས་ཀྱི་རྣམ་པ་ཅན; p0680 བསྒོམ་པའི་རྣམ་པས -> "hành tướng của sự tu". The view rules only རྣམ་པ་ཐམས་ཅད་མཁྱེན་པ. Collision to settle: the view gives འཛིན་སྟངས = "cách nắm giữ" glossed [ākāra], and that entry's own note records ཡུལ་གྱི་རྣམ་པ = "hình tướng của đối [tượng]" — so རྣམ་པ now carries two Vietnamese renderings across the corpus. Wording kept here; a sense split or a single word is owed.

p0679 in the seven-attentions list (མཚན་ཉིད་སོ་སོར་རིག་པ), p0680 3x. No entry. Related variant to settle: at p0680 the source prints མཚན་ཉིད་རབ་ཏུ་རིག་པ (རབ་ཏུ, not སོ་སོར) and the translation tracked it with "sự rõ biết tột cùng các tướng" — faithful to what is printed, but it de-links the phrase from the list item. The ruling should state whether the variant is normalised to the list form or kept as printed.

p0680, ཇི་འདྲ་བ་ཞིག་གཏན་ལ་ཕབ་ནས. No entry. Collision to flag: the view's དཔྱོད་པ = "thẩm sát" note already records that "thẩm sát" is contested against ངེས་པར་རྟོག་པ = "thẩm sát quyết định", which shares "quyết". These three (གཏན་ལ་ཕབ, དཔྱོད་པ, ངེས་པར་རྟོག་པ) should be ruled together so the Vietnamese keeps them separable.

terms.vi: thứ pha lẫn văn và tư / [trí tuệ] do tư sinh ra
terms.note: p0680, ...རེས་འགའ་ཐོས་པ་དང་རེས་འགའ་བསམ་བྱུང་དུ་འགྱུར་བས་ཐོས་བསམ་འདྲེས་མའོ. The view rules only ཐོས་པ = "văn" (prov); the văn/tư/tu triad compounds (ཐོས་བྱུང / བསམ་བྱུང / སྒོམ་བྱུང, ཐོས་བསམ་འདྲེས་མ) are unruled. Note also that the source writes the elliptical ཐོས་པ where the parallel demands ཐོས་བྱུང, and the translation supplies the ellipsis in brackets ("[trí tuệ] do văn [sinh ra]") — kept as printed, flagged rather than normalised.

p0654 l.7 sa-bcad heading ཞི་གནས་གྲུབ་པ་དང་མ་གྲུབ་པའི་ས་མཚམས་བསྟན་པ. First genuine occurrence in the corpus (the three earlier grep hits at p0017/p0121/p0299 are ཕྱོགས་མཚམས and མཚམས་སྦྱོར, different words). The 'boundary line' between attained and unattained śamatha. 'ranh giới' already used in c086/c091 for other boundary expressions.

p0654 l.9, ཡིད་བྱེད་དང་ལྡན་པའི་རྟགས་དོགས་གཅོད་དང་བཅས་པ. First occurrence in the corpus (recurs at p0701, p0702, p0905, all in later chunks), so a ruling here governs those. Kept literal; 'trừ nghi' would be shorter but is not established anywhere in the corpus.

terms.vi: thể nhập một cách nhậm vận
terms.note: p0654 l.11. No entry. 任運 'nhậm vận' chosen for ལྷུན་གྲུབ (effortless / spontaneously accomplished). The term also occurs on p0648 (c194, not yet translated) in the forms ལྷུན་གྲུབ་ཏུ་རང་གི་ངང་གིས་འཇུག and ལྷུན་གྱིས་གྲུབ་པར་འཇུག་པ, so the ruling should cover ལྷུན་གྲུབ / ལྷུན་གྱིས་གྲུབ་པ together and keep it distinct from རང་གི་ངང་གིས / རང་ཤུགས་ཀྱིས.

p0657 l.1, སེམས་མི་རྟོག་པར་རང་ཤུགས་ཀྱིས་འགྲོ. 'of its own force'. No entry. Should be ruled together with ལྷུན་གྲུབ and རང་གི་ངང་གིས (p0648), which currently would all collapse onto 'tự nhiên' in Vietnamese.

p0656 l.3, ×3 (incl. the negative མཉམ་པར་མ་བཞག་པའི་ས = 'địa không nhập đẳng dẫn'). Built on the registered provisional མཉམ་པར་བཞག་པ = 'nhập đẳng dẫn'. Note c187 renders མཉམ་པར་འཇོག་པ / སྙོམས་འཇུག as 'đẳng chí', so 'đẳng dẫn' and 'đẳng chí' now sit two pages apart for different Tibetan words — that is correct but should be recorded.

p0657 l.1, the technical name Tsongkhapa gives to the pre-khinh-an samādhi. Rendered per the registered སེམས་རྩེ་གཅིག་པ = 'tâm chuyên nhất'. The Maulī Bhūmi quotation on p0656 names the same thing as འདོད་པའི་ཁམས་ཀྱི་རྩེ་གཅིག་པ་ཉིད, which per the registered རྩེ་གཅིག་པ = 'sự nhất tâm' came out as 'sự nhất tâm của Dục giới'. Two glossary entries thus split one technical designation across two Vietnamese phrasings within twenty lines — see flag.
p0655 l.1, in the Mahāyānasūtrālaṃkāra verse ཤིན་ཏུ་སྦྱངས་པ་ཆེ་ཐོབ་ནས. Follows the registered ཤིན་ཏུ་སྦྱངས་པ = khinh an; ཆེ kept as a plain adjective, not expanded.

p0655 l.1 (MSA verse) and p0654 l.9 (sa-bcad). The technical designation for the practitioner who has crossed into actual śamatha — Tsongkhapa glosses it explicitly: ཡིད་ལ་བྱེད་པ་ནི་སྐབས་འདིར་ཞི་གནས་ལ་ཟེར་བ. Built on the registered ཡིད་ལ་བྱེད་པ = tác ý. Note the sa-bcad form uses ལྡན་པ and the verse form uses བཅས་པ; both rendered 'có đủ tác ý'.

p0657 l.1, as the four སྤྱོད་ལམ (= oai nghi, registered). Rendered literally rather than with the conventional Sino-Vietnamese set 'đi, đứng, nằm, ngồi', because འཆག is 'to walk / pace', not 'to stand' — see flag.

terms.vi: thể nhập một cách hoan hỷ thỏa thích
terms.note: p0657 l.3, last clause of the chunk (runs on into p0658). No entry. Kept distinct from དགའ་བ = hỷ (registered for the four immeasurables) and from དགའ་བདེ = hỷ lạc (registered).

terms.vi: trầm một và trạo cử / trầm một / trạo cử
terms.note: L30, `བྱིང་རྒོད་ཕྲ་མོ` -> 'trầm một và trạo cử vi tế' (p0654 l.11). The view carries no ruling for the pair at all, although it is the spine of the whole śamatha division; c187-c190 and c195 already use 'trầm một' and 'trạo cử' consistently and c196 matches that precedent. Wording kept. Should be registered as a pair, with the compound `བྱིང་རྒོད` and the two members each covered.

L49 (p0655 l.2), the eight abandoning-formations of the Madhyāntavibhāga. The view's `འདུ་བྱེད` entry is itself marked GAP and is scoped to the saṃskāraduḥkhatā verse at p0294, so this compound has no ruling. Wording kept. A ruling should cover `འདུ་བྱེད` in this Madhyāntavibhāga sense and keep it distinct from the duḥkhatā use.

L36, in the Kinh Trang Nghiêm Luận verse `དེ་གོམས་པ་ལས་འདུ་མི་བྱེད།` (p0655 l.1). Third Vietnamese word for the འདུ་བྱེད root within nine lines ('hành' at L49, 'hiện hành' at L47, 'tạo tác' here). Wording kept as verse; a ruling should decide whether the negated verb takes 'không còn hiện hành' to unify the root, or is deliberately distinguished.

p0643 l.3 (རྫུ་འཕྲུལ་གྱི་རྐང་པའམ་གནས) and p0645 ×3. The established Sino-Vietnamese 神足 for the four ṛddhipādas. Load-bearing here because p0645 spells out the etymology (རྐང་པ་དང་འདྲ་བས་རྫུ་འཕྲུལ་གྱི་རྐང་པ་ཡིན = 'vì giống như cái chân nên là chân của thần biến'), so the compound and its bare head must not share one Vietnamese word.

p0643 l.3 verse and p0644 l.1 prose, as the fourth and fifth of the five faults. Kept compatible with c181's fixed 'tám hành đoạn trừ' for སྤོང་བའི་འདུ་བྱེད་བརྒྱད (the eight remain 'hành'), but the two faults needed a verbal noun that reads in Vietnamese. A ruling should say whether the eight and the two take one word or two.
p0644 l.1, twice: once as the fifth fault, once as the antidote to འདུ་མི་བྱེད་པ. Built from the registered provisional སེམས་པ = 'tư' (cetanā) plus 'tác hành' above.

p0643 l.1 (×3) and p0644 l.1 (རྣལ་དུ་འཇོག་པའི་བཏང་སྙོམས). This is a FOURTH sense beside the three already recorded (ཚོར་བ་བཏང་སྙོམས = 'cảm thọ xả'; the immeasurable = 'tâm xả'; ཚད་མེད་བཏང་སྙོམས = 'xả vô lượng'). Rendered with the base glossary word 'xả'. Note p0642 (c192, same section) names all three kinds and settles on འདུ་བྱེད་བཏང་སྙོམས, so c192 and c193 must end up with the same word; 'hành xả' (行捨) is the alternative if a distinguishing form is wanted.

p0645 l.1, མཚན་ཉིད་ཀྱི་ཐེག་པའི་སྒོས་ཆོས. No corpus precedent (grep over translation/ finds none). Built on the registered provisional མཚན་ཉིད = 'tướng' and the ཐེག་པ་ཆེན་པོ = 'Đại thừa' pattern. 'Ba-la-mật thừa' was NOT used: that is already the corpus rendering of ཕ་རོལ་ཏུ་ཕྱིན་པའི་ཐེག་པ (c009), a different Tibetan phrase.
p0645 l.1. Follows the corpus use of 'bất cộng' for སྒོས / ཐུན་མོང་མ་ཡིན་པ (c007, c009), and pairs correctly with the registered ཐུན་མོང་བ = 'cộng thông', which occurs twice in the same sentence.

p0643 l.3 — the FULL Tibetan title, where c181's four occurrences are all the abbreviated དབུས་མཐའ. One Vietnamese title used for both, per the short-vs-full-title policy the ཀུན་ལས་བཏུས / འཇུག་པ notes already propose. If the project instead prefers the full Sino-Vietnamese *Biện Trung Biên Luận*, c181 and c193 sweep together. The verse couplet གནས་དང་དེ་ལ་གནས་པ་དང༌། །རྒྱུ་དང་འབྲས་བུ་ཉིད་དུ་འོ། is quoted in both chunks and is rendered here word-for-word as c181 renders it.

p0645 l.1, དཔལ་སམྦུ་ཊིའི་བརྟག་པ་དང་པོའི་རབ་བྱེད་གཉིས་པ = 'chương thứ hai thuộc phần khảo sát thứ nhất của *Saṃpuṭi* vinh quang'. No entry for either division name. They will recur wherever a tantra is cited by locus.

p0645 l.1, twice: inside the Saṃpuṭi quotation (ཤིན་ཏུ་ཞུམ་པ་དང་གཟེངས་མཐོ་བ་མ་ཡིན་པར) and in Tsongkhapa's gloss, which equates ཤིན་ཏུ་གཟེངས་མཐོ་བ with བསྒྲིམས་དྲགས་པ = 'gắng siết quá mức' (c187's wording). Paired opposite to ཞུམ་པ, for which the śamatha-sense provisional 'thối lui' was used, likewise following c187.

p0645 l.1, twice (དཔྱོད་པའི་ཏིང་ངེ་འཛིན). Follows the by-chunk provisional དཔྱོད་པ = 'thẩm sát'. Note the established Sino-Vietnamese name of this ṛddhipāda is 'quán thần túc', i.e. 'quán' — which is unavailable here, being fixed to ལྷག་མཐོང. Whoever closes the open དཔྱད/དཔྱོད ruling (c083 'quán sát' vs c125/c134 'thẩm sát') should scope this technical occurrence explicitly.

p0644 l.1, ལམ་རིམ་པའི་བླ་མ་གོང་མ་རྣམས = 'các bậc thượng sư tiền bối thuộc [dòng] Đạo Thứ Đệ'. The agentive ལམ་རིམ་པ (an adherent of the lamrim tradition) is unregistered; interacts with the open bare-ལམ་རིམ question (specific work vs genre).

terms.vi: đi vào / đặt vào trạng thái tự nhiên
terms.note: p0643 l.3 verse (ཞི་ཚེ་རྣལ་དུ་འཇུག་པ་འོ) and p0644 l.1 prose (རྣལ་དུ་འཇོག་པའི་བཏང་སྙོམས). No entry. p0642 (c192) has the cognate རྣལ་དུ་འབབ་པ inside the Śrāvakabhūmi definition of equanimity, so the two chunks should take one family of wording.

terms.bo: བཏང་སྙོམས (śamatha sense: the eighth application-of-abandonment, རྣལ་དུ་འཇོག་པའི་བཏང་སྙོམས)
terms.note: GAP, not a violation. The view's བཏང་སྙོམས -> 'xả' is scoped by its own note to ཚོར་བ་བཏང་སྙོམས (the neutral FEELING), and བཏང་སྙོམས -> 'tâm xả' is scoped to the immeasurable / seven-cause-and-effect sense. Neither covers upekṣā as the eighth of the འདུ་བྱེད་བརྒྱད here (c193 L13, L15, L17 on p0643, and L40 རྣལ་དུ་འཇོག་པའི་བཏང་སྙོམས on p0644). Rendering 'xả' KEPT: internally consistent and matches c196 on the same passage. A third scoped entry is owed, to be settled together with the ཚད་མེད་བཏང་སྙོམས / བཏང་སྙོམས་པ collision already flagged at p0373.

p0635, twice: དཔྱད་ནས་སྤྲོས་ནའང་བྱིང་བ་ལྡོག and དམིགས་པ་རྒྱ་བསྐྱེད་ནས་སྤྲོས་པས་ལྡོག་པ. The glossary registers སྤྲོས་པ = 'hí luận' (prapañca, p0308) — that sense is positively wrong here: this is the deliberate widening/elaborating of the meditative object as the antidote to trầm một. Requesting a scoped second entry so the Phase 5 sweep does not read it as drift.

p0635, Madhyamakahṛdaya verse ཡངས་པ་ཉིད་དུ་བྱ. The registered ཡངས་པ = 'rộng lớn' (p0559, in ཤེས་རབ་ཡངས་པ) could not be used here because རྒྱ་ཆེན in the SAME pada is already 'rộng lớn'; two distinct Tibetan words would have collapsed onto one Vietnamese word inside two lines of verse. Ruling needed.

p0635, the 'pitch/height' of the mode of apprehension, whose lowering defines བྱིང་བ. Coined to sit beside c187's already-used 'cái thế vươn cao của tâm giác tri' for རིག་པའི་གཟེངས, so the two stay visibly related. No entry exists.
p0635, རིག་པ་སིང་ཡེར་གྱིས་འགྲོ་བ — an onomatopoeic adverb for vivid alertness. No entry.

p0635, གཉིད་ཡུར་བའི་གདོང་དུ་ཆུ་གྲང་མོ་བཏབ་ན. Read as 'one who is dozing off / falling asleep'. See flags — ཡུར་བ is registered in the glossary only as 'con mương' (irrigation channel, p0585), which cannot be the sense here, and I could not confirm the compound.
p0636, སངས་རྒྱས་དང་ཆོས་དང་དགེ་འདུན་དང་ཚུལ་ཁྲིམས་དང་གཏོང་བ་དང་ལྷ་རྗེས་སུ་དྲན་པ་དྲུག. No entry for the set.

terms.bo: གཏོང་བ (as the fifth of the six recollections)
terms.note: p0636. Uses the 'buông xả' branch of the recorded three-way split of གཏོང་བ (abstract relinquishment of one's own possessions), NOT 'bố thí'. Note the established Sino-Vietnamese for this recollection is 'niệm thí'; a ruling should say whether the six-recollection list takes the standard set or stays componential.
p0636, as the སྤྱོད་ལམ (oai nghi) prescribed against trầm một. No entry.

terms.bo: སྲབ་པ / འཐུག་པ (of trầm một and of the dark aspect)
terms.note: p0636, four occurrences as a contrasted pair (བྱིང་བ་ཤིན་ཏུ་སྲབ་པ, བྱིང་བ་འཐུག་པ, རྣམ་པ་སྲབ་འཐུག་གང་རུང). Deliberately NOT the glossary's སྲབ = 'dây cương' (the bridle of the p0060 simile), a different word.
p0636. Aligned to c187's 'gắng siết' family for the taut/slack axis; no entry exists.
p0636, ཏིང་ངེ་འཛིན་བསྒོམ་པའི་འཕྲོ་བཤོལ. No entry.
p0637, Śrāvakabhūmi list of light-sources. Kept distinct from the glossary's ཕུང་པོ = 'uẩn' (skandha), which would be nonsense here.
p0637. Deliberately NOT the glossary's དཀྱིལ་འཁོར = 'mạn-đà-la': here it is the solar disc.

p0638, five occurrences, as one half of the technical pair below. Built from the registered འཇོག = 'an trú' plus རབ་ཏུ = 'trọn vẹn' so the pair stays parallel in Vietnamese. See flags — the established Sino-Vietnamese for this Śrāvakabhūmi pair may be 'chỉ tướng' / 'cử tướng', which a ruling should settle.
p0638, six occurrences, incl. རབ་ཏུ་འཛིན་པའི་མཚན་མ. Built from the registered འཛིན་སྟངས = 'cách nắm giữ'. Must be decided together with རབ་ཏུ་འཇོག་པ above.

terms.vi: không có sự tạo tác của tâm
terms.note: p0637, Bhāvanākrama I: སེམས་མངོན་པར་འདུ་བྱེད་པ་མེད་པར་འཇུག་པ. The glossary registers མངོན་པར་འདུ་བྱེད་པ = 'hiện hành' (p0229, a mode of karmic weight); 'không có sự hiện hành' would not carry the effortlessness sense here (the standard Sino-Vietnamese is 'vô công dụng'). Scoped ruling requested.
p0638. No entry; consistent with the rope/elephant imagery already used in c187.
p0638, Madhyamakahṛdaya verse གཡེངས་པ་གཡེངས་པའི་མཚན་མ་ལ. Follows c187, which renders the near-synonym རྣམ་གཡེང as 'sự tán loạn'; bare གཡེངས་པ has no entry.

terms.vi: hướng vào trong / hướng ra ngoài
terms.note: p0636, སེམས་གང་ལ་བཟུང་བའི་ཁ་ནང་ལྟ་དང་ཕྱིར་ལྟའི་དམིགས་པ. No entry.

terms.vi: các bộ pháp của đức Di-lặc
terms.note: p0666 l.1, བྱམས་ཆོས་ནས་གསུངས་པ་རྣམས — the Maitreya treatises as a corpus, contrasted with what Asaṅga commented on. NO entry. Distinct from the person entry བྱམས་པ = Di-lặc and from the maitrī entry བྱམས་པ = từ. Note the trap: the only other corpus occurrence, p0381 བྱམས་ཆོས་ཡོན་ཏན་བརྒྱད, is byams pa'i chos = the eight qualities of loving-kindness, a completely different word. A ruling must scope the two apart, or a Phase 5 sweep will conflate them. 'Từ Thị chư luận' would be an alternative if a Sino-Vietnamese form is preferred.

terms.vi: cắt đứt đến tận ngọn nguồn
terms.note: p0666, ལྟ་བའི་ཕུ་ཐག་བཅད་ནས — to settle the view definitively, to its very limit (lit. 'cut the head of the valley'). No entry; also occurs p0689 and p0942, both untranslated, so a ruling now would cover all three.

p0668 ×2, inside and after the Prajñāpāramitopadeśa citation; also p0656 (c196, untranslated). The text glosses it itself: ཡིད་ཀྱི་བརྗོད་པ་ནི་འདི་ནི་འདིའོ་ཞེས་རྣམ་པར་རྟོག་པའོ, so the Sino-Vietnamese 意言 'ý ngôn' is carried by its own gloss in the very next sentence. A plainer 'lời nói của ý' / 'sự thốt lời của ý' is the alternative; a ruling is needed before c196 is translated.

p0667, in the Śrāvakabhūmi negation series རྣམ་པར་ལྟ་བར་མི་བྱེད...ཡོངས་སུ་དཔྱོད་པར་མི་བྱེད. Only corpus occurrence. The four terms that follow it are all already fixed by c175 (phân biện / phân biện tột cùng / chu biến tầm tư / chu biến thẩm sát), so this first member is the one gap in an otherwise settled list. 'quán xem' was chosen to stay clear of 'quán sát' (= དཔྱོད་པ/དཔྱད་པ in the corpus) and of 'kiến' (= ལྟ་བ as the ninth item of c175's vipaśyanā list).

p0667, inside the Śrāvakabhūmi quotation: མཚན་མ་...ཉེ་བའི་ཉོན་མོངས་པ་དག་གིས་སྣང་བར་འགྱུར་སྒོ་སྟོན་པར་འགྱུར་དམིགས་པར་བྱེད་པར་འགྱུར་ན. See the flag: the three verbs' agency is ambiguous and the middle one has no entry.

p0668, in the first Bhāvanākrama citation ཞི་གནས་ཐམས་ཅད་ཀྱི་སྤྱིའི་མཚན་ཉིད. Matches c091 line 28 ('tướng chung của phiền não', p0295) so the corpus is consistent, but nothing is recorded. Registering it also settles one instance of the open མཚན་ཉིད = tướng / định nghĩa split noted in decisions.md: here the sense is arguably 'the general definition', and 'tướng chung' was chosen to follow c091 rather than to decide that question.

p0666, in the list ...དམིགས་མེད་དམ་མཚན་མེད་དམ་སྟོང་པ་ཉིད་ལ་བསམ་གཏན་པའོ. Follows c134's 'vô sở duyên' (p0435, hết thảy các pháp đều vô sở duyên; bố thí vô sở duyên) and the registered དམིགས་པ = sở duyên. Unrecorded.
p0666, same list. Built on the registered provisional མཚན་མ = 'tướng' (nimitta); 'vô tướng' also matches c041's du-già vô tướng. Unrecorded.
p0668, གཞུང་ཚད་ལྡན་རྣམས་ནས་གསུངས་པས. Composed from the two registered provisionals གཞུང = 'bản văn' and ཚད་ལྡན = 'bậc có thẩm quyền'; recorded so the compound is not read as drift.
p0666, ལྟ་བ་ཡོད་དམ་མེད་ཀྱང་བླ་ཡི — 'never mind whether or not'. Idiomatic concessive, four other corpus occurrences (p0341, p0477, p0483). No entry.

Missing house-style ruling on the Vietnamese honorific classifier before names of Indian masters. The FIXED entries give the bare names (ཐོགས་མེད -> 'Vô Trước', བྱམས་པ -> 'Di-lặc') but say nothing about ngài/đức, so the checker had to log c199 L11 as an unlicensed addition. It is settled practice, not drift: c123 L17 renders demonstrably bare Tibetan (p0401: `དང་ཐོགས་མེད་ནས`, `...བྱམས་པ་ད...`, no རྗེ་བཙུན) as 'đức Di-lặc và ngài Vô Trước', and that chunk passed its fidelity check; 'ngài Vô Trước' stands in 8 chunks (c006, c123, c129, c133, c162, c199, c200, c205) and 'đức Di-lặc' in 5 (c008, c123, c199, c200, c205). Where the Tibetan does carry the honorific (རྗེ་བཙུན་བྱམས་པ) the corpus escalates to 'đức Chí Tôn Di-lặc' (c005, c032, c110), so the two levels are already distinguished. Suggested ruling: in commentary prose the classifier ngài/đức is supplied as Vietnamese register and is not treated as added reverence; inside quotations the vocative stays bare ('Này Di-lặc' — c016, c077, c106, c133). If the ruling goes the other way it needs a sweep of all 8 chunks, not a strip of c199 alone.

terms.vi: quán sát (L23) vs thẩm sát (L13, L17)
terms.note: The existing `prov དཔྱོད་པ -> thẩm sát` entry already requests this ruling and records the corpus as split (c083 'quán sát', incl. དཔྱད་སྒོམ = 'tu theo lối quán sát', vs c125/c134 'thẩm sát'). c199 reproduces the split inside one chunk because each occurrence follows the precedent of its own collocation: L23 `དཔྱད་ནས་སྐྱོང་བ་མེད་པར་འཇོག་པའི་སྒོམ` (p0668 l.1) -> 'không có việc duy trì sau khi quán sát' pairs with the corpus-standard འཇོག་པའི་སྒོམ -> 'tu theo lối an trụ' (c011/c032/c033/c034/c174), i.e. the འཇོག་སྒོམ / དཔྱད་སྒོམ opposition; L17 `ཡོངས་སུ་དཔྱོད་པར་མི་བྱེད` (p0667 l.3) sits in the Śrāvakabhūmi list beside the registered ཡོངས་སུ་རྟོག་པ -> 'chu biến tầm tư', and L13 `མི་དཔྱོད་པར` (p0666 l.3, ×2) matches it. Both wordings kept pending the single ruling; when it lands, c083, c125, c134 and c199 must be swept together.

p0666 l.3. The registered provisional is `བདེ་བ -> lạc [sukha]`, with no note on the collocation with གསལ་བ. Not a violation: the entry is prov, not fixed, and the registered `བདེ་གསལ་མི་རྟོག་པ -> 'an lạc, sáng tỏ, không phân biệt'` (used correctly at c199 L31, p0668 l.1) supplies 'an lạc' for exactly this pairing — the contracted བདེ་གསལ and the uncontracted བདེ་བ་དང་གསལ་བ are the same collocation inside the same śamatha argument. Wording kept. The བདེ་བ entry should record that in the ཞི་གནས experience context, paired with གསལ་བ, it takes 'an lạc', while bare sukha elsewhere stays 'lạc'.

p0658 l.1 and p0660 l.1, cited twice for the definitions of bodily and mental karmaṇyatā and for bodily praśrabdhi as a tangible. བློ་བརྟན is the contraction of བློ་གྲོས་བརྟན་པ = Sthiramati; 安慧 'An Huệ' is the established Sino-Vietnamese name. Absent from glossary.json; the only other corpus hits for བློ་བརྟན (p0516, p0541) are the ordinary verb 'make the mind firm', not the name. སློབ་དཔོན = 'A-xà-lê' per the registered provisional. See flags: the identification is an inference from the name, not something the Tibetan states.

p0660 l.1, ལུས་ཀྱི་ནང་གི་རེག་བྱ་ཆེས་ཡིད་དུ་འོང་བ and ལུས་ཀྱི་རེག་བྱའི་ཁྱད་པར. No entry of any kind for རེག་བྱ or རེག་པ. The point of the passage is precisely that bodily khinh an is a རེག་བྱ (an object of touch) and NOT a སེམས་བྱུང (tâm sở), so the two words must stay visibly distinct in Vietnamese.

p0661 l.1, 4×, the technical status a meditator enters on attaining śamatha. Built on the registered ཡིད་ལ་བྱེད་པ = 'tác ý'; rendered plainly rather than with the Sino-Vietnamese 有作意 'hữu tác ý'. A ruling should pick one, since the phrase recurs as a heading term in the next chunk (ཡིད་བྱེད་དང་ལྡན་པའི་རྟགས).

p0661 l.1, inside the Śrāvakabhūmi quotation, qualifying མཉམ་པར་བཞག་པའི་ས་པའི་ཡིད་ལ་བྱེད་པ. No entry. Rendered from the components rather than with the compact 'Sắc giới hệ'; a ruling is wanted because the parallel འདོད་པ་ན་སྤྱོད་པ / གཟུགས་མེད་ན་སྤྱོད་པ will recur.

p0661 l.3, first of the four marks of possessing attention. Uses ས = 'địa' (glossary provisional) and བསྡུས་པ = 'được nhiếp', matching བསྡུས་པ in བསམ་གཏན་དང་པོའི་ཉེར་བསྡོགས་ཀྱིས་བསྡུས་པ two lines earlier.

terms.vi: hành tướng của cái tĩnh và cái thô
terms.note: p0661 l.3, the very last words of this chunk — the sentence is cut mid-phrase and continues in c198. No entry. Rendered literally and deliberately NOT collapsed into the technical 'thô tĩnh tướng' of the mundane path, since this chunk does not yet say what the pair qualifies. ཞི་བ here is kept apart from the registered ཞི་བ = 'tịch tĩnh' (śānta as a quality) and from ཞི་གནས. c198 should settle it.

p0659 l.3. Follows the registered རླུང་ལས་སུ་རུང་བ = 'sự kham nhậm của khí' (p0582) and keeps རླུང = 'khí' rather than the breath-sense 'hơi thở' registered for c184, because here it is the wind circulating through the body, not the breath as meditation object.
p0660 l.1, inside the Śrāvakabhūmi quotation. Uses the registered འབྱུང་བ = 'đại chủng' and རླུང = 'khí'.
p0658 l.1, inside the Sthiramati quotation. glossary.json has ཚུལ་བཞིན་ཡིད་ལ་བྱེད་པ = 'như lý tác ý' (yoniśomanaskāra), a different Tibetan word; registered separately so the two do not merge.
p0658 l.1, the definition of bodily karmaṇyatā in the Sthiramati quotation (and already at p0657 l.3, ལུས་ལྡང་བ་ཡང་བ). No entry.

terms.vi: đầu não nặng nề trì trệ / cái hiện ra là đầu nặng nề
terms.note: p0659 l.1, ×2 (Tsongkhapa's prose and the Śrāvakabhūmi quotation it glosses) — the physical omen of pliancy. Deliberately kept distinct from the registered ཀླད་པ་ཚ་ཀམ་ཀམ་པ = 'đầu não nóng ran' (p0174). བེམ་པ has no entry; 'trì trệ' is a guess at the register, see flags.
p0660 l.3, the fading/flickering mental joy that reverses before śamatha proper is attained. No entry; only occurrence of the reduplicated form in the corpus. See flags.
p0661 l.1, once in Tsongkhapa's prose (ཆུད་པ) and once in the Śrāvakabhūmi quotation (འགྲོ་བ). Rendered with one Vietnamese phrase because the quotation is what the prose is paraphrasing.

terms.bo: དགའ་བ (prīti — the joy of praśrabdhi / dhyāna, not muditā)
terms.note: Wording KEPT, per the check's own finding. View lines 274/280 register དགའ་བ -> hỷ but both notes scope that to the four-immeasurables sequence བྱམས་པ / སྙིང་རྗེ / དགའ་བ / བཏང་སྙོམས, and line 274 states outright that bare དགའ་བ has no entry. In c197 the term is the joy accompanying khinh an and śamatha (p0659 l.1 སྤོང་བ་ལ་དགའ་བ, p0660 l.1 དགའ་བས་ཟིན་ན, p0660 l.3 སེམས་དགའ་བ / སེམས་མཆོག་ཏུ་དགའ་བ, p0661 l.1 སེམས་དགའ་བ གང་ཡིན་པ), rendered 'hoan hỷ' at L27, L29, L35, L39, L43, L45 and 'niềm hân hoan' once for the compounded མངོན་པར་དགའ་བ at L45. A ruling should register the bare prīti sense separately from muditā = hỷ, and say whether མངོན་པར་དགའ་བ (abhirati) gets its own word — this chunk keeps 'hân hoan hiển lộ' so it stays distinct from plain དགའ་བ.

Wording KEPT. This is exactly the collision the view's line 135 note already flags as unresolved: 'tướng' is also the provisional Vietnamese for མཚན་ཉིད (lakṣaṇa), which occurs twice in this same chunk (L27 མཚན་ཉིད་ཡོངས་སུ་རྫོགས -> 'trọn vẹn các tướng', p0659 l.1; L29 གནོད་པའི་མཚན་ཉིད -> 'tướng của sự tổn hại', p0659 l.1). Two distinct Tibetan terms collapse onto one Vietnamese word inside four pages. The pair རྟགས་དང་མཚན་མ is itself the difficulty: རྟགས is rendered 'dấu hiệu', so a ruling must give མཚན་མ a word that is neither 'dấu hiệu' nor the same as མཚན་ཉིད. The suggestion already on record (མཚན་མ nimitta = 'tướng'; མཚན་ཉིད lakṣaṇa = 'đặc tướng' / 'định nghĩa') would resolve this chunk cleanly.

Raised BY this repair. Complying with the registered བདེ་བ -> lạc forced a periphrasis: ཉམས་བདེ་བ is arguably a single compound ('at ease, comfortable') rather than ཉམས + བདེ་བ, and the resulting 'tâm hết sức có cảm nghiệm lạc' is heavier than the Vietnamese wants. ཉམས has no entry of its own in the view either, though it is rendered 'cảm nghiệm' at L43 (བདེ་བའི་ཉམས་ཆེན་པོ) and L43 (དགའ་བདེའི་ཉམས). A ruling on ཉམས, and on whether ཉམས་བདེ་བ is a compound, would let this line read naturally without departing from བདེ་བ -> lạc.

terms.vi: mang hành tướng tịnh và thô
terms.note: p0673 ×2, p0674, p0675 ×2 — the mundane path that views the lower level as coarse (རགས) and the upper as peaceful (ཞི). No entry in the chunk view and no corpus precedent (grep for 'tướng thô' / 'thô và tịnh' returns nothing). Rendered literally, keeping ཞི first as the Tibetan has it. Note the collision risk: 'tịnh' here answers to ཞི་བ (peaceful) and is NOT the 'tịnh' of tịnh chỉ = ཞི་གནས; the two stand three words apart in the same sentences, so a ruling should say whether ཞི་རགས takes 'tịnh/thô' or something like 'tĩnh/thô' to keep them visually apart.

p0673, listed with ལྷའི་སྐུ and ཡི་གེ as tantric objects of meditation. No entry and no corpus precedent (grep 'biểu tướng' / 'pháp khí' returns nothing). 'pháp khí' would over-specify (ritual implement); 'biểu tướng cầm tay' keeps the literal 'hand-emblem'. Needs a ruling.

p0675, ཅིག་ཅར་བའི་དགྲ་བཅོམ་པ — the arhat who abandons the afflictions all at once, as against the gradualist (རིམ་གྱིས་པ). No entry, no corpus precedent for either member of the pair. 'đốn' (頓) is the established Sino-Vietnamese for ཅིག་ཅར; rendered 'các bậc A-la-hán thuộc hạng đốn'. A ruling should fix ཅིག་ཅར་བ / རིམ་གྱིས་པ together, since the contrast will recur.

terms.vi: Tán Thán Không Thể Đền Đáp
terms.note: p0675, cited as བསྔགས་འོས་བསྔགས་བསྟོད་ཀྱི་ལན་མི་ལྡོན་པར་བསྟོད་པ་ལས — a subsection of the Varṇārhavarṇastotra (registered as 'Tán Thán Đấng Đáng Tán Thán'). ལན་ལྡོན་པ = to requite/repay, so 'praise of [him whose kindness] cannot be repaid'. UNSURE — see flags. Rendered without supplying 'Đấng', which would assert a person the title does not name.
p0673, in the tail of the Abhidharmakośa verse carried over from p0672. Contracted form. No entry.

p0675, in the Varṇārhavarṇastotra verse. Follows c179's 'tịnh chỉ từ chính hành của tĩnh lự thứ nhất trở lên' — the counterpart of ཉེར་བསྡོགས = 'cận phần' (registered). Registers an existing corpus usage that has no glossary entry.
p0674, ཅི་ཡང་མེད་པ་མན་ཆད. The Tibetan writes only ཅི་ཡང་མེད་པ, not ཅི་ཡང་མེད་པའི་སྐྱེ་མཆེད, so 'Xứ' is bracketed as supplied. One corpus occurrence of 'Vô Sở Hữu Xứ' exists but no entry.

p0673–p0674. The glossary view has the bare དགོངས་འགྲེལ = 'Giải Thâm Mật' (provisional); མདོ་སྡེ is explicit here, so 'Kinh' is translated rather than supplied, parallel to c180's 'Thánh Giải Thâm Mật' for འཕགས་པ་དགོངས་འགྲེལ.

No entry in the view. Corpus was split: c198, c200, c203 = 'hành tướng tịch tĩnh và thô'; c201, c202 = 'hành tướng tịnh và thô'. c201 has been moved to the majority/adjacent form (4×, p0673 l.3, p0674 l.3, p0675 l.3). Two reasons beyond majority: 'tịch tĩnh' is the settled Sino-Vietnamese for śānta, and bare 'tịnh' collides visually with 'tịnh chỉ' (`ཞི་གནས`), which stands in the same sentences under decisions.md §1. A ruling is owed on `ཞི` inside `ཞི་རགས`, and c202 still carries the other form (3× incl. a section heading) so it needs the same sweep.

terms.bo: ཁྱོད (addressed to the Buddha inside a stotra)
terms.note: p0675 l.1, `ཁྱོད་ཀྱི་ཆོས`, `ཁྱོད་ཀྱི་བསྟན་པ` — Varṇārhavarṇastotra, addressee unambiguously the Buddha. The only recorded entry is PROVISIONAL `ཁྱོད -> ngươi` (view line 271), whose own note scopes it to an UNNAMED addressee in a Nāgārjuna verse (where identity must not be asserted) and asks for a project-wide ruling. Wording KEPT — see 'remaining' for the reason. The ruling should cover three cases separately: unnamed addressee, named non-buddha addressee (the same note records lowercase 'ngài' for `ལག་ན་རྡོ་རྗེ་ཁྱོད་ཀྱིས`), and the Buddha addressed in a hymn of praise.

p0674 l.1. Reported by the checker as borderline against decisions.md §1, which licenses bare 'chỉ'/'quán' 'inside the fixed compound chỉ quán'. KEPT: both forms are inside the fixed-set viVariants, the two registers match each other (§1's actual prohibition is 'tịnh chỉ beside bare quán'), and the same sentence's `ཞི་ལྷག` = 'chỉ quán' is licensed by the registered contraction entry (view line 122). A ruling on `ཞི་ལྷག་གཉིས` — the contraction split back into a pair — would close what view line 353 already requests.
p0674 l.3, L20. No entry in the view. Wording KEPT; standard Sino-Vietnamese.
p0675 l.1, L31. No entry in the view. Wording KEPT; contrasts with the gradualist and will recur.

terms.vi: tấm che mắt của ma bị mục rữa
terms.note: p0675 l.1, inside the Varṇārhavarṇastotra verse, L28. No entry for `མིག་རས` (eye-cloth / blindfold) nor for `བཙའ` (rust / rot). Wording KEPT — rendered literally, with no interpretive expansion inside the quotation; see 'remaining' for the residual uncertainty about `བཙའ`.

terms.bo: སེམས་དགུ (the nine names as a set)
terms.vi: chín tâm: sự đặt tâm vào [sở duyên] này kia · sự đặt liên tục · sự đặt trở lại · sự đặt sát cận · sự điều phục · sự làm cho tịch tĩnh · sự làm cho tịch tĩnh hoàn toàn · sự làm cho chuyên nhất · sự đặt quân bình
terms.note: This chunk is where the book actually names all nine mental abidings (p0646-p0648), so the set should be pinned here for c195 and the whole samatha section. Each name is rendered from the Tibetan verb, not from the Chinese standard set (内住/等住/安住/近住/調順/寂靜/最極寂靜/專注一趣/等持): デ dang de la sems 'jog pa = 'sự đặt tâm vào [sở duyên] này kia'; rgyun du 'jog pa = 'sự đặt liên tục'; blan te 'jog pa = 'sự đặt trở lại'; nye bar 'jog pa = 'sự đặt sát cận'; 'dul bar byed pa = 'sự điều phục' (follows the glossary's འདུལ་བ/དུལ་བ = điều phục); zhi bar byed pa = 'sự làm cho tịch tĩnh' (follows ཞི་བ = tịch tĩnh); rnam par zhi bar byed pa = 'sự làm cho tịch tĩnh hoàn toàn'; rtse gcig tu byed pa = 'sự làm cho chuyên nhất'; mnyam par 'jog pa = 'sự đặt quân bình'. When the text later refers back to them with སེམས (p0649) I used 'tâm đặt để / tâm đặt liên tục / …' so the back-reference stays visibly the same word. If the project prefers the established Sino-Vietnamese set, that is a corpus-wide ruling and must be made before c195.

terms.vi: sáu lực: lực của văn · lực của tư · lực của niệm · lực của tỉnh giác · lực của tinh tấn · lực của sự quen thuộc trọn vẹn
terms.note: p0648 l.3 – p0649. c181 already writes 'sáu lực'; the six members themselves are named here for the first time.

terms.vi: sự quen thuộc trọn vẹn / sự quen thuộc
terms.note: p0648-p0649, the sixth of the six forces (ཡོངས་སུ་འདྲིས་པའི་སྟོབས, then bare འདྲིས་པའི་སྟོབས). No entry. Deliberately kept apart from གོམས་པ = 'thuần thục', which occurs in the very same sentences as the thing the force does (སྔ་མ་རྣམས་ལ་གོམས་པ); collapsing the two would make the definition circular in Vietnamese.

terms.bo: བསམ་པ (in the ཐོས་པ / བསམ་པ pair of the six forces)
terms.note: p0648 l.3, བསམ་པའི་སྟོབས, paired with ཐོས་པའི་སྟོབས and glossed on p0649 as ཡང་ཡང་བསམས་ནས. Rendered 'tư' so 'lực của văn / lực của tư' reads as the văn-tư-tu pair; the finite verb བསམས in the gloss is 'suy xét', per the existing provisional entry. Adds a fifth scoped sense to the already-flagged བསམ་པ tangle (ý lạc / nghĩ đến / quán xét / tự đáy lòng).

terms.vi: làm cho [tâm] thành một dòng tương tục
terms.note: p0648, the Śrāvakabhūmi name for the eighth mental abiding. Built on the glossary's རྒྱུད = 'tâm tương tục'; 'dòng tương tục' is used here because the sentence is about making the samādhi unbroken, and Tsongkhapa's own remark is that the NAME makes the meaning easy — so a transparent rendering is required.
p0648, the Śrāvakabhūmi name for the ninth mental abiding, quoted as a bare phrase (ཉན་སར་ཏིང་ངེ་འཛིན་དུ་བྱེད་པ། ཞེས་གསུངས).

terms.vi: thể nhập một cách thành tựu tự nhiên / thể nhập tự nó
terms.note: p0648, the two adverbs stand side by side twice (once in Tsongkhapa's prose, once inside the Śrāvakabhūmi quotation), so they must take two different Vietnamese words. 'thành tựu một cách tự nhiên' follows the registered ལྷུན་གྱིས་གྲུབ་པ; རང་གི་ངང་གིས has no entry and was given 'tự nó'.

terms.vi: không có hiện hành / không còn hiện hành
terms.note: p0648. Negative of the registered མངོན་པར་འདུ་བྱེད་པ = 'hiện hành'; recorded so the negated form is not re-decided elsewhere.

p0646 end, དང་པོར་དྲན་པ་ཉེ་བར་བཞག་སྟེ — here a finite verbal phrase ('first establishing mindfulness'), NOT the registered title དྲན་པ་ཉེ་བར་བཞག་པ = 'Niệm Xứ' (smṛtyupasthāna). Rendering the verb as 'Niệm Xứ' would invent a doctrinal reference the passage does not make. A scoping note on the existing entry would prevent that.

terms.vi: triền cái là sự tham muốn đối với dục lạc
terms.note: p0647. Combines the two existing provisional entries (སྒྲིབ་པ = 'triền cái' in the five-hindrances sense, འདོད་པ་ལ་འདུན་པ = 'sự tham muốn đối với dục lạc'); the nīvaraṇa sense is unambiguous here because the item is listed among ཉེ་བའི་ཉོན་མོངས.

p0647, the ten signs of the Śrāvakabhūmi gloss on the fifth abiding: the five objects (གཟུགས་སོགས་ཡུལ་ལྔ), the three poisons, male and female. The source does not spell the list out as 'ten' anywhere except in the closing back-reference མཚན་མ་བཅུ་པོ་དེ་དག, so the count is the Tibetan's own, not supplied.

terms.kind: bare term, no ruling in view
terms.note: p0648 l.3 (`ཤེས་བཞིན་གྱི་སྟོབས`) and p0649 l.1 (`ཤེས་བཞིན་གྱིས་རིག་ནས`). The view rules only the compound `དྲན་པ་དང་ཤེས་བཞིན` → 'chánh niệm và tỉnh giác'. The chunk uses 'tỉnh giác' for the bare term at L88 and L96 and it is consistent with the compound; wording KEPT. A bare-term ruling should be recorded, exactly as was requested for bare `དྲན་པ` → 'niệm'.

terms.vi: sự quen thuộc / sự quen thuộc trọn vẹn
terms.kind: no ruling; collides with two existing entries
terms.note: The sixth of the six powers, p0648 l.3 (`ཡོངས་སུ་འདྲིས་པའི་སྟོབས`) and p0649 l.1 (`འདྲིས་པའི་སྟོབས`); rendered 'lực của sự quen thuộc trọn vẹn' (L88) and 'lực của sự quen thuộc' (L100). Wording KEPT. Needs a ruling because three Vietnamese words now sit across two Tibetan words: `གོམས་པ` → 'thuần thục' (used in this chunk at L74, L80, L90, L100, including `སྔ་མ་རྣམས་ལ་གོམས་པ` in the very sentence that defines this power) and the scoped `གོམས་པ` (habituation-as-cause-of-affliction) → 'quen tập', whose note itself glosses that sense with `འདྲིས་པ`. A ruling is needed to keep the six-powers list stable across the whole śamatha section.

terms.bo: བསམ་པ (in བསམ་པའི་སྟོབས, the middle member of ཐོས/བསམ/སྒོམ)
terms.kind: sense not covered by any existing བསམ་པ ruling
terms.note: p0648 l.3 and p0649 l.1; rendered 'lực của tư' (L88, L92). The view rules `བསམ་པ` only as the noun āśaya = 'ý lạc' and in verbal senses ('nghĩ đến' / 'quán xét' / 'suy xét' / 'Quán chiếu rằng…'); none governs the văn–tư–tu triad, though the `ཐོས་པ` → 'văn' note anticipates it. Wording KEPT; record 'tư' for this sense so it stays parallel with 'văn' (L88, L90) and with `སྒོམ་པ`.

p0669, སྒོམ་རིམ་གསུམ = 'ba bộ Tu Tập Thứ Đệ'. Absent from the c200 view, but 'Tu Tập Thứ Đệ' occurs 36× in the translated corpus (quyển đầu / giữa / cuối for the three volumes). Registering the short Tibetan citation form so the view carries it.
p0669-p0672, ~9×. Corpus already has 'xuất thế gian' for འཇིག་རྟེན་ལས་འདས་པ in c-earlier chunks ('đoạn đạo xuất thế gian', 'kiến đạo xuất thế gian'), but no entry exists.
p0671, ས་འོག་མ་ལ་རགས་པར་ལྟ་བ. Kept as plain 'thô' rather than 'thô trọng' (which would render གནས་ངན་ལེན / dauṣṭhulya).

p0671. The glossary's ས = 'địa' is scoped to the bodhisattva grounds (Bodhisattvapiṭaka list); here ས is a level of the dhyāna series. Same Vietnamese, different sense — record the scope so Phase 5 does not read it as drift. Cf. the registered ཁམས་གོང་མ་གཉིས = 'hai giới trên'.

terms.vi: căn tánh chậm lụt / căn tánh nhạy bén
terms.note: p0671 (Śrāvakabhūmi quotation) and p0672 (prose). GAP: glossary.json has དབང་པོ only as sense-faculty (དབང་པོའི་སྒོ་སྡོམ་པ) and as Indra. Corpus has no 'độn căn'/'lợi căn' at all but does have 'người căn tánh hết sức chậm…', which this follows. A ruling should choose between the descriptive form used here and the compact Sino-Vietnamese 'độn căn'/'lợi căn'.
p0672 ×2 (ཟག་མེད་ཀྱི་འཕགས་ལམ, འཕགས་ལམ་མི་བསྐྱེད་པ). No entry; corpus has 'thánh đạo' twice only. Uses the glossary's ཟག་མེད = vô lậu.

terms.vi: chỉ còn cách một lần sinh nữa
terms.note: p0672 ×2, of the bodhisattva one birth from buddhahood. Rendered descriptively rather than with the Sino-Vietnamese 'nhất sinh sở hệ' because no ruling exists; either would do, but it should be fixed once.

p0672. Uses the registered སྲིད་པ = hữu. NOTE the parse: I read ཡང in ཐོགས་པ་ཡང་སྲིད་པ་ཐ་མ་པ as the particle 'also' attaching to the preceding clause; the alternative parse takes ཡང་སྲིད་པ as punarbhava (registered as 'tái hữu'), giving 'the last of rebirth'. Both yield nearly the same sense here, but the reading should be recorded.

p0672, བདེན་པ་མངོན་སུམ་དུ་རྟོགས་པའི་དགེ་རྩ. The registered མངོན་སུམ = 'hiện lượng' is the epistemic-instrument sense (p0581) and does not fit this verbal use; 'hiện chứng' (現證) is the established Sino-Vietnamese. Bare བདེན་པ rendered 'các đế', following the p0601/c184 note that prefers 'đế' over 'chân đế' (which collides with thắng nghĩa đế).

terms.vi: niềm hoan hỷ nhỏ của sự đoạn trừ
terms.note: p0670, inside the Śrāvakabhūmi quotation. The registered དགའ་བ = 'hỷ' is scoped to the four-immeasurables sequence (muditā) and does not fit; rendered non-technically. Unsure of the technical force of ཆུང་ངུ here — see flags.
p0672, Abhidharmakośa verse སྟོན་དང་བསེ་རུ. Rendered literally; deliberately NOT expanded to the registered རང་སངས་རྒྱས = 'Độc Giác', since the verse uses the image, not the term.
p0672, Abhidharmakośa verse, truncated mid-pada at the chunk boundary. Uses the registered བསམ་གཏན = tĩnh lự. The rest of the verse falls in c201, so the entry should be confirmed there.

terms.vi: bậc học giả và thành tựu giả có thẩm quyền
terms.note: p0669. Compound of མཁས་པ + གྲུབ་ཐོབ; uses the registered ཚད་ལྡན = 'bậc có thẩm quyền' and the མཁས་པ nominal sense 'bậc học giả'. Note the same page also has གཞུང་ཚད་ལྡན = 'bản văn có thẩm quyền'.
p0669, གཞུང་ཚད་ལྡན་རྣམས་ལས་ལེགས་པར་གོ་བཟློག་ནས. No entry.

p0669-p0671, ×5, the Śrāvakabhūmi technical marker for the attainment that defines accomplished śamatha (ཞི་གནས་སམ་ཡིད་བྱེད་ཐོབ་པ makes the equation explicit at p0670). Uses the registered ཡིད་ལ་བྱེད་པ = tác ý; the compound merits its own entry because it names a stage, not an act. Note the short form ཡིད་བྱེད་ also occurs.

p0671 l.3, p0672 l.1. The view's only `དབང་པོ` entries are the Indra/Śakra deity sense and sense-faculty compounds; the dull-faculty sense has no ruling. Pairs with `དབང་པོ་རྣོ` / `དབང་རྣོན` below; the two occur 4× across these two pages and recur through the mundane-path discussion.

p0671 l.3, p0672 l.1. Both the full `དབང་པོ་རྣོ` and the contracted `དབང་རྣོན` occur and c200 renders both identically; a ruling should cover the contraction explicitly so later chunks do not split them.

terms.vi: những bậc học giả và thành tựu giả có thẩm quyền
terms.note: p0669 l.1, `མཁས་གྲུབ་ཚད་ལྡན་རྣམས`. No entry for the mkhas-grub dvandva (scholar + siddha). The view's `མཁས་པ` note (lines 159/386) already flags that the nominal 'bậc học giả' vs adjectival split is unrecorded; this compound is a third context and should be settled together with it. `ཚད་ལྡན` -> 'có thẩm quyền' here, matching 'các bản văn có thẩm quyền' for `གཞུང་ཚད་ལྡན` in the same paragraph.

p0672 l.1, same verse; metrical abbreviation of `སྟོན་པ`. The corpus house form is lowercase 'đấng Đạo Sư' (42×), but the verse has no honorific particle, so the repair uses bare 'Đạo Sư'. A ruling is needed on whether the house 'đấng' is licensed inside verse where the Tibetan is bare, and on the capitalisation of 'đấng'.

p0664. The registered དྲང་སྲོང = 'đấng Đại Tiên' is scoped by its own note to the Uttaratantra verse as an epithet of the BUDDHA and would be positively wrong here, where the ṛṣis are non-Buddhists on the mundane path. Needs a scoped second entry.
p0665, དབུ་མ་པ་དང་སེམས་ཙམ་པ. The glossary has only དབུ་མ = 'Trung Quán' (the system); the agentive པ (the proponents) is unregistered.
p0665. No entry for either སེམས་ཙམ or སེམས་ཙམ་པ in the view. 'Duy Thức' has corpus precedent (c004/c009: 'kiến Duy Thức chân tướng phái').
p0664. Follows existing corpus usage ('mạn-đà-la Vô Thượng Du-già').
p0664, རྣལ་འབྱོར་བླ་མེད་ཀྱི་རྫོགས་རིམ. Follows existing corpus usage ('định của viên mãn thứ đệ', 'du-già của viên mãn thứ đệ').

terms.vi: *Tu Tập Thứ Đệ* thuộc Trung Quán
terms.note: p0664. Follows the corpus form already in use ('*Tu Tập Thứ Đệ* thuộc Trung Quán'); registered here because the Tibetan short citation with དབུ་མའི་ is not itself recorded.
p0663, a topic label introducing the objection-and-answer that follows. Rendered inline (not as a heading), since the outline records no section here. No entry.

p0662, in the Śrāvakabhūmi quotation, and again at p0661 l.7 (c197). No entry for either member in this pairing. 'tướng hiệu' follows the registered scoped མཚན་མ = 'tướng hiệu' (sign/indication) rather than the bare provisional མཚན་མ = 'tướng' (nimitta as grasped object), which would collide with མཚན་ཉིད. c197 covers the first occurrence of the same pair — the two chunks must agree.
p0662, the technical Śrāvakabhūmi designation of the yogin who has attained manaskāra. Built on the registered provisional ཡིད་ལ་བྱེད་པ = 'tác ý'. The same phrase begins at p0661 (c197).

p0662, ནང་དུ་ཡང་དག་འཇོག་ལ་འདུག་སྟེ, inside the Śrāvakabhūmi quotation. No entry. Kept distinct from ཏིང་ངེ་འཛིན = 'định' and from མཉམ་པར་བཞག་པ = 'nhập đẳng dẫn', both of which occur in the same passage.
p0662, ཞི་གནས་ཀྱིས་ཉེ་བར་དཀྲིས་པ, in the Śrāvakabhūmi list of signs. No entry; the verb is literally 'wrapped/enveloped around'. Uncertain — see flags.

p0662, རྟགས་དང་མཚན་མ་ཡོངས་སུ་བྱང་བ་དག. སྦྱོང་/བྱང་ can be 'purified' or 'trained to proficiency'; 'thuần thục' takes the second. Uncertain — see flags. Note the collision risk with རྣམ་པར་སྦྱོང་བ = 'tịnh hóa' used of afflictions three lines earlier in the same quotation.
p0662, སྦྱོར་བའི་སྐལ་བ་ཡོད་ཅིང་ནུས་པ — the share/fortune that makes application possible, paired with ནུས་པ = 'năng lực'. No entry.
p0662, སྒྲིབ་པ་རྣམས་ཤས་ཆེར་ཀུན་ཏུ་མི་རྒྱུ་བ; bare རྒྱུ་བ again at p0664 (ཉེ་བའི་ཉོན་མོངས་རྣམས་ཀྱང་ཕལ་ཆེར་མི་རྒྱུ་བ, rendered 'không hiện hành'). No entry for either form.
p0665, ཞི་ལྷག་གི་ངོས་འཛིན. No entry.

p0665, ལྷག་མཐོང་གི་སྒྲུབ་ལུགས; and བསྐྱེད་ལུགས at p0665 rendered 'cách thức phát khởi'. The only ལུགས entry in the view is the provisional bare ལུགས = 'chủ trương', which does not fit these -ལུགས compounds ('the manner of doing X'). A scoping note is needed.
p0650–p0651, 2× (རྣམ་རྟོག་དང་ཉེ་ཉོན). Contraction of ཉེ་བའི་ཉོན་མོངས. No entry. Corpus precedent for 'tùy phiền não': c033, c043, c093, c107, c108.
p0650–p0653, 7×. The dvandva contraction of བྱིང་བ + རྒོད་པ; no entry in the view. Corpus precedent: c029, c034, c177 all render the pair 'trầm một và trạo cử'. Wording follows that.

terms.vi: chín [thứ] sự an trú của tâm
terms.note: p0652, in the Śrāvakabhūmi quotation. Built from the registered སེམས་གནས་པ = 'sự an trú của tâm' (p0550) and the registered སེམས་དགུ = 'chín tâm [trụ]'. The two registered renderings differ, so the same nine states now have two Vietnamese names; a single ruling is needed. The body prose of this chunk refers to them only by number ('tâm thứ chín' etc.), following c030/c179/c181.

First of the nine, in the Śrāvakabhūmi quotation p0652. Rendered as the verbal phrase the Tibetan actually writes, not as a Sino-Vietnamese name (內住 etc.), because no ruling exists and the quotation must not be glossed. All nine below are gaps; a single ruling should fix the set.
Second of the nine, p0652. ཡང་དག་པར rendered 'chân chánh' per existing corpus practice.

terms.vi: thu nhiếp lại mà khiến an trụ
terms.note: Third of the nine as printed in the p0652 quotation. NOTE: the body text at p0649 (chunk c194) names the third བླན་ཏེ་འཇོག་པ, a different verb. Translated as printed here; see flags.
Fourth of the nine, p0652. Rendered literally; 'cận trụ' deliberately not coined, since no ruling exists.
Fifth of the nine, p0652. Follows the registered དུལ་བ = 'điều phục'.
Sixth of the nine, p0652. Follows the registered ཞི་བ = 'tịch tĩnh'.

Seventh of the nine as printed at p0652. Follows the registered ཉེ་བར་ཞི་བ = 'cận tịch tĩnh' (recorded there for the ten qualities of a teacher, a different context). The body at p0649 names the seventh རྣམ་པར་ཞི་བར་བྱེད་པ instead; see flags.

terms.vi: sự thâm nhập có gián đoạn (ở khoảng giữa / từng lúc)
terms.note: Second of the four attentions, p0652–p0653, 4×. The enumeration in the quotation writes བར་དུ་འཆད་ཅིང, the application writes སྐབས་སུ་འཆད་ཅིང; both are translated as printed. Registered only for the first attention (བསྒྲིམས་ཏེ་འཇུག་པའི་ཡིད་ལ་བྱེད་པ = 'tác ý gắng siết mà thâm nhập', p0623), so the remaining three are gaps.

terms.vi: sự thâm nhập không có gián đoạn từng lúc
terms.note: Third of the four attentions, p0652–p0653, 3×.

terms.vi: sự thâm nhập thành tựu một cách tự nhiên / sự thâm nhập không cần dụng công
terms.note: Fourth of the four attentions, p0652–p0653. The enumeration writes ལྷུན་གྱིས་གྲུབ་པར (rendered per the registered ལྷུན་གྱིས་གྲུབ་པ = 'thành tựu một cách tự nhiên'); the three applications write རྩོལ་བ་མེད་པར. Both kept as printed — see flags.

terms.bo: བར་གཅོད་པ / བར་དུ་གཅོད་པ (verbal, of a meditation session)
terms.note: SENSE SPLIT requested. p0650 (2×), p0653 (2×), plus བར་མ་བཅད་པ p0651 and བར་བཅད་པ p0653. The registered བར་གཅོད = 'sự gây chướng ngại' (p0204, p0462) is the nominal obstacle-to-study sense; here the verb means to cut a samādhi session in two, and 'gây chướng ngại' would not parse. Kept distinct in this chunk from གེགས and སྒྲིབ་པ.
p0652, སེམས་ཏིང་ངེ་འཛིན་དུ་ཧྲིལ་ཧྲིལ་འགྲོ་བ. Colloquial intensifier ('in one whole lump'). No entry; rendering is a reading of the idiom — see flags.
p0651, གོམས་པ་ཀློང་དུ་གྱུར་ནས. No entry.
p0650, `ཁ་ཏོན་དེ་ཉིད་མི་འཆད་པར`. No entry in the view. Kept; the ruling should distinguish it from འདོན་པ, which the same sentence renders 'tụng đọc'.

GAP. p0641 ×3, p0642 ×2. The watchfulness kept against laya / auddhatya once the coarse form has subsided. Kept distinct from ཤེས་བཞིན = tỉnh giác (the faculty) and from བསྲུང་བ = phòng hộ (already fixed for དབང་པོའི་སྒོ་བསྲུང་བ, which occurs in the same chunk).

GAP. p0640 ×2. Named as one of the faults of samādhi taught in the དབུས་མཐའ (Madhyāntavibhāga) — the fifth of the five faults. Sino-Vietnamese 'bất tác hành' is the established calque; 'không dụng công' was chosen because the same page uses འདུ་བྱེད་པ and རྩོལ་བ in free prose ('dụng công', 'nỗ lực') and the fault must stay recognisably the negation of that. Recurs at p0643, p0648, p0650, p0655.

terms.vi: thế sắc bén đã lắng xuống / chưa lắng xuống
terms.note: HAPAX in the whole corpus (grep over source/clean: p0642 only, twice). Rendered from དབལ = mũi nhọn/thế sắc bén plus the argument of the passage (equanimity is cultivated only once laya/auddhatya no longer arise for a whole session). The idiom itself is NOT securely identified; flagged inline in the file and in flags.

terms.vi: an trú đúng mực / sự lắng xuống đúng mực
terms.note: GAP. p0641 (Bhāvanākrama quotation: སེམས་རྣལ་དུ་འདུག་པར་མཐོང་བ) and p0642 (Śrāvakabhūmi definition of upekṣā: རྣལ་དུ་འབབ་པ). 'đúng mực' chosen for རྣལ་དུ across both so the quotation and the definition stay linked; it also aligns with c187's 'nhập đẳng chí một cách đúng mực'.
GAP. p0640, of a chain of subtle distractions: དེ་རྣམས་ཤུགས་དྲག་པ་དང་ཧ་ཅང་རྒྱུན་རིང་བའི་ལུ་གུ་རྒྱུད་མེད་ན.
GAP. p0641, འཕྲོ་རྒོད་ལས་སེམས་བླན་ཏེ. Kept distinct from རྣམ་པར་གཡེང་བ = 'sự tán loạn' (c186/c187 precedent), which stands in the same paragraph.
GAP. p0639, ཉེ་དུ་ལ་རྟོག་པ (jñāti-vitarka) in the Śrāvakabhūmi list of auddhatya-signs. Deliberately not 'người thân', which the glossary provisionally assigns to གཉེན in དགྲ་གཉེན (p0374).

terms.vi: hai quyển sau của *Tu Tập Thứ Đệ*
terms.note: p0642. Follows the registered བསྒོམ་པའི་རིམ་པ = Tu Tập Thứ Đệ, the སྒོམ་རིམ་བར་པ = 'quyển giữa' entry, and c011's ཐ་མ = 'quyển cuối'.
GAP. p0641–p0642, བྱིང་རྒོད་མི་འབྱུང་བའི་གདེང་ཐོབ་པ. Kept distinct from ངེས་ཤེས (c187: 'trí xác quyết') and from དད་པ.

p0641. Note the near-homograph in the same chunk: ཐུན་མཚམས (p0640) = 'giữa các thời tu' (glossary). འཚམས here is 'fitting/proportioned', not the between-sessions མཚམས; recorded so the Phase 5 sweep does not read one as a typo for the other.

p0639, twice inside the Bhūmivastu quotations (ཞི་གནས་ཡོངས་སུ་བྱང་བར་མ་བྱས་པ, རབ་ཏུ་འཛིན་པ་ལ་བྱང་བར་མ་བྱས་པ). RULING REQUESTED so that the registered prov གོམས་པ = 'thuần thục' can stand here: this chunk previously used 'thuần thục' for བྱང་བ, which is what pushed གོམས་པ off its own ruling. 'thuần thạo' keeps the two visibly apart while staying in the same semantic field (trained/brought to proficiency). Note this sense must also be kept apart from the p0252 བྱང་བ = purification (སྡིག་པ་བྱང་བ) already in the view, and from རྣམ་པར་བྱང་བ = 'thanh tịnh'.

p0641. The view registers prov གཟེངས་བསྟོད -> 'nâng cao ý chí' (p0535, Jātakamālā context, བརྟན་པས་གཟེངས་བསྟོད). TEXT KEPT as 'sách tấn [tâm] lên' — the corpus is on the translator's side: c191 uses 'sách tấn [tâm]' three times in this same śamatha section, and c162 l.50 already renders བརྟན་པས་གཟེངས་བསྟོད as 'sách tấn [tâm]', i.e. the p0535 entry is itself contradicted by c162. Requested: either revise the headword to 'sách tấn [tâm]' outright, or scope it — 'nâng cao ý chí' for raising one's own resolve/courage in the general-exhortation passages, 'sách tấn [tâm]' for the technical śamatha antidote to བྱིང་བ, paired with ནང་དུ་འགུགས་པ. An owner ruling is needed; I did not change wording in either direction.

p0639, ×3 (in the Bhūmivastu list of auddhatya-signs and in Tsongkhapa's gloss). No entry in the view. The chunk's own gloss settles the sense: ཧ་ཅང་རབ་ཏུ་འཛིན་པ་ནི་དགའ་བའི་ཡུལ་ལ་སེམས་བཟུང་དྲགས་པ = 'nắm giữ tâm quá chặt nơi đối tượng đáng ưa thích'. Deliberately NOT 'cách nắm giữ', which is the registered prov འཛིན་སྟངས (ākāra) and occurs twice in this same chunk (འཛིན་སྟངས་ཀྱི་ངར); the bare རབ་ཏུ་འཛིན་པ also appears alone at p0639 and is rendered 'sự nâng giữ', so a ruling should cover the bare form and the ཧ་ཅང་ intensified form together.

p0640. No entry in the view, but the rendering is settled corpus practice — c005, c006, c032, c110, c133, c168, c175, c181, c193 all use it. Register it so the Phase 5 sweep does not read it as drift. Note it sits next to FIXED བྱམས་པ -> 'từ' (maitrī); here བྱམས་པ is Maitreya the person, so the pair རྗེ་བཙུན་བྱམས་པ should be registered as a unit = 'đức Chí Tôn Di-lặc'.

terms.vi: thế sắc bén … đã lắng xuống
terms.note: p0642, ×2 (affirmative and negated). No entry. Idiomatic; the reading is not fully certain. Read as དབལ = the sharp edge/force of laya-auddhatya and ཆོགས་པ = its having subsided, which the surrounding argument supports (equanimity can only be cultivated FROM that point, and is absent before it). Text KEPT as translated; the translator's inline hedge has been removed from the prose and is recorded here and in the chunk flag instead. Needs an owner ruling; if ཆོགས་པ is instead read as 'has been satisfied/exhausted' the Vietnamese would need to change.

p0634, inside the ཀུན་ལས་བཏུས definition of སེམས་པ. The SAME Tibetan sentence occurs at p0300 and was rendered in c093 as 'Tư là gì? Là sự tạo tác nơi tâm, tức ý nghiệp; nó có nghiệp dụng khiến tâm dấn vào thiện, bất thiện và vô ký.' Reused verbatim so one quotation has one Vietnamese. Note this diverges from the glossary's provisional མངོན་པར་འདུ་བྱེད་པ = 'hiện hành' (p0229); a ruling should say whether the c093 wording governs.

terms.vi: hành tướng sở thủ / hành tướng năng thủ
terms.note: p0632, the two kinds of object the meditator may hold. Uses the corpus's རྣམ་པ = 'hành tướng' (c182) and the standard Sino-Vietnamese sở thủ / năng thủ pair. No glossary entry.
p0634, in the magnet simile defining tư. Follows c093, which uses 'tâm sở' in the parallel passage on cetanā. No glossary entry.
p0634, the lodestone that moves iron without its being self-governing — the simile for cetanā.
p0633, རྒྱུ་ཐམ་ཐོམ་གྱིས་བསྒྲུབས་པའི་འབྲས་བུ. No entry.
p0632, the unique function of tỉnh giác: watching whether the mind strays. No entry.
p0631 (བྱིང་བ་ཁུངས་ཐུབ་པའི་གཞུང་ཆེ་བ་རྣམས) and p0633 (གཞུང་ཁུངས་ཐུབ་ཆེན་མོ་རེ). Matches the corpus rendering of ཁུངས་བཙུན = 'có nguồn gốc đáng tin cậy' (c004/c005).

p0689, vocative inside the Saṃdhinirmocana quotation. No entry in glossary.json (grep: 0 hits). Rendered 'Quán Tự Tại' rather than 'Quán Thế Âm' because the Tibetan is dbang phyug = īśvara, and the corpus already keeps དབང་ཕྱུག compounds separable (འཇིག་རྟེན་དབང་ཕྱུག = Thế Tự Tại, རྣལ་འབྱོར་དབང་ཕྱུག = Du-già Tự Tại).

p0689, Saṃdhinirmocana quotation ཆོས་རྣམས་ཀྱི་ངོ་བོ་ཉིད་མ་མཆིས་པ་ཉིད. Deliberately NOT the fixed རང་བཞིན་མེད་པ = 'vô tự tánh', which is scoped to རང་བཞིན (= tự tánh); this sūtra uses ངོ་བོ་ཉིད, registered as 'Thể tánh'. Built from the registered component so the two Tibetan words stay separable; a ruling may prefer the compact 'vô tự tánh tánh'. མ་མཆིས་པ is the honorific of མེད་པ.

p0689 final line, in the pair དྲང་དོན་ལ་མི་རྟོན་ངེས་དོན་ལ་རྟོན་པ. No entry (0 hits in glossary.json); its partner ངེས་དོན = 'nghĩa liễu nghĩa' is registered. Needed for c207, whose section head is དྲང་དོན་དང་ངེས་དོན་གྱི་གསུང་རབ་ངོས་གཟུང་བ.

p0689, ཡིན་ལུགས་ཀྱི་དོན་ལ་ཕུ་ཐག་ཆོད་པའི་ལྟ་བ. No entry. Occurs only twice in the whole corpus (p0689, p0942) — idiom for settling a matter right through to its end. Kept distinct from ངེས་པ = 'sự xác quyết'.
p0688, inside the Bhāvanākrama quotation (ལྟ་བའི་དྲ་བ་ཐམས་ཅད་དང་བྲལ་བར་འགྱུར). No entry. Built on the registered ལྟ་བ = 'kiến'; deliberately not 'lưới kiến chấp', which would add འཛིན་པ.

The bare form (without ཉིད), ~8× on p0688 in the Bhāvanākrama quotation and Tsongkhapa's framing prose, alternating with དེ་ཁོ་ན་ཉིད in the same passage. glossary.json registers only དེ་ཁོ་ན་ཉིད = 'thật tánh' (prov) and an older 'དེ་ཁོ་ན་ཉིད / དེ་ཉིད' = 'chân như' that the later entry supersedes. Rendered 'thật tánh' throughout; registering the bare form so the alternation is not read as drift.

terms.vi: trí tuệ của văn và tư
terms.note: p0689. No entry. Kept as a genitive rather than the corpus's 'trí tuệ do văn và tư sinh ra' (c011, c032, c168), which renders ཐོས་བསམ་ལས་བྱུང་བའི་ཤེས་རབ and would import a ལས་བྱུང་བ this Tibetan does not write.

p0689, ལྷག་མཐོང་གི་རྒྱུའི་ཚོགས་མེད་དུ་མི་རུང་བ. Follows the registered ཚོགས = 'tư lương' and c180's heading 'Nương vào tư lương của tịnh chỉ'; the added རྒྱུ is rendered so the phrase is not collapsed into bare ཚོགས.

p0688, བཅོམ་ལྡན་འདས་ཀྱི་བཀའ་ཐམས་ཅད་ནི་ལེགས་པར་གསུངས་པ་སྟེ. glossary.json carries it only inside the compound ལེགས་པར་གསུངས་པའི་ཆོས་འདུལ་བ = 'Pháp và Luật khéo được tuyên thuyết'; registering the bare predicate with the same wording.

p0689, དྲི་མ་མེད་པའི་གཞུང་ལུགས་མཉན. Only the bare དྲི་མ -> 'cấu bẩn' is registered; the negated compound as a modifier ('hệ thống giáo thuyết vô cấu') needs its own entry, since 'không có cấu bẩn' would be clumsy in this attributive position. Cf. the existing note at view line 123 which already quotes དྲི་མ་མེད་པའི་གསུང་རབ under a different headword.

GAP - no entry in glossary.json (grep: zero hits for གོལ་ས). Occurs 3x in this chunk: p0682 l.3 གོལ་སར་འཁྲིད་ས་མེད and ཏིང་ངེ་འཛིན་གཞན་གྱི་གོལ་ས་གཅོད་པ; p0684 l.1 ལམ་གྱི་གོལ་ས་དང་མ་གོལ་ས. It is a load-bearing term for this whole passage (the deviations the śamatha section is written to prevent) and will recur in the vipaśyanā division. 'nẻo lạc lối' chosen; the only corpus occurrence of 'lạc lối' is c187's elephant-simile verse (verbal, for a different Tibetan), so nothing collides.

p0682 l.1, ཚུལ་འདིས་ཅི་ཡང་མེད་པ་མན་ཆད་ལ་ཆགས་པ་དང་བྲལ་བར་བྱེད. glossary.json has only the full ཅི་ཡང་མེད་པའི་སྐྱེ་མཆེད = 'Vô Sở Hữu Xứ'. The Tibetan here writes the short form without སྐྱེ་མཆེད, so 'Xứ' is bracketed as supplied. A short-form ruling would let the sweep see the two as one term.

p0683 l.1, listed among Asaṅga's works beside བྱང་ས and གཏན་ལ་དབབ་པ་བསྡུ་བ. Rendered literally from the registered མངོན་པ = 'A-tỳ-đạt-ma' plus གོང་མ. The work meant is almost certainly the Abhidharmasamuccaya, but the Tibetan says only 'the upper Abhidharma', so the established title was NOT substituted. A ruling is needed on whether to keep the literal form or expand.

p0683 l.1. glossary.json has སེམས་དགུ = 'chín tâm [trụ]' (the nine abidings themselves); this form names the nine WAYS of settling the mind and keeps ཚུལ visible. Related: p0684 l.1 སེམས་དགུ་པ rendered 'cái tâm thứ chín', which follows the existing entry.

terms.vi: sự bịa đặt của riêng mình
terms.note: p0683 l.1, རང་བཟོ་དང་བྲལ་བར་བསྟན་པ - the presentation must be free of the expositor's own invention. GAP, no entry. This is exactly the failure mode this project guards against, so a fixed rendering would be useful.

p0684 l.3 verse, རྗོད་བྱེད་བརླིང་བས ('because the expressive words are weighty/dense'). GAP - no entry for རྗོད་བྱེད and none for བརླིང་བ. 'lời diễn đạt nặng nề' chosen; the Sino-Vietnamese 'năng thuyên' was rejected as too technical for a verse addressed to ordinary practitioners.

p0684 l.3 verse. glossary.json gives བློ་གྲོས / བློ / བརྟན་པ = 'tuệ / trí / sự kiên định' and a separate provisional བློ = 'cái trí'. 'kẻ tuệ nhỏ' is not idiomatic Vietnamese, so 'kẻ trí nhỏ' was used - which makes བློ་གྲོས and བློ collapse onto 'trí' in the same verse (pada 4 རང་གི་བློ་ཡི་སྐྱོན = 'lỗi của cái trí mình'). Flagged below.

p0684 l.3 verse: རང་གི་བློ་ཡི་སྐྱོན། །གཞན་ལ་བསྒོས་པས - transferring/smearing the fault of one's own mind onto something else (here: onto the texts). This is a THIRD sense of the root, distinct from the registered བསྒོ་བ = 'lời dặn bảo' (to instruct) and from ཡོངས་སུ་བསྒོས་པ = 'huân tập' (perfuming, vāsanā). Registering it so the Phase 5 sweep does not read 'huân tập' as owed here.

terms.vi: các hệ thống giáo thuyết lớn
terms.note: p0684 l.3 verse, ×2. Follows the registered provisional གཞུང་ལུགས = 'hệ thống giáo thuyết' (deliberately not 'tông nghĩa', which is གྲུབ་མཐའ). Kept distinct from གཞུང་ཆེ་བ = 'các bản văn lớn' (registered), which also occurs in this chunk at p0683 l.1 - the two are one syllable apart and must not merge.

p0683 l.1, བསྡུ་བ་ལས་ཞི་ལྷག་གཉིས་ཉན་ས་ལ་ཞལ་འཕངས་མཛད་པ - Asaṅga cross-refers the śamatha/vipaśyanā treatment from the Saṃgrahaṇī to the Śrāvakabhūmi. GAP; rendered 'ngài đã chuyển hai [phần] chỉ quán về *Thanh Văn Địa*'. A fixed rendering for this cross-reference idiom would help, as it recurs in Asaṅga citations.

p0684 l.1 (ཕྱི་ནང་གཉིས་ཀ) and l.3 verse (ཕྱི་རོལ་པ་དང་ནང་པ). glossary.json has only ནང་པ་སངས་རྒྱས་པ = 'người Phật giáo nội đạo'; bare ནང་པ, paired against the registered ཕྱི་རོལ་པ = 'ngoại đạo', is unregistered.

p0684 l.1, in the list of 'pleasant-sounding names' (མིང་སྙན་སྙན) misapplied to ordinary śamatha. Neither is registered, but both Vietnamese forms already occur in the corpus (vô sở duyên ×5, vô tướng ×2) and both follow registered pieces (དམིགས་པ = sở duyên, མཚན་མ = tướng).
