p0684 l.3, verse. No `རྡོ་རྗེ` entry at all in the view; 7× in corpus. Text KEPT.
p0682 l.3, `གཟུགས་མེད་བཞིའི་ཏིང་ངེ་འཛིན`. No entry in the view. Text KEPT.
p0683 l.1 `ཕྱི་ནང་གཉིས་ཀའི་ཏིང་ངེ་འཛིན`, p0684 l.3 verse `ཕྱི་རོལ་པ་དང་ནང་པ་ཡི`. No entry in the view. Text KEPT.
p0682 l.1, `སྦྱོར་བ་མཐར་ཐུག་པའི་ཡིད་ལ་བྱེད་པ` — the sixth of the seven manaskāras. No entry in the view. Text KEPT.

p0697 l.1 (སློབ་དཔོན་སངས་རྒྱས་བསྐྱངས) and p0699 l.1. GAP — glossary.json has no entry of any kind for Buddhapālita, although the whole section turns on Candrakīrti following him. Established Sino-Vietnamese 佛護. Used with the registered སློབ་དཔོན -> 'A-xà-lê', so the phrase reads 'A-xà-lê Phật Hộ', exactly parallel to the recorded ལེགས་ལྡན་འབྱེད -> 'A-xà-lê Thanh Biện'.

p0698 l.1, དེ་ཡང་ཚིག་གསལ་ལས — the source of the two long quotations that carry this whole section. glossary.json registers only ཕར་ཕྱིན་གྱི་འགྲེལ་བཤད་ཚིག་གསལ་བ -> 'Minh Cú (bộ thích luận về Ba-la-mật)', a DIFFERENT work; but that entry's own note says 'Minh Cú alone is the standard Vietnamese for Candrakīrti's [commentary]'. Registering the bare ཚིག་གསལ as the Prasannapadā so the two are visibly distinguished and the Pāramitā commentary keeps its descriptive tag. Note p0696 (c208's range) also cites ཚིག་གསལ.

p0696 (context) and p0699 l.1, རྩ་ཤེའི་རབ་བྱེད་བཅོ་བརྒྱད་པ. Short form of རྩ་བ་ཤེས་རབ. glossary.json registers only དབུ་མ་རྩ་བ -> 'Căn Bản Trung Luận' (p0302); expanded to the same registered title, following the short-vs-full-title precedent already set for འཇུག་པ -> Nhập Trung Luận. No new wording.

p0699 l.1, twice. SCOPING request, not a rewording. glossary.json carries རབ་བྱེད only inside the title ཕུང་པོ་ལྔའི་རབ་བྱེད -> 'Ngũ Uẩn Luận', where it is a work-title element ('luận'). Here it names a chapter of the Mūlamadhyamakakārikā, so 'phẩm thứ mười tám'. The two senses need separating.

terms.vi: bậc Thánh cùng người con của ngài
terms.note: p0697 l.1, འཕགས་པ་ཡབ་སྲས་ཀྱི་གཞུང. GAP — no entry, and no occurrence of any 'cha con' / 'phụ tử' rendering anywhere in translation/. The referents are Nāgārjuna and Āryadeva, but the Tibetan names neither, so no names were supplied. Rendered literally on the registered འཕགས་པ -> 'bậc thánh'. A ruling should fix one form, since the phrase recurs through the whole Madhyamaka chapter.

p0698 l.1, inside the Prasannapadā quotation, in the list ཉོན་མོངས་པ་རྣམས་དང་ལས་དང་ལུས་རྣམས་དང་བྱེད་པ་པོ་དང་འབྲས་བུ་རྣམས. No entry. Kept distinct from the registered བྱེད་པ་པོ-free renderings of ལས = nghiệp and འབྲས་བུ = quả, which stand beside it in the same list.

p0697 l.9, འདི་ཐམས་ཅད་བག་ཆགས་དང་བཅས་པ་ཉེ་བར་ཞི་བས. SCOPING request. glossary.json registers ཉེ་བར་ཞི་བ -> 'cận tịch tĩnh' (upaśānta), scoped by its own note to the THIRD of the ten qualities of a teacher, glossed as ཤེས་རབ་ཀྱི་བསླབ་པ. Here it is a finite verb about appearances and their latencies being stilled; 'cận tịch tĩnh' would be incoherent. Text kept.

p0698 l.1 (ནང་དང་ཕྱིའི་དངོས་པོ་མ་དམིགས་པས) and p0699 l.1 (བདག་མ་དམིགས་པས). No entry for the negated form. Rendered so the link to the registered དམིགས་པ -> 'sở duyên' stays visible, since the same passage has བདག་ནི་...དམིགས་པ་ཡིན་པ -> 'ngã là sở duyên'.

p0699 l.1, 3× inside the Prasannapadā quotation (ཉེ་བར་རྟོག་པར་བྱེད). GAP. glossary.json rules རྟོག་པ only as 'phân biệt' (vikalpa, the Hashang passage) and 'tầm tư' (vitarka, paired with དཔྱོད་པ); neither fits this verb of deliberate investigation. Kept distinct from རྩད་བཅད་པ -> 'truy xét đến cùng' (registered), which occurs in the surrounding prose.
p0699 l.1, 2× (འཁོར་བ་འདི་ཅིའི་རྩ་བ་ཅན་ཡིན / འཇིག་ཚོགས་ལ་ལྟ་བའི་རྩ་བ་ཅན་ཉིད་དུ). No entry; recorded because the passage is the pivot of the argument and the phrase recurs.

terms.vi: cái phá bác / cái thành lập
terms.note: p0698 l.1, བདག་དེ་ཡོད་པ་ལ་གནོད་བྱེད་དང་མེད་པའི་སྒྲུབ་བྱེད་ཀྱི་ལུང་དང་རིགས་པ. SCOPING. glossary.json has གནོད་བྱ་གནོད་བྱེད -> 'cái bị hại và cái làm hại' (of the two valid cognitions, p0438) and བསྒྲུབ་བྱ / སྒྲུབ་བྱེད -> 'điều cần thành tựu / phương tiện thành tựu' (p0337); neither sense is this one, where the pair names refutation and proof.

No headword for ཚིག་གསལ in the c209 view at all, yet the bare form ཚིག་གསལ་ལས། is cited in c208, c209, c210, c211, c212. decisions.md §'Cited text titles' requires one fixed title per cited text: register *Minh Cú Luận* as fixed. Also record that the shortened *Minh Cú* is already taken in c032 for ཕར་ཕྱིན་གྱི་འགྲེལ་པ, so the long form is the one that must be used for Candrakīrti's commentary.

The view's only འགོག་པ entry is 'diệt [đế]' (nirodha, scoped to p0402 ཐེག་ཆེན་གྱི་འགོག་པ) and does not cover the verbal negate/refute sense used here: p0698 l.1 བདག་དེ་དགག་དགོས་པར, p0698 verse རྣལ་འབྱོར་པ་ཡིས་བདག་ནི་འགོག་པར་བྱེད (MAv VI.120), p0699 l.1 རང་བཞིན་འགོག་པའི་རིགས་པ. A ruling separating nirodha ('diệt') from the verbal 'phủ định / bác bỏ' is owed; note also that 'bác bỏ' is the argumentative 'refute', a shade stronger than the plain 'negates' of འགོག་པར་བྱེད.
p0697 l.1 དཔལ་ལྡན་ཟླ་བ་གྲགས་པ. No ruling in the view; matches ~17 corpus occurrences. Registering it also settles that དཔལ་ལྡན alone carries no 'ngài'.
p0699 l.1, twice. No ruling for རབ་བྱེད as a chapter/prakaraṇa division of a śāstra.

p0696 l.3, ཐལ་འགྱུར་བ་དང་རང་རྒྱུད་པ་གཉིས་ཀྱི་ཐ་སྙད, and the abbreviation ཐལ་རང in the next sentence ('Ứng Thành và Tự Lập'). GAP - no entry, no corpus precedent. 'Ứng Thành' (應成) renders thal 'gyur = prasaṅga = consequence transparently. The competing established Vietnamese form is 'Cụ Duyên' (具緣), which is widespread in Vietnamese Lamrim literature but is not a rendering of the Tibetan word. RULING NEEDED and urgent: this pair names the two divisions the entire remaining Madhyamaka section is organised by.

p0696 l.3, paired with ཐལ་འགྱུར་བ. GAP. 'Tự Lập' renders rang rgyud = svatantra = autonomous [syllogism]. Competing established forms: 'Y Tự Khởi' (依自起) and 'Tự Tục' (自續). Must be ruled together with ཐལ་འགྱུར་བ.
p0695 l.3, དབུ་མ་རྒྱན་དང་སྣང་བ་གཉིས་ཀ. Śāntarakṣita's work. GAP.

p0695 l.3, abbreviated to bare སྣང་བ inside the pair དབུ་མ་རྒྱན་དང་སྣང་བ (rendered '*Trung Quán Trang Nghiêm* và *[Trung Quán] Quang Minh*', the supplied half bracketed). Kamalaśīla's work; the full form དབུ་མ་སྣང་བ occurs on p0693, inside c207, which is still pending - whatever is ruled must be applied there too.

p0695 l.2, ལོ་ཙཱ་བ་ཆེན་པོ་བློ་ལྡན་ཤེས་རབ -> 'đại dịch giả Loden Sherab' (Ngok Lotsāwa). Transcription, matching c005's 'đại dịch giả Naktso' for ལོ་ཙཱ་བ་ཆེན་པོ་ནག་ཚོ. Note the glossary already fixes བློ་ལྡན = 'có trí' as a common noun; that entry must not be applied inside this personal name.

p0694 l.4, p0696 l.1-2 (×3 with the bare མདོ་སྡེ་སྤྱོད་པ). GAP. Built to pair with རྣལ་འབྱོར་སྤྱོད་པའི་དབུ་མ་པ -> 'Trung Quán Du-già Hành', which follows the glossary's fixed རྣལ་འབྱོར་སྤྱོད་པའི་ས = 'Du-già Sư Địa' and c100's 'Bồ-tát Du-già Hành Tứ Bách Luận'. མདོ་སྡེ་པ (Sautrāntika) itself has no entry anywhere; 'Kinh Bộ' is proposed.
p0694 l.4, p0696 l.2. Paired with the above.

terms.vi: phái chủ trương huyễn hóa được thành lập bằng chánh lý
terms.note: p0694 l.5. A doxographic party-name, rendered descriptively from its components using the glossary's སྒྱུ་མ = 'huyễn hóa' and རིགས་པ = 'chánh lý'. GAP. The same school is referred to two lines later by the shorter tag སྒྱུ་མ་ལྟ་བུ -> 'như huyễn hóa'. A short fixed Vietnamese name would be better than a nine-word phrase; ruling needed.

terms.vi: phái chủ trương hoàn toàn vô trụ
terms.note: p0694 l.5 / p0695 l.1, with the short tag རབ་ཏུ་མི་གནས་པ -> 'hoàn toàn vô trụ'. GAP. Paired with the entry above; both should be ruled together.

p0694 l.3, the earlier Tibetans' designation for Nāgārjuna and Āryadeva, contrasted with ཕྱོགས་འཛིན་པའི་དབུ་མ་པ. GAP. ཕྱི་མོ = archetype/mother-copy; 'bản văn gốc' is a plain rendering. No entry for གཞུང་ཕྱི་མོ.

terms.vi: Trung Quán chấp giữ một phía
terms.note: p0694 l.3, the contrastive term to གཞུང་ཕྱི་མོའི་དབུ་མ་པ. GAP. Rendered literally (ཕྱོགས = side/party), following c021's 'rơi về một bên' for ཕྱོགས. 'phái Trung Quán theo phe' would read more idiomatically but adds a pejorative the Tibetan only implies.

p0695 l.4, རྣམ་པར་རིག་པ་ཙམ་གྱི་ལུགས་སུན་ཕྱུང -> 'bác bỏ chủ trương Duy Thức'. GAP, and a COLLISION: the corpus already uses 'Duy Thức' at c023 and c110 ('Duy Thức chân tướng phái'), where the Tibetan is སེམས་ཙམ. 唯識 is strictly vijñaptimātra and 唯心 cittamātra, so a ruling should decide whether the two Tibetan school-names are deliberately merged in Vietnamese or kept apart.

p0695 l.2-3, ×2: རིགས་ཤེས་རྗེས་དཔག་གིས་གཞལ་བ -> 'được đo lường bởi trí chánh lý tỷ lượng', and རིགས་ཤེས་ཀྱི་གཞལ་བྱ -> 'sở lượng của trí chánh lý'. GAP. Built on the view's provisional རིགས་པ = 'chánh lý'. Also newly used here: གཞལ་བྱ -> 'sở lượng' and རྗེས་དཔག -> 'tỷ lượng', neither of which has an entry; both are standard Sino-Vietnamese and will recur constantly once the Madhyamaka analysis begins.

p0694 l.3 (ཡབ་སྲས་གཉིས་ཀ), p0695 l.4 (སློབ་དཔོན་འཕགས་པ་ཡབ་སྲས), p0696 l.4 (འཕགས་པ་ཡབ་སྲས). GAP. Nāgārjuna and Āryadeva. Rendered literally 'hai cha con' / 'hai cha con bậc Thánh' rather than glossing the two names, since the chunk itself establishes the identification. Note that here འཕགས་པ standing alone (p0696 l.5, འཕགས་པའི་དགོངས་པ) denotes Nāgārjuna specifically, not the generic 'bậc thánh' of the registered འཕགས་པ entry - the scope needs recording.
L25, p0696 l.1. No entry.
L21, p0695. The Tibetan gives only the short སྣང་བ; the supplied part of the title is bracketed. No entry.
Throughout (p0694 L19, p0695 L23, p0696 L25). No entry; the two Tibetan forms are used interchangeably by the text and rendered alike.
L21, p0695. No entry.
L21, p0695. No entry.
p0703 l.1, གང་ཟག་བཏགས་ཡོད (×2). No entry in the c211 view. Established Sino-Vietnamese 假有. Pairs with རྫས་ཡོད below; the two must be ruled together.
p0703 l.1, ཕུང་པོ་རྫས་ཡོད / གང་ཟག་...རྫས་ཡོད་དུ་འཛིན་པ. No entry. 實有, the counterpart of བཏགས་ཡོད = giả hữu. Kept distinct from བདེན་དངོས (p0705) which I rendered 'sự vật chân thật'.

p0703 l.1 and p0706 l.3, always paired with དོན་དམ་པ = thắng nghĩa (registered). No entry for bare ཀུན་རྫོབ; glossary notes recorded elsewhere show ཀུན་རྫོབ་བདེན་པ → 'thế tục đế', so bare ཀུན་རྫོབ → 'thế tục' follows that.

terms.vi: sự nhận diện cái phải phá bỏ vốn quá rộng / quá hẹp
terms.note: p0704 l.5, p0705 l.1. Section headings s224/s225. ཁྱབ = pervasion; 'quá rộng / quá hẹp' renders the over-/under-extension of the identification.

p0703 l.5, in the three-fold sa-bcad of s221: དེ་འགོག་པ་དེ་ཐལ་རང་གང་གིས་བྱེད་པ. GAP — no entry anywhere in the view, and the corpus has no occurrence of 'ứng thành', 'tự lập', 'quy mậu' or 'Ứng Thành'. This is a top-level division heading of the whole vipaśyanā section and will recur constantly from here on, so it needs a ruling NOW. I supplied '[luận thức]' in brackets because the Tibetan abbreviation names only the two argument types.

p0704 l.1, དགག་པར་བྱ་བའི་སྤྱི་ལེགས་པར་མ་ཤར་ན. GAP. Chose 'cái tổng quát' over 'tổng tướng' deliberately: 'tướng' is already the provisional Vietnamese for མཚན་ཉིད, མཚན་མ and མཚན, and the glossary already asks for that three-way collision to be split.

p0704 l.1, inside the Bodhicaryāvatāra citation བཏགས་པའི་དངོས་ལ་མ་རེག་པར། །དེ་ཡི་དངོས་མེད་འཛིན་མ་ཡིན།. GAP, zero corpus precedent. Built on the registered དངོས་པོ = 'sự vật' so the verse's own pair stays visible. 'vô thể' / 'phi hữu' are the other candidates.

terms.vi: cực đoan (cực đoan hữu / cực đoan đoạn)
terms.note: p0704 l.1. The only registered མཐའ is the fifth member of a five-fold list ('chỗ cuối cùng'), a different sense. 'cực đoan' is standard in Vietnamese for the two extremes; 'hữu biên / đoạn biên' is the alternative. Same sentence also gives རྟག་ལྟ / ཆད་ལྟ → 'thường kiến / đoạn kiến'.

p0706 l.3, ×2. The technical sense is the qualifier 'ultimately' attached to a negandum. No entry for ཁྱད་པར at all. 'định ngữ' chosen for clarity; 'sự giản biệt' is the more Sino-Buddhist alternative.

p0703 l.1. Used the transliteration rather than the registered 'hạng người', per that entry's own note scoping 'hạng người' to enumerative non-technical use. Note that p0704 l.1's ordinary example གང་ཟག་འདི་མི་འདུག is rendered plain 'người'. This is a sixth trigger for the split the glossary already asks to be recorded.

Occurs on p0702 (outside my range) but governs the referent of དེ་དག throughout p0703 l.1. I wrote 'các vị ấy' rather than name the school. No entry exists; a ruling is needed before the chunks that render it.

terms.vi: [luận thức] ứng thành hay [luận thức] tự lập
terms.note: p0703, sa-bcad དེ་འགོག་པ་དེ་ཐལ་རང་གང་གིས་བྱེད་པ. No ruling in the view. ཐལ་རང is the contraction of ཐལ་འགྱུར (prāsaṅga, consequence) + རང་རྒྱུད (svātantrika, autonomous inference); the bracketed [luận thức] supplies the head noun Vietnamese needs and is marked as supplied. This names a top-level sa-bcad of the whole vipaśyanā section and recurs constantly, so it needs a fixed rendering now — including a ruling on whether the two members are also registered separately (ཐལ་འགྱུར -> 'ứng thành', རང་རྒྱུད -> 'tự lập') and whether the bracket is kept in headings.

p0703, ཕུང་པོ་རྫས་ཡོད་ཀྱི་གྲུབ་མཐའ་མ་དོར་བར་དུ -> 'chừng nào chưa buông bỏ tông nghĩa cho rằng uẩn là thật hữu'. No ruling in the view. 'tông nghĩa' (宗義) is the standard Sino-Vietnamese for siddhānta as a school's tenet-position. Recurs throughout the vipaśyanā section (tenet-system doxography); needs registering, with a note on whether 'tông phái' is ever licensed for the school rather than the tenet.

p0705–p0706, ×7 in the bare epistemological sense, incl. the Samādhirāja verse (མིག་དང་རྣ་བ་སྣ་ཡང་ཚད་མ་མིན), ཚད་མས་གྲུབ་བམ་མ་གྲུབ, and MAv རྣམ་ཀུན་འཇིག་རྟེན་ཚད་མིན -> 'thế gian chẳng phải là lượng'. Also སྒྲུབ་བྱེད་ཀྱི་ཚད་མ -> 'lượng năng thành' (pramāṇa that establishes). WORDING KEPT. The view holds only prov ཚད་མ *in ཚད་མར་གྱུར་པ* -> 'đã trở thành lượng', whose own note records that glossary.json has NO entry for bare ཚད་མ and asks for a ruling 'since ཚད་མ recurs in the vipaśyanā sections'. That is exactly what has now been hit. Ruling needed: bare ཚད་མ (epistemic) -> 'lượng'; ཚད་མར་གྱུར་པ (authoritative) keeps its own form; and whether སྒྲུབ་བྱེད་ཀྱི་ཚད་མ is registered as a compound.
p0704, ཡང་ན་རྟག་ལྟ་དང་ཡང་ན་ཆད་ལྟ. No ruling in the view; standard renderings. Register together.

terms.vi: cực đoan hữu / cực đoan đoạn
terms.note: p0704, ཡོད་པའི་མཐར་ལྟུང (…) ཆད་པའི་མཐར་ལྟུང. No ruling in the view. NOTE THE COLLISION the ruling must settle: the same sentence also has སྲིད་པ་ལས་གྲོལ་བར་མི་ནུས -> 'chẳng thể giải thoát khỏi hữu', following the view's prov སྲིད་པ -> 'hữu' [bhava]. So within one sentence 'hữu' renders སྲིད་པ while 'cực đoan hữu' renders ཡོད་པ — two different Tibetan words landing on the same Vietnamese syllable. One ruling should keep them apart (e.g. ཡོད་པའི་མཐའ -> 'biên kiến thường tồn' / 'cực đoan có', or a distinguishing form for སྲིད་པ).

terms.kind: compound, sense distinct from its head
terms.note: p0704, དངོས་པོར་མངོན་པར་ཞེན་པ་བསྐྱེད་པས. The text was CHANGED here (see fixed): 'sự bám chấp hiện hành vào sự vật' -> 'sự bám chấp vào sự vật'. The view's prov ཞེན་པ -> 'tham luyến' is scoped by its own note to འཁོར་བ་ལ་ཞེན་པ (p0262) and contrasted with ཆགས་པ / འདོད་ཆགས — the AFFECTIVE sense. Here the compound is abhiniveśa, a cognitive reification of things as real, so 'tham luyến' would be wrong. Register the compound separately from bare ཞེན་པ. 'hiện hành' was dropped because it is the corpus rendering of samudācāra and would collide.

GAP — glossary.json has ངེས་དོན = 'nghĩa liễu nghĩa' (provisional) but NOTHING for its partner དྲང་དོན, and that entry's own note says 'a ruling is owed before the ལྷག་མཐོང section' — this is that section. Rendered as the matching Sino-Vietnamese 不了義. Attributively (དྲང་དོན་གྱི་མདོ་སྡེ, དྲང་དོན་དུ་འགྲོ་བ) shortened to plain 'bất liễu nghĩa', following the precedent already in the corpus for ངེས་དོན ('giáo điển liễu nghĩa', c132; 'hiểu liễu nghĩa', c133). The pair governs this whole chunk and the next two.

Full form of the registered ངེས་དོན. Same Vietnamese; the Tibetan long/short alternation is not reproduced. Attributive uses (ངེས་དོན་གྱི་མདོ་སྡེ, ངེས་དོན་གྱི་གསུང་རབ) are 'kinh liễu nghĩa' / 'thánh giáo liễu nghĩa' — 'thánh giáo nghĩa liễu nghĩa' is unreadable. Register the long form so the sweep does not read it as drift.

terms.vi: Thánh Nhập Cảnh Giới Của Hết Thảy Chư Phật, Trí Quang Minh Trang Nghiêm
terms.note: p0692 l.1, cited inside the Madhyamakāloka quotation. No entry, no established Vietnamese title located. Rendered component-by-component: འཕགས་པ = Thánh; སངས་རྒྱས་ཐམས་ཅད་ཀྱི་ཡུལ་ལ་འཇུག་པ = nhập cảnh giới của hết thảy chư Phật; ཡེ་ཤེས་སྣང་བའི་རྒྱན = trí quang minh trang nghiêm. A fully Sino-Vietnamese form ('Thánh Nhập Nhất Thiết Phật Cảnh Trí Quang Minh Trang Nghiêm', matching the Chinese 入諸佛境界智光明莊嚴經) is the obvious alternative and may be preferable; needs one ruling.

p0692 l.1, དབུ་མ་རིགས་པའི་ཚོགས་དགོངས་འགྲེལ་དང་བཅས་པ — Nāgārjuna's corpus of reasoning (Chinese 理聚). Uses the glossary's རིགས་པ = 'chánh lý' (provisional) and follows c132's 'khối giáo điển và chánh lý' for ཚོགས = khối; deliberately NOT the registered ཚོགས = 'tư lương', which would be nonsense here. 'Lý Tụ' is the alternative if a Sino-Vietnamese proper name is wanted.

terms.vi: bậc đại khai sáng đường lối xe [pháp]
terms.note: p0690 l.1, ཚད་མར་གྱུར་པའི་ཤིང་རྟའི་སྲོལ་འབྱེད་ཆེན་པོ. glossary.json fixes ཤིང་རྟ་ཆེན་པོ = 'bậc Đại Xa', but here ཆེན་པོ stands over སྲོལ་འབྱེད, not over ཤིང་རྟ, so the fixed compound cannot be used without moving the adjective. 'xe' bracketed with [pháp] because ཤིང་རྟ alone is just 'chariot'. Contestable — see flags.
The section heading, twice (s216, s217). Matches glossary.json's སེམས་བསྐྱེད་པ་ངོས་གཟུང་བ = 'nhận diện sự phát tâm' (p0372); registered here for the bare verbal noun.

p0693, 3×, the pivot of the final argument (whether a nītārtha sūtra must be taken literally). No entry. Kept distinct from ཇི་ལྟ་བ = 'như sở hữu tánh' and from ཇི་ལྟ་བ་བཞིན = 'đúng như thật' (used two paragraphs earlier for ངེས་པའི་དོན་ཇི་ལྟ་བ་བཞིན་སྟོན་པ).

p0691 l.1, འདི་ནི་བརྗོད་བྱའི་སྒོ་ནས་བཞག་སྟེ — the drang-nges division is made from the side of what is expressed. No entry. Rendered plainly rather than as 'sở thuyên' (所詮), which occurs nowhere in the corpus; if the Sino-Vietnamese pair năng thuyên / sở thuyên is wanted elsewhere, this should be swept with it.

p0693 l.1. Uses the glossary's ཚད་མ = 'lượng' (from ཚད་མར་གྱུར་པ = 'đã trở thành lượng'), whose own entry already asks for a ruling on the opaque bare calque. སྒྲུབ་བྱེད = 'năng lập'. No entry for either.

p0691 l.1, in the ten-member ātman-synonym list of the Akṣayamatinirdeśa. glossary.json has only ཤེད་བུ་སེར་སྐྱ = 'người tên Kapila'. Rendered literally to stay parallel with the registered ཤེད་ལས་སྐྱེས་པ = 'kẻ sinh ra từ loài người', which stands immediately before it; the two are near-synonyms in Tibetan too. The established Sino-Vietnamese for mānava is 'nho đồng' (儒童) — a ruling should pick one, since the pair recurs.

p0691 l.1, last two members of the same ātman-synonym list. No entries. ཚོར་བ་པོ built on the glossary's provisional ཚོར་བ = 'cảm thọ'. This list should be registered as a set together with the six-member list already noted at p0608 (c184), which shares five members.

p0691 l.1 and the Samādhirāja verse at p0692 l.1. glossary.json's provisional bare སྐྱེས་བུ = 'bậc trượng phu' carries an honorific 'bậc' that is wrong inside a list of designations for a self (beside ngã, chúng sinh, mạng). Rendered without 'bậc'. This is the third chunk to flag the bare word — see the existing notes at p0139 and p0213.

p0691 l.1, inside the Akṣayamatinirdeśa quotation. glossary.json registers རྣམ་པར་ཐར་པ = 'hành trạng', but its own note scopes that to the biographical sense; here it is plainly liberation. Matches c168 l.55 ('các cửa giải thoát'). Register the compound so the scoping is explicit.

The sibling section heading སྟོང་པ་ཉིད་ཀྱི་ལྟ་བ་གཏན་ལ་འབེབས་པའི་ཚུལ (p0690 l.5), plus p0692 l.1 and p0693 l.1 (གཏན་ལ་དབབ་བྱ). No entry. 'quyết trạch' has 24 corpus occurrences (c015, c031, c032) for this verb and is kept distinct from ངེས་པ = 'sự xác quyết'. The heading is c209's, so one ruling now keeps the two chunks in step.

p0693, ཐུན་མོང་གི་ཆོས་ཡིན་པས་སྦྱར་དགོས — a property shared across the cases, so the 'ultimate' qualifier carries over where it is not written. glossary.json renders ཐུན་མོང་བ = 'cộng thông' for paths and vows; 'pháp cộng thông' would import a technical sense the passage does not have, so the plain word is used. Needs the scope recorded.
Etymological gloss of དྲང་བའི་དོན at p0693 l.1 (`དྲང་བའི་དོན་ནམ་དོན་དྲང་དགོས་པའོ`). Register alongside དྲང་དོན.
Etymological gloss of ངེས་པའི་དོན at p0692 l.3 (`ངེས་པའི་དོན་ནམ་དོན་ངེས་པ`). Register alongside ངེས་དོན.

The section heading of s213. Tibetan says only 'endowed with four'; Vietnamese needs a noun, so '[đặc điểm]' is bracketed as supplied. The body immediately after enumerates non-conceptuality, clarity free of laxity, and joy-and-bliss (dgaʼ + bde counted separately gives four), but the heading itself names nothing, so nothing was filled in.

p0685 verse, `rang gi nor bu rin po che // dor nas gzhan gyi mching bu ma len par`. No entry. Contrasted with ནོར་བུ་རིན་པོ་ཆེ, so it must be a lesser stone; read as a variant of མཆོང་བུ (agate/cornelian bead). Uncertain — see flags.

p0685 verse, `snying rus tsam la re ba'i bsam gtan pa` → 'những người tu tĩnh lự chỉ trông cậy nơi lòng gắng sức suông'. No entry. Kept distinct from བརྩོན་འགྲུས = tinh tấn (fixed), which does not occur here.

p0687, `hwa shang la gnod byed du drangs pas`. No entry. གནོད་པ is registered as 'tổn hại', but 'làm điều tổn hại đối với Hashang' does not parse as the technical 'refuting factor'. 'điều phá bác' chosen; corpus already uses 'bác bỏ' for the verbal act (c007, c032, c132). A ruling should decide whether the noun གནོད་བྱེད gets its own word or is folded into the བཀག་པ/སུན་འབྱིན family.
p0687, `bdag med pa'i don nyan pa'i thos bsam ma byas par`. No compound entry (only ཐོས་པ = văn, provisional). Follows existing corpus usage in c011 and c032 ('giai đoạn văn và tư').
p0687, closing `gsungs par gdon mi za'o`. Idiom, 'there is no doubt that'. No entry.
p0685 verse, `re zhig ngal bso byas na gnod pa chung` — Tsongkhapa's sharp remark that such practitioners would harm the Conqueror's teaching less by resting a while. No entry.

terms.vi: tiên nhân (các tiên nhân ngoại đạo)
terms.note: p0687 l.1, c205 l.55. WORDING KEPT. The view carries prov `དྲང་སྲོང` -> 'đấng Đại Tiên', but its own note scopes that to the Uttaratantra verse where it is an epithet of the Buddha. Applying that honorific to the tīrthika ṛṣis here would be positively wrong — the sentence's whole point is that they have samādhi and abhijñā but no view of selflessness and so cannot cross saṃsāra at all. Needs a second, non-honorific entry exactly like the `སྟོན་པ` Buddha/generic split already recorded, so Phase 5 does not read this as drift.

terms.vi: thẩm sát (l.19) vs quán sát (l.42) — unresolved
terms.note: c205 reproduces the corpus split internally: `དོན་ལའང་དཔྱོད་པར་རིགས` (p0685 l.1) -> 'thẩm sát' at l.19, but `ཤེས་རབ་ཀྱིས་རྣམ་པར་དཔྱད་པར་བྱ་སྟེ` (p0686 l.1) -> 'quán sát' at l.42. BOTH KEPT — the view's `དཔྱོད་པ` -> 'thẩm sát' note already documents the unruled c083 ('quán sát') vs c125/c134 ('thẩm sát') split and asks for one ruling. This chunk shows the split now occurring inside a single chunk, which strengthens the case: pin bare `དཔྱད/དཔྱོད` and `རྣམ་པར་དཔྱད་པ` in one ruling and sweep c083, c125, c134, c205 together. Constraint carried over from that note: the chosen word must not collide with `རྟོག་པ` -> 'phân biệt', nor with `ངེས་པར་རྟོག་པ` -> 'thẩm sát quyết định'.

terms.vi: quán xét riêng từng phần (l.53), beside giản trạch riêng từng phần for སོ་སོར་རྟོག
terms.note: p0686 l.3, one quoted stanza and its prose gloss. `གལ་ཏེ་ཆོས་ལ་བདག་མེད་སོ་སོར་རྟོག` -> 'giản trạch riêng từng phần' (correct per the view's `སོ་སོར་རྟོག་པ` = giản trạch note), while the next quoted line `སོ་སོར་དེ་བརྟགས་གལ་ཏེ་བསྒོམ་པ་ནི` and the gloss `སོ་སོར་བརྟགས་ནས` -> 'quán xét riêng từng phần'. BOTH KEPT — bare `བརྟག/བརྟགས` has no ruling in the view, so this is a gap. But the two Tibetan forms are doing one job across three adjacent clauses of the same argument, and the Vietnamese currently hides that. A ruling should say whether `སོ་སོར་བརྟགས` is to be aligned with `སོ་སོར་རྟོག་པ` = giản trạch, or kept distinct on purpose.

p0685 l.1, c205 l.24, Tsongkhapa's own closing verse. WORDING KEPT. The view carries four scoped senses: nominal 'bậc học giả' (p0106), 'bậc trí' for verse/contrastive occurrences (×3, all either paired with `བྱིས་པ` or inside MMK/BCA citations), adjectival 'khéo léo', and the kauśalya sense. This occurrence is in verse but has no `བྱིས་པ` contrast and denotes a real living teacher to be relied on, so the primary nominal entry fits. Nothing currently licenses 'bậc học giả' inside a verse, however, so the scoping needs stating explicitly: verse alone should not trigger 'bậc trí' — the contrast with `བྱིས་པ` should.

terms.vi: bậc thiện tri thức chân chánh
terms.note: p0687 l.1, c205 l.61. WORDING KEPT, translator did nothing wrong. Recorded only so the pending ruling is not lost: houseStyle in the c205 view lists only sinh/sanh and phúc/phước, and the view's own c034 note records `chân chánh` as an unruled case with a proposed rule ('chính' in free or adverbial use, 'chánh' only inside fixed Sino-Buddhist compounds). Under that proposal this would become 'chân chính'. No other southern spellings occur in c205. Also worth settling in the same ruling: whether `བཤེས་གཉེན་དམ་པ` gets its own entry beside FIXED `དགེ་བའི་བཤེས་གཉེན` -> 'thiện tri thức'.

terms.bo: སྐྱོང (sustaining samādhi / a view: སྐྱོང་ཚུལ, ལྟ་བ་དེ་སྐྱོང་ཞིང་བསྒོམ་པ)
terms.note: Not a gap that changed any wording — the text was brought INTO line with the recorded prov `སྐྱོང་ཚུལ` -> 'cách thức gìn giữ'. Recorded because that entry is scoped to p0058 (6.1's second sub-topic), while c205 uses it twice in the śamatha/view-sustaining sense at p0685 l.1 and p0686 l.3. The scope should simply be widened to cover 'sustain what has been attained' generally, so later chunks are not left guessing whether the p0058 scope binds them.

p0701, `འདི་ཡང་བུདྡྷ་པཱ་ལི་ཏ་ལས། ... ཞེས་གསུངས་པ་ལྟར`. Cited as a WORK, and the Tibetan uses the Sanskrit transliteration (not སངས་རྒྱས་བསྐྱངས, which p0699 uses for the author). Kept in transliteration, italicised as a title. glossary.json has no entry for either the person or the text (only སྐྱོང་བ/བསྐྱངས་པ -> 'gìn giữ', unrelated). The author name སངས་རྒྱས་བསྐྱངས (p0699, c209's range) needs ruling at the same time — 'Phật Hộ' is the established Vietnamese and occurs 0× in the corpus so far.

p0702. UNCERTAIN — see flags. Rendered as a title on the model of the registered འགྲེལ་པ = 'bản chú giải' (prov). དོན་གསལ = 'clear meaning' (Skt. Spuṭārthā), but the quoted objection is about dreams, the ten non-virtues and giving, addressed to the Mādhyamika, so I could not confirm which commentary is meant. Needs an owner ruling on the title before it is treated as settled.
p0702, `རང་སྡེ་...དངོས་པོར་སྨྲ་བ་རྣམས` — the non-Madhyamaka BUDDHIST schools, as opposed to non-Buddhists. NO entry. Kept distinct from ནང་པ (insider/Buddhist) and from གྲུབ་མཐའ = tông nghĩa.

p0700 ×1, p0701 ×2: `བདག་ཏུ་གདགས་པའི་གཞི` -> 'cơ sở để giả danh là ngã'. NO entry. Must be ruled together with བཏགས་ཡོད = 'giả hữu' and kept apart from སྒྲོ་འདོགས་པ = 'gán đặt', all three of which occur in this chunk.

p0702, ×2 (`མྱུ་གུ་ལ་སོགས་པ་རྣམས་བདེན་མེད་དུ་བསྒྲུབ`, `རྨི་ལམ་དང་འདྲ་བའི་བདེན་མེད`). NO entry. Kept deliberately distinct from the FIXED རང་བཞིན་མེད་པ = 'vô tự tánh', which occurs ~20× in this same chunk — the two are different words and this passage sets them side by side. Sino-Vietnamese alternatives considered and left to the owner: 'vô đế thật', 'vô thật'.

p0702, `དངོས་པོར་སྨྲ་བ་རྣམས་ཀྱི་རང་ལུགས` and the parallel `དབུ་མ་པའི་ལུགས` -> 'tông của phái Trung Quán'. glossary.json's provisional bare ལུགས = 'chủ trương' would read badly here ('chủ trương riêng của các nhà chủ trương thật hữu') and the sense is a SYSTEM, not a single assertion. SCOPE REQUEST rather than a contradiction of that entry.

p0702, `བདག་དེ་ཁོ་ནར་མེད་པར་ངེས་ན` / `དེའི་མིག་...དེ་ཁོ་ནར་ཡོད་པར་འཛིན་པ`. Follows the registered དེ་ཁོ་ན་ཉིད = 'thật tánh' (prov) so the adverb stays visibly the same word. Not 'thật sự có', which would collapse it onto བདེན་པ.

terms.vi: không nhận thấy / nhận thấy · duyên đến
terms.note: p0700 ×5, p0701 ×2. glossary.json registers only the NOMINAL དམིགས་པ = 'sở duyên' (ālambana). The corpus verbal use is 'duyên đến' (9×), which fits the positive occurrences here (`གཟུགས་...ལ་དམིགས་པས`, `ཕུང་པོ་ལ་དམིགས་པའི་ཕྱིར` -> 'duyên đến'), but not the negated ones, where the sense is 'not found on analysis'. I used 'duyên đến' for the positive and 'không nhận thấy' for the negative, and flagged it — see flags.
p0702, ×2, the continuum on which the completion of a karma-path is posited. NO entry.
p0702, the standard example of an impossible object. NO entry; 'thạch nữ' occurs 0× in the corpus so far.
p0702, ×2, the standard Madhyamaka example. NO headword, though 'mầm' is already the corpus rendering in the dependent-origination chapters (15 occurrences, e.g. 'mầm lúa gạo').
p0702, `...ལ་རྒོལ་བའི་དོན་མེད་དོ` -> 'lời vấn nạn ... sẽ trở thành vô nghĩa'. NO entry.

p0701, inside the Madhyamakāvatāra verse `དེ་སྲིད་དེ་ལ་ངར་འཛིན་ཡོད`. NO entry. Kept distinct from བདག་ཏུ་འཛིན་པ (the registered གང་ཟག་གི་བདག་ཏུ་འཛིན་པ family) because both appear in this chunk and the verse's force is the first-person 'I'.

terms.vi: Bao lâu còn có sự chấp uẩn, / Bấy lâu còn có sự chấp "ta" nơi đó.
terms.note: p0701, cited inside the འཇུག་འགྲེལ quotation via `ཇི་སྐད་དུ`. Source not named in the Tibetan; recorded so a later chunk citing the same lines uses the same wording.

terms.vi: Nếu bản thân cái ngã đã không có, / Thì ngã sở làm sao có được?
terms.note: p0700, cited inside the ཚིག་གསལ quotation. Uses the registered བདག་གི་བ = 'ngã sở' for བདག་གི. Recorded for consistency if the same verse recurs.

terms.kind: no ruling — corpus is split, one form should be fixed
terms.note: c210 L11 (p0700 འཛིན་པ་ལྡོག་པར་འགྱུར་བའི་ཕྱིར་ཏེ) and L39 (p0702 འཛིན་པ་ལྡོག་པར་འགྱུར་བའི་ཕྱིར་རོ) render it "tiêu dứt"; c209 renders the same verb (p0699 ལྡོག་པར་མཐོང་བས, and ལྡོག in the surrounding passage) as "bị đảo ngược" / "quay lui". ལྡོག is turn back / be reversed / cease, so "đảo ngược" is the closer gloss and "tiêu dứt" (be extinguished) is at the strong end of the range. Kept here per the repair rule (no ruling exists), but a single form should be fixed and both chunks aligned to it — this one is the one to change if "đảo ngược" wins.

p0707 l.1, དབུ་མ་རང་རྒྱུད་པ་ཁོ་ནའི་ལུགས. GAP - glossary.json has no entry for either རང་རྒྱུད་པ or ཐལ་འགྱུར་བ, and the whole remaining śamatha/vipaśyanā division turns on the contrast. 'Tự Lập' renders svātantra (autonomous inference); the literal calque of རང་རྒྱུད would be 'Tự Tục' (自續). A ruling is needed NOW, before the sibling chunks c213+ pick a different form, and it should settle ཐལ་འགྱུར་བ (Prāsaṅgika) at the same time.

p0709. Nāgārjuna. GAP - no entry. Established Sino-Vietnamese title (迴諍論) used, on the precedent set for Lục Thập Chánh Lý Luận and Căn Bản Trung Luận. Not verified against an existing Vietnamese edition.

p0710 ×5 (རབ་བྱེད་ཉེར་བཞི་པ / ཉེར་དྲུག་པ / ཉེར་ལྔ / རབ་བྱེད་གཞན). glossary.json has རབ་བྱེད only inside the title ཕུང་པོ་ལྔའི་རབ་བྱེད = *Ngũ Uẩn Luận* (prakaraṇa = luận). Here it is a chapter division, and 'phẩm' (品) is the standard for MMK chapters. Note c193 renders ལེའུ/བརྟག་པ of a tantra as 'chương' / 'phần khảo sát', so the two need to be kept apart deliberately.
p0710, the name of MMK chapter 24. Built from the glossary's འཕགས་པའི་བདེན་པ་བཞི = 'bốn thánh đế' and c193's བརྟག་པ = 'khảo sát'.

p0708, ཕྲ་ཞིང་མཛངས་ལ་ཤིན་ཏུ་རྒྱ་ཆེ་བའི་རྣམ་དཔྱོད་དང་ལྡན་པ. GAP. Occurs only twice in the whole corpus (p0633, p0708), so it is cheap to fix now. Kept apart from བློ = 'trí' and from ཤེས་རབ = 'trí tuệ'; c190 covers p0633 and should be checked for what it used.

terms.vi: cái sở sinh và cái năng sinh
terms.note: p0709 ×2, p0711. GAP. The བྱ/བྱེད (karman/kartṛ) pairing is the argument's whole point, so the Vietnamese must keep sở/năng visible.
p0709 ×2. GAP. Paired with the entry above; 'tác dụng' alone would collapse the agent half.

p0709-p0710, ~10× including the MMK XXIV.14 verse (གང་ལ་སྟོང་པ་ཉིད་རུང་བ). GAP for this sense. glossary.json registers རུང་བ only inside ལས་སུ་རུང་བ = 'kham nhậm' and བཀོལ་དུ་རུང་བ. Deliberately kept apart from འཐད་པ = 'hợp lý', which stands beside it in the same sentences (མི་འཐད / མི་རུང), though the two are near-synonyms in Tibetan.

p0707-p0710, throughout, including this chunk's own section heading དེ་མི་འཐད་པར་བསྟན་པ. GAP - no entry, though the corpus already uses 'hợp lý' (c012, c047). Registering it matters because the heading recurs and because it must stay separable from རུང་བ.

p0707-p0710, ~10×, including the sa-bcad headings. glossary.json's འགོག་པ = 'diệt [đế]' is scoped by its own note to nirodha, so this sense is unregistered; 'phủ định' follows c183. Kept apart from བཟློག་པ = 'ngăn dứt' (glossary) and from སྤོང་བ = 'khước bỏ' (glossary), both of which occur in this chunk's verses - the Vigrahavyāvartanī verse uses བཟློག་པ and Tsongkhapa's own gloss immediately substitutes འགོག་པ, so collapsing them would erase the gloss.

p0708, གཞིའི་ལྟ་བ་གཏན་ལ་འབེབས་ཚུལ, standing beside ལམ = 'đạo' and འབྲས་བུ = 'quả'. glossary.json's གཞི = 'cơ sở' is scoped by its own note to the fourfold karmapatha frame (གཞི/བསམ་པ/སྦྱོར་བ/མཐར་ཐུག), which is a different technical use. A scoped second sense is owed.
p0709, རིག་གནས་དུ་མ་ལ་ཆེས་ཤིན་ཏུ་སྦྱངས་པ. Follows c005's 'bốn minh xứ' for རིག་གནས་བཞི, but the bare term has no entry.
p0708, in the Mādhyamika's proclamation. GAP.

p0710. CONFIRMATION, not a gap: matches the registered ལུགས་འབྱུང་དང་ལུགས་ལྡོག = 'chiều thuận và chiều nghịch' (p0322-p0324), including its refusal of the Sino-Vietnamese 'lưu chuyển / hoàn diệt'. Recorded so the choice is not relitigated.
p0707 l.13, `ཆོས་སྐུ་དམ་པ་དང་གཟུགས་སྐུ་དམ་པ་གཉིས་འཐོབ་པ`. No entry. Also affects the plain `སྐུ་གཉིས` -> 'hai thân' at p0708 l.1.

p0707 l.13, same sentence as ཆོས་སྐུ. No entry. The attached `དམ་པ` is rendered 'tối thắng' following the registered `དམ་པ (adjectival, bare) -> tối thắng` (prov); the Sixty Stanzas verse just above renders `དམ་པ་གཉིས` as 'Hai điều tối thắng' for consistency.

p0719 l.3 has both forms in one sentence (དངོས་སྨྲའི་རྩོད་པ and དངོས་པོར་སྨྲ་བའི་རྩོད་པ). glossary.json's only entry for དངོས་པོར་སྨྲ་བ records 'not rendered in this chunk' (c211's agent wrote 'các vị ấy'). I followed c212, the immediately preceding section, which renders it 'nhà chủ trương sự vật'. NOTE the corpus divergence: c211 uses 'các nhà chủ trương thật hữu' for the same school. One ruling is needed, and it should cover the contracted spelling too so the sweep sees one term.

p0718 l.5. glossary.json registers ཟླ་བ་གྲགས་པ / སློབ་དཔོན་ཟླ་བ་གྲགས་པ / སློབ་དཔོན་ཆེན་པོ་ཟླ་བ་གྲགས་པ = Nguyệt Xứng / A-xà-lê Nguyệt Xứng / đại A-xà-lê Nguyệt Xứng, but not the bare short form ཟླ་བ. 'Xứng' is bracketed as supplied so the abbreviation is visible.
p0718–p0719, 8×; the running example of what the opponent's reasoning is said to destroy. No entry. Wording taken from c212, which uses it in the same argument.

p0718 l.5, p0719 ×3. No entry. Matches c212's rendering of the MMK XXIV.1 pāda འབྱུང་བ་མེད་ཅིང་འཇིག་པ་མེད ('chẳng có sinh khởi, chẳng có hoại diệt'). Kept distinct from སྐྱེ་འགག = 'sinh và diệt' below, since both stand in the same sentences.
p0718 l.5, p0719 ×2. No entry. Deliberately worded apart from འབྱུང་འཇིག so the two Tibetan compounds stay separable in Vietnamese; they occur side by side.

p0719 l.3, བདེན་པ་གཉིས་གང་དུའང་མི་རུང་བ. glossary.json rules only ཀུན་རྫོབ་བདེན་པ = thế tục đế and དོན་དམ་པའི་བདེན་པ = thắng nghĩa đế; the pair-word has no entry. 'hai đế' follows c212 ('sự xác quyết về hai đế', 'nơi cả hai đế'); 'nhị đế' deliberately not used, to stay with the corpus.
p0718 l.5. Plural of the registered provisional ཁྱེད = 'ông'. The whole section addresses the opponent in the plural, so registering the plural form keeps the address stable.
p0719 l.3 (the sentence that runs into p0720). No entry; the opponent's first-person plural self-reference.

p0719 l.3, རྒྱུ་མཚན་ཡང་དག་པ་ཅི་ཡང་མེད་དོ. No entry for either རྒྱུ་མཚན or ཡང་དག་པ. 'chân chánh' for ཡང་དག་པ follows the precedent recorded in the c142 note; see flags for the chánh/chính question that is still unruled.

terms.vi: cách thức đem lại [sự xác quyết]
terms.note: p0718 l.1. A -ལུགས compound, like the registered སྒྲུབ་ལུགས = 'cách thức thành tựu' and བསྐྱེད་ལུགས = 'cách thức phát khởi'; the bare ལུགས = 'chủ trương' entry does not fit. Recorded only so the compound family stays consistent.

p0719 l.4, x2 (dngos smra'i rtsod pa bkod pa; dngos por smra ba'i rtsod pa bkod pa). The c215 view carries the headword only as `prov དངོས་པོར་སྨྲ་བ -> (not rendered in this chunk)` - recorded with no Vietnamese ruling at all, so this is a gap, not a departure. Wording kept: it builds on the licensed དངོས་པོ = 'sự vật' and reads as the agentive. A ruling should also settle whether the abbreviated དངོས་སྨྲ and the full དངོས་པོར་སྨྲ་བ take the same Vietnamese (they do here) and whether the agentive prefix is 'nhà' or 'các vị' - note this chunk now uses 'các vị' for དབུ་མ་པ per that entry's provisional ruling, so the two agentives are currently inconsistent in prefix. The term is dense through this whole Madhyamaka section.

terms.vi: mang hành tướng của các đế
terms.note: p0662 l.1 (the chunk's opening words), paired with ཞི་རགས་ཀྱི་རྣམ་པ་ཅན as the two kinds of path that can purify afflictions. The view registers རྣམ་པ་ཅན = 'có hành tướng' and notes བདེན་པའི་རྣམ་པ་ཅན at p0679, but has no ruling for the compound. Deliberately NOT 'hành tướng của bốn đế': the Tibetan writes no numeral, and c203 already renders the same phrase 'hành tướng các đế'. Supplying '[bốn]' would add a claim the source does not make.

terms.vi: hành tướng tịch tĩnh và thô
terms.note: The view asks c198 to settle this. Settled to 'tịch tĩnh và thô', which is what c200 (×2), c201 (×3) and c203/c204 already write for the same phrase. NOT settled to c197's trailing 'hành tướng của cái tĩnh và cái thô' (the phrase is cut at the c197/c198 seam) nor to c202's heading form 'hành tướng tịnh và thô'. A sweep of c197 and c202 is owed; see flags.

p0664 l.1, ལུས་དང་སེམས་ལ་བདེ་ཉམས་ཆེན་པོ་སྐྱེ་བ — the great bliss-experience that the opponents mistake for the completion stage. No entry for ཉམས in the view. Kept distinct from བདེ་བ = 'lạc' (registered) and from ཕུལ་དུ་བྱུང་བའི་བདེ་བ = 'niềm an lạc tuyệt vời' three lines earlier, so that the experiential noun and the plain noun stay apart.

p0663 l.1, the conclusion of the śamatha/khinh an reciprocity argument, glossed in the Śrāvakabhūmi quotation by གཅིག་ལ་གཅིག་བརྟེན་པ་དང་གཅིག་ལ་གཅིག་རག་ལས་པ = 'cái này nương vào cái kia và cái này tùy thuộc cái kia'. Recorded only so the prose summary and the quotation stay visibly matched.

terms.vi: hành tướng tịch tĩnh và thô
terms.note: p0664 ཞི་རགས་ཀྱི་རྣམ་པ་ཅན་དུ་ལྟ་བའི་འཇིག་རྟེན་པའི་ལམ་རྣམས, rendered 'các đạo thế gian vốn quán [sự vật] theo hành tướng tịch tĩnh và thô' (L37). Wording KEPT: it matches the view's registered provisional ཞི་རགས (in ཞི་རགས་ཀྱི་རྣམ་པ་ཅན) -> 'tịch tĩnh và thô' exactly, and the view carries no fixed ruling for the phrase. But three competing provisionals for one phrase now stand in the view: (a) ཞི་རགས་ཀྱི་རྣམ་པ -> 'hành tướng của cái tĩnh và cái thô' (p0661, c197, whose note says 'c198 should settle it'), (b) ཞི་རགས་ཀྱི་རྣམ་པ་ཅན -> 'mang hành tướng tịnh và thô' (p0673-p0675), (c) ཞི་རགས -> 'tịch tĩnh và thô' (this chunk). c197's file literally ends mid-sentence with 'hành tướng của cái tĩnh và cái thô…' two lines earlier in the book, so (a) and (c) render the same continuous sentence differently across the chunk seam. One ruling is owed for the whole mundane-path section (c197, c198, c200-c202 and both sa-bcad headings). Recommendation: take (c) 'hành tướng tịch tĩnh và thô' as the single form — it is the technical name of the path, avoids the collision the view itself flags between the 'tịnh' of (b) and the 'tịnh' of tịnh chỉ = ཞི་གནས (both stand in the same sentences here), and keeps ཞི first as the Tibetan has it. If (c) is adopted, c197's final line and the p0673-p0675 chunks need the same word, so the ruling should be applied backward as well as forward. I did not change c198 for this, since the ruling is not mine to make and the text already follows the provisional registered for these pages.

terms.bo: བདེ་བ (in the śamatha section: ཕུལ་དུ་བྱུང་བའི་བདེ་བ, བདེ་ཉམས་ཆེན་པོ, ལུས་ཐམས་ཅད་བདེ་བས་གང་བ)
terms.note: p0664 l.1, three occurrences, rendered 'niềm an lạc tuyệt vời' (L33), 'cảm nghiệm an lạc lớn lao' and 'toàn thân tràn đầy an lạc' (L35). The view registers only the provisional བདེ་བ -> 'lạc' [sukha], whose own note scopes it to p0290. Wording KEPT: the bare noun 'lạc' will not carry a Vietnamese predicate here ('tràn đầy lạc', 'cảm nghiệm lạc lớn lao' do not parse), and corpus precedent from the immediately preceding discussion of this same samādhi is 'an lạc' — c195 renders བདེ་གསལ་མི་རྟོག as 'an lạc, sáng tỏ và không phân biệt'. Ruling owed: record the śamatha/absorption sense of བདེ་བ as 'an lạc', keeping 'lạc' for the p0290 use (or for compound positions where it is a bound element, e.g. བདེ་བ་ཅན, བདེ་སྡུག).

terms.bo: ཞི་ལྷག (ཞི་ལྷག་གི་ངོས་འཛིན) beside ལྷག་མཐོང in one sentence
terms.vi: chỉ quán (sự nhận định chỉ quán)
terms.kind: note-only, no change owed to the text
terms.note: p0665, rendered 'sự nhận định chỉ quán' (L41) in the same sentence that renders ལྷག་མཐོང as 'thắng quán' and, later in that sentence, ཞི་གནས་དང་ལྷག་མཐོང as 'tịnh chỉ và thắng quán'. NOT a violation: decisions.md §1's 'never tịnh chỉ beside bare quán' bars mixing registers for ONE term, these are two distinct Tibetan terms, the registered provisional ཞི་ལྷག -> 'chỉ quán' licenses the compact form for the contraction, ངོས་འཛིན -> 'sự nhận định' is registered in the view for this very passage (line 532-533, cited as p0665), and the view's c180 note (line 418-419) already resolved this exact collocation permissively. Request: state in the ཞི་ལྷག entry's note (and in decisions.md §1) that the contraction ཞི་ལྷག keeps its own 'chỉ quán' register even when ཞི་གནས / ལྷག་མཐོང stand in the same sentence, so the Phase 5 sweep does not re-flag it a fourth time.
p0711. Nāgārjuna. No entry anywhere in glossary or corpus. Established Sino-Vietnamese title 七十空性論. Not verified against an existing Vietnamese edition.

p0712. Nāgārjuna's hymn. No entry. Built on the glossary's འཇིག་རྟེན་ལས་འདས་པ = 'xuất thế gian' (prov) plus བསྟོད་པ = 'tán thán' (prov), giving 出世間讚. Not verified against an existing Vietnamese edition.

p0711, Vigrahavyāvartanī v.70-71, 4×: གང་ལ་སྟོང་ཉིད་འདི་སྲིད་པ / མི་སྲིད་པ. GAP for this sense. The registered སྲིད་པ = 'hữu' [bhava] is the wrong word here — this is the verb 'is possible', the exact synonym of the རུང་བ that the surrounding MMK verse and the Prasannapadā use. Deliberately NOT rendered 'khả dĩ', so that the reader can see the Tibetan uses a different word in the Vigrahavyāvartanī than in MMK XXIV.14; a ruling should say whether the two should be merged onto 'khả dĩ' or kept apart.

p0712, Lokātītastava: རྒྱུ་མེད་རྟོག་གེ་པ་ཡིས་འདོད. GAP, no entry and no corpus precedent for either རྟོག་གེ or རྟོག་གེ་པ. 'nhà lý luận' is deliberately neutral — the Tibetan does not say 'ngoại đạo', though that is who is meant.

p0713, Prasannapadā, 2×: སྡུག་བསྔལ་ཡོངས་སུ་ཤེས་པ, the first of the four activities on the four truths. GAP. 遍知 biến tri is the established Sino-Vietnamese for parijñā and keeps it apart from plain ཤེས་པ (= 'biết', used two lines earlier in Tsongkhapa's own summary).
p0713-p0714, 3×. GAP. The 果 half of the eight-fold ārya saṃgha (four pairs / eight persons).

p0714, 2×, paired with འབྲས་བུ་ལ་གནས་པ. GAP, and the rendering is uncertain — see flags. The Tibetan says only 'entered'; the standard Sino-Vietnamese counterpart of 'trụ quả' is 'hướng' (向), which would give 'những vị hướng [quả]'. '[đạo]' is bracketed because the Tibetan supplies no object.
p0712, Lokātītastava: མཉམ་མེད་ཁྱོད་ཀྱི་སེང་གེའི་སྒྲ. GAP.
p0712, epithet of the Buddha in the Lokātītastava. GAP; kept distinct from མཚུངས་པ་མེད་པ in the same chunk, which is rendered 'vô song' (p0711, twice).

terms.vi: theo cái nhìn of kẻ khác
terms.note: p0712, གཞན་ངོ་ལ་སོགས་པ་ལ་སྐྱེལ་བ. GAP. Rendered descriptively as 'đẩy sang [chỗ] "theo cái nhìn của kẻ khác"' — the technical sense is relegating dependent arising to what holds only in others' perception. A compact Sino-Vietnamese term (e.g. 'tha tông' / 'theo tha nhân') may be preferable; flagged rather than coined.

GAP. No headword for Tathāgata anywhere in the view, though FIXED entries exist for སངས་རྒྱས, རྒྱལ་བ, ཀླུ་སྒྲུབ, ཤཱཀྱའི་གཙོ་བོ. p0711, Śūnyatāsaptati verse. The classifier 'đấng' follows the precedent of FIXED རྒྱལ་བ -> Đấng Chiến Thắng and མགོན་པོ -> đấng Hộ Chủ; the ruling should confirm whether it is carried.

GAP WITH A LIVE COLLISION — most urgent of these. p0713, Prasannapadā: འཕགས་པའི་བདེན་པ་བཞི་རྣམས་རིགས་པར་འགྱུར་རོ. The view registers only prov རིགས་པ -> chánh lý (the NOUN, yukti, inside ལུང་དང་རིགས་པས); there is no ruling for this verbal sense. Rendering it 'hợp lý' collapses it into འཐད་པ, which view lines 316-320 record as being kept DELIBERATELY apart from རུང་བ -> khả dĩ because all these words stand side by side in these very sentences. The chunk is otherwise clean on that split (every རུང་བ = khả dĩ, every འཐད་པ = hợp lý, སྲིད་པ in the Vigrahavyāvartanī verse kept apart as 'có thể có'), so this is the one leak. Wording KEPT per the repair rule for gaps; a ruling is needed. A distinct word such as 'đúng lý' would separate the three, but that is a central call, not a chunk-level one.

terms.vi: những điều làm hại mà [họ] nêu ra
terms.note: Section heading (s232) གནོད་བྱེད་བརྗོད་པ་རྣམས་ཀྱིས་སུན་མི་ཕྱིན་པར་བསྟན་པ།, p0735. Wording taken VERBATIM from c212 l.15, which announces this very section in its enumeration ('trình bày rằng [chủ trương của chúng tôi] không bị những điều làm hại mà [họ] nêu ra bác bỏ'), so the heading and its announcement match. Note the collision the ruling must settle: the view registers prov གནོད་བྱེད -> 'điều phá bác' (p0687, the Bhāvanākrama cited against Hashang), and this chunk ALSO uses 'làm hại' for the verbal རིགས་པས་གནོད་པ ('bị chánh lý làm hại', ~4×), which is the passage's controlling contrast against རིགས་པས་དཔྱད་མི་བཟོད་པ. Keeping 'làm hại' for both the noun and the verb is deliberate here — the heading names exactly the objections the body then calls གནོད་པ.

terms.vi: chẳng bác bỏ được / chẳng thể phá trừ
terms.note: p0735, in the section heading and in three of the four enumerated sub-items. The view registers only prov སུན་འབྱིན (bare) -> 'phá trừ', whose own note says a ruling on the bare form is still owed. Here two different Tibetan verbs alternate for the same idea within four lines (སུན་མི་ཕྱིན་པ in the two headings, སུན་འབྱིན་མི་ནུས་པ in the enumeration items), and I rendered them differently ('bác bỏ' / 'phá trừ') to keep the alternation visible. 'phá trừ' follows the registered provisional; 'bác bỏ' matches c212's already-published wording for the parent heading. A ruling should say whether the two Tibetan forms get one Vietnamese word or two.

p0736 l.3 and p0738 l.5 (the latter runs into c221). Uses the view's prov ཐ་སྙད -> 'danh ngôn' and is built to parallel the registered prov རིགས་ཤེས -> 'trí chánh lý', which stands in explicit opposition to it in the same sentence (ཐ་སྙད་པའི་ཤེས་པས་འགྲུབ་པ ... རིགས་ཤེས་ཀྱིས་མི་འགྲུབ་པ). Note that c211 renders the parallel ཐ་སྙད་པའི་མིག་ཤེས as 'nhãn thức danh ngôn', i.e. ཤེས་པ as 'thức' there and 'trí' here. The pair should be ruled together.

p0735 l.5, བདེན་དངོས་སུ་ཐལ་བའི་སྐྱོན་མེད་དོ -> 'chẳng có lỗi thành ra [chúng] là vật thật hữu'. Contracted form of བདེན་པའི་དངོས་པོ. No entry. Built from the corpus's 'thật hữu' (c210/c211) plus the view's prov དངོས་པོ -> 'sự vật'; 'vật' rather than 'sự vật' only to keep the phrase short.

p0738 l.6, the closing exhortation བློ་གྲོས་དང་ལྡན་པ་རྣམས་ཀྱིས་ཞིབ་ཏུ་དཔྱོད་ལ. GAP — no entry for བློ་གྲོས. Deliberately NOT 'trí tuệ' (reserved for ཤེས་རབ) and NOT 'cái trí' (the view's prov for bare བློ, whose own note already flags that collision). Corpus precedent for the phrase-shape: 'bậc có trí' in c006/c012/c148/c161/c180/c212. Note c016 renders བློ་གྲོས as 'tuệ' inside an enumerated list where it stands beside བློ = 'trí', so a ruling should decide whether བློ་གྲོས gets its own word.

p0737 l.4, inside the Catuḥśataka-ṭīkā quotation: འཐད་པས་རྣམ་པར་དཔྱད་པ་ན -> 'lúc được thẩm sát bằng lý lẽ'. The view registers prov འཐད་པ -> 'hợp lý', which is the adjectival/predicative sense and is what I used everywhere else in this chunk (མི་འཐད་པ -> 'không hợp lý', ×3). Here it is an instrumental noun meaning the reasoning itself, and it stands two words from རིགས་པས་རྣམ་པར་དཔྱད་པ in the same quotation, so rendering it 'chánh lý' would collapse two distinct words inside a citation. A scoped second sense is owed.

p0737 l.4-5, ཡོད་པ་ཉིད་དུ་དམིགས་པར་འགྱུར་ན། དམིགས་པའང་མ་ཡིན་ཏེ, inside the Catuḥśataka-ṭīkā quotation. The view registers only the nominal prov དམིགས་པ -> 'sở duyên' (ālambana). Deliberately plain 'nhận thấy' rather than 'duyên' so it is not read as the ālambana term.

p0737 l.6 and p0738 l.2, རིགས་པའི་བརྟག་པ་མི་འཇུག་གོ / རིགས་པའི་བརྟག་པ་ཤིན་ཏུ་གཞུག་དགོས་པ. No entry. Kept distinct from དཔྱོད་པ -> 'thẩm sát' (the view's prov), which occurs throughout the same paragraphs; the two Tibetan words are near-synonyms but are used side by side here.

p0737 l.3, in the Catuḥśataka-ṭīkā triad དབང་པོ་དང་ཡུལ་དང་རྣམ་པར་ཤེས་པ -> 'các căn, các cảnh và các thức'. The view registers དབང་པོ only in the Śakra/Indra sense ('Đế Thích') and notes the sense-faculty compounds are unregistered as a bare headword. ཡུལ -> 'cảnh' follows the view's prov.

p0738 l.3, དབུ་མའི་ཚུལ་ལས་ཆེས་ཆེར་འཁྱམས་པ -> 'lạc rất xa khỏi cách thức của Trung Quán'. No entry for bare ཚུལ in this 'system / way of a school' sense. Kept apart from the view's prov ལུགས -> 'chủ trương', which is the word this passage would otherwise share.

terms.vi: sự giả danh nương vào [cái khác]
terms.note: p0735 l.1, ×2, quoting Buddhapālita: བརྟེན་ནས་གདགས་པར་ནི་གྲུབ་བོ. Uses the view's prov གདགས་པ -> 'giả danh' (registered from བདག་ཏུ་གདགས་པའི་གཞི, p0700-p0701). Registering the compound because it is the phrase on which this whole passage's contrast turns.

Epistemic sense: invalidated/refuted by reasoning — one of the two poles this whole section exists to distinguish (རིགས་པས་དཔྱད་མི་བཟོད་པ vs རིགས་པས་གནོད་པ, p0736 l.1, p0738 l.1 ×2). The view holds only prov གནོད་པ -> 'tổn hại', whose note scopes it against འཚེ་བ (bodily/ethical harm), so it does not cover this. Corpus precedent supports the wording: c135 l.23 'cái bị hại và cái làm hại' for the same epistemic pair, and 'bị chánh lý làm hại' also stands in c225, c226, c227, c229. Wording KEPT; a scoped entry is owed because the term names the section.

GAP — absent from the c219 view, yet it is one of the two parties of this whole section (p0732 ×3, p0733 ×1). Rendered agentively as 'kẻ chấp đoạn kiến' because the word names the person/school, not the view: it stands in every sentence opposite དབུ་མ་པ. Follows c211, which already renders bare ཆད་ལྟ as 'đoạn kiến'. A ruling should also fix whether the view itself (ཆད་ལྟ) and its holder (ཆད་ལྟ་བ) get visibly different Vietnamese.

terms.vi: kẻ chủ trương không có / phái chủ trương không có
terms.note: GAP. Occurs p0731–p0734 (×5 in my range, incl. inside two Prasannapadā quotations and the Buddhapālita quotation མེད་པ་པར་སྨྲ་བ). Rendered transparently rather than with 'hư vô luận' or 'chấp không', both of which add a qualifier the Tibetan does not carry; the whole argument turns on the difference between this school and ཆད་ལྟ་བ, so the two must not collapse onto one Vietnamese word. Note p0733 has the term written མེད་པ་པ༌དངོས་པོའི with an anomalous separator — see flags.

GAP. p0732 l.1, ལྟ་བ་འདྲ་བར་བསྟན་ཏོ — the school a self-styled Mādhyamika who denies karma even conventionally is said to resemble. 'Thuận Thế' (順世) is the established Sino-Vietnamese; kept distinct from མེད་པ་པ above, which the same passage treats as a separate party.

terms.vi: thành lập bằng thể tánh của chính nó
terms.note: p0732 ×2, p0733 ×1, p0734 ×2. No headword in the view. Follows c210/c211/c212, where this exact phrase occurs 4× and is the corpus-dominant form. Load-bearing here because རང་བཞིན (fixed = 'tự tánh') and ངོ་བོ (prov = 'thể tánh') stand inside a single noun phrase — རང་གི་ངོ་བོས་གྲུབ་པའི་རང་བཞིན — and must stay visibly distinct.

p0734, inside the Buddhapālita quotation རྒྱུ་དང་འབྲས་བུ་དང་ཚོགས་པའང་མེད་ན. No entry. This is the topic of MMK chapter 20 (the chapter whose commentary is being cited), so it is a technical term, not the ཚོགས = 'tư lương' of the view nor the assembly sense registered at p0468.

terms.vi: cái không trống rỗng cả khả năng tạo tác dụng
terms.note: p0734 l.2, དེས་ན་སྟོང་པ་དོན་བྱེད་ནུས་སྟོང་གི་སྟོང་པར་མ་སོང་བར. No entry for དོན་བྱེད་ནུས་པ (arthakriyā) anywhere in the view. The phrase names the wrong kind of emptiness the whole section is refuting, so it is worth pinning centrally.

p0734 l.1, a matched pair (སྣང་ཕྱོགས་ཀུན་རྫོབ་པ ... སྟོང་ཕྱོགས་ཀྱི་ལྟ་བ). No entries. Rendered as a visible pair so the contrast the sentence turns on survives; ཀུན་རྫོབ uses the registered 'thế tục'.

p0734 l.3, རབ་བྱེད་ཉི་ཤུ་པའི་འགྲེལ་པ = 'bản chú giải phẩm thứ hai mươi'. The view registers bare འགྲེལ་པ twice with different words — 'bản Thích' (line 106) and 'bản chú giải' (line 242, scoped to the Lamp commentary). Followed c210, which uses 'bản chú giải' for a named commentary. Also uses the registered རབ་བྱེད = 'phẩm' (MMK chapter sense).

SENSE SPLIT REQUESTED. p0734, inside the Buddhapālita quotation: ཇི་ལྟར་ཁྱོད་དུས་ལ་སོགས་པ་དག་ངོ་བོ་ཉིད་ལས་ཡོད་པར་ཡོངས་སུ་རྟོག་པར་བྱེད་པ. The view registers ཡོངས་སུ་རྟོག་པ = 'chu biến tầm tư' (paryeṣaṇā), but that entry is scoped by its own note to the nine-item vipaśyanā list and the Asaṅga gloss. Here the verb is the opponent's false imputation (parikalpa), the exact opposite of an investigative faculty; 'chu biến tầm tư' would be positively wrong. 'biến kế' is the established Sino-Vietnamese (biến kế sở chấp). Registering the split rather than overwriting either wording.

p0733, inside the Prasannapadā quotation, paired with ཁ་ན་མ་ཐོ་བ (registered = 'điều đáng chê trách'). Uses the view's provisional གྲགས་པ = 'danh tiếng' negated; recorded because the pair akīrti + avadya is a formula and the two must not converge in Vietnamese.

L46, p0734 l.3, inside the Buddhapālita quotation. The c219 view's only ruling is `prov ཡོངས་སུ་རྟོག་པ -> chu biến tầm tư [paryeṣaṇā]` (l.276), explicitly scoped to the p0577-p0578 nine-item vipaśyanā list — a different sense. So this sense is a genuine gap. I did NOT keep the prior wording `biến kế`, because it is not free: the corpus already uses `biến kế` / `biến kế sở chấp` for ཀུན་བརྟགས / parikalpita (verified in translation/c223.md L48, L50, L52), so `ngươi biến kế rằng` would tell the reader Buddhapālita is invoking the parikalpita-svabhāva, a doctrinal claim the Tibetan does not make. Replaced with the neutral `chấp rằng`. `giả lập` was rejected as a candidate because it collides twice — with ཀུན་བརྟགས at c223 L50 (`năng giả lập` / `được giả lập`) and with གདགས་པ -> `giả danh` in this very sentence. A ruling is owed: register ཡོངས་སུ་རྟོག་པ with two senses (paryeṣaṇā = chu biến tầm tư, p0577-p0578; parikalpayati = a neutral verb of imputing), and fix that second rendering centrally — `chấp rằng` here is my provisional choice, not a settled one.

terms.kind: compound vs FIXED headword — ruling owed, wording kept
terms.note: L17, p0732 l.3. `འཇིག་རྟེན` is FIXED -> `thế gian` (view l.29), but the compound འཇིག་རྟེན་སྔ་ཕྱི ('former and later worlds', i.e. past and future lives) has no headword in the view, and `đời trước đời sau` matches c218 L55 — same argument, same phrase — so this is standing corpus usage, not drift in this chunk. Kept. Needs an entry that either licenses the compound as a lexicalised exception to the fixed term or aligns it to `thế gian` — noting that c218's own quotation block uses `thế gian đời trước` / `thế gian bên kia` for འཇིག་རྟེན་ཕ་རོལ, so the section is internally split and only a central ruling can settle it.

terms.vi: nhà Trung Quán / các nhà Trung Quán
terms.kind: prov entry is the outlier — ruling owed, wording kept
terms.note: L17, L19, L21, L25. The view carries `prov དབུ་མ་པ -> các vị Trung Quán` (l.316, from p0665, noted as unregistered: the glossary has only དབུ་མ = Trung Quán, the system). `nhà Trung Quán` is what c211, c212, c215, c216 and c218 all use, so the provisional entry is the minority form and changing c219 alone would deepen the split. Kept. A central ruling is owed on the agentive པ; if `các vị Trung Quán` wins, the five earlier chunks move too. Note also that in this chunk the term is repeatedly contrasted with ཆད་ལྟ་བ, so whatever form is chosen must sit naturally opposite that one.

terms.kind: three-way provisional split — ruling owed, wording kept
terms.note: L27, p0733 l.1, inside the Prasannapadā quotation (`གཞན་ནི་དེ་དངོས་སུ་མཐོང་ནས་སུན་འབྱིན་པར་བྱེད་དོ`). The view holds three divergent provisional entries for the bare form and none is binding: `phá trừ` (l.200), `bài xích` (l.206), `đả phá` (l.222). `bài xích` fits this occurrence — the second man truthfully denounces the thief he saw — so the wording is kept. The three-way split is exactly the drift the glossary exists to prevent; a ruling should either split the senses (four-powers repudiation of sin vs. undermining an affliction vs. refuting/denouncing a person or thesis) or settle on one word and move p0251, p0337 and p0350 with it.

HIGHEST-CONSEQUENCE gap in this chunk — the pivot of the whole argument, ~25× across p0747–p0750 (རང་གི་མཚན་ཉིད་ཀྱིས་གྲུབ་པ, རང་མཚན་ལ་ཚད་མ, རང་གི་མཚན་ཉིད་ཀྱིས་སྟོང་པ). The view rules only prov མཚན་ཉིད → 'tướng'/'định nghĩa'; the compound has no entry. 'tự tướng' has corpus precedent (c182 L25 'sở duyên tự tướng', c184 L27). Must be pinned centrally because the whole Prāsaṅgika/Svātantrika section turns on it, and because 'tướng' already collides three ways (མཚན་ཉིད / མཚན་མ / མཚན) per the existing glossary note.

p0747. The prov entry says to decide per occurrence and flag. Here it is unambiguously 'definition of pramāṇa', not 'characteristic' — the sentence is the standard avisaṃvāda definition. Rendered 'định nghĩa của lượng'. See flags.

p0747–p0748, ~8×; carries the definition of pramāṇa. No entry for the bare word; glossary.json has only the compound བསླུ་བ་མེད་པའི་སྐྱབས = 'chỗ quy y không hư dối'. I departed from that precedent's 'hư dối' deliberately, because བསླུ་བ stands beside བརྫུན་པ ('false') in the very phrase བརྫུན་པ་བསླུ་བ (p0747, p0748) and one Vietnamese word for both would erase the pair. Needs a ruling.

p0747–p0749, 5×, incl. the MAv verse མཐོང་བ་བརྫུན་པ. glossary.json registers only བརྫུན / བརྫུན་དུ་སྨྲ་བ = 'nói dối' (the speech-act sense, mṛṣāvāda), which is a different word-sense and would be positively wrong here. Kept apart from བསླུ་བ = 'lừa dối'.

p0748, fourth member of the four-pramāṇa list quoted from the Prasannapadā (མངོན་སུམ་དང་རྗེས་དཔག་དང་ལུང་དང་ཉེར་འཇལ). GAP. 'thí dụ lượng' (譬喻量) is the standard Vietnamese for upamāna. Uncertain — see flags.

p0748, third of the four pramāṇas. Follows the registered prov ལུང = 'giáo điển', which explicitly forbids 'thánh giáo' (reserved for གསུང་རབ). Rendered 'giáo điển' inside the list, so the standard Vietnamese 'thánh giáo lượng' was deliberately NOT used. A ruling should say whether ལུང in a pramāṇa enumeration takes a -lượng form.
p0750, 3×, in the Bhāvaviveka refutation of Cittamātra and in the Prajñāpradīpa citation. No entry anywhere in glossary.json. Standard Sino-Vietnamese 遍計所執.
p0750, 2× (གཞན་དབང་གི་དངོས་པོ, གཞན་དབང་ལ་ཐ་སྙད་དུ). No entry. Standard Sino-Vietnamese 依他起. Pairs with ཀུན་བརྟགས above; the third member ཡོངས་གྲུབ does not occur here.

p0750, the first of the three niḥsvabhāvatā, attributed to the Cittamātrins. No entry. Note it uses 'tướng' for མཚན་ཉིད, whereas the same page's རང་གི་མཚན་ཉིད is 'tự tướng' — deliberate, since the Tibetan itself distinguishes them, but the two should be ruled on together.

p0750 l.3, རབ་བྱེད་ཉེར་ལྔ་པའི་ཤེས་རབ་སྒྲོན་མེ — Bhāvaviveka's own commentary. glossary.json registers only ཤེས་རབ་སྒྲོན་མེའི་རྒྱ་ཆེར་འགྲེལ་པ = 'Bát-nhã Đăng Luận Quảng Thích' (Avalokitavrata's sub-commentary, c009 L17). The bare title is the base work and must be visibly distinguished from its Quảng Thích.
p0750. Follows the prov ruling already recorded for རབ་བྱེད as an MMK chapter = 'phẩm'. Here it names the chapter of the Prajñāpradīpa (i.e. of the MMK it comments on), so the same word applies.

terms.vi: cái chỉ tựa như tỷ lượng
terms.note: p0749, inside the Madhyamakāvatārabhāṣya quotation, among the impairers of the mental consciousness. GAP. Built on the registered prov རྗེས་དཔག = 'tỷ lượng'; ལྟར་སྣང = 'chỉ tựa như'. The Sino-Vietnamese 'tợ tỷ lượng' is the alternative.

terms.vi: cái chỉ tựa như chánh lý
terms.note: p0749–p0750, Tsongkhapa's own gloss of the quotation. Built on the registered prov གཏན་ཚིགས = 'chánh lý' [hetu]. UNSATISFACTORY and flagged: 'chánh lý' is also the prov rendering of རིགས་པ, so 'cái chỉ tựa như chánh lý' reads as a pseudo-reasoning rather than the technical hetvābhāsa (tợ nhân / nhân tương tự). A ruling should either split གཏན་ཚིགས (hetu = 'nhân') from རིགས་པ ('chánh lý'), or license 'tợ nhân' for this compound.

p0749–p0750. Follows the registered prov གྲུབ་མཐའ = 'tông nghĩa'; ངན་པ = 'xấu'. Same referent as the quotation's ཡང་དག་པ་མ་ཡིན་པར་བྱས་པའི་གྲུབ་པའི་མཐའ = 'tông nghĩa được lập ra một cách không chân chánh'.

p0749, in the Madhyamakāvatārabhāṣya list of internal impairers of the faculties, beside རབ་རིབ = 'màng mắt' (registered). Jaundice/bilious eye-disease. No entry; rendered descriptively rather than as 'hoàng đản', which names the systemic disease rather than the visual defect at issue.

p0749, same list (ད་དྷུ་ར་ཟོས་པ = 'đã ăn dhattūra') — the datura/thorn-apple whose ingestion deranges vision. Tibetan is itself a phonetic transcription of the Sanskrit; left in Sanskrit transcription following the corpus practice for Indian proper terms. 'cà độc dược' is the botanical Vietnamese but is not a Buddhist-register word; a ruling is welcome.
p0749, in the triad གཟུགས་བརྙན / བྲག་ཆ / སྨིག་རྒྱུ. No entry. Kept plain; deliberately not 'tiếng vọng của hang', since the Tibetan names the echo itself.
p0749, མིག་འཕྲུལ་མཁན་ལ་སོགས་པས་རབ་ཏུ་སྦྱར་བའི་སྔགས་དང་སྨན. No entry for this form; glossary.json has the འཁྲུལ་འཁོར family ('cỗ máy'), a different word.

p0749. Follows the c045 precedent recorded in the view (mundane spells listed beside སྨན medicine as means of deceiving the senses), NOT the 'Mật chú' line. The bare-སྔགས casing/wording split remains open.

p0750, ངོ་བོ་དང་ཁྱད་པར་དུ་འདོགས་པའི་སྒྲ་དང་བློ — the substance/attribute pair that words and thoughts impute. The view's only ཁྱད་པར entry is 'định ngữ' [viśeṣaṇa] in a different construction (དོན་དམ་པའི་ཁྱད་པར་སྦྱར་བ), which does not fit here. Uncertain — see flags.

terms.vi: cái năng giả lập / cái được giả lập
terms.note: p0750, the two-fold analysis of the parikalpita. No entry. Built on the corpus's 'giả lập / gán đặt' for འདོགས་པ (c210 uses 'giả danh' for བཏགས་པ in the ādhyāropa sense); the agent/patient pair is made explicit with năng-/được- because Vietnamese cannot carry it otherwise.

p0750, གཞན་དབང་གི་དངོས་པོ་ལ་སྐུར་པ་བཏབ་པར་འགྱུར. Follows the registered སྐུར་པ་འདེབས་པ = 'phỉ báng'. Recorded because the sense here is ontological deprecation (denying what exists), not verbal slander; 'tổn giảm' (損減) is the technical alternative. See flags.

p0748–p0750, 4×, of the faculties corrupted by error-causes and of the mind corrupted by bad tenets. No entry. Kept distinct from གནོད་པ = 'tổn hại' (registered), which stands beside it in the same sentences.
p0747. No entry; the idiom is 'the place a pramāṇa can go', i.e. the domain in which it operates as pramāṇa. Rendered descriptively.

terms.kind: term (member of a fixed four-pramāṇa set)
terms.note: p0748 l.1, in the Prasannapadā four-pramāṇa list མངོན་སུམ་དང་རྗེས་དཔག་དང་ལུང་དང་ཉེར་འཇལ་གྱི་ཚད་མ → 'hiện lượng, tỷ lượng, giáo điển và thí dụ lượng'. No entry in the view; the other three members are already ruled (མངོན་སུམ → hiện lượng, རྗེས་དཔག → tỷ lượng, ལུང → giáo điển). WORDING KEPT — upamāna is pramāṇa by comparison/analogy, and 'thí dụ lượng' both matches the Sanskrit and keeps the parallel '…lượng' shape of the set. Register it so the four-fold list, which will recur throughout the vipaśyanā chapters, is complete and cannot drift member by member. Note also that the list member ལུང is here 'giáo điển' per the registered entry, i.e. not itself suffixed with 'lượng'; a ruling may wish to confirm that asymmetry is intended.

p0750, རབ་བྱེད་ཉེར་ལྔ་པའི་ཤེས་རབ་སྒྲོན་མེ་ལས → 'trong *Bát-nhã Đăng Luận*, phẩm thứ hai mươi lăm'. Bhāviveka's commentary on the Mūlamadhyamakakārikā. The view has no headword for the bare title — only the note under འགྲེལ་པ recording that glossary.json holds the DIFFERENT title ཤེས་རབ་སྒྲོན་མེའི་རྒྱ་ཆེར་འགྲེལ་པ ('*Bát-nhã Đăng Luận Quảng Thích*', Avalokitavrata's sub-commentary, used in c009). WORDING KEPT: it is consistent with that precedent and with decisions.md ('bát-nhã ... in the titles of cited texts'). Register the bare title so the pair title/sub-commentary stays distinguishable.

p0739 l.1 (འཇིག་རྟེན་གྲགས་པའི་ཚད་མས་གནོད་པ) and p0740 l.1 (འཇིག་རྟེན་གྱི་གྲགས་པས་གནོད་དོ). This is the load-bearing term of the whole section: what refutes the opponent is 'the pramāṇa of worldly renown'. The glossary registers གྲགས་པ = 'danh tiếng' (fame), scoped by its own note to personal names — a different sense entirely. No corpus precedent for the 'renown / what is commonly accepted' sense. Rendered 'lượng của chỗ thế gian công nhận' / 'bị chỗ thế gian công nhận làm tổn hại'.

terms.vi: cái chỉ tựa như chánh lý
terms.note: p0740 l.1, དེ་འདྲ་བའི་རིགས་པ་ལྟར་སྣང་ལ་ནི་ཐ་སྙད་པའི་ཤེས་པས་གནོད་པས — pseudo-reasoning. No entry. Follows c021's 'cái chỉ tương tự như đạo' for the parallel ལྟར་སྣང construction. A single ruling on the ལྟར་སྣང suffix would settle both.

p0740 l.2, རྟོག་ལྡན་ལ་…དོགས་པ་ཡོད་ཀྱི — contrasted in the same sentence with གྲུབ་མཐས་བློ་མ་བསྒྱུར་བ (those whose minds tenets have not altered) and with གནག་རྫི (cowherds). No entry, no corpus precedent. Deliberately NOT 'bậc trí' or 'bậc học giả', which the glossary assigns to མཁས་པ, and NOT 'người phân biệt' — རྟོག་ལྡན here is one who investigates, not the pejorative རྟོག་པ. Rendering is uncertain; see flags.

p0739 l.3, འཁྲུལ་སྣང་འདི་སྦྱང་བའི་ཕྱིར་དུ་ལམ་ལ་འབད་པ — striving on the path in order to CLEANSE mistaken appearance. The registered prov སྦྱང་བ = 'tu tập' is scoped by its own note to the section headword བདག་གཞན་བརྗེ་བའི་སྒོ་ནས་སྦྱང་བ (mental training). 'tu tập' would be positively wrong here: the object of སྦྱང་བ is the delusion being removed, not the practice being done.

p0739 l.2, inside the Madhyamakāvatāra-bhāṣya quotation ངས་ཀྱང་ཁྱོད་ལ་སྟོངས་གདབ་པར་བྱའོ. Idiom: to back up / lend assistance. Tsongkhapa's own gloss four lines later replaces it with དེའི་གྲོགས་བྱའོ ('làm trợ bạn'), which confirms the reading; the two Vietnamese words were kept distinct so the gloss remains visibly a gloss.
p0739 l.3, མགོ་བསྒྲེ་བྱས་པ — literally 'to raise the head', i.e. a tu-quoque retort. No entry. Names the Cittamātrin's counter-charge that the passage is answering.
p0741 l.1, paired with the registered མོ་གཤམ་གྱི་བུ = 'con của thạch nữ' as the standard pair of impossible objects.
p0740 l.1, ཕྱི་རོལ་གྱི་དོན་ལ་སོགས་པའི་ཀུན་རྫོབ་པ — the external object the proponents of real things themselves negate. No entry.

p0740 l.3, in the Catuḥśataka-ṭīkā quotation མོ་གཤམ་གྱི་བུ་ལ་སོགས་པ་དག་གིས་ཉེ་བར་གཞལ་བར་འགྱུར་བ. Literally 'measured near by', i.e. taken as the simile for. Rendered non-technically; deliberately not 'đo lường', which would read as ཚད་མས་འཇལ་བ.
p0741 l.3 and p0742 l.1, རང་བཞིན་ཚོལ་བ་ལྷུར་བྱེད་པ (2×) — the load-bearing phrase of the whole argument: reasoning is devoted to seeking intrinsic nature and therefore negates only that. No entry.
p0742 l.3, བདེན་པ་གཉིས་རྣམ་པར་འཇོག་པ་ལ་ཕུལ་དུ་བྱུང་བའི་མཁས་པ. No entry for the intensifier; 'tối thắng' is already used corpus-wide for མཆོག, so a distinguishing word may be preferred.

terms.vi: chánh lý thẩm sát thật tánh
terms.note: p0739-p0741, ~7×, and its variants དེ་ཉིད་དཔྱོད་པའི་རིགས་པ and རང་བཞིན་ཡོད་མེད་དཔྱོད་པའི་རིགས་པ. Built from the registered prov དེ་ཁོ་ན་ཉིད = 'thật tánh', རིགས་པ = 'chánh lý' and དཔྱོད་པ = 'thẩm sát'. Registered as a compound because it is the subject of the entire section and recurs through the whole vipaśyanā division.
p0742 l.3 (སྤྲུལ་པ་ལས་སྤྲུལ་པ་འབྱུང་བའི་ཚུལ). No entry in the view. Standard and internally consistent with the chunk's སྒྱུ་མ material; kept.
p0742 l.3, of ལས་རྣམས་ཀྱི་རྣམ་པར་སྨིན་པ. No entry in the view. Standard Sino-Vietnamese; kept.

terms.kind: scope note on a pending ruling
terms.note: p0740 l.1. The view's note on bare གྲོགས asks that it never be upgraded and take 'bạn hữu'/'bạn' with no value-word (the note that rejected 'bạn lành'). Here 'trợ' is not evaluative: it carries the verbal sense of གྲོགས་བྱེད (to assist), matching སྟོངས་གདབ་པར་བྱའོ -> 'tiếp sức' in the bhāṣya quoted three lines earlier. Wording kept; the pending ruling should scope itself to the nominal use so this verbal one is not swept as a violation.

p0743 l.1, འཕགས་ཡུལ་གྱི་གྲུབ་མཐའ་སྨྲ་བ་རྣམས. No entry. The corpus renders རྒྱ་གར as 'Ấn Độ' (c007, c008, c022, c106, c179, c181); འཕགས་ཡུལ is a different Tibetan word ('land of the āryas') and was kept distinct as 'Thánh xứ'. A ruling should say whether the two Tibetan names merge onto 'Ấn Độ' or stay apart.

p0744 l.1, དེའི་ཕྱི་འགྲེལ་དུ — the prose of the Madhyamakāvatārabhāṣya that follows and comments on the verse just quoted. No entry; the view registers only འགྲེལ་པ = 'bản Thích' / 'bản chú giải'. Rendered descriptively rather than as a title.

p0746, inside the Catuḥśataka-ṭīkā quotation, in the logicians' definition of རྟོག་པ: གང་དོན་ལ་མིང་དང་རིགས་སུ་ལྷག་པར་སྒྲོ་འདོགས་པར་ཞུགས་པའི་འདུ་ཤེས་གཡེར་པོ. Uses the view's འདུ་ཤེས = 'tưởng'. གཡེར་པོ (keen / nimble / alert) has no entry and I am not confident of it — see flags.

p0746, same definition of རྟོག་པ (name and class superimposed on the object). Deliberately NOT the view's རིགས = 'chủng tánh' (gotra) nor 'dòng dõi' (lineage): here it is the logicians' universal/class term paired with མིང.
p0746, ×2 — the second member of the logicians' definition of hiện lượng, and its gloss (ཡུལ་གྱི་རང་གི་མཚན་ཉིད་ཇི་ལྟར་གནས་པ་ལྟར་འཛིན་པ). No entry anywhere in the corpus.

p0743, inside the Prasannapadā quotation: འཇིག་རྟེན་པའི་ཆོས་ལུགས་ལས་ཉམས་པ་ཁྱོད. No entry. 'nếp pháp của thế gian' keeps ཆོས visible without importing 'tôn giáo' or 'chánh pháp' (the latter is explicitly not licensed by the ཆོས fixed-set).
p0746 (and again on p0747, outside this chunk). Idiomatic: the domain in which something 'goes as' valid cognition. Rendered literally as a place-noun; no entry.

p0743, Prasannapadā quotation, ×3 (ལ་ལར་འཐད་པ་བཅུག་ནས; འཐད་པ་གཞན་འཐད་པ་གཞན་གྱིས་ཟློག་པར་བྱེད). The view registers འཐད་པ = 'hợp lý' (predicative, p0707–p0710, incl. the sibling section heading), which does not cover this nominal 'argument put forward' sense. Both senses occur in this chunk, so the split should be recorded rather than left to look like drift.
p0745 l.1, ཡུལ་ཁྱད་པར་ཅན་དེ་ཁོ་ན་ཉིད. Built from the view's ཡུལ = 'cảnh'; ཁྱད་པར་ཅན has no entry (the view has ཁྱད་པར = 'định ngữ' only in the viśeṣaṇa sense).
p0746, Catuḥśataka-ṭīkā quotation. 'vấn nạn' is already in the corpus (c119, c156, c210) for the objection itself; this is the paired verb phrase and has no entry.

p0743 l.1, x3 inside the ཚིག་གསལ quotation: ལ་ལར་འཐད་པ་བཅུག་ནས and བཀོད་པའི་འཐད་པ་གཞན་འཐད་པ་གཞན་གྱིས་ཟློག་པར་བྱེད. The registered prov འཐད་པ -> 'hợp lý' is scoped by its own note to the predicate/adjectival use (p0707-p0710, heading དེ་མི་འཐད་པར་བསྟན་པ), which this chunk uses correctly at L25 (ཇི་ལྟར་འཐད) and L51 (རིགས་པ་མ་ཡིན). Here འཐད་པ is a count noun taking བཅུག / བཀོད་པའི / གཞན་གྱིས — it is a stated argument, not the property of being reasonable, and 'hợp lý' cannot take those. Wording KEPT; a scoped nominal entry is requested.

L25, L47, L51, L53, L57, L59, L61 — མིག་ལ་སོགས་པའི་ཤེས་པ (p0744 l.1, p0745), མི་བསླུ་བའི་ཤེས་པ (p0745), ཤེས་པ་མངོན་སུམ་ཡིན་ནོ (p0746). The only registered prov ཤེས་པ -> 'trí' is explicitly scoped to the Abhisamayālaṃkāra verse at p0358 (kept apart from ཤེས་རབ = trí tuệ) and cannot govern the pramāṇa debate. Wording KEPT. The ruling should also settle whether ཤེས་པ and རྣམ་པར་ཤེས་པ stay distinguishable: the བཞི་བརྒྱ་པའི་འགྲེལ་པ quotation at L51 runs both inside one argument (མི་བསླུ་བའི་ཤེས་པ vs རྣམ་པར་ཤེས་པའང / རྣམ་པར་ཤེས་པ་ཐམས་ཅད), and both are currently 'thức'; a split such as ཤེས་པ -> 'thức' / རྣམ་པར་ཤེས་པ -> 'thức (vijñāna)' or 'tâm thức' would keep them apart.

terms.bo: བརྫུན་པ (false, deceptive — not the speech act)
terms.note: p0745, x2 inside the བཞི་བརྒྱ་པའི་འགྲེལ་པ quotation: བརྫུན་པ་བསླུ་བའི་ཆོས་ཅན་དང་སྒྱུ་མ་ལྟ་བུ. The registered prov བརྫུན -> 'nói dối' [mṛṣāvāda] is the speech-act sense and cannot govern a predicate of འདུས་བྱས / རྣམ་པར་ཤེས་པ. Rendering KEPT; a sense split is owed.

terms.vi: linh hoạt (in 'cái tưởng linh hoạt') — UNCERTAIN
terms.note: p0746 l.1, inside the བཞི་བརྒྱ་པའི་འགྲེལ་པ definition of རྟོག་པ: དོན་ལ་མིང་དང་རིགས་སུ་ལྷག་པར་སྒྲོ་འདོགས་པར་ཞུགས་པའི་འདུ་ཤེས་གཡེར་པོ. འདུ་ཤེས -> 'tưởng' is registered; གཡེར་པོ has none. The lexical range is 'clear, distinct, articulate/sonorous' as well as 'sharp, keen, alert'; 'linh hoạt' picks up only the last and is a weak fit for the first. Wording KEPT rather than swapped on preference, because this is the load-bearing word in the definition of conceptuality and the evidence is not decisive — a ruling is requested (candidates: 'rõ rệt' / 'sắc bén' / a form marking the 'expressive, name-bearing' sense).

p0716, དེ་འདྲ་བའི་སྣང་སྟོང་ལ་ངེས་པ་འདྲེན་པ་གཉིས་ཚོགས. GAP — no entry for the compound. Rendered as the two members it abbreviates (སྣང་བ + སྟོང་པ་ཉིད), using the fixed སྟོང་པ་ཉིད = tánh không. 'nhị hiện' / 'hiện–không' were not used because the Tibetan is a plain dvandva here, not a technical unity-term.

terms.vi: hiếm hoi đến mức cùng tột
terms.note: p0716, གཉིས་ཚོགས་དེ་སྲིད་མཐའ་ཙམ་དུ་སོང་བས. Read as the same idiom already registered at p0121 as སྲིད་མཐར་སྣང་བ = 'thấy là [hiếm hoi] đến mức cùng tột' (བདེ་འགྲོ་ཙམ་ཡང་སྲིད་མཐར་སྣང་ལ). Recorded so the two occurrences stay in step; see flag.

terms.vi: vị trời rơi xuống thành ma
terms.note: p0716, ལྷ་བདུད་དུ་བབས་པ་ལྟར་གྱུར་ནས. Rendered literally. Uses the provisional བདུད = ma; ལྷ is left as the neutral 'vị trời' rather than the provisional 'bổn tôn', which is scoped to iṣṭadevatā contexts and would be wrong in a simile about something divine turning demonic.

p0717 ×4. GAP. Agentive of དཔྱོད་པ, which the glossary carries as provisional 'thẩm sát'; kept morphologically parallel to it so the argument (the analyser is analysed away too) stays visible. Note the unresolved corpus split c083 'quán sát' vs c125/c134 'thẩm sát' already recorded under དཔྱོད་པ — this chunk follows 'thẩm sát'.
p0716, MMK XXIV.12 དེ་ཕྱིར་ཞན་པས་ཆོས་འདི་ཡི. GAP. Of dull faculties. Rendered without supplying 'trí' or 'căn cơ', which the Tibetan does not write.
p0715, in the Vigrahavyāvartanī autocommentary's pot simile (སྦྲང་རྩི་དང་ཆུ་དང་འོ་ཐུག). GAP.
p0717, བུམ་པ་ལ་སོགས་པ་རྣམས་མཆུ་དང་མགྲིན་པ་ལ་སོགས་པ་རང་གི་ཡན་ལག. GAP. 'bình' supplied in each so Vietnamese parses; the Tibetan writes only 'lip' and 'neck'.

terms.vi: quy tụ nơi cùng một cơ sở
terms.note: p0715-p0716. GAP. Uses the registered provisional གཞི = 'cơ sở'. Deliberately not 'đồng nhất' or 'hợp nhất' — the point is that two predicates share one locus, not that they merge (cf. decisions.md §7 on ཟུང་དུ་འབྲེལ་བ).

p0717, Ratnāvalī verse ཤེས་པར་དཀའ་བར་ཐུགས་ཆུད་དེ. GAP. Honorific verb of understanding; kept distinct from རྟོགས་པ = chứng ngộ and མཁྱེན་པ ('biết') in the MMK verse four lines above, which this chunk renders 'biết'.

p0716. Uses the fixed ཚུལ་ཁྲིམས = giới and the provisional ཁས་བླངས་པ = 'thừa nhận', adjusted to 'thọ nhận' because the object is vows undertaken, not a proposition conceded. Register the sense split or the p0179 entry will read as drift.

p0715 l.1, ×3: `སྟོང་པའོ་ཞེས་བྱ་བར་འཆད་དོ` and `སྟོང་པའོ་ཞེས་བྱ་བ་འཐད་པ` -> 'trống rỗng' (in quotation marks, as the Vigrahavyāvartanī-commentary is naming the predicate), and `རང་བཞིན་སྟོང་པ` -> 'trống rỗng tự tánh'. The view fixes only `སྟོང་པ་ཉིད` -> 'tánh không'; there is no ruling for the bare form. 56 corpus occurrences across c212–c221 use 'trống rỗng', so the wording is consistent. KEPT. Register the bare form (and ideally the compound `རང་བཞིན་སྟོང་པ` -> 'trống rỗng tự tánh') so it is not read as a `སྟོང་པ་ཉིད` violation.

p0715 l.3, `ཀུན་ནས་ཉོན་མོངས་དང་རྣམ་པར་བྱང་བའི་ཆོས` -> 'các pháp tạp nhiễm và thanh tịnh'. The view has FIXED `ཉོན་མོངས` -> 'phiền não' for the bare term only. 'tạp nhiễm' has corpus precedent (c013, c058, c061, c069, c092, c192, c219, c228) and pairs correctly with the registered provisional `རྣམ་པར་བྱང་བ` -> 'thanh tịnh' (vyavadāna), which is the term it is contrasted with here. KEPT. Register the compound so the sweep does not read it as a `ཉོན་མོངས` violation.

terms.kind: gap — new entry needed, must stay distinct from འགོག་པ
terms.note: p0715 l.3 `སྐྱེ་བ་དང་འགག་པའི་རྟེན་འབྲེལ` and p0716 l.1 `བརྟེན་ནས་འགག་པ`, `སྐྱེ་བ་དང་འགག་པའི་རྟེན་འབྲེལ`. No entry exists. The chunk had rendered it 'hoại diệt' twice and 'diệt' once; I converged on 'diệt' throughout — 'hoại diệt' imports a destructive sense ('perish/be destroyed') that plain འགག་པ (mere ceasing, the counterpart of སྐྱེ་བ -> FIXED 'sinh') does not carry, and here it is one half of the dependent-arising pair sinh/diệt. The view registers only `འགོག་པ` -> 'diệt [đế]' (nirodha-satya, p0402), a different word and a different sense; the ruling must keep the two separable — otherwise every dependent-arising 'diệt' will be read as the third noble truth.

p0728 l.1 `བུད་དྷ༌པཱ་ལི་ཏ་ལས་ཀྱང༌།` — the commentary, cited as a text. Absent from the c218 view. Follows the precedent already set in c210 l.35, which cites the same work as *Buddhapālita* in italics, while the PERSON is rendered 'A-xà-lê Phật Hộ' (c208, c209). The split (work = transliterated title, person = Phật Hộ) should be recorded so Phase 5 does not read it as drift.

p0731, ×4. GAP in the c218 view. Rendered 'thế gian bên kia' rather than a temporal 'đời sau', because in the Prasannapadā passage at p0731 l.3 ཕ་རོལ is used BIDIRECTIONALLY in one sentence — འཇིག་རྟེན་ཕ་རོལ་ནས་འདིར་འོང་བ (coming here FROM it) and འཇིག་རྟེན་འདི་ནས་ཕ་རོལ་ཏུ་འགྲོ་བ (going TO it) — so a rendering meaning 'the later life' is positively wrong on the first limb. It keeps the fixed འཇིག་རྟེན = thế gian visible. See flag: glossary.json does carry འཇིག་རྟེན་ཕྱི་མ / འཇིག་རྟེན་ཕ་རོལ -> 'thế gian đời sau' (provisional), which this chunk departs from on purpose.
