p0730 l.3. Not in the c218 view; follows c212 (ll. 34, 50), which already uses 'nhà chủ trương sự vật' / 'các bậc học giả chủ trương sự vật'. No new wording — registration requested only so the recurring opponent-label is pinned.

p0731 l.1, `དམ་བཅའ་ལ་ཁྱད་པར་ཡོད་དོ` — the thesis asserted, contrasted two lines later with རྒྱུ་མཚན (the reason). No entry, no corpus precedent (grep: zero hits for 'lập tông'). 'lời lập tông' keeps the thesis/reason pair (dam bca' / rgyu mtshan) visibly matched; bare 'tông' would collide with གྲུབ་མཐའ = tông nghĩa, which occurs nearby in c212.

p0730 l.1, མཐའ་གཉིས་སུ་ལྟུང་བར་མི་འགྱུར. Follows the view's མཐའ (extreme sense) -> 'cực đoan' ruling from p0704 rather than the alternative 'nhị biên'. Note c187 l.62 uses 'hai biên' for the laya/auddhatya pair — a different sense, but the two will look alike to a consistency sweep.

p0729 l.2 verse, མི་མཁས་རྣམས་ནི་ཆུད་ཀྱང་འཛའ. glossary.json registers ཆུད་ཟ་བ -> 'luống mất' (provisional), which fits karma being wasted but not a person being ruined. Rendered 'bị hủy hoại' here; the entry should record the split or pick one word.
p0729 l.2 verse. Mirrors the view's ruling མཁས་པ (in verse) -> 'bậc trí' (p0302 MMK XXVI.10, p0388) and the same verse-sense used for མཁས་པ in the MMK XV.10 quotation at p0728 l.1 of this chunk.

p0728 l.2, inside the Prasannapadā quotation: a svabhāva admits no ལྡོག་པ, hence is never absent. Rendered 'sự lui chuyển' (reversal/turning back) rather than 'sự đổi khác', to keep it apart from འགྱུར་བ = 'đổi khác', which Tsongkhapa uses two lines later at p0730 l.3 (དུས་ཀུན་ཏུ་མི་འགྱུར་བ) for a related but distinct idea.

p0728 l.1. Left in Sanskrit while every other cited title in the chunk has a Vietnamese form (Căn Bản Trung Luận, Minh Cú Luận, Bảo Man Luận, all matching their prov entries). decisions.md requires one fixed Vietnamese title per cited text; 'Phật Hộ Thích' / 'Phật Hộ Luận' would be the candidates, but the ruling belongs centrally, not here.
p0728 l.3. Keeps the FIXED སྟོང་པ་ཉིད -> 'tánh không'. Register collision to note: དམ་པ is rendered 'tối thắng' here, while the registered དོན་དམ་པ -> 'thắng nghĩa' appears a page later (p0730).
p0728 l.1, རང་བཞིན་ལ་ལྡོག་པ་མེད་པས — no reversal/turning-back in a svabhāva.
p0729 l.1, in the Ratnāvalī verse སྤོང་བས་མ་རུངས་བདག་ཉིད་ཅན, where it stands beside the registered ངོ་བོ -> 'thể tánh' used in the surrounding prose. The ruling should keep the two separable.

terms.vi: được phân định dứt khoát (thành hai)
terms.note: GAP — no entry in the view. Occurs 7× in p0726 l.3 and p0727 l.1, and it is the pivot of the whole argument: the dichotomy hữu/vô must be EXHAUSTIVE, so no third option survives. Rendered 'phân định dứt khoát thành hai' so the phrase can carry both the verbal ('phải được phân định dứt khoát thành hai điều ấy') and the nominal ('việc phân định dứt khoát thành...') uses. It recurs in p0731–p0734, so a ruling is owed before those chunks.

GAP. p0726 l.3 (×1) and p0727 l.1 (×3): the 'third heap', i.e. a tertium quid outside an exhaustive dichotomy. Deliberately NOT 'trường hợp thứ ba', because the view fixes མུ་བཞི = 'bốn trường hợp' (catuṣkoṭi) and the two terms stand four lines apart in this chunk; collapsing them onto 'trường hợp' would make it look as though ཕུང་གསུམ were the third of the four མུ, which it is not.

GAP in the view, but NOT a free choice: c207 already renders ཡེ་མེད at p0693 as 'tuyệt nhiên không có' and this chunk follows it. Load-bearing here — p0726 l.1 and l.3 turn on the four-way distinction ཡེ་མེད / རང་བཞིན་མེད་པ / རང་གི་ངོ་བོས་གྲུབ་པ / ཡོད་པ་ཙམ, and if ཡེ་མེད and མེད་པ collapse onto one Vietnamese word the passage's whole point disappears. c216 (p0720–p0723, same batch) also contains ཡེ་མེད ×2 and must not diverge.

terms.vi: nhà chủ trương sự vật là không có
terms.note: p0724 l.3 (Catuḥśataka-ṭīkā quotation) and p0725 l.1, where it is paired against དངོས་པོ་ཡོད་པར་སྨྲ་བ = 'nhà chủ trương sự vật là có'. Rendered as a matched pair so the passage's point — that the two uses of དངོས་པོ are different — stays visible.

GAP. p0725 l.3 – p0726 l.1, ~6×, including the two-pada verse. The ṭīkā explicitly says ལོག་པ is synonymous with རང་བཞིན་མེད་པ and རྟེན་འབྲེལ and is NOT the same as དངོས་པོ་མེད་པ, so the Vietnamese must not say 'không có' or 'sai lầm'. Paired in the same passage with རྫུན་པ, which is rendered 'giả dối' to keep the two words separable.
p0726 l.1, ལོག་པའམ་རྫུན་པའི་དོན. Kept distinct from ལོག་པ = 'hư vọng'.

GAP. p0727 l.1, ཕུང་གསུམ་ལྡོག་པའི་གྲངས་ངེས — the definite enumeration that excludes a third option. Standard Sino-Vietnamese 定數; kept close to the Tibetan rather than paraphrased, since it is the technical partner of ཁ་ཚོན་ཆོད་པ in the same sentence.

terms.vi: loại trừ / xác định trọn vẹn
terms.note: GAP. p0727 l.1, ཡོད་མེད་ལ་སོགས་པའི་གཅིག་རྣམ་པར་བཅད་པས་ཅིག་ཤོས་ཡོངས་སུ་མི་གཅོད་པའི་ཕྱིར་རོ. This is the standard rnam-bcad / yongs-gcod pair (exclusion vs. inclusive determination). Rendered as a matched pair; the argument fails if both come out as 'phủ định' / 'xác định' without the contrast. A ruling should fix both members together — 'già thuyên / biểu thuyên' is the alternative Sino-Vietnamese pair.
GAP. p0727 l.1, describing the position that a dharma is neither of the two alternatives. 'rash / reckless'.

p0726 l.1 (ཡེ་མེད་ཀྱང་མིན) and l.3 (ཡེ་མེད་པ་དང་རང་བཞིན་མེད་པ ... ཁྱད་མ་ཕྱེད་པར). No entry. Rendering kept. This is the pivot the whole chunk contrasts against རང་བཞིན་མེད་པ = vô tự tánh — failing to distinguish the two is precisely the error being diagnosed — so a fixed rendering distinct from 'vô tự tánh' and from plain མེད་པ = 'không có' would prevent drift.

terms.bo: གྲགས་པ (prasiddha sense: renowned/current to a cognition)
terms.note: p0760–p0762, ~10×, and it is the FIRST of the three criteria by which the whole section decides what exists conventionally (ཐ་སྙད་པའི་ཤེས་པ་ལ་གྲགས་པ་ཡིན་པ), plus the technical noun འཇིག་རྟེན་གྱི་གྲགས་པ. The c226 view registers གྲགས་པ only as 'danh tiếng' (fame, from personal names / bare noun at p0522), a completely different sense that is unusable here. 'cực thành' (極成) is the established Sino-Vietnamese for prasiddha in Buddhist logic and keeps the word separable from ཐ་སྙད = danh ngôn and ཁས་ལེན = thừa nhận, both of which stand in the same sentences. Note: zero corpus precedent — 'cực thành' occurs 0× in translation/. Alternatives if the ruling goes otherwise: 'điều thế gian công nhận' / 'quen biết'. A ruling is owed because this word governs the criterion for the rest of the vipaśyanā section.

p0760–p0761, 3×. Tsongkhapa defines it explicitly here and immediately warns it is NOT a cognition that examines nothing at all — so the Vietnamese must not read as 'thức không hề khảo xét'. Paired with མ་བརྟགས་པར་འཇུག་པ, which I rendered 'vận hành mà chẳng khảo xét' to keep བརྟག་པ (khảo xét) apart from དཔྱོད་པ (thẩm sát).

terms.vi: người lập luận và người phản luận
terms.note: p0761 l.2. No entry. The debate pair. Alternatives: 'lập giả và địch giả' (nhân minh register).

terms.vi: sở thủ và năng thủ vô phần
terms.note: p0762 l.2, in the list of what the realist schools impute (beside བདག, གཙོ་བོ, དབང་ཕྱུག). 'sở thủ / năng thủ' follows corpus usage for གཟུང་རྣམ / འཛིན་རྣམ; ཆ་མེད = 'vô phần' is new — 'vô phần' occurs 0× in the corpus.
p0761 l.2, ཤེས་པ་རང་ག་བ — the cognition left just as it is, unaltered. No entry. Rendered 'thức tự nhiên'; the sense is 'plain / unmodified', and 'tự nhiên' may under-read it.

p0762 l.2. Deliberately kept distinct from བཏགས་པ = 'được giả danh' (p0759 MAv verse and p0760 prose), which stands ten lines away in the same argument. Neither is registered. 'biến kế' was considered and rejected as it does not work verbally in Vietnamese.

terms.vi: các nhà chủ trương thật hữu thuộc tự bộ
terms.note: p0760 l.1. Combines the view's prov རང་སྡེ = 'tự bộ' with c212's 'các nhà chủ trương thật hữu' for དངོས་པོར་སྨྲ་བ (which the view lists as 'not rendered in this chunk'). Also used at p0762 as རང་གཞན་གྱི་སྡེ་པ་དངོས་པོར་སྨྲ་བ -> 'các bộ phái chủ trương thật hữu, tự bộ và tha bộ'.

terms.vi: bậc kỳ lão của thế gian
terms.note: p0761 l.2, the tenet-free old people one might consult about worldly renown. No entry; 'kỳ lão' occurs 0× in the corpus.
p0762 l.1, 3×, in the Īśvara/pradhāna vs virtue/sin comparison. No entry; follows the corpus's 'an lạc và khổ' (7×) rather than 'khổ vui' (5×), and preserves the Tibetan's happiness-first order.

terms.bo: གནོད་པ (epistemic sense: invalidation by a pramāṇa or by reasoning; also མི་གནོད་པ, གནོད་པ་མི་འབབ་པ)
terms.note: The view records `prov གནོད་པ -> tổn hại` (line 164), but its own note scopes that to the harm/violence sense kept apart from `འཚེ་བ`. Throughout c226 (L11, L36, L38, L40, L46, 6x) `གནོད་པ` is the epistemic 'invalidation': `ཐ་སྙད་པའི་ཚད་མ་གཞན་གྱིས་གནོད་པ་མེད་པ`, `རིགས་པས་གནོད་པ་མི་འབབ་པ` (p0760), `འཁྲུལ་རྒྱུའི་གནོད་པ` (p0762). 'tổn hại' (physical/emotional injury) would read wrongly here. WORDING KEPT. Needs a scoped ruling: epistemic གནོད་པ -> 'làm hại / sự làm hại' (verbal 'bị ... làm hại'), vs. the existing harm sense -> 'tổn hại'. This sense drives the whole chunk and the entire vipaśyanā section, so it should be settled once centrally. The departure was made silently by the translator (no flag recorded) — that is the only procedural fault; the rendering itself is correct.

terms.bo: གྲགས་པ (prasiddha sense; incl. the standing term འཇིག་རྟེན་གྱི་གྲགས་པ and ཐ་སྙད་པའི་ཤེས་པ་ལ་གྲགས་པ)
terms.vi: cực thành (འཇིག་རྟེན་གྱི་གྲགས་པ -> cực thành của thế gian)
terms.note: GLOSSARY GAP, not a translator error. The view's only entry is `prov གྲགས་པ -> danh tiếng` (line 300), explicitly noted as having no bare entry and scoped to the fame sense inside personal names (བློ་བཟང་གྲགས་པ, ཟླ་བ་གྲགས་པ). Here (p0760–p0762, L26, L30, L32, L34, L46) it is prasiddha, 'renowned to / established for a cognition'. 'cực thành' is the established Sino-Vietnamese (極成) and is used internally consistently. WORDING KEPT. `འཇིག་རྟེན་གྱི་གྲགས་པ` is a standing technical term across the whole Prāsaṅgika section and needs its own ruling so it stays stable in later chunks.

terms.vi: thức (thức danh ngôn / thức chưa thẩm sát / thức của chánh lý)
terms.note: GLOSSARY GAP. The view's only entry is `prov ཤེས་པ -> trí` (line 224), explicitly scoped to the Abhisamayālaṃkāra verse at p0358 where 'trí' was chosen to stay apart from ཤེས་རབ. Here ཤེས་པ occurs ~12x on p0760–p0762 as 'a cognition'. The chunk renders it 'thức' while reserving 'cái trí' for `བློ` (per the ruled `prov བློ -> cái trí`, line 146), which keeps the two Tibetan words separable — internally consistent and defensible. WORDING KEPT. Caveat for the ruling: 'thức' normally carries vijñāna (`རྣམ་ཤེས`), so an explicit scoped ruling is needed rather than letting the choice drift; note `རིགས་ཤེས` is separately ruled 'trí chánh lý' (line 342) and is rendered correctly at L40.

terms.bo: གཟུགས (rūpa as sense-object / aggregate; གཟུགས་ལ་སོགས་པ, གཟུགས་སྒྲ་ལ་སོགས་པ)
terms.note: GLOSSARY GAP / sense split, not a translator error. The view records `prov གཟུགས -> sắc tướng` (line 210) but its own note scopes it to p0306–p0307 `གཟུགས་མི་སྡུག་པ`, i.e. physical appearance. Here (L11 `གཟུགས་ལ་སོགས་པ`, L46 `གཟུགས་སྒྲ་ལ་སོགས་པ` -> 'sắc, thanh v.v.') it is rūpa as sense-object/aggregate, where 'sắc' is the standard rendering and 'sắc tướng' would be wrong. WORDING KEPT; register the split.

COLLISION TO SETTLE, wording kept. glossary.json's only entry reads literally '(not rendered in this chunk)', i.e. no Vietnamese is registered. The corpus is already split: c212 (pages 707–710, immediately before this one, same argument) has 'nhà chủ trương sự vật'; c210 has 'các nhà chủ trương thật hữu'. I followed c212 because it is the adjacent chunk, continues the identical debate, and is built on the registered དངོས་པོ = 'sự vật'. One ruling is owed, and whichever way it goes it is a corpus sweep across c210/c212/c216/c217, not a c216-only edit.
p0722 l.2 (རྟག་པའི་མཐར་ལྟུང་བ). glossary.json registers ཡོད་པའི་མཐའ / ཆད་པའི་མཐའ -> 'cực đoan hữu / cực đoan đoạn'; this is the third member of the same pattern and is formed on it.
p0722 l.2 (མེད་པའི་མཐའ་སྤོང་བ), paired in the same paragraph with ཡོད་མཐར་མི་ལྟུང. Same pattern as the registered ཡོད་པའི་མཐའ / ཆད་པའི་མཐའ.

p0720 l.1, MAv verse ཚོགས་ལ་ལྟོས་རྣམས་མ་གྲགས་པ་ཡང་མིན. The view registers only bare གྲགས་པ -> 'danh tiếng' (fame), which is a different sense — here it is 'not renowned / not commonly acknowledged'. No expansion supplied.
p0721 l.1, inside the Catuḥśataka-ṭīkā quotation (འདིའི་མངོན་པར་འདོད་པ་ཐམས་ཅད་འགྲིགས་དཀའ). No entry; kept distinct from bare འདོད་པ = 'chủ trương' used throughout the surrounding prose.
p0721 l.1, inside the Catuḥśataka-ṭīkā quotation. The standard example of the utterly non-existent. No entry.

p0721 l.1 (དངོས་པོར་སྨྲ་བའི་གོ་ལུགས). No entry. Kept distinct from bare ལུགས = 'chủ trương' (provisional), which also occurs in this chunk at p0723 l.2 (དབུ་མའི་ལུགས་སུ་བྱས་ནས) and is rendered 'chủ trương' there.
p0723 l.1, inside the Prasannapadā quotation (ཉེས་པ་སོ་ན་འདུག་པ་ཉིད་དོ) — the fault stays exactly where it was. No entry.

terms.bo: རྩ་བ (bare, = the root text of the Prasannapadā)
terms.note: p0720 l.1, རྩ་བར་ཡང, standing in contrast to འགྲེལ་པ་ཚིག་གསལ in the previous clause. The Tibetan gives only 'in the root [text]', so 'Căn Bản Trung Luận' is bracketed as supplied. This follows the short-vs-full-title precedent already recorded for རྩ་ཤེ and འཇུག་པ, but bare རྩ་བ is a third short form and is not registered.

p0723 l.1, inside the Prasannapadā quotation. Formed on the registered ཐར་པའི་གྲོང་ཁྱེར -> 'thành trì giải thoát' plus the registered མྱ་ངན་ལས་འདས་པ -> 'niết-bàn'. No 'Kinh'/title reading here — it is the metaphor, not the sūtra.

p0720 l.1, the ཕར་ལ་འཕང / ཚུར་ལ་འཕངས / བཟློག་ནས་སྐྱོན་འཕེན image (the fault the Mādhyamika would hurl at the opponent is hurled back, so he turns it around and hurls it again). The registered འཕེན་པ senses are 'dẫn phát' (karma, ākṣepaka) and 'dẫn phát' (mental thrust of offering) — neither fits a fault being thrown in debate. Rendered with the plain verb 'ném'; needs its own scoped entry.

The recorded prov is གདོན་མི་ཟ -> 'chắc chắn rằng', taken from p0687 where the phrase closes a sentence as ...གསུངས་པར་གདོན་མི་ཟའོ ('it is certain that [he] said...'), so 'rằng' is a complementizer belonging to that construction. All three occurrences in c216 (p0721 ×2, p0722 l.3) are the adverbial གདོན་མི་ཟ་བར/གདོན་མི་ཟ་བས modifying a verb inside a clause, where 'rằng' cannot stand. Text aligned to 'chắc chắn'; the ruling should be widened to admit the bare adverbial 'chắc chắn' alongside the sentence-final 'chắc chắn rằng'.

p0720 l.1, ཚོགས་ལ་ལྟོས་རྣམས in the Madhyamakāvatāra verse — 'those that depend on a collection [of causes]'. The only ཚོགས entries in the view are prov ཚོགས -> 'tư lương' [saṃbhāra] (the accumulations of merit and wisdom) and prov ཚོགས (assembly/host sense) -> 'các việc'. Neither fits: this is the causal aggregate, a third sense. 'tổ hợp' KEPT and left unglossed (the earlier '[các duyên]' has been removed as a gloss inside a citation). A third scoped entry is owed.

p0720 l.1, Madhyamakāvatāra final pāda. No entry in the view. Rendered 'trọn vẹn' adverbially; 'hoàn toàn' was avoided because c216 already uses it for ཡེ་མེད / གཏན་མེད ('hoàn toàn không có') in the surrounding prose and the two must not be confusable.

Not a violation, recorded so the Phase 5 consistency sweep does not misfire. FIXED སྐྱེ་བ -> 'sinh' is honoured literally where the Tibetan is nominal (L46, སྐྱེ་བ་ཙམ -> 'cái chỉ là sinh'). In the two verse passages the reading is verbal and renders as 'sinh khởi' (L16 སྐྱེ་འགྱུར, L18 རབ་ཏུ་སྐྱེ་བར་འགྱུར, L11 and L40 འབྱུང་བ). The fixed stem is present in every case. If the sweep matches whole tokens it will fire on 'sinh khởi'; either the sweep should match the stem, or 'sinh khởi' should be recorded as the licensed verbal extension. Separately, འབྱུང་བ here is 'arising' and must not be matched against the registered prov འབྱུང་བ -> 'đại chủng' [mahābhūta], a different sense.

p0755–p0758, ~12×; the pivot of the whole passage (sense consciousnesses are mistaken conventionally, yet valid). No glossary entry. 'lầm loạn' (錯亂) chosen because it must stay visibly distinct from ཕྱིན་ཅི་ལོག = 'điên đảo' (glossary), which stands beside it in the same sentences (ཕྱིན་ཅི་ལོག་མ་ལོག), and from བརྫུན་པ = 'hư vọng'. Three near-synonyms are contrasted here on purpose, so one word must not absorb another.

terms.vi: chánh thế tục và tà thế tục
terms.note: p0756 l.1, the division applied to reflections vs blue. No glossary entry and no corpus precedent (grep found none). Deliberately NOT 'thế tục chân thật / thế tục điên đảo': 'điên đảo' is already the glossary's ཕྱིན་ཅི་ལོག, which is used in the very same sentence for the SUBJECT-side division, and collapsing the two would erase the object/subject parallel the passage is building. 'chánh' here answers to ཡང་དག་ in the Tibetan, so it is not an added qualifier.

terms.vi: hiện lượng theo lối giả lập / hiện lượng đích thực
terms.note: p0755 l.1, Candrakīrti's point that consciousness is pratyakṣa only figuratively while the object is pratyakṣa properly. No entry. མཚན་ཉིད་པ rendered 'đích thực' rather than the glossary's provisional མཚན་ཉིད = 'tướng', because 'tướng' would be unreadable here; see flags.
p0755 l.3 and p0756, 4×, the face reflected in a mirror, contrasted with གཟུགས་བརྙན = 'ảnh tượng'. No entry.

terms.vi: thế tục đế của thế gian
terms.note: p0756–p0757, 3×. Compound of the registered ཀུན་རྫོབ = 'thế tục' + བདེན་པ; recorded because the passage distinguishes it from bare ཀུན་རྫོབ་བདེན་པ and the distinction is load-bearing (reflections are not lokasaṃvṛtisatya though they are conventional).

Governing term of the whole chunk (~15×: p0757 l.3 ཐ་སྙད་དུ་འཁྲུལ་བ, དབང་པོའི་ཤེས་པ་རྣམས་འཁྲུལ་པ་ཡིན, མ་འཁྲུལ་བ; p0755–0756 passim). The view has no entry at all. Wording is internally consistent and kept. The ruling must be decided jointly with ཕྱིན་ཅི་ལོག = điên đảo (registered prov), because the two are contrasted inside the same sentences (ཐ་སྙད་དུ་འཁྲུལ་བ vs ཕྱིན་ཅི་མ་ལོག་པ, p0757 l.3) and must stay visibly distinct in Vietnamese.

FIRST OCCURRENCE IN THE CORPUS (p0764, ×2; the pair with ཞེན་ཡུལ at p0766). No entry in the view. The passage turns on the contrast between the appearing object (where conceptual thought IS mistaken) and the ascertaining mode of apprehension (where it is not), so the two object-terms must stay visibly distinct from each other and from the registered དམིགས་པ = 'sở duyên'. Candidates considered: 'sở hiện cảnh', 'cảnh sở hiện'.

p0766, first corpus occurrence. Paired in the argument with སྣང་ཡུལ and with འཛིན་སྟངས་ཀྱི་ཡུལ (rendered 'cảnh của cách nắm giữ', following the registered འཛིན་སྟངས = 'cách nắm giữ'). Three object-terms stand within two pages; a ruling should give all three distinct words.

p0764. Paired with ཡང་དག་ཀུན་རྫོབ. Deliberately NOT 'điên đảo', which this same page uses for ཕྱིན་ཅི་ལོག (registered prov) four sentences earlier — collapsing them would destroy the distinction the passage draws between an erroneous CONCEPTION and a false CONVENTIONALITY. Sino-Vietnamese 倒世俗 'đảo thế tục' is the alternative if a compact form is wanted.

p0764, paired with ལོག་པའི་ཀུན་རྫོབ. 'chân chánh' follows the corpus rendering of ཡང་དག noted in the view; the Sino-Vietnamese 正世俗 'chánh thế tục' is the alternative. Both members of the pair need one ruling together.

p0764, ×4. No entry; the view's དབང་པོ entries are sense-faculty compounds and the deity sense. Rendered with the full form 'các thức của căn' where the Tibetan writes དབང་པོའི་ཤེས་པ and 'căn thức' where it writes the contraction དབང་ཤེས, so the source's own long/short alternation is visible.

GAP — the view registers གྲགས་པ only as 'danh tiếng' (fame) and inside personal names. Here it is the technical Madhyamaka 'renowned / established by common consent': འཇིག་རྟེན་ཐམས་ཅད་ལ་གྲགས་པ, གྲུབ་མཐའ་སྨྲ་བ་ཁོ་ན་ལ་གྲགས་པ, ཐོག་མ་མེད་པ་ནས་གྲགས་པའི་དོན, འཇིག་རྟེན་ན་གང་གྲགས (p0763–p0764, 6×). It is the pivot of the whole passage. Deliberately NOT 'thừa nhận', which the view registers for ཁས་བླངས་པ and which occurs in the same sentences.
p0765, ×2, in the rope-snake example. No entry. Kept distinct from ཕྱིན་ཅི་ལོག = 'điên đảo' (registered prov) and from ལོག་རྟོག = 'tà chấp' (glossary), which shares the 'tà' element by design.

p0766, ×3 (སྡུག་མི་སྡུག་ལ་སོགས་པའི་ཁྱད་པར, incl. inside the Chú Giải Tứ Bách Luận quotation). The view registers ཁྱད་པར only as 'định ngữ' (viśeṣaṇa, the qualifier appended to a negandum, p0706) — a different sense in the immediately preceding chunks, so the two must be kept apart.

p0766, ×2 (prose and the Chú Giải Tứ Bách Luận quotation). Deliberately NOT the view's མི་སྡུག་པ = 'sự bất tịnh' (aśubha), which its own note scopes to p0348 as the antidote object for འདོད་ཆགས. Here the pair is what desire and hatred superimpose, so 'bất tịnh' would state the antidote where the text states the cause.

p0766, in the Chú Giải Tứ Bách Luận quotation གཏི་མུག་གཙོ་བོ་ཉིད་ཀྱི་ཕྱིར. COLLISION: the view registers གཙོ་བོ = 'thắng tánh' [pradhāna/prakṛti], the Sāṃkhya principle — and that very sense occurs two pages earlier at p0762 (དབང་ཕྱུག་དང་གཙོ་བོ). Using 'thắng tánh' here would make Āryadeva's commentary say that delusion is the Sāṃkhya prakṛti. A scoped split is needed.

p0765, བདེན་པར་མངོན་པར་རློམ་པ་མེད་པ. Follows the view's རློམ་པ = 'sự tự phụ' (prov, p0268), but see flags: 'tự phụ' reads as conceit/arrogance in Vietnamese and sits awkwardly with 'cho là thật'. Candidates: 'sự khăng khăng cho là thật', 'tăng thượng mạn'.
p0765. Rendered without naming which two (Tibetan does not name them either); the reference is to the arhats of the two lower vehicles.

p0763 l.3, `མུ་སྟེགས་ཀྱིས་བཏགས་པ་རྣམས` -> 'những thứ do ngoại đạo giả lập'. No headword anywhere in the c227 view. 'ngoại đạo' is the standard Sino-Vietnamese rendering and reads correctly here (the non-Buddhist tenet-holders whose imputations are contrasted with sắc/thanh). Wording KEPT; entry owed.

p0763 l.1, five occurrences in c227 (དཔྱད་ནས, དེ་ལྟར་དཔྱོད་པ་དེས, རང་བཞིན་ཡོད་མེད་དཔྱོད་པའི་རིགས་པའི་དཔྱད་པ, རིགས་པས་དཔྱད་བཟོད, དཔྱོད་དུ་མི་རུང་བ). Bare དཔྱད/དཔྱོད་པ still has no headword. The view's `སོ་སོར་དཔྱོད་པ` note records the corpus rule དཔྱད/དཔྱོད -> 'quán sát' (c083, and དཔྱད་སྒོམ = 'tu theo lối quán sát'), while c125 l.114 (p0410) and c134 render it 'thẩm sát'. c227 follows the c125/c134 side. Wording KEPT — not a violation, since no ruling binds. When the ruling is made, sweep c083, c125, c134 and c227 together. Two collisions the ruling must respect: 'thẩm sát' is already head word of the provisional `ངེས་པར་རྟོག་པ / ངེས་རྟོག` = 'thẩm sát quyết định', and `དཔྱོད་པ` as the fourth ṛddhipāda member is separately registered as 'sự thẩm sát' (p0645). Additionally in c227 `དཔྱད་བཟོད` ('kham nổi sự thẩm sát') depends on whatever word is chosen.

terms.vi: biến kế / thể tánh biến kế
terms.note: GAP - no entry in the c224 view for any of the three natures. The established Sino-Vietnamese 遍計 'biến kế' is used for the bare ཀུན་བརྟགས; the full 'biến kế sở chấp' was NOT used because the Tibetan short form carries no 'sở chấp'. Governs the whole first half of this chunk (~12x).
GAP. Established Sino-Vietnamese 圓成實. Third of the triad; must be ruled together with ཀུན་བརྟགས and གཞན་དབང.

Built on the registered ངོ་བོ་ཉིད = 'Thể tánh' (prov) and ངོ་བོ་ཉིད་མ་མཆིས་པ་ཉིད = 'tánh không có thể tánh'. Deliberately NOT 'vô tự tánh', which is the FIXED rendering of རང་བཞིན་མེད་པ: this passage turns on the two being different words (p0751: 'the lakṣaṇa of lakṣaṇa-niḥsvabhāvatā is svalakṣaṇa or rang bzhin'), so collapsing them would destroy the argument. Also ངོ་བོ་ཉིད་མེད་པ་གསུམ = 'ba [thứ] vô thể tánh'.

terms.vi: tự tướng / được thành lập bằng tự tướng
terms.note: No entry. 'tự tướng' already has corpus precedent (c182, c184). The compound is the pivot of the whole Svātantrika/Prāsaṅgika discussion here and recurs ~8x; kept distinct from རང་གི་ངོ་བོས་གྲུབ་པ = 'được thành lập bằng thể tánh của chính nó' (c211, c212 precedent).

Author of the ṭīkā on the Prajñāpradīpa, cited p0751. No entry; no established Sino-Vietnamese form. Left in Sanskrit transcription like Kamalaśīla / Śāntarakṣita. The Tibetan is itself a translation (Quán Tự Tại + cấm hạnh: cf. registered སྤྱན་རས་གཟིགས་དབང་ཕྱུག = Quán Tự Tại, བརྟུལ་ཞུགས = cấm hạnh), so a Sino-Vietnamese form is possible if the project prefers it.

terms.vi: phái Kinh Bộ / các vị Kinh Bộ
terms.note: No entry for the school name alone; glossary has only the compound མདོ་སྡེ་སྤྱོད་པའི་དབུ་མ་པ = 'Trung Quán Kinh Bộ Hành' (c208). p0754 x1 plus p0753 end.

p0754, in the Catuḥśatakaṭīkā citation བྱེ་བྲག་པ་ལྟར་རང་གི་སྡེ་པ་རྣམས་ཀྱིས་རྫས་ཀྱི་རྡུལ་ཕྲ་རབ་ཁས་བླང་བར་མི་རིགས་སོ. AMBIGUOUS - see flags. Read as Vaiśeṣika (non-Buddhist) because (a) the full form བྱེ་བྲག་ཏུ་སྨྲ་བ = 'phái Tỳ-bà-sa' is used two lines earlier for the Vaibhāṣikas, so the shorter different form is likely deliberate, and (b) 'rang gi sde pa rnams' (our own schools) needs the compared party to be an outsider. Needs a reader's ruling.

p0754, གཟུང་འཛིན་ཆ་མེད = 'những cái vô phần nơi sở thủ và năng thủ'. No entry; the registered འཛིན་པ compounds are all 'chấp' (grasping-at) senses, which does not fit the grāhaka half of this technical pair.

terms.vi: vô phần / vi trần vô phần
terms.note: p0753-p0754, 3x. No entry. Central to the Sautrāntika/Vaibhāṣika atom discussion.

p0753, 6x (རྫས་སུ་མེད་པ, རྫས་སུ་འདོད, རྫས་བརྒྱད, རྫས་ཉིད). No entry for bare རྫས; glossary registers only the compound རྫས་ཡོད = 'thật hữu' (prov, from c210/c211), which I used for རྫས་ཡོད here. 'thật thể' keeps the compound and the simplex visibly related. Kept distinct from དངོས་པོ = 'sự vật'.
Contracted form of the registered དམིགས་པའི་རྐྱེན = 'sở duyên duyên'. p0753 and p0754, 2x. Same Vietnamese; registering the short form so the alternation is not read as drift.
p0753, inside the Tarkajvālā citation. Follows the registered ཕྱོགས་སྔ་མ = 'tông trước' (pūrvapakṣa). Note the collision with གྲུབ་མཐའ = 'tông nghĩa' and རང་ལུགས = 'tự tông', all in this same chunk.

terms.vi: được thành lập là chân thật
terms.note: p0752, the Buddhapālita/Candrakīrti position. No entry. Follows c211's བདེན་དངོས = 'sự vật chân thật'; kept distinct from དོན་དམ་པར་གྲུབ་པ = 'được thành lập trong thắng nghĩa', which stands in the very same sentence as the contrasting Bhāvaviveka position.

p0753, ཕན་བཏགས་པའི་སྦྱོར་བ་དང་ལྡན་པ - atoms of one kind assisting one another. Deliberately NOT the registered སྦྱོར་བ = 'gia hành' (prayoga), whose own note scopes it to the བསམ་པ་དང་སྦྱོར་བ pair. Third scoped sense.
p0753, རྡུལ་ཕྲ་བའི་ཡང་མཐར་ཐུག་པ - the final limit of the subtle. NOT the registered མཐར་ཐུག = 'cứu cánh', whose note scopes it to the fourth member of the four-part karma frame at p0238.

p0751-p0752, ~10x. No ruling in the c224 view. Rendered 'biến kế' (遍計) consistently; the full form ཀུན་བརྟགས་པའི་ངོ་བོ་ཉིད = 'thể tánh biến kế'. First of the trisvabhāva trio that carries the whole argument of this chunk; needs registering together with the other two.

p0751, inside the Avalokitavrata quotation. No entry; the view has only རྣལ་འབྱོར -> 'du-già'. Kept distinct from སེམས་ཙམ་པ -> 'các vị Duy Thức' (prov, registered), which Tsongkhapa uses in his own prose in the same passage.

terms.vi: Kinh Vô Nhiệt Não Thưa Hỏi
terms.note: p0770 l3, source of the four-pāda verse `གང་ཞིག་རྐྱེན་ལས་སྐྱེས་པ་དེ་མ་སྐྱེས`. No entry in the view and no occurrence anywhere in the translated corpus. མ་དྲོས་པ = Anavatapta (the 'Unheated'), rendered with the established Sino-Vietnamese 無熱惱. The Tibetan short title carries no ནཱ་ག / ཀླུའི་རྒྱལ་པོ, so 'Long Vương' was NOT supplied. Not verified against an existing Vietnamese edition.

p0770 l3, `ཚིག་གསལ་དུ་དྲངས་པའི་ལང་གཤེགས་ལས`. Short form of ལང་ཀར་གཤེགས་པ. No entry in the view; no occurrence in the translated corpus. Established Vietnamese title used. Note this is the first citation of the sūtra and it is cited AT SECOND HAND, through the Prasannapadā — the framing is kept.
p0770 l3, vocative opening the Laṅkāvatāra quotation. Kept distinct from བློ་གྲོས་དང་ལྡན་པ (p0767 l1) = 'những bậc có trí', the common noun.

terms.vi: kẻ không tai và không tim
terms.note: p0769 l3 and p0770 l1 (Yuktiṣaṣṭikāvṛtti). Rendered literally because Tsongkhapa GLOSSES both halves in the very next sentence: རྣ་བ་མེད་པ because the opponent did not hear the word རང་བཞིན, སྙིང་མེད་པ because he got no understanding of its meaning. Any idiomatic rendering ('kẻ ngu muội', 'điếc và vô tâm') would break the gloss. 'tim' rather than 'tâm' so it does not collide with སེམས = tâm. Ruling owed on whether the literal form stands.

The pivot of this whole section, ~8× in p0768-p0770, deliberately kept distinct from རྟེན་འབྲེལ / རྟེན་ཅིང་འབྲེལ་བར་འབྱུང་བ / རྟེན་འབྱུང = 'duyên khởi' (registered prov). The section's argument is precisely that བརྟེན་ནས་སྐྱེ་བ is what REFUTES the four-alternative birth, and p0768 l1 puts both words in one sentence (བརྟེན་ནས་སྐྱེས་པའི་རྟེན་འབྲེལ), so a single Vietnamese word for both would make that sentence tautologous. No entry in the view.

terms.vi: được thành lập là thật thể
terms.note: p0768 l3, paired with རང་གི་མཚན་ཉིད་ཀྱིས་གྲུབ་པ = 'được thành lập bằng tự tướng'. No entry in the view; follows c224's 'thật thể' for རྫས and c222/c223's 'tự tướng'. Also p0768 l3 / p0769 l1 རྫས་ཀྱི་བདག་ཉིད = 'với tự thể là thật thể'.

terms.vi: với tự thể là thật thể
terms.note: p0768 l.3, in the མཚམས་སྦྱོར quotation: རྫས་ཀྱི་བདག་ཉིད་སྐྱེ་བར་འགྱུར་. No headword in the view. Paired with རྫས་སུ་གྲུབ་པ above.

terms.vi: được thành lập bằng tự tướng
terms.note: p0768 l.3 and p0769 l.1. The view rules only མཚན་ཉིད → "tướng / định nghĩa" (prov), which does not reach svalakṣaṇa-siddha. "tự tướng" matches established corpus usage (x42 in c2xx). Wording kept; entry owed.
p0769 l.1, inside the Nhập Trung Luận verse. No headword in the view; matches established corpus usage (x5). Wording kept; entry owed.

terms.vi: lối giả định mà khảo xét
terms.note: p0781, བརྟག་པ་མཐའ་བཟུང་གི་སྒོ་ནས་གསུངས་སམ. Also occurs at p0799. No entry. The idiom is 'to hold a position hypothetically, for the sake of examination'; rendered descriptively. A shorter fixed form ('theo lối giả thiết' / 'nói theo giả định') should be chosen.

p0783, ×2 (མྱང་འདས་དེ་མངོན་སུམ་དུ་བྱས་པ, འགོག་པའི་བདེན་པ་མངོན་སུམ་དུ་བྱ་དགོས་པ). The view registers མངོན་དུ་གྱུར་པ = 'sự hiện tiền' and མངོན་སུམ = 'hiện lượng' (epistemological); this third form is the act of actualizing, already rendered 'việc hiện chứng' in c219. Recording so the three stay separable.

p0781. The registered མཚན་ཉིད = 'tướng' (prov) instructs deciding per occurrence and flagging. Here Candrakīrti's མ་བཅོས་པ / གཞན་ལ་བལྟོས་པ་མེད་པ is the DEFINIENS of svabhāva (MMK XV.2), so 'định nghĩa' was chosen over 'tướng'.

p0782 and p0783, honorific of ཁས་ལེན. Rendered with the same plain 'thừa nhận' as ཁས་ལེན / འདོད་པ elsewhere in the chunk; the Tibetan honorific register is not reproduced. Flagged only so the flattening is on record.

L13/15/17/29/31/33. No headword for bare `བདག་མེད` in the view — only `གང་ཟག་གི་བདག -> cái ngã của bổ-đặc-già-la` (line 221). Wording kept: consistent with that entry and with `ཆོས་ཀྱི་བདག་མེད` -> "vô ngã của pháp" and `གང་ཟག་གི་བདག་མེད` -> "vô ngã của bổ-đặc-già-la" at L29. Should be registered.
L18 and L34, `དཔྱིས་ཀྱང་འབྱིན` in the two parallel Madhyamakāvatāra verses. No headword; rendering consistent and technical, recurs. Should be registered.

terms.vi: cái chỉ tựa như sự phá trừ
terms.note: p0771 ×2 (སུན་འབྱིན་ལྟར་སྣང་གི་མཐར་ཐུག་པ). GAP — no headword. Built from the two registered patterns: སུན་འབྱིན (bare) = 'phá trừ' and the descriptive ལྟར་སྣང renderings already in the glossary (ལམ་ལྟར་སྣང = 'cái chỉ tương tự như đạo', ཡོན་ཏན་ལྟར་སྣང = 'cái tựa như công đức'), plus c223's 'những cái chỉ tựa như tỷ lượng' for རྗེས་སུ་དཔག་པ་ལྟར་སྣང. This is the technical pramāṇa-śāstra term for a pseudo-refutation; a ruling should decide whether the whole ལྟར་སྣང family gets one fixed Vietnamese frame.

p0771 ×2. Uses the registered provisional མཐར་ཐུག = 'cứu cánh', but the sense here is 'the extreme/limiting case of a pseudo-refutation', not the goal-sense of the གནས་སྐབས / མཐར་ཐུག pair. Scope note requested so Phase 5 does not read it as drift.

terms.vi: câu đáp phân biệt riêng từng trường hợp
terms.note: p0771 l.1, contrasted with དོན་གྱིས་སོང་བ ('has already followed by implication'). GAP. དམིགས་ཀྱིས་ཕྱེ་བ is the technical 'singled out case by case'; rendered descriptively rather than with a Sino-Vietnamese coinage.

p0772 l.2, ཁོ་བོ་ཅག་སྨོན་པ་དང་ལྷན་ཅིག་ཏུ་མི་རྩོད་དོ. Same source typo already recorded for p0471 (glossary entry སྨྱོན་པ = 'người điên', note: 'printed in source/clean as སྨོན་པ'). Rendered 'người điên' to match that precedent — see flags.

terms.vi: sự vật có năng lực tác dụng
terms.note: p0772 l.1, the second of the two senses of དངོས་པོ, the one NOT negated conventionally. Follows the registered provisional དོན་བྱེད་པའི་ནུས་པ = 'năng lực tác dụng' (p0708) and c223's wording.

terms.vi: mâu thuẫn trực tiếp với điều đã thừa nhận
terms.note: p0772 l.2. Uses the registered ཁས་བླངས་པ = 'thừa nhận'; ནོminalised ཁས་བླངས here is the accepted thesis itself, so 'điều đã thừa nhận'.

terms.vi: cái chẳng phải là không / chẳng không
terms.note: p0772–p0773, in the MMK XIII.7 verse and Tsongkhapa's gloss on it, ~6×. GAP. Kept as a plain negation of the glossary's སྟོང་པ་ཉིད = 'tánh không' rather than importing 'bất không', so that the verse's own argument (nothing non-empty ⇒ how could there be the empty) stays visible in the Vietnamese.
p0773 l.1, གཞུང་གི་འགོ་མཇུག་ཐམས་ཅད་དུ. GAP, ordinary idiom.
p0774 l.2. GAP. Rendered literally; the sense is that the stated reason then holds good. རྒྱུ་མཚན = 'lý do' follows the registered རྒྱུ་མཚན་དགུ = 'chín lý do'.

p0771 l.4, ཐལ་འགྱུར་དང་རང་རྒྱུད་གང་གིས་གཏན་ལ་འབེབས་པའི་སྐབས. glossary.json registers only the agentive ཐལ་འགྱུར་བ = 'Ứng Thành' and རང་རྒྱུད་པ = 'Tự Lập' (both provisional, both flagged as GAPs at p0696), plus the contraction ཐལ་རང = 'ứng thành / tự lập' lowercase at p0703. Here the bare non-agentive forms name the two methods, not the two schools. Capitalised to match the p0696 entries; a ruling is owed on capitalisation of the method vs the school, since the same chunk-family already has both.

Section heading s236 and its opening restatement, p0771. Matched to c220's rendering of the same heading inside the four-fold enumeration ('thì chẳng thể làm điều làm hại được'), NOT to the registered provisional གནོད་བྱེད = 'điều phá bác' (p0687). The two chunks must agree; one ruling should pick one word. c220 also uses 'bị chánh lý làm hại' for རིགས་པས་གནོད་པ throughout, which is why 'làm hại' was preferred here.

terms.vi: `སྨོན་པ` retained + bracketed note, translated as "người điên" per the སྨྱོན་པ reading
terms.note: Second occurrence of this printed spelling in the corpus; c145 (p0469-p0472) hit the identical spelling and handled it the same way, keeping the Tibetan and footnoting the reading. Neither of the view's two provisional entries for སྨོན་པ ([tâm] nguyện in སྨོན་པའི་ཆོ་ག; tâm nguyện in སྨོན་པའི་ཡུལ་དུ་བྱས་ཏེ) covers this sense, and there is no ruling for the emended སྨྱོན་པ = madman sense. What is owed centrally is a corpus policy for this printed form: keep the Tibetan inline with a note (as c145 and now c229 do), or rule a plain rendering. Until then the wording here is deliberately provisional.
No entry in the view. 'Specifically/individually distinguished'. Kept; the added qualifier 'từng trường hợp' was removed.
No entry in the view. Matches c220's 'sự thẩm sát bằng chánh lý'. Kept deliberately distinct from བརྟག་པ.

No entry in the view. Kept distinct from དཔྱད་པ = 'sự thẩm sát'; both stand in the same passage (རིགས་པས་གནོད་མི་གནོད་ལ་སོགས་པའི་བརྟག་པ་བྱས་ནས vs དཔྱད་པ་དེ་དག་འཇུག་པ), so the distinction is load-bearing.

The view's only འགོག་པ entry is the unrelated nirodha sense ('diệt [đế]', p0402). This chunk uses འགོག་པ ~30× in the negation sense. Wording kept; a ruling is owed on the negation sense and on whether 'phủ định' and 'bác bỏ' split by context (the section heading uses 'bác bỏ' for མུ་བཞི་ག་འགོག་པ).
No entry in the view. p0772 l.1, ཁས་བླངས་དངོས་སུ་འགལ་བ = 'mâu thuẫn trực tiếp với điều đã thừa nhận'.
No entry in the view, but the rendering matches c208 and c212 verbatim. Registering the pair only; no wording change.

p0785 l.3, གཟུགས་སོགས་ཀྱི་ཆོས་འདི་དག་ཁྱད་གཞིར་བྱས་པའི་སྟེང་དུ. GAP — no headword in the view. Deliberately NOT 'hữu pháp', because ཆོས་ཅན = hữu pháp (registered, provisional) occurs four clauses later in the very same paragraph and the two must stay separable. Paired with ཁྱད་ཆོས = 'pháp sai biệt' so the qualificand/qualifier pair is visibly matched.

p0785 l.3, སྟོང་ཉིད ... ཁྱད་ཆོས་སུ་ཡོད་པས. SCOPE REQUEST, not a rewording: glossary registers ཁྱད་ཆོས = 'pháp đặc thù' scoped to p0410 (ཐེག་དམན་ལས་འབྱེད་པའི་ཐེག་ཆེན་གྱི་ཁྱད་ཆོས — the distinguishing feature of the Mahāyāna). Here it is the ontological/logical property standing on a qualificand, and 'pháp đặc thù' does not pair with ཁྱད་གཞི. Requested: 'pháp đặc thù' = distinguishing feature of a vehicle/doctrine; 'pháp sai biệt' = the property in the ཁྱད་གཞི / ཁྱད་ཆོས pair.

p0785 l.3, གཉིས་སྣང་དེ་མ་ལོག་པས. GAP — no entry, and no corpus precedent (grep: no 'nhị hiện'). Rendered descriptively to follow the corpus's སྣང་བ = 'hiện ra'. The established Sino-Vietnamese 'nhị hiện' is shorter and may be preferred; a ruling is owed because the term will recur throughout the vipaśyanā section.
p0785 l.3 and p0786 l.1. GAP. Built from the corpus's settled འཁྲུལ་བ = 'lầm loạn' (c225, c227) plus སྣང་བ = 'hiện ra'.

p0785 l.3, སྟོང་ཉིད་དེ་དོན་དམ་བདེན་པ་བཏགས་པ་བར་འགྱུར་རོ. GAP. This is the technical 'nominal / metaphorical ultimate' as against the actual ultimate; the corpus already renders བཏགས་པ = 'giả lập' (c211, c223, c225, c226), so the adjectival བཏགས་པ་བ was kept in that family. A ruling should decide whether the technical pair paryāya / aparyāya-paramārtha gets fixed Vietnamese wording, since it recurs in this section.
p0786 l.3, སྤྲོས་པ་རྣམ་པར་བཅད་པ་ཙམ་ལ་མི་འཇོག་པར. GAP. Kept plain and distinct from དགག་པ = 'phá bỏ' and from འགོག་པ, both of which occur nearby.

terms.vi: được thành lập một cách tự chủ
terms.note: p0786 l.3. Uses the registered རང་དབང = 'tự chủ' (provisional, from p0500-p0502 where it is the agent's autonomy). Here the sense is an object established independently/under its own power, not agency; recorded so the carry-over is deliberate. 'thành lập độc lập' may read better but drops the link to the registered word.

p0784 l.3, twice — in Tsongkhapa's gloss (གློ་བུར་དུ་རང་བཞིན་ཁས་བླངས་པ) and inside the Madhyamakāvatārabhāṣya quotation. GAP: the view registers only གློ་བུར་བ as the contrast term for རང་བཞིན of sentient beings (p0503 note). Here the adverb is the opponent's jibe that the Mādhyamika 'suddenly' concedes a nature; 'bỗng nhiên' keeps that, whereas the doctrinal 'khách trần / ngẫu nhiên' would not.

p0785 l.1, སྔར་གཉིས་སུ་སྨྲ་བའི་སྐབས་སུ་བཤད་པ་ལྟར — a back-reference. Follows the wording already used in c216 for the same phrase at p0721/p0723 ('chẳng vượt ra khỏi lối nói theo hai [bên]', 'bác bỏ lối nói theo hai bên có và không'). Recorded so the cross-reference stays findable.

p0786 l.3. SCOPE REQUEST. The registered ཞེན་པ = 'tham luyến' is scoped by its own note to འཁོར་བ་མཐའ་དག་ལ་ཞེན་པ (craving directed at saṃsāra); here the verb is purely cognitive — clinging to outer and inner dharmas AS the two selves — and 'tham luyến' would positively misdescribe it as desire. 'bám chấp' is already in corpus use (c091, c095, c155, c168, c210, c211).

p0784 l.3, inside the Madhyamakāvatārabhāṣya; the shorter བྱིས་པའི་སྐྱེ་བོ at p0785 l.1 was rendered 'kẻ phàm ấu trĩ'. Compounds the registered སོ་སོའི་སྐྱེ་བོ = 'phàm phu' with the corpus's བྱིས་པ = 'ấu trĩ' (c015, c082, c107).

p0785, `སྟོང་ཉིད་དེ་དོན་དམ་བདེན་པ་བཏགས་པ་བར་འགྱུར་རོ` — that emptiness becomes only a NOMINAL/imputed ultimate truth (because dualistic appearance has not yet reversed). No entry for བཏགས་པ or བཏགས་པ་བ in the view. Not a translator error. The term is load-bearing for the two-truths argument running through c230-c240 and should be ruled centrally (candidates: 'giả lập' / 'giả danh'), kept distinct from the already-registered ཐ་སྙད = 'danh ngôn'.

p0777 l.2, ཤཱ་རིའི་བུས་སྤྱན་རས་གཟིགས་ལ ... — the Heart Sutra dialogue. Absent from the c230 view. Follows the single existing corpus precedent (c206 l.19, 'Này Quán Tự Tại!'), so the two do not diverge. 'Quán Thế Âm' deliberately NOT used: it renders a different Sanskrit form and the corpus already committed to Quán Tự Tại.

p0777 last line, in the triad སྟོང་པ་ཉིད / མཚན་མ་མེད་པ / སྨོན་པ་མེད་པ. 'vô tướng' for མཚན་མ་མེད་པ already has three corpus occurrences; 'vô nguyện' has none and no entry. The sentence runs into c231, so the triad must read identically there.

MMK 13.8d, p0775. First occurrence in the corpus; no entry. Literally 'there is no accomplishing [them]'. Rendered with the medical sense that asādhya carries, matching the corpus's existing 'không thể chữa' (c014, c053, c156) — but Tsongkhapa does not gloss the word here, so this is an inference from the Sanskrit, not from the Tibetan on the page. See flags.

MMK 13.8b, p0775. No entry. Kept literal (ངེས་པར = quyết định, འབྱིན་པ = xuất ly) rather than the freer 'sự trừ khử', because the verse's whole point is that emptiness is the way OUT of views, not a device that destroys them.

terms.vi: không có cửa thứ hai dẫn đến tịch tĩnh
terms.note: p0777, quoted as the contracted pāda ཞི་སྒོ་གཉིས་པ་མེད་པ་དང and then restated in full inside the Catuḥśataka-ṭīkā passage. Registering the phrase so the pāda and its commentarial echo stay identical in Vietnamese; ཞི་བ follows the view's provisional 'tịch tĩnh'.
p0777, ཟླ་མེད་པའི་སྒོ. No entry; 'vô song' is already in corpus use (c004, c051, c056, c168, c213) for the matchless/unrivalled sense.
p0777. Follows c216 l.58, 'thành trì niết-bàn', the only close precedent (c106 l.77 has the shorter 'thành niết-bàn' in a verse).

p0776, ཚིག་གསལ་དུའང་སྟོང་ཉིད་ལ་དངོས་པོར་ཞེན་པ་ལ་གསུངས. The view's ཞེན་པ = 'tham luyến' is scoped by its own note to attachment-to-saṃsāra and is positively wrong here; the sense is cognitive reification, identical to མངོན་པར་ཞེན་པ = 'bám chấp', which occurs three times on the same and preceding page. 'chấp trước' keeps the two Tibetan words separable and matches c227's use of 'chấp trước' for the ཞེན family.

p0775, སྔར་རྩ་ཤེའི་ལུང. The view rules ལུང = 'giáo điển' (from ལུང་གིས་ཕྱུག, p0060), which does not fit a back-reference to a specific citation. Rendered 'trong đoạn *Căn Bản Trung Luận* đã dẫn ở trước'. A scoped entry is owed; this citation-back-reference use recurs throughout the Madhyamaka chapters.

p0775 ×2, p0777 ×1. Deliberately NOT the FIXED རང་བཞིན་མེད་པ = 'vô tự tánh', because this chunk's entire argument turns on the difference between the negation (རང་བཞིན་མེད་པ) and the emptiness that is that negation (རང་བཞིན་གྱིས་སྟོང་པའི་སྟོང་པ), and both stand in the same sentence. 'trống rỗng tự tánh' has 25 corpus occurrences but no headword.

NO ruling in the view — only སྟོང་པ་ཉིད → 'tánh không' is fixed — so neither rendering in c230 is a violation, and the wording was kept except for the re-quoted MMK line. c230 currently splits: 'trống rỗng' at L13 (སྟོང་པ་མ་ཡིན་པར་འགྱུར), L24 (རང་བཞིན་གྱིས་སྟོང་པའི་སྟོང་པ), L44 (རང་བཞིན་གྱིས་སྟོང་པར), L53 (བདག་གིས་སྟོང་ལྟ་བས); 'không' at L34 (ཕུང་འདི་སྟོང་ཞེས, verse) and L42 (སྟོང་པ་དང་བདག་མེད་པར་བལྟ་བ, paired with vô ngã). RECOMMENDED RULING: bare སྟོང་པ → 'không'. Evidence: c229, the immediately preceding chunk of this same continuous argument, renders it 'không' throughout ('chẳng phải là không', 'chút gì là không', 'cái không', 'không hay chẳng không tự tánh'), including the very MMK line c230 re-cites. This is a corpus-wide sweep (c229/c230 at minimum), not a c230-only edit, which is why the remaining occurrences were left as they stand. Whichever way it goes, the ruling must keep bare སྟོང་པ visibly distinct from སྟོང་པ་ཉིད = 'tánh không', since this chunk's whole argument turns on that contrast (སྟོང་པ་ཉིད་དུ་ལྟ་བ vs རང་བཞིན་གྱིས་སྟོང་པའི་སྟོང་པ).

terms.bo: ཞེན་པ (epistemic sense: clinging to emptiness as a thing)
terms.note: p0776, སྟོང་ཉིད་ལ་དངོས་པོར་ཞེན་པ, at L30. Text kept. The view's prov ཞེན་པ → 'tham luyến' (line 188) is explicitly scoped to affective attachment to saṃsāra (འཁོར་བ་མཐའ་དག་ལ་ཞེན་པ) and would be wrong here, where nothing affective is meant; the compound མངོན་པར་ཞེན་པ → 'bám chấp' (view line 330) is used correctly at L26 for the Buddhapālita passage. 'chấp trước' is therefore a third Vietnamese word for this root with no ruling behind it. A ruling is needed to split the epistemic ཞེན་པ from the affective one — either license 'chấp trước' for the epistemic sense (kept distinct from འཛིན་པ = 'nắm giữ', which occurs several times in the same paragraph), or fold it into 'bám chấp' alongside མངོན་པར་ཞེན་པ.

terms.bo: ལྟ་བ / བལྟ་བ (verbal, governing an object or a -ར/-དུ complement)
terms.note: Registering the departure from prov ལྟ་བ → 'kiến' (view line 38), which is not recorded in the file. Text kept, because the distribution in c230 is grammatical, not arbitrary: the nominal dṛṣṭi is 'kiến' (L20 ལྟ་ཀུན → 'hết thảy các kiến'; L58 དེ་ཁོ་ན་ཉིད་ཀྱི་ལྟ་བ, genitive-marked noun → 'cái kiến về thật tánh'), while every occurrence that takes a complement is verbal and reads 'thấy' (L24 སྟོང་པ་ཉིད་དུ་ལྟ་བ, རང་བཞིན་གྱིས་སྟོང་ངོ་སྙམ་དུ་ལྟ་བ, དངོས་པོར་ལྟ་བ; L30 སྟོང་པ་ཉིད་དུ་བལྟ་བ་ཙམ; L39 བདག་དང་བདག་མེད་བལྟ་བ་དག; L42 སྟོང་པ་དང་བདག་མེད་པར་བལྟ་བ; L53 བདག་གིས་སྟོང་ལྟ་བས; L60 རང་བཞིན་མེད་པར་བལྟ་བ). On L21 (MMK 13.8, གང་དག་སྟོང་པ་ཉིད་ལྟ་བ) the checker reads a technical noun; the Tibetan is ambiguous, but Tsongkhapa's own gloss in the very next sentence resolves it verbally — སྟོང་པ་ཉིད་དུ་ལྟ་བ་ཞེས་པ, with the -དུ complement — so the verbal reading is the one the commentary licenses and 'cái thấy' was kept. Requested ruling: license 'cái thấy' (nominalised verbal) as the form for ལྟ་བ/བལྟ་བ with a complement, reserving 'kiến' for the bare/genitive-marked noun, so the Phase 5 sweep does not read the split as drift.

terms.vi: Nhận định cái phải phá bỏ theo tự tông
terms.note: Section heading, sectionPath 6.2.3.1.11.2.6.2.1.1.3.2.1.3, first occurrence in the corpus (c231-c233 not yet translated). Uses the registered རང་ལུགས = 'tự tông' and དགག་བྱ = 'cái phải phá bỏ'. ངོས་བཟུང་བ / ངོས་འཛིན has no glossary entry at all; 'nhận định' chosen over 'xác định' (which the corpus already uses for ངེས་པ / གྲངས་ངེས) so the two stay separable. The heading recurs across c234-c237 and in the sibling sa-bcad དགག་བྱ་ངོས་འཛིན་ཁྱབ་ཆུངས་པ་དགག་པ (c231-c233), so one ruling settles seven chunks.

terms.vi: Nhận định cái phải phá bỏ, tức ý nghĩa chính
terms.note: Sub-heading, path …3.2.1.3.1. Follows the established corpus pattern for དངོས་ཀྱི་དོན་X = 'X, tức ý nghĩa chính' (c137 L57, c138 L13, for དངོས་ཀྱི་དོན་གྲངས་ངེས་པ་བསྟན་པ).

GAP. glossary.json registers ཤེས་བྱའི་སྒྲིབ་པ = 'sở tri chướng' (provisional) but not its partner. Rendered as the established Sino-Vietnamese pair so the two members of the MAV verse stay visibly matched; note that the Tibetan writes a genitive (ཉོན་མོངས་པ་ཡི་སྒྲིབ་པ) which 'phiền não chướng' compresses — the same compression the registered སོ་སོ་ཏྲི entry already makes. Occurs 2× at p0788.

GAP. p0788, 5× in the Vigrahavyāvartanī verse and its autocommentary. Deliberately NOT the registered ལོག་རྟོག = 'tà chấp' (a different word), and deliberately NOT 'sự chấp điên đảo', because ཕྱིན་ཅི་ལོག་གི་འཛིན་པ and ཡུལ་ཅན་ཕྱིན་ཅི་ལོག occur eight lines later on the same page and are rendered 'sự chấp điên đảo' / 'hữu cảnh điên đảo' per the registered ཕྱིན་ཅི་ལོག = 'điên đảo'. Collapsing them would erase the contrast Tsongkhapa draws between the verse's wording and his own gloss.
GAP, p0789 (ཡོད་པར་འཛིན་པའི་འཁྲུལ་ཤེས་ལྡོག་པ). No entry. Follows c221's 'hữu cảnh lầm lạc' / 'hiển hiện lầm lạc' for the འཁྲུལ་ family, and keeps 'lầm lạc' apart from ཕྱིན་ཅི་ལོག = 'điên đảo'.

p0787, རིགས་པའི་ཚོགས་རྒྱ་ཆེ་བ. GAP. The registered ཚོགས = 'tư lương' (saṃbhāra) would misread it, and the second, scoped ཚོགས = 'các việc' (assembly sense, p0468) does not fit either. Note this may be the proper name of Nāgārjuna's rigs tshogs (Collection of Reasonings) rather than a common noun; the modifier རྒྱ་ཆེ་བ made a common-noun reading likelier, so it was translated rather than treated as a title. See flags.

terms.vi: chẳng khả dĩ dẫn về [nghĩa khác]
terms.note: p0787, དེའི་དོན་གཞན་དུ་དྲང་དུ་མི་རུང་བ — i.e. cannot be interpreted as neyārtha. Uses the provisional རུང་བ = 'khả dĩ' (tenable sense) already recorded from p0709-p0710. The verbal འདྲེན་པ/དྲང་བ in the neyārtha sense has no entry; 'dẫn về nghĩa khác' keeps the link to the registered དྲང་དོན.

terms.vi: lời nói càn bậy chứa đầy mâu thuẫn
terms.note: p0790. No entry for བབ་ཅོལ; 'càn bậy' follows c032's 'lời càn bậy'. འགལ་འདུ (self-contradiction) has no entry.

p0789-p0790, the standard Vigrahavyāvartanī 'Devadatta is not in the house' example. Uses the provisional ལྷས་བྱིན = 'Devadatta' recorded from p0216. NOTE: the source writes ལྷས་བྱིན once and ལྷ་སྦྱིན four times within the same sentence — see flags.
p0790. Uses the registered སྒྱུ་མ = 'huyễn hóa' (provisional, p0334-p0335). Kept distinct from སྤྲུལ་པ, rendered 'hóa hiện' throughout this chunk.

p0788, 6×. The only registered form is སྤྲུལ = 'vật biến hóa' (provisional, p0502 BCA verse སྤྲུལ་ལྟ་བུའི་དངོས་པོ), which is scoped to a 'thing'. Here the emanation is a person (an emanated woman, and an emanation produced by a tathāgata), so 'vật' would be wrong; 'hóa hiện' has 12 corpus occurrences as the verb (c028, c054). A ruling should cover the noun.

terms.vi: kẻ ngu, tức hạng người [bị vô minh làm mê muội]
terms.note: p0790. Compound of two separately-provisional entries (བྱིས་པ = 'kẻ ngu', སྐྱེ་བོ = 'người / hạng người'). Rendered as an apposition rather than a single word so both members remain traceable.

terms.vi: sự gán đặt (as written; a ruling is needed — 'tăng ích' is the standard rendering)
terms.kind: gap + collision with a registered provisional
terms.note: L43, p0789 l.1, ཡོད་པར་འཛིན་པའི་སྒྲོ་འདོགས. No ruling for སྒྲོ་འདོགས in the view, so the wording is KEPT. But it collides inside this one chunk with prov སྒྲོ་བཏགས -> 'sự gán đặt' (p0309/p0310), which this chunk itself uses at L52 for སྒྲོ་བཏགས་པ (p0790 l.1): two distinct Tibetan words on one Vietnamese. One ruling should settle both; note 'tăng ích' appears nowhere in translation/ yet, so adopting it would be a clean split rather than a sweep.

terms.vi: thẩm sát (L56) vs khảo xét (L56, three lines on)
terms.kind: gap + internal split; ruling must sweep, not patch this chunk
terms.note: p0790 l.3: དགག་སྒྲུབ་ཀྱི་རིགས་པའི་དཔྱོད་པ -> 'thẩm sát' and དགག་སྒྲུབ་ཀྱི་དཔྱད་པ -> 'khảo xét', same phrase frame, one paragraph. The view's own prov དཔྱོད་པ -> 'thẩm sát' entry already records the corpus as split c083 ('quán sát') vs c125/c134 ('thẩm sát') and asks for a single ruling; 'khảo xét' is a third form in use across ~20 chunks. Left as written — patching c234 alone would only deepen the split. Constraint from the existing note: the chosen word must not be one already carrying རྟོག་པ's sense, and 'thẩm sát' is already the head word of prov ངེས་པར་རྟོག་པ / ངེས་རྟོག.

No entry in the view. Consistent with the single corpus precedent c068 l.13 ('Devadatta', beside 'Yajñadatta'), so KEPT. Orthographic note for the entry: the source spells the first occurrence ལྷས་བྱིན and the rest ལྷ་སྦྱིན — a genuine variant of the same name, not a typo, so no text change is warranted, but the entry should record both spellings.

terms.vi: người (in སྒྱུ་མའི་སྐྱེས་བུ 'người huyễn hóa', སྐྱེས་བུ་ཡང་དག་པའི་ངོ་བོ 'thể tánh chân thật của người'); có người nào đó (སྐྱེས་བུ་ཁ་ཅིག, L39)
terms.kind: gap the view's own entry predicts — formal departure from a prov, wording kept
terms.note: L39 and L52 (p0789 l.1, p0790 l.1). The view carries prov སྐྱེས་བུ -> 'bậc trượng phu', but that entry's note states there is NO RULING for the bare word and itself flags 'trượng phu' as re-importing a heroic/masculine gloss the Tibetan lacks. In the māyā simile the referent is the illusory *man*, and in སྐྱེས་བུ་ཁ་ཅིག simply 'someone', so 'người' is the better reading. KEPT; a ruling for the bare word would settle this together with the p0139/p0213/p0441/p0524 occurrences the entry lists.

p0778 l.1, inside the Catuḥśatakaṭīkā quotation: བྱང་ཆུབ་ཀྱི་ཚོགས་ལས ... ཞེས་བཤད་དོ. The view registers བྱང་ཆུབ་ཀྱི་ཚོགས only as the common noun 'tư lương bồ-đề' (bodhisaṃbhāra, p0072 Ratnamegha). Here it names Nāgārjuna's treatise. Rendered as the title *Bồ-đề Tư Lương* (word order inverted from the common-noun entry so the two are visibly different). No corpus precedent — grep finds no prior occurrence of this title in translation/. A ruling is owed on whether to add 'Luận'.

p0779 l.1, དེ་དག་ནི་ཁྱབ་བྱེད་ཀྱི་ངོས་ནས་སྐྱོན་བརྗོད་པ་ཡིན་གྱི. GAP — no entry, no corpus occurrence. Chose 'cái bao trùm' over the standard Sino-Vietnamese 能遍 'năng biến' deliberately: the argument turns on the link with the pot analogy two sentences later (བུམ་པ་ལ་མི་རྟག་པས་ཁྱབ = 'cái bình bị vô thường bao trùm'), and with the section heading pair ཁྱབ་ཆེས་པ / ཁྱབ་ཆུངས་པ ('quá rộng' / 'quá hẹp', c211). 'năng biến' would break that link and also sits one syllable from 'biến kế' (ཀུན་བརྟགས), which occurs in this same chunk. The partner ཁྱབ་བྱ (vyāpya) occurs later in the book (p0862-ish, ཁྱབ་བྱེད་ཁེགས་པས་ཁྱབ་བྱ་ཡང་ཁེགས་པ) and should be ruled at the same time ('cái bị bao trùm' / 'sở biến').

p0778 l.5, རྣམ་འཇོག་གཞན་ལ་མི་ལྟོས་པའོ — the third of the opponent's three characteristics of svabhāva. Contracted form of རྣམ་པར་འཇོག་པ; rendered with the corpus's 'an lập' (75 occurrences) used for རྣམ་གཞག / རྣམ་པར་བཞག་པ. Registered only so the contracted form is on record.

terms.vi: thành lập một cách chân chánh
terms.note: p0779 l.3, in the triad དོན་དམ་པར་[གྲུབ་པ] / ཡང་དག་པར་གྲུབ་པ / བདེན་པར་གྲུབ་པ. GAP. The other two follow the corpus: དོན་དམ་པར་གྲུབ་པ = 'thành lập trong thắng nghĩa' (c211-c227, 7×), བདེན་པར་གྲུབ་པ = 'thành lập là chân thật' (c224). The middle member needed a third distinct word; 'chân chánh' follows the existing houseStyle-note rendering of ཡང་དག་པར. All three must stay separable because the sentence enumerates them as three separate designations.

p0780 l.1, ལྟོ་ལྡིར་བ་དེའི་དོན་དུ་བཞག་དགོས་པ — the standard definition-word for བུམ་པ in the pot/impermanence analogy. No entry, no corpus occurrence. Rendered descriptively; a shorter fixed form ('bụng phình') may be preferable if it recurs.

p0780 l.3, ཀུན་བརྟགས་ཀྱི་འཛིན་པའི་ཡུལ་རྣམས, standing against ལྷན་སྐྱེས་ཀྱི་མ་རིག་པ = 'vô minh câu sinh' (the view's ལྷན་སྐྱེས = 'câu sinh'). Wording follows the corpus (c219, c223, c224: 'biến kế', 'biến kế sở chấp'), but every corpus occurrence is the trisvabhāva sense (parikalpita vs paratantra); this is the acquired-vs-innate sense of the afflictions, a different technical pairing. Note the standard Vietnamese alternative '[khởi bởi] phân biệt' is blocked, because the view already fixes རྟོག་པ = 'phân biệt'.

terms.vi: cái ngã thường, nhất, tự chủ
terms.note: p0780 l.3. The standard tīrthika ātman formula. Uses the view's རང་དབང = 'tự chủ' (p0500-p0502). No entry for the formula as a unit; registering it so the three adjectives are not re-decided later.

p0779 l.1, ...འགྱུར་དགོས་སོ་ཞེས་འཕངས་པ་ནི་དབུ་མའི་གཞུང་རྣམས་སུ་དུ་མ་ཞིག་ཡོད. GAP. The verb is the technical one for flinging a thal-'gyur consequence at an opponent. Rendered plainly as 'nêu ra' because the corpus has no established word and a stronger rendering ('tung ra nghịch lượng', 'phóng ra hệ quả') would supply 'consequence', a word the Tibetan leaves implicit here.

p0778 l.1 (ཡུལ་དེ་སུན་དབྱུང) and p0780 l.3 (×2). NOT a new headword — a request to close the split the view already records. glossary.json now carries three divergent provisional renderings for this verb: 'phá trừ' (bare form, c094), 'bài xích' (p0337, graded-triad sense), 'đả phá' (p0350). All three occurrences here are the same verb in one argument, so one word had to be used; chose 'phá trừ', which is what c2xx already uses 11× and which the bare-form entry names. The chunk cannot be internally consistent AND consistent with all three entries at once.

terms.bo: བྱང་ཆུབ་ཀྱི་ཚོགས (as the title of Nāgārjuna's śāstra)
terms.note: p0778 l.1, བྱང་ཆུབ་ཀྱི་ཚོགས་ལས། … ཞེས་བཤད་དོ (c231 L11). The view carries only 'prov བྱང་ཆུབ་ཀྱི་ཚོགས -> tư lương bồ-đề [bodhisaṃbhāra]', which is the concept, not the book. decisions.md requires one fixed Vietnamese title per cited text, decided at first occurrence. Wording kept. Note the title deliberately reverses the word order of the concept entry (Bồ-đề Tư Lương vs tư lương bồ-đề) — that is a title/concept distinction, not drift, and the ruling should say so explicitly so a later sweep does not collapse the two.

p0779 l.1, དེ་ཡང་དབུ་མའི་རྩ་བ་ལས། (c231 L24), introducing MMK XV.1-2. The view has no headword for དབུ་མའི་རྩ་བ at all — only དབུ་མ -> 'Trung Quán' and དབུ་མ་པ -> 'các vị Trung Quán'. 'Trung Luận' is the established Sino-Vietnamese title and is kept; it needs fixing centrally, and the ruling should also cover the fuller form དབུ་མ་རྩ་བའི་ཤེས་རབ if it occurs later in the vipaśyanā section.

p0778 l.1: རང་བཞིན་མེད་པས་སྟོང་ལ་སྟོང་པ་ནི (Bodhisaṃbhāraka verse, c231 L13) and རང་བཞིན་གྱིས་སྟོང་པར་བལྟ་བའི་ལྟ་བ (c231 L20). The view fixes only སྟོང་པ་ཉིད -> 'tánh không'; the bare form is unruled. Rendered 'trống rỗng' consistently across the verse and the prose that follows, deliberately kept distinct from the fixed 'tánh không'. A ruling is owed because the choice between 'trống rỗng' and 'không' on the bare adjective recurs on nearly every page of the remaining vipaśyanā section.

MMK verse at p0779 l.1, འབྱུང་བར་རིགས་པ་མ་ཡིན་ནོ (c231 L27). The view registers only the nominal sense — prov རིགས་པ -> 'chánh lý' [yukti], and ལུང་དང་རིགས་པ -> 'giáo điển và chánh lý' (used correctly at c231 L20) — while the རུང་བ entry notes that 'hợp lý' is the corpus rendering of འཐད་པ. So the predicative རིགས་པ and འཐད་པ now both land on 'hợp lý'. Wording kept (the nominal 'chánh lý' is unusable predicatively), but the sense split and the collision with འཐད་པ should be registered together, alongside the existing རུང་བ -> 'khả dĩ' ruling that already sits in this cluster.

Three renderings inside c231, all contextually defensible, because the view fixes only the noun དགག་བྱ -> 'cái phải phá bỏ' and lists འགོག་པ only in its nirodha sense ('diệt [đế]', p0402): 'ngăn dứt' at L20 (བཟང་རྟོག་དང་ངན་རྟོག་གང་ཡིན་ཀྱང་འགོག་ན, p0778 l.1 — a meditator suppressing conceptions, not refuting a thesis); 'phá bỏ' at L37 (དགག་པར་བྱ་དགོས, p0779 l.1 — the Mādhyamika refuting an assertion, matching the registered noun); 'phủ định' at L41 (གང་ཟག་གི་བདག་འགོག་པ་ན / ཆོས་ཀྱི་བདག་འགོག་པ་ན, p0780 l.1 — negating a self). All kept, since no ruling exists. A ruling is owed on the philosophical sense: suggest 'phá bỏ' as the single verb, so it matches the fixed noun དགག་བྱ, with the meditative-suppression sense at L20 split off explicitly. Note also that 'phủ định' at L41 stands in the same sentence as སུན་འབྱིན་པ -> 'phá trừ' (licensed by the view), so those two verbs are currently distinguished only by accident.

p0794 l.1, twice: མ་རིག་པ་ནི་རིག་པའི་བཟློག་ཕྱོགས་ཡིན and དེའི་བཟློག་ཕྱོགས. GAP. Deliberately kept one word apart from the registered འགལ་ཟླ = 'cái đối nghịch' (prov, p0314), because both stand in the SAME sentence here (དེའི་འགལ་ཟླ་འཛིན་པའོ) and must remain separable.

p0791 l.1. GAP. Rendered descriptively; the registered ཚོགས = 'tư lương' (saṃbhāra) would misread it, and the view's second scoped sense ཚོགས = 'các việc' does not fit either. A ruling is owed on whether this names Nāgārjuna's Yukti corpus (rigs tshogs) as a title-like collection or is a plain common noun - see flags.

p0792 l.3, inside the Catuḥśataka-ṭīkā quotation. No entry and no corpus occurrence. Contains the fixed བཟོད་པ = 'nhẫn'; the established Sino-Vietnamese compound was preferred over a literal 'nhẫn nơi pháp vô sinh'.

terms.vi: vô tri mang tánh phiền não
terms.note: p0792 l.3, inside the Catuḥśataka-ṭīkā quotation. Uses the view's ཉོན་མོངས་ཅན = 'mang tánh phiền não'; མི་ཤེས་པ = 'vô tri' is a GAP. Kept distinct from ཉོན་མོངས་ཅན་གྱི་མ་རིག་པ = 'vô minh mang tánh phiền não' (registered), which occurs on p0793 in the same argument - the two must stay separable.
p0793 l.1, གཙོ་བོའི་རྒྱུ་གཉིས་མེད་པའི་ཕྱིར. GAP. Deliberately NOT the view's གཙོ་བོ = 'thắng tánh' (pradhāna/prakṛti, the Sāṃkhya principle at p0208), which would be positively wrong here.
p0794 l.1, མ་རིག་པ་སྤྱི་དང་འཇིག་ལྟ་བྱེ་བྲག. Paired with the view's སྤྱི = 'cái tổng quát' (prov), so given the matching form.

terms.vi: sự gán đặt thành ngã của pháp / cái chấp ngã của pháp
terms.note: p0794 l.1. Built from the view's གང་ཟག་གི་བདག = 'cái ngã của bổ-đặc-già-la' so the two members of the pair are parallel in Vietnamese as they are in Tibetan. The compact 'pháp ngã' (c135) was avoided because the sentence sets ཆོས་ཀྱི་བདག against གང་ཟག་གི་བདག explicitly.
p0791 l.3, inside the Prasannapadā verse. GAP; rendered literally. Kept distinct from སྤྱོད་ཡུལ = 'hành cảnh' (registered), which occurs in the Catuḥśataka verse two paragraphs later.

p0791 l.1. Follows the view's adjectival དམ་པ = 'tối thắng' (p0359) rather than its དམ་པ = 'chân chánh' (c142), because 'chánh lý chân chánh' doubles 'chánh'. See flags - the two དམ་པ rulings need reconciling.

p0791 l.3, 3x (ཉེས་སྐྱོན་ཐམས་ཅད་ཀྱི་རྩ་བར / ཉེས་སྐྱོན་ཐམས་ཅད་ལྡོག་པར / ཉེས་སྐྱོན་ཐམས་ཅད་ཀྱི་གཞི). No headword in the view; wording KEPT per the gap rule. A ruling is owed on the PAIR, because the view's note at line 186 already renders the different word ཉེས་དམིགས (ādīnava) as 'lỗi hại' too, so a Phase-5 sweep will see two distinct Tibetan terms on one Vietnamese word. Suggested split: ཉེས་དམིགས = 'lỗi hại' (the settled one) / ཉེས་སྐྱོན = 'lỗi lầm' or 'tội lỗi'. Not changed here because either member of the pair could move, and only a central ruling can decide which.

p0791 verse, `སངས་རྒྱས་རྣམས་ཀྱི་མདོ་ཡི་སྡེ་སོགས`. No headword for མདོ་སྡེ / མདོ་ཡི་སྡེ; the only མདོ mentions in the view are inside the Samādhirāja title notes (lines 80/82). Wording kept. The ruling should be taken together with the ཆོས fixed-set and the registered མདོ forms, and should say whether the navāṅga member is 'khế kinh' or plain 'kinh'.

terms.bo: སུན་འབྱིན་པ / སུན་དབྱུང་བ / སུན་ཕྱུང་བ (object = the mode of apprehension or object of ignorance)
terms.note: p0795 l.3, p0798 l.1 (×3). The glossary view carries three divergent provisional renderings for this root — 'phá trừ' (c094), 'bài xích' (p0337, graded triad), 'đả phá' (p0350) — and asks for a ruling. Here the operation is the central technical one of the whole section (rigs pas 'dzin stangs sun dbyung ba). 'phá trừ' chosen because the immediately preceding verified chunk c227 renders exactly this collocation ('chánh lý phá trừ cách nắm giữ của vô minh') that way, so the two chunks read as one argument. The owed ruling should cover this sense explicitly.

terms.bo: མཚམས་སྦྱོར (transitional passage introducing a chapter of a commentary)
terms.note: p0796 l.1, ×2 (རབ་བྱེད་ཉེར་དྲུག་པའི་མཚམས་སྦྱོར་དུ / རབ་བྱེད་ཉེར་བདུན་པའི་མཚམས་སྦྱོར་དུའང). GAP — no entry. Corpus has མཚམས་སྦྱོར only inside ཉིང་མཚམས་སྦྱོར་བ = 'kết sinh' (rebirth-linking), a wholly different sense that must stay separate.

terms.bo: བུད་དྷ་པཱ་ལི་ཏ (as the title of the commentary)
terms.note: p0795 l.3. Kept in transcription, following c210 and c218 which already cite the work this way. Distinct from the person སངས་རྒྱས་བསྐྱངས = Phật Hộ (registered), which occurs in this same chunk at p0796 l.1 — both forms stand within fifteen lines of each other here, so the split is load-bearing.

p0796 l.1. GAP. Deliberately NOT 'trí tuệ', because ཤེས་རབ་ཀྱི་མིག = 'con mắt trí tuệ' occurs three lines later in the same Buddhapālita citation and the two must stay visibly apart. Follows the glossary's provisional བློ = 'cái trí'.
p0797 l.1, སྒྲུབ་བྱེད་ཆེན་པོ. No entry. 'năng lập' is attested once in the corpus (c207, ཚད་མ་སྒྲུབ་བྱེད); kept for the technical proof sense rather than a loose 'chứng cứ'.
p0798 l.1, རྩ་བ་ཆད་པའི་ལོན་པ་ལྟར = 'như cây bị chặt đứt gốc rễ'. No entry; matches the corpus's ཙནྡན་ལོན་པ = 'cây chiên-đàn'.

terms.vi: đạt được … một cách phân định rõ ràng
terms.note: p0798 l.1, ངེས་པ་དམིགས་ཕྱེད་པར་རྙེད་པ. Follows the corpus rendering of དམིགས་ཕྱེད་པར་བྱས་ནས = 'phân định rõ [làm đối tượng]' (c158, c165, c216). ངེས་པ uses the registered 'sự xác quyết'.

p0796 l.1, ལྟ་བའི་རྣམ་པ་མི་སྲིད་པ — Buddhapālita's introduction to MMK ch. 27, which enumerates the varieties of wrong view. The glossary rules རྣམ་པ = 'hành tướng' [ākāra] and its own note already records a collision with འཛིན་སྟངས; 'hành tướng của kiến' would be positively wrong here. Scoped sense needed.
p0798 l.1. No entry; matches c227's 'căn thức' in the immediately preceding pages.

p0796 l.1, the sole occurrence in the whole corpus (checked source/clean/). The view has no མདོ་སྡེ headword, and its two མཐའ entries are different senses ('chỗ cuối cùng' as the fifth member of a five-fold list; 'cực đoan' for ཡོད་པའི་མཐའ / ཆད་པའི་མཐའ). Rendered as the unit sūtrānta -> 'khế kinh' to supply the dropped མཐའ. A ruling should confirm 'khế kinh' for the compound and, separately, fix bare མདོ་སྡེ (currently 'các bộ kinh' / 'khế kinh' elsewhere in the corpus) so the two do not collapse.

terms.vi: phân định rõ được điều được nhắm đến
terms.note: p0798 l.1. Unusual collocation; not in the view and not elsewhere in the corpus. Rendered literally with an inline uncertainty flag rather than smoothed. A ruling (or a source-reading check against another edition — this may be a printing oddity like the ones in FINDINGS §8.6) would settle it.

p0796 l.1, rendered at L46. No headword in the view (the nearest is བདག་མེད་པ inside a phrase gloss at line 153). Corpus is split 4 'pháp vô ngã' / 3 'vô ngã của pháp' — unsettled centrally rather than wrong here, so the wording is KEPT. A ruling is needed to close the drift.

p0812 ×2, in ཡིན་ཚུལ་ལ་ཇི་ལྟར་ཡིན་ཚུལ་བཞིན་དུ་དཔྱོད་པའི་རིགས་པ and ཡིན་ཚུལ་དཔྱོད་པའི་རིགས་པ — the 'reasoning that analyses the mode of being'. GAP: no entry in the view. Rendered 'cách thức tồn tại', which matches c227's 'cách thức tồn tại của chính đối tượng' (ཡུལ་རང་གི་སྡོད་ལུགས). A ruling should say whether ཡིན་ཚུལ and སྡོད་ལུགས may share one Vietnamese, since this phrase names a variant of the registered དེ་ཁོ་ན་ཉིད་ལ་དཔྱོད་པའི་རིགས་པ = 'chánh lý thẩm sát thật tánh', which stands three lines later in the same paragraph.

p0812 ×2 (ཐལ་འགྱུར་དང་རང་རྒྱུད་གཉིས་སུ་ཕྱེ་ནས་ཐལ་འགྱུར་མཛད་པ). The view registers only the abbreviation ཐལ་རང (prov, '[luận thức] ứng thành hay [luận thức] tự lập'); the full words have no headword. Corpus precedent: c208 and c229 capitalise as school names ('Ứng Thành và Tự Lập'), c211 lowercases as argument types. Here the sense is the argument type, so lowercase was used.

p0812, paired with ཐལ་འགྱུར in the same phrase. Same gap and same reasoning as ཐལ་འགྱུར. Kept distinct from the registered prov རྒྱུད = 'tâm tương tục' (santāna), which also occurs in this chunk (ལྟ་བ་རྒྱུད་ལ་བསྐྱེད་པ).
p0812, ཐལ་འགྱུར་མཛད་པའི་གསལ་ཁ་ནི་མེད — 'there is no explicit statement that he made prasaṅga arguments'. No entry. Rendered as a common noun 'chỗ nói rõ'.

terms.vi: kham chịu nổi sự thẩm sát
terms.note: p0812 ×2. Not a headword in the view, but this is the established corpus wording (c211, c220 ×several, c226, c227, c228), so it is recorded rather than re-decided.

p0812 ×2 (དཔྱད་བཟོད་ཀྱིས་ཁྱབ་པས་ན / དོན་དམ་དུ་གྲུབ་པས་ཀྱང་ཁྱབ་པར་བཞེད). GAP — the logical pervasion relation has no entry, and the corpus's only 'biến khắp' is ཁྱབ་པ in the unrelated sense of the pervasive object of meditation (c182, c183). Rendered idiomatically as 'hễ … thì tất phải …' so the two senses do not collide; a ruling is owed because pervasion statements will recur constantly from here on.

p0812 l.1, 2×: `ཡིན་ཚུལ་ལ་...དཔྱོད་པའི་རིགས་པས་རྣམ་པར་དཔྱད་ན` → 'khi đem chánh lý thẩm sát cách thức tồn tại ... ra mà phân tích', and `རིགས་པས་རྣམ་པར་དཔྱད་པ་ན་མེད་དེ` → 'khi đem chánh lý ra phân tích thì [nó] chẳng có'. In the same sentences the bare root is rendered 'thẩm sát': `དཔྱད་པ་མ་བཅུག་པར` → 'chẳng đưa vào sự thẩm sát', `དཔྱད་བཟོད` → 'kham chịu nổi sự thẩm sát', `དཔྱོད་པའི་རིགས་པ` → 'chánh lý thẩm sát'. Wording KEPT: rnam par dpyad pa is the exhaustive analysing *act* performed by the rigs pa, while dpyod pa here names the reasoning itself, so distinguishing them is defensible and it is not a fixed/fixed-set breach. But the view has prov `དཔྱོད་པ` → thẩm sát, prov `དཔྱོད་པ` (ṛddhipāda) → sự thẩm sát, prov `དཔྱད་པ` → sự thẩm sát, and NO ruling for the རྣམ་པར་ compound. The `དཔྱོད་པ` note already records the corpus split c083 'quán sát' vs c125/c134 'thẩm sát'; this adds a third form inside one paragraph. A ruling should settle bare དཔྱད/དཔྱོད་པ and the རྣམ་པར་དཔྱད་པ compound together — either licensing 'phân tích' for the compound as a deliberate distinction, or collapsing it onto the bare-root word and sweeping c083/c125/c134/c241.

p0804, inside the Chú Giải Tứ Bách Luận quotation, paired with སྤྲུལ་པ as a standard example of a deceptive appearance. No entry in the view; no corpus precedent (c079's 'vòng lửa địa ngục' is a different thing, འཁོར་ལོ in a hell context).

p0804, same quotation: the thing whose own nature WOULD be found vividly if analysis found anything. No entry. 'vàng ròng' already occurs in the corpus (c053, c056) but there it renders གསེར in verse, so this is a distinct headword landing on the same Vietnamese; register deliberately or split.

terms.vi: cái chấp âm thanh là thường
terms.note: p0802, the standard example: the apprehension of sound as permanent, whose ālambana (sound) is not negated though its adhyavasāya-viṣaya (permanent sound) is. No entry.

terms.vi: *Nhập Trung Luận* cả bản gốc lẫn bản Thích
terms.note: p0804. Composite of two registered items (འཇུག་པ = Nhập Trung Luận, འཇུག་འགྲེལ = Chú Giải Nhập Trung Luận); recorded so the compound form is not read as a new title.

terms.vi: chánh lý thẩm sát cách thức [nó] là như thế nào
terms.note: p0804. No entry for ཡིན་ཚུལ. Kept deliberately apart from གནས་ཚུལ, which c227 renders 'cách thức tồn tại' — a bare 'cách thức tồn tại' here would collapse the two.

p0802, in འཕགས་པ་ཡབ་སྲས་དང་སློབ་དཔོན་གཉིས་ཀྱི་གཞུང. Read as Buddhapālita and Candrakīrti, standing beside the registered འཕགས་པ་ཡབ་སྲས = 'bậc Thánh cùng người con của ngài'. Left unnamed in the translation because the Tibetan does not name them — see flags.
p0803, དེ་དག་ལ་བསམ་ངོ་ན་སྦྱར་དགོས་པའི་སྐབས་འགའ་རེ. No entry; rendered plainly. See flags — the phrase is not certain.

terms.bo: ཁྱད་པར (sense: the distinction between two positions)
terms.note: p0803, ཁས་མི་ལེན་ལ་...ཁས་ལེན་པའི་ཁྱད་པར and p0804 སྦྱོར་མི་སྦྱོར་གྱི་ཁྱད. Third sense of ཁྱད་པར in this chapter, alongside the registered 'định ngữ' (viśeṣaṇa, p0706 — used throughout this chunk) and 'sai biệt' (viśeṣa as an attribute, p0766). Follows c225's 'sự khác biệt'. All three senses occur within these three pages, so the split is load-bearing.

The periphrastic form of the registered compound རྫས་ཡོད. Occurs twice on p0802 l.1 in one paragraph (གང་ཟག་རྫས་སུ་ཡོད་པར་འཛིན་པ, and རྫས་སུ་ཡོད་ན in the list of four negation-formulae alongside རང་བཞིན་གྱིས་ཡོད་ན / རང་གི་ངོ་བོས་ཡོད་ན / རང་གི་མཚན་ཉིད་ཀྱིས་ཡོད་ན). The view had no headword for it, so the two occurrences drew on two different entries (prov རྫས་ཡོད -> thật hữu, c210/c211; prov རྫས -> thật thể, c220) and came out differently. Both are now 'thật hữu'. Ruling owed: register རྫས་སུ་ཡོད་པ = 'thật hữu', explicitly tied to རྫས་ཡོད, and keep 'thật thể' scoped to bare རྫས (རྫས་སུ་མེད་པ, རྫས་བརྒྱད, རྫས་ཉིད) as c220 set it.

p0803 l.3, ...ཁས་མི་ལེན་ལ་གཟུགས་སྒྲ་ལ་སོགས་པ་ཁས་ལེན་པའི་ཁྱད་པར་གཏན་མི་རུང་བས (L17). This is the plain 'difference between two positions' (not accepting Īśvara vs accepting form and sound), not the two senses the view registers: prov ཁྱད་པར (in དོན་དམ་པའི་ཁྱད་པར་སྦྱར་བ) -> định ngữ [viśeṣaṇa], used ~10× correctly elsewhere in this chunk, and prov ཁྱད་པར (distinguishing-feature sense) -> sai biệt [viśeṣa]. Wording kept — it reads correctly and 'định ngữ' would be plainly wrong here — but it stands in the same paragraph as the qualifier sense, so a third sense should be registered explicitly (ཁྱད་པར in the sense 'difference between two positions' -> 'sự khác biệt') to keep the Phase 5 sweep from reading it as drift.

p0801 l.1. Literally 'the school honoured by many'; this is the standard Tibetan name of the Sāṃmitīya, rendered 正量部 / Chánh Lượng bộ in Sino-Vietnamese. The identification is an established one, not a guess from context, but it IS an identification rather than a rendering of the Tibetan words — recorded so a Phase 5 reader can override it in favour of a literal 'bộ phái được nhiều người tôn sùng' if the project prefers not to name schools the Tibetan only describes. No entry exists for any of the eighteen nikāya names; the corpus has zero occurrences of 'Chánh Lượng'.

p0799 (×3). Paired throughout with གནས་ཚུལ / གནས་ལུགས in the doublet 'གནས་ཚུལ་ལམ་སྡོད་ཚུལ' and 'གནས་ལུགས་སམ་སྡོད་ལུགས' — the mode of being that ignorance imputes from the object's own side. No entry for either word. 'lối an trụ' was deliberately AVOIDED because the corpus already uses that phrase 15× (c011, c032–c034, c174, c179, c184, c199) for འཇོག་སྒོམ ('tu theo lối an trụ'), an unrelated term.

p0799 l.1, in the doublet གནས་ཚུལ་ལམ་སྡོད་ཚུལ. Rendered with the same Vietnamese as the registered prov གནས་ལུགས = 'thật tánh', because the two stand in exactly parallel doublets ten lines apart (གནས་ཚུལ་ལམ་སྡོད་ཚུལ / གནས་ལུགས་སམ་སྡོད་ལུགས) and are plainly the same word with ཚུལ for ལུགས. Recorded so the merger is deliberate; if the ruling splits them, this occurrence is the one to change.

p0799 l.1, དེ་དག་རྣམ་གྲངས་སུ་གསུངས་པ — Candrakīrti states རང་གི་ངོ་བོ / རང་བཞིན / རང་དབང / གཞན་ལ་རག་མ་ལས་པ as synonyms. The only registered sense is prov རྣམ་གྲངས -> 'pháp môn' (p0269, inside a sūtra quotation), which cannot govern this. A second scoped entry is owed.

p0799 l.1 (×1), ཐ་སྙད་པའི་བློའི་ངོ་ན་ཇི་ལྟར་སྣང་བ. Follows the registered prov བློ = 'cái trí' and keeps བློ separable from ཤེས་པ ('thức'), which stands in the very same sentences here (ཐ་སྙད་པའི་ཤེས་པ). The corpus already has 'cái trí thuộc danh ngôn' once (c233) and 'cái trí danh ngôn' once; one form should be fixed.
p0800 l.3, ཁྱད་པར་གྱི་གཞི་གང་ཟག — the person as the substratum on which the absence of svabhāva is the property. No entry; matches c233's usage of the same phrase.

terms.vi: chứng ngộ một cách gián tiếp
terms.note: p0800 l.3. No entry. 'gián tiếp' is already the corpus word for བརྒྱུད་ནས / ཤུགས་ལ (7×), so this keeps it consistent, but ཤུགས་ཀྱིས་རྟོགས་པ is a technical pramāṇa term ('implicit realization') and may want its own fixed rendering.

terms.kind: no ruling for the bare word
terms.note: GAP — wording KEPT. p0801 l.1: འཇུག་པར་ཕུང་པོ་དམིགས་པ་ཡིན་པ་བཀག་ཅིང་འགྲེལ་པར་…གསུངས་པས — the bare འགྲེལ་པ is Candrakīrti's own commentary on the འཇུག་པ named in the same clause, and the view registers འཇུག་འགྲེལ -> 'Chú Giải Nhập Trung Luận', so 'bản Chú Giải' reads as its short form. But the view already holds `prov འགྲེལ་པ -> bản Thích` and `prov འགྲེལ་པ (bare) -> bản chú giải` scoped to the ལམ་སྒྲོན་འགྲེལ་པ, whose note states the bare word has no ruling. Three renderings are now in play; one ruling should settle bare འགྲེལ་པ and say whether it takes its capitalisation from the adjacent registered title.

terms.kind: scoped entry owed; near-synonym pair collapsed with གནས་ལུགས / སྡོད་ལུགས
terms.note: GAP — wording KEPT. p0799 has གནས་ཚུལ་ལམ་སྡོད་ཚུལ་ཅིག and, eleven lines later, གནས་ལུགས་སམ་སྡོད་ལུགས, plus རང་གི་གནས་ལུགས and གཞལ་བའི་གནས་ལུགས on p0800 l.1. The view rules only `prov གནས་ལུགས -> thật tánh`. The chunk maps གནས་ཚུལ and གནས་ལུགས both to 'thật tánh' and སྡོད་ཚུལ / སྡོད་ལུགས both to 'lối trụ' — internally consistent, and the two Tibetan pairs are used here as near-synonymous variants of one formula. A scoped entry should put the collapse on record (and rule on སྡོད་ལུགས, which has no headword at all) rather than leaving it accidental.

terms.kind: further trigger for the pending enumerative-vs-technical split
terms.note: KNOWN GAP — wording KEPT, consistent with the corpus. p0799 (གང་ཟག་གམ་ཆོས་གང་ཡང་རུང་བ), p0800 l.3 (ཁྱད་པར་གྱི་གཞི་གང་ཟག་གི་སྟེང་དུ, གང་ཟག་གི་བདག་མེད), p0801 l.1 (གང་ཟག་གཞན་ལ་དམིགས་ནས, གང་ཟག་ཙམ་ཞིག་དམིགས་པའོ, རྒྱུད་གཞན་གྱི་གང་ཟག). The view's `prov གང་ཟག -> hạng người` restricts itself to enumerative, non-technical use, and four technical transliteration entries already ask for the split to be ruled. Recorded here as a further trigger — note this chunk adds a case the earlier ones do not cover: bare གང་ཟག་ཙམ / གང་ཟག་གཞན as the ālambana of the innate view, where 'hạng người' would be plainly wrong.

p0846 x2: `སྐྲ་ཤད་ལ་སོགས་པ་ལྟར` -> 'như những sợi tóc v.v.' and `སྐྲ་ཤད་འཛག་པའི་སྣང་བ` -> 'sự hiện ra của những sợi tóc rơi xuống'. The classic timira illusion, paired throughout with རབ་རིབ = 'màng mắt' (already prov). No entry in the view; the word occurs in the root Prasannapadā quotation at p0842-p0843 (c250) too, so a single ruling covers both chunks. `འཛག་པ` ('rơi xuống') is rendered separately so it is not absorbed into the headword.

p0846 l.1. No entry. Corpus precedent: c222 renders `རྟོག་པ་དང་བྲལ་བ` as 'lìa khỏi phân biệt'; 'vô phân biệt' is used in c133/c134/c143/c195/c200/c236. Kept distinct from `མ་འཁྲུལ་བ` = 'không lầm loạn', which stands in the same argument.

p0846 l.1, `དེ་ཁོ་ན་ཉིད་མངོན་སུམ་དུ་མཛད་པ་ལ་ཡོད` -> 'chỉ có nơi bậc đã hiện chứng thật tánh'. Honorific མཛད་པ. Kept apart from the view's prov མངོན་སུམ = 'hiện lượng' (pratyakṣa, the epistemological term), which occurs in the same chapter — this is the verbal 'make manifest', not the pramāṇa.

terms.vi: bị vô minh làm cho hư hoại
terms.note: p0845, 3x. No entry in the view. Rendering taken from c223 (l.25, l.46), which translates the same phrase at p0748/p0750 the same way; registered so the repetition is visible as deliberate.

p0846 l.1. The view's prov rules the short form དབང་ཤེས = 'căn thức' (line 294) and both forms occur within four sentences here, so BOTH are rendered 'căn thức' to keep them from reading as two things. NOTE THE CORPUS SPLIT this creates: c222/c223/c224/c227 render དབང་པོའི་ཤེས་པ as 'thức của căn' (11x) and c225 as 'các thức căn', against 'căn thức' in c227/c236 (5x). A ruling is owed and it is a corpus-wide sweep, not a c251 edit.

p0846 l.3, lemma from the Prasannapadā (`ཡང་དག་པ་མ་ཡིན་པ་སྒྲོ་མི་འདོགས་པ`). `སྒྲོ་འདོགས་པ` is rendered 'gán đặt' following settled corpus usage (c033, c092, c096, c120, c210, c224, c226, c227) — registering it because 'tăng ích' (增益) is the other standard Sino-Vietnamese for samāropa and appears nowhere in the corpus, so the choice should be recorded rather than left to drift.

p0845. The view has prov ཁས་བླངས་པ = 'thừa nhận' and prov ལུགས = 'chủ trương'; in this compound ལུགས is the light nominaliser 'manner of', not a doctrinal position, so 'cách thừa nhận' rather than 'chủ trương thừa nhận'. Same shape as `འགྲུབ་ལུགས` / `མི་འགྲུབ་ལུགས` on p0843-p0844 (c250).

No entry for སྒྲོ་འདོགས in the view, and none for its counterpart སྐུར་འདེབས (apavāda). Occurs 2x at p0846 l.3 (ཡང་དག་པ་མ་ཡིན་པ་སྒྲོ་མི་འདོགས་པ, གཟུགས་སྒྲ་སོགས་སྒྲོ་མི་འདོགས་པ), glossed there by the text itself as ཡོད་པར་མི་འཛིན་པ.
