A ruling is owed so this does not drift against the more usual 'tăng ích' in later chunks; if 'tăng ích' is chosen, the pair should be settled together with སྐུར་འདེབས = 'tổn giảm'.

terms.vi: bị (vô minh) làm cho hư hoại — provisional; proposed 'bị nhiễm ô' / 'bị làm hư hỏng'
terms.note: 3x on p0845 as མ་རིག་པས་བསླད་པ ('tainted/corrupted by ignorance'). Not in the view. Needs a ruling distinct from ཉམས་པ below, in the same family as the deliberate འཁྲུལ་པ = lầm loạn / ཕྱིན་ཅི་ལོག = điên đảo / བརྫུན་པ = hư vọng separation the view already protects.

terms.vi: đã bị hư hoại — provisional; proposed 'bị hoại mất' / 'bị mất đi'
terms.note: p0845 l.1, དེ་ཁོ་ནར་ཉམས་པར་གྱུར་པ་སྟེ་མ་གྲུབ་པ ('ruined/lost in suchness, i.e. not established'). Not in the view. As rendered, c251 collapses ཉམས་པ and བསླད་པ onto the same Vietnamese phrase inside a single sentence; the two need separate rulings so the distinction is recoverable. Wording kept pending that ruling.

p0809 l.2, གཉིས་ཀ་གཞི་མཐུན་ནོ — 'don' and 'dam pa' share one locus, i.e. paramārtha as a karmadhāraya. No entry in the view. Rendered descriptively; the technical Sino-Vietnamese 'đồng y' / 'y chủ thích' was avoided because the passage is doing Tibetan-language etymology, not naming a compound-type in the abstract.

p0809 l.2 (×2) and p0810 l.3 / p0811 l.1 (×2), always in ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་ཐ་ཚིག་གོ — the commentarial formula closing a gloss. No entry in the view and no corpus precedent (grep: zero). Deliberately plain; 'định nghĩa là' would overstate it.

p0810 l.1, in the Tarkajvālā's description of the first paramārtha. The view registers only ཟག་པ (in ཟག་པ་ཆུང་འབྲིང) → 'sai phạm', whose own note says 'lậu' (āsrava) was deliberately NOT used there because that context was vow infractions. Here the āsrava sense is unmistakable (beside འཇིག་རྟེན་ལས་འདས་པ and སྤྲོས་པ་མེད་པ), so the compound needs its own entry rather than inheriting the scoped one.
p0810 l.1, the second paramārtha in the Tarkajvālā. Read as one established compound (dag pa qualifying the whole) rather than as a separate adjective in the list; see flags.

terms.vi: tỷ lượng vận hành do sức của sự vật
terms.note: p0810 l.3, in the Madhyamakālaṃkārapañjikā. རྗེས་སུ་དཔག་པ = 'tỷ lượng' follows c208 and c223; the full compound has no entry.

p0811 l.1. The view registers the verbal སྐུར་པ་བཏབ་པ → 'phỉ báng' (p0750); the nominal form is used three lines later in the same paragraph and takes the same word so the pair stays visibly one term.
p0811 l.3, སྒྱུ་མ་མཁན་གྱིས་སྤྲུལ་པའི་མི. No entry; follows c223 ('các nhà huyễn thuật') and c234's 'hóa hiện' for སྤྲུལ་པ of a person.

terms.vi: *Bát-nhã Đăng Luận*, tức bản Thích phẩm thứ mười lăm
terms.note: p0811 l.1. Combines the view's prov ཤེས་རབ་སྒྲོན་མེ → 'Bát-nhã Đăng Luận' with its prov རབ་བྱེད (MMK chapter) → 'phẩm'; follows c223's 'trong *Bát-nhã Đăng Luận*, phẩm thứ hai mươi lăm'.

terms.vi: bản *Nan Giải* về *Trung Quán Trang Nghiêm*
terms.note: p0810 l.3. Built from the view's prov དབུ་མ་རྒྱན → 'Trung Quán Trang Nghiêm' and prov དཀའ་འགྲེལ → 'Nan Giải'; the phrasing follows c026 ('bản *Nan Giải* về *Hắc Địch*'). The combined title has no entry.

terms.vi: Ở đây, đất và những thứ khác / Trong thắng nghĩa chẳng phải là đại chủng.
terms.note: p0809 l.2, the root verse (Madhyamakahṛdaya) on which the quoted Tarkajvālā passage comments. Rendering of འབྱུང་བ is uncertain — see flags.

terms.bo: གཏན་ཚིགས (member of a formal syllogism, in གཏན་ཚིགས་ཀྱི་དོན་མ་གྲུབ་པ)
terms.note: p0811 l.1, inside the Prajñāpradīpa reply to the self-contradiction charge: གཏན་ཚིགས་ཀྱི་དོན་མ་གྲུབ་པ་ཉིད་མ་ཡིན་པས -> 'nghĩa của nhân chẳng phải là không được thành lập'. The view's `prov གཏན་ཚིགས -> chánh lý` is scoped by its own note to the triad thí dụ / chánh lý / giáo chứng (means of proof). Here it is the reason-member of a syllogism against which asiddha is alleged, and 'nhân' is the standard Sino-Vietnamese for that member; 'chánh lý' would make the sentence unreadable as a pramāṇa-śāstra objection. WORDING KEPT. A scoped second entry is owed so the syllogistic sense and the means-of-proof sense stay separable.

terms.bo: མངོན་སུམ (adverbial: directly, as opposed to བརྒྱུད་པས)
terms.note: p0810 l.3, inside the Madhyamakāloka quotation: མངོན་སུམ་དང་བརྒྱུད་པས་བྱས་པའི་ཁྱད་པར -> 'sự sai biệt về việc [chúng] được tạo ra một cách trực tiếp và một cách gián tiếp'. The view's only entry, `prov མངོན་སུམ -> hiện lượng [pratyakṣa]`, is explicitly scoped by its note to the epistemological sense at p0581 (direct perception as a means of knowledge); it is here paired with བརྒྱུད་པས and modifies བྱས་པ, so 'hiện lượng' would positively misread it. WORDING KEPT.

terms.skt: abhiprāya / āśaya (here: the intent or purport of a cognition)
terms.kind: scoped sense — recurring gap, one more instance
terms.note: p0811 l.1, inside the Madhyamakālaṃkāra-pañjikā quotation: 'do sức của ý hướng nơi thức chân thật' (contrasted with ཀུན་རྫོབ་ཀྱི་ཤེས་པའི་དབང་གིས). None of the registered senses governs it: the headword is āśaya = 'ý lạc', scoped to the བསམ་པ / སྦྱོར་བ pair, and the recorded verbal senses are 'nghĩ đến' / 'quán xét' / 'suy xét' / 'tư' (văn-tư-tu) / 'Quán chiếu rằng…'. This is what the correct cognition takes the thing to be, i.e. its purport, not a disposition and not an act of thinking. WORDING KEPT; adds one more instance to the བསམ་པ scoping gap the view already flags.

terms.kind: missing headword — completes the pramāṇa pair
terms.note: p0810 l.3–4, in the Madhyamakālaṃkāra-pañjikā quotation: 'tỷ lượng vận hành do sức của sự vật'. No entry for རྗེས་སུ་དཔག་པ / རྗེས་དཔག anywhere in the view, although its counterpart མངོན་སུམ -> 'hiện lượng' is registered (p0581). 'tỷ lượng' is the standard pair-word for hiện lượng. WORDING KEPT; register it so the pramāṇa pair stays matched across the chapter.

terms.kind: missing headword — load-bearing in this chunk
terms.note: p0810 l.3–4 and p0811 l.1: ཡང་དག་པར་ན -> 'trong chân thật', ཡང་དག་པའི་ཤེས་པ -> 'thức chân thật', ཡང་དག་པའི་ཐོས་པ་དང་བསམས་པ་དང་བསྒོམས་པ -> 'văn, tư và tu chân thật', and the closing རང་བཞིན་མེད་པ་ལ་ཡང་དག་པ་སོགས་ཀྱི་ཁྱད་པར་སྦྱོར་བ -> the định ngữ 'chân thật'. The view records under the `དམ་པ` entry that ཡང་དག has NO entry and should be ruled; the corpus elsewhere renders it adverbially as 'chân chánh' / 'chân chính'. This chunk needs it as a nominal qualifier appended to a negandum alongside དོན་དམ་པར and དེ་ཁོ་ན་ཉིད་དུ, which the adverbial 'chân chánh' cannot carry; 'chân thật' is used consistently for all of them. WORDING KEPT; a ruling is needed, and it should also keep ཡང་དག་པ apart from དེ་ཁོ་ན་ཉིད = 'thật tánh' (fixed-in-view prov), which stands in the same sentences.

terms.vi: thành lập trong hiện tướng tương đồng
terms.note: GAP - no entry in the view. The controlling technical term of this whole section (~8x on p0842-p0843): a dharmin must be established for BOTH disputants by the same kind of pramāṇa. Rendered 'hiện tướng tương đồng' because སྣང་ = appearance (corpus already uses 'hiện tướng' for སྣང་བ in c048, c208) and མཐུན་ = concordant/common. Deliberately NOT 'cộng nhận' or 'cùng thừa nhận', which would say ཁས་བླངས (already registered as 'thừa nhận') and would lose the appearance-element the argument turns on. The term recurs through c251-c254, so one ruling is needed now.

GAP. Paired with སྔ་རྒོལ, 4x across p0842 and p0844. The referents are fixed by the text: at p0844 the སྔ་རྒོལ is the one for whom nothing is svalakṣaṇa-established even conventionally (the Prāsaṅgika), and at p0843 the ཕྱི་རྒོལ is 'the opponent in the refutation of self-arising'. Chose transparent 'bên đối luận' / 'bên lập luận' over the opaque Sino-Vietnamese 'địch giả' / 'lập giả'. Must be ruled together with སྔ་རྒོལ.
GAP. See ཕྱི་རྒོལ. Here it is the Mādhyamika who states the thesis.

SCOPE REQUEST, not a violation. The view registers prov གཏན་ཚིགས -> 'chánh lý', whose own note scopes it to the triad thí dụ / chánh lý / giáo chứng. At p0843 l.1 it stands in the fixed logical pair with ཕྱོགས: གཞི་མ་གྲུབ་པའི་ཕྱོགས་ཀྱི་སྐྱོན་དང་གཞི་མ་གྲུབ་པའི་གཏན་ཚིགས་ཀྱི་སྐྱོན = 'lỗi của tông ... và lỗi của nhân ...' (āśrayāsiddha-pakṣadoṣa / -hetudoṣa). 'chánh lý' would be positively wrong there — it is the reason-member of an inference, not reasoning in general. Scoped entry owed.

Fourth scoped sense of སྦྱོར་བ. p0843 l.3, ...ཞེས་པའི་སྦྱོར་བ་ལ་མཚོན་ན — the formal syllogism 'the āyatana of form does not arise from itself, because it exists, like a pot manifest in front'. Deliberately NOT 'gia hành' (registered, scoped to the བསམ་པ/སྦྱོར་བ pair) nor 'sự kết hợp' (registered, p0753). Follows c211's '[luận thức] ứng thành hay [luận thức] tự lập'.

p0844, 3x (རང་རྒྱུད་འགོག་པ, རང་རྒྱུད་དགོས་པ, རང་རྒྱུད་དགོས་མི་དགོས). The view registers རང་རྒྱུད་པ = 'Tự Lập' (the proponents) and དབུ་མ་རང་རྒྱུད་པ = 'phái Trung Quán Tự Lập', but not the bare རང་རྒྱུད = the autonomous syllogism itself. Bracketed 'luận thức' supplied, following c211 l.15. Entry owed so the school-name and the argument-form stay distinguishable.

p0844 l.1. Established Sino-Vietnamese and already the corpus form (c211, c220, c221, c222). Recording it because the view's only ཤེས་པ rulings are 'trí' (scoped to p0358) and 'thức' (scoped to the pramāṇa debate at p0744-p0762).
GAP. p0843 l.1, the fourth pāda of the quoted verse: ང་ལ་ཀླན་ཀ་མེད = 'nơi tôi chẳng có chỗ bắt lỗi'. Deliberately not 'sự tranh biện' (already the corpus word for རྒོལ་བ) and not 'vấn nạn'.

terms.vi: nhà chủ trương vô thể tánh
terms.note: p0844 l.1. Built on the registered ངོ་བོ་ཉིད་མེད་པ = 'vô thể tánh' and kept deliberately apart from རང་བཞིན་མེད་པར་སྨྲ་བ = 'nhà chủ trương vô tự tánh' in the very next clause: the sentence exists precisely to say that the two labels are applied differently, so collapsing them destroys it.

terms.vi: nhà chủ trương vô tự tánh / nhà chủ trương hữu tự tánh
terms.note: p0844 l.1, Tsongkhapa's own stipulated abbreviations for Prāsaṅgika vs (Vaibhāṣika-etc. + Svātantrika). Built on the FIXED རང་བཞིན = tự tánh and རང་བཞིན་མེད་པ = vô tự tánh.
p0842 l.1, contrasted with རང་སྡེ. The view registers only རང་སྡེ = 'tự bộ' and རང་སྡེ་དངོས་པོར་སྨྲ་བ; c226 l.42 already writes 'tự bộ và tha bộ', so this follows the corpus.

p0842 l.9, inside the Prasannapadā quotation. Rendered descriptively rather than as 'sở lập pháp' to avoid inventing a compound; a ruling could prefer the Sino-Vietnamese form since the paired ཆོས་ཅན is already 'hữu pháp'.
p0843 l.1, སློབ་དཔོན་གྱི་ཞལ་སྔ་ནས་ཀྱིས. The honorific particle has no separate Vietnamese word here; 'đấng' carries it. Recording it so a Phase 5 reader does not report an omission.

terms.bo: གཏན་ཚིགས (hetu of a syllogism, paired with ཕྱོགས)
terms.note: p0843 l.1, གཞི་མ་གྲུབ་པའི་གཏན་ཚིགས་ཀྱི་སྐྱོན, in the pair ཕྱོགས་ཀྱི་སྐྱོན / གཏན་ཚིགས་ཀྱི་སྐྱོན. The view's prov གཏན་ཚིགས -> 'chánh lý' is scoped by its own note to the triad dpe/rigs-pa/lung (thí dụ / chánh lý / giáo chứng), i.e. reasoning as a source of knowledge. That does not reach the hetu of a formal proof, where 'chánh lý' would be wrong and 'nhân' is the settled technical term (matching the registered prov ཕྱོགས -> 'tông' = pakṣa). Wording KEPT; a scoped second entry is owed.

p0842 l.1 ×3 and p0843 l.3. No headword for མཐུན་སྣང anywhere in the c250 view, yet it is the technical pivot of the whole Svātantrika refutation: མཐུན་སྣང་དུ་གྲུབ་པ = established in a commonly-appearing / commonly-agreed appearance. Rendered consistently as 'được thành lập trong hiện tướng tương đồng' (verb form) throughout. Wording KEPT; entry owed, and it recurs across the following chunks.

p0843 l.3, ...བུམ་པ་བཞིན་ནོ། །ཞེས་པའི་སྦྱོར་བ — the three-membered statement just quoted. The view registers three scoped senses (gia hành in the བསམ་པ་དང་སྦྱོར་བ pair; việc gia hành in the BCA verse; sự kết hợp = conjunction at p0753), none of which covers prayoga as a syllogism. A fourth scoped entry is owed. Wording KEPT.

p0844 l.1 ×2, རང་རྒྱུད་འགོག་པ and རང་རྒྱུད་དགོས་པ. The view registers only རང་རྒྱུད་པ -> 'Tự Lập' (the proponent, Svātantrika) and དབུ་མ་རང་རྒྱུད་པ -> 'phái Trung Quán Tự Lập'; bare རང་རྒྱུད = the autonomous inference itself is unruled. Rendered '[luận thức] tự lập' with the head noun bracketed as supplied. Wording KEPT; entry owed, ideally settling whether the bracket should stand or a bare noun be coined.

terms.bo: ཡན་ལག (component of a proof / of the generation of a view)
terms.note: p0844 l.1 ×2, ...ལྟ་བ་གསར་དུ་བསྐྱེད་པའི་ཡན་ལག་ཏུ་རང་རྒྱུད་དགོས་པ and ...རྗེས་དཔག་སྐྱེད་པའི་ཡན་ལག་ཏུ. The view has the base prov ཡན་ལག -> 'chi' (seven-limb practice) plus two scoped 'chi phần' entries (bodily limb, p0471–2; limbs of śamatha, p0594). This third sense is unruled. 'chi phần' agrees with both scoped entries but departs from the base 'chi', so a scope note is owed. Wording KEPT.

p0836. No entry. Rendered descriptively rather than with a Sino-Vietnamese 'sở lập', which has zero corpus occurrences, while 'năng lập' is already in use for སྒྲུབ་བྱེད (c207, c236). Same Vietnamese used in verse and prose deliberately. Note that in the same verse བསྒྲུབ་བྱའི་ཕྱིར (རང་གི་བྱད་བཞིན་མཛེས་པར་བསྒྲུབ་བྱའི་ཕྱིར) is verbal and was rendered 'vì để làm cho…', not with this noun.

terms.vi: sự phá trừ / cái phải bị phá trừ
terms.note: p0836. The view holds three divergent provisional renderings of bare སུན་འབྱིན་པ — 'phá trừ' (c094), 'bài xích' (p0337, graded triad), 'đả phá' (p0350) — and already asks for a ruling. Here the two form a technical debate PAIR (the refutation and its object), so one stem had to cover both; 'phá trừ' chosen as the corpus majority. Kept distinct from དགག་བྱ = 'cái phải phá bỏ' (c236 precedent) and from སྤོང་བ = 'gạt bỏ' (of a fault), both of which occur in this chunk.

p0836. No entry. The tu-quoque reversal of one's own reason back upon oneself. Rendered literally ('chánh lý … chẳng quay ngược đầu lại mà áp dụng vào chính mình') rather than with a technical term, since none is established in the corpus.

terms.vi: chỉ thuần là tánh "lấy cái này làm duyên"
terms.note: p0838, inside the Chú Giải Nhập Trung Luận quotation. No entry. The established Sino-Vietnamese 此緣性 'thử duyên tánh' was NOT used because it is opaque and unattested in this corpus; a transparent gloss was given instead. A ruling is owed since the term recurs (also at p0923).

terms.vi: sự giả danh do nương [vào cái khác]
terms.note: p0838. No entry. Follows the view's ཀུན་བརྟགས་པ / བཏགས་པ note, which records བཏགས་པ -> 'được giả danh'. Kept distinct from ཀུན་བརྟགས་པ -> 'được giả lập', which occurs in this same chunk at p0837 (ལོག་པར་ཀུན་བརྟགས་པས).
p0836 verse. Rendered 'gương mặt' deliberately so it stays separable from བྱད་བཞིན -> 'khuôn mặt' (registered prov), which stands two padas away in the same verse (རང་གི་བྱད་བཞིན་མཛེས་པར).
p0838. No entry. Follows the corpus usage in c031/c164/c234.

p0838, ཕྱོགས་འདི and ཁོ་བོ་ཅག་གི་ཕྱོགས. The view registers ཕྱོགས only as 'tông (lấy … làm tông)' inside ཕྱོགས་སུ་བྱས་ནས (p0753). Here it is the party's own position, and 'tông' would collide with ལུགས / རང་ལུགས -> 'tự tông' used in the same chunk. 'lập trường' has corpus precedent in c212/c213.

terms.bo: གཏན་ཚིགས (logical reason of a syllogism: ནུས་པ་མཐོང་བར་གྱུར་པའི་གཏན་ཚིགས; འཐད་པ་དང་བྲལ་བའི་གཏན་ཚིགས་ཀྱིས)
terms.note: p0836 L16, L19. The view's only entry, prov གཏན་ཚིགས -> chánh lý [hetu], carries a note scoping it to the triad thí dụ / chánh lý / giáo chứng, so it cannot govern the syllogism sense here. WORDING KEPT. It keeps གཏན་ཚིགས apart from རིགས་པ = chánh lý, which stands three lines later at L21 in the same argument (རང་ལ་ཕར་བཀག་པའི་རིགས་པ), and it matches c249's nhân đủ ba tướng / nhân tự lập. Caveat the ruling must settle: it overlaps རྒྱུ = nhân at L23 (nhân quả, nhân sinh ra quả), a different word on the same page. Either scope this sense to nhân and accept the overlap, or give it a separable form such as nhân [chứng]. Central call, not a chunk-level one.

p0838 L87, L91, both inside Chú Giải Nhập Trung Luận quotations. The view's only ཕྱོགས entry is prov ཕྱོགས (in ཕྱོགས་སུ་བྱས་ནས) -> tông, explicitly scoped to a different phrase at p0753. WORDING KEPT: lập trường matches c247, which uses it for the same word throughout the same argument, and keeps ཕྱོགས apart from ལུགས = tông (tự tông L21, tông Trung Quán L31) and from དམ་བཅའ = lời lập tông. Register the bare pakṣa sense.

p0837 L29, inside the Chú Giải Nhập Trung Luận quotation. The recorded prov ལོག་པ -> hư vọng is scoped to p0725-p0726, where the ṭīkā makes ལོག་པ synonymous with རང་བཞིན་མེད་པ; that sense cannot be the adverb qualifying ཀུན་བརྟགས་པ here. WORDING KEPT, but flagged: điên đảo is the corpus word for ཕྱིན་ཅི་ལོག (viparyāsa), which ལོག་པར is not, and L49 in this same chunk renders ལོག་མིན་པར (Yuktiṣaṣṭikā verse) as chẳng phải hư vọng per the recorded ruling, so one root now carries two Vietnamese words inside one chunk. A ruling should either license điên đảo for the adverbial ལོག་པར and note the collision with ཕྱིན་ཅི་ལོག, or supply a third word (e.g. sai lệch / trái ngược) that leaves both hư vọng and điên đảo free.

terms.bo: རིགས་པ (predicative negative: མི་རིགས་སོ; མི་རིགས་ལ) vs འཐད་པ vs རུང་བ
terms.note: p0836 L19 (རང་གི་ཚིག་ལའང་ཐལ་བ་མཚུངས་པར་མི་རིགས་སོ) and p0838 L76 (Xuất Thế Gian Tán verse, འབྱུང་བར་མི་རིགས་ལ). Same Vietnamese as འཐད་པ, which the recorded prov fixes to hợp lý and which stands at L13/L17/L19 (lìa sự hợp lý, འཐད་པ་དང་བྲལ). This is the collision already recorded in the view at lines 351 and 415; it recurs on these pages, including once inside a citation, and was unflagged in the file. Not a new error, wording KEPT pending the central ruling. Note L76 is verse: any replacement must still scan as a verse line.

p0836 L19, p0838 L91. No ruling for ཐལ་བ anywhere in the view. WORDING KEPT: consistent with c247 and c249. The ruling should pin two things: (a) that lỗi is a supplied word at L19, where ཐལ་བ་མཚུངས་པར has no word for fault and the sense comes from the surrounding སྐྱོན context, hence the bracketed [lỗi] at L91; (b) that ཐལ་བ stays separable from སྐྱོན = lỗi, which occurs bare at L23, L29, L31 and L87.

p0805, vocative twice inside the Prajñāpāramitā passage quoted by the Chú Giải Nhập Trung Luận (ཚེ་དང་ལྡན་པ་རབ་འབྱོར / རབ་འབྱོར་གྱིས་སྨྲས་པ). No entry in the view. Established Sino-Vietnamese name used, matching the treatment of ཤཱ་རིའི་བུ = Xá-lợi-phất, which stands in the same exchange.

p0806, 3× inside the Buddhapālita quotation, paired with བུམ་པ: 'བུམ་པ་ཡོད་དོ་སབ་མ་ཡོད་དོ' / 'བུམ་པ་ཆག་གོ་སབ་མ་ཚིག་གོ' / 'བུམ་པ་དང་སབ་མ་དག'. The word occurs nowhere else in the 978-page corpus and I could not identify it. Extraction is stable (all three decode identically as ས+བ+tsheg+མ). Left in transliteration with a bracketed note at first occurrence rather than guessed; the only thing the text itself licenses is that it is something that burns (ཚིག). See flags.

p0808, the example (dṛṣṭānta) of the Svātantrika syllogism quoted from the Chú Giải Nhập Trung Luận: 'དོན་དམ་པར་བདག་ལས་སྐྱེ་བ་མ་ཡིན་ཏེ། ཡོད་པའི་ཕྱིར། སེམས་པ་ཅན་བཞིན་ནོ།'. No entry. Rendered literally from སེམས་པ = 'tư' (the view's cetanā ruling) + ཅན; deliberately NOT 'hữu tình'/'chúng sinh', which render སེམས་ཅན and stand for a different word. A ruling is owed — this is a standing member of Bhāviveka's syllogism and will recur.

p0806 (ཡང་དག་དབང་གིས་མིན in the Thất Thập Không Tánh Luận verse; ཡང་དག་བརྟེན in MMK XXIV.8; དོན་དམ་པ་དང་བདེན་པ་དང་ཡང་དག་པ) and p0808 (ཡང་དག་པར་རམ / ཡང་དག་པའམ, ×2). Follows c142's rendering of ཡང་དག as 'chân chánh'. Load-bearing here because the chunk lists three near-synonymous qualifiers side by side — དོན་དམ་པ / ཡང་དག་པ / བདེན་པ — which must stay separable in Vietnamese.
p0805, in the Prajñāpāramitā list. Follows c093/c095/c201, which already use 'Dự lưu'.
p0805. Full form of the view's ཕྱིར་འོང = 'Nhất lai'; same Vietnamese.
p0805. Follows c095, which already uses 'Bất hoàn'.
p0805, ×4 in the Prajñāpāramitā passage, always paired with ཐོབ་པ. No entry. 'hiện quán' has corpus precedent (c070, c117) and stays clear of རྟོགས་པ = 'chứng ngộ'.
p0805, ×4, paired with མངོན་པར་རྟོགས་པ. No entry for the noun.
p0808, བདེན་གཉིས་ཀྱི་རྣམ་དབྱེ. No entry. Kept distinct from རབ་དབྱེ and from རྣམ་པར་བཞག་པ = 'sự an lập', which occurs in this same chunk (p0807).

p0805, third member of the Thất Thập Không Tánh Luận triad དམན་པ / མཉམ་པ / ཁྱད་པར་ཅན. Rendered plainly so it is not confused with ཁྱད་པར = 'định ngữ' (viśeṣaṇa), which is the technical term this whole section turns on and occurs ~15× in the same pages.
p0805, འཇིག་རྟེན་སྙད་དབང་གིས in the Thất Thập Không Tánh Luận verse — metri causa short form of ཐ་སྙད, which the view registers as 'danh ngôn'. Same Vietnamese.

c239 L19, p0805 `ངེས་དོན་གྱི་མདོ་རྣམས`. The view registers prov `ངེས་དོན` -> "nghĩa liễu nghĩa" (line 268), scoped to p0426 inside the reported Hashang position. In the compound with `མདོ` that head noun cannot be carried through — "kinh nghĩa liễu nghĩa" is unidiomatic — so the compound was rendered "kinh liễu nghĩa". Wording KEPT per the gap rule; a scoped second form is owed so the departure from the prov ruling is recorded rather than silent.

c239 L15, p0805 `ཆེས་མི་རིགས་ཏེ` -> "hết sức chẳng hợp lý". The view registers only prov `རིགས་པ` -> "chánh lý" (the noun, yukti), which is unusable predicatively, and prov `འཐད་པ` -> "hợp lý". So predicative `རིགས་པ` collapses onto `འཐད་པ`, which in this same chunk at L50 renders `མི་འཐད་ན` -> "chẳng hợp lý" and `འཐད་པར་ག་ལ་འགྱུར` -> "làm sao lại hợp lý được" — the two Tibetan words are three lines apart in one Buddhapālita citation. This is the identical collision already flagged on c231 (view lines 397, 451) and on the verbal sense at view line 393. Wording KEPT; one central ruling should settle predicative `རིགས་པ` (e.g. "đúng lý"), the verbal `རིགས་པར་འགྱུར`, `འཐད་པ` -> "hợp lý" and `རུང་བ` -> "khả dĩ" together, then sweep c231 and c239.

terms.skt: yojana / prayoga (here: to attach a qualifier)
terms.note: c239, ten occurrences across p0805-p0808 including the sa-bcad heading `དགག་བྱ་ལ་དོན་དམ་གྱི་ཁྱད་པར་སྦྱོར་མི་སྦྱོར་བཤད་པ།`. The view rules `ཁྱད་པར` -> "định ngữ" (line 366) but nothing for the verb that attaches it. The three registered senses of `སྦྱོར་བ` — "gia hành" (line 126, scoped to the `བསམ་པ་དང་སྦྱོར་བ` pair), "việc gia hành" (line 326, the BCA verse), "sự kết hợp" (line 442, p0753) — none applies. I unified the chunk on "gắn ... vào" (heading included); "áp dụng" was the competing form and is now removed. A ruling is owed to fix one Vietnamese for this sense across the whole `རང་རྒྱུད/ཐལ་འགྱུར` discussion, which continues into c240.

terms.vi: bên tranh biện (hai bên tranh biện)
terms.note: p0841, ཆོས་ཅན་ནི་རྒོལ་བ་གཉིས་ཀས་ཁྱད་པར་གྱི་ཆོས་དཔྱོད་པའི་གཞི. The view registers རྒོལ་བ -> 'vấn nạn' (the objection raised), scoped to p0702. Here it is the person disputing, not the objection. Sense split needed.

p0839. Built on the view's རྗེས་དཔག -> 'tỷ lượng' and གཞན་དོན -> 'lợi ích cho kẻ khác'. GAP for the compound. Note the established Sino-Vietnamese alternative 'tỷ lượng vị tha' was not used, to keep the phrase transparent.

p0839. GAP. Recurs heavily in the chunks that follow (p0849, p0851, p0858, p0865-p0867), so it needs pinning now. Chose 'ba tướng' (三相, the established Sino-Vietnamese) despite the view's warning that 'tướng' already carries མཚན་ཉིད / མཚན་མ / མཚན — this is a fourth collision on that word and should be decided together with the split the view already requests.

p0839, and recurring at p0852, p0856, p0867. The view registers རང་རྒྱུད་པ -> 'Tự Lập' (the Svātantrika proponents) but nothing for the autonomous REASON itself. 'nhân tự lập' keeps the two visibly linked.

terms.bo: རང་རྒྱུད (bare, = the autonomous reason, in the sa-bcad རང་རྒྱུད་སུན་དབྱུང་བ་དངོས།)
terms.note: p0840 section heading. Rendered with a bracketed supplied noun because bare 'tự lập' does not stand as a Vietnamese noun phrase. Reading confirmed by the body of the section, which refutes the autonomous reason via the unestablished subject (གཞི་ཆོས་ཅན་མ་གྲུབ་པ).

terms.vi: nhân vận hành do sức của sự vật
terms.note: p0839. GAP. Built on the view's དངོས་པོ -> 'sự vật'. The reason that operates by the force of real entities, as opposed to one operating merely by the opponent's acceptance.
p0839, 3×. GAP — no entry. See the flag on the རྟགས / གཏན་ཚིགས collision.

terms.bo: གཏན་ཚིགས (probans of an inference, in སྐྱོན་དེས་གཏན་ཚིགས་ཀྱང་མ་གྲུབ་པར་བསྟན་པ)
terms.note: p0840 section heading. The view registers གཏན་ཚིགས -> 'chánh lý', but that entry's own note scopes it to the triad ཐི་དུ / chánh lý / giáo chứng (དཔེ / གཏན་ཚིགས / ལུང), a different sense. Here it is the reason-member of a syllogism, standing opposite ཆོས་ཅན (hữu pháp), and 'chánh lý' would be unreadable. See flags.
p0839, in the triad རང་འདོད / ཁས་ལེན / དམ་བཅའ. GAP. Deliberately not plain 'chủ trương', because the view's ལུགས -> 'chủ trương' occupies that word in the very same sentence.
p0839, same triad. Follows the corpus rendering of ཁས་བླངས་པ = 'thừa nhận', nominalised.

terms.bo: སངས་རྒྱས་པ (the Buddhist, as a party to debate)
terms.note: p0840-p0841, 3×, opposed to བྱེ་བྲག་པ (phái Thắng Luận). Agentive པ of the fixed སངས་རྒྱས -> 'Phật'; recorded so it is not read as drift from that ruling.

terms.bo: གསལ་བྱེད་པ (the party holding sound to be manifested, not produced)
terms.vi: phái chủ trương sự hiển lộ
terms.note: p0841, 2×, as the opponent to whom the Vaiśeṣika addresses the syllogism. Rendered descriptively rather than coining a school name, since the Tibetan gives only 'the manifester'. Corresponds to the quotation's མངོན་པར་གསལ་བར་བྱ་བ = 'cái được làm cho hiển lộ rõ'.

p0840 (quotation) and p0841 (gloss). DEVIATION from the fixed ཡོན་ཏན -> 'công đức': here guṇa is the Vaiśeṣika category of quality (the thesis that sound is a quality of ether), and 'công đức của hư không' would be doctrinally false. See flags.

p0841, 3×, and the pivot of the whole section (the subject and the predicate must be established in a manner appearing the same to both parties). GAP. Kept deliberately as 'hiện ra' (from སྣང་བ) rather than 'công nhận', so it stays distinct from ཁས་ལེན -> 'thừa nhận' and from གྲགས་པ -> 'cực thành / quen thuộc', both registered in the view.
p0840, in the Prasannapadā quotation, paired with རྗེས་སུ་དཔག་པ -> 'tỷ lượng' (per the view's རྗེས་དཔག entry).
p0841. GAP. Rendered descriptively rather than as 'sở lập' (zero corpus precedent for that form); the pair with 'cái phải phá bỏ' (དགག་བྱ, corpus-standard in c211-c226) is deliberate.

terms.bo: ཆོས་ཅན (as the subject-term of a syllogism)
terms.note: Not new — following the view's prov ཆོས་ཅན -> 'hữu pháp' and the corpus (c179, c209, c233). Recorded only to note that in this chunk it is the logical subject of a proof, not the śamatha-object sense the view's note is scoped to.

p0841 l.3, ×2. The Mīmāṃsaka-type opponent of the Vaiśeṣika in this passage: sound is pre-existent and merely made manifest (`སྔར་ཡོད་རྐྱེན་གྱིས་གསལ་བར་བྱེད་པའི་སྒྲ`), contrasted with `བྱས་པའི་སྒྲ` (sound as produced). Currently bracketed in c249 because the doctrinal gloss has no Tibetan counterpart. A ruling should settle whether the school is named plainly (e.g. 'phái Hiển Lộ' / 'phái Hiển Thị') so the brackets can drop; it recurs through the Svātantrika-refutation section. Distinguish from the verbal `མངོན་པར་གསལ་བར་བྱ་བ` (L38, 'cái được làm cho hiển lộ rõ').

terms.kind: prov-ruling deviation with a three-way collision
terms.note: The view has `prov གཏན་ཚིགས -> chánh lý [hetu]`, scoped by its own note to the triad thí dụ / chánh lý / giáo chứng. c249 L28 renders the sa-bcad heading `སྐྱོན་དེས་གཏན་ཚིགས་ཀྱང་མ་གྲུབ་པར་བསྟན་པ` (p0840 l.7) as 'nhân cũng chẳng thành lập': 'chánh lý' would be wrong here (this is the logical reason of a probative argument, and 'chánh lý' is already this view's rendering of རིགས་པ and of ལུང་དང་རིགས་པ). But 'nhân' is also the chunk's rendering of རྟགས (L18 ×3: 'cái nhân đủ ba tướng', 'nhân vận hành do sức của sự vật', 'nhân tự lập') and of རྒྱུ (L38 `རྒྱུ་དང་བཅས་པ` / `རྒྱུ་མེད་པ`; L13-14 verse `རྒྱུ་མེད་པར`). Three distinct Tibetan words land on 'nhân' in one chunk. Wording KEPT; a ruling is owed that separates གཏན་ཚིགས / རྟགས / རྒྱུ — this heading propagates into later chunks.

`འདོད་པ` has no entry in the view, and c249 renders it 'chủ trương' — the same Vietnamese the view already registers for ལུགས (`prov ལུགས -> chủ trương`, itself marked GAP). They collide inside single sentences: L18 'Còn việc chủ trương [འདོད་པ] — như là chủ trương [ལུགས] của A-xà-lê Nguyệt Xứng — … trong chủ trương [ལུགས] của cả hai bên'; also L32 `འདོད་པ་བརྗོད་པ` (heading, p0840 l.11/13) -> 'nêu ra chỗ chủ trương', L42 `སོ་སོའི་འདོད་པ་ཐུན་མོང་མིན་པ` -> 'chủ trương bất cộng của riêng từng bên'. `རང་འདོད` (p0839 l.1) is already handled separately as 'điều tự mình chủ trương', so the root has two forms. Needs ONE ruling covering ལུགས / འདོད་པ / རང་འདོད. Wording KEPT pending it.

terms.kind: scope question on an existing prov entry
terms.note: The view has `prov ཕྱོགས (in ཕྱོགས་སུ་བྱས་ནས) -> tông (lấy … làm tông) [pakṣa]`, scoped to a different construction. c249 L28/L30 render `གཞི་ཆོས་ཅན་མ་གྲུབ་པའི་ཕྱོགས་ཀྱི་སྐྱོན་བསྟན་པ` (p0840 l.7 and the heading at l.9) as 'lỗi của phía mà nơi đó cơ sở tức hữu pháp chẳng thành lập' — ཕྱོགས as 'side/party' rather than as the pakṣa (the thesis whose dharmin is unestablished: the āśrayāsiddha fault this whole section treats). Both readings are defensible from the Tibetan alone; wording KEPT, but the heading propagates into later chunks so the sense should be pinned once.

p0840 l.15, p0841 l.1 and l.3. The view fixes only the bare headword `སངས་རྒྱས -> Phật`; the agentive school-name form (the Buddhist party in debate, opposed to བྱེ་བྲག་པ / Vaiśeṣika) is unregistered. Wording KEPT; recurs through the whole Svātantrika-refutation section, so it should be registered — cf. the existing precedent of `རང་རྒྱུད་པ -> Tự Lập`.

p0825, གནས་མ་བུ་པས་...བདག་རྫས་ཡོད་ཁས་བླངས་པ. This is the ONLY occurrence of the word in the entire book (grep over source/clean: 1 hit). No entry. 'Độc Tử' (犢子) is the established Sino-Vietnamese for Vātsīputrīya; kept as 'phái Độc Tử' to match the corpus pattern 'phái Thuận Thế' / 'các vị Duy Thức'.

p0824. The glossary registers prov རྒོལ་བ -> 'vấn nạn' scoped to the NOUN (the objection itself, p0702 རྒོལ་བའི་དོན་མེད་དོ = 'lời vấn nạn'). Here it is the agent — the disputants who raise the objection. 'những kẻ vấn nạn' keeps the same root word; 'kẻ đối luận' (used in c181 for ཕྱི་རྒོལ) is the alternative. A scoped ruling is owed.

p0824. No entry. The doctrine held by the opponent (existence in the ultimate, non-existence conventionally). Rendered as a 'saying/assertion' rather than as a person, since སྨྲ་བ is here the thing refuted (བཀག་ནས).

p0826, ×2 — the ONLY two occurrences in the book (the third grep hit is ཞེ་བསྔགས at p0561, a different word). Read as ཞེ = inner mind/heart, i.e. saying something with real assertoric intent rather than merely mouthing it, which is exactly what the argument turns on: one who genuinely means 'I have no assertions' must thereby assert that. UNCERTAIN — see flag.
p0824, ...གཅོད་པ་ལ་ཁོངས་གཟོ་བའི་བློ་གྲོས་ཅན་རྣམས་ཀྱིས. Hapax in the book (1 grep hit). Read as 'digest inwardly / take to heart'. UNCERTAIN — see flag.

p0827, ×3 (བསྙོན་པར་མི་ནུས་པའི་མངོན་སུམ་ལ་བསྙོན་ན, དེ་ལ་བསྙོན་པས་ཆོག་པས). No entry. Deliberately kept apart from སྐུར་པ་འདེབས་པ = 'phỉ báng' (which also occurs, p0824) and from སུན་འབྱིན་པ = 'phá trừ' — all three stand within these four pages.
p0824, བསྙོན་འདིངས་པ་ལ་རེ་བར་མི་བྱའོ. No entry; compound of བསྙོན་པ (deny) + འདིང་བ (spread out, lay out). Rendered descriptively.

p0824, འགལ་འདུ་ཐམས་ཅད་དང་བྲལ་བར་བྱ. No entry. Follows c233 l.15, which renders འགལ་འདུ་སྨྲ་བ inside the Madhyamakāvatārabhāṣya quotation as 'nói ra một điều mâu thuẫn lẫn nhau'. Occurs 8× in the book (p0438, p0562, p0726, p0743, p0770, p0790, p0816, p0824), so one ruling settles several chunks.

terms.vi: chẳng thể gán lỗi / chẳng thể chất lỗi lên
terms.note: p0825 ×2, p0827 ×1. Two near-identical Tibetan idioms (འདོགས་པ 'impute' and དགལ་བ 'load onto') used interchangeably in this passage. Rendered with two different Vietnamese verbs to keep them separable; a ruling could equally merge them.

p0827. No entry. 'Definite/committed words' — words one actually stands behind. Note the collision: ངེས་པ is registered as 'sự xác quyết' (niścaya) and is used in that sense at p0825 (ངེས་པ་རྙེད་པར་བྱའོ = 'phải tìm cho được sự xác quyết') in this same chunk.

p0827, ...ཁྱེད་ཀྱིས་རིག་པ་དེ་ནི་ངོ་མཚར་རོ. The registered prov ངོ་མཚར -> 'kỳ diệu' is scoped to ངོ་མཚར་ཆེན་པོ་ཅན inside the Śikṣāsamuccaya quotation (p0460), a plainly positive use. Here it is sarcasm aimed at the opponent, and Vietnamese 'kỳ diệu' is unambiguously laudatory, so it would read wrongly. 'kỳ lạ thay' follows c046 l.77. A sense split is owed.

terms.vi: bất khả thuyết / chẳng thể diễn tả
terms.note: p0825 ×3, p0826 ×1 — the Vātsīputrīya thesis that the self is inexpressible as either identical with or different from the aggregates, plus the MAv VI.146 verse (གྲུབ་དངོས་བརྗོད་དུ་མེད་མི་འགྱུར). Follows c222 l.57 ('tự tướng bất khả thuyết'). Both forms used: the Sino-Vietnamese 'bất khả thuyết' in the verse and in the technical thesis, the plain 'chẳng thể diễn tả' where a verb is needed. A ruling should say whether the two may alternate.
p0825 ×2. No entry. The identity/difference pair in the pudgala argument, parallel to ཕུང་པོ་དང་གཅིག་ཐ་དད in the same sentence, which is rendered 'một với các uẩn hoặc khác'.

p0826 ×2. The view registers prov གྲོལ་བ -> 'giải thoát', whose own note already records that it silently collapses onto the FIXED ཐར་པ = 'giải thoát'. Here it is 'getting out of having to make assertions' — 'giải thoát khỏi sự thừa nhận' would import soteriological weight the sentence does not have. Wording departed from the provisional deliberately; a scoped ruling is owed.

p0827, སེམས་ཙམ་གཞན་ངོར་འདོད, beside སེམས་ཙམ་པར་བཞག་ཏུ་མི་རུང ('chẳng khả dĩ được an lập là nhà Duy Thức'). The view registers only prov སེམས་ཙམ་པ -> 'các vị Duy Thức' (the proponents). Bare སེམས་ཙམ needs its own entry, as དབུ་མ / དབུ་མ་པ already have.

Expanded form of the registered རང་ལུགས -> 'tự tông' (view line 381); no separate headword. It carries the slogan under refutation in this section — དབུ་མ་པ་ལ་རང་གི་ལུགས་མེད་དོ (p0825 l.1) and རང་གི་ལུགས་ལ་མི་འདོད་དོ / རང་གི་ལུགས་ལ་མི་རུང (p0827 l.1) — and alternates with bare རང་ལུགས within the same paragraphs (དེ་དག་ལ་རང་ལུགས་མེད་པ, རང་ལུགས་ལ་མི་རུང་བ). Requested ruling: རང་གི་ལུགས = རང་ལུགས = 'tự tông', so the slogan stays recognisable as one thing across the section.

terms.bo: འདོད་པ (chủ trương sense, in མི་འདོད / འདོད་དགོས / གཞན་ངོར་འདོད)
terms.note: No ruling for འདོད in the view. It must be kept OFF 'thừa nhận', which is registered for ཁས་བླངས་པ / ཁས་ལེན (lines 161, 431) — this chunk's entire argument is about ཁས་ལེན་མེད་པ ('chẳng có sự thừa nhận', ~27×), so collapsing འདོད into it destroys the distinction. Occurrences here: འདོད་དགོས (p0824 l.1), འདོད་པའི་སྨྲ་བ་ངན་པ (p0824 l.1), རྫས་སུ་འདོད, སེམས་ཙམ་གཞན་ངོར་འདོད / རང་ལུགས་ལ་མི་འདོད་པ and རང་གི་ལུགས་ལ་མི་འདོད་དོ (p0827 l.1). Requested ruling: འདོད -> 'chủ trương', ཁས་ལེན/ཁས་བླངས -> 'thừa nhận'.

p0827 l.1, ཁྱེད་ཀྱིས་རིག་པ་དེ་ནི་ངོ་མཚར་རོ — Tsongkhapa's sarcastic 'how marvellous that you know…'. The view's prov ངོ་མཚར -> 'kỳ diệu' (line 275) is scoped to ངོ་མཚར་ཆེན་པོ་ཅན inside the Śikṣāsamuccaya quotation at p0460, an adjectival attribute of an object, not an exclamation. WORDING KEPT and flagged here rather than silently: a second, scoped ruling is requested for the predicative/exclamatory ངོ་མཚར་རོ, since 'kỳ diệu' as an exclamation reads as praise and loses the irony.

p0827 l.1 ×4: ཐལ་འགྱུར་གྱི་གཞུང, ཐལ་འགྱུར་ཡང་མི་རུང, ཐལ་འགྱུར་གཞན་ངོར་རུང་བ, ཐལ་འགྱུར་གྱིས་གཏན་ལ་འབེབས་པ. The view registers only the agentive ཐལ་འགྱུར་བ -> 'Ứng Thành' and རང་རྒྱུད་པ -> 'Tự Lập' (lines 361, 363). WORDING KEPT (capitalised, since here it names the system/method opposed to རང་རྒྱུད, and stands beside ཐལ་འགྱུར་བ 'nhà Ứng Thành' in the same sentence). A ruling should state when the capitalised school/system name is used versus lowercase 'ứng thành' for the consequence as an argument form, which c244 uses.

p0826 l.1 ×2: ཁས་ལེན་མེད་དོ་ཞེས་པའང་ཞེ་བས་སྨྲ་མི་རུང་བ and ཁས་ལེན་མེད་དོ་ཞེས་ཞེ་བས་སྨྲ་བ་དེས. 'from the heart / in earnest' — load-bearing here, because the whole refutation turns on whether the opponent means his 'I have no assertions' sincerely. No ruling. WORDING KEPT.

p0824 l.1 (བསྙོན་འདིངས་པ་ལ་རེ་བར་མི་བྱའོ) and p0827 l.1 ×2 (བསྙོན་པར་མི་ནུས་པའི་མངོན་སུམ་ལ་བསྙོན་ན, དེ་ལ་བསྙོན་པས་ཆོག་པས). No ruling. 'chối bỏ' is deliberately kept visibly apart from སྐུར་པ་འདེབས་པ -> 'phỉ báng' (L13), per the view's line-82 note on the སྤོང་བ / སྐུར་པ་འདེབས་པ contrast. WORDING KEPT.

མི་རིགས (p0826 l.3, མི་རིགས་ཏེ) and མི་འཐད་པ (p0825 l.1, p0826 l.1) both land on 'chẳng hợp lý'. This is the collision already recorded in the view (lines 435–436): predicative རིགས་པ has no usable nominal form ('chánh lý' cannot be predicated) and འཐད་པ -> 'hợp lý' is the corpus rendering. Nothing changed; re-reported so the pair is ruled once, together with the existing རུང་བ -> 'khả dĩ' entry that sits in the same cluster (this chunk also has མི་རུང ×5 rendered 'chẳng khả dĩ', which keeps that third word apart correctly).

p0820 l.1, ×4. GAP — no entry in the view. The standard pramāṇa-literature example-locus for establishing the smoke/fire pervasion. Read as mahānasa (tshang = nasa, mang = mahā), not as anything to do with 'many'. Flagged: this is the one place in the chunk where a plain lexical reading carries the whole example, and if it is wrong the whole paragraph reads wrong.

p0820 l.1 (×4), p0821 l.1, p0822 l.1 (རྟགས་སུ་བཀོད་ནས = 'nêu ra làm nhân'). GAP. The logical sign/reason. Safe in this chunk because རྒྱུ (cause) does not occur here — རྒྱུ་མཚན ('lý do') does, and the two are kept apart. A scoped ruling is owed, since 'nhân' is the corpus word for hetu-as-cause elsewhere.

terms.vi: cái phải thành lập / pháp phải thành lập
terms.note: p0820 l.1, p0821 l.1 (×2). GAP. Built to match the corpus's དགག་བྱ = 'cái phải phá bỏ' (registered prov, c231 passim), so the negandum/probandum pair stays visibly parallel in Vietnamese. Deliberately NOT 'sở lập', which would break that parallel and collide with c207's 'lượng năng lập' (སྒྲུབ་བྱེད་ཀྱི་ཚད་མ).

p0821 l.1, སྒྲ་བུམ་གཉིས་ཀ་ལ་རྗེས་སུ་འགྲོ་བ་དགོས. GAP. The only other occurrence in the whole corpus (p0028) is a different sense ('the training that follows upon the vow taken'), so nothing constrains this one. 隨行 tùy hành is the standard Sino-Vietnamese for anvaya (positive concomitance).

p0822 l.1. GAP, and a corpus hapax — this is the ONLY occurrence of the term in all 978 pages. The scholastic 'specific exclusion / explicit exception clause'. Deliberately NOT 'sự loại trừ riêng': རྣམ་པར་བཅད་པ stands eight lines further down in this same paragraph and takes 'loại trừ' (c217 precedent), so the two must not collapse. See flags — the wording is a proposal, not a settled reading.

ཐལ་འགྱུར p0822 l.1 (×2), ཐལ་བ p0823 l.1 (×2). The view registers only ཐལ་འགྱུར་བ = 'Ứng Thành' (the school, Prāsaṅgika). Follows c211 L15, which already writes '[luận thức] ứng thành' for the consequence itself. Capitalisation carries the distinction: 'phái Ứng Thành' = the school (p0823 ཐལ་འགྱུར་བའི་ཁྱད་ཆོས), lowercase 'ứng thành' = the consequence. The two Tibetan words ཐལ་འགྱུར and ཐལ་བ are merged onto one Vietnamese word — see flags.

p0822 l.1 (×2), paired with རྣམ་པར་བཅད་པ. Not in the view, but c217 L33 already renders exactly this pair at p0727 (གཅིག་རྣམ་པར་བཅད་པས་ཅིག་ཤོས་ཡོངས་སུ་མི་གཅོད = 'việc loại trừ một [bên] … thì chẳng xác định trọn vẹn được [bên] kia'). Followed verbatim so the two chunks stay in step.

terms.vi: bản thích luận Nhập Trung Luận
terms.note: p0820 l.1, opening of the section. Composed from two registered provisionals: འཇུག་པ = 'Nhập Trung Luận' and འགྲེལ་བཤད = 'bản thích luận' [ṭīkā], the latter's own note keeping it apart from འགྲེལ་པ (bhāṣya/vṛtti). The short-form-title policy already flagged in the view applies here too.
p0821 l.3. Composed from the registered དམ་བཅའ = 'lời lập tông' and the 'Tự Lập' half of the registered ཐལ་འགྱུར་བ / རང་རྒྱུད་པ pair (c208, c229).
p0822 l.1, རྩོད་ཟློག་རྩ་འགྲེལ. GAP. Root text plus its own commentary; the title itself is the registered རྩོད་ཟློག = 'Hồi Tránh Luận'.

terms.vi: xác định một cách trực tiếp
terms.note: p0820 l.1. Adverbial, NOT the view's registered epistemological མངོན་སུམ = 'hiện lượng' (p0581) nor མངོན་སུམ་དུ་མཆོད་པ = 'cúng dường hiện tiền'. Here it qualifies hearing the opponent's words, so 'hiện lượng' would read as a claim about the means of knowledge that the sentence is not making. Registered so the departure is on record.

p0823, ཐལ་བ་ཙམ ('ứng thành suông') and ཐལ་བ་བྱེད་དོ ('đưa ra ứng thành'). Wording KEPT. The view registers only ཐལ་འགྱུར་བ -> 'Ứng Thành' (the school, capitalised; used correctly at L27 for ཐལ་འགྱུར་བའི་ཁྱད་ཆོས). But this chunk also renders ཐལ་འགྱུར (the consequence-statement, p0822: གཞན་ལུགས་འགོག་པའི་ཐལ་འགྱུར, སུན་འབྱིན་པའི་ཐལ་འགྱུར) as lowercase 'ứng thành', so ཐལ་བ and ཐལ་འགྱུར merge onto one Vietnamese word within two pages. A ruling should say whether the merger is intended (both are the prasaṅga consequence and the merger is harmless) or whether ཐལ་བ needs its own word.

p0822. Wording KEPT — 'bài xích' is one of the registered provisionals, so this is not a violation. But the view holds three competing provisionals for the same headword: 'phá trừ' (bare form), 'bài xích' (in ཉོན་མོངས་སུན་འབྱིན་པ, p0337), 'đả phá' (p0350). Here the object is གྲུབ་མཐའ (a tenet system), not an affliction, so neither existing note's scope actually covers this occurrence. The three-way split must be settled centrally; a sense split by object (tenet-system vs affliction vs accumulated sin) would resolve all three sites.

terms.vi: xác định trọn vẹn / loại trừ
terms.note: p0822, ×2 each, in the paired argument རང་བཞིན་མེད་པ་ཡོངས་སུ་གཅོད ↔ རང་བཞིན་ ... རྣམ་པར་བཅད. No entry in the view for either. Wordings KEPT. The pair is technical (affirmative determination vs exclusion) and the whole passage turns on the two being distinct and symmetrical, so they should be ruled on together rather than one at a time.

p0820, རྟོགས་པར་བྱ་བའི་གཞི and རྟོགས་པར་བྱ་བའི་དོན in the smoke-and-fire inference. RAISED BY THIS REPAIR: the file said 'chứng ngộ', which the fidelity check rightly rejected as overstating a plain cognitive act; changed to 'nhận hiểu'. The view registers རྟོགས་པ only inside བདག་མེད་པའི་དེ་ཁོ་ན་ཉིད་རྟོགས་པ = 'chứng ngộ thật tánh vô ngã' (p0089-0090), a soteriological scope. A ruling is now owed for the epistemic/logical sense so that 'nhận hiểu' (or whichever word is chosen) is applied consistently and 'chứng ngộ' stays reserved for realization.
p0829, ཕྱོགས་ཆོས་དང་ཁྱབ་པའི་ཚུལ་གཉིས. No entry; first occurrence in the corpus (source has it only at p0829 and p0865).

p0829, only occurrence in the source. Kept distinct from the registered སྦྱོར་བ = 'gia hành' (prayoga, scoped to the བསམ་པ་དང་སྦྱོར་བ pair) and from the third scoped sense 'sự kết hợp' at p0753. Note c211 already writes '[luận thức] ứng thành hay [luận thức] tự lập' for ཐལ་རང, so 'luận thức' is the corpus stem.

terms.vi: những vị chủ trương [các pháp] hiện hữu do giả lập
terms.note: p0831, last line, running into c247. The corpus renders བཏགས་ཡོད as 'giả hữu' (c209/c210 on p0702–p0703); this is the periphrastic form, so it is rendered analytically. c247 must not re-decide it.

p0828, རིགས་པའི་ཤེས་ངོར་འཇོག. Contraction of ཤེས་པའི་ངོ; rendered per the view's ཤེས་པ -> 'thức' ruling for the pramāṇa-debate sense. See flags for the collision with རིགས་ཤེས = 'trí chánh lý', which stands two clauses away.

p0830–p0831, ~7×, incl. the Vigrahavyāvartanī verse and its commentary. The view registers the verbal དམིགས་པ as 'nhận thấy' (p0737, chosen to avoid the ālambana word), but here the verb stands in the same sentences as དམིགས་བྱ / དམིགས་བྱེད, which are registered 'sở duyên' / 'năng duyên'; 'nhận thấy' would break that link inside one argument. Flagged.
p0830, རྟེན་འབྱུང་གི་ཚད་མ་དང་གཞལ་བྱ. Contracted variant of རྟེན་འབྲེལ, which occurs in this same chunk at p0829; same Vietnamese, the Tibetan alternation is not reproduced.
p0828 (ཁུངས་སུ་མི་རུང) and p0831 (ཁུངས་སུ་ཇི་ལྟར་རུང). No headword for the bare noun; the glossary reaches ཁུངས only inside ཆོས་ཁུངས་བཙུན་པ. 'xuất xứ' follows existing corpus usage.
p0829, དེའི་ཤེས་བྱེད་དུ. No entry; 'chứng cứ' has 3 corpus occurrences already.
p0830, བརྩད་པ་ལས་འཕྲོས་པ་ཡིན — the Vigrahavyāvartanī's 'no thesis' statement as an offshoot of a particular challenge. No entry.

terms.bo: སྡང་བ (of a name, not a person)
terms.note: p0829, རང་རྒྱུད་ཀྱི་མིང་ལ་སྡང་བ་ཙམ. The registered prov སྡང་བ -> 'sân hận' (dveṣa) is scoped to སྡང་བ་དྲག་པོ at p0137 and would be incoherent of a mere term of art.

terms.bo: རང་བཞིན་མེད་པ (split by an intervening modifier: རང་གི་ངོ་བོས་གྲུབ་པའི་རང་བཞིན་མེད་པ)
terms.vi: chẳng có tự tánh được thành lập bằng thể tánh của chính nó
terms.kind: scoped exception to a FIXED ruling
terms.note: p0828 l.1 (ཆོས་རྣམས་ལ་རང་གི་ངོ་བོས་གྲུབ་པའི་རང་བཞིན་མེད་པ) and p0829 l.3 (མྱུ་གུ་རང་གི་ངོ་བོས་གྲུབ་པའི་རང་བཞིན་མེད་དོ). Every unmodified occurrence in the chunk has been normalised to the FIXED 'vô tự tánh'. These two cannot be: the qualifier stands between རང་བཞིན and མེད་པ, so the negated thing is 'the svabhāva established by its own entity', not the lexical unit. Register the exception explicitly so a later consistency sweep does not read these two as violations, and so no one 'fixes' them into 'vô tự tánh được thành lập bằng...', which would negate the wrong thing.

terms.kind: gap — no ruling in the view
terms.note: p0828 l.1. The sense is 'left to itself / unrestrained / not brought under analysis': an uncritical conventional consciousness, contrasted with རིགས་པའི་ཤེས་པ two clauses earlier. Must be kept distinct from མ་དཔྱད་པའི་ཤེས་པ -> 'thức chưa thẩm sát' (view line 392), which is the near neighbour it would otherwise collapse into. Confidence moderate; a native-speaker call on the wording is owed.

terms.bo: གཏན་ཚིགས (inferential reason of a formal syllogism)
terms.note: p0829 l.3, ×2 (རྟེན་འབྲེལ་ཡིན་པའི་ཕྱིར་ཞེས་པའི་གཏན་ཚིགས; ཕྱོགས་ཆོས་དང་ཁྱབ་པའི་ཚུལ་གཉིས་ཀྱི་གཏན་ཚིགས). The view's prov གཏན་ཚིགས -> 'chánh lý' scopes itself to the triad thí dụ / chánh lý / giáo chứng. Here 'chánh lý' would collide head-on with prov རིགས་པ -> 'chánh lý', which occurs 3× in the immediately preceding paragraph (རིགས་པས་གཞན་དབང་སེལ་ན, ཁྱེད་རང་གི་རིགས་པ་རྣམས་ཀྱིས, རིགས་པས་འགོག་ནུས). Wording kept.

terms.kind: gap — with a live collision to register
terms.note: p0829 l.3. Standard Sino-Vietnamese for the logician's 因二相, but 'tướng' is already the view's prov Vietnamese for མཚན་ཉིད (line 38) and for མཚན་མ, and the view's own note (line 163) already asks for that three-way collision to be split; this makes a fourth Tibetan word land on it. The scoped prov ཚུལ -> 'cách thức' (line 368, in དབུ་མའི་ཚུལ) does not reach this compound, so the wording is a gap, not a violation. Kept, but it should be ruled on together with the མཚན་ཉིད / མཚན་མ / མཚན split rather than settled chunk by chunk.
p0830 l.1. The action/agent pair of negation and proof.
p0831 l.1, སུན་འབྱིན་བརྗོད་མི་ནུས་པར — the refutation that cannot be stated against the proponent of emptiness. Kept distinct from འགོག་པ -> 'sự phủ định', which stands in the same paragraph.
p0829 l.1, ×2. The negative counterpart of prov རང་གི་མཚན་ཉིད་ཀྱིས་གྲུབ་པ -> 'được thành lập bằng tự tướng' (view line 402), which is itself only provisional; the two should be registered together.

p0817, ×2 (རྒྱུ་མཚན་མཚུངས་པའི་མགོ་སྙོམས / མགོ་སྙོམས་པའོ). GAP — no entry. The fourth of the four Prāsaṅgika devices: showing the opponent's reason applies equally to himself ('if you accept this you must accept this'). Literally 'levelling of heads'. 'sự đánh đồng' is slightly colloquial; alternatives 'sự san bằng' / 'cách nói ngang bằng'. Zero corpus precedent — needs a ruling because the four devices form a named list that will be referred back to.
p0817, p0818 (དཔེ་རྟགས, དཔེ་དང་རྟགས). The example limb of a proof.

p0819 l.3. The glossary's prov གཏན་ཚིགས -> 'chánh lý' is scoped to the triad thí dụ/chánh lý/giáo chứng and is unusable here, where གཏན་ཚིགས is the logical reason. 'chánh nhân' (正因) is the established rendering, but note it also carries an unrelated ordinary sense ('primary cause') in Vietnamese Buddhist usage; zero corpus precedent (grep: 0).
p0819 l.3, བསྒྲུབ་པའི་ངག་བཀོད་པའི་སྒོ་ནས. The formal proof-statement put to the opponent. Follows the སྒྲུབ་བྱེད = 'cái năng lập' register.

terms.vi: vận hành do sức của sự vật
terms.note: p0819 l.3, དངོས་པོ་སྟོབས་ཞུགས་ཀྱི་ཚད་མ. GAP. Rendered descriptively rather than by a compound because no Vietnamese calque is established; uses the glossary's དངོས་པོ -> 'sự vật'. It is a standing technical term in the whole Svātantrika/Prāsaṅgika division and will recur.

p0818 l.1, inside the Prasannapadā quotation. Uses the corpus's རང་རྒྱུད་པ -> 'Tự Lập' (c208, c211, c229). Also registers རྗེས་དཔག / མངོན་རྗེས -> 'tỷ lượng' / 'hiện lượng và tỷ lượng' (p0819), which follow the glossary's མངོན་སུམ -> 'hiện lượng'.

p0818 (ཐལ་བར་འགྱུར་བ་བཟློག་པའི་དོན), p0819 verse (ཐལ་བར་འགྱུར་བ་འདི་ནི་སྲིད་མ་ཡིན). The glossary registers only ཐལ་འགྱུར་བ -> 'Ứng Thành' (the school). c211 already writes '[luận thức] ứng thành' lowercase for the argument form; this pins the bare noun.

terms.vi: việc lật ngược sự ứng thành
terms.note: p0818 l.1, Prasannapadā. The implied reverse inference a consequence generates. The glossary's prov བཟློག་པ -> 'ngăn dứt' is scoped to འཁོར་བ་བཟློག་པ and cannot carry this.

p0818 l.1, Madhyamakāvatāra verse, paired with སུན་འབྱིན་པ -> 'người phá trừ' (following c229's 'kẻ phá trừ'). Note the glossary already carries THREE competing provisionals for the སུན་འབྱིན family (phá trừ / bài xích / đả phá); this pair should be settled in the same ruling.

terms.vi: vị có tự thể vĩ đại
terms.note: p0818, Yuktiṣaṣṭikā verse. Built from the glossary's ཆེ་བ -> 'sự vĩ đại' and prov བདག་ཉིད -> 'tự thể' (p0729). Reads mechanically; the epithet is simply 'great beings' and a freer 'bậc đại sĩ' may be preferable, but that would import a word the Tibetan does not have.
p0817, ×2 (རྒྱུ་མཚན་མཚུངས་པ, རྒྱུ་མཚན་ཁྱད་པར་མེད་པ). No entry in the view; follows the c227 note that records རྒྱུ་མཚན as 'the reason' contrasted with དམ་བཅའ.

terms.vi: phía (rang phyogs -> phía của mình, gzhan phyogs -> phía của kẻ khác)
terms.note: GAP, not a translator error. The view registers ཕྱོགས only in the scoped idiom 'ཕྱོགས་སུ་བྱས་ནས -> tông (lấy … làm tông)' from the Tarkajvālā citation at p0753. Bare ཕྱོགས is the pivot of this whole chunk (L11 ×4, L13, L27–L29, L34, L40, L50, L53, L67, L69) and of the entire Prāsaṅgika section. 'phía' is used internally consistently and keeps the word separable from དམ་བཅའ = 'lời lập tông'; it is however a literal calque of 'side', while 'tông' / 'lập trường' is the standing Sino-Vietnamese for pakṣa — and 'tông' already collides with the scoped ཕྱོགས་སུ་བྱས་ནས entry and with དམ་བཅའ = 'lời lập tông'. WORDING KEPT. A ruling is owed before later chunks, and it must fix རང་ཕྱོགས / གཞན་ཕྱོགས together with the bare noun.

terms.vi: công nhận (འཇིག་རྟེན་གྲགས་པ -> được thế gian công nhận; གཞན་ལ་གྲགས་པ -> được kẻ khác công nhận)
terms.note: CONFLICT in the glossary itself, not a translator error. The view carries three competing provisional renderings of one prasiddha sense: 'cực thành' (two entries, p0760–p0762), 'quen thuộc' (p0763–p0764), and 'chỗ thế gian công nhận' (p0739–p0740, for འཇིག་རྟེན་གྲགས་པ). c243 follows the third (L11 for གཞན་ལ་གྲགས་པ carried over from p0816; L69 ×2 for འཇིག་རྟེན་གྲགས་པ). It also honours the standing constraint recorded under the 'quen thuộc' entry — deliberately NOT 'thừa nhận', which is reserved for ཁས་བླངས་པ / ཁས་ལེན and stands in the very same sentences at L69. WORDING KEPT. One of the three must be chosen centrally before the section continues; whichever wins must also cover the compound འཇིག་རྟེན་གྲགས་པའི་ཚད་མ.

GAP. The view registers only ཐལ་འགྱུར་བ -> 'Ứng Thành' as the school name [Prāsaṅgika], which c243 renders 'phái Ứng Thành' (L11, L13). The consequence itself — the argument form — has no entry: L44 ཐལ་བར་འགྱུར་བ་བཟློག་པའི་དོན and L51 ཐལ་བར་འགྱུར་བ་འདི་ནི་སྲིད་མ་ཡིན (MAv). 'sự ứng thành' is used consistently and keeps the argument-form visibly distinct from the school by the classifier alone. WORDING KEPT; needs registering so 'phái Ứng Thành' vs 'sự ứng thành' stays stable through the rest of the section.

terms.vi: bác bỏ (in བསྒྲུབ་པའམ་བཟློག་པར་བྱ་ན); lật ngược (in ཐལ་བར་འགྱུར་བ་བཟློག་པ)
terms.note: SENSE-SPLIT GAP, not drift. The view's prov བཟློག་པ -> 'ngăn dứt' is explicitly scoped to འཁོར་བ་བཟློག་པ (nivartana, turning saṃsāra back) — a different sense from the logical one here. c243 has two logical uses that are themselves distinct: L21, in the Vigrahavyāvartanī verse བསྒྲུབ་པའམ་བཟློག་པར་བྱ་ན, paired against བསྒྲུབ་པ 'thành lập', i.e. refute -> 'bác bỏ'; and L44, in ཐལ་བར་འགྱུར་བ་བཟློག་པའི་དོན (Prasannapadā), i.e. turning a consequence back on the opponent -> 'lật ngược'. WORDING KEPT for both. The split should be registered — both logical senses recur through the Prāsaṅgika section — and note that 'bác bỏ' is also carrying དགག་པ / འགོག་པ elsewhere in this chunk ('phủ định', 'phá bỏ'), so the ruling should settle the whole negation family together.

terms.vi: Chẳng tương tự với thí dụ đã nêu
terms.note: The chunk's sa-bcad heading, second of the two under དེ་དགག་པ (sibling: དོན་མི་འཐད་པ). དང་མི་འདྲ་བ governs དཔེ་བཀོད་པ, and the body confirms the reading (དཔེ་ལ་ཡང་འདྲ་བ་ཡོད་པ་མ་ཡིན་ནོ / དཔེ་དང་འདྲ་བ་ཡོད་པ་མ་ཡིན་ནོ).
p0847. Matches c249 verbatim ('việc nó là nhân tự lập'), built on the registered རང་རྒྱུད་པ = 'Tự Lập'. Also used in this chunk: རང་རྒྱུད་ཀྱི་ཆོས་ཅན -> 'hữu pháp tự lập'.

p0847, ×2. Follows c250's ཕྱོགས་ཀྱི་སྐྱོན = 'lỗi của tông' and the parent sa-bcad གཞི་ཆོས་ཅན་མ་གྲུབ་པའི་ཕྱོགས་ཀྱི་སྐྱོན་བསྟན་པ. Kept distinct from the view's ཕྱོགས (in ཕྱོགས་སུ་བྱས་ནས) = 'tông', same word, same Vietnamese.

p0848 ×2, p0849 ×1 (རྒོལ་བ་དེ་དག, རྒོལ་བ་གཉིས་པོ་དེ་དག, རྒོལ་བ་གཉིས་ཀའི་རྒྱུད). glossary.json's only bare རྒོལ་བ entry is 'vấn nạn' (an objection, p0702) — a different word-sense that would be wrong here. Rendered 'bên tranh luận' DELIBERATELY apart from ཕྱི་རྒོལ = 'bên đối luận' and སྔ་རྒོལ = 'bên lập luận' (both from c250), which stand in the same sentences. A scoped ruling covering all three is owed.

terms.vi: bên đối luận / bên lập luận
terms.note: p0847, p0848, p0849. No entry (glossary has only ཕས་ཀྱི་རྒོལ་བ = 'kẻ đối luận' and རྒོལ་ཕྱི་རྒོལ = 'người lập luận và người phản luận'). Wording taken verbatim from c250, the immediately preceding chunk of the same argument. Registering so the pair is visibly fixed before the rest of this section.
p0848 ×2, the competing account of sound. GAP. Follows c249 ('âm thanh vốn được sinh ra từ bốn đại chủng') and the registered འབྱུང་བ = 'đại chủng'.
p0848, ×5, the stock example of the debate. No entry at all. Follows c249, which renders the same example 'âm thanh' throughout ('âm thanh là vô thường').

p0849. GAP. The established Sino-Vietnamese for 因三相. NOTE the cost: it puts ཚུལ onto 'tướng', which the glossary already flags as carrying མཚན་ཉིད, མཚན་མ and མཚན. 'ba phương diện của nhân' would avoid that; I chose the established form because the passage is formal pramāṇa theory. See flags.
p0847, ཁུངས་སུ་མཛད་པ་ཡིན་ནོ — the Nāgārjuna passage taken as the authority for the point. glossary.json has only compounds (ཁུངས་མ, ཁུངས་དག་པོ, ཁུངས་ཐུབ་པ).

terms.vi: chứng cứ (việc trưng dẫn chứng cứ)
terms.note: p0847. Follows the registered ཤེས་བྱེད་ཡང་དག་པ = 'chứng cứ chân chính' and its note, which records that bare ཤེས་བྱེད has no entry and that 'chứng cứ' is kept apart from ཚད་མ = lượng and སྒྲུབ་བྱེད = năng lập.
p0847. No entry for bare སྐྱེ་མཆེད (glossary has only སྐྱེ་མཆེད་དྲུག and ཅི་ཡང་མེད་པའི་སྐྱེ་མཆེད).
p0849, རྟོག་གེ་པ་དག་འདོད་པ་ལྟར་དོན་བྱེད་པ་ཁོ་ན — the logicians' criterion for svalakṣaṇa. Follows the registered དོན་བྱེད་པའི་ནུས་པ = 'năng lực tác dụng'; the bare verbal form has no entry.
p0849. Built on the registered དེ་ཁོ་ན / དེ་ཁོ་ན་ཉིད = 'thật tánh'; the compound with དོན has no entry.

p0848. Uses the registered སྤྱི = 'cái tổng quát' plus ཙམ; recorded because the whole Prasannapadā argument turns on the mere generality as against the ཁྱད་པར (sai biệt), and c249 renders the same contrast 'cái tổng quát chưa được làm thành sai biệt'.

p0848 l.1, x2, both inside Tsongkhapa's gloss (ནམ་མཁའི་ཡོན་ཏན་གཉིས and the re-quoted ནམ་མཁའི་ཡོན་ཏན་གྱི་སྒྲ་ཞེས་པ); the word does not occur inside the Prasannapada citation itself. Here it is the Vaisesika doxographic position that sound is a quality inhering in akasa, set opposite འབྱུང་གྱུར; 'công đức của hư không' would be positively wrong, merit does not enter the sentence. WORDING KEPT. Ruling owed: ཡོན་ཏན as guna/attribute in doxographic contexts -> 'phẩm tính', scoped apart from the fixed merit sense -> 'công đức'. Procedural fault acknowledged: departure made with no flag recorded.

terms.vi: bên tranh luận (các bên tranh luận) / bên lập luận / bên đối luận
terms.note: p0847 l.1 (ཕྱི་རྒོལ་ལ་བསྒྲུབ་པར་བྱ་བའི་ཕྱོགས), p0848 l.1 (རྒོལ་བ་དེ་དག, རྒོལ་བ་གཉིས་པོ་དེ་དག, and ཕྱི་རྒོལ་ལ་མ་གྲུབ ... སྔ་རྒོལ་གྱི་ཚད་མས་མི་འགྲུབ in one sentence), p0849 l.1 (རྒོལ་བ་གཉིས་ཀའི་རྒྱུད, ཕྱི་རྒོལ་གྱི་རྒྱུད). The view has only prov རྒོལ་བ -> 'vấn nạn', scoped by its own note to p0702 ལ་རྒོལ་བའི་དོན་མེད་དོ = 'lời vấn nạn', i.e. the speech-act sense, which cannot govern the debater sense running through all three pages. WORDING KEPT. Rule the three together: they stand side by side at p0848 l.1 and must stay distinguishable.

terms.vi: tự lập (nhân tự lập, hữu pháp tự lập); nhân (ba tướng của nhân)
terms.note: p0847 l.1 x2, p0849 l.1. Neither headword appears in the view. 'nhân tự lập' for svatantra-hetu matches standard Vietnamese usage; WORDING KEPT. The ruling must settle an internal collision: རྟགས is rendered 'nhân' while its own ཚུལ་གསུམ is rendered 'tướng', and 'tướng' is already the provisional Vietnamese for མཚན་ཉིད / མཚན་མ / མཚན (the view's མཚན line already asks for that three-way split). Decide together.

terms.vi: được thành lập trong sự hiện ra tương đồng
terms.note: p0847 l.1, x2 (མངོན་སུམ་མཐུན་སྣང་དུ་མ་གྲུབ་པས and མཐུན་སྣང་དུ་གྲུབ་པའི་ཆོས་ཅན). Load-bearing: this is the technical 'commonly appearing subject' on which the entire Svatantrika refutation turns, and it recurs in the following chunks. WORDING KEPT, but it should be registered once so it is not paraphrased differently later.

terms.vi: do đại chủng sinh ra; sắc xứ; chứng cứ
terms.note: འབྱུང་གྱུར p0848 l.1 (of sound, opposite ནམ་མཁའི་ཡོན་ཏན); གཟུགས་ཀྱི་སྐྱེ་མཆེད p0847 l.1; ཤེས་བྱེད p0847 l.1 (གཞུང་གི་ཤེས་བྱེད་བཀོད་པ -> 'trưng dẫn chứng cứ từ bản văn'). None has a headword in the view. All three are standard Sino-Vietnamese and consistent with the corpus. WORDING KEPT; entries owed.

terms.bo: རིགས་པ (predicative, ལན་དེ་ནི་རིགས་པ་མ་ཡིན་ནོ) vs འཐད་པ (མི་འཐད་པ) vs རུང་བ
terms.vi: chẳng đúng lý (vs 'chẳng hợp lý' for མི་འཐད་པ)
terms.note: p0847 l.1: མི་འཐད་པ and རིགས་པ་མ་ཡིན་ནོ stand in the SAME sentence. The view rules prov རིགས་པ (predicative) -> 'chẳng hợp lý', but that is also the corpus rendering of མི་འཐད་པ, so obeying it here would collapse the two words the sentence contrasts. 'đúng lý' is precisely the separating word the view's own note (line 298) proposes. WORDING KEPT. What is owed is the central ruling that splits འཐད་པ / རིགས་པ / རུང་བ once for the whole vipasyana section; the procedural fault is that the departure was not flagged.

p0813 l.5, འདི་ལ་ཛཱ་ཡ་ཨ་ནནྟ་ནི་འདི་ལྟར་སྨྲ་སྟེ. The Kashmiri paṇḍita, author of the Madhyamakāvatāraṭīkā (འཇུག་པའི་འགྲེལ་བཤད) quoted here and refuted through c243. Left in Sanskrit transcription, following the c005 precedent for Indian personal names with no established Sino-Vietnamese form (no 闍耶阿難陀 in use). His name recurs across this whole sub-section, so it needs pinning now.

p0816 l.1, ×2 (ཚུལ་གསུམ་ཚད་མས་གྲུབ་པའི་རྟགས / ཚུལ་གསུམ་ཁས་བླངས). The three modes of a valid reason. 'ba tướng' is the established Sino-Vietnamese (三相, with 因三相). Flagged rather than assumed: the view's མཚན entry already warns that 'tướng' carries མཚན, མཚན་ཉིད and མཚན་མ; ཚུལ is a fourth Tibetan word landing on it, and the view separately rules ཚུལ (in དབུ་མའི་ཚུལ) -> 'cách thức'. None of those three words occurs in this chunk, so there is no local collision.

terms.vi: cái năng lập / cái sở lập
terms.note: p0814 (རྒོལ་བས་སྒྲུབ་བྱེད་བཀོད་པའི་དུས), p0815 (×2). སྒྲུབ་བྱེད = 'cái năng lập' follows the registered prov entry (p0797). བསྒྲུབ་པར་བྱ་བ has no entry; 'cái sở lập' is the matching half of the pair and keeps the two visibly paired, as they are in the Tibetan.
Section heading ཐལ་རང་གཉིས་ཀྱི་འཇོག་ཚུལ (s244) and its restatement. No entry. Follows the corpus rendering of རྣམ་པར་འཇོག་པའི་ཚུལ = 'cách thức an lập' (c229).
Section heading s246 (p0813 l.11). Wording taken verbatim from c211, which renders the identical heading at p0705 the same way, so the two stay matched. The heading recurs again at p0840.

terms.vi: có ý nghĩa / có chỗ cùng tận
terms.note: p0816 l.3, inside the translators' quotation, ×2 each with their negatives དོན་མེད / ཐུག་མེད. The two absurdities of self-production in the Madhyamakāvatāra argument. No entry. Rendered plainly; 'mục đích' was avoided because the view fixes དགོས་པ -> 'mục đích' (p0474) and the Tibetan word here is དོན.

terms.vi: tỷ lượng [dựa vào điều] cực thành nơi người khác
terms.note: p0816 l.3, and the phrase གཞན་ལ་གྲགས་པའི་ཆོས that the chunk breaks off on. Built from the registered pieces — རྗེས་དཔག -> 'tỷ lượng' and གྲགས་པ (prasiddha) -> 'cực thành' — but it is a standing technical term of this whole section and should be registered as a compound so it does not drift in c243 and after. The bracketed [dựa vào điều] supplies what Vietnamese needs to parse the compound.

terms.kind: gap — no ruling in the view
terms.note: ~6× across p0814 l.1, p0815 l.1, p0816 l.1, incl. the abbreviated རྗེས་དཔག (p0815 l.1) and གཞན་གྲགས་ཀྱི་རྗེས་དཔག -> 'tỷ lượng [dựa vào điều] cực thành nơi người khác' (p0816 l.1). Standard Sino-Vietnamese; pairs with the view-clean ཚད་མ -> 'lượng' and མངོན་སུམ -> 'hiện lượng'.

terms.kind: gap — no ruling in the view
terms.note: p0815 l.1 ×2. Kept parallel with the view-clean སྒྲུབ་བྱེད -> 'cái năng lập' (năng/sở pair).

terms.kind: gap — no ruling in the view
terms.note: p0815 l.1, in མངོན་སུམ་དང་མི་དམིགས་པ་དག་གིས — the non-perception that pairs with perception in establishing vyāpti. Rendered descriptively rather than with a Sino-Vietnamese term ('bất khả đắc' / 'vô sở duyên' would both over-commit); a ruling is owed.

terms.vi: kẻ vấn nạn trước / kẻ vấn nạn sau
terms.kind: gap — no ruling in the view
terms.note: p0814 l.1, incl. the bare རྒོལ་བ ('kẻ vấn nạn') in the quotation itself. The proponent and the respondent in a debate. Note the corpus elsewhere uses 'người phản luận' for other disputant terms (c243, c257), so a ruling should fix which word goes where.

terms.kind: gap — no ruling in the view
terms.note: p0816 l.3, པཎྚི་ཏ་དེའི་སློབ་མ་ལོ་ཙཱ་བ་དག — the lo-tsā-bas who were Jayānanda's students. The view is clean on པཎྚི་ཏ -> 'paṇḍita'; ལོ་ཙཱ་བ is unregistered.

p0834 l.3 / p0835 l.1, cited by the Madhyamakāvatārabhāṣya as proof. Rendered literally from the view's prov ཡུམ -> 'Mẹ' (whose note deliberately rejects 'Phật mẫu' for the bare word). NOTE this leaves the Vietnamese opaque: no reader will recognise '*Kinh Mẹ*' as the Prajñāpāramitā. A ruling is owed — either the literal '*Kinh Mẹ*', or '*Kinh Bát-nhã*' / '*Kinh Phật Mẫu*'. I did NOT supply 'Bát-nhã', which the Tibetan does not write.

p0834 l.3, p0835 l.1, ×6, paired throughout with སུན་འབྱིན་པ (agent) -> 'cái phá trừ' and the contracted འབྱིན་བྱེད. Follows the view's prov སུན་འབྱིན -> 'phá trừ' (corpus-dominant, 35×) rather than the divergent 'bài xích' / 'đả phá' entries, which are scoped to ཉོན་མོངས་སུན་འབྱིན་པ. The whole passage turns on the object/agent pair, so both members are needed as an entry.

p0833 l.3, paired with དགག་བྱ -> 'cái phải phá bỏ' (view). Kept on the 'phá bỏ' stem so the negandum/negator pair stays matched, and deliberately apart from the སུན་འབྱིན pair ('phá trừ') which stands in the same section.

p0832–p0835, ~9× (ཕྱོགས་མེད་པ, བདག་དང་གཞན་གྱི་ཕྱོགས, ཁོ་བོ་ཅག་གི་ཕྱོགས, གཞན་ཕྱོགས, ཡོད་མེད་ལ་སོགས་པའི་ཕྱོགས). The view registers ཕྱོགས only as 'tông', scoped to ཕྱོགས་སུ་བྱས་ནས (p0753). 'tông' is unusable here because it collides with རང་ལུགས -> 'tự tông' (view) in the very same sentences — the whole argument is 'no ཕྱོགས' vs 'no རང་ལུགས'. 'lập trường' has c212/c213 precedent for the same debate.
p0832 l.1, དབུ་མ་པ་ལ་རྣམ་པ་ཐམས་ཅད་དུ་གླགས་མི་རྙེད་དོ. No entry. Corpus has 'kẽ hở' (c045, c165, c169) and 'sơ hở' (c016); followed the majority.

terms.vi: kham chịu được sự khảo xét
terms.note: p0834 l.3, རིགས་པས་བརྟག་བཟོད་དུ་འདོད་མི་དགོས་པ. No entry; built on the view's prov བརྟག་པ (in རིགས་པའི་བརྟག་པ) -> 'sự khảo xét'.

terms.vi: sự bị tinh diệu nắm giữ
terms.note: p0835 l.3, inside the verse: the marks visible on the sun's disc that also appear in its reflection. གཟའ is the planet/Rāhu and གཟས་བཟུང is the eclipse ('seized by Rāhu'). Rendered literally; 'nhật thực' or '[La-hầu]' would both supply what the Tibetan only implies. Ruling owed.
p0832 l.3 (×2), p0835 l.1 (མི་ཁེགས་པས). Deliberately distinct from འགོག་པ/བཀག་པ -> 'phá bỏ / phủ định' and from སུན་འབྱིན -> 'phá trừ'; all three stand within a few lines of each other here.

terms.vi: tự lập (lời lập tông tự lập)
terms.note: p0834 l.1. No entry for རང་རྒྱུད / svātantra anywhere in the view, although this term governs the whole Prāsaṅgika/Svātantrika section these chunks run through. 'tự lập' is corpus-dominant (42× across c211, c241-c244, c249-c253); wording KEPT. A central ruling is owed, and it should also say what རང་རྒྱུད་པ (the school name) takes.

The view records the split twice as load-bearing (ll.394-395, 436-437) but only as prov, and only for བརྟག་པ in the compound རིགས་པའི་བརྟག་པ. This chunk has all four shapes within four pages — རིགས་པའི་བརྟག་པ (p0834 l.3 ×2, p0835 l.3), རིགས་པས་བརྟག་བཟོད (p0834 l.3), དཔྱད་ནས (p0835 l.1), མ་བརྟགས་པར (p0835 l.1) — so the split needs registering as a rule over the ROOTS, not over one compound. I have brought the chunk onto བརྟག = khảo xét / དཔྱད = thẩm sát throughout.

p0833 l.1, Yuktiṣaṣṭikāvṛtti: དངོས་པོ་རྣམས་ཀྱི་རང་གི་མཚན་ཉིད་ ... ཡོངས་སུ་རྟོག་པར་བྱེད་པ་དེ་དག. The registered prov (view l.402, raised by the c243 repair) is 'chấp rằng', chosen as a NEUTRAL verb of imputing and scoped to a complement-taking use inside the Buddhapālita quotation. Here the verb takes a direct object, so the 'rằng' shape cannot apply. I trimmed 'chấp lấy' to bare 'chấp' so the stem matches; recording it so the pending central ruling on this headword covers both the complement shape and the transitive one (and so the ruling can decide whether a more neutral verb than 'chấp' — which still reads as grasping — is wanted for both).

NOT a translator error — the view prescribes གཏན་ཚིགས -> 'chánh lý' (l.125) and རིགས་པ -> 'chánh lý' (l.145), and both were followed. At p0835 l.3 they land in adjacent sentences: རིགས་པའི་བརྟག་པ -> 'sự khảo xét của chánh lý' and གཏན་ཚིགས་ཀྱིས་བསྒྲུབ་བྱ་འགྲུབ་པ -> 'cái phải thành lập được thành lập bằng chánh lý'. The second sentence is the paragraph's whole point — that Candrakīrti accepts a probative REASON establishing a probandum — and the shared word erases the hetu/yukti distinction it turns on. A central ruling is needed (e.g. གཏན་ཚིགས -> 'nhân' / 'chánh nhân', keeping རིགས་པ = 'chánh lý'); it would touch the whole Prāsaṅgika section, so I did not make the call at chunk level. Both renderings LEFT AS PRESCRIBED.
p0856 (སྔར་ཕྱོགས་སྔ་བསླངས་པ་ལྟར) and p0857 (ཕྱོགས་སྔ་གཏན་མ་གོ་བའོ). No entry in the view. 'tông trước' follows c245 (ཕྱོགས་སྔ་མ་མ་གོ་བར་སྨྲ་བ = 'nói mà chẳng hiểu tông trước') and c133.
p0857 l.1, the dharmin of Bhāvaviveka's own proof. No entry; built on c250's གཟུགས་ཀྱི་སྐྱེ་མཆེད = 'sắc xứ', so སྐྱེ་མཆེད = 'xứ'.

p0856, རགས་པ་དེ་འདྲ་བའི་ལྟག་ཆོད. GAP — no entry anywhere in the view, and I found no occurrence in the already-translated corpus. In debate usage ལྟག་ཆོད is a statement that cuts its own head off, i.e. a self-refuting/self-contradictory absurdity. Rendered descriptively rather than with a Sino-Vietnamese technical term; 'lỗi tự hại' or 'tự ngôn tương vi' are alternatives a ruling should weigh.

The Prasannapadā lemma Tsongkhapa is glossing (quoted whole on p0855: གང་གི་ཕྱིར་ཇི་སྐད་བསྙད་པའི་དོན་འདི་ནི་འདིས་རང་ཉིད་ཀྱིས་ཁས་བླངས་པ་ཡིན་ནོ). It is cited twice in this chunk as a bare lemma (p0856, p0857) and must read the same both times; c254 (part 1/2, which contains the full quote) is not yet translated, so this rendering needs to be matched there.
p0857 l.3. No entry; 'singling out specifically' — the point is that Candrakīrti restricts his statement to དངོས་པོའི་ཆོས, properties of real things.

terms.vi: người lập luận / người phản luận
terms.note: Text aligned to the view's prov (line 215). But the corpus is already split - 'người phản luận' x17, 'bên đối luận' x13, 'kẻ đối luận' x3 - so the prov needs elevating to fixed and a sweep run. Also unregistered: the bare second member ཕྱིར་རྒོལ alone (p0857 `ཕྱིར་རྒོལ་དེ་དག`), rendered 'những người phản luận ấy'.

p0857 `འདིར་སློབ་དཔོན་གྱིས་...ལ་དགོངས་ནས`. No ruling in the view. 'mật ý' was removed as a fabrication (it asserts 密意, concealed intent) and replaced with 'nhắm đến'. A ruling is needed because དགོངས has two distinct uses in this book: the plain 'have in mind / with reference to' (here) and དགོངས་པ as the Buddha's intent behind a provisional teaching (where 'mật ý' / 'ý thú' IS appropriate). One word must not serve both.

p0852, ཐལ་བ་པའི་རྗེས་སུ་ཞུགས་པ. Variant of ཐལ་འགྱུར་བ; corpus already uses 'nhà Ứng Thành' (c245, c250). No entry in the view for either form. Registering ཐལ་བ་པ specifically so it is not read as a different school.

terms.vi: cực thành đối với kẻ khác
terms.note: p0852, བསྒྲུབ་པའི་རྟགས་སྦྱོར་ཐམས་ཅད་གཞན་གྲགས་ཙམ་དུ་འགྱུར་བས. GAP — zero corpus precedent. Built on the view's prov གྲགས་པ (prasiddha) -> 'cực thành' and its འཇིག་རྟེན་གྱི་གྲགས་པ -> 'cực thành của thế gian', so the compound stays visibly the same word. Alternatives if the ruling goes otherwise: 'tha cực thành', 'điều chỉ kẻ khác thừa nhận'.

terms.vi: nhà chủ trương hành tướng chân thật
terms.note: p0852, སྔོན་པོ་ལ་སོགས་པ་རྣམ་བདེན་པ་འདོད་པ་ལྟར. GAP — no entry, no corpus precedent. Rendered descriptively from the view's prov རྣམ་པ -> 'hành tướng' (ākāra) + བདེན་པ, so it stays separable from the also-unregistered རྣམ་བརྫུན་པ (Alīkākāravādin) that will follow. A short Sino-Vietnamese form ('phái Hữu Tướng' / 'phái Chân Tướng') may be preferred; needs one ruling.

p0852, བསྒྲུབ་པའི་རྟགས་སྦྱོར་ཐམས་ཅད -> 'hết thảy luận thức dùng để chứng thành'. Follows c246 ('lời luận thức') and c241/c250 ('[luận thức] ứng thành / tự lập'). Note the collision the view already flags: bare རྟགས is rendered 'dấu hiệu' elsewhere (and once in this chunk, རྟགས་སུ -> 'làm dấu hiệu'), so the compound and the simplex now take unrelated Vietnamese words on purpose.

p0851, ཆོས་མང་དུ་སྤོང་བ་རྒྱའི་མཁན་པོ་ལྟར་གྱུར་པ. The Tibetan does NOT name Hashang here, so no name was supplied. Follows c007 and c032, which both write 'vị hòa thượng Trung Hoa tên Hashang' where the source does name him. Deliberately NOT the view's prov མཁན་པོ -> 'thân giáo sư' (upādhyāya), which is scoped to the Bodhisattvaprātimokṣa quotation.

p0851, བདེན་པར་ཡོད་པར་འཛིན་པ་མངོན་གྱུར་བ — manifest, as opposed to latent/seed-state, apprehension of true existence. No entry. 'hiện hành' has heavy corpus precedent (c200–c204, ~24×) but always inside ཉོན་མོངས་མངོན་གྱུར; the ruling should say whether it covers the bare qualifier.

p0852, 3×. The c253 view has no entry for རང་རྒྱུད in any form. Wording KEPT — corpus-consistent ('nhân tự lập' ×9, 'Tự Lập' ×23 in translation/). The ruling must also settle རྟགས in its logical sense ('nhân') against རྟགས as sign ('dấu hiệu'), both of which occur in this same chunk (p0850 ལོག་པར་གོ་བའི་རྟགས་སུ -> 'Làm dấu hiệu'), and register རྟགས་སྦྱོར -> 'luận thức' (p0852).

terms.vi: Cách thức [lỗi ấy] chẳng ngang bằng nơi chính mình
terms.note: Sa-bcad 6.2.3.1.11.2.6.2.1.1.3.2.2.1.1.2.2 (p0858). མི་མཚུངས་པ = the fault alleged against the opponent does not apply equally to the Prāsaṅgika himself. '[lỗi ấy]' is supplied; the Tibetan heading has no explicit subject.
p0858 l5 ×2, p0859 l1 (Prasannapadā, as རང་རྒྱུད་ཀྱི་རྗེས་སུ་དཔག་པ). Compound of རང་རྒྱུད + the view's prov རྗེས་དཔག = 'tỷ lượng'. The chunk itself glosses it: འདིར་རྗེས་དཔག་རྣམས་ནི་སྦྱོར་བ་ལ་བྱའོ།

terms.vi: tỷ lượng cực thành đối với kẻ khác
terms.note: p0859 l1 ×2, and the paired རང་ལ་གྲགས་པའི་རྗེས་སུ་དཔག་པ = 'tỷ lượng cực thành đối với chính mình' (p0860 l1). Built on the view's prov གྲགས་པ (prasiddha) = 'cực thành'. This is the standing name for the Prāsaṅgika proof-form and will recur; a fixed entry is owed. Also གཞན་གྲགས་ཀྱི་སྦྱོར་ངག (p0860 l3) = 'lời luận thức cực thành đối với kẻ khác', and གཞན་ལ་གྲགས་པའམ་གཞན་ལ་གྲུབ་པ (p0860 l3) = 'cực thành đối với kẻ khác' hay 'thành lập nơi kẻ khác'.

FOURTH scoped sense. The view registers སྦྱོར་བ = 'gia hành' (prayoga, the བསམ་པ་དང་སྦྱོར་བ pair), 'việc gia hành' (BCA verse) and 'sự kết hợp' (conjunction of atoms) — none reaches this. Here (p0858 l5, p0859 l1 ×3) it is the formal proof-statement, and the text explicitly equates it with རྗེས་དཔག. 'luận thức' follows c250 L32 (for the same word at p0843) and c246. Related: སྦྱོར་ངག (p0860 l3) = 'lời luận thức', per c246.
p0858 l5, གཞན་ལ་བརྒལ་བར་མི་བྱའོ. No entry. Follows c146, c213, c245, which all render the challenge/objection sense 'bắt bẻ'. Kept apart from རྒོལ་བ = 'vấn nạn' (view) and སུན་འབྱིན = 'phá bỏ'.
p0858 l1, མཐར་གཏུགས་པའི་སྒྲུབ་བྱེད = 'cái năng lập rốt ráo'. No entry.

terms.vi: Cái thấy ấy, đối với tự thể của chính nó, / Chính là chẳng phải cái thấy; / Cái nào mà chẳng thấy chính mình, / Thì cái ấy làm sao thấy được những cái khác?
terms.note: p0859 l1, cited as རྩ་ཤེའི་རབ་བྱེད་གསུམ་པ = 'phẩm thứ ba của Căn Bản Trung Luận' (uses the view's prov རྩ་ཤེ = Căn Bản Trung Luận and རབ་བྱེད = phẩm). First occurrence of this verse; recording the wording so later citations match. Note this edition reads ལྟ་དེ་ where the common Tibetan MMK reads ལྟ་བ་དེ་ནི — translated as printed.

terms.vi: bên tranh luận / bên đối luận / bên lập luận
terms.note: Disputant vocabulary — the PARTIES, not the objection. རྒོལ་བ p0858 l.5 -> 'bên tranh luận'; ཕྱི་རྒོལ -> 'bên đối luận' and སྔ་རྒོལ -> 'bên lập luận', both p0860 l.1. The view registers only 'prov རྒོལ་བ -> vấn nạn', whose own note scopes it to …ལ་རྒོལ་བའི་དོན་མེད་དོ = 'lời vấn nạn', i.e. the objection. Wording kept and matched to c250/c252/c254; a scoped entry is owed since these three name the parties for the rest of the section.

p0865 l.3. GAP — no headword in the view and zero corpus precedent ('tông pháp' occurs 0× in translation/). First of the three modes of a valid reason (trairūpya). 'tông pháp' is the established Sino-Vietnamese (宗法).

terms.bo: ཚུལ (mode of a valid reason: ཚུལ་གཉིས, ཚུལ་གསུམ)
terms.note: p0865 l.3, ×3. GAP in the view, but c249 L18 already renders ཚུལ་གསུམ་པའི་རྟགས (p0839) as 'cái nhân đủ ba tướng', so this follows the one existing precedent. Deliberately NOT the view's ཚུལ = 'cách thức' (registered for དབུ་མའི་ཚུལ), which would be wrong for the technical trairūpya.

p0865 l.3 (དེའི་རྟེན་གཏན་ཚིགས), p0866 l.3 inside the Prasannapadā quotation (རང་ཉིད་ལ་གྲུབ་པའི་གཏན་ཚིགས). The view's only entry is prov གཏན་ཚིགས -> 'chánh lý', scoped by its own note to the triad thí dụ / chánh lý / giáo chứng — unusable here, where 'chánh lý' is the corpus word for རིགས་པ. Second scoped sense needed.

p0865 l.3. GAP. Built from two rulings already in the view: གྲགས་པ (prasiddha) -> 'cực thành' (c226) and སྦྱོར་བ as the syllogism, matching c241's '[luận thức] ứng thành / tự lập' for ཐལ་འགྱུར / རང་རྒྱུད. The descriptive phrase གཞན་ལ་གྲགས་པ at p0866 l.3 is rendered 'cái cực thành đối với kẻ khác' — same root word, different Tibetan form, kept visibly related.

terms.vi: cái năng thiêu / cái sở thiêu
terms.note: p0864 l.3, ×2 each. GAP. Follows the năng/sở pattern already used in c212 for བསྐྱེད་བྱ་སྐྱེད་བྱེད = 'cái sở sinh và cái năng sinh'. The pair must stay separable because the whole argument turns on swapping them ('lửa là cái sở thiêu, còn củi là cái năng thiêu').
p0864 l.3, ×7; p0865–p0866, ×5. GAP. The fire/fuel example that carries this whole passage.
p0866 l.3, inside the Prasannapadā quotation (དཔང་པོ… ཚད་མར་བྱས་པའི་ཚིག). GAP, no entry and no corpus precedent.
p0866 l.3. GAP. Built on the view's prov སྒྲུབ་བྱེད་ཀྱི་ཚད་མ -> 'lượng năng thành' plus དོན = nghĩa, and on the bare ཚད་མ -> 'lượng' ruling requested at c226/c223.
p0866 l.3, inside the Prasannapadā quotation. Combines the view's prov བསྟན་བཅོས -> 'bộ luận' with prov རིགས་པ -> 'chánh lý'.

terms.bo: འཕེན་པ (logical sense: to hurl an unwanted consequence)
terms.note: p0866 l.1, ཕ་རོལ་པོ་ལ་མི་འདོད་པ་འཕེན་པ. The view registers འཕེན་པ twice — the karma sense (ākṣepaka, 'dẫn phát / dẫn nghiệp') and the p0195 'mental thrust of offering sent forth'. This is a third sense: what a prāsaṅga does to the opponent. Wording kept as 'dẫn phát' so the three stay recognisably one Tibetan word; a scoped entry is owed.

terms.bo: རུང་བ (in རྟགས་སུ་རུང་བ, 'fit to serve as X')
terms.kind: construction not covered by the recorded provisional
terms.note: Text CHANGED to 'khả dĩ dùng làm nhân' to respect prov རུང་བ -> 'khả dĩ'. The 'fit to serve as X' construction (རྟགས་སུ་རུང་བ) is arguably a second, scoped sense; if a distinct form such as 'kham dùng' is wanted for it, that needs a scoped entry. Kept apart from འཐད་པ -> 'hợp lý', which this chunk uses correctly 3x.
p0865 l.3. c246 has 'tông pháp'.

terms.kind: gap - first occurrence in the corpus
terms.note: p0864 l.3, paired with བསྲེག་བྱ. Sino-Vietnamese năng/sở pair chosen to keep the agent/patient contrast visible, which the Catuhsataka argument turns on.

terms.kind: gap - first occurrence in the corpus
terms.note: p0864 l.3, paired with སྲེག་བྱེད.

p0867 l.1, inside the Prasannapadā quotation. GAP — no entry. Coined to match c249's already-used 'tỷ lượng vì kẻ khác' for གཞན་གྱི་དོན་གྱི་རྗེས་སུ་དཔག་པ (parārthānumāna), so the standard pair stays visibly matched. If a ruling prefers the Sino-Vietnamese 'vị tự tỷ lượng / vị tha tỷ lượng', both chunks must move together.

p0867 l.1, Prasannapadā: a proof-statement or a refutation-statement in debate. The view already carries THREE renderings of this headword, each scoped elsewhere: 'phá trừ' (bare, c094), 'bài xích' (in ཉོན་མོངས་སུན་འབྱིན་པ, p0337), 'đả phá' (p0350) — all in the affliction/undermining sense, none usable for the debate-logic sense. 'phá bác' follows the immediately preceding chunk c258 L35, which renders Tsongkhapa's own gloss of this same passage as '[lời] phá bác chủ trương của các nhà lý luận'. A fourth rendering is not desirable; one ruling should cover all four.

p0867 l.1. The view rules སྒྲུབ་པ only in the practice sense (sự thực hành / sự tu tập, from c131/c134) — unusable here, where it is the proof-statement paired with dūṣaṇa. Kept as the plain verbal noun 'sự thành lập', consistent with this chunk's བསྒྲུབ་བྱ = 'cái sở lập' and with c258's སྒྲུབ་བྱེད་ཀྱི་ཚད་མ = 'lượng năng thành'. A ruling should say whether the debate pair takes the Sino-Vietnamese 'năng lập / năng phá'.
