p0867 l.1, རྟོག་གེའི་མཚན་ཉིད་བརྗོད་པ. No entry. Follows the corpus, which already renders the agentive རྟོག་གེ་པ as 'nhà luận lý' (c222 L55) / 'các nhà lý luận' (c213, c258 L35). Registering the bare noun so the two stay tied.
p0867 l.1, རང་ལ་གྲུབ་པ་ཉིད་བརླིང་བ་ཡིན. No entry anywhere in the view. Plain rendering of 'weighty / firm / decisive'.

terms.bo: ཐལ་འགྱུར་བ (as a classification of the argument-type, in ཐལ་འགྱུར་བར་འཇོག་པ)
terms.note: p0867 l.1. 'phái' is bracketed as supplied. The view records ཐལ་འགྱུར་བ -> 'Ứng Thành' (p0696) for the school and ཐལ་རང -> '[luận thức] ứng thành hay [luận thức] tự lập' for the argument-types, and c258 uses '[luận thức] ứng thành' for bare ཐལ་འགྱུར. Here the Tibetan itself is uneven: the first member of the pair is རང་རྒྱུད་ཀྱི་རྟགས (an autonomous REASON) while the second carries the agentive བ (a Prāsaṅgika PERSON/school). Rendered as the school because the whole passage is deciding what makes a master one or the other, and the next section immediately says ཐལ་འགྱུར་བའི་ལུགས. See flag.

terms.vi: thể tánh (được thành lập bằng thể tánh của chính nó)
terms.note: p0868 l.1. The view rules ངོ་བོ -> 'thể tánh' and ངོ་བོ་ཉིད -> 'Thể tánh' separately, and registers རང་གི་ངོ་བོས་གྲུབ་པ -> 'thành lập bằng thể tánh của chính nó'. This line writes ངོ་བོ་ཉིད་ཀྱིས where the very next line (p0868 l.1) writes ངོ་བོས — the two Tibetan forms therefore land on one Vietnamese phrase in a single paragraph. The collapse is deliberate (following c258, which uses the same phrase throughout); recording it so Phase 5 does not read it as drift.
p0868 l.1, འཕགས་པ་ཡབ་སྲས་ཀྱི་གཞུང་རྣམས་དང་ཤིན་ཏུ་འགྲིག་པར་མཐོང་བས. No entry. Plain rendering ('accord with').

terms.bo: སུན་འབྱིན་པ (bare, paired with སྒྲུབ་པ as sādhana/dūṣaṇa)
terms.note: p0867 l.1, སྒྲུབ་པའམ་སུན་འབྱིན་པ. Text has been aligned to 'phá trừ' per the view's prov སུན་འབྱིན (bare) -> phá trừ, but the view carries three different provisionals for the same headword — phá trừ (c094), bài xích (p0337, ཉོན་མོངས་སུན་འབྱིན་པ), đả phá (p0350) — and all three notes ask for a central ruling. This occurrence is a fourth context: the logician's pair 'proof or refutation', not affliction-repudiation. A scoped ruling is owed: logic-pair སྒྲུབ་པའམ་སུན་འབྱིན་པ -> 'thành lập hay phá trừ' as a standing doublet, separate from whatever the affliction sense settles on. It will recur throughout the Prāsaṅgika/Svātantrika section.

terms.vi: tỷ lượng (rang gi don gyi ... -> tỷ lượng vì chính mình)
terms.note: p0867 l.1, ×2. No headword anywhere in the view. 'tỷ lượng' (比量) is the established Sino-Vietnamese and is coherent with the view's prov ཚད་མ -> lượng (bare epistemic sense, itself still unruled at line 307). anumāna recurs through the whole Prāsaṅgika section, so it should be registered together with that ཚད་མ ruling: ཚད་མ -> lượng, རྗེས་སུ་དཔག་པ -> tỷ lượng, and whether the compound རང་གི་དོན་གྱི་རྗེས་སུ་དཔག་པ (svārthānumāna) gets its own fixed form 'tỷ lượng vì chính mình' vs. the Sino-Vietnamese 'tự nghĩa tỷ lượng'.

p0867 l.1, ×2 (གཉིས་ཀ་ལ་གྲུབ་པའི་རྟགས, རང་རྒྱུད་ཀྱི་རྟགས). No entry. 'nhân' (因) is the standard Sino-Vietnamese for the logical sign and is used consistently here ('cái nhân đã thành lập', 'nhân tự lập'). The view registers only the abbreviation ཐལ་རང -> ứng thành / tự lập (lines 301, 305), not the full རང་རྒྱུད་ཀྱི་རྟགས, so 'nhân tự lập' was formed from that abbreviation's ruling. Should be registered alongside ཚུལ་གསུམ and བསྒྲུབ་བྱ (-> 'cái sở lập', also unlisted), since the three are the standing vocabulary of every svātantra/prāsaṅga argument from here to the end of the section.

p0867 l.1, ཕྱི་རྒོལ་གཞན་ལ་གྲགས་པ. No entry. Should be ruled together with རྒོལ་བ་གཉིས་ཀ (rendered 'hai bên tranh luận' at L15 in this chunk), so the opponent/proponent pair stays separable: candidates 'người lập luận' / 'người phản luận', or the Sino-Vietnamese 'lập luận giả' / 'địch luận giả'.

terms.bo: གྲགས་པ (prasiddha sense: renowned to / established for)
terms.kind: not a violation — three-way split in the view needs collapsing
terms.note: p0867 l.1, ×2 (རང་ལ་ཇི་ལྟར་གྲགས་པའི་འཐད་པ, ཕྱི་རྒོལ་གཞན་ལ་གྲགས་པ). The chunk used 'cực thành', matching the view's prov གྲགས་པ (prasiddha) -> cực thành (lines 337, 341). But the view also carries prov གྲགས་པ -> danh tiếng (fame sense, line 259) and prov གྲགས་པ (renowned sense) -> quen thuộc (line 345) for what is the same technical sense as this one. Not a translator error: the chunk picked the dominant and best-attested reading. The defect is in the glossary — the prasiddha sense needs ONE form (recommend 'cực thành', 極成, already used across c226 and here), with 'danh tiếng' scoped explicitly to the fame sense and 'quen thuộc' retired or scoped to འཇིག་རྟེན་ན་གང་གྲགས-type lokaprasiddha only.

p0863 l.1, ཟླ་བའི་ཞབས་ཀྱི་ལུགས. Honorific of Candrakīrti ('the feet of Candra'). No entry; the view has ཟླ་བ་གྲགས་པ = Nguyệt Xứng and prov ཟླ་བ -> 'A-xà-lê Nguyệt [Xứng]'. I rendered ཞབས by the honorific 'ngài' rather than literally (a calque 'Nguyệt Túc' has zero corpus precedent and reads opaquely), and bracketed [Xứng] because གྲགས་པ is not in the Tibetan. It recurs at p0884, so it should be pinned.

གཞན་གྲགས་ཀྱི་སྦྱོར་བ (p0861 ×2) -> 'luận thức cực thành nơi người khác'. FOURTH scoped sense: the view registers སྦྱོར་བ = 'gia hành' (prayoga, scoped to the བསམ་པ་དང་སྦྱོར་བ pair), 'việc gia hành' (BCA verse), and 'sự kết hợp' (conjunction of atoms). 'luận thức' follows c211/c241/c242/c250. NOTE the same chunk also has སྦྱོར་བ in the ordinary sense at p0863 l.3 (སྐབས་ཀྱི་དོན་ལ་སྦྱོར་བ = 'phần áp dụng vào ý nghĩa của trường hợp'), so a fifth sense stands twenty lines away.

terms.vi: cái làm hại và cái bị làm hại
terms.note: p0861. Consistent with the view's ruled epistemic གནོད་པ -> 'làm hại' (c226/c227) and with c135 L23; deliberately NOT the view's གནོད་བྱེད -> 'điều phá bác' (p0687) nor 'điều làm hại' (c220/s236), both of which render the same word elsewhere. Three renderings of གནོད་བྱེད now stand in the corpus; one ruling is owed.

p0862 l.1, དེའི་ཟླ་བོ་སུ་ཞིག་གིས་བྱེད — 'who would act as his match/partner [in debate]?'. No entry; unrelated to ཟླ་བ = Candra. 'tranh biện' is supplied from the context (བརྩད་པ stands in the immediately preceding clause).
p0863 l.3. Combines the view's `prov བུད་དྷ་པཱ་ལི་ཏ -> *Buddhapālita*` (the commentary cited as a text) with `prov འགྲེལ་པ -> bản Thích`.

p0863 l.3, ×2 — the Buddhapālita example (a garment scented by the flower it is kept with). Identified as a jasmine (Skt. sumanā). Northern register spelling 'nhài' rather than 'lài'. See flags: the identification is not certain and the argument does not turn on the species.

p0863 l.1, རང་གི་ངོ་བོས་གྲུབ་པའི་ལྟ་བ་ཡོད་པར་འགལ་བ — here ལྟ་བ is the eye's ACT of looking, not the view. It stands one clause after ...རྟོགས་པའི་ལྟ་བ་རྙེད་པ, where the same word is the view (the view's `prov ལྟ་བ -> kiến`). Both senses inside one sentence, so the split is load-bearing; a scoped entry is owed.

terms.vi: hợp lý / — (collision, needs one distinct word)
terms.note: Now that འཐད་པ is brought back to the recorded 'hợp lý', both `མི་འཐད་ལ` and `མི་རིགས་ཏེ` land on 'chẳng hợp lý' inside one sentence (p0862 l.3). This is exactly the collision the view flags at lines 287 and 334-335 and it is now visible in a single sentence. A ruling is owed: keep འཐད་པ -> 'hợp lý' and give predicative རིགས་པ a separate word ('đúng lý' / 'thành hợp lý'), or vice versa. I did NOT resolve it unilaterally this time.

terms.vi: tông (རང་གི་ལུགས -> tự tông; ཁོའི་ལུགས -> tông của vị ấy; ཟླ་བའི་ཞབས་ཀྱི་ལུགས -> tông của ngài Nguyệt [Xứng]); ཁྱབ་ལུགས -> cách thức chu biến
terms.note: View lines 260-261 record `prov ལུགས -> chủ trương` with its own note 'GAP — bare ལུགས has no entry'. 'chủ trương' is spoken for by `འདོད་པ` in these same sentences (`ཡོད་པར་འདོད་པས`, `མི་འགལ་བར་འདོད་པས`); 'tự tông' for རང་གི་ལུགས has 17-file corpus precedent. Wording KEPT.

p0862 l.3. The view's ཚད་མ note (line 275) records the compound as 'lượng năng thành'; `prov སྒྲུབ་བྱེད -> cái năng lập` (line 337). The glossary contradicts itself; the translator followed the སྒྲུབ་བྱེད headword. One ruling on the compound is needed, not a chunk-level edit. Wording KEPT.

terms.vi: cái làm hại và cái bị làm hại
terms.note: p0861, `དེ་གཉིས་གནོད་བྱེད་དང་གནོད་བྱར་ག་ལ་རུང`. The view carries two conflicting prov entries for གནོད་བྱེད — 'điều phá bác' (line 279) and 'điều làm hại' (line 330). The wording used matches the c135/c220/c225-c229 precedent recorded at view line 297 ('bị chánh lý làm hại' for རིགས་པས་གནོད་པ, used correctly throughout this chunk). Wording KEPT.

p0861 ×2, p0862 l.3. No entry in the view. Matches c242 and the view's own prasiddha -> 'cực thành' notes at lines 314/318, which are themselves recorded as unresolved gaps. Wording KEPT; one ruling should cover གྲགས་པ (prasiddha), གཞན་གྲགས and འཇིག་རྟེན་གྱི་གྲགས་པ together.

p0861 `གཞན་གྲགས་ཀྱི་སྦྱོར་བ`, p0861 `སྦྱོར་བའི་ཆོས་ཅན`. The view registers three senses — 'gia hành', 'sự kết hợp', 'việc gia hành' — none of which is the logical syllogism. 'luận thức' has 11-file precedent. Wording KEPT; a fourth scoped sense is owed.

terms.bo: ལྟ་བ (act of seeing, of the eye)
terms.note: p0861-p0863, throughout (`སྔོ་སོགས་ལ་བལྟ་བ`, `ལྟ་བའི་རང་བཞིན`). The view registers only `prov ལྟ་བ -> kiến` [dṛṣṭi]. The chunk keeps the two senses apart — 'kiến' for `རང་བཞིན་མེད་པར་རྟོགས་པའི་ལྟ་བ` (p0863 l.1), 'cái nhìn' for the eye's seeing — but the split is unregistered. Wording KEPT.

terms.vi: chứng ngộ (with a suchness-type object) / hiểu (with ལུགས as object)
terms.note: p0863 l.1 has both: `རང་བཞིན་མེད་པར་རྟོགས་པའི་ལྟ་བ` -> 'cái kiến chứng ngộ ... vô tự tánh' (kept) and `ལུགས་རྟོགས་པར་འདོད་ན` -> now 'muốn hiểu' (fixed). The view has no bare རྟོགས་པ entry. A ruling should record that the object governs the strength: doctrinal reality -> 'chứng ngộ', a system/position -> 'hiểu / lãnh hội'.

The chariot of the sevenfold analysis, which is what this whole section (dpe dgod pa) is about; occurs ~30x in these four pages. glossary view registers only ཤིང་རྟ་ཆེན་པོ = 'bậc Đại Xa'. 'cỗ xe' follows c210, which already renders ཤིང་རྟ this way twice inside a Madhyamakāvatāra-bhāṣya quotation ('ví như khi cỗ xe bị thiêu cháy thì các chi phần của nó, như bánh xe v.v., cũng đều cháy'). No new wording; registration requested so the section headword is pinned before c260/c262 are translated.

p0876, in the MAv verse ཡན་ལག་ཅན་མེད་དེའི་ཡན་ལག་ཀྱང་མེད, and p0873 ཚོགས་པ་ཅན rendered in parallel as 'cái có sự tụ hội'. No entry. Deliberately kept as a transparent phrase so its morphological link to ཡན་ལག = 'chi phần' stays visible; 'toàn thể' would assert a Vietnamese abstraction the Tibetan does not use.

GAP — no entry, yet it is the pivot of these four pages (~18x): the opponent's claim that the chariot IS the shape of the assembled parts. 'hình dạng' kept deliberately plain and distinct from གཟུགས = 'sắc' (rūpa) and from the 'tướng' cluster (མཚན་ཉིད / མཚན་མ / མཚན), which the glossary already asks to be split three ways.
p0873, p0876. The chariot's wheel; p0869 lists the parts as སྲོག་ཤིང་དང་འཁོར་ལོ, so འཕང་ལོ and འཁོར་ལོ are the same referent here. Follows c210's 'bánh xe'.

p0873, paired with འཕང་ལོ in the list of chariot parts introduced at p0869 (ཤིང་རྟའི་ཡན་ལག་ནི་སྲོག་ཤིང་དང་འཁོར་ལོ). No entry. Literally 'life-wood' = the axle/centre pole. Flagged: 'trục xe' is my reading of the referent, not a literal rendering.

The sevenfold reasoning (one, different, possessing, dependent, depended-on, mere collection, shape) by which the chariot is sought; 5x here (རྣམ་པ་བདུན་གྱི་སྒོ་ནས, རྣམ་པ་བདུན་གྱིས་འགྲུབ, བདུན་པོ་དེ). Introduced at p0869 (in c260, not yet translated), so this fixes it. Note it collides with the view's prov རྣམ་པ -> 'hành tướng' (ākāra) and 'các loại' (kinds) — this is a third, enumerative use.

p0873 ×2. No entry. Matches c210's 'cơ sở để giả danh là ngã' for the same term inside a Prasannapadā quotation, and keeps the pair visible with བཏགས་ཡོད = 'giả hữu' (registered). Deliberately NOT using 'sở y'/'thân y', the two registered renderings of རྟེན, since གཞི is a different word.

p0873, the counterpart of གདགས་གཞི in the same sentence (ཤིང་རྟ་ནི་དེ་ལ་བཏགས་པའི་བཏགས་ཆོས་ཡིན). No entry. Renders ཆོས here as the imputed property/entity; note this is a sense the SET ruling on ཆོས (pháp | Pháp | giáo pháp) does not obviously cover, and it takes the lowercase 'pháp' variant.

p0874 ×2, གཟུགས་ལ་སོགས་པའི་རྡུལ་བརྒྱད་འདུས་པ — the Abhidharma eight-substance atom, whose mere aggregation the opponent posits as the pot. No entry. Kept distinct from རྫས = 'thật thể' (registered), which stands in the very same sentence (རྡུལ་བརྒྱད་རྫས་སུ་གྲུབ་པ).
p0876, སྣམ་བུ་ཚིག་པའི་ཐལ་བ་ལ་སྣལ་མ་ཚོལ་བ — the burnt-blanket simile. No entry.
p0876, same simile: the threads sought in the ashes of the burnt woollen cloth. No entry.

p0876, MAv verse དེ་ནི་དེ་ཉིད་དུ་འམ་འཇིག་རྟེན་དུ. No entry for the short form. 'thật tánh' is the corpus rendering of དེ་ཁོ་ན་ཉིད throughout c201–c209, so the same word is used; recorded because tattva and tathatā are not the same word and a ruling should say whether the corpus 'thật tánh' is meant to cover both.

p0874, དབྱིབས་ཁྱད་པར་བ = 'hình dạng đặc thù'. Third sense of the ཁྱད་པར family standing in this one chunk, alongside the registered 'định ngữ' (viśeṣaṇa, used at p0874 ཁྱད་པར་སྦྱར) and 'sai biệt' (viśeṣa, used at p0873 ཁྱད་པར་གཞན་ཞིག). All three are in the view; recorded so the co-occurrence is deliberate.

p0875 (ཐ་སྙད་འདོགས་པ་རྣམས་བྱར་མེད་པར་འགྱུར) and p0876 (ཐ་སྙད་པའི་རྣམ་གཞག་ཐམས་ཅད་བྱར་མེད་པའི་སྐྱོན). No entry. The consequence the opponent charges the Mādhyamika with: conventional usage becomes unworkable. Same Vietnamese used for both occurrences so the charge and its restatement are visibly the same.

p0875, ཤིང་རྟ་འོན་ཅིག ཉོས་ཤིག ཆོས་ཤིག — the three worldly imperatives about a chariot. Read as the imperative of འཆོས་པ 'to make / fashion / repair'. Flagged: the reading is mine, and ཆོས here is emphatically NOT the dharma-word, so a reader sweeping for ཆོས must not touch it.
p0873 l.1 `དབྱིབས་སུ་འདོགས་པ`, p0876 l.1 `བརྟེན་ནས་འདོགས་པ་ཡིན`. Verbal 'to designate/impute', rendered 'giả danh' consistently with `བཏགས་ཡོད` -> 'giả hữu'.

SCOPE REQUEST, not a fresh word. The view registers ཡན་ལག -> 'chi' (limb of the seven-limb practice), ཡན་ལག (bodily limb) -> 'chi phần', and ཡན་ལག (of śamatha) -> 'chi phần'. Here it is the parts of an artefact. 'chi phần' kept, matching c210 which already renders this exact chariot example that way.

terms.vi: chỉ thuần là cái được giả danh
terms.note: p0869 l.3, closing the MAv VI.151 gloss. Follows the corpus split already in force: བཏགས་པ / གདགས་པ in the designation sense = 'giả danh' (c239, c248), as against the superimposition sense = 'gán đặt' (c235-c237).
p0870 l.1, second reason against the chariot being substantially separate from its parts.

terms.bo: ཚོགས་པ / འདུས་པ (of the parts of a thing)
terms.note: p0869-p0872, ~15×; the sixth member of the sevenfold analysis. THIRD scoped sense of ཚོགས/ཚོགས་པ: the view already carries ཚོགས -> 'tư lương' (saṃbhāra), ཚོགས (assembly/host) -> 'các việc', and ཚོགས (assemblage of causes) -> 'tổ hợp' [sāmagrī]. Here it is the assembled parts of an artefact, deliberately kept apart from the causal 'tổ hợp'.
p0870 l.1, same list.
p0870 l.1, འཁར་གཞོང་ལ་ཞོ་གནས་པ — the container in the support/supported example.
p0870 l.1. COLLISION with the view's prov ཞོ -> 'zho' (the gold-weight unit at p0192). Here ཞོ sits in a bowl, so it is curds/yogurt. A scoped entry is needed for each sense.

p0870 l.1, རེ་ལྡེ་ལ་ལྷ་སྦྱིན་གནས་པ — what Devadatta sits on in the supported/support example. UNCERTAIN: the word also appears at p0906 inside the MAv VI.166 list བུམ་པ་སྣམ་བུ་རེ་ལྡེ་དམག་དང་ནགས་ཚལ, where it is a woven/felted article beside 'cloth'. 'tấm thảm' is a best reading, not a settled one — see flags.
p0870 l.1, ×3: ལྷ་སྦྱིན་...བ་ལང་དག་དང་ལྡན་པ — the separable-possession example.

p0870 l.1, བྱེད་པ་པོ་དང་བྱ་བའི་ལས་ཀྱང་གཅིག་ཏུ་འགྱུར་བ. Paired with the view's registered བྱེད་པ་པོ -> 'kẻ tạo tác' [kāraka/kartṛ]. ལས here is the agent's object, NOT karma; rendering it 'nghiệp' per the fixed entry would destroy the argument. Scoped exception needed — see flags.

p0870-p0871, ×5 (རྟེན་དང་བརྟེན་པའི་ཕྱོགས་གཉིས, ལྡན་པའི་ཕྱོགས, ཕྱོགས་ལྷག་མ་གཉིས, རང་བཞིན་གཅིག་པའི་ཕྱོགས) — the members of the sevenfold analysis. The view registers ཕྱོགས only as 'tông' inside ཕྱོགས་སུ་བྱས་ནས (p0753). 'lập trường' follows c247/c248.
p0871 l.3 (verse and prose), the parts lying dismantled. Paired in the chunk with ཕྲལ་བ -> 'tháo rời' and བསྒྲིགས་པ -> 'lắp ráp'.
p0872, ~7×, the assembling of the chariot parts; its opposite ཕྲལ་བ / བྱེ་བར་གྱུར་པ is rendered 'tháo rời' / 'rời ra'.

terms.vi: sự sai biệt của danh xưng
terms.note: p0869 l.3, third of the four sub-topics (མིང་གི་ཁྱད་པར་གྱི་སྒོ་ནས་གྲུབ་པའི་ཚུལ), and a printed sa-bcad heading at p0904. Uses the view's ཁྱད་པར (distinguishing-feature sense) -> 'sai biệt' rather than its 'định ngữ' sense. The section itself lies outside this chunk, so the heading wording should be fixed centrally before c26x-c27x reach it.

p0869 l.3, inside the sūtra verse quoted in the Madhyamakāvatārabhāṣya. The view's prov འདུ་བྱེད -> 'hành' asks for a ruling that keeps the bare term distinct from འདུ་བྱེད་ཀྱི་ཕུང་པོ; this is that compound, spelled without ཀྱི.
p0869 l.3, second of the four sub-topics; also a printed sa-bcad heading later in this section. 'đoạn trừ' rather than 'khước bỏ', which the view fixes to ཆོས་སྤོང་བ only.

terms.bo: ཚོགས་པ (sense: sāmagrī, the mere assemblage of parts / of aggregates as the imputation-basis)
terms.kind: scoping / drift from a scoped provisional
terms.note: WORDING KEPT. The view's only ཚོགས་པ entry is prov 'sự tụ hội', scoped by its own note to p0734 inside the Buddhapālita quotation (རྒྱུ་དང་འབྲས་བུ་དང་ཚོགས་པའང་མེད་ན). c260 uses 'sự tụ hợp' consistently ~8× (L19 verse ཡན་ལག་ཚོགས་པ, L54, L56, L58) for the chariot/aggregate assemblage that is the opponent's candidate for the chariot and the imputation-basis of the self. Changing it here would also break the deliberate merger with འདུས་པ (below), which the text itself licenses. Central ruling owed: either extend 'sự tụ hội' to this sense and change c260, or record 'sự tụ hợp' for the sāmagrī-of-parts sense and re-scope the p0734 entry. Flagged because 'tụ hội' / 'tụ hợp' are near-homographs and no consistency sweep by eye will catch the split.

terms.kind: gap — merger to be recorded deliberately
terms.note: WORDING KEPT. No འདུས་པ entry exists in the view. c260 renders both ཚོགས་པ་ཙམ (L54, L58, p0871) and འདུས་པ་ཙམ (L33 MAv verse འདུས་པ་ཙམ་མིན; L56 ཡན་ལག་འདུས་པ་ཙམ, p0871) with 'sự tụ hợp'. Both Tibetan words occur in p0871 within a few lines and the text treats ཚོགས་པ་ཙམ and འདུས་པ་ཙམ as one and the same opponent position — Tsongkhapa restates the verse's འདུས་པ་ཙམ with ཚོགས་པ་ཙམ — so the merger is defensible, but two distinct Tibetan words now collapse onto one Vietnamese and that should be a recorded decision, not drift.

terms.bo: ཤིང་རྟ (bare, the chariot of the MAv sevenfold analysis)
terms.kind: gap — head term of the chunk
terms.note: WORDING KEPT. The view registers only FIXED ཤིང་རྟ་ཆེན་པོ -> 'bậc Đại Xa' (mahāratha, the epithet for Nāgārjuna/Asaṅga), which does not reach the vehicle itself. Bare ཤིང་རྟ occurs ~40× in c260 and is the head term of the whole chariot analysis, which continues across the following chunks. An entry is owed now, scoped so that the fixed epithet ཤིང་རྟ་ཆེན་པོ = 'bậc Đại Xa' is not disturbed.

terms.bo: ཡན་ལག (sense: part of a chariot) and ཡན་ལག་ཅན
terms.vi: chi phần / cái có chi phần
terms.kind: gap — fourth sense of ཡན་ལག, plus its correlate
terms.note: WORDING KEPT. ཡན་ལག as chariot-part occurs ~30× in c260. The view has prov ཡན་ལག -> 'chi' (seven-limb practice), prov ཡན་ལག (bodily limb) -> 'chi phần' (p0471–p0472), prov ཡན་ལག (of śamatha) -> 'chi phần' (p0594). The chariot part is a fourth sense; 'chi phần' follows the two existing 'chi phần' precedents and stays clear of 'chi'. ཡན་ལག་ཅན -> 'cái có chi phần' (L51, L56, L60) has no entry either and must be ruled together with it, because the ཁས་བླངས་དང་འགལ་བ (contradicts-what-was-conceded) argument turns entirely on the ཡན་ལག / ཡན་ལག་ཅན pair: 'chẳng có cái có chi phần nên các chi phần cũng chẳng có'.

terms.vi: hình dạng / hình dạng đặc thù
terms.kind: gap, with a collision on ཁྱད་པར
terms.note: WORDING KEPT. No དབྱིབས entry; it occurs ~15× (L33, L52, L54, L60, L62, L64, L69, L71) as the sixth of the seven positions — the shape of the assembled parts proposed as the chariot. Related collision: ཁྱད་པར is ruled in the view in two scoped senses, 'định ngữ' (viśeṣaṇa, p0706) and 'sai biệt' (viśeṣa, p0766), and c260 correctly uses both — 'áp dụng định ngữ' at L58 for ཁྱད་པར་སྦྱར, 'sự sai biệt của danh xưng' at L26 for མིང་གི་ཁྱད་པར, 'sự sai biệt' at L69 — while adding a third, adjectival form 'đặc thù' for ཁྱད་པར་བ (L54, L60). Each of the three is defensible in place, but a scoped ruling is owed so the adjectival form does not drift.

terms.bo: རྟེན (āśraya of the རྟེན་དང་བརྟེན་པ pair) vs རྟེན (abstract basis) -> 'chỗ nương'
terms.kind: scoping note owed on an existing entry
terms.note: TEXT CHANGED in this chunk (see fixed[1]): the bare རྟེན at L43 now reads 'sở y' like the compound it belongs to. The ruling owed is a note on the prov རྟEN (abstract basis/support) -> 'chỗ nương' entry (p0387), scoping it away from the āśraya of the āśraya-āśrita pair, which the view already renders 'sở y và năng y' — otherwise the same drift recurs wherever the pair is argued about clause by clause.

terms.kind: already-recorded gap and collision — c260 counted in
terms.note: WORDING KEPT per the repair rule for gaps; reported only so this chunk is counted in the pending central ruling. Both Tibetan words land on 'chẳng hợp lý' within a few lines: རིགས་པ at L45, L52, L60; འཐད་པ at L45 (ལྡན་པའི་ཕྱོགས་ཀྱང་མི་འཐད, p0870) and L54. The view already carries prov རིགས་པ (predicative) -> 'chẳng hợp lý' from c231, and prov རུང་བ -> 'khả dĩ' kept deliberately apart from འཐད་པ -> 'hợp lý'. c260 is internally clean on the third member: every རུང་བ is 'khả dĩ' (L58 བདག་ཏུ་མི་རུང་བ, L60 ཤིང་རྟར་མི་རུང་བ).

terms.kind: gap — merger to be recorded deliberately
terms.note: WORDING KEPT. Neither word is registered. འཁོར་ལོ at L24, L39, L56, L69; འཕང་ལོ at p0872 l.3 and rendered at L69, L71. Both denote the chariot wheel in the MAv analysis, so the merger is almost certainly right, but at L69 the two collapse onto one Vietnamese inside a single paragraph ('bánh xe' for འཁོར་ལོ earlier, 'hình dạng của bánh xe v.v.' for འཕང་ལོ་ལ་སོགས་པ). Record the merger, or split them, before the chariot analysis runs on through the following chunks.

terms.bo: གཏན་ཚིགས (hetu, member of a formal proof)
terms.note: DEPARTURE from the registered prov གཏན་ཚིགས -> 'chánh lý', taken deliberately. In this chunk གཏན་ཚིགས (12x) stands in the SAME sentences as རིགས་པ (p0853 'དེ་ནི་རིགས་པས་དགག་པར་ནུས', p0854 'བསྒྲུབ་བྱ་མེད་པར་བཤད་པའི་རིགས་པ་དེས') and as རིགས་ཤེས (p0855), both of which the glossary rules to 'chánh lý' / 'trí chánh lý'. Using 'chánh lý' for གཏན་ཚིགས would have made p0854 read 'bằng chánh lý ... thì chánh lý "vì có" cũng...' — incoherent. 'nhân' is the reading the glossary's own note names as the logic-textbook rendering, and it is already the corpus reading in the immediately adjacent chunks: c250 renders གཞི་མ་གྲུབ་པའི་གཏན་ཚིགས་ཀྱི་སྐྱོན (p0843) as 'lỗi của nhân mà cơ sở chẳng thành lập', and c255 (the second half of THIS section) uses 'nhân' throughout. A ruling is owed to close the split with c224/c249's 'chánh lý'.

terms.bo: རྟགས (liṅga, the sign/reason of a proof); རང་རྒྱུད་ཀྱི་རྟགས
terms.note: No entry (glossary has རྟགས only in the non-logical senses 'hình tướng' / 'dấu hiệu'). Rendered 'nhân', the same word as གཏན་ཚིགས — a deliberate collapse, not inattention: Tsongkhapa uses the two as synonyms here (his gloss at p0854-p0855 identifies the Prasannapadā's གཏན་ཚིགས་མ་གྲུབ་པ with his own རྟགས་མ་གྲུབ་པ). Matches c252 ('nhân tự lập' for རང་རྒྱུད་རྟགས) and c255 ('nhân tự lập' for p0856's རང་རྒྱུད་ཀྱི་རྟགས). Two Tibetan words now share one Vietnamese word; a ruling should say whether that stands.

GAP — p0853, 'ཡང་ན་གཞན་རིག་མ་འཁྲུལ་བ་དང་ཡང་ན་རང་རིག་མ་འཁྲུལ་བ'. No entry and zero corpus precedent ('tự chứng' occurs 0x in translation/). 自證 / 他證 is the established Sino-Vietnamese pair. རང་རིག recurs across the Prāsaṅgika section, so a ruling is owed.
p0853 l.3. No entry. Follows c236's 'khuất lấp' for the hidden/imperceptible; kept plain so it stays distinct from ལྐོག་གྱུར compounds elsewhere.
p0853, 'དེ་དག་གི་རང་རང་གི་སྡོད་ལུགས་ཀྱི་ངོ་བོ'. No entry; follows c135's 'cách an trụ'.

terms.bo: ས (earth, as one of the four elements)
terms.note: p0855, inside the Tarkajvālā syllogism 'ས་ནི་དོན་དམ་པར་སྲ་བའི་ངོ་བོ་མ་ཡིན་ཏེ'. SENSE SPLIT: the view registers ས only as 'địa' (the bodhisattva bhūmis), which is unusable here.

terms.bo: རླུང (wind, as one of the four elements)
terms.note: p0855, 'རླུང་བཞིན་ནོ' — the example in the same Tarkajvālā syllogism. SENSE SPLIT: glossary has རླུང only as 'khí' (humoral) and 'hơi thở' (breath/prāṇa). Third sense, unregistered.
p0855, 'སྲ་བའི་ངོ་བོ' = 'thể tánh cứng chắc' — the defining property of the earth element. No entry.
p0855, 'རྟགས་མ་གྲུབ་པས་ཁྱབ་པར'. The view registers only ཁྱབ་པའི་དམིགས་པ = 'sở duyên biến khắp', a different use. Rendered 'được biến khắp bởi …'; the alternative 'châu biến' has no corpus presence.

p0853 (Prasannapadā, 'གཞི་མ་གྲུབ་པའི་ཕྱོགས་ཀྱི་ཉེས་པ') and p0854 ('ཆོས་གཉིས་བསྡོམས་པའི་ཕྱོགས'). Follows c250, which renders the same Prasannapadā phrase 'lỗi của tông mà cơ sở chẳng thành lập'. Note the corpus is split: c249 renders the sibling heading's ཕྱོགས as 'phía'. The view's only ཕྱོགས entry is scoped to ཕྱོགས་སུ་བྱས་ནས in the Tarkajvālā citation.

terms.vi: một chuỗi những người mù nối tiếp nhau
terms.note: p0853, 'རྗེས་དཔག་ལོང་བ་བརྒྱུད་པ་ལྟ་བུ' — the infinite-regress simile. No entry; rendered descriptively rather than importing 'kẻ mù dắt kẻ mù', which the Tibetan does not say.

p0854, Prasannapadā: 'གཏན་ཚིགས་མ་གྲུབ་པའི་དོན་ཉིད་དང་འགལ་བའི་དོན་ཉིད་དོ' — the pair asiddha / viruddha. Rendered literally; the Sino-Vietnamese technical name 'tương vi nhân' was NOT used because the Tibetan writes only འགལ་བའི་དོན.

terms.bo: འགོག་པ (verbal, to refute an opponent's reason)
terms.note: p0855, 'རིགས་ཤེས་ཀྱིས་མ་གྲུབ་པས་འགོག་པ་ཡིན་ནོ'. Kept apart from the view's འགོག་པ -> 'diệt [đế]' (nirodha) and from དགག་པ -> 'phủ định', which stands in the same paragraph ('རིགས་པས་དགག་པར་ནུས').
L13. No headwords in the view. Correctly and consistently handled; register so the pair is not re-decided.
No སྐྱེ་མཆེད headword in the view. L21 གཟུགས་ཀྱི་སྐྱེ་མཆེད -> 'sắc xứ', L23 ནང་གི་སྐྱེ་མཆེད -> 'nội xứ'. Standard renderings; register the base term.

terms.vi: hai bên tranh luận / bên đối luận
terms.note: L21, L25. The view's only entry, prov རྒོལ་བ -> vấn nạn, is scoped to the objection sense and cannot govern the disputant sense. Kept; a second sense-scoped entry is owed (རྒོལ་བ as disputant, ཕྱི་རྒོལ as the opposing party, སྔ་རྒོལ as its counterpart when it appears).

terms.bo: ལས (grammatical/kāraka sense, in the pair ལས་དང་བྱེད་པ་པོ)
terms.skt: karman (as object of the act, not karma)
terms.note: p0893 l.1, ལས་དང་བྱེད་པ་པོ་གཅིག་ཏུ་འགྱུར་བའི་སྐྱོན. The view FIXES ལས -> «nghiệp» [karma], which would positively misread this: the fault is that the appropriated (ཉེ་བར་བླང་བྱ = the aggregates) and the appropriator (the self) collapse into one, i.e. the grammatical object and agent, not moral karma. Corpus precedent is already settled the same way and must not be broken: c264 renders བྱེད་པ་པོ་དང་ལས་གཅིག་འགྱུར (p0888 verse) «kẻ tạo tác và cái được tạo tác thành ra một» and བྱ་བའི་ལས་དང་བྱེད་པ་པོ (p0888) «các đối tượng được tạo tác và các kẻ tạo tác», c260 «kẻ tạo tác cùng đối tượng được tạo tác». A scoped entry is owed so the FIXED karma entry is not disturbed.

p0893, 3×. No entry in the view. Rendered to match c264 (p0888 ཕུང་པོ་ནི་ཉེ་བར་བླང་བྱ་བ་ཡིན་ལ། བདག་ནི་དེ་ལེན་པ་པོའོ -> «uẩn là cái đáng được chấp thủ, còn ngã là kẻ chấp thủ nó») and c262 («cái được chấp thủ» / «kẻ chấp thủ»), since this is one continuous argument running c262→c264→c266. Deliberately NOT «cận thủ», which c028/c082 use for ཉེར་ལེན / ཉེ་བར་ལེན་པའི་ཕུང་པོ (the upādāna cause and the appropriated aggregates); keeping the two apart is the reason for the choice.

p0892, MAv verse and Tsongkhapa's gloss ལྷས་བྱིན་བ་ལང་དང་ལྡན་པ. The stock example of separable possession. No entry; བ་ལང -> «bò» is registered (prov, from p0870), this is the possessive compound built on it. Number left unmarked («có bò», not «có những con bò») because the Tibetan here has no plural particle, unlike p0870's བ་ལང་དག.

p0892, MAv verse and gloss ལྷས་བྱིན་གཟུགས་དང་ལྡན་པ — the paired example of inseparable possession. Kept as a bare possessive «có sắc» and deliberately distinct from the registered prov གཟུགས་ཅན -> «có hình sắc» [rūpin], which occurs four lines later in this same chunk (p0893, དབྱིབས་ནི་གཟུགས་ཅན་ཁོ་ན་ལ་ཡོད) — two different Tibetan words that would otherwise merge.

p0892, MAv verse ལྡན་དོན་སྦྱོར་བ་མེད. Uses the view's scoped prov སྦྱོར་བ -> «gắn» (yojana, 'to attach'), which is the only one of the five registered senses of སྦྱོར་བ that fits; 'gia hành', 'luận thức', 'sự kết hợp' would all misread it.

p0892, MAv verse བདག་ནི་གཟུགས་ལས་དེ་ཉིད་གཞན་ཉིད་མེད. The view registers prov དེ་ཉིད -> «thật tánh» [tattva], scoped by its own note to the p0876 MAv verse དེ་ནི་དེ་ཉིད་དུ་འམ་འཇིག་རྟེན་དུ. Here it is the correlate of གཞན་ཉིད (otherness) and means sameness/identity; «thật tánh» would be positively wrong. Second scoped sense.

terms.bo: ཁྱོད (opponent addressed inside a debate verse)
terms.note: p0893, MAv verse ཁྱོད་ལ་དེ་དག་ཉིད་བདག་ཅེས་འགྱུར. A FOURTH case for the unresolved ཁྱོད ruling the view already asks for: the view records prov «ngươi» (unnamed addressee, Nāgārjuna verse p0357), lowercase «ngài» (named non-buddha addressee), and «Ngài» (the Buddha in a stotra, p0675). Here the addressee is the named-by-position opponent in a śāstra debate; «ông» is the ordinary Vietnamese for that register and «ngươi» would import a contempt the Tibetan does not carry. Wording kept; the project-wide ruling should cover this case too.

p0918 l.2, གྲངས་ཅན་ཡང་ཉན་ཤེས་ཀྱི་ཡུལ་ན་གྲགས་པའི་དོན་འདི་ལ་རྟག་པར་སྨྲ་བས. NO entry in glossary.json and ZERO corpus precedent (grep: 'Số Luận' occurs only in this file). Coined to parallel the corpus's existing 'phái Thắng Luận' (Vaiśeṣika, 5×) and the registered 'người tên Kapila' for ཤེད་བུ་སེར་སྐྱ. Needs a ruling because the non-Buddhist schools will recur in the remaining Prāsaṅgika chapters and should be named as one set (Số Luận / Thắng Luận / …).

p0918 l.2, ×2 (ཉན་ཤེས་ཀྱི་ཡུལ་ན་གྲགས་པ, ཉན་ཤེས་ཀྱི་ཡུལ་དུ་གྲགས་པ). No entry; contracted form of རྣ་བའི་རྣམ་པར་ཤེས་པ. Standard Sino-Vietnamese 'nhĩ thức'. Note it lands inside the ཤེས་པ / རྣམ་པར་ཤེས་པ / རྣམ་ཤེས rendering question already flagged in the view (ཤེས་པ → 'thức'), so it should be settled with that.

p0916 l.1 and l.3, ×2 (ཀུན་བྱང་གི་རྟེན་འབྲེལ་སྒྱུ་མ་ལྟ་བུ). Contracted form of ཀུན་ནས་ཉོན་མོངས་པ་དང་རྣམ་པར་བྱང་བ, both of which ARE registered separately (tạp nhiễm / thanh tịnh) and both of which stand uncontracted in the quotation on the same page. Rendered with the same two words so the contraction and its expansion read identically. Register the contraction so the sweep does not read it as an unglossed term.

p0917 l.2, ཁོང་དུ་ཚུད་པར་མི་ཤེས་ཏེ — inside the quotation, paired with རྟོགས་པ ('chứng ngộ', registered) and བརྗོད་པ ('diễn nói'/'nói ra', registered prov). No entry. 'lãnh hội' chosen to stay apart from རྟོགས་པ = chứng ngộ, since the quoted passage distinguishes knowing-how-to-take-it-in from knowing-how-to-state-it.

terms.vi: chưa thuần thạo về danh ngôn
terms.note: p0917 l.1, of the young child who misreads a reflection. Composed from two registered provisionals (ཐ་སྙད = danh ngôn; བྱང་བ = thuần thạo). Recorded only so the compound is on file, not as a new decision.
p0918 l.3, དོན་གྱི་དབང་འདི་གཟིགས་ནས་བཅོམ་ལྡན་འདས་ཀྱིས — the formula introducing the Anavatapta verse. No entry. Rendered literally; 'do thấy được sức của ý nghĩa này'.

p0918 l.3, `མཐར་འཛིན་གྱི་ལྟ་བའི་འཆིང་བ` -> 'sự trói buộc của biên kiến'. No ruling in the view; only prov ལྟ་བ -> kiến, which 'biên kiến' honours. Matches c091 and c274 corpus usage. KEPT; entry owed.

L15 (inside the citation) and L17 (prose), p0917-p0918. No ruling in the view; only prov ལྟ་བ -> kiến. Rendered as the pair 'kiến thường cùng kiến đoạn' / 'kiến thường và kiến đoạn'. KEPT; entry owed, and it should be settled together with `མཐར་འཛིན་གྱི་ལྟ་བ` -> biên kiến, since the two extremes are what the biên kiến of the following sentence subsumes.

L13, L15, L17. The view DOES carry prov ཀུན་ནས་ཉོན་མོངས་པ -> tạp nhiễm (line 80) and prov ཀུན་ནས་ཉོན་མོངས -> tạp nhiễm (line 321), plus prov རྣམ་པར་བྱང་བ -> thanh tịnh, so the rendering is licensed; what is unruled is the CONTRACTED form ཀུན་བྱང, which is what the Tibetan actually writes at L13/L17. Register ཀུན་བྱང as the abbreviation resolving to the same 'tạp nhiễm và thanh tịnh'. Also, as line 321's note already requests: scope the FIXED entry ཉོན་མོངས -> phiền não to the BARE term, or a mechanical Phase-5 substring sweep will read 'tạp nhiễm' here as a violation of it. ཀུན་ནས་ཉོན་མོངས་པ (saṃkleśa) is a distinct term from ཉོན་མོངས (kleśa), and 'tạp nhiễm' already stands in 10 other chunks.

p0918 l.3. The view carries three scopes — prov མཁས་པ -> bậc học giả (nominal, paṇḍita); prov མཁས་པ (contrastive with བྱིས་པ) -> bậc trí; prov མཁས་པ (in verse) -> bậc trí — and none reaches this occurrence: the contrast here is with སེམས་ཅན་གཞན་རྣམས (other sentient beings, who are bound by grasping), not with བྱིས་པ, and it is prose, not verse. 'các bậc trí' is the better fit for a contrast about insight rather than scholarship and is KEPT. Requested ruling: widen the contrastive scope from 'contrastive with བྱིས་པ' to 'contrastive with the unlearned/unrealised generally' so this and like passages are covered.

p0902 l.1, ལྟད་མོ་བ་འགས = 'by some spectators' at a magic show, contrasted with སྒྱུ་མ་མཁན = 'nhà huyễn thuật' (already registered) in the same clause. No entry in the view. Plain 'người xem' keeps the two separable.

p0903, Samādhirāja verse (སྒྱུ་མ་བྱེད་པ་དག་གིས་གཟུགས་སྤྲུལ་ཏེ). A different Tibetan word from སྒྱུ་མ་མཁན = 'nhà huyễn thuật' (registered), which occurs in this chunk's own prose eleven lines earlier. Rendered compositionally so the two stay distinguishable inside one chunk; a ruling could licence merging them.
p0903 verse, ཆུ་ཟླ་སྟོང་པ་གསོག་སྟེ་བཟུང་དུ་མེད. No entry. Rendered 'rỗng không' alongside སྟོང་པ = 'trống rỗng' so the doublet stays a doublet rather than collapsing into one word.
p0903 verse, སྨིག་རྒྱུ་དག་ལ་ཆུ་ཡི་ཕུང་པོར་མཐོང. Deliberately NOT the view's prov ཕུང་པོ = 'uẩn', which would be wrong here. Same 'heap' sense the view already records for རིན་པོ་ཆེའི་ཕུང་པོ.
p0903 verse, སྒྲ་ལ་དབྱངས་དེ་ནམ་ཡང་ཡོད་མ་ཡིན — the melody/tune, kept apart from སྒྲ = 'âm thanh' (registered) since the pada turns on the contrast between the two.
p0902 l.3, མདོ་སྡེ་ཟབ་མོའི་ཚིགས་སུ་བཅད་པའི་དབྱངས་ངག་ཏུ་བརྗོད — reciting the sutra verses in chant. No entry.

p0903 verse. The view's བསྟེན་པ entry records a three-way sense split (nương tựa / hầu hạ / chịu lấy); none covers indulging in kāma. 'thọ dụng' is the closest plain rendering of བསྟེན་པ as 'resort to, make use of' without importing enjoyment-language the Tibetan does not have. Contestable — see flags.
p0903 verse, སོས་ཀའི་ཉི་མ་ཕྱེད་དུས. No entry. Kept plain rather than 'mùa hạ', since སོས་ཀ names the hot season and the pada's point is the heat.
p0903 verse, ཇི་ལྟར་བུ་མོ་གཞོན་ནུའི་རྨི་ལམ་ན. No entry.

No entry for རྟ་གླང or bare གླང in the c269 view (only FIXED ཤིང་རྟ་ཆེན་པོ -> 'bậc Đại Xa' and prov ཤིང་རྟ -> 'cỗ xe'). Occurs 3x in p0902 l.1: ལྟད་མོ་བ་འགས་རྟ་གླང་སོགས་སུ་བདེན་པར་འཛིན, སྒྱུ་མ་མཁན་གྱིས་རྟ་གླང་བརྫུན་པར་ཤེས་པ, and ཆུ་དང་རྟ་གླང་དང་སྐྱེས་པ་བུད་མེད. Wording KEPT: it matches the precedent already set in c267 (p0894), the only other corpus occurrence, which reads 'ngựa và voi' / 'ngựa voi' 3x, so the chunk is internally and corpus-consistent. A ruling is nevertheless owed, because bare གླང is ordinarily 'ox' while གླང་པོ is 'elephant', and the Samādhirāja verse on p0903 (རྟ་དང་གླང་པོ་ཤིང་རྟ་སྣ་ཚོགས) does write གླང་པོ and is likewise rendered 'voi' (L43). Whichever way it is settled it is a c267+c269 sweep, not a c269-only edit — so it must not be changed here unilaterally.

terms.vi: đối đãi (có đối đãi với nhân / chẳng đối đãi với nhân)
terms.note: GAP — no headword in the view for bare བལྟོས་པ. p0908 l.3, twice, in the exhaustive division 'if it arises by nature, it is decisively divided into depending on a cause or not'. 'đối đãi' follows c270, which renders ཕན་ཚུན་བལྟོས་པ (p0907) as 'sự đối đãi lẫn nhau' and ལ་བལྟོས་ནས as 'đối đãi với'; deliberately NOT 'nương vào', which the corpus uses for བརྟེན་ནས / ལ་བརྟེན་ནས and which stands in the same passages (MAv VI.14 གཞན་ལ་བརྟེན་ནས = 'nương vào cái khác'). A ruling should keep བརྟེན and བལྟོས separable.

terms.vi: trường hợp (loại trừ các trường hợp khác)
terms.note: p0909 l.1, མུ་བཞིའི་སྐྱེ་བ་ཙམ་ཞིག་འགོག་པའི་མཐའ་གཞན་སེལ་ལུགས. Neither registered sense fits: the view has མཐའ as the fifth member of a five-fold list ('chỗ cuối cùng') and མཐའ as extreme ('cực đoan'). Here it is an alternative in an exhaustive division, and it is the same thing the registered མུ་བཞི = 'bốn trường hợp' counts, so 'trường hợp' was used to keep the two visibly matched.

MAv VI.8a, quoted p0909 l.3. Deliberate departure from the FIXED ཡོན་ཏན = 'công đức': here guṇa means the advantage/point of the arising, not merit or quality, and 'chẳng có công đức nào cả' would assert something doctrinally different. Precedent for a scoped split already exists (ཡོན་ཏན in ནམ་མཁའི་ཡོན་ཏན = 'phẩm tính'). Requesting a third scoped sense rather than an edit to the fixed entry.

terms.vi: sự tiếp sức của [lý] đồng nhất phản thể
terms.note: p0911 l.1, once. GAP and the least secure rendering in the chunk. 'phản thể' (反體) is the standard Sino-Vietnamese for ལྡོག་པ as vyāvṛtti/isolate, and is deliberately kept apart from the view's registered ལྡོག་པ = 'sự lui chuyển', which its own note scopes to རང་བཞིན་ལ་ལྡོག་པ་མེད་པ (a svabhāva admits no reversal) — a different word-sense. དཔུང་འཕུལ ('lending force, reinforcement') has no entry anywhere; 'sự tiếp sức' is a literal reading. See flags.

terms.bo: རྒྱུད (continuum of a causal series, in རྒྱུད་གཅིག་ཏུ་གཏོགས་མི་གཏོགས)
terms.note: p0911 l.1, twice — the seed/sprout series, not a mind. The view's རྒྱུད = 'tâm tương tục' is scoped by its own note to རང་གི་རྒྱུད (one's own mental continuum) and would import 'tâm' the Tibetan does not have here; 'dòng tương tục' follows the registered རྒྱུན = 'dòng tương tục'. Record the second, non-mental sense.
Listed separately from the compound above in case the ruling wants the bare word. p0911 l.1, one occurrence.

terms.vi: bình gốm / đất sét / người thợ gốm
terms.note: p0911 l.3, the Jain (ubhaya-utpāda) example. No entries; the view registers only བུམ་པ = 'bình'.

terms.vi: lúa mạch (ནས་ཀྱི་ས་བོན = hạt giống lúa mạch)
terms.note: p0910 l.3 and p0911 l.1, inside the Madhyamakāvatārabhāṣya quotation, contrasted with ས་ལུ = rice. No entry.
p0910 l.3 and p0911 l.1, same quotation (མེ་དང་སོལ་བ་དང་ནས་ཀྱི་ས་བོན). No entry.

p0910 throughout (ས་ལུའི་ས་བོན, ས་ལུའི་མྱུ་གུ, and the contracted ས་མྱུག at p0910 l.1). No entry; ས་མྱུག was read as the contraction of ས་ལུའི་མྱུ་གུ on the evidence of the same sentence continuing with ས་ལུའི་མྱུ་གུ་དེ.
p0909 l.5 (prose) and p0911 l.1 (MAv VI.14). No entry; kept distinct from bare མེ = 'lửa', which stands in the same sentences.
p0910 l.1, twice — 'the manner in which it has come to be different in nature from X'. No entry; rendered analytically.

p0910 l.1. Uses the registered རང་དབང = 'tự chủ'; རག་ལས་པ ('to depend on') has no entry, and its negative རག་མ་ལས is rendered 'chẳng lệ thuộc' — deliberately a third word, kept apart from བརྟེན ('nương vào') and བལྟོས ('đối đãi'), both of which occur in this chunk.

terms.kind: scoped departure from a FIXED entry
terms.note: p0909 l.3, inside the Madhyamakāvatāra verse quoted at L35. Third sense of the FIXED ཡོན་ཏན -> công đức, after the view's own scoped departure at line 435 (ནམ་མཁའི་ཡོན་ཏན -> 'phẩm tính'). Here Candrakīrti's point is that self-arising would serve NO PURPOSE — the sprout has already obtained its own self — not that it produces no merit; 'công đức' would state a doctrinal claim the verse does not make. WORDING KEPT at 'chẳng có lợi ích nào cả', but the departure is now declared rather than taken silently. A ruling is owed on whether the FIXED entry admits scoped senses at all, or whether these two should be split off as separate headwords.

terms.bo: མཐའ (alternative / koṭi of a catuṣkoṭi, in མུ་བཞིའི་སྐྱེ་བ་ཙམ་ཞིག་འགོག་པའི་མཐའ་གཞན་སེལ་ལུགས)
terms.note: p0909 l.1, rendered L24. Neither registered མཐའ fits: view line 321 is the extreme sense ('cực đoan', ཡོད་པའི་མཐའ / ཆད་པའི་མཐའ) and line 183 the fifth-member/final sense ('chỗ cuối cùng / cứu cánh'). WORDING KEPT per the repair rule, but flagging the real cost: 'các trường hợp khác' reuses the exact Vietnamese already fixed for མུ in the same clause (མུ་བཞི -> 'bốn trường hợp', view line 169), so two distinct Tibetan words collapse onto one Vietnamese word inside a single sentence. A ruling is owed that keeps them separable — e.g. reserving 'trường hợp' for མུ and giving མཐའ its own word here. I did not pick one myself, because any choice would be as unruled as the present wording and would silently re-decide a term.

terms.vi: phản thể ([lý] đồng nhất phản thể)
terms.note: p0911 l.1, rendered L55. The view registers ལྡོག་པ only as 'sự lui chuyển' (lines 359-362), explicitly scoped to རང་བཞིན་ལ་ལྡོག་པ་མེད་པ in the Prasannapadā — the reversal/turning-back sense, unusable for the pramāṇa-technical isolate. WORDING KEPT; 'phản thể' is the standard Sino-Vietnamese for vyāvṛtti. The two senses must be recorded as a split, or Phase 5 will read this line as drift from 'sự lui chuyển'.

terms.skt: (reinforcement / lending of support to an argument)
terms.note: p0911 l.1, rendered L55: 'nhờ sự tiếp sức của [lý] đồng nhất phản thể'. No headword of any kind in the view. The sense is one argument being propped up by another; 'sự tiếp sức' keeps that without importing a military reading of དཔུང.

terms.bo: རྒྱུད (causal continuum of seed and sprout, in རྒྱུད་གཅིག་ཏུ་གཏོགས་མི་གཏོགས)
terms.note: p0911 l.1, rendered L69 (×2 in the sentence). The view's prov རྒྱུད -> 'tâm tương tục' (line 71) is scoped by its own note to the mental continuum (p0052, རང་གི་རྒྱུད). Here the continuum belonging to 'one and the same' series is the seed-sprout causal series, where 'tâm tương tục' would be positively wrong. WORDING KEPT as the neutral 'dòng tương tục'; a scoped entry is owed.

terms.kind: gap — further trigger for an already-open split
terms.note: p0908 l.3, rendered L13. Consistent with view lines 285-286 / 325 / 405-406, which already record the enumerative 'hạng người' vs technical transliteration split as unresolved. Recorded here only as one more instance so the eventual ruling covers the 'basis of designation as a pudgala' idiom; NOT a translator error and nothing was changed.

p0895, named explicitly as what སྔོན་གྱི་མཁས་པ་རྣམས call it, paired with the next entry. Built from the registered སྒྱུ་མ = huyễn hóa and སྟོང་པ་ཉིད = tánh không (both fixed/prov), so no new word is introduced; registered because the pair is the controlling technical vocabulary of this whole section and recurs in c268.
p0895, ×2. The equipoise (མཉམ་གཞག) counterpart of the previous entry. No entry in the view for either.

p0896, inside the Catuḥśataka-ṭīkā quotation སྒྱུ་མ་བྱས་པ་ལྟ་བུར་འགྱུར. Distinguished from bare སྒྱུ་མ = huyễn hóa: here it is the conjured object, not the illusoriness. The bracketed [vật] is supplied so Vietnamese parses.

p0895, དེའི་ངེས་པའི་རྩིས་ཟིན་པར་བྱས་ནས. Follows the view's prov རྩི -> 'hương vị' (p0435, which cites this exact idiom དེའི་རྩིས་ཟིན་པ). Recorded because here it is the verbal idiom, not the bare noun.

p0897. GAP with a live collision: the view registers prov འདུ་བྱེད -> 'hành' (saṃskāra, the third duḥkhatā, p0294). Here the word is the residual impetus/momentum a piece of reasoning leaves behind, which lasts 'as long as it has not degenerated' — 'hành' would be positively wrong. Wording kept; a scoped ruling is owed.

p0897, ཡུལ་དཔྱད་དེ་རིགས་པས་གསིལ་བ་ན. No entry. 'nghiền nát' is already the corpus word (c010, c045, c049, c087) but for other Tibetan verbs (bcom/rdungs); registered so the Phase 5 sweep does not read the overlap as drift.
p0896. No entry. Rendered literally ('in the track/wake of'); a smoother 'tiếp ngay sau' would lose the image. Flagged rather than smoothed.

terms.vi: sự chấp trước của cái chấp huyễn
terms.note: p0897. Neither སྒྱུ་འཛིན nor མངོན་ཞེན has an entry in the view. 'chấp trước' is the corpus word (c070, c071, c134, c213, c227, c230, c235) but for ཞེན་པ / མངོན་པར་ཞེན་པ; a ruling should say whether མངོན་ཞེན keeps a distinct word (e.g. 'sự chấp trước hiện hành').

p0896, inside the Catuḥśataka-ṭīkā quotation — the same phrase the view already notes at p0740 l.3 ('literally measured near by, i.e. taken as the simile for; deliberately not đo lường'). Recorded as a second occurrence so the two chunks can be swept together.

terms.vi: cái lối trụ trên phía cảnh
terms.note: p0897 l.5, the chunk's closing clause, running into c268. Built on the view's prov ཡུལ -> 'cảnh'. Registered because it names what the reasoning is said to find absent, and the sentence completes in the next chunk.
p895 l.5ff, contrasted with the correct view as a གོལ་ས. Standard Sino-Vietnamese rendering; no ruling in the view.
p896, སྒྱུ་འཛིན་གྱི་མངོན་ཞེན. No ruling in the view.
p896, the apprehension-of-illusion that an objector wants discarded. No ruling in the view.
p895 l.3, སྒྱུ་མ་ལྟ་བུའི་སྟོང་པ་ལོགས་སུ་གཏན་ལ་འབེབས་ཚུལ་མེད། No ruling in the view.
p896-897, the blurred/hazy appearance arising from over-negation. No ruling in the view.
p895 l.3, ཕྱག་སྐོར་བ་བཟླས་བརྗོད as practice activities. No ruling in the view.
p895 l.3, same list as ཕྱག. No ruling in the view.
p896, རང་བཞིན་ཁེགས་པའི་བཤུལ - the 'trace/track' left where tự tánh has been refuted. No ruling in the view.

terms.vi: chánh lý về sự tùy thuộc
terms.note: p0929, first of the four རིགས་པ་བཞི of the Śrāvakabhūmi sixfold seeking. Built on the registered prov རིགས་པ = 'chánh lý'. No entry existed for any of the four yuktis. Deliberately descriptive rather than the Chinese calque 觀待道理 'quán đãi đạo lý', which has no corpus precedent.

terms.vi: chánh lý về việc thực hiện công dụng
terms.note: p0929, second of the four. Glossed in the text by མེས་སྲེག་པའི་བྱ་བ་བྱེད་པ (fire performing the function of burning).

terms.vi: chánh lý thành lập bằng lý lẽ
terms.note: p0929, third of the four. Uses the view's scoped prov འཐད་པ (nominal, = reasoning) -> 'lý lẽ' (view line 342), deliberately NOT 'hợp lý' (the predicative sense) and not 'chánh lý', which is already རིགས་པ inside the same compound.
p0929, fourth of the four. Uses the registered prov ཆོས་ཉིད = 'pháp tánh'.

terms.vi: lượng của giáo điển đáng xác tín
terms.note: p0929, third of the three pramāṇas listed under འཐད་པས་བསྒྲུབ་པའི་རིགས་པ. Assembled from registered pieces: prov ཡིད་ཆེས = 'xác tín', prov ལུང = 'giáo điển', prov ཚད་མ = 'lượng'. Alongside prov མངོན་སུམ = 'hiện lượng' and prov རྗེས་དཔག = 'tỷ lượng', already in the view.

terms.vi: pháp tánh được thế gian công nhận
terms.note: p0929, first of the three dharmatās under ཆོས་ཉིད་ཀྱི་རིགས་པ; the other two are བསམ་གྱིས་མི་ཁྱབ་པའི་ཆོས་ཉིད = 'pháp tánh bất khả tư nghì' and གནས་པའི་ཆོས་ཉིད = 'pháp tánh an trụ'. Follows the view's third གྲགས་པ rendering ('chỗ thế gian công nhận', p0739-p0740) rather than 'cực thành' or 'quen thuộc' — the three-way conflict in the glossary is already on record at view line 405.

The sa-bcad heading printed at p0930, opening section 6.2.3.1.11.2.6.2.3. Parallel to c180's ཞི་གནས་བསྒོམ་པའི་ཚུལ-family headings ('Cách thức nương vào đó mà tu tịnh chỉ'). 'thắng quán' per decisions.md §1 (headings take the headword form).

terms.vi: sự phá bỏ chủ trương của người khác
terms.note: Named as the first of the two subdivisions in this chunk's closing sa-bcad; the sentence is cut by the page break and completed in c278. Wording chosen to match c278's own heading 'Phá bỏ chủ trương của người khác'. NOTE c280 renders the sibling phrase གཞན་ལུགས་དགག་པ as 'Sự bác bỏ chủ trương khác' — a corpus-wide sweep is owed.

terms.vi: tác ý gắng siết mà thâm nhập
terms.note: p0930, first of the four manaskāras said to be common to śamatha and vipaśyanā. No entry; follows c187 line 66, which renders the identical phrase the same way inside a quotation.

terms.kind: doctrinal term (negated counterpart of a registered term)
terms.note: p0929 l.1, ཐུན་མོང་བ་དང་ཐུན་མོང་མ་ཡིན་པ་ཚོལ་བའོ. WORDING KEPT. The view registers only the positive prov ཐུན་མོང་བ -> 'cộng thông' (view line 94), scoped to paths and vows; there is no ruling for the negated form. 'bất cộng' is the standard Sino-Vietnamese pair for 'cộng thông' and is used consistently here. The two words stand side by side in this sentence and recur together through the whole vipaśyanā division (ཐུན་མོང་བ again at p0930 l.1, ཞི་ལྷག་གཉིས་ཀའི་ཐུན་མོང་བ -> 'cộng thông cho cả hai chỉ quán'), so the pair should be registered together to stay stable.

terms.vi: chánh lý về sự tùy thuộc / chánh lý về việc thực hiện công dụng / chánh lý thành lập bằng lý lẽ / chánh lý về pháp tánh
terms.kind: fixed-set candidate — the four yukti, a standing tetrad
terms.note: p0929 l.1, all four named in one passage (རིགས་པ་བཞི་ལས...). WORDING KEPT — no entries exist. The view holds only prov རིགས་པ -> 'chánh lý' (line 150, itself flagged there as carrying a qualifier the Tibetan lacks) and prov འཐད་པ (nominal) -> 'lý lẽ', which the third name follows. These four recur in the Saṃdhinirmocana and Śrāvakabhūmi material and need ONE ruling as a set, so the four names stay identical wherever the tetrad appears. Note the second name's dependence on the བྱ་བ ruling below.

p0929 l.1, four occurrences in one passage: བྱ་བ་བྱེད་པའི་རིགས་པ, མེས་སྲེག་པའི་བྱ་བ་བྱེད་པ, རང་རང་གི་བྱ་བ་བྱེད་པ, ཆོས་འདིས་ནི་བྱ་བ་འདི་བྱེད་དོ. No entry in the view. I have made all four 'công dụng' in this repair (one was 'công việc'), because the switch fell inside the definition and its own worked example. A ruling is owed: recommend བྱ་བ (as the object of བྱེད་པ, i.e. the function a dharma performs) -> 'công dụng', kept distinct from the ordinary sense 'việc/việc làm' which the view already touches at line 147 (གཉིད་ཀྱིས་རྒྱས་པར་བྱ་བ) and line 240.

terms.vi: tác ý gắng siết mà thâm nhập v.v. — bốn [tác ý]
terms.note: p0930 l.1. WORDING KEPT. ཡིད་བྱེད / ཡིད་ལ་བྱེད་པ -> 'tác ý' is registered prov (view lines 102, 306, 320) and is used correctly, but the INDIVIDUAL names of the four manasikāras are registered nowhere. Only the first is named here (བསྒྲིམས་ཏེ་འཇུག་པ, 'gắng siết mà thâm nhập'), the rest carried by ལ་སོགས་པ; they are named in full in the Śrāvakabhūmi material and were given earlier in the śamatha section (སྔར་བཤད་པའི), so the set should be ruled once and swept back over the earlier chunks.

p0898, Samādhirāja verse `ཆོས་འདི་རྣམས་ནི་དབུ་བ་ཆུ་ཤིང་འདྲ`. No entry in the view. Corpus precedent exists (c039 L92 `như cây chuối, như bọt nước`, c040, c047), so the wording follows it; recorded only so the pairing with the registered ཆུ་ཤིང = 'cây chuối' is visible.
p0898 verse, fourth of the eight similes. GAP; no entry for གློག.
p0898 verse. GAP. The view registers ཟླ་བ only as the short form of ཟླ་བ་གྲགས་པ (A-xà-lê Nguyệt [Xứng]), a different word entirely — recorded so a sweep does not read this as drift.

p0898 verse `སེམས་ཅན་མི་དང་སྲོག་ཀྱང་མི་རྙེད་དེ`. Part of the standard ātman-synonym list; the view's c184 entry already renders སྲོག as 'mạng' inside the six-synonym list, so this follows it. No headword of its own.

terms.vi: mức tận cùng của điều khả dĩ
terms.note: p0898 l.1, `དེ་རྣམས་སུ་འཇོག་ཐུབ་པའི་གཉིས་ཚོགས་དེ་སྲིད་མཐའ་ཙམ་དུ་སོང་བས`. GAP, and the parse is not certain — see flag. Read as 'the limit of what is possible', i.e. the conjunction of the two certainties barely occurs at all, which is why the Madhyamaka view is said to be so hard to find. Deliberately NOT the registered སྲིད་པ = 'hữu' (bhava), which would misread it.

p0901, `བརྡ་ལ་མ་བྱང་པའི་བྱིས་པ་ཆུང་ངུ` / `རྒན་པོ་བརྡ་ལ་བྱང་བ` — children unskilled in convention vs adults skilled in it. GAP. Deliberately kept apart from the registered ཐ་སྙད = 'danh ngôn', which occurs in this same chunk (p0899, `གང་ཟག་གི་ཐ་སྙད`); a single Vietnamese word for both would flatten the child/adult simile into the technical vocabulary of the argument.

p0901, Catuḥśataka verse `དངོས་པོ་གཅིག་གི་ལྟ་པོ་གང༌། །དེ་ནི་ཀུན་གྱི་ལྟ་པོར་བརྗོད`. GAP. The view has ལྟ་བ = 'kiến' (dṛṣṭi) and a scoped ལྟ་བ = 'cái nhìn' (the eye's act of looking); ལྟ་པོ is the agent noun and needs its own form.

terms.vi: nối tiếp mãi đến vô cùng
terms.note: p0900 l.3, the infinite-regress consequence in the objection about examples. GAP; recurs in the vipaśyanā logic sections, so it is worth one fixed form.

SCOPING REQUEST. p0900 l.3 and p0901 l.3, 2×, the pivot of the whole objection-and-reply: the emptiness of only a partial dharmin. The view carries ཉི་ཚེ་བ -> 'địa ngục cá biệt' (scoped by its own note to the naraka at p0163) and ཉི་ཚེ -> 'cục bộ' (p0434). This chunk follows the second. A scoped entry is owed so the naraka form is not read into it.

terms.bo: གང་ཟག (technical pudgala, in the karma-agent / illusion-like-person argument)
terms.note: KNOWN GAP, wording KEPT and consistent with c267, the first half of this same section. Occurs ~8× here (p0898 `རང་བཞིན་མེད་པའི་གང་ཟག`, p0899 `སྐྱེ་བ་དང་འཆི་འཕོ་བའི་གང་ཟག` and `གང་ཟག་གཞན`, p0899 `གང་ཟག་གི་ཐ་སྙད`, p0900 `གང་ཟག་ལ་ཡང་རང་བཞིན་རྡུལ་ཙམ་མེད`). The view's `གང་ཟག -> hạng người` restricts itself to enumerative, non-technical use and would be plainly wrong here. This is a further trigger for the split the glossary has already asked for four times.

p0901 l.3. Follows the ruling already requested at the view's bare ཚད་མ entry ('bare ཚད་མ (epistemic) -> lượng', p0705–p0706). Recorded as a further occurrence, not a fresh proposal. Note this chunk also has མངོན་སུམ་གྱིས་གྲུབ་པ = 'được thành lập bằng hiện lượng' in the adjacent sentence, so the two must stay visibly distinct.

terms.vi: Những thứ như bình v.v. này, trong thật tánh thì chẳng có, / Mà y như [chúng] có, được cực thành trọn vẹn nơi thế gian
terms.note: p0901 l.3, two padas re-cited from the same verse already quoted in full at p0807 and rendered in c239 L73–76. Wording taken over verbatim from c239 so the re-citation matches. Note the source spelling differs between the two occurrences (p0807 `ཡོད་ཅི་བཞིན`, p0901 `ཡོད་ཇི་བཞིན`) — not normalised, and the sense is unaffected. The 'cực thành' for གྲགས་པ follows c239; the view records three competing provisional renderings of that word (cực thành / quen thuộc / chỗ thế gian công nhận) and one must be chosen centrally.

p0898 l.3, inside the Samādhirāja verse: `རྒྱལ་བ་དེས་ནི་ཏིང་འཛིན་མཆོག་འདི་འཆང་` (c268 L16). No entry in the view. CHANGED in this repair from 'thọ trì' to 'trì giữ' on the fabrication finding — 'thọ trì' (受持) adds a receiving element the bare verb 'to hold/bear' does not have, and no addition is licensed inside a quotation. Register 'trì giữ' (or a better plain equivalent) for འཆང, and keep it apart from འཛིན་པ, which this chunk renders 'chấp' throughout in the grasping sense (L45, L11).

p0901 l.1, `རྒན་པོ་བརྡ་ལ་བྱང་བ་རྣམས` (c268 L45), in contrast with `བྱིས་པ་ཆུང་ངུ` -> 'những đứa trẻ nhỏ'. No entry in the view. WORDING KEPT. The contrast is age/experience, not ordination or seniority in the sangha, so 'người lớn tuổi' avoids 'trưởng lão'. A ruling should also confirm that བྱིས་པ here is the literal 'child' (paired with རྒན་པོ) and not the doctrinal bāla = 'phàm phu', which this chunk renders 'phàm phu' at L38 for སོ་སོ་སྐྱེ་བོ.

p0900 l.3, `ཐུག་མེད་དུ་བརྒྱུད་དགོས་སོ` (c268 L38) -> 'sẽ phải nối tiếp mãi đến vô cùng'. No entry in the view. WORDING KEPT. This is the infinite-regress objection (anavasthā), a technical move, so the entry should probably scope a fixed rendering ('vô cùng' vs 'vô cùng tận' vs 'thoái lui vô cùng') and keep it apart from མཐའ་ཡས / མུ་མཐའ་མེད་པ used of beginningless saṃsāra.

p0898 l.1, ×2 (c268 L11): `སྤྱོད་ཕྱོགས་ལ་ངེས་པ`, standing opposite `ལྟ་བའི་ངེས་པ`. No entry in the view. WORDING KEPT. The -ཕྱོགས here is 'the side of / as regards', paired with the view-side, and 'phía' preserves that pairing; note this chunk also uses 'phía' for ཕྱོགས in `སྟོང་ཕྱོགས` -> 'phía trống rỗng' (L34) and `རྟེན་འབྲེལ་གྱི་ཕྱོགས་རྣམས` -> 'các phương diện duyên khởi' (L34), so a ruling should settle whether ཕྱོགས keeps one word across these.

NOT a violation and NOTHING CHANGED. p0898 l.3, inside the single Samādhirāja citation: `སྲིད་པའི་འགྲོ་བ་རྨི་ལམ་ལྟ་བུ་སྟེ` (c268 L17) and `སེམས་ཅན་མི་དང་སྲོག་ཀྱང་མི་རྙེད་དེ` (L19). The view registers FIXED སེམས་ཅན -> 'chúng sinh' and prov འགྲོ་བ -> 'chúng sinh', so both renderings are licensed and the fixed one cannot move. But two distinct Tibetan words become indistinguishable four lines apart inside one quotation, and the alternative registered sense prov འགྲོ་བ (gati) -> 'thú' does not apply. This is the same open question view line 155 already raises. If the central ruling gives འགྲོ་བ its own word (e.g. 'loài hữu tình' / 'hữu tình'), this verse should be swept — I did not resolve it unilaterally, since it would put a non-registered word inside a citation.

terms.vi: chẳng hợp lý / hợp lý / khả dĩ
terms.note: NOTHING CHANGED — reported only so c268 is counted in the pending central ruling. `རྟེན་འབྲེལ་འཐད་པའི་འཐད་ལུགས` (p0899 l.3, L34) -> 'các cách thức khiến duyên khởi là hợp lý', and predicative `རིགས་པ་མ་ཡིན` (p0900 l.3, L38) -> 'chẳng hợp lý', land on the same Vietnamese word. The view already carries `prov རིགས་པ (predicative) -> chẳng hợp lý` with the collision flagged from c231/c239/c249/c260. After this repair c268 is internally clean on the third member: 'khả dĩ' now renders only རུང་བ (L38 `ཇི་ལྟར་རུང་`, L47 `དཔེར་རུང་ལུགས`) — the སྲིད leak at L11 has been removed.

p0926 l.2 and p0927 l.1 (Śrāvakabhūmi quotation), the fourth of the four vipaśyanās. The view registers its partner ཡོངས་སུ་རྟོག་པ -> 'chu biến tầm tư' (paryeṣaṇā, scoped to p0577-p0578) but not this one. Wording follows translation/c175.md L39 and L45, which already renders the identical Asaṅga gloss as 'chu biến thẩm sát'. Registering only confirms the pair so the two are never split.

p0927 l.3 (Saṃdhinirmocana, second of the three vipaśyanās: ཡོངས་སུ་ཚོལ་བ་ལས་བྱུང་བ) and p0928 l.3 (ཡོངས་སུ་ཚོལ་བའི་ལྷག་མཐོང, and the six-fold ཡོངས་སུ་ཚོལ་བར་བྱེད). Also its past form ཡོངས་སུ་བཙལ་བ at p0926 l.1 (the second of the three prerequisites, མང་དུ་ཐོས་པ་ཡོངས་སུ་བཙལ་བ) and p0928 l.1-2 (ཡོངས་སུ་བཙལ་བའི་རྗེས་སུ་ཞུགས་པ). COLLISION TO NOTE IN THE RULING: the view already gives ཡོངས་སུ་རྟོག་པ = 'chu biến tầm tư', so ཡོངས་སུ་ཚོལ་བ and ཡོངས་སུ་རྟོག་པ now share the 'chu biến' head. That is deliberate (both are pari-), and the second element keeps them apart (tầm cầu vs tầm tư), but the two stand three lines from each other on p0927 so the choice should be recorded rather than left to drift.

p0927 l.3, first of the Saṃdhinirmocana's three vipaśyanās; siblings ཡོངས་སུ་ཚོལ་བ་ལས་བྱུང་བ -> 'phát sinh từ sự chu biến tầm cầu' and སོ་སོར་རྟོག་པ་ལས་བྱུང་བ -> 'phát sinh từ sự giản trạch'. Built from registered pieces (མཚན་མ = tướng, སོ་སོར་རྟོག་པ = giản trạch); recorded because these three name a division the following chunks refer back to.

p0927 l.5, inside the Saṃdhinirmocana quotation (རྣམ་པར་གྲོལ་བས་ཤིན་ཏུ་ལེགས་པར་བདེ་བ་ལ་རེག་པར་བྱ་བའི་ཕྱིར). No entry for གྲོལ་བ or རྣམ་པར་གྲོལ་བ; the view records only that bare གྲོལ་བ was rendered 'giải thoát' and thereby silently collides with the FIXED ཐར་པ = 'giải thoát'. 'trọn vẹn' renders རྣམ་པར and keeps this form visibly distinct from ཐར་པ, but the collision on the head word is still open.

p0928 l.1-2, 3× (མཚན་མ་ཙམ་གྱི་རྗེས་སུ་ཞུགས་པ, ཡོངས་སུ་བཙལ་བའི་རྗེས་སུ་ཞུགས་པ, སོ་སོར་རྟོག་པའི་རྗེས་སུ་ཞུགས་པ) — the Śrāvakabhūmi's names for the three vipaśyanās. No entry. 'đi theo sau' is the corpus rendering of རྗེས་སུ་འབྲང་བ (c057, c066, c086, c119, c136, c161, c189), so the two Tibetan expressions now land on one Vietnamese phrase; a ruling should either accept that or give this one a distinct word.

terms.vi: sở duyên tịnh hóa sự thẩm sát
terms.note: p0927 l.1, inside the Śrāvakabhūmi quotation. AS PRINTED the syllable is དཔྱད་པ, and it is translated as printed. The same book spells the same list item སྤྱད་པ་རྣམ་པར་སྦྱོང་བའི་དམིགས་པ at p0600 l.11, p0602 l.3 and p0607 l.1 (rendered 'sở duyên tịnh hóa hành vi' in c182 and 'sở duyên tịnh hóa hạnh' in c183), and the Śrāvakabhūmi's four ālambanas are ཁྱབ་པ / སྤྱད་པ་རྣམ་པར་སྦྱོང་བ / མཁས་པ / ཉོན་མོངས་པ་རྣམ་པར་སྦྱོང་བ. Two independent signals therefore agree that p0927 has a printing error for སྤྱད་པ. See flags — Phase 5 should decide whether to keep the literal reading or restore the list item. Note also the c182/c183 corpus split ('hành vi' vs 'hạnh') needs settling in the same ruling.

terms.vi: ba tư lương của thắng quán
terms.note: p0926 l.1, naming the three prerequisites from the middle Bhāvanākrama: སྐྱེས་བུ་དམ་པ་ལ་བརྟེན་པ, མང་དུ་ཐོས་པ་ཡོངས་སུ་བཙལ་བ, ཚུལ་བཞིན་དུ་སེམས་པ. Built from registered pieces (ཚོགས = tư lương, སྐྱེས་བུ་དམ་པ = bậc chân nhân, མང་དུ་ཐོས་པ = đa văn, ཚུལ་བཞིན་དུ = như lý).

terms.vi: tiếp xúc được với an lạc
terms.note: p0927 l.5, in the Saṃdhinirmocana definition of the third vipaśyanā. The view's རེག་པ = 'xúc' is scoped to the sixth link of dependent origination and its own note says that in བདེ་བ་ལ་རེག་པར་གནས་པ the word is 'sự tiếp xúc' in an ordinary sense; བདེ་བ takes 'an lạc' per the śamatha-section entry rather than bare 'lạc', which will not carry a Vietnamese predicate here.

terms.bo: མཚན་མར་འཛིན་པ (in the Śrāvakabhūmi / Asaṅga vipaśyanā gloss)
terms.note: Requested as the licensed compressed variant alongside the recorded prov `མཚན་མར་འཛིན་པ -> chấp lấy làm tướng` (view l.135, scoped to p0093). Reason for keeping 'chấp tướng' here rather than restoring: c276 L25 is the Śrāvakabhūmi sentence `ཤེས་རབ་དང་ལྡན་པའི་ཡིད་ལ་བྱེད་པ་རྣམ་པར་རྟོག་པ་དང་བཅས་པས་མཚན་མར་འཛིན་པར་བྱེད་པའི་ཚེ་ན`, and Tsongkhapa's own paraphrase of that exact sentence at p0578 is already rendered 'chấp tướng' in translation/c175.md L45, where the same chunk supplies the defining gloss: "'Chấp tướng' [ở đây] không phải là chấp thật, mà là sự phân định các nét sai biệt của cảnh." Restoring the long form in c276 alone would split the quotation from its own commentary. The corpus is genuinely split and only a central sweep can settle it: 'chấp lấy làm tướng' in c030, c231, c253, c274, c283 (sense-restraint and two-selves reification); 'chấp tướng' in c029, c032, c135, c175, c183, c279, c281, c276 (Hashang polemic and the technical Asaṅga/Saṃdhinirmocana usage). A defensible ruling is to license the short form for the technical non-reifying usage per c175's gloss and keep the long form for the reifying usage — but that must be ruled once, centrally, not per chunk.

terms.bo: ཕྱོགས (as a member of the six-fold paryeṣaṇā list, `དོན། དངོས་པོ། མཚན་ཉིད། ཕྱོགས། དུས། རིགས་པ`)
terms.note: p0928 l.5 (c276 L39). The view registers ཕྱོགས only in senses scoped elsewhere: 'tông' in `ཕྱོགས་སུ་བྱས་ནས` (p0753), 'lập trường' (debate position, p0838), 'phía' (p0838). None covers this list-member sense — the class or side an object falls under (inner vs outer, good vs bad qualities etc.). Wording KEPT. Needs its own entry because the six are enumerated here and expounded immediately in c277, so the two chunks must not drift.

c276 L19, L31, L35, L39 (p0926, p0927 l.3, p0928 l.1 and l.5). No entry of any kind in the view for either the present or the past stem, though this is one of the three Saṃdhinirmocana vipaśyanā types (`ཡོངས་སུ་ཚོལ་བ་ལས་བྱུང་བ` = '[loại] phát sinh từ sự chu biến tầm cầu') and one of the three vipaśyanā prerequisites at L19. Rendering is internally consistent and agrees with c277 ('sự đi theo sau việc chu biến tầm cầu'). Register both stems under one head so the two chunks cannot drift, and so it stays distinct from `ཡོངས་སུ་རྟོག་པ` = 'chu biến tầm tư'.

p0912 རྨ་བྱའི་མདོངས — the eye-pattern on a peacock's feathers, in the causeless-production refutation. No entry in the view. 'đốm mắt' chosen as the narrow sense (the ocellus); 'đốm lông' would lose the eye-shape that makes the example work.

terms.vi: những vị chủ trương [các pháp] phát sinh từ thể tánh
terms.note: p0912, the fourth position (causeless production, the naturalists). ངོ་བོ་ཉིད is rendered by the view's prov 'thể tánh'; note that Tsongkhapa immediately reclassifies the position as རྒྱུ་མེད་ལས་སྐྱེ་བ ('sinh từ không nhân'), so the Vietnamese must not pre-empt that by writing 'tự nhiên'.

p0913 མཐའ་བཞི་ལས་སྐྱེ་བ་མེད་པ and སྐྱེ་བའི་མཐའ་བཞི. The view registers མཐའ only as 'cực đoan' (ཡོད་པའི་མཐའ / ཆད་པའི་མཐའ) and as 'chỗ cuối cùng' (the fifth member of a five-fold list); neither fits. 'bốn biên' follows c228, the only other corpus occurrence. Kept deliberately distinct from མུ་བཞི = 'bốn trường hợp' (view prov), which stands three words away in the same sentence (མུ་བཞིའི་སྐྱེ་བ … མཐའ་བཞི་ལས་སྐྱེ་བ).

p0913 དངོས་སུ་དམ་བཅའ་བསྒྲུབ་པའི་སྦྱོར་ངག་མེད་དོ. GAP in the view, but corpus-established: 'luận thức' appears in c242, c250, c253, c254, c256, c257, c258, c265. Registering it so the wording is not read as a free choice.

terms.bo: ཚོགས་པ (of the two causes, self and other)
terms.note: p0912 གཉིས་ཀ་ཚོགས་པ་ལས་སྐྱེ་བ. Third scoped sense; see flags — the corpus is split between 'sự tụ hội' (c219, c261, and the view's p0734 entry) and 'sự tụ hợp' (c224, c260, and the view's c260 entry). 'sự tụ hội' chosen because this is the assemblage of causes, matching the p0734 entry, not the assemblage of parts.

terms.vi: phẩm thứ bảy [của *Căn Bản Trung Luận*]
terms.note: p0914. Follows the view's prov རབ་བྱེད (MMK chapter) = 'phẩm'. The Tibetan gives only the chapter number, so the title is bracketed as supplied; corpus practice is inconsistent — c212/c214/c216/c236/c256 write the title unbracketed, c209 likewise. A ruling on bracketing supplied titles would settle it.

p0915. The view carries prov འགྲེལ་པ -> 'bản Thích' (c021), prov འགྲེལ་པ (bare) -> 'bản chú giải' (p0422, the Bodhipathapradīpa commentary) and prov འགྲེལ་པ (bare) -> 'bản Chú Giải' (the Madhyamakāvatārabhāṣya) — three forms. 'bản Thích của [luận] ấy' chosen because that is exactly what c236 and c246 use for དེའི་འགྲེལ་པ referring to the Catuḥśataka. Note the corpus elsewhere names the same work *Chú Giải Tứ Bách Luận* when the full title is given (c235, c237, c238, c253, c262, c264, c267), so short form and full form currently take different Vietnamese words.

p0914-p0915, ~8×, the pivot of these two pages (རང་དབང་བའི་ངོ་བོ, རང་དབང་བར་བྱའོ, རང་དབང་དུ་མི་འགྱུར). Follows the view's prov རང་དབང -> 'tự chủ' and c237's 'có tự chủ'. Kept distinct from རང་རྒྱུད = 'tự lập' (the Svātantrika sense), which is a different word and stands in the neighbouring chunks.

terms.vi: sự vật tạo ra tác dụng
terms.note: p0915 དོན་བྱེད་པའི་དངོས་པོ་མེད་པ་ལ་མི་བྱེད་པས. Follows the view's prov དོན་བྱེད་པ -> 'cái tạo ra tác dụng' and c267's 'sự tạo ra tác dụng'. Load-bearing: the sentence turns on emptiness NOT meaning the non-existence of functioning things.

p0913 l.3, c272 L29 x2 and L34. The view's only headword for མཐའ་བཞི is `prov མཐའ་བཞི -> Tazhi` (view line 124), scoped to p0062 where it is quoted with ཞལ་ནས and read as a personal name — unusable here. Needs a scoped entry for the 'four extremes of arising' sense. Must stay distinct from མུ་བཞི -> 'bốn trường hợp' (view line 166), which c272 renders correctly in the very same sentence (མུ་བཞིའི་སྐྱེ་བ -> 'sự sinh theo bốn trường hợp'). Wording KEPT.

p0912 l.1, c272 L11. No headword in the view. Here སྲོག is the opponent's jīva — the persisting life-principle identified with the person Devadatta across lives (p0911 ends ལྷས་བྱིན་ཚེ་རབས་གཞན་དུ་ཡང་སྲོག་གི་བདག་ཉིད་དུ་ཡོད་པ), i.e. the ground of the self-production thesis. 'mạng sống' may under-read the technical sense; a scoped entry is owed (e.g. 'mạng' / 'mạng căn' / 'sinh mạng' with a note on the Sāṃkhya-style jīva). Wording KEPT per the gap rule.
p0924, ཐེག་དམན་གྱི་དགྲ་བཅོམ. No entry in the c275 view. 'A-la-hán' has 23 corpus occurrences already; registering the bare word so it is not read as unruled.
p0924, ×2. Follows the view's prov ས -> 'địa' (bodhisattva grounds) and corpus precedent (c133, c134).

p0923. The view has བདག་འཛིན -> 'ngã chấp' (p0266) and ཆོས་ཀྱི་བདག་མེད -> 'vô ngã của pháp'. Rendered 'cái chấp ngã của pháp' rather than 'ngã chấp của pháp' so it stays audibly parallel with 'vô ngã của pháp' in the same sentence. A ruling should fix which of the two shapes the compound takes.

p0923, in the definition of ཤེས་སྒྲིབ: ...མངོན་པར་ཞེན་པའི་སྒོ་བྱེད་ཀྱིས་སེམས་རྒྱུད་ལ་བག་ཆགས་བརྟན་པར་བཞག་པ. No entry. Rendered literally ('the door-maker', i.e. the agent through which the latencies get deposited) rather than glossed as 'phương tiện' or 'nhân', which would state a relation the Tibetan does not.

p0923, བཅོས་མའི་རང་བཞིན་ཡིན་གྱི་བདེན་པར་ནི་མ་ཡིན, inside the Madhyamakāvatārabhāṣya quotation. No entry. Kept literal ('tự tánh giả tạo') even though the phrase pairs the FIXED རང་བཞིན = 'tự tánh' with a contrived-nature sense; the quotation says it, so it stands.
p0925, opening pāda of Tsongkhapa's closing verse, of Gṛdhrakūṭa. No entry.
p0925, verse. First occurrence in the corpus (zero prior hits for 'Linh Thứu'). The established Vietnamese name is used; the literal 'Thứu Phong' / 'núi Kên Kên' was not.
p0925, verse: རྨད་བྱུང་ས་འཛིན་མཆོག་དེར་མངོན་གཤེགས་ནས. Poetic 'earth-holder' = mountain. Rendered plainly 'ngọn núi' inside the verse; a calque such as 'đấng trì địa' would read as a deity. No entry.
p0925, verse: ཐུབ་པས་དཔལ་གྱི་མགུར་ནས་བཀའ་སྩལ་པ. Honorific 'throat'. Follows the view's prov དཔལ་ལྡན -> 'Cát Tường'. See flag — མགུར can also be 'song', and the two readings give different lines.

p0925, verse: དེ་ནི་དཔལ་ལྡན་རྩ་བའི་ཤེས་རབ་ཅེས. The corpus title 'Căn Bản Trung Luận' (22 occurrences, c093/c208/c209/c212/c214/c216) is used so the reference is findable, but note the Tibetan here reads ཤེས་རབ ('wisdom'), not དབུ་མ — a fourth short form of this title alongside རྩ་ཤེ, རྩ་བ and འགྲེལ་པ-relative uses. Registering so Phase 5 does not read it as an invented title.

p0925, verse: རྣམ་བཤད་ཟླ་མེད་པ, of Buddhapālita's commentary. No entry. Kept distinct from འགྲེལ་པ = 'bản Thích' / 'bản chú giải' and from བཀྲལ་བ ('chú giải', verbal) — all three stand within four padas of each other here.

terms.vi: làm sáng tỏ lời và nghĩa
terms.note: p0925, verse: ཟླ་བའི་གཞུང་བཟང་ཚིག་དོན་གསལ་བ་འོ. A descriptor of the Prasannapadā (registered elsewhere as *Minh Cú Luận*). Rendered descriptively rather than as the title, since the Tibetan writes ཚིག་དོན་གསལ་བ, not ཚིག་གསལ; a ruling should say whether the verse should carry the title instead.

L30, ཞིང་བརྒྱ་འོད་ཀྱིས་འགེངས་པའི་ཆོ་འཕྲུལ་གྱིས -> 'làm trăm cõi tràn đầy ánh sáng'. WORDING KEPT. The view's prov ཞིང -> 'ruộng' (line 197) is scoped by its own note to the merit-field metaphor, and that same note already records 'cõi' as the reading used for buddha-fields (ཞིང་ཐམས་ཅད at p0200). Consistent with that precedent; logged only so the field/realm split is on record as still unruled.

terms.vi: cái kiến về nghĩa liễu nghĩa
terms.note: L23. Text CHANGED back to the registered prov 'nghĩa liễu nghĩa' (view line 327). Flagged because the attributive position is what pulled the draft toward the short 'liễu nghĩa': the full form needs a linking 'về' to parse, and ངེས་དོན་གྱི་ལྟ་བ recurs through the Prāsaṅgika chapters. If Phase 5 prefers the compact attributive 'cái kiến liễu nghĩa', that split should be licensed explicitly rather than left to drift.

p0886, twice: the second member of Candrakīrti's standard pair བྱམས་པ་དང་ཉེར་སྦས (Maitreya and Upagupta) used as the example of two things that cannot be one continuum. Left in Sanskrit transcription, matching the c263 precedent of Māndhātṛ / Devadatta / Yajñadatta. བྱམས་པ in the same phrase is the FIXED person-sense Di-lặc.

p0887 (ཞོས་བཀང་བའི་སྣོད, ཞོའི་སྣོད) and p0888 (ཞོའི་སྣོད་ཁང་པ). This is curd/yoghurt, in the pigeon-footprint simile. The glossary already registers ཞོ -> 'zho' as a weight/coin unit (p0192, གསེར་ཞོ་བཞི). Two unrelated senses of the same syllable; the entry needs scoping or the sweep will read one as drift from the other.
p0887, p0888. The bird of the Catuḥśataka-ṭīkā simile.
p0888, in the agent/object list གཅོད་པ་པོ་དང་གཅད་བྱ, བུམ་པ་དང་རྫ་མཁན, མེ་དང་བུད་ཤིང.

p0888, in the MMK XXVII verse ཉེ་བར་བླང་བ་ཇི་ལྟ་བུར། །ཉེ་བར་ལེན་པོ་ཡིན་པར་འགྱུར and its prose gloss. Uses the same Vietnamese root as the glossary's provisional ཉེ་བར་ལེན་པ = chấp thủ and as c263/c265, which render ཉེ་བར་ལེན་པ 'sự chấp thủ'. Registered separately because this is the passive/object form (the appropriated = the aggregates), paired against ཉེ་བར་ལེན་པོ.

p0888. The appropriator (= the self), explicitly glossed by the text: བདག་ནི་དེ་ལེན་པ་པོའོ. Kept as the active counterpart of ཉེ་བར་བླང་བ. Distinct from the glossary's ལེན་པ་པོ = 'người nhận' (recipient of a gift, p0461), which is a different context.

p0885, in the Madhyamakāvatāra verse མྱ་ངན་འདས་སྔོན་སྐད་ཅིག་ཉིད་ལ་ནི. The abstract-noun form (momentariness as a position), not the bare སྐད་ཅིག = sát-na already provisionally registered. Coined form — see flags.

terms.vi: nghiệp được tạo tác và kẻ tạo tác
terms.note: p0888, and the same pair as ལས་དང་བྱེད་པ་པོ inside the MMK X.15 and MAv verses. Here ལས is the grammatical/kāraka object (what is acted upon), not karma-with-a-result: the parallel examples are cutter/cut, potter/pot, fire/fuel. 'nghiệp' is retained per the FIXED ལས ruling and matches the Vietnamese convention for MMK ch. 8 (tác giả / tác nghiệp), but the ruling should record this scoped sense explicitly — see flags.
p0888, ད་ནི་དཀྱུས་མའི་དོན་བཤད་དེ — resuming the main line of the root text after the long digression on memory of past lives. No entry.

terms.vi: kẻ kinh nghiệm / kẻ nhớ lại
terms.note: p0887, སྔ་དུས་ཀྱི་མྱོང་མཁན་དང་ཕྱི་དུས་ཀྱི་དྲན་མཁན. Kept as transparent agent nouns; མྱོང་བ is rendered 'kinh nghiệm' (following c263) and 'thọ nhận' where its object is འབྲས་བུ, so that ལོངས་སྤྱོད = 'thọ dụng' stays distinct.

terms.bo: ལས (bare, grammatical karman inside a verse citation)
terms.vi: nghiệp (kept, under protest) — scoped exception requested
terms.kind: scoped exception to a FIXED entry
terms.note: p0888, two verse instances: MMK ch.10 བྱེད་པ་པོ་དང་ལས་གཅིག་འགྱུར and MA ལས་བྱེད་པོ་གཅིག་ཉིད་འགྱུར. FIXED ལས -> nghiệp is binding and no scoped exception exists, so the wording is KEPT. But the argument is generic agent/object (cutter/cut, potter/pot, fire/fuel), not karma, and the surrounding prose now reads 'đối tượng được tạo tác và kẻ tạo tác' per the registered prov བྱ་བའི་ལས. The verse and the prose it is cited to support therefore use two different Vietnamese words for the same Tibetan notion. Identical request already filed on c263 (view line 457, p0870). Requested ruling: a scoped exception licensing bare ལས -> 'đối tượng được tạo tác' (or 'nghiệp [tức đối tượng]') wherever it stands in the བྱེད་པ་པོ / ལས kāraka pair, then sweep c263 and c264 together.

p0887, standing in explicit contrast with རང་གི་ལུགས -> 'tự tông' in the same sentence. The view registers only bare ལུགས (line 444, with རང་གི་ལུགས -> tự tông and ཁོའི་ལུགས -> tông của vị ấy); the གཞན་ compound has no entry. Rendering follows c256, which uses 'tông của kẻ khác' three times. Should be registered so the pair 'tự tông' / 'tông của kẻ khác' is fixed rather than re-decided each chunk.

p0891 l.3, དབུ་ཚད་ཐམས་ཅད་ཀྱི་ལུགས — abbreviation of དབུ་མ + ཚད་མ, the two textual systems. No entry anywhere in the view and the string does not occur elsewhere in the corpus so far. Rendered analytically; if a compact form (e.g. 'Trung-Lượng') is wanted it should be fixed centrally.

p0889 l.3, ཕུང་པོའི་མཚན་ཉིད་གཟུགས་སུ་རུང་བ་སོགས — the defining characteristic of the form aggregate, cited as an example of ཕུང་པོའི་མཚན་ཉིད. Built from the registered prov རུང་བ -> 'khả dĩ' so it stays separable from འཐད་པ -> 'hợp lý'. No entry.

p0890 l.1–2, ×2 (བདག་དོན་གཞན་དུ་མེད; ཕུང་པོ་ལས་དོན་གཞན་པའི་བདག). No entry. Rendered to match c260, which renders དོན་གཞན་དུ་གྱུར་པའི་བ་ལང at p0870 as 'những con bò vốn là vật khác'. A more technical 'thật thể khác' was avoided because c284 already uses that phrase for རྫས་གཞན-type contexts.

terms.vi: cái lượng là cái thấy của thế gian
terms.note: p0890 l.4. Appositional genitive, read as 'the pramāṇa that is worldly seeing'. Built from c222's 'cái thấy của thế gian' for འཇིག་རྟེན་གྱི་མཐོང་བ (in the Madhyamakāvatārabhāṣya quotation at p0744) plus the bare ཚད་མ -> 'lượng' the view asks a ruling on.
p0889 l.1, ལས་བྱས་པ་ཆུད་ཟོས་པ, fourth of the six faults. No entry; wording taken from c264, which renders ཆུད་ཟ in the same argument (p0885–p0886) as 'thành ra luống mất'.
p0890 l.2, བདག་མིང་ཙམ་དུ་མ་རྟོགས་ཤིང. No entry. Kept apart from བཏགས་པ -> 'giả danh', which this same chunk uses for བདག་ཏུ་བཏགས་པ at p0889 l.3.
p0890 l.3, ངེས་པ་རྣམ་དག་མ་འདྲོངས་ན. No entry for འདྲོང / འདྲོངས. Read as the causative of འདྲེན་པ (to induce/draw forth certainty).

terms.bo: ལས (karman, the object member of the བྱེད་པ་པོ / ལས agent–object pair)
terms.note: Item 1, WORDING KEPT — scope gap, not a translator error. p0890, `མེ་དང་བུད་ཤིང་ལ་སོགས་པའི་བྱེད་པ་པོ་དང་ལས་གཅིག་ཏུ་འགྱུར་བ` (c265 L36). The view has `FIXED ལས -> nghiệp [karma]` and one scoped `prov ལས (work/task sense) -> việc làm`; neither covers ལས as the grammatical/ontological correlate of བྱེད་པ་པོ. 'cái được tạo tác' pairs correctly with the registered `prov བྱེད་པ་པོ -> kẻ tạo tác [kāraka/kartṛ]`, and rendering it 'nghiệp' here would destroy the fire/fuel agent-object argument. The same chunk correctly uses 'nghiệp' for ལས་བྱས་པ at L11, so the split is already observed in practice. Register as a third scoped sense.

Item 2, WORDING KEPT. The view holds TWO provisional entries for bare ལུགས: `prov ལུགས -> chủ trương` (whose own note says 'GAP — bare ལུགས has no entry') and the later, more specific `prov ལུགས (bare) -> tông (རང་གི་ལུགས -> tự tông; ཁོའི་ལུགས -> tông của vị ấy; ཟླ་བའི་ཞབས་ཀྱི་ལུགས -> tông của ngài Nguyệt [Xứng])`. c265 L36 follows the later entry. Reason for taking that branch rather than 'chủ trương': c265 already uses 'chủ trương' as its rendering of འདོད་པ / བཞེད་པ six times in the same paragraph (གཅིག་ཏུ་འདོད་ན, དེ་དག་གཅིག་ཏུ་འདོད་ན, བཞེད་པ་ཡིན་གྱི, མི་བཞེད་པ་མིན་ཏེ, སོ་སོའི་འདོད་པ), and the view registers `prov འདོད་པ (with ལུགས and རང་འདོད) -> chủ trương` — so moving ལུགས to 'chủ trương' would merge two different Tibetan words inside one sentence. The ཕྱོགས note's collision warning does not bite in this chunk: every ཕྱོགས here is rendered 'lập trường' (heading L13, L15, L34) per `prov ཕྱོགས (position in a debate) -> lập trường`, and རང་ལུགས does not occur. One ruling should pick between the two entries.

terms.bo: དབུ་མ / ཚད་མ, in the compound དབུ་ཚད
terms.note: Item 5, WORDING KEPT. p0891, `དབུ་ཚད་ཐམས་ཅད་ཀྱི་ལུགས` (L36). The view registers only the compound title དབུ་མ་ལ་འཇུག་པ; neither དབུ་མ nor ཚད་མ as a bare discipline name has an entry. The abbreviation དབུ་ཚད is the standard pairing of the two textual traditions.
