Item 5, WORDING KEPT. p0889, `བདག་ཏུ་བཏགས་པ་དོན་མེད་པར་འགྱུར་ཏེ` (c265 L20). The view carries སྒྲོ་འདོགས་པ -> 'gán đặt' and སྒྲོ་བཏགས -> 'sự gán đặt' (both the over-imputation sense, used correctly elsewhere in this chunk for མུ་སྟེགས་པའི་སྒྲོ་འདོགས་པ at L34), and `prov འདོགས་པ -> giả danh` (p0873/p0876). Plain བཏགས་པ / the ཐ་སྙད་འདོགས་པའི་གཞི construction is the neutral designating sense and needs its own entry so it stays apart from སྒྲོ་འདོགས.
Item 5, WORDING KEPT. p0889 l.1, `ངེས་པ་བརྟན་པོ་རྙེད་རྙེད་དུ་སྦྱང་བར་བྱ་སྟེ` (c265 L34). The reduplicated verb + དུ 'until one finds' idiom has no entry in the view.

p0879, མ་རིག་པའི་ལིང་ཐོག་གིས་བློའི་མིག་ཉམས་པར་བྱས་པ = 'những kẻ bị màng lòa của vô minh làm hỏng con mắt của cái trí'. The word occurs ONCE in the whole book (grep over source/clean: only p0879). No entry in the view. The cataract/film-over-the-eye image; 'màng lòa' keeps it concrete and avoids importing རབ་རིབ's usual rendering.

terms.vi: cách thức quyết đoán dứt khoát
terms.note: p0879, ཤིང་རྟ་ལ་རང་བཞིན་ཡོད་པ་འགོག་པའི་མཐའ་གཅོད་ལུགས. Also a single occurrence in the whole corpus (only p0879). No entry. Kept deliberately distinct from ངེས་པ = 'sự xác quyết', which stands three lines away in the same paragraph (ཐག་ཆོད་ཀྱི་ངེས་པ = 'sự xác quyết dứt khoát'); 'quyết đoán' vs 'xác quyết' is the only thing separating them at present and a ruling should confirm or replace it.

p0880, ཁྱབ་བྱ་རང་བཞིན་གྱིས་གྲུབ་ན ... ཁྱབ་བྱེད་ཁེགས་པས་ཁྱབ་བྱ་ཡང་ཁེགས་པ. This is EXACTLY the passage the view's prov ཁྱབ་བྱེད -> 'cái bao trùm' entry predicted and asked to be ruled together with its partner ('The partner ཁྱབ་བྱ (vyāpya) occurs later in the book ... and should be ruled at the same time'). 'cái bị bao trùm' is the transparent partner form; the Sino-Vietnamese alternative is 'sở biến' beside 'năng biến', which the ཁྱབ་བྱེད note argues against. Registering the partner so the pair is fixed as a pair.

p0877, MAv VI.162 pada སྐྱེ་བོ་རྣམས་ལ་ལེན་པོ་ཉིད་དུ་གྲུབ. Short (metri causa) form of ཉེ་བར་ལེན་པ་པོ, which Tsongkhapa's own prose gloss two sentences later spells out; both are rendered 'kẻ chấp thủ', following the view's prov ཉེ་བར་ལེན་པ -> 'chấp thủ'. Flagged rather than silently merged, because the view separately registers ལེན་པ་པོ -> 'người nhận' (pratigrāhaka, the recipient of a gift, p0461) — a different word in the same shape, and 'người nhận' would be wrong here.

terms.vi: bộ phận / cái có bộ phận
terms.note: p0877–p0878, ~6×, always in the doublet ཡན་ལག་དང་ཆ་ཤས / ཡན་ལག་ཅན་དང་ཆ་ཤས་ཅན (incl. inside the MAv VI.162 verse དེ་ཉིད་ཡན་ལག་ཅན་ཏེ་ཆ་ཤས་ཅན). The view registers ཡན་ལག -> 'chi phần' and ཡན་ལག་ཅན -> 'cái có chi phần' but has nothing for ཆ་ཤས. The two Tibetan words are near-synonyms deliberately paired by the text, so they must stay separable in Vietnamese: 'chi phần' / 'bộ phận'. Matches c261, which already uses 'bộ phận' for ཆ་ཤས.

p0880. The technical move of attaching a qualifier ('by intrinsic nature') to the object of negation before negating it. No entry; 'định ngữ' is a grammatical term borrowed for it. Alternatives a ruling might prefer: 'gắn thêm sự giản biệt' / 'thêm điều kiện phân định'. Load-bearing, because the whole second advantage turns on it.
p0879 and p0880, 2×. No entry. Kept distinct from འགོག་པ -> 'phá bỏ' and ཁེགས་པ -> 'bị bác bỏ', both of which occur in the same paragraphs.

p0879, མ་རིག་པའི་ལིང་ཐོག་གིས་བློའི་མིག་ཉམས་པར་བྱས་པ -> 'những kẻ bị màng lòa của vô minh làm hỏng con mắt của cái trí'. No entry in the view. WORDING KEPT. Standard cataract/film-over-the-eye image of the Madhyamaka; recurs through the vipaśyanā section, so it should be pinned once.

terms.vi: cách thức quyết đoán dứt khoát
terms.note: p0879, ཤིང་རྟ་ལ་རང་བཞིན་ཡོད་པ་འགོག་པའི་མཐའ་གཅོད་ལུགས་ནི. No entry for མཐའ་གཅོད nor for this compound. WORDING KEPT. Note the view has prov ལུགས -> 'chủ trương' (bare, gap-flagged) — here ལུགས is the 'manner/way' sense and was rendered 'cách thức', matching prov ཚུལ -> 'cách thức'; a ruling should say whether ལུགས and ཚུལ may share one Vietnamese word.

p0879 (ཤིང་རྟའི་ཐ་སྙད་བསྙོན་མི་ནུས་པར་སྣང་བ་ན) and p0880 (ཤིང་རྟའི་ཐ་སྙད་བསྙོན་མི་ནུས་པར་མཐོང་བ་ན). No entry. WORDING KEPT. The phrase carries the whole 'conventions cannot be denied though nothing is found' move and repeats verbatim in both pages, so it should be stable.
p0880, ཤིན་ཏུ་ཡ་མཚན་ཏེ -> 'thật hết sức kỳ diệu'. No entry. WORDING KEPT and deliberately kept apart from ངོ་མཚར below, which stands eight lines later.

terms.bo: གྲགས་པ (prasiddha sense; incl. འཇིག་རྟེན་ལ་གྲགས་པ, འཇིག་རྟེན་གྲགས་པའི་ཀུན་རྫོབ, མ་བརྟགས་པར་གྲགས་པས་ཡོད་པ)
terms.note: NOT a violation — recorded so the next repair stage does not 'fix' correct text. Rendered 'cực thành' throughout c262 per view line 386 ('qua cửa ngõ cực thành nơi thế gian' ×2, 'thế tục cực thành của thế gian', 'có do sự cực thành khi không khảo xét'). But the same view also carries 'được thế gian công nhận' (line 380-ish, འཇིག་རྟེན་གྲགས་པ -> 'chỗ thế gian công nhận') and 'quen thuộc' (line 390) for the identical prasiddha sense, with the conflict already noted in the view itself. c262 is internally consistent; the central ruling is still owed and governs the rest of the Prāsaṅgika section.

p0883 (×3), p0883 ང་ལས་ནུའི་བདག / སྟོན་པ་དང་ང་ལས་ནུ་གཉིས. The Tibetan name (lit. 'suckled from me') is the standard rendering of the cakravartin king Māndhātṛ, cited in the Madhyamakāvatāra-bhāṣya sūtra passage 'at that time I was king Māndhātṛ'. Rendered in Sanskrit transliteration to match the corpus precedent for Devadatta / Yajñadatta (already registered as personal names), rather than the Chinese-derived Đảnh Sinh vương. A ruling is owed on whether Tibetan-translated Indian personal names are restored to Sanskrit or given their Sino-Vietnamese form; this is the first occurrence of a Tibetan-calqued royal name in the corpus.

terms.vi: có cái thứ hai / chẳng có cái thứ hai
terms.note: p0881, 4× in the opening argument of the section. No entry. Literal rendering kept: the whole argument turns on the pair being an exhaustive dichotomy identified with 'one' and 'many', so a freer 'độc nhất / chẳng độc nhất' would hide the identification the text then makes explicit.

terms.vi: sự loại trừ cái thứ ba
terms.note: p0881, ཕུང་གསུམ་སེལ་བ་ཡིན་ཏེ. Tibetan logic term for a dichotomy that admits no third alternative. Rendered by sense; 'ཕུང' (heap) is not rendered literally, since 'đống thứ ba' would be opaque. Owed an entry so it is not re-decided.
p0883, ས་མྱུག་གཉིས — the contracted dvandva ས་བོན + མྱུ་གུ. Expanded to the full pair, matching the corpus's existing མྱུ་གུ = 'mầm'.

p0882, ཟླ་བ་དང་རི་བོང་ཅན — the standard synonym-pair example (moon / hare-possessor). Rendered literally so the point (that two names denote one thing) survives; 'thỏ đế' or a gloss 'mặt trăng' would destroy the example.

p0884. The view registers ཟླ་བའི་ཞབས = 'ngài Nguyệt [Xứng]' (ཞབས rendered by the honorific 'ngài') and ཟླ་བ = 'A-xà-lê Nguyệt [Xứng]'. With སློབ་དཔོན present, 'A-xà-lê' renders སློབ་དཔོན and ཞབས is left unrendered — stacking 'A-xà-lê, ngài Nguyệt [Xứng]' reads badly. Flagged rather than invented: a ruling should say whether ཞབས is dropped when སློབ་དཔོན is present.

terms.vi: chánh lý bác bỏ sự sinh từ cái khác
terms.note: p0883. Follows the view's prov རིགས་པ = 'chánh lý' (whose own note records that 'chánh' adds a qualifier the Tibetan lacks). No entry for the compound.

p0884, paired in the same sentence with རྟག་པར་འགྱུར = 'thành ra thường'. The view registers only ཆད་པའི་མཐའ = 'cực đoan đoạn' (under མཐའ). 'đoạn kiến' matches c262's 'thường kiến' / 'đoạn kiến' pair for the same doctrinal contrast.
p0883, third of the three faults from the Madhyamakāvatāra root and commentary. No entry. Kept literal — no 'mình' or other agent supplied, since the Tibetan names none.

terms.bo: འཁྲུལ་པ (sense: a person mistaken about a text / doctrine)
terms.kind: sense split on an existing prov entry
terms.note: p0884 l.1, དེ་ལྟར་གསུངས་པའི་མདོ་ལ་འཁྲུལ་པ་ཁ་ཅིག་ན་རེ -> 'Có một số kẻ lầm lẫn về bản kinh dạy như thế'. The view (line 398) rules prov `འཁྲུལ་པ` -> 'lầm loạn', but its own note scopes that to bhrānta SENSE-CONSCIOUSNESS, where it must stay visibly distinct from ཕྱིན་ཅི་ལོག = 'điên đảo' and བརྫུན་པ = 'hư vọng'. Here the word denotes people who misread a sūtra — no distinction from those two terms is at stake and 'lầm loạn' would read wrongly. Wording KEPT; the split needs recording.

terms.bo: མཁས་པ (contrastive force, in Tsongkhapa's prose paraphrase of MAv VI.126)
terms.kind: sense split on an existing prov entry
terms.note: p0884 l.1, མཁས་པས་ནི་བདག་ལ་རང་བཞིན་ཁས་བླང་བར་མི་བྱའོ -> 'bậc trí chẳng nên thừa nhận nơi ngã có tự tánh'. The bare headword (view line 138) is prov 'bậc học giả'; 'bậc trí' is registered only for verse (view lines 218, 254) and for the contrastive-with-བྱིས་པ sense (line 262). This occurrence is prose but near-verbatim MAv VI.126 and contrastive in force. Wording KEPT; the prose-contrastive case needs pinning so the Phase 5 sweep does not read it as drift.

terms.vi: Thánh Tam Luật Nghi Sở Thuyết
terms.note: p0906 l.1, the sutra cited for «Thế gian tranh biện với ta…». GAP — no entry in the view, no corpus precedent (grep for 'Luật Nghi' in translation/ finds only c123's *Nghi Quỹ Phát Tâm Và Luật Nghi*, a different work). Rendered from the Tibetan title element by element (འཕགས་པ = Thánh, སྡོམ་པ་གསུམ = Tam Luật Nghi following the view's prov སྡོམ་པ = 'luật nghi', བསྟན་པ = Sở Thuyết). Needs a fixed title before it recurs.

p0906 ×3, in the MAv 6.167 verse (ཡན་ལག་ཡོན་ཏན་འདོད་ཆགས་མཚན་ཉིད…ཡོན་ཏན་ཅན) and in the prose gloss སྔོན་པོ་ལ་སོགས་པ་ནི་ཡོན་ཏན. This is a DELIBERATE departure from the view's FIXED ཡོན་ཏན -> 'công đức': here ཡོན་ཏན is the Vaiśeṣika quality-category (blue etc. are the guṇa of a pot), not merit, and 'công đức' would make the sentence unreadable. It follows the view's already-registered prov ཡོན་ཏན (in ནམ་མཁའི་ཡོན་ཏན) -> 'phẩm tính'. Asking that the scoped exception be recorded against the fixed entry so Phase 5 does not read it as drift.

terms.bo: ལས (grammatical-object sense, in the བྱེད་པ་པོ / ལས pair)
terms.note: p0904 ×2 (ཤིང་རྟ་དང་དེའི་ཡན་ལག་རྣམས་བྱེད་པ་པོ་དང་ལས་སུ་འཇོག་པ; MAv verse ཉེར་ལེན་ལས་ཡིན), p0905 (MAv བྱེད་པོ་མེད་ཅན་ལས་མེད་པ), p0907 ×3 (MMK ch.8). The view registers only the compound བྱ་བའི་ལས -> 'đối tượng được tạo tác', whose own note says rendering it 'nghiệp' per the FIXED ལས entry 'would destroy the argument'. Here the bare ལས carries exactly that sense, four chunks later. Requesting the scoping be widened from the compound to bare ལས inside the agent/action pair.

p0906 ×2, MAv 6.167 verse (མཚན་གཞི་མེ་ལ་སོགས) and the prose gloss (བུམ་པ་ནི་…མཚན་གཞི་ཡིན). No entry. Rendered so it stays visibly paired with the view's prov མཚན་ཉིད (definition sense) -> 'định nghĩa', which is what the same passage glosses (ལྟོ་ལྡིར་བ… ནི་མཚན་ཉིད་ཡིན). 'sự cơ sở' / 'sở tướng' are the alternatives if the ruling goes otherwise.

terms.bo: ཆགས་པ / ཆགས (rakta: the one who has attachment)
terms.note: p0906 l.3 (ཆགས་པ་ནི་དེའི་རྟེན) and the MAv verse (ཆགས་ in the ཡོན་ཏན་ཅན ཡན་ལག་ཅན ཆགས list); p0907 ཆགས་ཅན་གྱི་གང་ཟག -> 'hạng người có tham đắm'. Follows the view's prov ཆགས་པ -> 'tham đắm', but here the word is the agent-noun (the attached PERSON), not the attachment, so it needed 'kẻ …'. Kept distinct from འདོད་ཆགས -> 'tham ái', which stands in the same sentence as its correlate.

terms.bo: སྙིང་པོ (pith of a plant, in the ཆུ་ཤིང simile)
terms.note: p0904 l.1 ×2, the closing stanza of the Samādhirāja quotation (ཆུ་ཤིང་རློན་པའི་སྡོང་པོ… སྙིང་པོ་མེད). The view's prov སྙིང་པོ -> 'tinh yếu' is scoped by its own note to p0066 and explicitly kept apart from the 'heart/essence' of titles; neither sense fits a plantain trunk. 'lõi' follows c040 ('như cây chuối và như bọt nước, không có lõi thực').

terms.vi: cái sở kiến / cái năng kiến
terms.note: p0907 l.1, in the list བསྐྱེད་བྱ་སྐྱེད་བྱེད / འགྲོ་བ་དང་འགྲོ་བ་པོ / བལྟ་བྱ་ལྟ་བྱེད / ཚད་མ་དང་གཞལ་བྱ. No entry. Rendered on the năng/sở pattern the view already fixes for the neighbouring pair སྲེག་བྱེད / བསྲེག་བྱ -> 'năng thiêu / sở thiêu', and to match ཚད་མ / གཞལ་བྱ -> 'lượng / sở lượng' three words later in the same list.
p0906 l.3, གྱོ་མོ་ལ་སོགས་པ་ནི་ཡན་ལག — the potsherds given as the ཡན་ལག (parts) of a pot. No entry.
p0906 l.1, MAv 6.166 list (ཁང་ཁྱིམ་ཤིང་རྟ་ཕྲན་དང་མགྲོན་གནས). No entry.

terms.bo: མཚན་ཉིད (lakṣaṇa paired with མཚན་གཞི, in the MAv list of relative pairs)
terms.note: decisions.md ('Rules that apply across the glossary') requires a flag rather than a silent choice where the characteristic/definition reading is not obvious. Here it IS obvious - the term stands inside a list of five correlative pairs and is answered by མཚན་གཞི - so 'tướng' was restored per the primary entry rather than left as 'định nghĩa'. Recording the scoping so the reading is on file and Phase 5 does not read this as drift against the line-403 'định nghĩa' entry. See also 'remaining' for the flag text.

terms.bo: ཡོན་ཏན (attribute/guṇa of a substance, bare, and ཡོན་ཏན་ཅན = guṇin)
terms.vi: phẩm tính (ཡོན་ཏན་ཅན -> cái có phẩm tính)
terms.note: p0906, MAv verse (ཡན་ལག་ཡོན་ཏན་... / ཡོན་ཏན་ཅན་ཡན་ལག་ཅན་...) and the prose gloss སྔོན་པོ་ལ་སོགས་པ་ནི་ཡོན་ཏན. Formally a departure from FIXED ཡོན་ཏན -> công đức (line 34), but a genuine sense split: this is the Vaiśeṣika-style attribute of a substance (blue etc. of a pot), where 'công đức' would be plainly wrong. Precedent exists at line 495, `prov ཡོན་ཏན (in ནམ་མཁའི་ཡོན་ཏན) -> phẩm tính`, scoped to a compound that does not reach bare ཡོན་ཏན. WORDING KEPT; the 'phẩm tính' entry should be extended to bare ཡོན་ཏན in the attribute sense, with ཡོན་ཏན་ཅན covered too, so the FIXED entry is not read as broken.

terms.bo: འགྲོ་བ / འགྲོ་བ་པོ (gamana / gantṛ - the act of going and its agent, in the MMK-derived list of mutually dependent pairs)
terms.note: p0907, བསྐྱེད་བྱ་སྐྱེད་བྱེད་དང་། འགྲོ་བ་དང་འགྲོ་བ་པོ་དང་། བལྟ་བྱ་ལྟ་བྱེད་དང་། ཚད་མ་དང་གཞལ་བྱ. The view registers only `prov འགྲོ་བ -> chúng sinh` (line 124) and `prov འགྲོ་བ (gati sense) -> thú` (line 211); neither covers this sense, and 'chúng sinh' would destroy the argument (the whole point is action/agent interdependence, the MMK gatāgata analysis). Wording KEPT; a third scoped sense is owed. Note འགྲོ་བ་པོ has no entry of any kind.

terms.bo: སྙིང་པོ (concrete/physical pith, in the plantain-trunk simile)
terms.note: p0904 l.1, ཆུ་ཤིང་རློན་པའི་སྡོང་པོ་ལ། སྙིང་པོ་འདོད་ཕྱིར... ནང་དང་ཕྱི་རོལ་ཀུན་ན་སྙིང་པོ་མེད. The view's `prov སྙིང་པོ -> tinh yếu [sāra]` (line 110) is scoped by its own note to p0066 (སྙིང་པོ་མེད་པའི་ཕྱོགས་དོར་ནས་སྙིང་པོ་ལེན) and expressly distinguished from the 'heart/essence' of text titles. Here it is the literal pith of a banana trunk and 'tinh yếu' is unusable. Wording KEPT; the concrete sense needs its own scoped entry.

terms.vi: cực thành / cực thành nơi thế gian / cực thành của thế gian / qua cửa ngõ cực thành nơi thế gian
terms.note: p0904 MAv verse (དེ་བཞིན་འཇིག་རྟེན་གྲགས་པས་ཕུང་པོ་དང་), p0906 འཇིག་རྟེན་གྱི་གྲགས་པ་རིགས་པས་མི་འགོག་པ and the MAv verse འཇིག་རྟེན་གྲགས་པའི་སྒོ་ནས་ཡོད་པ་ཡིན. NOT a translator error - this is the standing conflict already documented inside the view: four competing provisional renderings of the one prasiddha sense ('cực thành' at 419/421/513, 'quen thuộc' at 427, 'chỗ thế gian công nhận' at 405, 'công nhận' at 493), plus 'danh tiếng' for the unrelated fame sense (309). The chunk used the best-attested form, is internally consistent, and correctly avoided 'thừa nhận', which the view reserves for ཁས་ལེན / ཁས་བླངས་པ and which this chunk uses for ཞལ་གྱིས་བཞེས་པ in the same sentence (L53). WORDING KEPT. One central ruling is owed; it must also cover the compound འཇིག་རྟེན་གྲགས་པའི་སྒོ་ནས.

terms.vi: phẩm thứ tám [của *Căn Bản Trung Luận*]
terms.note: p0907 l.1. The view registers only རབ་བྱེད་བཅོ་བརྒྱད་པ -> 'phẩm thứ mười tám' (line 367) as a whole-phrase entry, alongside two requests (lines 361, 383) for རབ་བྱེད = 'phẩm' in the MMK-chapter sense to be separated from རབ་བྱེད as a work-title element ('luận', in ཕུང་པོ་ལྔའི་རབ་བྱེད). This is a new instance of the same scoped sense; one ruling on རབ་བྱེད = phẩm (chapter of the MMK) covers both the eighth and the eighteenth and closes the request. Wording KEPT, including the bracketed expansion of the work's name, which is supplied and marked as supplied.

First and ONLY occurrence in the whole book (p0919). Title rendered from the Tibetan གླང་པོའི་རྩལ = 'elephant's strength/prowess' -> 'Tượng Lực'. NOTE the alternative: the Sanskrit Hastikakṣya and the Chinese 象腋 give 'Tượng Dịch' (elephant's flank/armpit), which is the established East-Asian title. The Tibetan translators evidently read rtsal = strength, so the Tibetan-based rendering was chosen per the 'source is the Tibetan' rule. A ruling should confirm which of the two the project wants.

p0922 l.1, སློབ་དཔོན་འཕགས་པའི་གཞུང་དེ་དག. Read as Nāgārjuna: the 'those texts' referred to are MMK ch.18 (rab byed bco brgyad pa) and the Prasannapadā just quoted, and c208/c275 already render འཕགས་པ (as father of འཕགས་པ་ཡབ་སྲས) 'bậc Thánh' = Nāgārjuna. Follows c201's 'A-xà-lê, bậc thánh Vô Trước' for སློབ་དཔོན་འཕགས་པ་ཐོགས་མེད. NOT read as Āryadeva — no Āryadeva text is quoted here. See flags.

p0922, both the full and contracted forms, paired throughout with ཤེས་བྱའི་སྒྲིབ་པ / ཤེས་སྒྲིབ. The view registers ཤེས་སྒྲིབ / ཤེས་བྱའི་སྒྲིབ་པ -> 'sở tri chướng' (prov) but has no entry for its counterpart. 'phiền não chướng' is already corpus use (c168, c234) and keeps the fixed ཉོན་མོངས = phiền não visible.
p0922, ×2, in the simile of one realization of selflessness being the antidote to both. No entry in the view. Corpus precedent: c281.
p0922, ×3, the counterpart of མཐོང་སྤང. No entry in the view. Corpus precedent: c281.

MMK 18.2cd quoted at p0920. Deliberately kept in the ང/ངའི register (quotation marks) and NOT collapsed onto c209's 'chấp ngã / chấp ngã sở', which that chunk uses for བདག་ཏུ་འཛིན་པ / བདག་གིར་འཛིན་པ — the Tibetan uses different words in the verse (ང-) and in the prose (བདག-), and this chunk contains both within ten lines. In the prose I used 'chấp ngã và chấp ngã sở' for བདག་དང་བདག་གིར་འཛིན་པ, following c209/c270.
p0919, མཚན་མར་འཛིན་པའི་སྤྲོས་པའི་དྲ་བ་བཅད་དུ་མེད་པས. Uses the view's སྤྲོས་པ -> 'hí luận' and the view's མཚན་མར་འཛིན་པ -> 'chấp lấy làm tướng'. No entry for དྲ་བ.

terms.bo: ཉེ་བར་ཞི་བ (of elaborations, not the tenth-quality list)
terms.note: p0921, inside the Prasannapadā: སྤྲོས་པ་མ་ལུས་པ་ཉེ་བར་ཞི་བའི་མཚན་ཉིད་ཅན. The view's ཉེ་བར་ཞི་བ -> 'cận tịch tĩnh' is explicitly scoped to the third of the ten qualities (glossed ཤེས་རབ་ཀྱི་བསླབ་པ) and would be unreadable here. Kept the view's ཞི་བ -> 'tịch tĩnh' as the stem. A scoped second sense is owed.

p0921, ཉོན་མོངས་པའི་ཚོགས་འཇིག་ཚོགས་ལ་ལྟ་བའི་རྩ་བ་ཅན, ×3 in the Prasannapadā. A FOURTH sense of ཚོགས, after the view's 'tư lương' (saṃbhāra), 'các việc' (set of activities) and 'tổ hợp' (causal aggregate). None of the three fits. Note it stands beside འཇིག་ཚོགས (satkāya, 'hoại tụ') in the same phrase, so the Vietnamese must not reuse 'tụ' there.

p0921 l.3, སྒྲུབ་བྱེད་ཡང་དག་པས་བསྟན་པ་ཡིན་པས. Follows c258's སྒྲུབ་བྱེད་ཀྱི་ཚད་མ = 'lượng năng thành' and c098's 'năng thành'. Deliberately avoids 'chánh lý', which the view assigns to རིགས་པ, and 'lý chứng', which would import a word the Tibetan does not write.
p0922, སྒྲིབ་པ་གཉིས་ཀའི་ས་བོན་དྲུངས་འབྱིན་པའི་གཉེན་པོ. No entry. Uses the view's ས་བོན -> 'hạt giống' and གཉེན་པོ -> 'đối trị'.

p0922, སྤྱོད་པ་རླབས་ཆེན་པོ་གཞན་མང་པོ. No entry; occurs 6× in the book. Deliberately NOT 'rộng lớn', which c275 (the continuation of this same section) uses for སྤྱོད་པ་རྒྱ་ཆེན་པོ four pages later — the two Tibetan modifiers would otherwise collapse.

p0919 verse, མཐར་ལྟ་བ་ལ་བརྟེན་པར་ཡོང་མི་བྱེད. Contracted form of མཐའ་འཛིན་གྱི་ལྟ་བ; c273 (immediately preceding, p0918) already renders མཐར་འཛིན་གྱི་ལྟ་བ as 'biên kiến'. In the same p0919 sentence bare མཐར་འཛིན is rendered 'sự chấp biên' so the noun and the verbal noun stay visibly related but distinct.

terms.vi: dòng luân hồi sinh tử tiếp nối
terms.note: p0920. བརྒྱུད་པ here is the chain/succession, not the lineage sense; kept apart from the view's རྒྱུད -> 'tâm tương tục'.

p0921 l.1, ×2 inside the Prasannapadā quotation: `ཉོན་མོངས་པའི་ཚོགས་འཇིག་ཚོགས་ལ་ལྟ་བའི་རྩ་བ་ཅན` -> 'khối phiền não lấy hoại tụ kiến làm gốc rễ'. Text KEPT. The view registers ཚོགས only as 'tư lương' [saṃbhāra], as 'các việc' (assembly/host of activities, p0468) and as 'tổ hợp' (causal assemblage, p0720). None fits the mass/host of afflictions; this is a fourth scoped sense. Note the same sentence has འཇིག་ཚོགས (the perishable collection) two words later, so 'khối' was deliberately not reused there — 'hoại tụ kiến' keeps its registered form and the two ཚོགས stay visibly distinct.

p0922 l.1 (`ཉོན་མོངས་པའི་སྒྲིབ་པ་ཙམ་སྤོང་ནུས` and the contracted `ཉོན་སྒྲིབ་སྤོང་བའི་ཐབས་ཙམ་དུ་བསྒོམ`). Text KEPT. The view carries the counterpart pair ཤེས་སྒྲིབ / ཤེས་བྱའི་སྒྲིབ་པ -> 'sở tri chướng' but nothing for these; both the full and the contracted Tibetan form should be registered on one Vietnamese, as was done for ཤེས་སྒྲིབ.

p0922 l.1, `སངས་རྒྱས་དོན་དུ་གཉེར་བས`. No entry in the view. The repair moved 'cầu mong' -> 'mưu cầu' to restore the sense of an act rather than a wish, but corpus precedent is 'mong cầu' (c114 renders the sa-bcad `གཞན་དོན་དོན་དུ་གཉེར་བའི་བློ་སྦྱང་བ` as 'Tu tập cái trí mong cầu lợi ích cho kẻ khác'). One ruling should settle whether the corpus uses 'mong cầu' or 'mưu cầu' for དོན་དུ་གཉེར་བ; if 'mong cầu' wins, c274 should be swept back to it and the c114 heading kept.

Checker item 8. The view has prov ཉན་ཐོས -> 'thanh văn' (lowercase, line 87) while prov ཉན་རང -> 'hàng Thanh văn Độc giác' (line 204, capitalised). c274 writes 'các Thanh văn' / 'Đấng Chiến Thắng cùng các Thanh văn' (p0919 `རྒྱལ་བ་ཉན་ཐོས་དང་བཅས་པས`, ×2, once inside the Hastikakṣya verse) and 'hàng Thanh văn Độc giác' (p0922, matching line 204 exactly). Text KEPT — the inconsistency is between the two glossary entries, not within the chunk. A single casing ruling is owed covering ཉན་ཐོས, ཉན་རང and རང་སངས་རྒྱས (already FIXED as capitalised 'Độc Giác'), and whichever way it goes the sweep is mechanical.

p0931, p0932 (×2). No entry in the view. Occurs exactly 4× in the whole book (p0427, p0931, p0932, p0940) and ALWAYS spelled ཙོམ་ (never ཙམ་འཇོག — zero hits), so it is a real lexical item, not a typo for ཙམ. Rendering follows c280, which already renders the p0940 occurrence 'một sự an trụ suông'. It is the pivot term of this whole refutation (the opponent's 'just plopping the mind down'), so it should be registered before the rest of the ལུགས་གཞན་དགག་པ section is repaired.

p0931, ×2: འདི་ཡིན་འདི་མ་ཡིན་གྱི་ངོས་བཟུང་ཐམས་ཅད་དང་བྲལ་བ and ཅིར་ཡང་ངོས་བཟུང་ས་མ་བྱུང་བ. No entry. Deliberately NOT 'xác định' (which would collide with ངེས་པ) and not 'chấp' (which is འཛིན་པ, used four times in the same sentences and kept as 'chấp lấy').

p0933, inside the Bhāvanākrama III quotation. The bare ག་ཡ་གཽ་རི is already rendered *Gayāgaurī* in c112, c131, c133, but the title is absent from this chunk's view. འཕགས་པ prefixed = 'Thánh'. Registering so the honorific-prefixed form does not drift to a different Vietnamese title.

p0933, inside the Bhāvanākrama III quotation; only occurrence in the book. Distinct from the already-used *Kinh Bí Mật Bất Tư Nghì* (བསམ་གྱིས་མི་ཁྱབ་པའི་གསང་བ, c025/c100/c132/c135) — the two must not collapse onto one Vietnamese title.

p0932, དེ་འདྲ་བའི་མཐུན་ལུགས་དེ་ཤེས་ན. ལུགས here is the plain 'mode/way' sense, NOT the 'chủ trương / tông' sense the view registers for bare ལུགས (lines 338, 480). Recorded so a Phase 5 sweep does not read it as drift; the same page also has ལུགས་གཞན / རང་གི་ལུགས in the doctrinal sense.

terms.vi: cách thức đặt [tâm] của cái trí
terms.note: p0932. The view registers འཇོག་ཚུལ -> 'cách thức an lập', but that entry is explicitly scoped to the section heading ཐལ་རང་གཉིས་ཀྱི་འཇོག་ཚུལ (s244). Here the sense is how the mind settles in meditation, so 'an lập' would be plainly wrong. Rendered to match c280/c281, which use 'đặt [tâm]' for འཇོག་པ throughout this same argument.
p0931, དེ་ལྟར་བསྒོམ་མཁན་དེས. No entry; agentive noun from བསྒོམ་པ (view line 328, itself unruled between 'tu thiền' and 'tu').

p0933, inside the Bhāvanākrama III quotation. Follows the view's བླུན་པ -> 'kẻ ngu' and སྐྱེ་བོ -> 'người / hạng người'. See the flag: this walks straight into the བླུན་པ / བྱིས་པ collision the view's own note already asks to be ruled.
p0933, ཐབས་ཤིན་ཏུ་ཟུར་ཕྱིན་པར་སྤངས་པ. No entry.
p0934, བདག་ཕུང་བར་བྱས་ནས་གཞན་ཕུང་བར་བྱེད་པ, inside the quotation. No entry. Kept distinct from གནོད་པ = 'tổn hại' (view line 176).
p0934, ངེས་དོན་གྱི་ལྟ་སྒོམ་འདྲ་བ. The abbreviated dvandva ལྟ་བ + སྒོམ་པ. No entry; unpacked rather than compressed, so ལྟ་བ = 'kiến' stays visible.
p0934, ཧྭ་ཤང་གི་འདོད་པ་བཀོད་ནས. No entry.

terms.kind: collision, gap not error — text KEPT
terms.note: COLLISION with the entry above, inside four lines of one another: `ཧྭ་ཤང་གི་ལུགས` (p0932) and `ཧྭ་ཤང་གི་འདོད་པ` (p0934) are both 'chủ trương của Hashang' and are now indistinguishable in Vietnamese. View line 453 already records exactly this unresolved pair (འདོད་པ has no entry; c249 renders it 'chủ trương', the word the view registers for ལུགས). One ruling should settle ལུགས and འདོད་པ together rather than either alone.

terms.vi: chấp cái kiến của mình là tối thượng
terms.kind: scope request on an existing prov entry — text KEPT
terms.note: p0934 l.1, inside the Bhāvanākrama (Sgom rim tha ma) quotation. The view carries `prov ལྟ་བ་མཆོག་ཏུ་འཛིན་པ -> kiến thủ [dṛṣṭiparāmarśa]` (line 208, scoped to the list of ten at p0296). The departure is deliberate and I judge it correct: here the phrase is descriptive prose about a polemicist holding his own opinion supreme, in a list with ཐོས་པ་ཉུང་བ / བསྙེན་བཀུར་མ་བྱས་པ, not the technical eighth of the five/ten wrong views; and `བདག་གི` cannot be carried inside the fused Sino-Vietnamese 'kiến thủ'. Requested: scope line 208 to the dṛṣṭiparāmarśa list and license the descriptive rendering where བདག་གི modifies ལྟ་བ. The silent departure with no flag is the actual defect and is remedied by this entry.

terms.vi: chẳng phân biệt / cái định chẳng phân biệt bất cứ điều gì
terms.kind: reconciliation of two prov entries — text KEPT
terms.note: View line 282 records `prov མི་རྟོག་པ -> không phân biệt`; c278 uses 'chẳng phân biệt' throughout. The difference is the negation particle only, and this chunk's (and c280's) whole negation register is 'chẳng' — 'không' would be inconsistent within the same section. Requested: rule the particle centrally rather than per-chunk. Separately, `ཅིར་ཡང་མི་རྟོག་པའི་ཏིང་ངེ་འཛིན` (p0934) is rendered literally rather than with the registered `prov མི་རྟོག་པའི་ཏིང་ངེ་འཛིན -> định vô phân biệt` (line 139); the literal form is required here because `ཅིར་ཡང` ('about anything at all') must be carried and cannot be fitted into the fused compound. The two entries should be reconciled: fused 'định vô phân biệt' for the bare compound, expanded form when ཅིར་ཡང modifies it.

terms.kind: scope note on the fix above
terms.note: p0934 l.3, in the pair `སྦྱིན་པ་གཏོང་བ་དང་ཚུལ་ཁྲིམས་བསྲུང་བ`. Rendered 'việc ban cho bố thí' to carry the verb `གཏོང་བ` per the view's `prov གཏོང་བ -> sự ban cho` (line 283), against the FIXED སྦྱིན་པ -> 'bố thí' for the object. Note the view's other, higher-priority entry (line ~276, `གཏོང་བ` dāna sense -> buông xả / bố thí / đem cho, marked HIGH PRIORITY, still unruled) covers the same verb; when that ruling is made it should say what to do with the verb+object collocation `སྦྱིན་པ་གཏོང་བ` specifically, where collapsing the verb into 'bố thí' would flatten a symmetry the Tibetan builds ('give giving / guard morality').

p0935, སངས་རྒྱས་ཀྱི་གསུང་རབ་དང་རྒྱན་དྲུག་ལ་སོགས་པའི་མཁས་པའི་གཞུང. First occurrence in the corpus (grep: only p0935). The Six Ornaments of Jambudvīpa. Descriptive Vietnamese chosen over the Sino-Vietnamese 'Lục Trang Nghiêm' to match the corpus pattern already set by ཤིང་རྟ་ཆེན་པོ = 'bậc Đại Xa'. Either is defensible; a ruling is wanted before it recurs.

terms.vi: Đấng Tự Tại của chánh lý
terms.note: p0937 and p0938, introducing two Pramāṇavārttika citations, i.e. Dharmakīrti. First occurrence in the corpus. Rendered as the epithet the Tibetan actually writes, NOT expanded to 'ngài Pháp Xứng' — the text names him by title only. Uses the corpus's རིགས་པ = 'chánh lý' plus the Suhṛllekha-vocative precedent དབང་ཕྱུག = 'đấng Tự Tại'. Must stay distinct from the glossary's འཇིག་རྟེན་དབང་ཕྱུག = Thế Tự Tại, རྣལ་འབྱོར་དབང་ཕྱུག = Du-già Tự Tại, and the non-Buddhist deity དབང་ཕྱུག = Tự Tại Thiên.

p0936-p0937, དབུ་མ་རིགས་ཚོགས་ལ་སོགས་པར — Nāgārjuna's Collection of Reasonings. First occurrence in the corpus (grep: only p0937). Established Sino-Vietnamese rendering; the title names a collection, not a single work, so it takes no 'Luận'.

p0937 (×2) and p0938, paired against མངོན་གྱུར = 'hiện tiền' in the manifest/hidden dichotomy that drives the whole argument. NO entry in the view. Wording aligned deliberately to the corpus, which uses 'khuất lấp' in exactly this sense in c236 ('ý nghĩa của thật tánh là điều khuất lấp đối với phàm phu'), c009, c131, c254, and in c280 — the very next chunk, continuing this same sentence. Register it so the pair ལོག་གྱུར/ལྐོག་གྱུར vs མངོན་གྱུར is fixed for the rest of the vipaśyanā section.

p0937, the manifest half of the pair with ལོག་གྱུར. No entry. Kept distinct from མངོན་སུམ = 'hiện lượng' (pramāṇa sense, glossary prov) and མངོན་སུམ་དུ་རྟོགས་པ = 'hiện chứng', both of which occur in the same paragraphs.

p0935, འཁྲུལ་པའི་བརྫུན་ཕུགས་རྡིབ་པ — the 'false lair/stronghold' of error that scripture and reasoning must bring down. No entry. Kept apart from the glossary's བརྫུན = 'nói dối' (mṛṣāvāda, the verbal non-virtue) and from བརྫུན་པ = 'hư vọng'; this is a metaphorical noun, not the ethical term.

p0937, Dharmakīrti verse འདི་ཡུལ་སུན་ཕྱུང་མེད་པར་ནི. No entry. Falls into the unresolved negation family already flagged in the view (དགག་པ / འགོག་པ / བཟློག་པ), where 'bác bỏ', 'phủ định' and 'phá bỏ' are still unallocated; this chunk uses 'phá bỏ' for འགོག་པ and 'bác bỏ' for སུན་ཕྱུང, keeping them separable. Should be settled with that family, not alone.

p0938, དཀར་ཟལ་བ་ལང་ཡིན་ཡང་བ་ལང་གི་མཚན་ཉིད་དུ་མི་རུང་བ — the logician's stock example that a particular cow is not the definition of cow. First and only occurrence in the corpus. ཟལ is not securely identified; see flags. Rendered on དཀར = white.

p0935, རྡོ་འཕེན་པའི་ལག་མགོ་ནས་འཛིན་པ — in the dog-and-stone / lion-and-thrower simile, seizing the stone-thrower's hand rather than chasing the stone. Rendered literally (ལག = hand, མགོ = head/tip). No entry.

terms.vi: Kinh Thánh Giả Văn-thù Du Hý
terms.kind: declared departure from a prov ruling — needs a ruling either way
terms.note: p0936 l.3, quoted inside the Bhāvanākrama III passage. The view registers prov འཇམ་དཔལ་རྣམ་པར་རོལ་པའི་མདོ -> 'Kinh Văn-thù Du Hý' (view l.318), built at p0494 where the Tibetan had no འཕགས་པ. Here the Tibetan does write འཕགས་པ. The chunk's original 'Kinh Thánh Văn-thù Du Hý' was both an undeclared departure and a bad string — 'Kinh Thánh' is the Vietnamese for the Bible. Changed to 'Kinh Thánh Giả Văn-thù Du Hý', using the view's prov འཕགས་པ -> 'bậc thánh' in its Sino-Vietnamese title form 'Thánh Giả', rather than dropping འཕགས་པ, which would be an omission from the source. A central ruling is owed: either (a) the registered short form 'Kinh Văn-thù Du Hý' is the fixed title and འཕགས་པ is absorbed wherever it appears in citations, or (b) 'Kinh Thánh Giả Văn-thù Du Hý' is registered as the form used when འཕགས་པ is written. Whichever is chosen, record that 'Kinh Thánh + <name>' must never be produced for འཕགས་པ before a title.

terms.kind: gap with a live corpus split — must settle c279 and c280 together
terms.note: p0937 l.3 (L49, ×3: མངོན་གྱུར་ཡིན་ནམ་ལོག་གྱུར་ཡིན, ལོག་གྱུར་དུ་སོང་བའི་གང་ཟག) and p0938 l.3 (L58, ལོག་ཏུ་གྱུར་པ, ལོག་གྱུར་གྱི་དོན). The epistemic pair: an object manifest to direct perception vs. one hidden from it and reachable only by inference. No ruling in the view; the nearest entry, མངོན་སུམ་གྱིས་འགྲུབ་པ -> 'thành lập bằng hiện lượng' (view l.335), covers the pramāṇa མངོན་སུམ, not this pair. Wordings kept. LIVE SPLIT: c280 — the immediately following chunk of this same continuous argument, and in places the same sentence-chain — renders ལོག་གྱུར as 'ẩn khuất' ('nghĩa vô ngã là ẩn khuất') where c279 uses 'khuất lấp'. One ruling must fix both, and both chunks then need the sweep. Note also that 'hiện tiền' already carries མངོན་སུམ་དུ་མཆོད་པ elsewhere in the glossary, so the ruling should say whether མངོན་གྱུར may share that word or needs its own.

terms.bo: འགོག་པ (verbal: to negate/refute an object under analysis)
terms.kind: gap — sense split needed; wording kept
terms.note: p0937 l.1, ཡུལ་རྣམས་ལ་དཔྱད་ནས་འགོག་པའི་རྒྱུ་མཚན (L33) and inside the Madhyamakāvatāra verse རྣལ་འབྱོར་པ་ཡིས་བདག་ནི་འགོག་པར་བྱེད (L38). The view registers two senses, neither of which fits: prov འགོག་པ -> 'diệt [đế]' is the noun nirodha-satya (view ll.258-259, p0402), and prov འགོག་པ (verbal, to refute an opponent's reason) -> 'bị bác bỏ' (ll.524-525, p0855) is passive and takes a reason, not an object. Here the yogin negates the object (ཡུལ / བདག) under analysis. Wording kept as 'phá bỏ'. View l.485 already asks that 'the ruling should settle the whole negation family together' (དགག་པ / འགོག་པ / བཟློག་པ / སུན་འབྱིན), and l.409 warns that འགག་པ (mere ceasing, -> 'diệt') must stay separable from འགོག་པ; this chunk is a third data point for that same ruling.

terms.bo: ལྡོག་པ (verbal: to cease / be turned back, of delusion and of suffering)
terms.kind: gap — sense split needed; wording kept
terms.note: p0936 l.3, ×4 in one sentence (L25): འཁྲུལ་པ་དང་སྐྲག་པའི་སྡུག་བསྔལ་དེ་ལྡོག་དགོས་པ, དེའི་དོན་གོམས་པས་ལྡོག, དེ་ལོག་ན, སྡུག་བསྔལ་ཐམས་ཅད་ལྡོག་པས་ན. The view registers prov ལྡོག་པ -> 'sự lui chuyển' twice (ll.410-413), but both are scoped to the Prasannapadā construction རང་བཞིན་ལ་ལྡོག་པ་མེད་པ at p0728, where the word is a nominal 'reversal/alteration' of a svabhāva and was chosen specifically to stay apart from འགྱུར་བ -> 'đổi khác'. That is a different construction and a different sense from the verbal 'ceases / is turned back' here. Wording kept as 'lui dứt'. The ruling should also keep it apart from the neighbouring registered བཟློག་པ -> 'ngăn dứt' (used correctly at L11 for བཟློག་པ), since ལྡོག་པ here is intransitive and བཟློག་པ transitive.

p0942 l.1, ཞི་ལྷག་གཉིས་འབྲེལ་བར་སྐྱོང་བ་མེད་པའི་ཕྱོགས་གཅིག་པ. No entry. Kept deliberately distinct in Vietnamese from ཕྱོགས་རེ་བ = 'phiến diện' (registered, and used in this very chunk five lines later for ཕྱོགས་རེ་བས་མི་ཆོག), so that the two Tibetan words stay separable; both mean 'one-sided'.
p0944 l.1, མཐོང་ལམ་དུ་བདག་མེད་པ་མངོན་སུམ་དུ་རྟོགས་པ. No headword in the view; standard Sino-Vietnamese, and c032 already uses it.

p0943 l.3, ×2. The view registers only the note under མཚན (line 170) that 'tướng' already serves མཚན་ཉིད and མཚན་མ. 'chấp tướng' has corpus precedent in c274/c276/c279 for this same argument and is kept distinct from བདེན་འཛིན = 'chấp thật' (registered), which stands three clauses later in the same passage.

p0943 l.3, last member of the list འཆད་པ / རྩོད་པ / རྩོམ་པ / ལྟ་རྟོག་བྱེད་པ. No entry. Rendered with a free two-verb phrase so it does not collide with ལྟ་བ = 'kiến' nor with རྟོག་པ = 'phân biệt', both of which occur in the same sentence.

terms.vi: cái làm hại (… và cái năng lập)
terms.note: p0944 l.1, གནོད་བྱེད་དང་སྒྲུབ་བྱེད་དུ་མའི་སྒོ་ནས་བསམ་དགོས. Rendered 'cái làm hại' to hold it together with གནོད་བྱ་གནོད་བྱེད = 'cái bị hại và cái làm hại' (registered) and གནོད་པ = 'làm hại', both of which stand in the two clauses immediately before it; 'cái năng lập' follows the registered སྒྲུབ་བྱེད. NOTE the collision reported in flags: c282 renders the identical phrase at p0945 as 'cái năng phá và cái năng lập'.
p0942 l.11 – p0943 l.1, inside the Saṃdhinirmocana quotation (ཚུལ་ཁྲིམས་རྣམ་པར་དག་པ, ལྟ་བ་རྣམ་པར་དག་པ). No entry in the view.

p0943 l.1, inside the Saṃdhinirmocana quotation. Matches the registered compound ཐོས་བསམ = 'văn và tư'; recorded because here the two members stand apart in the quotation and each had to be rendered singly.
p0944 l.1, ངེས་པ་ཇེ་འཕེལ་དུ་བརྟན་དགོས. No entry; free adverbial rendering.

terms.vi: tu sở đoạn (/ kiến sở đoạn)
terms.note: L37, p0944 l.1 (སྒོམ་སྤང་རྣམས་གོམས་པས་སྤོང). No headword in the view. Matches translation/c274.md line 73, which uses the established Sino-Vietnamese pair "kiến sở đoạn" / "tu sở đoạn". WORDING KEPT; register the pair once so it is fixed across the corpus.

terms.bo: ཤེས་པ (in རྟོག་བྲལ་གྱི་ཤེས་པ — a cognition, not ཤེས་རབ)
terms.vi: thức (rendering རྟོག་བྲལ་གྱི་ཤེས་པ as "cái thức lìa phân biệt")
terms.note: L33, p0943 l.4. The view's only ཤེས་པ entry is prov -> "trí", explicitly scoped to the Abhisamayālaṃkāra verse at p0358; view line 321-322 already records this exact gap and the corpus choice "thức" (c226). c281 uses "thức" here while reserving "cái trí" for བློ at L15 (བློ་ཁ་མ་ཕྱོགས་པ), per the ruled prov བློ -> "cái trí", so the two Tibetan words stay separable. WORDING KEPT; the scoped ruling is still owed. Caveat: "thức" normally carries vijñāna (རྣམ་ཤེས), so the scope should be stated explicitly rather than left to drift.

terms.kind: prov-collision (no action taken on this chunk)
terms.note: L42, p0944 l.1. The view carries three renderings of this headword: prov "điều phá bác" (p0687, line 299), prov "điều làm hại" (p0771 sa-bcad, line 329), and the pair ruling གནོད་བྱ་གནོད་བྱེད -> "cái bị hại và cái làm hại" (p0438, line 231). c281 follows the pair ruling, which is right here because the Pramāṇavārttika couplet two lines above (L39-40) uses the pair གནོད་བྱ་གནོད་བྱེད་ངོ་བོའི་ཕྱིར. Recorded only so c281 is counted in the pending central ruling on this headword.

p0939 l.1, ‘མ་འཁྲུལ་བ་དེ་ལས་ཀྱང་འགྲུབ་པར་སླ་བས་རྣལ་འབྱོར་མངོན་སུམ་དུ་འགྱུར་ཏེ’. Built on the view's prov མངོན་སུམ -> ‘hiện lượng’ (epistemological sense, p0581) plus the registered རྣལ་འབྱོར -> ‘du-già’. No compound entry exists. Register it, since the whole refutation turns on the absurd consequence that an ordinary being's meditation would become yogic direct perception.

terms.vi: làm cho sự phân biệt trở nên sắc bén
terms.note: p0941 l.1. First of two corpus occurrences (the other is p0970, not yet translated). སྤྱང་བ = keen/alert, applied to རྟོག་པ, which the view registers as ‘phân biệt’ (vikalpa). Note the point being made: Tsongkhapa is not asking for vikalpa to be suppressed but sharpened, so a rendering that reads as ‘abandon conception’ would invert the passage. A ruling should fix this before p0970.

p0940 l.1 (×1), p0941 (×4). The pivotal phrase of all four refutations — ‘placed on top of the view’. ‘nền’ is a supplied noun with no Tibetan word behind it, used so the Vietnamese parses; an alternative such as ‘đặt [tâm] ngay trên cái kiến’ would avoid the supplement. No entry; needs one, because the contrast ལྟ་ཐོག་ཏུ་བཞག་པ vs ཙོམ་འཇོག carries the whole argument.

p0939 l.1, ཡུལ་དེ་མངོན་ལོག་གང་རུང་གཅིག་ཏུ་ངེས་ཤིང. Contracted dvandva of མངོན་གྱུར (manifest) + ལོག་གྱུར (hidden). Rendered per c279, the immediately preceding chunk of the same argument, which uses ‘hiện tiền’ / ‘ẩn khuất’ for the two expanded forms. Register the contracted form so it is not read as a stray.

p0939 l.1, བདག་ཏུ་འཛིན་པའི་ཡུལ་རིགས་པས་སུན་ཕྱུང་བའི་ཡང་དག་པའི་ལྟ་བ. No entry for the past stem. The view registers only the related སུན་འབྱིན་པའི་ཐལ་འགྱུར inside the ཐལ་བ note. Should be pinned against དགག་པ -> ‘phá bỏ’ (used for the section heading in c278) so the two stay separable.

p0939 l.1: ཡུལ་དེ་མངོན་ལོག་གང་རུང་གཅིག་ཏུ་ངེས་ཤིང་, then བདག་མེད་མངོན་གྱུར་ཡིན་ན and དོན་ལོག་གྱུར་དུ་འདོད་དགོས་ན. No headword for any of the three in the view; wording KEPT. The abbreviation མངོན་ལོག is expanded as the next two clauses spell it out. Caveat for whoever rules: 'hiện tiền' is already the glossary's Vietnamese for མངོན་སུམ inside མངོན་སུམ་དུ་མཆོད་པ, and མངོན་སུམ occurs a few lines later in this same chunk as 'hiện lượng' per prov མངོན་སུམ -> hiện lượng (view line 221). c280 keeps the two apart; the pair should be registered before the vocabulary recurs.

p0939 l.1 (×5) and p0940 l.1. No headword in the view; wording KEPT. Load-bearing: the whole chunk argues that རྟོག་བྲལ (a non-conceptual COGNITION) is not མི་རྟོག་པ (not conceptualising, the author's own usage), and p0940 l.1 ends རྟོག་བྲལ་དུ་འདོད་པ་མིན་ནོ, explicitly separating them. c280 keeps them distinct as 'lìa phân biệt' vs 'chẳng phân biệt'. Register the split so it does not drift.

terms.vi: phiên hành trì / trong từng phiên hành trì
terms.note: Applied here as the prov requires, so c032 and c280 — the only two occurrences in the corpus (p0129, p0940) — now agree. But the prov's own note says the sense could not be verified, and at p0940 the compound sits inside ཅིར་ཡང་མི་རྟོག་པར་སྐྱོང་རེས་ཀྱིས, where སྐྱོང is the separate prov 'gìn giữ'. One ruling should confirm or replace 'phiên hành trì' and name both chunks for the sweep.

terms.vi: chẳng đúng lý / chẳng hợp lý
terms.note: Reported only so c280 is named in the pending central ruling, per the check. The chunk follows view line 335 (predicative རིགས་པ -> 'đúng lý', མི་འཐད་པ -> 'hợp lý'): མི་རིགས་པ / རིགས་པ་མ་ཡིན -> 'chẳng đúng lý' (¶2 ×3, ¶4), མི་འཐད་དེ -> 'chẳng hợp lý' (¶3). That contradicts the c231/c239/c260 provs (view lines 297, 309, 315, 353), which give predicative རིགས་པ as 'chẳng hợp lý'. The glossary is split against itself; c280's choice is the one that keeps the two Tibetan words separable, which those same notes recommend. No edit made.

Short name form used in the Atiśa verse on p0959 (ཀླུ་སྒྲུབ་སློབ་མ་ཟླ་གྲགས་ཡིན). The view has no headword for ཟླ་གྲགས; it carries only ཟླ་བའི་ཞབས་ཀྱི་ལུགས -> 'tông của ngài Nguyệt [Xứng]'. Rendered 'Nguyệt Xứng', matching c042 and c100 which use that for the full name. Register the short form so a Phase 5 sweep does not read it as a new person.
p0959, ཇོ་བོས་དབུ་མའི་གདམས་ངག་ཏུ་གསུངས་པ — Atiśa's own text, cited by title. Built from registered pieces: དབུ་མ = 'Trung Quán' and གདམས་ངག = 'giáo huấn'. First occurrence in the corpus; no entry.

p0960 l.1. No entry. Rendered 'thắng quán thực thụ' to match c083 and c174, which already use 'tịnh chỉ thực thụ / thắng quán thực thụ' for the same construction. Note c196 uses 'tịnh chỉ thực sự' for ཞི་གནས་མཚན་ཉིད་པ, so the corpus is already split between 'thực thụ' and 'thực sự' — one form should be picked and swept. Kept deliberately apart from the view's མཚན་ཉིད -> 'tướng / định nghĩa'.
p0959, དཔྱད་སྒོམ་དང་...འཇོག་པའི་སྒོམ་སྤེལ་མར་གསུངས་པ. No entry. 'xen kẽ' follows c285 (same pair of meditations, immediately preceding page) and c203.

terms.bo: ལུགས (sense: way/system of practice, not a school's position)
terms.note: p0959 verse, ཕ་རོལ་ཕྱིན་ལུགས་སྤྱོད་པར་འདོད་པས and ཤེས་རབ་བསྒོམ་པའི་ལུགས་ནི་དེ་ཡིན -> 'hành theo lối ba-la-mật' / 'lối tu trí tuệ'. The view registers ལུགས only as 'chủ trương' and as 'tông' (རང་གི་ལུགས -> tự tông), both position/school words that do not fit 'the way one meditates'. The two prose occurrences in the same chunk (སློབ་དཔོན་ཀ་མ་ལ་ཤཱི་ལའི་ལུགས, དེའི་ལུགས) DO take the registered 'chủ trương'. A scoped ruling is needed or the split will read as drift.

terms.bo: རིག་པ (awareness sense, in སེམས་རིག་ཅིང་གསལ་ལ་དྭངས་པ and ཡུལ་ཅན་རིག་པ་དང་མྱོང་བ)
terms.note: p0961 ×2. The view registers རིག་པ as 'minh' (vidyā), 'minh trí', and — for exactly this awareness sense at p0621–p0622 — 'tâm giác tri', whose own note asks for an owner ruling. Rendered with the bare stem 'giác tri' so the two occurrences here stay linked to that entry without importing 'tâm' where the Tibetan has none.

p0961, ཡིད་ཤེས་ཀྱི་ངོ་ན་བཟུང་བའི་ཡུལ་དུ་གང་འཆར་བ. No entry. Uses the view's ཡུལ -> 'cảnh' plus the standard Sino-Vietnamese 所取 for བཟུང་བ; kept distinct from ཡུལ་ཅན -> 'hữu cảnh', which stands two clauses away.

p0961, གཏད་ཅུང་ཟད་ཀྱང་མི་བཟོད་པར་ཞིག་ནས. The view registers མི་བཟོད་པ -> 'không kham nhẫn nổi' and མི་བཟོད་པའི་སེམས -> 'tâm không kham nhẫn', both scoped to the anger/impatience passages at p0223 and p0369–p0370. Here the subject is an appearance that cannot bear being attended to, where 'kham nhẫn' (forbearance) would be wrong. Sense split requested; the shared stem 'kham' is kept.

terms.bo: ཁྱད་པར (sense: a feature something is endowed with, ...ཁྱད་པར་དང་ལྡན་པ)
terms.note: p0961, སེམས་...གསལ་ལ་དྭངས་པའི་ཁྱད་པར་དང་ལྡན་པ. The view already carries three senses of ཁྱད་པར — 'định ngữ' (viśeṣaṇa), 'sai biệt' (viśeṣa, the distinguishing feature of pleasant/unpleasant), 'sự khác biệt' (the difference between two positions). This is a fourth: the qualifying feature a mind possesses. Rendered 'đặc điểm'.

terms.bo: རྣམས་པ / རྣམ་པ (non-technical, 'the look of a rainbow or thin smoke')
terms.note: p0961, འཇའ་ཚོན་ནམ་དུ་བ་སྲབ་མོའི་རྣམ་པ་འདྲ་བར་འཆར and སྔར་གྱི་རིགས་པའི་རྣམ་པ་དེ་བུད་པ. The view registers རྣམ་པ -> 'hành tướng' (ākāra, technical) with a note recording the existing collision against ཡུལ་གྱི་རྣམ་པ -> 'hình tướng'. Here the word is plainly non-technical, so 'hình tướng' was used; this is a further occurrence for that pending split.

terms.vi: trợ bạn (… trở thành trợ bạn cho tịnh chỉ)
terms.note: p0961 l.1. Text KEPT. The view's bare-གྲོགས note (p0051) restricts the *person* sense to 'bạn hữu'/'bạn' with no value-word — that ruling was opened against 'bạn lành'. Here གྲོགས is not a person at all but the helping/assisting condition, and the view already carries a second entry, prov གྲོགས (verbal, དེའི་གྲོགས་བྱའོ) -> 'làm trợ bạn cho ngươi' (p0740), whose own note argues 'trợ' is functional, not evaluative. This is the third trigger. The pending ruling should be scoped: person sense = 'bạn hữu'/'bạn', no value-word; assisting sense (verbal གྲོགས་བྱེད and nominal X་གྱི་གྲོགས་སུ་འགྲོ་བ) = 'trợ bạn'.

terms.vi: chủ trương (doctrinal position) / lối (manner, in verse) / -cách thức (compound suffix)
terms.note: Text KEPT for all three. p0959 l.1 prose ཀ་མ་ལ་ཤཱི་ལའི་ལུགས -> 'chủ trương của A-xà-lê Kamalaśīla' and དེའི་ལུགས -> 'chủ trương ấy' follow the view's prov ལུགས -> chủ trương (itself marked GAP). The Atisa verse at L16-17 has ཕ་རོལ་ཕྱིན་ལུགས -> 'lối ba-la-mật' and ཤེས་རབ་བསྒོམ་པའི་ལུགས -> 'lối tu trí tuệ', where ལུགས is manner/way, not a school's position; p0960 སྐྱེ་ལུགས -> 'cách thức sinh khởi' is the light nominalising suffix (same class as ཁྱབ་ལུགས -> 'cách thức chu biến', already recorded at view line 468). The view also carries a competing prov ལུགས (bare) -> tông. Four Vietnamese renderings now stand across the corpus for one headword; the split needed is: doctrinal position (chủ trương / tông — pick one), manner in verse (lối), and the V-ལུགས compound suffix (cách thức).

p0961 l.3 ×2, rendered at L52. Text KEPT. Departs from prov རྣམ་པ -> 'hành tướng' [ākāra], but that entry's own note (p0679/p0680) already records the unresolved collision with འཛིན་སྟངས and with ཡུལ་གྱི་རྣམ་པ -> 'hình tướng của đối [tượng]'. Here རྣམ་པ is the *appearance* things take in a simile (like a rainbow or thin smoke) and the appearance that later slips away — not the technical ākāra of a cognition. Third trigger for a ruling that is owed; proposed split: technical ākāra (in the dmigs pa / rnam pa / byed las triad, བདེན་པའི་རྣམ་པ་ཅན etc.) = 'hành tướng'; appearance/aspect as it shows up to mind = 'hình tướng'; kinds/varieties (ལྟ་བའི་རྣམ་པ) = 'các loại'.

terms.bo: ཟུང་འབྲེལ (short form of ཟུང་དུ་འབྲེལ་བ; here ཟུང་འབྲེལ་དུ་འགྱུར་ཚུལ)
terms.note: p0960, rendered at L48. Text KEPT and it is already correct: the view has FIXED ཟུང་དུ་འབྲེལ་བ -> song vận (decisions.md §7), but the contracted headword ཟུང་འབྲེལ has no entry of its own. Register ཟུང་འབྲེལ as a variant of the fixed entry, same Vietnamese, carrying the same prohibition on 'hợp nhất'. Urgent: section s281 (p0964) is titled ཞི་ལྷག་དེ་གཉིས་ཟུང་དུ་འབྲེལ་བའི་ཚུལ.

p0959 l.1, at L32. Text KEPT — it follows the view's prov དགོངས་པ -> 'mật ý'. Reported because the view's own note on དགོངས (p0857) records that 'mật ý' was REMOVED as a fabrication there: 密意 asserts a concealed intent, and the note asks that the two uses be separated — the Buddha's intent behind a provisional teaching (where 'mật ý'/'ý thú' is right) versus the plain 'what X has in mind'. This occurrence is a third case the note does not cover: the settled position of two Madhyamaka treatises and of Śāntideva, with nothing concealed about it. The pending ruling should decide treatise-author དགོངས་པ explicitly (candidate: 'ý chỉ' or 'chủ ý'); the wording here was not changed because the standing prov entry licenses it and unilaterally changing it would be re-deciding a settled term mid-book.

terms.vi: thắng quán thực thụ (against: cái tùy thuận với thắng quán)
terms.note: p0960 l.1, at L36. Text KEPT. The view registers only prov མཚན་ཉིད -> 'tướng' [lakṣaṇa]; the substantival མཚན་ཉིད་པ ('definition-bearing', i.e. the actual thing as opposed to the merely concordant རྗེས་མཐུན་པ) has no ruling, and 'tướng' cannot generate it. This is the term that draws the line the whole section (བསྒོམས་པས་ལྷག་མཐོང་གྲུབ་པའི་ཚད) exists to draw and it recurs for ཞི་གནས as well; register X་མཚན་ཉིད་པ -> 'X thực thụ' as a pair with X་རྗེས་མཐུན་པ -> 'cái tùy thuận với X'.

p0946 l.3 (inside the Ratnamegha citation quoted by the Bhāvanākrama) and p0947 l.3 (མཚན་མེད་ཀྱི་རྣལ་འབྱོར). Compound of the view's registered prov མཚན་མེད -> 'vô tướng' and རྣལ་འབྱོར -> 'du-già'; recorded only so the compound itself is pinned. Note the same chunk also has bare མཚན་མེད (p0947 l.3, མཚན་མེད་དམ་མི་རྟོག་པར་འཇུག་པ) -> 'cái vô tướng', which stays inside that entry.

p0947 l.3, རིགས་པའི་མཚོན་གྱིས་བཤིག. HAPAX: this is the only occurrence of རིགས་པའི་མཚོན in the whole book. No entry for bare མཚོན. 'binh khí' follows the corpus rendering of མཚོན/མཚོན་ཆ in c017, c044, c049, c050. A ruling might prefer 'lưỡi gươm chánh lý' or 'vũ khí chánh lý' for a metaphorical single blade; the corpus word was kept rather than a new one invented.

p0945 l.3. Rendered 'Hành giả du-già phủ định ngã'. Follows the corpus's དགག་པ/བཀག་པ -> 'phủ định' (c238, and this chunk's own དེ་བཀག་པའི at p0947). NOTE THE COLLISION: c281 — the immediately preceding chunk of this same section — renders the same verb འགོག in བསྒོམ་པའི་ཚེ་འགོག་ན / འགོག་དགོས as 'ngăn dứt' (stopping conceptions during meditation). The two senses are genuinely different in context, but one ruling should record the split so the Phase 5 sweep does not read this chunk as drift from c281.

p0946 l.3. Combines the view's prov ཞི་ལྷག -> 'chỉ quán' with the FIXED ཟུང་དུ་འབྲེལ་བ -> 'song vận' (decisions.md §7). Recorded because the contracted Tibetan ཟུང་འབྲེལ (not the full ཟུང་དུ་འབྲེལ་བ) is what stands here, and because c281 renders what appears to be the same idea periphrastically as 'một cách liên kết với nhau' — see flags.

p0946 l.1, paired in the same clause with ཕར་ཕྱིན་ཐ་མ་གཉིས -> 'hai ba-la-mật sau cùng' (already in the view). Uses the view's prov བསླབ་པ -> 'môn học' and the fixed བསླབ་པ་གསུམ -> 'ba môn học'; refers to định học and tuệ học.

p0945 l.3. No entry for bare བློ་གྲོས; the view has only བློ་གྲོས་ཀྱི་མིག -> 'con mắt của trí' and prov བློ -> 'cái trí'. Kept as 'cái trí' for consistency with both. Flagged: ཤེས་རབ -> 'trí tuệ' stands in pada 4 of the very same four-line verse, so two Tibetan words share the root 'trí' inside one quatrain.

p0947 l.3, མོ་གཤམ་དང་བུ་དམིགས་པ་ལ་བལྟོས་ཏེ and དེ་གཉིས་ནམ་ཡང་མ་དམིགས་ན. The view registers only the nominal དམིགས་པ -> 'sở duyên' (ālambana). The corpus has 'không duyên được' for the negated verb, which is what 'duyên tới' follows. Kept distinct from the same chunk's དམིགས་པ in བདག་མེད་པ་ལ་དམིགས་པའི་ཞི་ལྷག (p0946), rendered 'duyên nơi vô ngã'.

terms.vi: vị đã thiện xảo về lỗi lầm
terms.note: p0946 l.3, inside the Ratnamegha citation. Adjectival མཁས་པ, so it follows the view's recorded adjectival split ('khéo léo' / 'thiện xảo') rather than the nominal 'bậc học giả'.

p0947 l.1 (ཡོངས་སུ་རྟོག་པ་སྔོན་དུ་གཏོང་བ་ཉིད) and l.3 (དཔྱད་པ་སྔོན་དུ་མ་བཏང་བར). No entry. Deliberately NOT rendered with the གཏོང་བ = 'buông xả / bố thí / đem cho' family (the dāna verb, view line 283) — here གཏོང་བ is 'to send ahead / put first' and has nothing to do with giving. Registering only so the sweep does not read it as a གཏོང་བ violation.

terms.vi: một trong hai, tịnh chỉ hoặc thắng quán
terms.kind: ruling needed — disjunctive use of the contraction
terms.note: p0945 l.3, `རྣལ་འབྱོར་པ་ནི་ཞི་ལྷག་གང་རུང་རྙེད་པ་ཞིག་ལ་བྱེད་པ`. The view registers prov `ཞི་ལྷག` -> 'chỉ quán' (line 126) and has resolved the compact register permissively three times (lines 225-226 c?/p0270, 347-348 c180, 389-390 c180/p0665) — but every one of those is the contraction standing for the PAIR. Here `གང་རུང` makes it a disjunction ('whichever one of the two'), where the compound 'chỉ quán' misreads as the union `ཟུང་འབྲེལ` — the very thing this chunk names separately at L22 (`ཞི་ལྷག་ཟུང་འབྲེལ` -> 'chỉ quán song vận'). Expanded to the fixed-set headwords here. The `ཞི་ལྷག` entry should state that the contraction keeps 'chỉ quán' when it stands for the pair, but is expanded to 'tịnh chỉ / thắng quán' under `གང་རུང` or any other distributive, so the Phase 5 sweep does not read this as drift.

p0945 l.3, `བདག་མེད་གཉིས་ལ་དཔྱོད་པ` (L20), and the parallel `བདག་གཉིས` (p0947 l.3) -> 'hai ngã' (L30, ×2). No headword for bare `བདག་མེད` or `བདག་གཉིས` in the view — only `གང་ཟག་གི་བདག` -> 'cái ngã của bổ-đặc-già-la'. Consistent with the c-series note already recorded in the view (line ~465) asking for `བདག་མེད` -> 'vô ngã' to be registered; logging this chunk's occurrences so one entry covers them.

p0956 l.1, ཤིན་ཏུ་ཡ་མཚན་པ་ཡིན་ནོ → 'thật hết sức kỳ diệu'. No entry in the view. Corpus already uses 'kỳ diệu' (c028, c034, c047) and 'hy hữu' (c033, c056, c062, c100) without a ruling; note the collision with the recorded prov མད་པ → 'kỳ diệu' (p0110). One ruling should split ཡ་མཚན / རྨད་བྱུང / མད་པ.
p0958 l.1, ×2: འཛིན་སྟངས་སུན་ཕྱུང་བའི་སྒོ་ནས and འཛིན་སྟངས་སུན་མ་ཕྱུང་བར. No entry. 'phá bác' matches c205, c209, c258, c271, c281.
p0958 l.1, འདྲེ་ཤར་སྒོར་གནོད་པ་ལ་གླུད་ནུབ་སྒོར་གཏོང་བ — the ransom effigy offered to buy off a harming spirit. First occurrence in translation/. འདྲེ rendered 'con quỷ' (also unruled).

p0958 l.3, in the Be'u bum verse, named beside རྟེན་འབྲེལ as a reasoning. Follows c263's 'một và nhiều' for གཅིག / དུ་མ. Consider whether the established Sino-Vietnamese 'lìa nhất và dị' is preferred; 'lìa một và nhiều' was chosen to stay in step with c217/c263.

p0958 l.3, cited as a source ('...ལས།') with a nine-pada verse, so it is being used as the title of Potowa's work, not as a common noun. glossary.json has བེའུ་བུམ = 'cẩm nang nhỏ' (prov, common noun; c010 uses it that way). Rendered '*Cẩm Nang Nhỏ* của ngài Potowa'. A ruling is owed on capitalisation/italics when it names the work.

p0958 l.1, དེ་དག་སོ་སོར་གྲུབ་པ་ན་ཟུང་དུ་སྦྲེལ་བར་གསུངས. Transitive/verbal variant (སྦྲེལ, not འབྲེལ) of the FIXED ཟུང་དུ་འབྲེལ་བ = 'song vận'. 'song vận' kept per the fixed entry; 'hợp nhất' deliberately not used. Also ཟུང་འབྲེལ་དུ་འཇུག་ཚུལ at p0956 l.1 → 'cách thức thể nhập song vận'.
p0957 l.3, the standard session frame. ཐུན་མཚམས = 'giữa các thời tu' and སྦྱོར་བ = 'gia hành' are both recorded; མཇུག is not. No prior corpus rendering of the three-member phrase was found.

p0957 l.1, ×2, inside the Bhāvanākrama III quotation (དེ་ཁོ་ན་ཤིན་ཏུ་གསལ་བར་མི་མཐོང). glossary has only དེ་ཁོ་ན་ཉིད = 'thật tánh' (prov). Same Vietnamese used for the bare form; recorded so the shortening is deliberate.
p0958 l.1, བསྒོམ་པའི་སྐབས་ཀྱི་ཕྲ་མོའི་སྐྱོན་ཡོན་རྣམས. Dvandva of སྐྱོན + ཡོན་ཏན; ཡོན་ཏན is FIXED = 'công đức', so the compound follows it.

terms.vi: khôi phục phần an trú như cũ
terms.note: p0957 l.1. Built on the recorded prov གནས་ཆ = 'phần an trú'; སོར་གཞུག ('restore to its former state') has no entry.

terms.vi: hết sức [*mad pa* — nghĩa không rõ]
terms.note: Fourth corpus occurrence of the frame ཤིན་ཏུ་མད་པར་སྣང (p0067, p0185, p0234, now p0958 l.1). མད་པ is not a readable Tibetan word; likely a printing error in this edition. c022, c072 and now c285 all render it with the inline bracket flag [*mad pa* — nghĩa không rõ]. Worth registering as a fixed treatment so the fourth agent does not guess again, and so Phase 5 can sweep all four occurrences with one decision. Candidate readings (མེད་པ? མཚན་པ? ལེགས་པ?) must not be adopted without a second independent signal.

terms.bo: ལུགས (bare, of an instructional tradition with its own གཞུང)
terms.note: p0956 l.1 ×3: ལུགས་དེའི་ལྟ་བ་གཏན་ལ་འབེབས་ཚུལ, ལུགས་འདི་ལེགས་པར་རྟོགས་ནས, དེའི་གཞུང. Text KEPT. Both registered entries are provisional and neither binds: view line 407 `prov ལུགས -> chủ trương` carries its own note 'GAP — bare ལུགས has no entry', and view line 545 `prov ལུགས (bare) -> tông` is scoped by its own examples to doxographical use (རང་གི་ལུགས -> tự tông, ཟླ་བའི་ཞབས་ཀྱི་ལུགས -> tông của ngài Nguyệt Xứng). Reason for keeping 'hệ thống' here: the referent is the ཤེར་ཕྱིན་མན་ངག lineage of practice instruction — a body of teaching one 'understands well and then meditates as it appears in its གཞུང' — not a tenet position held against rivals. 'chủ trương' (an assertion) is wrong; 'tông' would import a doxographical sense the passage does not have. One ruling is owed that splits ལུགས by environment: doxographical (tự tông / tông của X) vs an instructional tradition and its corpus. It should sweep the 8 other chunks using 'hệ thống' together with c285.

p0958 l.1 -> L29 'các bậc thiện tri thức thiện xảo'. Text KEPT. The view rules མཁས་པ only as (a) a person-noun 'bậc học giả' [paṇḍita], (b) 'bậc trí' in verse, (c) 'khéo léo' as adjective of a craftsman (blacksmith similes), (d) the kauśalya abstract noun 'sự thiện xảo'. None covers the adjective attached to a person-noun. 'thiện xảo' is chosen over 'khéo léo' because this same chunk's ཐེག་པ་ཐམས་ཅད་ལ་མཁས་པ -> 'sự thiện xảo về hết thảy các thừa' (L13) already occupies that root under the registered kauśalya pattern, and both passages describe the same competence in a teacher; 'khéo léo' is registered for manual craft. A ruling on adjectival མཁས་པ of a person is owed, and it should be settled together with the abstract-noun ruling the view already requests.

p0958 l.3. Text KEPT with title treatment (italic, capitalised). The view registers only `prov བེའུ་བུམ -> cẩm nang nhỏ` as a generic common noun ('a small handbook of pith instructions'), and the sole corpus precedent c010 L40 is generic and lowercase. Here བེའུ་བུམ is possessed by པོ་ཏོ་བ and introduced by ལས as the source of a cited verse, i.e. it names Potowa's specific work (the Be'u bum sngon po), so decisions.md applies: 'Cited text titles get one fixed Vietnamese title each, decided at first occurrence and added to the glossary immediately.' This is that first occurrence. The ruling must keep the generic common noun (lowercase 'cẩm nang nhỏ', c010) distinct from the fixed work title, and decide whether the title carries the author ('Cẩm Nang Nhỏ của ngài Potowa') or stands alone.

p0951 l.1, cited as a text (ཤེས་རབ་སྙིང་པོ་ལས). GAP - no entry in the view. Literally 'Tinh Yếu Bát-nhã'; the established Vietnamese title 'Bát-nhã Tâm Kinh' was used so readers can identify the work, on the precedent of the བྱང་ཆུབ་ལམ་རིམ་ཆེན་མོ ruling. No 'kinh' is in the Tibetan, but the title itself is conventionally 'Tâm Kinh'. Corpus has no prior occurrence (the only other ཤེས་རབ་སྙིང་པོ in source/clean is p0132, not a title there).

p0949 l.1, inside the Kāśyapaparivarta quotation: འཕགས་པའི་ཤེས་རབ་ཀྱི་དབང་པོ་སྐྱེ 'căn trí tuệ của bậc thánh sinh khởi'. The view registers དབང་པོ only in the Śakra/Indra sense ('Đế Thích') plus the note at line 440 that the bare sense-faculty headword is unregistered. Third occurrence of that gap.

p0949 l.1, twice, inside the quotation. The view registers only the chapter title འོད་སྲུངས་ཀྱི་ལེའུ = 'phẩm Ca-diếp'; the bare vocative addressing the person is not registered. No honorific added - the Tibetan is plain vocative.

p0948 l.1 (×3: རྟོག་པ་ཐམས་ཅད་ལྡོག་པར་འགྱུར, ཁྱབ་བྱེད་ལོག་ན, ཁྱབ་བྱ་ཡང་ལྡོག་པ) and p0949 l.1 (རྣམ་པར་རྟོག་པ་ནམ་ཡང་མི་ལྡོག). The view's prov ལྡོག་པ = 'sự lui chuyển' is scoped by its own note to རང་བཞིན་ལ་ལྡོག་པ་མེད་པ (a svabhāva admits no reversal), which does not fit here. 'dứt bặt' follows the corpus: c009/c012 section heading ངང་གིས་ལྡོག = 'tự nó dứt bặt', c029. Second scoped sense; needs registering.

p0949 l.1, inside the Bhāvanākrama II quotation: གཙུབ་ཤིང་གཙུབས་པའི་མེ. The fire-drill. No entry. Rendered descriptively rather than with a Sino-Vietnamese equivalent, since the image (not a technical term) is what the passage needs.
p0948 l.1, of alternating between generating ངེས་པ and resting in what it has settled. No entry.

terms.vi: hạt giống trắng nhạt / mầm xanh
terms.note: p0949 l.1 - p0950 l.1, the dissimilar-cause examples. Uses the view's ས་བོན = 'hạt giống' and མྱུ་གུ = 'mầm'. སྐྱ་བོ (pale/whitish) has no entry.

p0950 l.1, བུད་མེད་ལས་སྐྱེས་པ་སྐྱེ་བ. Note the pun the Tibetan carries: སྐྱེས་པ 'a male' beside སྐྱེ་བ 'to be born' - not reproducible in Vietnamese, and no attempt was made to reproduce it. Also note the FIXED སྐྱེ་བ = 'sinh' does not govern སྐྱེས་པ here.
p0951 l.1, Ratnaguṇasañcayagāthā verse, ཤེས་རབ་ཕ་རོལ་ཕྱིན་གྲངས་འགྲོ, and its prose gloss ཤེར་ཕྱིན་དུ་འགྲོ་བར་གསུངས. No entry.

p0950 l.5 - p0951 l.1, in the Prajñāpāramitā quotation, paired with ངེས་པར་བསམ་པ. No entry. Kept distinct from སོ་སོར་རྟོག་པ = 'giản trạch' and from དཔྱད་པ = 'quán sát', both of which occur in the same passage.
p0950 l.5 - p0951 l.1, same quotation. No entry. The view's several བསམ་པ rulings (ý lạc / quán xét / nghĩ) do not cover this compound.

p0951 l.3, བདེན་པར་འཛིན་པའི་རྟོག་པ་འགོག་ན. No bare entry. Rendered to match c284, which continues this very sentence and renders p0952's འགོག་པར་མི་ནུས and འགོག་པའི་དོན་མེད་པ as 'ngăn dứt'. See the flag: this collides with the view's prov བཟློག་པ = 'ngăn dứt', and the two words stand in one sentence here.

p0951 l.3, འཁྲུལ་པ་དེ་བཟློག་པ - turning back the rope/snake delusion. Fourth scoped sense, after 'ngăn dứt' (འཁོར་བ་བཟློག་པ), 'bác bỏ' and 'lật ngược' (the logical senses recorded from c243). Rendered 'đảo ngược' because འགོག་པ in the SAME sentence takes 'ngăn dứt'.

Bare དཔྱོད་པ/དཔྱད་པ occurs three times in c283 and is rendered 'quán sát' each time: རྣམ་པར་དཔྱད་དེ (p0949, Bhāvanākrama II) -> 'quán sát trọn vẹn'; དཔྱོད་པར་གསུངས་པ (p0951 l.1) -> 'phải quán sát'; ཤེས་རབ་ཀྱིས་ཆོས་རྣམས་ལ་དཔྱད་པས (p0951 l.1) -> 'dùng trí tuệ quán sát các pháp'. The view carries only two scoped provs — དཔྱོད་པ -> thẩm sát (p0436) and དཔྱོད་པ (ṛddhipāda) -> sự thẩm sát (p0645) — and that entry's own note already records the corpus as split c083 ('quán sát') vs c125/c134 ('thẩm sát') with the central ruling still owed. c283 follows the c083 line and is internally consistent with the view's སོ་སོར་དཔྱོད་པ -> sự quán sát từng phần, used correctly at p0948 l.5 and p0950 l.3. WORDING KEPT: this is the pending ruling surfacing again, not drift introduced here. A ruling is needed that either settles one rendering corpus-wide or scopes the split explicitly.

terms.kind: third sense of a term whose ruling is already pending
terms.note: རླུང in the Kāśyapaparivarta simile ཤིང་གཉིས་རླུང་གིས་དྲུད་པ (p0949) -> 'hai [khúc] cây bị gió cọ xát', i.e. plain meteorological wind. The view registers རླུང only as 'khí' — in the humoral triad and in རྩ་རླུང་ཐིག་ལེ — and its note (view line 397) already asks for a ruling on the non-humoral senses. 'gió' is unarguable in a two-fire-sticks simile. Recorded so the term's pending ruling covers this third sense and the sweep does not flag it.

p0953 l.1. GAP: no entry in the c284 view and zero occurrences of 'Lăng Già' anywhere in translation/. Formed on the model of the registered འཕགས་པ་དཀོན་མཆོག་སྤྲིན -> 'Thánh Bảo Vân'. གཤེགས་པ (avatāra) is rendered 'Nhập' rather than dropped; the draft's bare 'Thánh Lăng-già' lost it.

p0952, inside the Bhāvanākrama III quotation. Absent from the c284 view, but *Giải Thâm Mật* is already settled corpus usage (17 occurrences in translation/). Should be registered so it stops surfacing as a gap.

terms.vi: Tổng Trì Nhập Vô Phân Biệt
terms.note: p0954 l.3 – p0955 l.1, cited inside the first Bhāvanākrama. GAP. Translated rather than transliterated, following the registered གཟུངས -> 'tổng trì' and its companion entry licensing translation inside cited titles.
p0955 l.1. GAP — no entry in the view. 'đẳng chí' (等至) is the established Sino-Vietnamese; 'vô tưởng' follows the registered འདུ་ཤེས -> 'tưởng'.
p0955 l.3, in the Yogācāra summary. GAP. Established Sino-Vietnamese pair; kept distinct from འཛིན་པ used alone elsewhere.
p0955 l.3, twice. Built on the registered prov རྫས -> 'thật thể' so the simplex and the compound stay visibly related.

p0953 l.1, Laṅkāvatāra quotation. The view registers only སྤྱིའི་མཚན་ཉིད -> 'tướng chung'; 'tự tướng' is corpus-established (c182, c184, c222) and pairs with it. The draft's 'tướng riêng' was changed to 'tự tướng' for that reason.
p0954 l.3, twice inside the Kāśyapaparivarta quotation. GAP: the view registers only དབུ་མ -> 'Trung Quán' (Madhyamaka, the school), which is the wrong sense here.

terms.vi: cái phải tự mình chứng biết riêng
terms.note: p0953 l.5 – p0954 l.1, three times (Tsongkhapa's prose and the Bhāvanākrama III quotation). GAP. Rendered descriptively rather than with 'tự nội chứng' so that 'chứng' does not collide with རྟོགས་པ = 'chứng ngộ' standing in the same sentences.
p0953 l.3, twice inside the Bhāvanākrama III quotation. The view's ཐོས་པ note reserves 'đa văn' for exactly this form (and ཐོས་པ་མང་བ), but no headword is registered for it. Registering it here.
p0955 l.3, རྒྱ་བོད་ཀྱི་མཁས་གྲུབ་དམ་པ་རྣམས. GAP; the view registers only བོད -> 'Tây Tạng'.

terms.vi: kẻ sinh ra từ loài người
terms.note: p0954 l.3, in the Kāśyapaparivarta ātman-synonym list. The view records the longer ཤེད་ལས་སྐྱེས་པ with this wording (in the ཤེད་བུ note); registering the short form so the pair ཤེད་ལས་སྐྱེས / ཤེད་བུ ('con của loài người') stays matched. The open question of 'ý sinh / nho đồng' vs the literal rendering is unchanged.

Two incompatible provisionals stand in the view: line 562 `དམིགས་པ` (verbal, pramāṇa context) -> "duyên đến", and lines 472/572 `དམིགས་པ` -> "nhận thấy" / `མི་དམིགས་པ` -> "những sự chẳng nhận thấy", the latter noting that "duyên" is avoided so it is not read as `དམིགས་པ` -> "sở duyên" [ālambana] (line 135). This chunk's `ཤེས་རབ་ཀྱིས་བརྟགས་ན་མི་དམིགས་པ` (p0955) has been brought onto "chẳng nhận thấy". One ruling should settle the verbal root across the three registrations, and say whether the pramāṇa-scoped "duyên đến" survives as a scoped exception or is folded into "nhận thấy".

terms.bo: དམ་པའི་ཆོས (vs དམ་ཆོས, vs the fixed-set ཆོས)
terms.note: p0952, in the Bhāvanākrama III quotation `དམ་པའི་ཆོས་ལས་དྲན་པ་མེད་པ་...འབྱུང་བ`. The chunk follows the provisional entry at view line 117 (`དམ་པའི་ཆོས` -> "Chánh pháp"), so this is NOT a translator error — but that entry is in standing tension with the FIXED `དམ་ཆོས` -> "Diệu pháp" (the same compound contracted) and with the fixed-set `ཆོས` entry, which states that "chánh pháp" is NOT licensed because it adds a qualifier the Tibetan does not have. The view's own note at lines 186-187 already records the tension and asks for a central ruling. Wording KEPT pending that ruling; if it goes to "Diệu pháp", this site and the ~8 corpus-wide sites sweep together.

p0962 l.1, གཉིས་མེད་ཀྱི་དེ་ཁོ་ན་ཉིད་རྟོགས་པའི་ལྟ་བ -> 'cái kiến chứng ngộ thật tánh vô nhị'. No headword in the view. Stands in deliberate contrast with the preceding ཡུལ་ཡུལ་ཅན་གཉིས་སུ་སྣང་བ (c286: 'hiển hiện thành hai, tức cảnh và hữu cảnh'), so the Vietnamese must keep 'hai' visible.

terms.vi: tính ngăn ngại / xúc ngăn ngại
terms.note: p0962, ×4. GAP. The pivot of the whole argument: the passage says a rainbow-like appearance is merely (a) freedom from ཐོགས་རྡུགས་ཀྱི་རེག་བྱ plus (b) vivid appearance, and that mistaking this for emptiness collapses the negandum རང་བཞིན into ཐོགས་པའི་རེག་བྱ. རེག་བྱ is already prov 'xúc' (p0660), so 'xúc ngăn ngại' keeps the two words linked. A ruling should fix ཐོགས་རྡུགས / ཐོགས་པ (obstructive resistance, sapratigha) once, since it recurs in the rūpa discussions.

p0962-p0963, ×5. The view already registers both forms (prov, from p0785 and p0800). Recorded only as a further occurrence — wording follows the existing entries exactly, and the pair ཁྱད་གཞི / ཁྱད་ཆོས stays matched.

p0962, སྣང་བ་ལམ་མེ་བ — vivid, unobscured appearing. GAP. Deliberately not 'sáng tỏ' (= གསལ་བ, prov) nor 'trong trẻo' (= དྭངས་པ, prov), both of which occur in the same two sentences and must stay separable.

p0963, གསལ་བའམ་ཉམས་སུ་མྱོང་བ་སྙམ་བྱེད་པ་ནས་འཕྲོ་བཅད་ལ་བྱ — breaking the session off while it is still going well. GAP. Kept distinct from the view's འཕྲོ (in འཕྲོ་རྒོད) -> 'sự tán tâm', a different sense of the same syllable.
p0963, ཐུན་རེ་ལ་འཁྱོངས་པ་ན — becoming able to sustain/carry through a single session. GAP. Kept distinct from གོམས་པ = 'thuần thục', which the neighbouring c286 text uses.
p0963, in the four-session list སྔ་དྲོ་ / ཕྱི་དྲོ་ / སྲོད་ / ཐོ་རངས. GAP for all four; ཐུན is already prov 'thời khóa'. Registering so the daily-session list stays fixed wherever it recurs.

p0963, ཡུལ་དེ་དག་གི་སྡོད་ཚུལ་གྱི་གནས་ལུགས — 'thật tánh nơi cách trụ của các cảnh ấy'. GAP. Uses the view's གནས་ལུགས -> 'thật tánh' for the head noun and a separate word for སྡོད་ཚུལ so the two are not merged.
p0963 l.3, དབུགས་ཕྱི་ནང་དུ་རྒྱུ་བ — the breath moving out and in. GAP. Note རྒྱུ་བ here is physical motion, NOT the view's prov རྒྱུ་བ (of afflictions) -> 'lưu hành'.

p0962 l.3, 5x: `ཐོགས་རྡུགས་ཀྱི་རེག་བྱ་དང་བྲལ་བ` -> 'sự lìa khỏi xúc có tính ngăn ngại'; `ཐོགས་རྡུགས་ཅན་དུ་མེད་ཀྱང` -> 'dù chẳng có tính ngăn ngại'; `ཐོགས་པའི་རེག་བྱ` (x2) -> 'xúc ngăn ngại'. NO entry in the view (the only ཐོགས headword is the fixed proper noun ཐོགས་མེད -> Vô Trước). Wording KEPT and internally consistent; the compound ཐོགས་རྡུགས and the bare ཐོགས་པ are deliberately kept as one sense ('ngăn ngại') because the argument turns on their identity. A ruling should fix both forms together and decide 'ngăn ngại' vs 'chất ngại' / 'đối ngại'.

p0962 l.1 (`སྣང་བ་བན་བུན་ཤར་བ` -> 'những hiển hiện mờ mịt đã khởi lên'), l.3 (`སྣང་བ་བསྙོན་དུ་མེད་པར` -> 'hiển hiện là chẳng thể chối bỏ được'; `སྣང་བ་ལམ་མེ་བ` -> 'sự hiển hiện rõ mồn một'; `སྣང་ལ་རང་བཞིན་མེད་པ` -> 'hiển hiện mà vô tự tánh'). The view's only སྣང་བ entry is the scoped title `prov སྣང་བ -> [Trung Quán] Quang Minh [Madhyamakāloka]`, which cannot bind the common noun. Wording KEPT and consistent; a ruling is owed for the ordinary sense (it is the pivot of the whole appearance-and-emptiness argument here), and it must be scoped so as not to collide with the Madhyamakāloka title.

terms.vi: Đặc biệt, cách thức tu học nơi Kim Cang thừa
terms.note: Sa-bcad 6.2.3.2.1, printed on p0971. Follows c137 L19, which announces the pair as 'cách tu học nơi Đại thừa nói chung; và đặc biệt, cách tu học nơi Kim Cang thừa', and c137's sibling heading 'Cách thức tu học nơi Đại thừa nói chung'. རྡོ་རྗེའི་ཐེག་པ = 'Kim Cang thừa' is the registered prov.

p0972 l.1. No entry. Deliberately NOT 'đọa tội thô trọng': 'thô trọng' is already the corpus rendering of གནས་ངན་ལེན (dauṣṭhulya) in c083/c085/c088/c090, and reusing it would collapse two unrelated terms. Kept distinct from རྩ་བའི་ལྟུང་བ = 'đọa tội căn bản' (c040, c041, c079, c129, c137, c151) and from the ཡན་ལག་གི་ལྟུང་བ = 'đọa tội chi phần' of c041.

p0972 l.1, རྒྱུད་སྨིན་པར་བྱ in the same clause. Uses the registered prov དབང = 'quán đảnh' and སྨིན་པ = 'thành thục' (which the glossary keeps apart from གོམས་པ = 'thuần thục'). Note c041 renders the parallel sentence 'làm chín muồi tâm tương tục bằng quán đảnh' — 'chín muồi' vs 'thành thục' for སྨིན་པ is a corpus split that a ruling should close.

terms.vi: thực hành theo lời dạy [của ngài]
terms.note: p0971 l.5, བླ་མ་བསྙེན་བཀུར་དང་བཀའ་བསྒྲུབ་པ་སོགས་ཀྱིས་མཉེས་པར་བྱ་བ. The registered prov བཀའ = 'Phật ngôn' is scoped to the pair བཀའ་དང་བསྟན་བཅོས and must NOT apply: here བཀའ is the guru's own instruction, not buddhavacana. Paired with the registered བསྙེན་བཀུར = 'phụng sự'.

p0972 l.3, བསྐྱེད་པའི་རིམ་པ་ལྷའི་འཁོར་ལོ་ཚང་བ. No འཁོར་ལོ headword in the view. ལྷ follows the registered prov ལྷ (in ལྷའི་བཀོད་པ) = 'chư bổn tôn', whose own note says this — an explicitly tantric maṇḍala array — is the one environment where 'bổn tôn' is defensible. 'vòng' follows c028's 'vòng chư bồ-tát quyến thuộc'; 'mạn-đà-la' was avoided because the Tibetan says འཁོར་ལོ, not དཀྱིལ་འཁོར.
p0972 l.3, སྔགས་ཀྱི་ལམ་གྱི་ཐུན་མོང་མ་ཡིན་པའི་སྤང་བྱ. No entry; 'sở đoạn' follows c274 and c281.

p0972 l.3, of what the generation stage turns abode, body and enjoyments into. The view's only ཁྱད་པར་ཅན entry is 'hơn hẳn', scoped to the དམན་པ / མཉམ་པ / ཁྱད་པར་ཅན triad of the Thất Thập Không Tánh Luận, and its only སྣང་བ entry is the short title *[Trung Quán] Quang Minh*. 'sự hiển hiện' for bare སྣང་བ follows c227/c267.

p0972 l.3. Combines the glossary's ཐ་མལ་པའི་འདུ་ཤེས = 'tưởng phàm thường' (so the ཐ་མལ་པ element stays constant) with the registered prov རྣམ་རྟོག = 'sự phân biệt'. Deliberately not the view's ཐ་མལ་པ = 'người bình thường', which is scoped to the དགྲ་གཉེན་ཐ་མལ་པ triad.

terms.vi: chấp trước … để mặc theo chính chúng
terms.note: p0972 l.3, ཕུང་པོ་དང་ཁམས་དང་སྐྱེ་མཆེད་ལ་རང་དགའ་བར་ཞེན་པ. Follows the registered prov རང་དགའ་བ (in ཐ་སྙད་པའི་ཤེས་པ་རང་དགའ་བ) = 'để mặc theo chính nó' rather than the other registered prov 'thuần túy' (p0303–p0304), because the sense is the aggregates left in their unimproved ordinary state. ཞེན་པ takes the registered epistemic/reifying prov 'chấp trước', not the affective 'tham luyến' (scoped to འཁོར་བ་ལ་ཞེན་པ).

terms.vi: ngôi nhà mục nát có chân tường đã sụt lở
terms.note: p0972 l.1, the simile for a path lacking samaya and vows. No entry for འགྲམ་རྩ or ཟགས་པ; read as 'the base of the wall having given way'. See flag — the reading of འགྲམ་རྩ is mine.
p0972 l.1, སྔགས་ཀྱི་ཚུལ་ལས་རྣམ་པར་འཁྱམས་པ. Follows the corpus's 'lạc rất xa khỏi cách thức của Trung Quán' for ཆེས་ཆེར་འཁྱམས་པ at p0738. ཚུལ takes the registered prov 'cách thức'.

terms.vi: ba thứ tất-địa thượng, trung, hạ
terms.note: p0972 l.1. The registered prov གྲུབ་པ (siddhi sense) gives མཆོག / འབྲིང / ཐ་མ = 'tối thượng / bậc trung / bậc hạ' from p0344; here the first member is རབ, not མཆོག, so the plain triad 'thượng, trung, hạ' is used. c106 L64–66 renders the same Mañjuśrīmūlatantra passage's three siddhis 'tất-địa tối thượng / bậc trung / bậc hạ'.

p0971 l.1, རྒྱུད་དགེ་བའི་ཕྱོགས་ཐམས་ཅད་ལ་བཀོལ་དུ་རུང་བ. Of the view's four ཕྱོགས senses ('tông', 'lập trường', 'phía', 'phương diện'), 'phương diện' fits; and ཕྱོགས་རེ་བ = 'phiến diện' (registered) stands two words earlier, so the two must stay legible together.

L19. decisions.md requires every cited title to receive one fixed Vietnamese form at first occurrence; the view carries only `prov འཇམ་དཔལ -> Văn-thù` (line 99) and no title entry. The rendering is already consistent with c106 L69, which translates the same work under its shorter Tibetan form `འཇམ་དཔལ་རྩ་རྒྱུད` (p0344) identically, and the couplet quoted here (`ཚུལ་ཁྲིམས་འཆལ་ལ་ཐུབ་དབང་གིས། །སྔགས་འགྲུབ་པར་ནི་མ་གསུངས་ཏེ།`) is the same couplet as c106 L75-76. Register one form covering BOTH Tibetan forms (`འཇམ་དཔལ་རྩ་བའི་རྒྱུད` and `འཇམ་དཔལ་རྩ་རྒྱུད`) so the Phase 5 sweep sees a single title. Text unchanged.

terms.bo: ཞེན་པ (clinging to the aggregates AS ORDINARY, in ཕུང་པོ་དང་ཁམས་དང་སྐྱེ་མཆེད་ལ་རང་དགའ་བར་ཞེན་པ)
terms.kind: sense not covered by any registered scope
terms.note: p0972 l.3 -> L26. The view's `prov ཞེན་པ -> tham luyến` (line 217) is explicitly scoped to affective attachment to saṃsāra (`འཁོར་བ་མཐའ་དག་ལ་ཞེན་པ`) and is wrong here — nothing affective is meant, this is the ordinary conception (`ཐ་མལ་པའི་རྣམ་རྟོག`) that takes the aggregates, elements and sense-bases to be what they appear. The nearer registered variant, `ཞེན་པ` (reification sense, `དངོས་པོར་ཞེན་པ`, p0776) -> 'chấp trước' (view lines 413-416), is what the chunk follows. Neither scope covers the tantric 'ordinary appearance' sense, so a third scope is needed. Wording kept; it should be decided together with the open ཞེན་པ / མངོན་པར་ཞེན་པ ('bám chấp') split the view already flags.

terms.kind: scope of an existing prov entry does not reach this construction
terms.note: p0972 l.3. The view registers `prov རང་དགའ་བ -> thuần túy` (line ~230), but scoped to the NOMINAL use at p0303-p0304 (`འཕེན་བྱེད་ཀྱི་ལས་རང་དགའ་བ`, `ཀུན་འབྱུང་གི་བདེན་པ་རང་དགའ་བ་དངོས` — 'the karma / the truth of origin proper, taken alone'). Here it is adverbial over a verb of clinging, where 'thuần túy' will not carry. Two readings are both available from the Tibetan: (a) clinging to them just as they plainly are, i.e. as merely ordinary — the reading the current wording aims at; (b) clinging to them freely / unrestrainedly / as one pleases. A ruling covering the adverbial `རང་དགའ་བར` would settle it; nothing was changed, see 'remaining'.

p0965, Śrāvakabhūmi quotation: ལྷག་པའི་ཤེས་རབ་ཆོས་རྣམ་པར་འབྱེད་པ. No entry in the view. Follows c179 l.51, which already renders ལྷག་པའི་ཤེས་རབ / ལྷག་པའི་སེམས as 'tăng thượng tuệ' / 'tăng thượng tâm' inside a Śrāvakabhūmi quotation. Deliberately NOT 'tuệ học' (which the glossary fixes for ཤེས་རབ་ཀྱི་བསླབ་པ) and not bare 'trí tuệ'.
p0965 ×2, Śrāvakabhūmi. Built on the registered provisional རྣམ་པར་འབྱེད་པ = 'phân biện' (vicaya) and matching c276's 'phân biện các pháp' for the same Saṃdhinirmocana/Śrāvakabhūmi idiom.

terms.vi: thể nhập thành cặp một cách bình đẳng
terms.note: p0965, Śrāvakabhūmi, beside འདྲེས་པར་གྱུར་ཅིང. Rendered so that ཟུང་དུ་འཇུག་པ (a distinct Tibetan phrase from the FIXED ཟུང་དུ་འབྲེལ་བ) does not silently absorb 'song vận'. See flag: the closing མཉམ་པར་འཇུག་པ of the same sentence is rendered 'thể nhập một cách bình đẳng', NOT 'nhập đẳng dẫn' (samāpatti), because the parallel with མཉམ་པར་ཟུང་དུ་འཇུག་པ forces the adverbial reading.

p0965 ×2, p0966. No entry. Follows c195/c204, which render འདྲེས་པ 'hòa lẫn' (đẳng dẫn và hậu đắc hòa lẫn). Kept distinct from ཟུང་དུ་འབྲེལ་བ = song vận in the very same sentence — the sūtra pairs the two words, so they must not collapse.

p0967 ×2, དཔྱད་པའི་མཐར་འཇོག་པའི་སྤེལ་མ. No entry. Follows c285 ('làm xen kẽ giữa sự tu theo lối an trụ với sự quán sát') and c203 ('tu xen kẽ chỉ quán'). Kept distinct from the same page's འཇོག་རེས, rendered 'thay phiên an trụ'.
p0967, འཇོག་རེས་ཀྱིས་དཔྱད་པའི་མཐར་འཇོག་པའི་འཇོག་སྒོམ་བྱས་པས. No entry. Deliberately worded so it stays separable from སྤེལ་མ ('sự xen kẽ') in the same summary sentence.
p0967, དམིགས་བསལ་དེ་དོར་བའི. The view's only དམིགས་བསལ entry is '[điểm] không có gì đặc biệt', a different sense that will not carry 'setting aside that exception'. Scoped entry needed.

p0966, དཔྱད་སྒོམ་དེ་ཉིད་ཀྱི་འཕྲོ་བཞག་ནས = 'bỏ dở mạch của chính sự tu theo lối quán sát ấy'. The view registers འཕྲོ only inside འཕྲོ་རྒོད = 'sự tán tâm', a different sense. Cf. p0963 l.3 འཕྲོ་བཅད་ལ་བྱ (just outside this chunk), the same word.

terms.vi: chẳng bị gián cách ở khoảng giữa
terms.note: p0966 ×3, in the Prajñāpāramitopadeśa quotation and Tsongkhapa's gloss of it, beside རྒྱུན་མི་འཆད་པ = 'chẳng đứt đoạn'. The two must stay distinguishable because the gloss defines the second and not the first; c195 already uses 'gián đoạn' for ཆད་པ in the four-manaskāra names, so 'gián cách' was chosen here to keep those separable too.

p0966. The view's only ཁྱད་པར་ཅན entry is 'hơn hẳn', scoped to the Śūnyatāsaptati triad དམན་པ/མཉམ་པ/ཁྱད་པར་ཅན (p0805). 'đặc thù' follows the corpus rendering of ཁྱད་པར in this division (c201 'pháp đặc thù', c205 'nét đặc thù').
