p0967 l.3, final words of the chunk: གནས་ཆ་བརྟན་པོའི་མི་རྟོག་པའི་རྩི་མ་ (continues into p0968 as རྩི་མ་ཞིག་པའི་ངང་ནས). No entry for རྩི་མ. Rendered on the precedent of the registered provisional རྩི = 'hương vị' (p0435, the residual flavour a strong preceding mental state leaves on a later one), which fits the sense here. Uncertain — see flag.
p0967 l.3, ཆུ་མི་གཡོ་བར་གནས་པའི་སྟེང་ན་ཕར་ཉེའུ་ཆུང་འཕྱོ་བ་བཞིན་དུ — the classic simile of a small fish moving in still water without disturbing it. No entry.
p0964 l.1, ཏིང་གཙང་མའི་ནང་དུ་ཆུ་བླུགས་ནས — the simile for དྭངས་པ. No entry; 'bát' is a guess at the vessel word. See flag.
p0964 l.1, the simile for གསལ་བ (a cloudless autumn sky at midday). Recorded because the simile recurs in the śamatha/vipaśyanā literature.

p0966, `དཔྱད་སྒོམ་དེ་ཉིད་ཀྱི་འཕྲོ་བཞག་ནས` -> "bỏ dở mạch của chính sự tu theo lối quán sát ấy" — the continuity/thread of an ongoing activity that one breaks off. The view's only `འཕྲོ` entry is `prov འཕྲོ (in འཕྲོ་རྒོད) -> sự tán tâm` (p0641), a different word-sense. Wording KEPT; register the continuity sense so the two are not collapsed.

p0964, fourth of the four marks: `ཕྲ་བ་ནི། མཚན་ཉིད་གསུམ་པོ་དེའི་ངང་ནས་བལྟས་པ་ན...`, and the finite form `དབུགས་དང་རྟོག་པ་ཕྲར་སོང་བའོ` -> "trở nên vi tế". Its two siblings in the same list, `གསལ་བ` -> "sự sáng tỏ" and `དྭངས་པ` -> "sự trong trẻo", ARE registered; the fourth member is not. Wording KEPT and is consistent with them.

terms.vi: bậc tinh cần trì luật nghi
terms.note: p0976, ×3 (སྔོན་དུས་ཀྱི་སྡོམ་བརྩོན་རྣམས, གངས་རིའི་ཁྲོད་ཀྱི་སྡོམ་བརྩོན་རྣམས, སྡོམ་བརྩོན་ཆེན་པོ). No entry. 'vow-diligent' = a strict keeper of the vinaya vows. Kept distinct from འདུལ་བ = Luật and ཚུལ་ཁྲིམས = giới.
p0976, དམ་པ་བྱ་འདུལ་བ་འཛིན་པའི་རྒྱལ་ཚབ. Read as the proper name of the Bya-clan vinaya master (Cha Dülwa Dzinpa), not as a common noun 'holy vinaya-holder'. See flags — the reading is not certain.
p0976, མཁན་ཆེན་ཟུལ་ཕུ་བ. Built on the recorded མཁན་པོ = 'thân giáo sư' (upādhyāya). A ruling is needed on whether the title is translated this way or transcribed 'Khenchen'.
p0976, one of the two named patrons who urged the composition. Transcription only.
p0976, the first named patron, described as རྒྱལ་ཚབ་ཆེན་པོ of Ngok Loden Sherab. Transcription only; not to be read as དཀོན་མཆོག = Tam Bảo + ཚུལ་ཁྲིམས = giới.
p0976. The great translator; corpus already has 'đại dịch giả Loden Sherab' (c158). ལོཙྪ་བ་ཆེན་པོ at p0977 is rendered 'đại dịch giả' and taken to be this same figure.
p0976, the later petitioner whose request Tsongkhapa accepted. Transcription only.

p0976, སྐད་གཉིས་སྨྲ་བ་ཡོངས་སུ་རྫོགས་པ — literally 'speaker of two languages', the standard designation of a lotsāwa. Rendered literally rather than as 'dịch giả' (= ལོ་ཙཱ་བ), which occurs separately at p0977.
p0977, རྗེ་བཙུན་དམ་པ་རེད་མདའ་བ — Tsongkhapa's chief teacher. c002 already writes 'Đức Rendawa'; here rendered 'đức Chí Tôn chân chính Rendawa' following the རྗེ་བཙུན་དམ་པ view entry.
p0977, in Tsongkhapa's self-designation མང་དུ་ཐོས་པའི་དགེ་སློང་སྤོང་བ་པ. No entry; 'one who abandons/renounces'.
p0977, ཡི་གེ་པ (the scribe of the work).
p0977. Built on the recorded ཡི་གེ = 'chữ'. The colophon's scribe.
p0977, བྲག་སེང་གེའི་ཞོལ་གྱི་རི་ཁྲོད — the place of composition, at Radreng. Transcription only.

terms.vi: Lời nguyện của bản khắc in
terms.note: p0978, the heading of the modern printing colophon. པར་བྱང 'printing colophon' + སྨོན་ཚིག 'words of aspiration'.
p0978 verse, རྣམ་དཀར་ཕུང་པོའི་མཐུས = 'do năng lực khối thiện bạch'. No entry. Kept distinct from དགེ་བ = thiện and བསོད་ནམས = phúc đức.
p0978 verse, རྒྱུད་ལྔའི་འགྲོ་བ་མ་ལུས་པ. Literally 'five continua'; read as the five destinies, so rendered with the glossary's འགྲོ་བ་ལྔ = 'ngũ thú' sense but in the free form 'năm nẻo'. See flags.
p0978, འཚེ་མེད་ཞི་བའི་ལམ་སྟོན (ahiṃsā). No entry.
p0978, ཤཱཀྱ་སེངྒེའི་རིང་ལུགས. Kept distinct from གཞུང་ལུགས = 'hệ thống giáo thuyết', which occurs twice in this same chunk at p0976-p0977.
p0978, Śākyasiṃha, epithet of the Buddha. Distinct from the fixed ཤཱཀྱའི་གཙོ་བོ = 'đấng Tối Thắng của dòng Thích-ca'.
p0978, the author of the printing-colophon aspiration. Transcription only.
p0978, ནང་བསྟན་གྲུབ་མཐའ་རིས་མེད་ཀྱི་གསུང་རབ. No entry.
p0978, དགེ་བསྔོའི་སྨོན་ཚིག. Built on the recorded དགེ་བ = 'thiện'; no entry for the compound.
p0978, འཕྲལ་ཡུན་ལེགས་ཚོགས་དུ་མ. No entry.
p0977, ལོཙྪ་བ་ཆེན་པོ་དང་གྲོ་ལུང་པ་ཡབ་སྲས. Literally 'father and son', idiomatic for a master–disciple pair.
p0977, ལམ་རིམ་གྱི་ཁོག་རྣམས — the structural frameworks of the earlier lamrims. Consistent with the recorded ཁོག (in ཏིང་ངེ་འཛིན་གྱི་སྤྱིའི་ཁོག) = 'khung chung'.

terms.vi: đem vào sự tu tập / đem vào thực hành
terms.note: p0976, ཚུལ་བཞིན་དུ་ཐུགས་ཉམས་སུ་བཞེས་ཏེ. No headword in the c292 view. The ruling must state that this is 'to take into practice/experience' and must NOT be rendered with a realization word (thực chứng / chứng ngộ), which is `རྟོགས་པ`. The honorific form ཉམས་སུ་བཞེས་པ should be scoped to the same headword.

p0977, ལམ་སྒྲོན་གྱི་སྐྱེས་བུ་གསུམ་གྱི་སྤྱིའི་མཚན་ཉིད་སྟོན་པ་ཙམ. WORDING KEPT. The view carries `prov སྤྱིའི་མཚན་ཉིད -> tướng chung` scoped to p0668 (Bhāvanākrama, the general characteristic of all śamatha) AND `prov མཚན་ཉིད (definition sense, in མི་བསླུ་བ་ནི་ཚད་མའི་མཚན་ཉིད་ཡིན) -> định nghĩa` (p0747). Here the Lamp for the Path is said to merely set out what the three persons ARE, i.e. the definition sense, so 'định nghĩa tổng quát' follows the registered definition-sense entry rather than departing from the glossary. A sense-split ruling is owed on སྤྱིའི་མཚན་ཉིད so 'tướng chung' (characteristic sense) and 'định nghĩa tổng quát' (definition sense) are both licensed and scoped. Per decisions.md the chunk is also flagged — see remaining.

p0978 verse, མཐའ་ཡས་ཆོས་ཚུལ་དལ་འབབ་ཀླུང. GLOSSARY GAP, wording kept. Needs its own headword so a Phase 5 sweep does not read the compound as a violation of the fixed-set `ཆོས -> pháp | Pháp | giáo pháp ('Nothing else')`.

p0977, ལམ་སྒྲོན་གྱི་སྐྱེས་བུ་གསུམ. GLOSSARY GAP, wording kept. The view rules only the individual capacities (སྐྱེས་བུ་ཆུང་ངུ/འབྲིང/ཆེན་པོ -> bậc hạ/trung/thượng, decisions.md §3, which strips the classifier). A ruling is owed on the collective so it does not drift between 'ba hạng người' and 'ba bậc'; note the tension with §3's classifier-stripping.

p0976. The view has `prov འདྲེན་པ -> đấng Dẫn Đạo [nāyaka]` (provisional, not fixed). Here the referent is Könchok Tsültrim, a human master, so the lowered 'bậc dẫn đạo' was used, while L34 keeps 'đấng Dẫn Đạo' for རྣམ་འདྲེན་ཤཱཀྱ་སེངྒེ (the Buddha). Both renderings kept; a scoped ruling (Buddha vs. human guide, and the capitalisation that goes with it) is owed.

terms.vi: Tóm lược ý nghĩa của đạo lộ nói chung
terms.note: The sa-bcad heading of 6.2.3.2 (p0968 l.3). Built from the registered prov ལམ -> 'đạo lộ' plus the heading precedent in c285 ('Tóm lược yếu điểm của cách thức gìn giữ' for a བསྡུ་བ heading). Deliberately NOT 'nhiếp', which the view reserves for བསྡུ་བ as the cited title Nhiếp Quyết Trạch.

p0968 l.5, དེའི་བདར་ཤ་བཅད. Hapax in the corpus. GAP. Rendered 'hãy thẩm định cho dứt khoát điều ấy'. Deliberately NOT 'quyết trạch', which the corpus already uses for གཏན་ལ་དབབ་པ / སོ་སོར་རྟོག་པ, nor 'xác quyết', which is the registered ངེས་པ and occurs three times in this same chunk.

p0968 l.5 and p0969 l.3, both times as སྐྱེས་བུ་ཆུང་ངུའི/འབྲིང་གི་ཆོས་སྐོར་རྣམས་ཚགས་སུ་ཆུད་པ་ན. Occurs only on these two pages in the whole book. GAP. Chosen over 'thuần thục', which would collide with the registered སྨིན་པ = 'thành thục' used two sentences later in this same chunk.

p0970 l.3, ལེགས་ཚོགས་ཐམས་ཅད་ཀྱི་རྩ་བ (of the spiritual friend). Occurs only at p0970 and p0978, neither yet translated. GAP. Rendered 'gốc rễ của hết thảy điều tốt lành'; a Sino-Vietnamese 'thiện tụ' was avoided as unidiomatic here.

terms.vi: sự hợp tụ của cả hai
terms.note: p0968 l.1. Follows c208's rendering of སྣང་སྟོང་གཉིས་ཚོགས as 'sự hợp tụ của cả hai — hiện tướng và tánh không' (p0694). Recurs at p0716, p0898, p0962.

terms.vi: dựng tầng lầu trên chỗ chẳng có nền móng
terms.note: p0969 l.3. ཐོག read as 'upper storey', རྨང as 'foundation'. GAP for both words; the simile is the standard one for practising the six pāramitās without bodhicitta.

p0970 l.3, བློ་རྣམས་ཆ་མཉམ་དགོས. Follows c285's rendering of ཞི་ལྷག་གཉིས་ཆ་མཉམ (p0957) as 'hai phần chỉ quán được ngang bằng nhau'. Here the balanced things are the various states of mind, not śamatha/vipaśyanā.
p0970 l.1, ལྟ་ཐོག་དེར་བཞག་ནས་སྐྱོང་བ. Already used in c280 ('trụ trên nền cái kiến') and c285, but never registered.
p0969 l.3, ཕྱིན་དྲུག་དང་རིམ་གཉིས. The two tantric stages. Follows c009 and c039, which both already render it 'hai thứ đệ'; unregistered.
p0970 l.3, བཅས་པ་རྣམས་ལ་གཡེལ་བར་སྣང་ན. GAP.
p0970 l.1, ནུས་པ་སྤྲུག་ལོ་བྱས. GAP, and see flags — the syllable ལོ in སྤྲུག་ལོ is not accounted for by this rendering.

p0970 l.1, ལམ་གྱི་ལུས་ཡོངས་སུ་རྫོགས་པ. Rendered literally ('một cái thân trọn vẹn viên mãn của đạo lộ') rather than paraphrased as 'toàn bộ đạo lộ', since the body-metaphor is what the sentence is arguing for.

terms.bo: རྟོག་པ (in རྟོག་པ་སྤྱང་བར་བྱས་ནས — the discernment one is told to sharpen)
terms.vi: sự phân biệt (wording KEPT pending a ruling; candidates: trí phân biệt / sự thẩm sát / sự biện biệt)
terms.note: p0970 l.3. Third sense, covered by neither existing entry: view line 157-158 scopes རྟོག་པ -> 'phân biệt' to the Hashang vikalpa (the thing being REFUTED), and view line 408 records the vitarka sense as 'tầm tư'. Here རྟོག་པ is the discerning intelligence being RECOMMENDED, so 'phân biệt' reads as the refuted term in a sentence that praises it. Text left as-is per the repair rule (no ruling exists); a scoped entry is owed, and if it lands on a different wording this occurrence needs a one-word sweep.
p0968 l.5, དེའི་བདར་ཤ་བཅད. No entry in the view. Wording kept.

p0969 l.3, རྨང་མེད་པའི་ཐོག་བྱེད་པ (building an upper storey where there is no foundation). No entry in the view. Wording kept; note the same chunk uses 'nền tảng lớn' for གཞི་ཆེན་པོ (p0968) and 'nền' for ལྟ་ཐོག (p0970), so a ruling should keep the three distinct.
p0969 l.3, རྩ་ལྟུང་ལ་འབད་པ་དྲག་པོས་སྲོག་བསྡོས་བྱ. No entry in the view; consistent with the registered སྲོག -> 'mạng sống'. Wording kept.

terms.bo: ཞི་ལྷག་ཟུང་དུ་འབྲེལ་བ (full form of the compound registered only as ཞི་ལྷག་ཟུང་འབྲེལ)
terms.note: p0968 l.1. The view registers the contracted ཞི་ལྷག་ཟུང་འབྲེལ -> 'chỉ quán song vận' (line 610) but not the uncontracted ཞི་ལྷག་ཟུང་དུ་འབྲེལ་བའི་ཚུལ, which occurs one sentence later in the same paragraph. Rendered identically (the fix above). Requesting the entry cover both forms so the Phase 5 sweep does not read the long form as unruled.

The book's closing section heading (sectionPath 7), p0973 l.14. No entry in the c291 view. Rendered 'Lời bạt' (colophon / concluding statement). Alternatives considered: 'Kết từ', 'Bạt văn'. Needs a fixed ruling because c292 carries the same heading.

p0975 l.3, ཤིང་རྟ་ཆེན་པོ་ཀླུ་སྒྲུབ་དང་ཐོགས་མེད་གཉིས་ཀྱི་ལམ་སྲོལ. No entry. Kept distinct from ལུགས / ཆོས་ལུགས ('nếp pháp', view line 408, used two clauses later in the same sentence) and from གཞུང་ལུགས ('hệ thống giáo thuyết').

terms.vi: bậc tự tại (of chư Đấng Chiến Thắng)
terms.note: p0974 l.19 / p0975 l.1, རྣམ་འདྲེན་རྒྱལ་བའི་དབང་པོར་བདག་གྱུར་ཅིག. THIRD unregistered sense of དབང་པོ: the view has only the Śakra/Indra sense ('Đế Thích', lines 252-255), the sense-faculty sense ('căn', lines 396, 532), and neither fits. Here it is 'lord/sovereign of the Victors'. Rendered 'bậc tự tại của chư Đấng Chiến Thắng'. One ruling should now cover all three senses.
p0974 l.19, རྣམ་འདྲེན་རྒྱལ་བའི་དབང་པོ. No entry. Deliberately NOT 'đấng Đạo Sư', which the view assigns to སྟོན་པ (lines 144, 198, 214), so the two epithets stay separable.
p0974 l.14-15, རྒྱལ་སྲས་འཇུག་ངོགས་ཤིན་ཏུ་རྟོགས་པར་དཀའ. No entry. Literal 'ford / landing-place of entry'; rendered 'bến vào của hàng Phật tử'.

terms.vi: vua tự tại của các trân bảo
terms.note: p0974 l.3-4, གདམས་པ་རིན་ཆེན་དབང་གི་རྒྱལ་པོ་སྟེ. No entry. Read as an epithet of the wish-fulfilling jewel (the preceding pada is སྐྱེ་དགུའི་འདོད་དོན་མ་ལུས་སྐོང་བས་ན). Alternative reading — 'the sovereign king among precious instructions' — is possible; see flags.

p0974 l.4-5, དཔལ་ལྡན་ལེགས་པར་བཤད་པའི་རྒྱ་མཚོའང་ཡིན. 'thiện thuyết' occurs once elsewhere in the corpus; registering it here so the metaphor pair (ཆུ་བོ 'dòng nước' / རྒྱ་མཚོ 'biển') is stable. དཔལ་ལྡན rendered adjectivally 'cát tường', per the view's prov དཔལ་ལྡན = Cát Tường.
p0974 l.1, འཛམ་གླིང་མཁས་པ་ཡོངས་ཀྱི་གཙུག་གི་རྒྱན. Follows the view's prov རྒྱན split (line 304): 'trang sức' because this is the physical-jewellery half of the simile, not the abstract 'trang nghiêm'.
p0974 l.1, སྙན་པའི་བ་དན་འགྲོ་ན་ལྷང་ངེ་བ -> 'ngọn phướn thanh danh rực rỡ giữa loài chúng sinh'. No entry.
p0974 l.11, སྐལ་བཟང་གཅིག་གི་ལམ་གྱི་རིམ་པ་རུ. No entry. Kept distinct from ལས་འཕྲོ / རྟེན་འབྲེལ. See flags on the parsing of གཅིག here.
p0975 l.1, ཐེག་པ་མཆོག་ལ་ཆོས་སྤྱོད་བཅུས. Built on the view's prov ཆོས་སྤྱོད = 'pháp hành' (line 272), now with the numeral. Deliberately no gloss of the ten.

p0974 l.18, དེར་ནི་རིང་དུ་འབད་ལས. No entry. Rendered 'nỗ lực' precisely so it does not collide with the view's prov བརྩོན་པ / fixed བརྩོན་འགྲུས = 'tinh tấn', which occurs in this same chunk at p0975 l.1 (བསྒྲུབ་ལ་བརྩོན་པ).

p0974 l.19, བློ་མིག་མ་རིག་གིས་ལྡོངས. Follows the view's prov བློ = 'cái trí' and བློ་གྲོས་ཀྱི་མིག = 'con mắt của trí' (line 418), so the two land on the same phrase — consistent, but the collision is on record.

p0975 l.1, རྒྱལ་བའི་མཛད་པ་རིང་དུ་སྐྱོང་གྱུར་ཅིག. Deliberately NOT 'sự nghiệp', which the view's prov assigns to འཕྲིན་ལས (line 194) — and འཕྲིན་ལས occurs four padas earlier in this same stanza (སྲས་བཅས་རྒྱལ་བའི་རྨད་བྱུང་འཕྲིན་ལས་ལས), so the two had to stay separable.
p0975 l.1, མཐུ་ལྡན་རྣམས་ཀྱིས་རྟག་ཏུ་གྲོགས་བྱེད་ཅིང. No entry. Built on the view's prov མཐུ = 'năng lực / sức' but nominalised as a class of beings (protectors), so a separate wording was needed.
p0973 l.17-18, དང་པོའི་སངས་རྒྱས་འཇམ་པའི་དབྱངས. Epithet of Mañjughoṣa here. Follows FIXED སངས་རྒྱས = 'Phật'.
p0975 l.1. Follows the view's prov གྲོགས = 'bạn hữu' with its explicit prohibition on adding a value-word ('bạn lành'); 'giúp đỡ' renders the verb བྱེད in this idiom, not an added epithet.

c291 L57 བསྟན་པའི་རིམ་པ་ཀུན་ཚང (p0975 l.1) → 'các thứ đệ của giáo pháp'; L80 རིམ་པ་ཐམས་ཅད (p0975 l.3) → 'hết thảy thứ đệ'. KEPT. The view's headword is prov རིམ་པ → 'trình tự', and its own note (view line 251) records that the proposed split — 'thứ đệ' in titles/fixed compounds vs 'trình tự' bare — is NOT yet ruled. The chunk is internally consistent and follows the proposed split. The reason to close the ruling now: the parallel sentence at c004 L62 renders the same རིམ་པ as 'giai trình', so three Vietnamese words ('thứ đệ' / 'trình tự' / 'giai trình') now cover one term inside one formula, and this is the book's last page — whatever is ruled needs a corpus sweep, not a c291-only edit.

The term sits on p0972 (c290) and so is absent from c291's view, and no ruling exists. c290 renders ཐ་མལ་པའི་རྣམ་རྟོག 'sự phân biệt phàm thường'; c291 L11 continued the same sentence with 'phàm tình'. Harmonised to 'phàm thường' in this repair (see fixed[4]). Register the entry so the split does not reappear: ཐ་མལ = 'phàm thường' (ordinary), and note that 'phàm tình' (worldly sentiment) is a weaker match. Occurrences to check in a sweep are all in c290/c291 around p0972–p0973.
